arabic: بِسۡمِ ٱللَّهِ ٱلرَّحۡمَٰنِ ٱلرَّحِيمِ
translation: In the name of Allah, the Entirely Merciful, the Especially Merciful
normalizedArabic: بسم الله الرحمن الرحيم
normalizedTranslation: in the name of allah, the entirely merciful, the especially merciful

arabic: ٱلۡحَمۡدُ لِلَّهِ رَبِّ ٱلۡعَٰلَمِينَ
translation: [All] praise is [due] to Allah, Lord of the worlds
normalizedArabic: الحمد لله رب العلمين
normalizedTranslation: [all] praise is [due] to allah, lord of the worlds

arabic: ٱلرَّحۡمَٰنِ ٱلرَّحِيمِ
translation: The Entirely Merciful, the Especially Merciful
normalizedArabic: الرحمن الرحيم
normalizedTranslation: the entirely merciful, the especially merciful

arabic: مَٰلِكِ يَوۡمِ ٱلدِّينِ
translation: Sovereign of the Day of Recompense
normalizedArabic: ملك يوم الدين
normalizedTranslation: sovereign of the day of recompense

arabic: إِيَّاكَ نَعۡبُدُ وَإِيَّاكَ نَسۡتَعِينُ
translation: It is You we worship and You we ask for help
normalizedArabic: اياك نعبد واياك نستعين
normalizedTranslation: it is you we worship and you we ask for help

arabic: ٱهۡدِنَا ٱلصِّرَٰطَ ٱلۡمُسۡتَقِيمَ
translation: Guide us to the straight path
normalizedArabic: اهدنا الصرط المستقيم
normalizedTranslation: guide us to the straight path

arabic: صِرَٰطَ ٱلَّذِينَ أَنۡعَمۡتَ عَلَيۡهِمۡ غَيۡرِ ٱلۡمَغۡضُوبِ عَلَيۡهِمۡ وَلَا ٱلضَّآلِّينَ
translation: The path of those upon whom You have bestowed favor, not of those who have evoked [Your] anger or of those who are astray
normalizedArabic: صرط الذين انعمت عليهم غير المغضوب عليهم ولا الضالين
normalizedTranslation: the path of those upon whom you have bestowed favor, not of those who have evoked [your] anger or of those who are astray

arabic: الٓمٓ
translation: Alif, Lam, Meem
normalizedArabic: الم
normalizedTranslation: alif, lam, meem

arabic: ذَٰلِكَ ٱلۡكِتَٰبُ لَا رَيۡبَۛ فِيهِۛ هُدٗى لِّلۡمُتَّقِينَ
translation: This is the Book about which there is no doubt, a guidance for those conscious of Allah
normalizedArabic: ذلك الكتب لا ريب فيه هدي للمتقين
normalizedTranslation: this is the book about which there is no doubt, a guidance for those conscious of allah

arabic: ٱلَّذِينَ يُؤۡمِنُونَ بِٱلۡغَيۡبِ وَيُقِيمُونَ ٱلصَّلَوٰةَ وَمِمَّا رَزَقۡنَٰهُمۡ يُنفِقُونَ
translation: Who believe in the unseen, establish prayer, and spend out of what We have provided for them
normalizedArabic: الذين يومنون بالغيب ويقيمون الصلوه ومما رزقنهم ينفقون
normalizedTranslation: who believe in the unseen, establish prayer, and spend out of what we have provided for them

arabic: وَٱلَّذِينَ يُؤۡمِنُونَ بِمَآ أُنزِلَ إِلَيۡكَ وَمَآ أُنزِلَ مِن قَبۡلِكَ وَبِٱلۡأٓخِرَةِ هُمۡ يُوقِنُونَ
translation: And who believe in what has been revealed to you, [O Muhammad], and what was revealed before you, and of the Hereafter they are certain [in faith]
normalizedArabic: والذين يومنون بما انزل اليك وما انزل من قبلك وبالاخره هم يوقنون
normalizedTranslation: and who believe in what has been revealed to you, [o muhammad], and what was revealed before you, and of the hereafter they are certain [in faith]

arabic: أُوْلَـٰٓئِكَ عَلَىٰ هُدٗى مِّن رَّبِّهِمۡۖ وَأُوْلَـٰٓئِكَ هُمُ ٱلۡمُفۡلِحُونَ
translation: Those are upon [right] guidance from their Lord, and it is those who are the successful
normalizedArabic: اوليك علي هدي من ربهم واوليك هم المفلحون
normalizedTranslation: those are upon [right] guidance from their lord, and it is those who are the successful

arabic: إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُواْ سَوَآءٌ عَلَيۡهِمۡ ءَأَنذَرۡتَهُمۡ أَمۡ لَمۡ تُنذِرۡهُمۡ لَا يُؤۡمِنُونَ
translation: Indeed, those who disbelieve - it is all the same for them whether you warn them or do not warn them - they will not believe
normalizedArabic: ان الذين كفروا سواء عليهم ءانذرتهم ام لم تنذرهم لا يومنون
normalizedTranslation: indeed, those who disbelieve - it is all the same for them whether you warn them or do not warn them - they will not believe

arabic: خَتَمَ ٱللَّهُ عَلَىٰ قُلُوبِهِمۡ وَعَلَىٰ سَمۡعِهِمۡۖ وَعَلَىٰٓ أَبۡصَٰرِهِمۡ غِشَٰوَةٞۖ وَلَهُمۡ عَذَابٌ عَظِيمٞ
translation: Allah has set a seal upon their hearts and upon their hearing, and over their vision is a veil. And for them is a great punishment
normalizedArabic: ختم الله علي قلوبهم وعلي سمعهم وعلي ابصرهم غشوه ولهم عذاب عظيم
normalizedTranslation: allah has set a seal upon their hearts and upon their hearing, and over their vision is a veil. and for them is a great punishment

arabic: وَمِنَ ٱلنَّاسِ مَن يَقُولُ ءَامَنَّا بِٱللَّهِ وَبِٱلۡيَوۡمِ ٱلۡأٓخِرِ وَمَا هُم بِمُؤۡمِنِينَ
translation: And of the people are some who say, "We believe in Allah and the Last Day," but they are not believers
normalizedArabic: ومن الناس من يقول ءامنا بالله وباليوم الاخر وما هم بمومنين
normalizedTranslation: and of the people are some who say, "we believe in allah and the last day," but they are not believers

arabic: يُخَٰدِعُونَ ٱللَّهَ وَٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُواْ وَمَا يَخۡدَعُونَ إِلَّآ أَنفُسَهُمۡ وَمَا يَشۡعُرُونَ
translation: They [think to] deceive Allah and those who believe, but they deceive not except themselves and perceive [it] not
normalizedArabic: يخدعون الله والذين ءامنوا وما يخدعون الا انفسهم وما يشعرون
normalizedTranslation: they [think to] deceive allah and those who believe, but they deceive not except themselves and perceive [it] not

arabic: فِي قُلُوبِهِم مَّرَضٞ فَزَادَهُمُ ٱللَّهُ مَرَضٗاۖ وَلَهُمۡ عَذَابٌ أَلِيمُۢ بِمَا كَانُواْ يَكۡذِبُونَ
translation: In their hearts is disease, so Allah has increased their disease; and for them is a painful punishment because they [habitually] used to lie
normalizedArabic: في قلوبهم مرض فزادهم الله مرضا ولهم عذاب اليم بما كانوا يكذبون
normalizedTranslation: in their hearts is disease, so allah has increased their disease; and for them is a painful punishment because they [habitually] used to lie

arabic: وَإِذَا قِيلَ لَهُمۡ لَا تُفۡسِدُواْ فِي ٱلۡأَرۡضِ قَالُوٓاْ إِنَّمَا نَحۡنُ مُصۡلِحُونَ
translation: And when it is said to them, "Do not cause corruption on the earth," they say, "We are but reformers
normalizedArabic: واذا قيل لهم لا تفسدوا في الارض قالوا انما نحن مصلحون
normalizedTranslation: and when it is said to them, "do not cause corruption on the earth," they say, "we are but reformers

arabic: أَلَآ إِنَّهُمۡ هُمُ ٱلۡمُفۡسِدُونَ وَلَٰكِن لَّا يَشۡعُرُونَ
translation: Unquestionably, it is they who are the corrupters, but they perceive [it] not
normalizedArabic: الا انهم هم المفسدون ولكن لا يشعرون
normalizedTranslation: unquestionably, it is they who are the corrupters, but they perceive [it] not

arabic: وَإِذَا قِيلَ لَهُمۡ ءَامِنُواْ كَمَآ ءَامَنَ ٱلنَّاسُ قَالُوٓاْ أَنُؤۡمِنُ كَمَآ ءَامَنَ ٱلسُّفَهَآءُۗ أَلَآ إِنَّهُمۡ هُمُ ٱلسُّفَهَآءُ وَلَٰكِن لَّا يَعۡلَمُونَ
translation: And when it is said to them, "Believe as the people have believed," they say, "Should we believe as the foolish have believed?" Unquestionably, it is they who are the foolish, but they know [it] not
normalizedArabic: واذا قيل لهم ءامنوا كما ءامن الناس قالوا انومن كما ءامن السفهاء الا انهم هم السفهاء ولكن لا يعلمون
normalizedTranslation: and when it is said to them, "believe as the people have believed," they say, "should we believe as the foolish have believed?" unquestionably, it is they who are the foolish, but they know [it] not

arabic: وَإِذَا لَقُواْ ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُواْ قَالُوٓاْ ءَامَنَّا وَإِذَا خَلَوۡاْ إِلَىٰ شَيَٰطِينِهِمۡ قَالُوٓاْ إِنَّا مَعَكُمۡ إِنَّمَا نَحۡنُ مُسۡتَهۡزِءُونَ
translation: And when they meet those who believe, they say, "We believe"; but when they are alone with their evil ones, they say, "Indeed, we are with you; we were only mockers
normalizedArabic: واذا لقوا الذين ءامنوا قالوا ءامنا واذا خلوا الي شيطينهم قالوا انا معكم انما نحن مستهزءون
normalizedTranslation: and when they meet those who believe, they say, "we believe"; but when they are alone with their evil ones, they say, "indeed, we are with you; we were only mockers

arabic: ٱللَّهُ يَسۡتَهۡزِئُ بِهِمۡ وَيَمُدُّهُمۡ فِي طُغۡيَٰنِهِمۡ يَعۡمَهُونَ
translation: [But] Allah mocks them and prolongs them in their transgression [while] they wander blindly
normalizedArabic: الله يستهزي بهم ويمدهم في طغينهم يعمهون
normalizedTranslation: [but] allah mocks them and prolongs them in their transgression [while] they wander blindly

arabic: أُوْلَـٰٓئِكَ ٱلَّذِينَ ٱشۡتَرَوُاْ ٱلضَّلَٰلَةَ بِٱلۡهُدَىٰ فَمَا رَبِحَت تِّجَٰرَتُهُمۡ وَمَا كَانُواْ مُهۡتَدِينَ
translation: Those are the ones who have purchased error [in exchange] for guidance, so their transaction has brought no profit, nor were they guided
normalizedArabic: اوليك الذين اشتروا الضلله بالهدي فما ربحت تجرتهم وما كانوا مهتدين
normalizedTranslation: those are the ones who have purchased error [in exchange] for guidance, so their transaction has brought no profit, nor were they guided

arabic: مَثَلُهُمۡ كَمَثَلِ ٱلَّذِي ٱسۡتَوۡقَدَ نَارٗا فَلَمَّآ أَضَآءَتۡ مَا حَوۡلَهُۥ ذَهَبَ ٱللَّهُ بِنُورِهِمۡ وَتَرَكَهُمۡ فِي ظُلُمَٰتٖ لَّا يُبۡصِرُونَ
translation: Their example is that of one who kindled a fire, but when it illuminated what was around him, Allah took away their light and left them in darkness [so] they could not see
normalizedArabic: مثلهم كمثل الذي استوقد نارا فلما اضاءت ما حوله ذهب الله بنورهم وتركهم في ظلمت لا يبصرون
normalizedTranslation: their example is that of one who kindled a fire, but when it illuminated what was around him, allah took away their light and left them in darkness [so] they could not see

arabic: صُمُّۢ بُكۡمٌ عُمۡيٞ فَهُمۡ لَا يَرۡجِعُونَ
translation: Deaf, dumb and blind - so they will not return [to the right path]
normalizedArabic: صم بكم عمي فهم لا يرجعون
normalizedTranslation: deaf, dumb and blind - so they will not return [to the right path]

arabic: أَوۡ كَصَيِّبٖ مِّنَ ٱلسَّمَآءِ فِيهِ ظُلُمَٰتٞ وَرَعۡدٞ وَبَرۡقٞ يَجۡعَلُونَ أَصَٰبِعَهُمۡ فِيٓ ءَاذَانِهِم مِّنَ ٱلصَّوَٰعِقِ حَذَرَ ٱلۡمَوۡتِۚ وَٱللَّهُ مُحِيطُۢ بِٱلۡكَٰفِرِينَ
translation: Or [it is] like a rainstorm from the sky within which is darkness, thunder and lightning. They put their fingers in their ears against the thunderclaps in dread of death. But Allah is encompassing of the disbelievers
normalizedArabic: او كصيب من السماء فيه ظلمت ورعد وبرق يجعلون اصبعهم في ءاذانهم من الصوعق حذر الموت والله محيط بالكفرين
normalizedTranslation: or [it is] like a rainstorm from the sky within which is darkness, thunder and lightning. they put their fingers in their ears against the thunderclaps in dread of death. but allah is encompassing of the disbelievers

arabic: يَكَادُ ٱلۡبَرۡقُ يَخۡطَفُ أَبۡصَٰرَهُمۡۖ كُلَّمَآ أَضَآءَ لَهُم مَّشَوۡاْ فِيهِ وَإِذَآ أَظۡلَمَ عَلَيۡهِمۡ قَامُواْۚ وَلَوۡ شَآءَ ٱللَّهُ لَذَهَبَ بِسَمۡعِهِمۡ وَأَبۡصَٰرِهِمۡۚ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ عَلَىٰ كُلِّ شَيۡءٖ قَدِيرٞ
translation: The lightning almost snatches away their sight. Every time it lights [the way] for them, they walk therein; but when darkness comes over them, they stand [still]. And if Allah had willed, He could have taken away their hearing and their sight. Indeed, Allah is over all things competent
normalizedArabic: يكاد البرق يخطف ابصرهم كلما اضاء لهم مشوا فيه واذا اظلم عليهم قاموا ولو شاء الله لذهب بسمعهم وابصرهم ان الله علي كل شيء قدير
normalizedTranslation: the lightning almost snatches away their sight. every time it lights [the way] for them, they walk therein; but when darkness comes over them, they stand [still]. and if allah had willed, he could have taken away their hearing and their sight. indeed, allah is over all things competent

arabic: يَـٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلنَّاسُ ٱعۡبُدُواْ رَبَّكُمُ ٱلَّذِي خَلَقَكُمۡ وَٱلَّذِينَ مِن قَبۡلِكُمۡ لَعَلَّكُمۡ تَتَّقُونَ
translation: O mankind, worship your Lord, who created you and those before you, that you may become righteous
normalizedArabic: يايها الناس اعبدوا ربكم الذي خلقكم والذين من قبلكم لعلكم تتقون
normalizedTranslation: o mankind, worship your lord, who created you and those before you, that you may become righteous

arabic: ٱلَّذِي جَعَلَ لَكُمُ ٱلۡأَرۡضَ فِرَٰشٗا وَٱلسَّمَآءَ بِنَآءٗ وَأَنزَلَ مِنَ ٱلسَّمَآءِ مَآءٗ فَأَخۡرَجَ بِهِۦ مِنَ ٱلثَّمَرَٰتِ رِزۡقٗا لَّكُمۡۖ فَلَا تَجۡعَلُواْ لِلَّهِ أَندَادٗا وَأَنتُمۡ تَعۡلَمُونَ
translation: [He] who made for you the earth a bed [spread out] and the sky a ceiling and sent down from the sky, rain and brought forth thereby fruits as provision for you. So do not attribute to Allah equals while you know [that there is nothing similar to Him]
normalizedArabic: الذي جعل لكم الارض فرشا والسماء بناء وانزل من السماء ماء فاخرج به من الثمرت رزقا لكم فلا تجعلوا لله اندادا وانتم تعلمون
normalizedTranslation: [he] who made for you the earth a bed [spread out] and the sky a ceiling and sent down from the sky, rain and brought forth thereby fruits as provision for you. so do not attribute to allah equals while you know [that there is nothing similar to him]

arabic: وَإِن كُنتُمۡ فِي رَيۡبٖ مِّمَّا نَزَّلۡنَا عَلَىٰ عَبۡدِنَا فَأۡتُواْ بِسُورَةٖ مِّن مِّثۡلِهِۦ وَٱدۡعُواْ شُهَدَآءَكُم مِّن دُونِ ٱللَّهِ إِن كُنتُمۡ صَٰدِقِينَ
translation: And if you are in doubt about what We have sent down upon Our Servant [Muhammad], then produce a surah the like thereof and call upon your witnesses other than Allah, if you should be truthful
normalizedArabic: وان كنتم في ريب مما نزلنا علي عبدنا فاتوا بسوره من مثله وادعوا شهداءكم من دون الله ان كنتم صدقين
normalizedTranslation: and if you are in doubt about what we have sent down upon our servant [muhammad], then produce a surah the like thereof and call upon your witnesses other than allah, if you should be truthful

arabic: فَإِن لَّمۡ تَفۡعَلُواْ وَلَن تَفۡعَلُواْ فَٱتَّقُواْ ٱلنَّارَ ٱلَّتِي وَقُودُهَا ٱلنَّاسُ وَٱلۡحِجَارَةُۖ أُعِدَّتۡ لِلۡكَٰفِرِينَ
translation: But if you do not - and you will never be able to - then fear the Fire, whose fuel is men and stones, prepared for the disbelievers
normalizedArabic: فان لم تفعلوا ولن تفعلوا فاتقوا النار التي وقودها الناس والحجاره اعدت للكفرين
normalizedTranslation: but if you do not - and you will never be able to - then fear the fire, whose fuel is men and stones, prepared for the disbelievers

arabic: وَبَشِّرِ ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُواْ وَعَمِلُواْ ٱلصَّـٰلِحَٰتِ أَنَّ لَهُمۡ جَنَّـٰتٖ تَجۡرِي مِن تَحۡتِهَا ٱلۡأَنۡهَٰرُۖ كُلَّمَا رُزِقُواْ مِنۡهَا مِن ثَمَرَةٖ رِّزۡقٗا قَالُواْ هَٰذَا ٱلَّذِي رُزِقۡنَا مِن قَبۡلُۖ وَأُتُواْ بِهِۦ مُتَشَٰبِهٗاۖ وَلَهُمۡ فِيهَآ أَزۡوَٰجٞ مُّطَهَّرَةٞۖ وَهُمۡ فِيهَا خَٰلِدُونَ
translation: And give good tidings to those who believe and do righteous deeds that they will have gardens [in Paradise] beneath which rivers flow. Whenever they are provided with a provision of fruit therefrom, they will say, "This is what we were provided with before." And it is given to them in likeness. And they will have therein purified spouses, and they will abide therein eternally
normalizedArabic: وبشر الذين ءامنوا وعملوا الصلحت ان لهم جنت تجري من تحتها الانهر كلما رزقوا منها من ثمره رزقا قالوا هذا الذي رزقنا من قبل واتوا به متشبها ولهم فيها ازوج مطهره وهم فيها خلدون
normalizedTranslation: and give good tidings to those who believe and do righteous deeds that they will have gardens [in paradise] beneath which rivers flow. whenever they are provided with a provision of fruit therefrom, they will say, "this is what we were provided with before." and it is given to them in likeness. and they will have therein purified spouses, and they will abide therein eternally

arabic: ۞إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ لَا يَسۡتَحۡيِۦٓ أَن يَضۡرِبَ مَثَلٗا مَّا بَعُوضَةٗ فَمَا فَوۡقَهَاۚ فَأَمَّا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُواْ فَيَعۡلَمُونَ أَنَّهُ ٱلۡحَقُّ مِن رَّبِّهِمۡۖ وَأَمَّا ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُواْ فَيَقُولُونَ مَاذَآ أَرَادَ ٱللَّهُ بِهَٰذَا مَثَلٗاۘ يُضِلُّ بِهِۦ كَثِيرٗا وَيَهۡدِي بِهِۦ كَثِيرٗاۚ وَمَا يُضِلُّ بِهِۦٓ إِلَّا ٱلۡفَٰسِقِينَ
translation: Indeed, Allah is not timid to present an example - that of a mosquito or what is smaller than it. And those who have believed know that it is the truth from their Lord. But as for those who disbelieve, they say, "What did Allah intend by this as an example?" He misleads many thereby and guides many thereby. And He misleads not except the defiantly disobedient
normalizedArabic: ان الله لا يستحي ان يضرب مثلا ما بعوضه فما فوقها فاما الذين ءامنوا فيعلمون انه الحق من ربهم واما الذين كفروا فيقولون ماذا اراد الله بهذا مثلا يضل به كثيرا ويهدي به كثيرا وما يضل به الا الفسقين
normalizedTranslation: indeed, allah is not timid to present an example - that of a mosquito or what is smaller than it. and those who have believed know that it is the truth from their lord. but as for those who disbelieve, they say, "what did allah intend by this as an example?" he misleads many thereby and guides many thereby. and he misleads not except the defiantly disobedient

arabic: ٱلَّذِينَ يَنقُضُونَ عَهۡدَ ٱللَّهِ مِنۢ بَعۡدِ مِيثَٰقِهِۦ وَيَقۡطَعُونَ مَآ أَمَرَ ٱللَّهُ بِهِۦٓ أَن يُوصَلَ وَيُفۡسِدُونَ فِي ٱلۡأَرۡضِۚ أُوْلَـٰٓئِكَ هُمُ ٱلۡخَٰسِرُونَ
translation: Who break the covenant of Allah after contracting it and sever that which Allah has ordered to be joined and cause corruption on earth. It is those who are the losers
normalizedArabic: الذين ينقضون عهد الله من بعد ميثقه ويقطعون ما امر الله به ان يوصل ويفسدون في الارض اوليك هم الخسرون
normalizedTranslation: who break the covenant of allah after contracting it and sever that which allah has ordered to be joined and cause corruption on earth. it is those who are the losers

arabic: كَيۡفَ تَكۡفُرُونَ بِٱللَّهِ وَكُنتُمۡ أَمۡوَٰتٗا فَأَحۡيَٰكُمۡۖ ثُمَّ يُمِيتُكُمۡ ثُمَّ يُحۡيِيكُمۡ ثُمَّ إِلَيۡهِ تُرۡجَعُونَ
translation: How can you disbelieve in Allah when you were lifeless and He brought you to life; then He will cause you to die, then He will bring you [back] to life, and then to Him you will be returned
normalizedArabic: كيف تكفرون بالله وكنتم اموتا فاحيكم ثم يميتكم ثم يحييكم ثم اليه ترجعون
normalizedTranslation: how can you disbelieve in allah when you were lifeless and he brought you to life; then he will cause you to die, then he will bring you [back] to life, and then to him you will be returned

arabic: هُوَ ٱلَّذِي خَلَقَ لَكُم مَّا فِي ٱلۡأَرۡضِ جَمِيعٗا ثُمَّ ٱسۡتَوَىٰٓ إِلَى ٱلسَّمَآءِ فَسَوَّىٰهُنَّ سَبۡعَ سَمَٰوَٰتٖۚ وَهُوَ بِكُلِّ شَيۡءٍ عَلِيمٞ
translation: It is He who created for you all of that which is on the earth. Then He directed Himself to the heaven, [His being above all creation], and made them seven heavens, and He is Knowing of all things
normalizedArabic: هو الذي خلق لكم ما في الارض جميعا ثم استوي الي السماء فسويهن سبع سموت وهو بكل شيء عليم
normalizedTranslation: it is he who created for you all of that which is on the earth. then he directed himself to the heaven, [his being above all creation], and made them seven heavens, and he is knowing of all things

arabic: وَإِذۡ قَالَ رَبُّكَ لِلۡمَلَـٰٓئِكَةِ إِنِّي جَاعِلٞ فِي ٱلۡأَرۡضِ خَلِيفَةٗۖ قَالُوٓاْ أَتَجۡعَلُ فِيهَا مَن يُفۡسِدُ فِيهَا وَيَسۡفِكُ ٱلدِّمَآءَ وَنَحۡنُ نُسَبِّحُ بِحَمۡدِكَ وَنُقَدِّسُ لَكَۖ قَالَ إِنِّيٓ أَعۡلَمُ مَا لَا تَعۡلَمُونَ
translation: And [mention, O Muhammad], when your Lord said to the angels, "Indeed, I will make upon the earth a successive authority." They said, "Will You place upon it one who causes corruption therein and sheds blood, while we declare Your praise and sanctify You?" Allah said, "Indeed, I know that which you do not know
normalizedArabic: واذ قال ربك للمليكه اني جاعل في الارض خليفه قالوا اتجعل فيها من يفسد فيها ويسفك الدماء ونحن نسبح بحمدك ونقدس لك قال اني اعلم ما لا تعلمون
normalizedTranslation: and [mention, o muhammad], when your lord said to the angels, "indeed, i will make upon the earth a successive authority." they said, "will you place upon it one who causes corruption therein and sheds blood, while we declare your praise and sanctify you?" allah said, "indeed, i know that which you do not know

arabic: وَعَلَّمَ ءَادَمَ ٱلۡأَسۡمَآءَ كُلَّهَا ثُمَّ عَرَضَهُمۡ عَلَى ٱلۡمَلَـٰٓئِكَةِ فَقَالَ أَنۢبِـُٔونِي بِأَسۡمَآءِ هَـٰٓؤُلَآءِ إِن كُنتُمۡ صَٰدِقِينَ
translation: And He taught Adam the names - all of them. Then He showed them to the angels and said, "Inform Me of the names of these, if you are truthful
normalizedArabic: وعلم ءادم الاسماء كلها ثم عرضهم علي المليكه فقال انبوني باسماء هولاء ان كنتم صدقين
normalizedTranslation: and he taught adam the names - all of them. then he showed them to the angels and said, "inform me of the names of these, if you are truthful

arabic: قَالُواْ سُبۡحَٰنَكَ لَا عِلۡمَ لَنَآ إِلَّا مَا عَلَّمۡتَنَآۖ إِنَّكَ أَنتَ ٱلۡعَلِيمُ ٱلۡحَكِيمُ
translation: They said, "Exalted are You; we have no knowledge except what You have taught us. Indeed, it is You who is the Knowing, the Wise
normalizedArabic: قالوا سبحنك لا علم لنا الا ما علمتنا انك انت العليم الحكيم
normalizedTranslation: they said, "exalted are you; we have no knowledge except what you have taught us. indeed, it is you who is the knowing, the wise

arabic: قَالَ يَـٰٓـَٔادَمُ أَنۢبِئۡهُم بِأَسۡمَآئِهِمۡۖ فَلَمَّآ أَنۢبَأَهُم بِأَسۡمَآئِهِمۡ قَالَ أَلَمۡ أَقُل لَّكُمۡ إِنِّيٓ أَعۡلَمُ غَيۡبَ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلۡأَرۡضِ وَأَعۡلَمُ مَا تُبۡدُونَ وَمَا كُنتُمۡ تَكۡتُمُونَ
translation: He said, "O Adam, inform them of their names." And when he had informed them of their names, He said, "Did I not tell you that I know the unseen [aspects] of the heavens and the earth? And I know what you reveal and what you have concealed
normalizedArabic: قال يادم انبيهم باسمايهم فلما انباهم باسمايهم قال الم اقل لكم اني اعلم غيب السموت والارض واعلم ما تبدون وما كنتم تكتمون
normalizedTranslation: he said, "o adam, inform them of their names." and when he had informed them of their names, he said, "did i not tell you that i know the unseen [aspects] of the heavens and the earth? and i know what you reveal and what you have concealed

arabic: وَإِذۡ قُلۡنَا لِلۡمَلَـٰٓئِكَةِ ٱسۡجُدُواْ لِأٓدَمَ فَسَجَدُوٓاْ إِلَّآ إِبۡلِيسَ أَبَىٰ وَٱسۡتَكۡبَرَ وَكَانَ مِنَ ٱلۡكَٰفِرِينَ
translation: And [mention] when We said to the angels, "Prostrate before Adam"; so they prostrated, except for Iblees. He refused and was arrogant and became of the disbelievers
normalizedArabic: واذ قلنا للمليكه اسجدوا لادم فسجدوا الا ابليس ابي واستكبر وكان من الكفرين
normalizedTranslation: and [mention] when we said to the angels, "prostrate before adam"; so they prostrated, except for iblees. he refused and was arrogant and became of the disbelievers

arabic: وَقُلۡنَا يَـٰٓـَٔادَمُ ٱسۡكُنۡ أَنتَ وَزَوۡجُكَ ٱلۡجَنَّةَ وَكُلَا مِنۡهَا رَغَدًا حَيۡثُ شِئۡتُمَا وَلَا تَقۡرَبَا هَٰذِهِ ٱلشَّجَرَةَ فَتَكُونَا مِنَ ٱلظَّـٰلِمِينَ
translation: And We said, "O Adam, dwell, you and your wife, in Paradise and eat therefrom in [ease and] abundance from wherever you will. But do not approach this tree, lest you be among the wrongdoers

normalizedTranslation: and we said, "o adam, dwell, you and your wife, in paradise and eat therefrom in [ease and] abundance from wherever you will. but do not approach this tree, lest you be among the wrongdoers

arabic: فَأَزَلَّهُمَا ٱلشَّيۡطَٰنُ عَنۡهَا فَأَخۡرَجَهُمَا مِمَّا كَانَا فِيهِۖ وَقُلۡنَا ٱهۡبِطُواْ بَعۡضُكُمۡ لِبَعۡضٍ عَدُوّٞۖ وَلَكُمۡ فِي ٱلۡأَرۡضِ مُسۡتَقَرّٞ وَمَتَٰعٌ إِلَىٰ حِينٖ
translation: But Satan caused them to slip out of it and removed them from that [condition] in which they had been. And We said, "Go down, [all of you], as enemies to one another, and you will have upon the earth a place of settlement and provision for a time
normalizedArabic: فازلهما الشيطن عنها فاخرجهما مما كانا فيه وقلنا اهبطوا بعضكم لبعض عدو ولكم في الارض مستقر ومتع الي حين
normalizedTranslation: but satan caused them to slip out of it and removed them from that [condition] in which they had been. and we said, "go down, [all of you], as enemies to one another, and you will have upon the earth a place of settlement and provision for a time

arabic: فَتَلَقَّىٰٓ ءَادَمُ مِن رَّبِّهِۦ كَلِمَٰتٖ فَتَابَ عَلَيۡهِۚ إِنَّهُۥ هُوَ ٱلتَّوَّابُ ٱلرَّحِيمُ
translation: Then Adam received from his Lord [some] words, and He accepted his repentance. Indeed, it is He who is the Accepting of repentance, the Merciful

normalizedTranslation: then adam received from his lord [some] words, and he accepted his repentance. indeed, it is he who is the accepting of repentance, the merciful

arabic: قُلۡنَا ٱهۡبِطُواْ مِنۡهَا جَمِيعٗاۖ فَإِمَّا يَأۡتِيَنَّكُم مِّنِّي هُدٗى فَمَن تَبِعَ هُدَايَ فَلَا خَوۡفٌ عَلَيۡهِمۡ وَلَا هُمۡ يَحۡزَنُونَ
translation: We said, "Go down from it, all of you. And when guidance comes to you from Me, whoever follows My guidance - there will be no fear concerning them, nor will they grieve
normalizedArabic: قلنا اهبطوا منها جميعا فاما ياتينكم مني هدي فمن تبع هداي فلا خوف عليهم ولا هم يحزنون
normalizedTranslation: we said, "go down from it, all of you. and when guidance comes to you from me, whoever follows my guidance - there will be no fear concerning them, nor will they grieve

arabic: وَٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُواْ وَكَذَّبُواْ بِـَٔايَٰتِنَآ أُوْلَـٰٓئِكَ أَصۡحَٰبُ ٱلنَّارِۖ هُمۡ فِيهَا خَٰلِدُونَ
translation: And those who disbelieve and deny Our signs - those will be companions of the Fire; they will abide therein eternally
normalizedArabic: والذين كفروا وكذبوا بايتنا اوليك اصحب النار هم فيها خلدون
normalizedTranslation: and those who disbelieve and deny our signs - those will be companions of the fire; they will abide therein eternally

arabic: يَٰبَنِيٓ إِسۡرَـٰٓءِيلَ ٱذۡكُرُواْ نِعۡمَتِيَ ٱلَّتِيٓ أَنۡعَمۡتُ عَلَيۡكُمۡ وَأَوۡفُواْ بِعَهۡدِيٓ أُوفِ بِعَهۡدِكُمۡ وَإِيَّـٰيَ فَٱرۡهَبُونِ
translation: O Children of Israel, remember My favor which I have bestowed upon you and fulfill My covenant [upon you] that I will fulfill your covenant [from Me], and be afraid of [only] Me
normalizedArabic: يبني اسرءيل اذكروا نعمتي التي انعمت عليكم واوفوا بعهدي اوف بعهدكم وايي فارهبون
normalizedTranslation: o children of israel, remember my favor which i have bestowed upon you and fulfill my covenant [upon you] that i will fulfill your covenant [from me], and be afraid of [only] me

arabic: وَءَامِنُواْ بِمَآ أَنزَلۡتُ مُصَدِّقٗا لِّمَا مَعَكُمۡ وَلَا تَكُونُوٓاْ أَوَّلَ كَافِرِۭ بِهِۦۖ وَلَا تَشۡتَرُواْ بِـَٔايَٰتِي ثَمَنٗا قَلِيلٗا وَإِيَّـٰيَ فَٱتَّقُونِ
translation: And believe in what I have sent down confirming that which is [already] with you, and be not the first to disbelieve in it. And do not exchange My signs for a small price, and fear [only] Me

normalizedTranslation: and believe in what i have sent down confirming that which is [already] with you, and be not the first to disbelieve in it. and do not exchange my signs for a small price, and fear [only] me

arabic: وَلَا تَلۡبِسُواْ ٱلۡحَقَّ بِٱلۡبَٰطِلِ وَتَكۡتُمُواْ ٱلۡحَقَّ وَأَنتُمۡ تَعۡلَمُونَ
translation: And do not mix the truth with falsehood or conceal the truth while you know [it]
normalizedArabic: ولا تلبسوا الحق بالبطل وتكتموا الحق وانتم تعلمون
normalizedTranslation: and do not mix the truth with falsehood or conceal the truth while you know [it]

arabic: وَأَقِيمُواْ ٱلصَّلَوٰةَ وَءَاتُواْ ٱلزَّكَوٰةَ وَٱرۡكَعُواْ مَعَ ٱلرَّـٰكِعِينَ

normalizedTranslation: and establish prayer and give zakah and bow with those who bow [in worship and obedience]

arabic: ۞أَتَأۡمُرُونَ ٱلنَّاسَ بِٱلۡبِرِّ وَتَنسَوۡنَ أَنفُسَكُمۡ وَأَنتُمۡ تَتۡلُونَ ٱلۡكِتَٰبَۚ أَفَلَا تَعۡقِلُونَ
translation: Do you order righteousness of the people and forget yourselves while you recite the Scripture? Then will you not reason

arabic: وَٱسۡتَعِينُواْ بِٱلصَّبۡرِ وَٱلصَّلَوٰةِۚ وَإِنَّهَا لَكَبِيرَةٌ إِلَّا عَلَى ٱلۡخَٰشِعِينَ
translation: And seek help through patience and prayer, and indeed, it is difficult except for the humbly submissive [to Allah]

normalizedTranslation: and seek help through patience and prayer, and indeed, it is difficult except for the humbly submissive [to allah]

arabic: ٱلَّذِينَ يَظُنُّونَ أَنَّهُم مُّلَٰقُواْ رَبِّهِمۡ وَأَنَّهُمۡ إِلَيۡهِ رَٰجِعُونَ

arabic: وَٱتَّقُواْ يَوۡمٗا لَّا تَجۡزِي نَفۡسٌ عَن نَّفۡسٖ شَيۡـٔٗا وَلَا يُقۡبَلُ مِنۡهَا شَفَٰعَةٞ وَلَا يُؤۡخَذُ مِنۡهَا عَدۡلٞ وَلَا هُمۡ يُنصَرُونَ
translation: And fear a Day when no soul will suffice for another soul at all, nor will intercession be accepted from it, nor will compensation be taken from it, nor will they be aided

normalizedTranslation: and fear a day when no soul will suffice for another soul at all, nor will intercession be accepted from it, nor will compensation be taken from it, nor will they be aided

arabic: وَإِذۡ نَجَّيۡنَٰكُم مِّنۡ ءَالِ فِرۡعَوۡنَ يَسُومُونَكُمۡ سُوٓءَ ٱلۡعَذَابِ يُذَبِّحُونَ أَبۡنَآءَكُمۡ وَيَسۡتَحۡيُونَ نِسَآءَكُمۡۚ وَفِي ذَٰلِكُم بَلَآءٞ مِّن رَّبِّكُمۡ عَظِيمٞ
translation: And [recall] when We saved your forefathers from the people of Pharaoh, who afflicted you with the worst torment, slaughtering your [newborn] sons and keeping your females alive. And in that was a great trial from your Lord
normalizedArabic: واذ نجينكم من ءال فرعون يسومونكم سوء العذاب يذبحون ابناءكم ويستحيون نساءكم وفي ذلكم بلاء من ربكم عظيم
normalizedTranslation: and [recall] when we saved your forefathers from the people of pharaoh, who afflicted you with the worst torment, slaughtering your [newborn] sons and keeping your females alive. and in that was a great trial from your lord

arabic: وَإِذۡ فَرَقۡنَا بِكُمُ ٱلۡبَحۡرَ فَأَنجَيۡنَٰكُمۡ وَأَغۡرَقۡنَآ ءَالَ فِرۡعَوۡنَ وَأَنتُمۡ تَنظُرُونَ
translation: And [recall] when We parted the sea for you and saved you and drowned the people of Pharaoh while you were looking on
normalizedArabic: واذ فرقنا بكم البحر فانجينكم واغرقنا ءال فرعون وانتم تنظرون
normalizedTranslation: and [recall] when we parted the sea for you and saved you and drowned the people of pharaoh while you were looking on

arabic: وَإِذۡ وَٰعَدۡنَا مُوسَىٰٓ أَرۡبَعِينَ لَيۡلَةٗ ثُمَّ ٱتَّخَذۡتُمُ ٱلۡعِجۡلَ مِنۢ بَعۡدِهِۦ وَأَنتُمۡ ظَٰلِمُونَ
translation: And [recall] when We made an appointment with Moses for forty nights. Then you took [for worship] the calf after him, while you were wrongdoers
normalizedArabic: واذ وعدنا موسي اربعين ليله ثم اتخذتم العجل من بعده وانتم ظلمون
normalizedTranslation: and [recall] when we made an appointment with moses for forty nights. then you took [for worship] the calf after him, while you were wrongdoers

arabic: ثُمَّ عَفَوۡنَا عَنكُم مِّنۢ بَعۡدِ ذَٰلِكَ لَعَلَّكُمۡ تَشۡكُرُونَ
translation: Then We forgave you after that so perhaps you would be grateful
normalizedArabic: ثم عفونا عنكم من بعد ذلك لعلكم تشكرون
normalizedTranslation: then we forgave you after that so perhaps you would be grateful

arabic: وَإِذۡ ءَاتَيۡنَا مُوسَى ٱلۡكِتَٰبَ وَٱلۡفُرۡقَانَ لَعَلَّكُمۡ تَهۡتَدُونَ
translation: And [recall] when We gave Moses the Scripture and criterion that perhaps you would be guided
normalizedArabic: واذ ءاتينا موسي الكتب والفرقان لعلكم تهتدون
normalizedTranslation: and [recall] when we gave moses the scripture and criterion that perhaps you would be guided

arabic: وَإِذۡ قَالَ مُوسَىٰ لِقَوۡمِهِۦ يَٰقَوۡمِ إِنَّكُمۡ ظَلَمۡتُمۡ أَنفُسَكُم بِٱتِّخَاذِكُمُ ٱلۡعِجۡلَ فَتُوبُوٓاْ إِلَىٰ بَارِئِكُمۡ فَٱقۡتُلُوٓاْ أَنفُسَكُمۡ ذَٰلِكُمۡ خَيۡرٞ لَّكُمۡ عِندَ بَارِئِكُمۡ فَتَابَ عَلَيۡكُمۡۚ إِنَّهُۥ هُوَ ٱلتَّوَّابُ ٱلرَّحِيمُ
translation: And [recall] when Moses said to his people, "O my people, indeed you have wronged yourselves by your taking of the calf [for worship]. So repent to your Creator and kill yourselves. That is best for [all of] you in the sight of your Creator." Then He accepted your repentance; indeed, He is the Accepting of repentance, the Merciful
normalizedArabic: واذ قال موسي لقومه يقوم انكم ظلمتم انفسكم باتخاذكم العجل فتوبوا الي باريكم فاقتلوا انفسكم ذلكم خير لكم عند باريكم فتاب عليكم انه هو التواب الرحيم
normalizedTranslation: and [recall] when moses said to his people, "o my people, indeed you have wronged yourselves by your taking of the calf [for worship]. so repent to your creator and kill yourselves. that is best for [all of] you in the sight of your creator." then he accepted your repentance; indeed, he is the accepting of repentance, the merciful

arabic: وَإِذۡ قُلۡتُمۡ يَٰمُوسَىٰ لَن نُّؤۡمِنَ لَكَ حَتَّىٰ نَرَى ٱللَّهَ جَهۡرَةٗ فَأَخَذَتۡكُمُ ٱلصَّـٰعِقَةُ وَأَنتُمۡ تَنظُرُونَ
translation: And [recall] when you said, "O Moses, we will never believe you until we see Allah outright"; so the thunderbolt took you while you were looking on
normalizedArabic: واذ قلتم يموسي لن نومن لك حتي نري الله جهره فاخذتكم الصعقه وانتم تنظرون
normalizedTranslation: and [recall] when you said, "o moses, we will never believe you until we see allah outright"; so the thunderbolt took you while you were looking on

arabic: ثُمَّ بَعَثۡنَٰكُم مِّنۢ بَعۡدِ مَوۡتِكُمۡ لَعَلَّكُمۡ تَشۡكُرُونَ
translation: Then We revived you after your death that perhaps you would be grateful
normalizedArabic: ثم بعثنكم من بعد موتكم لعلكم تشكرون
normalizedTranslation: then we revived you after your death that perhaps you would be grateful

arabic: وَظَلَّلۡنَا عَلَيۡكُمُ ٱلۡغَمَامَ وَأَنزَلۡنَا عَلَيۡكُمُ ٱلۡمَنَّ وَٱلسَّلۡوَىٰۖ كُلُواْ مِن طَيِّبَٰتِ مَا رَزَقۡنَٰكُمۡۚ وَمَا ظَلَمُونَا وَلَٰكِن كَانُوٓاْ أَنفُسَهُمۡ يَظۡلِمُونَ
translation: And We shaded you with clouds and sent down to you manna and quails, [saying], "Eat from the good things with which We have provided you." And they wronged Us not - but they were [only] wronging themselves
normalizedArabic: وظللنا عليكم الغمام وانزلنا عليكم المن والسلوي كلوا من طيبت ما رزقنكم وما ظلمونا ولكن كانوا انفسهم يظلمون
normalizedTranslation: and we shaded you with clouds and sent down to you manna and quails, [saying], "eat from the good things with which we have provided you." and they wronged us not - but they were [only] wronging themselves

arabic: وَإِذۡ قُلۡنَا ٱدۡخُلُواْ هَٰذِهِ ٱلۡقَرۡيَةَ فَكُلُواْ مِنۡهَا حَيۡثُ شِئۡتُمۡ رَغَدٗا وَٱدۡخُلُواْ ٱلۡبَابَ سُجَّدٗا وَقُولُواْ حِطَّةٞ نَّغۡفِرۡ لَكُمۡ خَطَٰيَٰكُمۡۚ وَسَنَزِيدُ ٱلۡمُحۡسِنِينَ
translation: And [recall] when We said, "Enter this city and eat from it wherever you will in [ease and] abundance, and enter the gate bowing humbly and say, 'Relieve us of our burdens.' We will [then] forgive your sins for you, and We will increase the doers of good [in goodness and reward]
normalizedArabic: واذ قلنا ادخلوا هذه القريه فكلوا منها حيث شيتم رغدا وادخلوا الباب سجدا وقولوا حطه نغفر لكم خطيكم وسنزيد المحسنين
normalizedTranslation: and [recall] when we said, "enter this city and eat from it wherever you will in [ease and] abundance, and enter the gate bowing humbly and say, 'relieve us of our burdens.' we will [then] forgive your sins for you, and we will increase the doers of good [in goodness and reward]

arabic: فَبَدَّلَ ٱلَّذِينَ ظَلَمُواْ قَوۡلًا غَيۡرَ ٱلَّذِي قِيلَ لَهُمۡ فَأَنزَلۡنَا عَلَى ٱلَّذِينَ ظَلَمُواْ رِجۡزٗا مِّنَ ٱلسَّمَآءِ بِمَا كَانُواْ يَفۡسُقُونَ
translation: But those who wronged changed [those words] to a statement other than that which had been said to them, so We sent down upon those who wronged a punishment from the sky because they were defiantly disobeying
normalizedArabic: فبدل الذين ظلموا قولا غير الذي قيل لهم فانزلنا علي الذين ظلموا رجزا من السماء بما كانوا يفسقون
normalizedTranslation: but those who wronged changed [those words] to a statement other than that which had been said to them, so we sent down upon those who wronged a punishment from the sky because they were defiantly disobeying

arabic: ۞وَإِذِ ٱسۡتَسۡقَىٰ مُوسَىٰ لِقَوۡمِهِۦ فَقُلۡنَا ٱضۡرِب بِّعَصَاكَ ٱلۡحَجَرَۖ فَٱنفَجَرَتۡ مِنۡهُ ٱثۡنَتَا عَشۡرَةَ عَيۡنٗاۖ قَدۡ عَلِمَ كُلُّ أُنَاسٖ مَّشۡرَبَهُمۡۖ كُلُواْ وَٱشۡرَبُواْ مِن رِّزۡقِ ٱللَّهِ وَلَا تَعۡثَوۡاْ فِي ٱلۡأَرۡضِ مُفۡسِدِينَ
translation: And [recall] when Moses prayed for water for his people, so We said, "Strike with your staff the stone." And there gushed forth from it twelve springs, and every people knew its watering place. "Eat and drink from the provision of Allah, and do not commit abuse on the earth, spreading corruption

normalizedTranslation: and [recall] when moses prayed for water for his people, so we said, "strike with your staff the stone." and there gushed forth from it twelve springs, and every people knew its watering place. arabic: وَإِذۡ قُلۡتُمۡ يَٰمُوسَىٰ لَن نَّصۡبِرَ عَلَىٰ طَعَامٖ وَٰحِدٖ فَٱدۡعُ لَنَا رَبَّكَ يُخۡرِجۡ لَنَا مِمَّا تُنۢبِتُ ٱلۡأَرۡضُ مِنۢ بَقۡلِهَا وَقِثَّآئِهَا وَفُومِهَا وَعَدَسِهَا وَبَصَلِهَاۖ قَالَ أَتَسۡتَبۡدِلُونَ ٱلَّذِي هُوَ أَدۡنَىٰ بِٱلَّذِي هُوَ خَيۡرٌۚ ٱهۡبِطُواْ مِصۡرٗا فَإِنَّ لَكُم مَّا سَأَلۡتُمۡۗ وَضُرِبَتۡ عَلَيۡهِمُ ٱلذِّلَّةُ وَٱلۡمَسۡكَنَةُ وَبَآءُو بِغَضَبٖ مِّنَ ٱللَّهِۚ ذَٰلِكَ بِأَنَّهُمۡ كَانُواْ يَكۡفُرُونَ بِـَٔايَٰتِ ٱللَّهِ وَيَقۡتُلُونَ ٱلنَّبِيِّـۧنَ بِغَيۡرِ ٱلۡحَقِّۚ ذَٰلِكَ بِمَا عَصَواْ وَّكَانُواْ يَعۡتَدُونَ
translation: And [recall] when you said, "O Moses, we can never endure one [kind of] food. And they were covered with humiliation and poverty and returned with anger from Allah [upon them]. That was because they [repeatedly] disbelieved in the signs of Allah and killed the prophets without right. That was because they disobeyed and were [habitually] transgressing

arabic: قَالُواْ ٱدۡعُ لَنَا رَبَّكَ يُبَيِّن لَّنَا مَا هِيَ إِنَّ ٱلۡبَقَرَ تَشَٰبَهَ عَلَيۡنَا وَإِنَّآ إِن شَآءَ ٱللَّهُ لَمُهۡتَدُونَ
translation: They said, "Call upon your Lord to make clear to us what it is. Indeed, [all] cows look alike to us. And indeed we, if Allah wills, will be guided
normalizedArabic: قالوا ادع لنا ربك يبين لنا ما هي ان البقر تشبه علينا وانا ان شاء الله لمهتدون
normalizedTranslation: they said, "call upon your lord to make clear to us what it is. indeed, [all] cows look alike to us. and indeed we, if allah wills, will be guided

arabic: قَالَ إِنَّهُۥ يَقُولُ إِنَّهَا بَقَرَةٞ لَّا ذَلُولٞ تُثِيرُ ٱلۡأَرۡضَ وَلَا تَسۡقِي ٱلۡحَرۡثَ مُسَلَّمَةٞ لَّا شِيَةَ فِيهَاۚ قَالُواْ ٱلۡـَٰٔنَ جِئۡتَ بِٱلۡحَقِّۚ فَذَبَحُوهَا وَمَا كَادُواْ يَفۡعَلُونَ
translation: He said, "He says, 'It is a cow neither trained to plow the earth nor to irrigate the field, one free from fault with no spot upon her.' " They said, "Now you have come with the truth." So they slaughtered her, but they could hardly do it
normalizedArabic: قال انه يقول انها بقره لا ذلول تثير الارض ولا تسقي الحرث مسلمه لا شيه فيها قالوا الن جيت بالحق فذبحوها وما كادوا يفعلون
normalizedTranslation: he said, "he says, 'it is a cow neither trained to plow the earth nor to irrigate the field, one free from fault with no spot upon her.' " they said, "now you have come with the truth." so they slaughtered her, but they could hardly do it

arabic: وَإِذۡ قَتَلۡتُمۡ نَفۡسٗا فَٱدَّـٰرَ ٰٔتُمۡ فِيهَاۖ وَٱللَّهُ مُخۡرِجٞ مَّا كُنتُمۡ تَكۡتُمُونَ
translation: And [recall] when you slew a man and disputed over it, but Allah was to bring out that which you were concealing
normalizedArabic: واذ قتلتم نفسا فادر تم فيها والله مخرج ما كنتم تكتمون
normalizedTranslation: and [recall] when you slew a man and disputed over it, but allah was to bring out that which you were concealing

arabic: فَقُلۡنَا ٱضۡرِبُوهُ بِبَعۡضِهَاۚ كَذَٰلِكَ يُحۡيِ ٱللَّهُ ٱلۡمَوۡتَىٰ وَيُرِيكُمۡ ءَايَٰتِهِۦ لَعَلَّكُمۡ تَعۡقِلُونَ
translation: So, We said, "Strike the slain man with part of it." Thus does Allah bring the dead to life, and He shows you His signs that you might reason
normalizedArabic: فقلنا اضربوه ببعضها كذلك يحي الله الموتي ويريكم ءايته لعلكم تعقلون
normalizedTranslation: so, we said, "strike the slain man with part of it." thus does allah bring the dead to life, and he shows you his signs that you might reason

arabic: ثُمَّ قَسَتۡ قُلُوبُكُم مِّنۢ بَعۡدِ ذَٰلِكَ فَهِيَ كَٱلۡحِجَارَةِ أَوۡ أَشَدُّ قَسۡوَةٗۚ وَإِنَّ مِنَ ٱلۡحِجَارَةِ لَمَا يَتَفَجَّرُ مِنۡهُ ٱلۡأَنۡهَٰرُۚ وَإِنَّ مِنۡهَا لَمَا يَشَّقَّقُ فَيَخۡرُجُ مِنۡهُ ٱلۡمَآءُۚ وَإِنَّ مِنۡهَا لَمَا يَهۡبِطُ مِنۡ خَشۡيَةِ ٱللَّهِۗ وَمَا ٱللَّهُ بِغَٰفِلٍ عَمَّا تَعۡمَلُونَ
translation: Then your hearts became hardened after that, being like stones or even harder. For indeed, there are stones from which rivers burst forth, and there are some of them that split open and water comes out, and there are some of them that fall down for fear of Allah. And Allah is not unaware of what you do
normalizedArabic: ثم قست قلوبكم من بعد ذلك فهي كالحجاره او اشد قسوه وان من الحجاره لما يتفجر منه الانهر وان منها لما يشقق فيخرج منه الماء وان منها لما يهبط من خشيه الله وما الله بغفل عما تعملون
normalizedTranslation: then your hearts became hardened after that, being like stones or even harder. for indeed, there are stones from which rivers burst forth, and there are some of them that split open and water comes out, and there are some of them that fall down for fear of allah. and allah is not unaware of what you do

arabic: ۞أَفَتَطۡمَعُونَ أَن يُؤۡمِنُواْ لَكُمۡ وَقَدۡ كَانَ فَرِيقٞ مِّنۡهُمۡ يَسۡمَعُونَ كَلَٰمَ ٱللَّهِ ثُمَّ يُحَرِّفُونَهُۥ مِنۢ بَعۡدِ مَا عَقَلُوهُ وَهُمۡ يَعۡلَمُونَ
translation: Do you covet [the hope, O believers], that they would believe for you while a party of them used to hear the words of Allah and then distort the Torah after they had understood it while they were knowing
normalizedArabic: افتطمعون ان يومنوا لكم وقد كان فريق منهم يسمعون كلم الله ثم يحرفونه من بعد ما عقلوه وهم يعلمون
normalizedTranslation: do you covet [the hope, o believers], that they would believe for you while a party of them used to hear the words of allah and then distort the torah after they had understood it while they were knowing

arabic: وَإِذَا لَقُواْ ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُواْ قَالُوٓاْ ءَامَنَّا وَإِذَا خَلَا بَعۡضُهُمۡ إِلَىٰ بَعۡضٖ قَالُوٓاْ أَتُحَدِّثُونَهُم بِمَا فَتَحَ ٱللَّهُ عَلَيۡكُمۡ لِيُحَآجُّوكُم بِهِۦ عِندَ رَبِّكُمۡۚ أَفَلَا تَعۡقِلُونَ
translation: And when they meet those who believe, they say, "We have believed"; but when they are alone with one another, they say, "Do you talk to them about what Allah has revealed to you so they can argue with you about it before your Lord?" Then will you not reason
normalizedArabic: واذا لقوا الذين ءامنوا قالوا ءامنا واذا خلا بعضهم الي بعض قالوا اتحدثونهم بما فتح الله عليكم ليحاجوكم به عند ربكم افلا تعقلون
normalizedTranslation: and when they meet those who believe, they say, "we have believed"; but when they are alone with one another, they say, "do you talk to them about what allah has revealed to you so they can argue with you about it before your lord?" then will you not reason

arabic: أَوَلَا يَعۡلَمُونَ أَنَّ ٱللَّهَ يَعۡلَمُ مَا يُسِرُّونَ وَمَا يُعۡلِنُونَ
translation: But do they not know that Allah knows what they conceal and what they declare
normalizedArabic: اولا يعلمون ان الله يعلم ما يسرون وما يعلنون
normalizedTranslation: but do they not know that allah knows what they conceal and what they declare

arabic: وَمِنۡهُمۡ أُمِّيُّونَ لَا يَعۡلَمُونَ ٱلۡكِتَٰبَ إِلَّآ أَمَانِيَّ وَإِنۡ هُمۡ إِلَّا يَظُنُّونَ
translation: And among them are unlettered ones who do not know the Scripture except in wishful thinking, but they are only assuming
normalizedArabic: ومنهم اميون لا يعلمون الكتب الا اماني وان هم الا يظنون
normalizedTranslation: and among them are unlettered ones who do not know the scripture except in wishful thinking, but they are only assuming

arabic: فَوَيۡلٞ لِّلَّذِينَ يَكۡتُبُونَ ٱلۡكِتَٰبَ بِأَيۡدِيهِمۡ ثُمَّ يَقُولُونَ هَٰذَا مِنۡ عِندِ ٱللَّهِ لِيَشۡتَرُواْ بِهِۦ ثَمَنٗا قَلِيلٗاۖ فَوَيۡلٞ لَّهُم مِّمَّا كَتَبَتۡ أَيۡدِيهِمۡ وَوَيۡلٞ لَّهُم مِّمَّا يَكۡسِبُونَ
translation: So woe to those who write the "scripture" with their own hands, then say, "This is from Allah," in order to exchange it for a small price. Woe to them for what their hands have written and woe to them for what they earn
normalizedArabic: فويل للذين يكتبون الكتب بايديهم ثم يقولون هذا من عند الله ليشتروا به ثمنا قليلا فويل لهم مما كتبت ايديهم وويل لهم مما يكسبون
normalizedTranslation: so woe to those who write the "scripture" with their own hands, then say, "this is from allah," in order to exchange it for a small price. woe to them for what their hands have written and woe to them for what they earn

arabic: وَقَالُواْ لَن تَمَسَّنَا ٱلنَّارُ إِلَّآ أَيَّامٗا مَّعۡدُودَةٗۚ قُلۡ أَتَّخَذۡتُمۡ عِندَ ٱللَّهِ عَهۡدٗا فَلَن يُخۡلِفَ ٱللَّهُ عَهۡدَهُۥٓۖ أَمۡ تَقُولُونَ عَلَى ٱللَّهِ مَا لَا تَعۡلَمُونَ
translation: And they say, "Never will the Fire touch us, except for a few days." Say, "Have you taken a covenant with Allah? For Allah will never break His covenant. Or do you say about Allah that which you do not know
normalizedArabic: وقالوا لن تمسنا النار الا اياما معدوده قل اتخذتم عند الله عهدا فلن يخلف الله عهده ام تقولون علي الله ما لا تعلمون
normalizedTranslation: and they say, "never will the fire touch us, except for a few days." say, "have you taken a covenant with allah? for allah will never break his covenant. or do you say about allah that which you do not know

arabic: بَلَىٰۚ مَن كَسَبَ سَيِّئَةٗ وَأَحَٰطَتۡ بِهِۦ خَطِيٓـَٔتُهُۥ فَأُوْلَـٰٓئِكَ أَصۡحَٰبُ ٱلنَّارِۖ هُمۡ فِيهَا خَٰلِدُونَ
translation: Yes, whoever earns evil and his sin has encompassed him - those are the companions of the Fire; they will abide therein eternally
normalizedArabic: بلي من كسب سييه واحطت به خطيته فاوليك اصحب النار هم فيها خلدون
normalizedTranslation: yes, whoever earns evil and his sin has encompassed him - those are the companions of the fire; they will abide therein eternally

arabic: وَٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُواْ وَعَمِلُواْ ٱلصَّـٰلِحَٰتِ أُوْلَـٰٓئِكَ أَصۡحَٰبُ ٱلۡجَنَّةِۖ هُمۡ فِيهَا خَٰلِدُونَ
translation: But they who believe and do righteous deeds - those are the companions of Paradise; they will abide therein eternally
normalizedArabic: والذين ءامنوا وعملوا الصلحت اوليك اصحب الجنه هم فيها خلدون
normalizedTranslation: but they who believe and do righteous deeds - those are the companions of paradise; they will abide therein eternally

arabic: وَإِذۡ أَخَذۡنَا مِيثَٰقَ بَنِيٓ إِسۡرَـٰٓءِيلَ لَا تَعۡبُدُونَ إِلَّا ٱللَّهَ وَبِٱلۡوَٰلِدَيۡنِ إِحۡسَانٗا وَذِي ٱلۡقُرۡبَىٰ وَٱلۡيَتَٰمَىٰ وَٱلۡمَسَٰكِينِ وَقُولُواْ لِلنَّاسِ حُسۡنٗا وَأَقِيمُواْ ٱلصَّلَوٰةَ وَءَاتُواْ ٱلزَّكَوٰةَ ثُمَّ تَوَلَّيۡتُمۡ إِلَّا قَلِيلٗا مِّنكُمۡ وَأَنتُم مُّعۡرِضُونَ
translation: And [recall] when We took the covenant from the Children of Israel, [enjoining upon them], "Do not worship except Allah; and to parents do good and to relatives, orphans, and the needy. And speak to people good [words] and establish prayer and give zakah." Then you turned away, except a few of you, and you were refusing
normalizedArabic: واذ اخذنا ميثق بني اسرءيل لا تعبدون الا الله وبالولدين احسانا وذي القربي واليتمي والمسكين وقولوا للناس حسنا واقيموا الصلوه وءاتوا الزكوه ثم توليتم الا قليلا منكم وانتم معرضون
normalizedTranslation: and [recall] when we took the covenant from the children of israel, [enjoining upon them], "do not worship except allah; and to parents do good and to relatives, orphans, and the needy. and speak to people good [words] and establish prayer and give zakah." then you turned away, except a few of you, and you were refusing

arabic: وَإِذۡ أَخَذۡنَا مِيثَٰقَكُمۡ لَا تَسۡفِكُونَ دِمَآءَكُمۡ وَلَا تُخۡرِجُونَ أَنفُسَكُم مِّن دِيَٰرِكُمۡ ثُمَّ أَقۡرَرۡتُمۡ وَأَنتُمۡ تَشۡهَدُونَ
translation: And [recall] when We took your covenant, [saying], "Do not shed each other's blood or evict one another from your homes." Then you acknowledged [this] while you were witnessing
normalizedArabic: واذ اخذنا ميثقكم لا تسفكون دماءكم ولا تخرجون انفسكم من ديركم ثم اقررتم وانتم تشهدون
normalizedTranslation: and [recall] when we took your covenant, [saying], "do not shed each other's blood or evict one another from your homes." then you acknowledged [this] while you were witnessing

arabic: ثُمَّ أَنتُمۡ هَـٰٓؤُلَآءِ تَقۡتُلُونَ أَنفُسَكُمۡ وَتُخۡرِجُونَ فَرِيقٗا مِّنكُم مِّن دِيَٰرِهِمۡ تَظَٰهَرُونَ عَلَيۡهِم بِٱلۡإِثۡمِ وَٱلۡعُدۡوَٰنِ وَإِن يَأۡتُوكُمۡ أُسَٰرَىٰ تُفَٰدُوهُمۡ وَهُوَ مُحَرَّمٌ عَلَيۡكُمۡ إِخۡرَاجُهُمۡۚ أَفَتُؤۡمِنُونَ بِبَعۡضِ ٱلۡكِتَٰبِ وَتَكۡفُرُونَ بِبَعۡضٖۚ فَمَا جَزَآءُ مَن يَفۡعَلُ ذَٰلِكَ مِنكُمۡ إِلَّا خِزۡيٞ فِي ٱلۡحَيَوٰةِ ٱلدُّنۡيَاۖ وَيَوۡمَ ٱلۡقِيَٰمَةِ يُرَدُّونَ إِلَىٰٓ أَشَدِّ ٱلۡعَذَابِۗ وَمَا ٱللَّهُ بِغَٰفِلٍ عَمَّا تَعۡمَلُونَ
translation: Then, you are those [same ones who are] killing one another and evicting a party of your people from their homes, cooperating against them in sin and aggression. And if they come to you as captives, you ransom them, although their eviction was forbidden to you. So do you believe in part of the Scripture and disbelieve in part? Then what is the recompense for those who do that among you except disgrace in worldly life; and on the Day of Resurrection they will be sent back to the severest of punishment. And Allah is not unaware of what you do
normalizedArabic: ثم انتم هولاء تقتلون انفسكم وتخرجون فريقا منكم من ديرهم تظهرون عليهم بالاثم والعدون وان ياتوكم اسري تفدوهم وهو محرم عليكم اخراجهم افتومنون ببعض الكتب وتكفرون ببعض فما جزاء من يفعل ذلك منكم الا خزي في الحيوه الدنيا ويوم القيمه يردون الي اشد العذاب وما الله بغفل عما تعملون

arabic: أُوْلَـٰٓئِكَ ٱلَّذِينَ ٱشۡتَرَوُاْ ٱلۡحَيَوٰةَ ٱلدُّنۡيَا بِٱلۡأٓخِرَةِۖ فَلَا يُخَفَّفُ عَنۡهُمُ ٱلۡعَذَابُ وَلَا هُمۡ يُنصَرُونَ
translation: Those are the ones who have bought the life of this world [in exchange] for the Hereafter, so the punishment will not be lightened for them, nor will they be aided
normalizedArabic: اوليك الذين اشتروا الحيوه الدنيا بالاخره فلا يخفف عنهم العذاب ولا هم ينصرون
normalizedTranslation: those are the ones who have bought the life of this world [in exchange] for the hereafter, so the punishment will not be lightened for them, nor will they be aided

arabic: وَلَقَدۡ ءَاتَيۡنَا مُوسَى ٱلۡكِتَٰبَ وَقَفَّيۡنَا مِنۢ بَعۡدِهِۦ بِٱلرُّسُلِۖ وَءَاتَيۡنَا عِيسَى ٱبۡنَ مَرۡيَمَ ٱلۡبَيِّنَٰتِ وَأَيَّدۡنَٰهُ بِرُوحِ ٱلۡقُدُسِۗ أَفَكُلَّمَا جَآءَكُمۡ رَسُولُۢ بِمَا لَا تَهۡوَىٰٓ أَنفُسُكُمُ ٱسۡتَكۡبَرۡتُمۡ فَفَرِيقٗا كَذَّبۡتُمۡ وَفَرِيقٗا تَقۡتُلُونَ
translation: And We did certainly give Moses the Torah and followed up after him with messengers. And We gave Jesus, the son of Mary, clear proofs and supported him with the Pure Spirit. But is it [not] that every time a messenger came to you, [O Children of Israel], with what your souls did not desire, you were arrogant? And a party [of messengers] you denied and another party you killed

normalizedTranslation: and we did certainly give moses the torah and followed up after him with messengers. and we gave jesus, the son of mary, clear proofs and supported him with the pure spirit. but is it [not] that every time a messenger came to you, [o children of israel], with what your souls did not desire, you were arrogant? and a party [of messengers] you denied and another party you killed

arabic: وَقَالُواْ قُلُوبُنَا غُلۡفُۢۚ بَل لَّعَنَهُمُ ٱللَّهُ بِكُفۡرِهِمۡ فَقَلِيلٗا مَّا يُؤۡمِنُونَ
translation: And they said, "Our hearts are wrapped." But, [in fact], Allah has cursed them for their disbelief, so little is it that they believe
normalizedArabic: وقالوا قلوبنا غلف بل لعنهم الله بكفرهم فقليلا ما يومنون
normalizedTranslation: and they said, "our hearts are wrapped." but, [in fact], allah has cursed them for their disbelief, so little is it that they believe

arabic: وَلَمَّا جَآءَهُمۡ كِتَٰبٞ مِّنۡ عِندِ ٱللَّهِ مُصَدِّقٞ لِّمَا مَعَهُمۡ وَكَانُواْ مِن قَبۡلُ يَسۡتَفۡتِحُونَ عَلَى ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُواْ فَلَمَّا جَآءَهُم مَّا عَرَفُواْ كَفَرُواْ بِهِۦۚ فَلَعۡنَةُ ٱللَّهِ عَلَى ٱلۡكَٰفِرِينَ
translation: And when there came to them a Book from Allah confirming that which was with them - although before they used to pray for victory against those who disbelieved - but [then] when there came to them that which they recognized, they disbelieved in it; so the curse of Allah will be upon the disbelievers
normalizedArabic: ولما جاءهم كتب من عند الله مصدق لما معهم وكانوا من قبل يستفتحون علي الذين كفروا فلما جاءهم ما عرفوا كفروا به فلعنه الله علي الكفرين
normalizedTranslation: and when there came to them a book from allah confirming that which was with them - although before they used to pray for victory against those who disbelieved - but [then] when there came to them that which they recognized, they disbelieved in it; so the curse of allah will be upon the disbelievers

arabic: بِئۡسَمَا ٱشۡتَرَوۡاْ بِهِۦٓ أَنفُسَهُمۡ أَن يَكۡفُرُواْ بِمَآ أَنزَلَ ٱللَّهُ بَغۡيًا أَن يُنَزِّلَ ٱللَّهُ مِن فَضۡلِهِۦ عَلَىٰ مَن يَشَآءُ مِنۡ عِبَادِهِۦۖ فَبَآءُو بِغَضَبٍ عَلَىٰ غَضَبٖۚ وَلِلۡكَٰفِرِينَ عَذَابٞ مُّهِينٞ
translation: How wretched is that for which they sold themselves - that they would disbelieve in what Allah has revealed through [their] outrage that Allah would send down His favor upon whom He wills from among His servants. So they returned having [earned] wrath upon wrath. And for the disbelievers is a humiliating punishment
normalizedArabic: بيسما اشتروا به انفسهم ان يكفروا بما انزل الله بغيا ان ينزل الله من فضله علي من يشاء من عباده فباءو بغضب علي غضب وللكفرين عذاب مهين
normalizedTranslation: how wretched is that for which they sold themselves - that they would disbelieve in what allah has revealed through [their] outrage that allah would send down his favor upon whom he wills from among his servants. so they returned having [earned] wrath upon wrath. and for the disbelievers is a humiliating punishment

arabic: وَإِذَا قِيلَ لَهُمۡ ءَامِنُواْ بِمَآ أَنزَلَ ٱللَّهُ قَالُواْ نُؤۡمِنُ بِمَآ أُنزِلَ عَلَيۡنَا وَيَكۡفُرُونَ بِمَا وَرَآءَهُۥ وَهُوَ ٱلۡحَقُّ مُصَدِّقٗا لِّمَا مَعَهُمۡۗ قُلۡ فَلِمَ تَقۡتُلُونَ أَنۢبِيَآءَ ٱللَّهِ مِن قَبۡلُ إِن كُنتُم مُّؤۡمِنِينَ
translation: And when it is said to them, "Believe in what Allah has revealed," they say, "We believe [only] in what was revealed to us." And they disbelieve in what came after it, while it is the truth confirming that which is with them. Say, "Then why did you kill the prophets of Allah before, if you are [indeed] believers
normalizedArabic: واذا قيل لهم ءامنوا بما انزل الله قالوا نومن بما انزل علينا ويكفرون بما وراءه وهو الحق مصدقا لما معهم قل فلم تقتلون انبياء الله من قبل ان كنتم مومنين
normalizedTranslation: and when it is said to them, "believe in what allah has revealed," they say, "we believe [only] in what was revealed to us." and they disbelieve in what came after it, while it is the truth confirming that which is with them. say, "then why did you kill the prophets of allah before, if you are [indeed] believers

arabic: ۞وَلَقَدۡ جَآءَكُم مُّوسَىٰ بِٱلۡبَيِّنَٰتِ ثُمَّ ٱتَّخَذۡتُمُ ٱلۡعِجۡلَ مِنۢ بَعۡدِهِۦ وَأَنتُمۡ ظَٰلِمُونَ
translation: And Moses had certainly brought you clear proofs. Then you took the calf [in worship] after that, while you were wrongdoers
normalizedArabic: ولقد جاءكم موسي بالبينت ثم اتخذتم العجل من بعده وانتم ظلمون
normalizedTranslation: and moses had certainly brought you clear proofs. then you took the calf [in worship] after that, while you were wrongdoers

arabic: وَإِذۡ أَخَذۡنَا مِيثَٰقَكُمۡ وَرَفَعۡنَا فَوۡقَكُمُ ٱلطُّورَ خُذُواْ مَآ ءَاتَيۡنَٰكُم بِقُوَّةٖ وَٱسۡمَعُواْۖ قَالُواْ سَمِعۡنَا وَعَصَيۡنَا وَأُشۡرِبُواْ فِي قُلُوبِهِمُ ٱلۡعِجۡلَ بِكُفۡرِهِمۡۚ قُلۡ بِئۡسَمَا يَأۡمُرُكُم بِهِۦٓ إِيمَٰنُكُمۡ إِن كُنتُم مُّؤۡمِنِينَ
translation: And [recall] when We took your covenant and raised over you the mount, [saying], "Take what We have given you with determination and listen." They said [instead], "We hear and disobey." And their hearts absorbed [the worship of] the calf because of their disbelief. Say, "How wretched is that which your faith enjoins upon you, if you should be believers
normalizedArabic: واذ اخذنا ميثقكم ورفعنا فوقكم الطور خذوا ما ءاتينكم بقوه واسمعوا قالوا سمعنا وعصينا واشربوا في قلوبهم العجل بكفرهم قل بيسما يامركم به ايمنكم ان كنتم مومنين
normalizedTranslation: and [recall] when we took your covenant and raised over you the mount, [saying], "take what we have given you with determination and listen." they said [instead], "we hear and disobey." and their hearts absorbed [the worship of] the calf because of their disbelief. say, "how wretched is that which your faith enjoins upon you, if you should be believers

arabic: قُلۡ إِن كَانَتۡ لَكُمُ ٱلدَّارُ ٱلۡأٓخِرَةُ عِندَ ٱللَّهِ خَالِصَةٗ مِّن دُونِ ٱلنَّاسِ فَتَمَنَّوُاْ ٱلۡمَوۡتَ إِن كُنتُمۡ صَٰدِقِينَ
translation: Say, [O Muhammad], "If the home of the Hereafter with Allah is for you alone and not the [other] people, then wish for death, if you should be truthful
normalizedArabic: قل ان كانت لكم الدار الاخره عند الله خالصه من دون الناس فتمنوا الموت ان كنتم صدقين
normalizedTranslation: say, [o muhammad], "if the home of the hereafter with allah is for you alone and not the [other] people, then wish for death, if you should be truthful

arabic: وَلَن يَتَمَنَّوۡهُ أَبَدَۢا بِمَا قَدَّمَتۡ أَيۡدِيهِمۡۚ وَٱللَّهُ عَلِيمُۢ بِٱلظَّـٰلِمِينَ
translation: But they will never wish for it, ever, because of what their hands have put forth. And Allah is Knowing of the wrongdoers
normalizedArabic: ولن يتمنوه ابدا بما قدمت ايديهم والله عليم بالظلمين
normalizedTranslation: but they will never wish for it, ever, because of what their hands have put forth. and allah is knowing of the wrongdoers

arabic: وَلَتَجِدَنَّهُمۡ أَحۡرَصَ ٱلنَّاسِ عَلَىٰ حَيَوٰةٖ وَمِنَ ٱلَّذِينَ أَشۡرَكُواْۚ يَوَدُّ أَحَدُهُمۡ لَوۡ يُعَمَّرُ أَلۡفَ سَنَةٖ وَمَا هُوَ بِمُزَحۡزِحِهِۦ مِنَ ٱلۡعَذَابِ أَن يُعَمَّرَۗ وَٱللَّهُ بَصِيرُۢ بِمَا يَعۡمَلُونَ
translation: And you will surely find them the most greedy of people for life - [even] more than those who associate others with Allah. One of them wishes that he could be granted life a thousand years, but it would not remove him in the least from the [coming] punishment that he should be granted life. And Allah is Seeing of what they do
normalizedArabic: ولتجدنهم احرص الناس علي حيوه ومن الذين اشركوا يود احدهم لو يعمر الف سنه وما هو بمزحزحه من العذاب ان يعمر والله بصير بما يعملون
normalizedTranslation: and you will surely find them the most greedy of people for life - [even] more than those who associate others with allah. one of them wishes that he could be granted life a thousand years, but it would not remove him in the least from the [coming] punishment that he should be granted life. and allah is seeing of what they do

arabic: قُلۡ مَن كَانَ عَدُوّٗا لِّـجِبۡرِيلَ فَإِنَّهُۥ نَزَّلَهُۥ عَلَىٰ قَلۡبِكَ بِإِذۡنِ ٱللَّهِ مُصَدِّقٗا لِّمَا بَيۡنَ يَدَيۡهِ وَهُدٗى وَبُشۡرَىٰ لِلۡمُؤۡمِنِينَ
translation: Say, "Whoever is an enemy to Gabriel - it is [none but] he who has brought the Qur'an down upon your heart, [O Muhammad], by permission of Allah, confirming that which was before it and as guidance and good tidings for the believers
normalizedArabic: قل من كان عدوا لجبريل فانه نزله علي قلبك باذن الله مصدقا لما بين يديه وهدي وبشري للمومنين
normalizedTranslation: say, "whoever is an enemy to gabriel - it is [none but] he who has brought the qur'an down upon your heart, [o muhammad], by permission of allah, confirming that which was before it and as guidance and good tidings for the believers

arabic: مَن كَانَ عَدُوّٗا لِّلَّهِ وَمَلَـٰٓئِكَتِهِۦ وَرُسُلِهِۦ وَجِبۡرِيلَ وَمِيكَىٰلَ فَإِنَّ ٱللَّهَ عَدُوّٞ لِّلۡكَٰفِرِينَ
translation: Whoever is an enemy to Allah and His angels and His messengers and Gabriel and Michael - then indeed, Allah is an enemy to the disbelievers
normalizedArabic: من كان عدوا لله ومليكته ورسله وجبريل وميكيل فان الله عدو للكفرين
normalizedTranslation: whoever is an enemy to allah and his angels and his messengers and gabriel and michael - then indeed, allah is an enemy to the disbelievers

arabic: وَلَقَدۡ أَنزَلۡنَآ إِلَيۡكَ ءَايَٰتِۭ بَيِّنَٰتٖۖ وَمَا يَكۡفُرُ بِهَآ إِلَّا ٱلۡفَٰسِقُونَ
translation: And We have certainly revealed to you verses [which are] clear proofs, and no one would deny them except the defiantly disobedient
normalizedArabic: ولقد انزلنا اليك ءايت بينت وما يكفر بها الا الفسقون
normalizedTranslation: and we have certainly revealed to you verses [which are] clear proofs, and no one would deny them except the defiantly disobedient

arabic: أَوَكُلَّمَا عَٰهَدُواْ عَهۡدٗا نَّبَذَهُۥ فَرِيقٞ مِّنۡهُمۚ بَلۡ أَكۡثَرُهُمۡ لَا يُؤۡمِنُونَ
translation: Is it not [true] that every time they took a covenant a party of them threw it away? But, [in fact], most of them do not believe
normalizedArabic: اوكلما عهدوا عهدا نبذه فريق منهم بل اكثرهم لا يومنون
normalizedTranslation: is it not [true] that every time they took a covenant a party of them threw it away? but, [in fact], most of them do not believe

arabic: وَلَمَّا جَآءَهُمۡ رَسُولٞ مِّنۡ عِندِ ٱللَّهِ مُصَدِّقٞ لِّمَا مَعَهُمۡ نَبَذَ فَرِيقٞ مِّنَ ٱلَّذِينَ أُوتُواْ ٱلۡكِتَٰبَ كِتَٰبَ ٱللَّهِ وَرَآءَ ظُهُورِهِمۡ كَأَنَّهُمۡ لَا يَعۡلَمُونَ
translation: And when a messenger from Allah came to them confirming that which was with them, a party of those who had been given the Scripture threw the Scripture of Allah behind their backs as if they did not know [what it contained]
normalizedArabic: ولما جاءهم رسول من عند الله مصدق لما معهم نبذ فريق من الذين اوتوا الكتب كتب الله وراء ظهورهم كانهم لا يعلمون
normalizedTranslation: and when a messenger from allah came to them confirming that which was with them, a party of those who had been given the scripture threw the scripture of allah behind their backs as if they did not know [what it contained]

arabic: وَٱتَّبَعُواْ مَا تَتۡلُواْ ٱلشَّيَٰطِينُ عَلَىٰ مُلۡكِ سُلَيۡمَٰنَۖ وَمَا كَفَرَ سُلَيۡمَٰنُ وَلَٰكِنَّ ٱلشَّيَٰطِينَ كَفَرُواْ يُعَلِّمُونَ ٱلنَّاسَ ٱلسِّحۡرَ وَمَآ أُنزِلَ عَلَى ٱلۡمَلَكَيۡنِ بِبَابِلَ هَٰرُوتَ وَمَٰرُوتَۚ وَمَا يُعَلِّمَانِ مِنۡ أَحَدٍ حَتَّىٰ يَقُولَآ إِنَّمَا نَحۡنُ فِتۡنَةٞ فَلَا تَكۡفُرۡۖ فَيَتَعَلَّمُونَ مِنۡهُمَا مَا يُفَرِّقُونَ بِهِۦ بَيۡنَ ٱلۡمَرۡءِ وَزَوۡجِهِۦۚ وَمَا هُم بِضَآرِّينَ بِهِۦ مِنۡ أَحَدٍ إِلَّا بِإِذۡنِ ٱللَّهِۚ وَيَتَعَلَّمُونَ مَا يَضُرُّهُمۡ وَلَا يَنفَعُهُمۡۚ وَلَقَدۡ عَلِمُواْ لَمَنِ ٱشۡتَرَىٰهُ مَا لَهُۥ فِي ٱلۡأٓخِرَةِ مِنۡ خَلَٰقٖۚ وَلَبِئۡسَ مَا شَرَوۡاْ بِهِۦٓ أَنفُسَهُمۡۚ لَوۡ كَانُواْ يَعۡلَمُونَ
translation: And they followed [instead] what the devils had recited during the reign of Solomon. It was not Solomon who disbelieved, but the devils disbelieved, teaching people magic and that which was revealed to the two angels at Babylon, Harut and Marut. But the two angels do not teach anyone unless they say, "We are a trial, so do not disbelieve [by practicing magic]." And [yet] they learn from them that by which they cause separation between a man and his wife. But they do not harm anyone through it except by permission of Allah. And the people learn what harms them and does not benefit them. But the Children of Israel certainly knew that whoever purchased the magic would not have in the Hereafter any share. And wretched is that for which they sold themselves, if they only knew
normalizedArabic: واتبعوا ما تتلوا الشيطين علي ملك سليمن وما كفر سليمن ولكن الشيطين كفروا يعلمون الناس السحر وما انزل علي الملكين ببابل هروت ومروت وما يعلمان من احد حتي يقولا انما نحن فتنه فلا تكفر فيتعلمون منهما ما يفرقون به بين المرء وزوجه وما هم بضارين به من احد الا باذن الله ويتعلمون ما يضرهم ولا ينفعهم ولقد علموا لمن اشتريه ما له في الاخره من خلق ولبيس ما شروا به انفسهم لو كانوا يعلمون
normalizedTranslation: and they followed [instead] what the devils had recited during the reign of solomon. it was not solomon who disbelieved, but the devils disbelieved, teaching people magic and that which was revealed to the two angels at babylon, harut and marut. but the two angels do not teach anyone unless they say, "we are a trial, so do not disbelieve [by practicing magic]." and [yet] they learn from them that by which they cause separation between a man and his wife. but they do not harm anyone through it except by permission of allah. and the people learn what harms them and does not benefit them. but the children of israel certainly knew that whoever purchased the magic would not have in the hereafter any share. and wretched is that for which they sold themselves, if they only knew

arabic: وَلَوۡ أَنَّهُمۡ ءَامَنُواْ وَٱتَّقَوۡاْ لَمَثُوبَةٞ مِّنۡ عِندِ ٱللَّهِ خَيۡرٞۚ لَّوۡ كَانُواْ يَعۡلَمُونَ
translation: And if they had believed and feared Allah, then the reward from Allah would have been [far] better, if they only knew
normalizedArabic: ولو انهم ءامنوا واتقوا لمثوبه من عند الله خير لو كانوا يعلمون
normalizedTranslation: and if they had believed and feared allah, then the reward from allah would have been [far] better, if they only knew

arabic: يَـٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُواْ لَا تَقُولُواْ رَٰعِنَا وَقُولُواْ ٱنظُرۡنَا وَٱسۡمَعُواْۗ وَلِلۡكَٰفِرِينَ عَذَابٌ أَلِيمٞ
translation: O you who have believed, say not [to Allah 's Messenger], "Ra'ina" but say, "Unthurna" and listen. And for the disbelievers is a painful punishment
normalizedArabic: يايها الذين ءامنوا لا تقولوا رعنا وقولوا انظرنا واسمعوا وللكفرين عذاب اليم
normalizedTranslation: o you who have believed, say not [to allah 's messenger], "ra'ina" but say, "unthurna" and listen. and for the disbelievers is a painful punishment

arabic: مَّا يَوَدُّ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُواْ مِنۡ أَهۡلِ ٱلۡكِتَٰبِ وَلَا ٱلۡمُشۡرِكِينَ أَن يُنَزَّلَ عَلَيۡكُم مِّنۡ خَيۡرٖ مِّن رَّبِّكُمۡۚ وَٱللَّهُ يَخۡتَصُّ بِرَحۡمَتِهِۦ مَن يَشَآءُۚ وَٱللَّهُ ذُو ٱلۡفَضۡلِ ٱلۡعَظِيمِ
translation: Neither those who disbelieve from the People of the Scripture nor the polytheists wish that any good should be sent down to you from your Lord. But Allah selects for His mercy whom He wills, and Allah is the possessor of great bounty

normalizedTranslation: neither those who disbelieve from the people of the scripture nor the polytheists wish that any good should be sent down to you from your lord. but allah selects for his mercy whom he wills, and allah is the possessor of great bounty

arabic: ۞مَا نَنسَخۡ مِنۡ ءَايَةٍ أَوۡ نُنسِهَا نَأۡتِ بِخَيۡرٖ مِّنۡهَآ أَوۡ مِثۡلِهَآۗ أَلَمۡ تَعۡلَمۡ أَنَّ ٱللَّهَ عَلَىٰ كُلِّ شَيۡءٖ قَدِيرٌ
translation: We do not abrogate a verse or cause it to be forgotten except that We bring forth [one] better than it or similar to it. Do you not know that Allah is over all things competent
normalizedArabic: ما ننسخ من ءايه او ننسها نات بخير منها او مثلها الم تعلم ان الله علي كل شيء قدير
normalizedTranslation: we do not abrogate a verse or cause it to be forgotten except that we bring forth [one] better than it or similar to it. do you not know that allah is over all things competent

arabic: أَلَمۡ تَعۡلَمۡ أَنَّ ٱللَّهَ لَهُۥ مُلۡكُ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلۡأَرۡضِۗ وَمَا لَكُم مِّن دُونِ ٱللَّهِ مِن وَلِيّٖ وَلَا نَصِيرٍ
translation: Do you not know that to Allah belongs the dominion of the heavens and the earth and [that] you have not besides Allah any protector or any helper

normalizedTranslation: do you not know that to allah belongs the dominion of the heavens and the earth and [that] you have not besides allah any protector or any helper

arabic: أَمۡ تُرِيدُونَ أَن تَسۡـَٔلُواْ رَسُولَكُمۡ كَمَا سُئِلَ مُوسَىٰ مِن قَبۡلُۗ وَمَن يَتَبَدَّلِ ٱلۡكُفۡرَ بِٱلۡإِيمَٰنِ فَقَدۡ ضَلَّ سَوَآءَ ٱلسَّبِيلِ
translation: Or do you intend to ask your Messenger as Moses was asked before? And whoever exchanges faith for disbelief has certainly strayed from the soundness of the way
normalizedArabic: ام تريدون ان تسلوا رسولكم كما سيل موسي من قبل ومن يتبدل الكفر بالايمن فقد ضل سواء السبيل
normalizedTranslation: or do you intend to ask your messenger as moses was asked before? and whoever exchanges faith for disbelief has certainly strayed from the soundness of the way

arabic: وَدَّ كَثِيرٞ مِّنۡ أَهۡلِ ٱلۡكِتَٰبِ لَوۡ يَرُدُّونَكُم مِّنۢ بَعۡدِ إِيمَٰنِكُمۡ كُفَّارًا حَسَدٗا مِّنۡ عِندِ أَنفُسِهِم مِّنۢ بَعۡدِ مَا تَبَيَّنَ لَهُمُ ٱلۡحَقُّۖ فَٱعۡفُواْ وَٱصۡفَحُواْ حَتَّىٰ يَأۡتِيَ ٱللَّهُ بِأَمۡرِهِۦٓۗ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ عَلَىٰ كُلِّ شَيۡءٖ قَدِيرٞ
translation: Many of the People of the Scripture wish they could turn you back to disbelief after you have believed, out of envy from themselves [even] after the truth has become clear to them. So pardon and overlook until Allah delivers His command. Indeed, Allah is over all things competent
normalizedArabic: ود كثير من اهل الكتب لو يردونكم من بعد ايمنكم كفارا حسدا من عند انفسهم من بعد ما تبين لهم الحق فاعفوا واصفحوا حتي ياتي الله بامره ان الله علي كل شيء قدير
normalizedTranslation: many of the people of the scripture wish they could turn you back to disbelief after you have believed, out of envy from themselves [even] after the truth has become clear to them. so pardon and overlook until allah delivers his command. indeed, allah is over all things competent

arabic: وَأَقِيمُواْ ٱلصَّلَوٰةَ وَءَاتُواْ ٱلزَّكَوٰةَۚ وَمَا تُقَدِّمُواْ لِأَنفُسِكُم مِّنۡ خَيۡرٖ تَجِدُوهُ عِندَ ٱللَّهِۗ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ بِمَا تَعۡمَلُونَ بَصِيرٞ
translation: And establish prayer and give zakah, and whatever good you put forward for yourselves - you will find it with Allah. Indeed, Allah of what you do, is Seeing
normalizedArabic: واقيموا الصلوه وءاتوا الزكوه وما تقدموا لانفسكم من خير تجدوه عند الله ان الله بما تعملون بصير
normalizedTranslation: and establish prayer and give zakah, and whatever good you put forward for yourselves - you will find it with allah. indeed, allah of what you do, is seeing

arabic: وَقَالُواْ لَن يَدۡخُلَ ٱلۡجَنَّةَ إِلَّا مَن كَانَ هُودًا أَوۡ نَصَٰرَىٰۗ تِلۡكَ أَمَانِيُّهُمۡۗ قُلۡ هَاتُواْ بُرۡهَٰنَكُمۡ إِن كُنتُمۡ صَٰدِقِينَ
translation: And they say, "None will enter Paradise except one who is a Jew or a Christian." That is [merely] their wishful thinking, Say, "Produce your proof, if you should be truthful
normalizedArabic: وقالوا لن يدخل الجنه الا من كان هودا او نصري تلك امانيهم قل هاتوا برهنكم ان كنتم صدقين
normalizedTranslation: and they say, "none will enter paradise except one who is a jew or a christian." that is [merely] their wishful thinking, say, "produce your proof, if you should be truthful

arabic: بَلَىٰۚ مَنۡ أَسۡلَمَ وَجۡهَهُۥ لِلَّهِ وَهُوَ مُحۡسِنٞ فَلَهُۥٓ أَجۡرُهُۥ عِندَ رَبِّهِۦ وَلَا خَوۡفٌ عَلَيۡهِمۡ وَلَا هُمۡ يَحۡزَنُونَ
translation: Yes [on the contrary], whoever submits his face in Islam to Allah while being a doer of good will have his reward with his Lord. And no fear will there be concerning them, nor will they grieve
normalizedArabic: بلي من اسلم وجهه لله وهو محسن فله اجره عند ربه ولا خوف عليهم ولا هم يحزنون
normalizedTranslation: yes [on the contrary], whoever submits his face in islam to allah while being a doer of good will have his reward with his lord. and no fear will there be concerning them, nor will they grieve

arabic: وَقَالَتِ ٱلۡيَهُودُ لَيۡسَتِ ٱلنَّصَٰرَىٰ عَلَىٰ شَيۡءٖ وَقَالَتِ ٱلنَّصَٰرَىٰ لَيۡسَتِ ٱلۡيَهُودُ عَلَىٰ شَيۡءٖ وَهُمۡ يَتۡلُونَ ٱلۡكِتَٰبَۗ كَذَٰلِكَ قَالَ ٱلَّذِينَ لَا يَعۡلَمُونَ مِثۡلَ قَوۡلِهِمۡۚ فَٱللَّهُ يَحۡكُمُ بَيۡنَهُمۡ يَوۡمَ ٱلۡقِيَٰمَةِ فِيمَا كَانُواْ فِيهِ يَخۡتَلِفُونَ
translation: The Jews say "The Christians have nothing [true] to stand on," and the Christians say, "The Jews have nothing to stand on," although they [both] recite the Scripture. Thus the polytheists speak the same as their words. But Allah will judge between them on the Day of Resurrection concerning that over which they used to differ
normalizedArabic: وقالت اليهود ليست النصري علي شيء وقالت النصري ليست اليهود علي شيء وهم يتلون الكتب كذلك قال الذين لا يعلمون مثل قولهم فالله يحكم بينهم يوم القيمه فيما كانوا فيه يختلفون
normalizedTranslation: the jews say "the christians have nothing [true] to stand on," and the christians say, "the jews have nothing to stand on," although they [both] recite the scripture. thus the polytheists speak the same as their words. but allah will judge between them on the day of resurrection concerning that over which they used to differ

arabic: وَمَنۡ أَظۡلَمُ مِمَّن مَّنَعَ مَسَٰجِدَ ٱللَّهِ أَن يُذۡكَرَ فِيهَا ٱسۡمُهُۥ وَسَعَىٰ فِي خَرَابِهَآۚ أُوْلَـٰٓئِكَ مَا كَانَ لَهُمۡ أَن يَدۡخُلُوهَآ إِلَّا خَآئِفِينَۚ لَهُمۡ فِي ٱلدُّنۡيَا خِزۡيٞ وَلَهُمۡ فِي ٱلۡأٓخِرَةِ عَذَابٌ عَظِيمٞ
translation: And who are more unjust than those who prevent the name of Allah from being mentioned in His mosques and strive toward their destruction. It is not for them to enter them except in fear. For them in this world is disgrace, and they will have in the Hereafter a great punishment
normalizedArabic: ومن اظلم ممن منع مسجد الله ان يذكر فيها اسمه وسعي في خرابها اوليك ما كان لهم ان يدخلوها الا خايفين لهم في الدنيا خزي ولهم في الاخره عذاب عظيم
normalizedTranslation: and who are more unjust than those who prevent the name of allah from being mentioned in his mosques and strive toward their destruction. it is not for them to enter them except in fear. for them in this world is disgrace, and they will have in the hereafter a great punishment

arabic: وَلِلَّهِ ٱلۡمَشۡرِقُ وَٱلۡمَغۡرِبُۚ فَأَيۡنَمَا تُوَلُّواْ فَثَمَّ وَجۡهُ ٱللَّهِۚ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ وَٰسِعٌ عَلِيمٞ
translation: And to Allah belongs the east and the west. So wherever you [might] turn, there is the Face of Allah. Indeed, Allah is all-Encompassing and Knowing
normalizedArabic: ولله المشرق والمغرب فاينما تولوا فثم وجه الله ان الله وسع عليم
normalizedTranslation: and to allah belongs the east and the west. so wherever you [might] turn, there is the face of allah. indeed, allah is all-encompassing and knowing

arabic: وَقَالُواْ ٱتَّخَذَ ٱللَّهُ وَلَدٗاۗ سُبۡحَٰنَهُۥۖ بَل لَّهُۥ مَا فِي ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلۡأَرۡضِۖ كُلّٞ لَّهُۥ قَٰنِتُونَ
translation: They say, "Allah has taken a son." Exalted is He! Rather, to Him belongs whatever is in the heavens and the earth. All are devoutly obedient to Him

normalizedTranslation: they say, "allah has taken a son." exalted is he! rather, to him belongs whatever is in the heavens and the earth. all are devoutly obedient to him

arabic: بَدِيعُ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلۡأَرۡضِۖ وَإِذَا قَضَىٰٓ أَمۡرٗا فَإِنَّمَا يَقُولُ لَهُۥ كُن فَيَكُونُ
translation: Originator of the heavens and the earth. When He decrees a matter, He only says to it, "Be," and it is

arabic: وَقَالَ ٱلَّذِينَ لَا يَعۡلَمُونَ لَوۡلَا يُكَلِّمُنَا ٱللَّهُ أَوۡ تَأۡتِينَآ ءَايَةٞۗ كَذَٰلِكَ قَالَ ٱلَّذِينَ مِن قَبۡلِهِم مِّثۡلَ قَوۡلِهِمۡۘ تَشَٰبَهَتۡ قُلُوبُهُمۡۗ قَدۡ بَيَّنَّا ٱلۡأٓيَٰتِ لِقَوۡمٖ يُوقِنُونَ
translation: Those who do not know say, "Why does Allah not speak to us or there come to us a sign?" Thus spoke those before them like their words. Their hearts resemble each other. We have shown clearly the signs to a people who are certain [in faith]

normalizedTranslation: those who do not know say, "why does allah not speak to us or there come to us a sign?" thus spoke those before them like their words. their hearts resemble each other. we have shown clearly the signs to a people who are certain [in faith]

arabic: إِنَّآ أَرۡسَلۡنَٰكَ بِٱلۡحَقِّ بَشِيرٗا وَنَذِيرٗاۖ وَلَا تُسۡـَٔلُ عَنۡ أَصۡحَٰبِ ٱلۡجَحِيمِ

arabic: ٱلَّذِينَ ءَاتَيۡنَٰهُمُ ٱلۡكِتَٰبَ يَتۡلُونَهُۥ حَقَّ تِلَاوَتِهِۦٓ أُوْلَـٰٓئِكَ يُؤۡمِنُونَ بِهِۦۗ وَمَن يَكۡفُرۡ بِهِۦ فَأُوْلَـٰٓئِكَ هُمُ ٱلۡخَٰسِرُونَ

normalizedArabic: ولين اتيت الذين اوتوا الكتب بكل ءايه ما تبعوا قبلتك وما انت بتابع قبلتهم وما بعضهم بتابع قبله بعض ولين اتبعت اهواءهم من بعد ما جاءك من العلم انك اذا لمن الظلمين
normalizedTranslation: and if you brought to those who were given the scripture every sign, they would not follow your qiblah. nor will you be a follower of their qiblah. nor would they be followers of one another's qiblah. so if you were to follow their desires after what has come to you of knowledge, indeed, you would then be among the wrongdoers

arabic: ٱلَّذِينَ ءَاتَيۡنَٰهُمُ ٱلۡكِتَٰبَ يَعۡرِفُونَهُۥ كَمَا يَعۡرِفُونَ أَبۡنَآءَهُمۡۖ وَإِنَّ فَرِيقٗا مِّنۡهُمۡ لَيَكۡتُمُونَ ٱلۡحَقَّ وَهُمۡ يَعۡلَمُونَ
translation: Those to whom We gave the Scripture know him as they know their own sons. But indeed, a party of them conceal the truth while they know [it]
normalizedArabic: الذين ءاتينهم الكتب يعرفونه كما يعرفون ابناءهم وان فريقا منهم ليكتمون الحق وهم يعلمون
normalizedTranslation: those to whom we gave the scripture know him as they know their own sons. but indeed, a party of them conceal the truth while they know [it]

arabic: ٱلۡحَقُّ مِن رَّبِّكَ فَلَا تَكُونَنَّ مِنَ ٱلۡمُمۡتَرِينَ
translation: The truth is from your Lord, so never be among the doubters
normalizedArabic: الحق من ربك فلا تكونن من الممترين
normalizedTranslation: the truth is from your lord, so never be among the doubters

arabic: وَلِكُلّٖ وِجۡهَةٌ هُوَ مُوَلِّيهَاۖ فَٱسۡتَبِقُواْ ٱلۡخَيۡرَٰتِۚ أَيۡنَ مَا تَكُونُواْ يَأۡتِ بِكُمُ ٱللَّهُ جَمِيعًاۚ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ عَلَىٰ كُلِّ شَيۡءٖ قَدِيرٞ
translation: For each [religious following] is a direction toward which it faces. So race to [all that is] good. Wherever you may be, Allah will bring you forth [for judgement] all together. Indeed, Allah is over all things competent
normalizedArabic: ولكل وجهه هو موليها فاستبقوا الخيرت اين ما تكونوا يات بكم الله جميعا ان الله علي كل شيء قدير
normalizedTranslation: for each [religious following] is a direction toward which it faces. so race to [all that is] good. wherever you may be, allah will bring you forth [for judgement] all together. indeed, allah is over all things competent

arabic: وَمِنۡ حَيۡثُ خَرَجۡتَ فَوَلِّ وَجۡهَكَ شَطۡرَ ٱلۡمَسۡجِدِ ٱلۡحَرَامِۖ وَإِنَّهُۥ لَلۡحَقُّ مِن رَّبِّكَۗ وَمَا ٱللَّهُ بِغَٰفِلٍ عَمَّا تَعۡمَلُونَ
translation: So from wherever you go out [for prayer, O Muhammad] turn your face toward al- Masjid al-Haram, and indeed, it is the truth from your Lord. And Allah is not unaware of what you do
normalizedArabic: ومن حيث خرجت فول وجهك شطر المسجد الحرام وانه للحق من ربك وما الله بغفل عما تعملون
normalizedTranslation: so from wherever you go out [for prayer, o muhammad] turn your face toward al- masjid al-haram, and indeed, it is the truth from your lord. and allah is not unaware of what you do

arabic: وَمِنۡ حَيۡثُ خَرَجۡتَ فَوَلِّ وَجۡهَكَ شَطۡرَ ٱلۡمَسۡجِدِ ٱلۡحَرَامِۚ وَحَيۡثُ مَا كُنتُمۡ فَوَلُّواْ وُجُوهَكُمۡ شَطۡرَهُۥ لِئَلَّا يَكُونَ لِلنَّاسِ عَلَيۡكُمۡ حُجَّةٌ إِلَّا ٱلَّذِينَ ظَلَمُواْ مِنۡهُمۡ فَلَا تَخۡشَوۡهُمۡ وَٱخۡشَوۡنِي وَلِأُتِمَّ نِعۡمَتِي عَلَيۡكُمۡ وَلَعَلَّكُمۡ تَهۡتَدُونَ
translation: And from wherever you go out [for prayer], turn your face toward al-Masjid al-Haram. And wherever you [believers] may be, turn your faces toward it in order that the people will not have any argument against you, except for those of them who commit wrong; so fear them not but fear Me. And [it is] so I may complete My favor upon you and that you may be guided
normalizedArabic: ومن حيث خرجت فول وجهك شطر المسجد الحرام وحيث ما كنتم فولوا وجوهكم شطره ليلا يكون للناس عليكم حجه الا الذين ظلموا منهم فلا تخشوهم واخشوني ولاتم نعمتي عليكم ولعلكم تهتدون
normalizedTranslation: and from wherever you go out [for prayer], turn your face toward al-masjid al-haram. and wherever you [believers] may be, turn your faces toward it in order that the people will not have any argument against you, except for those of them who commit wrong; so fear them not but fear me. and [it is] so i may complete my favor upon you and that you may be guided

arabic: كَمَآ أَرۡسَلۡنَا فِيكُمۡ رَسُولٗا مِّنكُمۡ يَتۡلُواْ عَلَيۡكُمۡ ءَايَٰتِنَا وَيُزَكِّيكُمۡ وَيُعَلِّمُكُمُ ٱلۡكِتَٰبَ وَٱلۡحِكۡمَةَ وَيُعَلِّمُكُم مَّا لَمۡ تَكُونُواْ تَعۡلَمُونَ
translation: Just as We have sent among you a messenger from yourselves reciting to you Our verses and purifying you and teaching you the Book and wisdom and teaching you that which you did not know
normalizedArabic: كما ارسلنا فيكم رسولا منكم يتلوا عليكم ءايتنا ويزكيكم ويعلمكم الكتب والحكمه ويعلمكم ما لم تكونوا تعلمون
normalizedTranslation: just as we have sent among you a messenger from yourselves reciting to you our verses and purifying you and teaching you the book and wisdom and teaching you that which you did not know

arabic: فَٱذۡكُرُونِيٓ أَذۡكُرۡكُمۡ وَٱشۡكُرُواْ لِي وَلَا تَكۡفُرُونِ
translation: So remember Me; I will remember you. And be grateful to Me and do not deny Me
normalizedArabic: فاذكروني اذكركم واشكروا لي ولا تكفرون
normalizedTranslation: so remember me; i will remember you. and be grateful to me and do not deny me

arabic: يَـٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُواْ ٱسۡتَعِينُواْ بِٱلصَّبۡرِ وَٱلصَّلَوٰةِۚ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ مَعَ ٱلصَّـٰبِرِينَ
translation: O you who have believed, seek help through patience and prayer. Indeed, Allah is with the patient
normalizedArabic: يايها الذين ءامنوا استعينوا بالصبر والصلوه ان الله مع الصبرين
normalizedTranslation: o you who have believed, seek help through patience and prayer. indeed, allah is with the patient
