arabic: مَّن ذَا ٱلَّذِي يُقۡرِضُ ٱللَّهَ قَرۡضًا حَسَنٗا فَيُضَٰعِفَهُۥ لَهُۥٓ أَضۡعَافٗا كَثِيرَةٗۚ وَٱللَّهُ يَقۡبِضُ وَيَبۡصُۜطُ وَإِلَيۡهِ تُرۡجَعُونَ
translation: Who is it that would loan Allah a goodly loan so He may multiply it for him many times over? And it is Allah who withholds and grants abundance, and to Him you will be returned

normalizedTranslation: who is it that would loan allah a goodly loan so he may multiply it for him many times over? and it is allah who withholds and grants abundance, and to him you will be returned

arabic: أَلَمۡ تَرَ إِلَى ٱلۡمَلَإِ مِنۢ بَنِيٓ إِسۡرَـٰٓءِيلَ مِنۢ بَعۡدِ مُوسَىٰٓ إِذۡ قَالُواْ لِنَبِيّٖ لَّهُمُ ٱبۡعَثۡ لَنَا مَلِكٗا نُّقَٰتِلۡ فِي سَبِيلِ ٱللَّهِۖ قَالَ هَلۡ عَسَيۡتُمۡ إِن كُتِبَ عَلَيۡكُمُ ٱلۡقِتَالُ أَلَّا تُقَٰتِلُواْۖ قَالُواْ وَمَا لَنَآ أَلَّا نُقَٰتِلَ فِي سَبِيلِ ٱللَّهِ وَقَدۡ أُخۡرِجۡنَا مِن دِيَٰرِنَا وَأَبۡنَآئِنَاۖ فَلَمَّا كُتِبَ عَلَيۡهِمُ ٱلۡقِتَالُ تَوَلَّوۡاْ إِلَّا قَلِيلٗا مِّنۡهُمۡۚ وَٱللَّهُ عَلِيمُۢ بِٱلظَّـٰلِمِينَ
translation: Have you not considered the assembly of the Children of Israel after [the time of] Moses when they said to a prophet of theirs, "Send to us a king, and we will fight in the way of Allah "? He said, "Would you perhaps refrain from fighting if fighting was prescribed for you?" arabic: ٱلَّذِينَ يُنفِقُونَ أَمۡوَٰلَهُمۡ فِي سَبِيلِ ٱللَّهِ ثُمَّ لَا يُتۡبِعُونَ مَآ أَنفَقُواْ مَنّٗا وَلَآ أَذٗى لَّهُمۡ أَجۡرُهُمۡ عِندَ رَبِّهِمۡ وَلَا خَوۡفٌ عَلَيۡهِمۡ وَلَا هُمۡ يَحۡزَنُونَ

arabic: يَـٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُواْ لَا تُبۡطِلُواْ صَدَقَٰتِكُم بِٱلۡمَنِّ وَٱلۡأَذَىٰ كَٱلَّذِي يُنفِقُ مَالَهُۥ رِئَآءَ ٱلنَّاسِ وَلَا يُؤۡمِنُ بِٱللَّهِ وَٱلۡيَوۡمِ ٱلۡأٓخِرِۖ فَمَثَلُهُۥ كَمَثَلِ صَفۡوَانٍ عَلَيۡهِ تُرَابٞ فَأَصَابَهُۥ وَابِلٞ فَتَرَكَهُۥ صَلۡدٗاۖ لَّا يَقۡدِرُونَ عَلَىٰ شَيۡءٖ مِّمَّا كَسَبُواْۗ وَٱللَّهُ لَا يَهۡدِي ٱلۡقَوۡمَ ٱلۡكَٰفِرِينَ

arabic: لِلۡفُقَرَآءِ ٱلَّذِينَ أُحۡصِرُواْ فِي سَبِيلِ ٱللَّهِ لَا يَسۡتَطِيعُونَ ضَرۡبٗا فِي ٱلۡأَرۡضِ يَحۡسَبُهُمُ ٱلۡجَاهِلُ أَغۡنِيَآءَ مِنَ ٱلتَّعَفُّفِ تَعۡرِفُهُم بِسِيمَٰهُمۡ لَا يَسۡـَٔلُونَ ٱلنَّاسَ إِلۡحَافٗاۗ وَمَا تُنفِقُواْ مِنۡ خَيۡرٖ فَإِنَّ ٱللَّهَ بِهِۦ عَلِيمٌ
translation: [Charity is] for the poor who have been restricted for the cause of Allah, unable to move about in the land. An ignorant [person] would think them self-sufficient because of their restraint, but you will know them by their [characteristic] sign. They do not ask people persistently [or at all]. And whatever you spend of good - indeed, Allah is Knowing of it
normalizedArabic: للفقراء الذين احصروا في سبيل الله لا يستطيعون ضربا في الارض يحسبهم الجاهل اغنياء من التعفف تعرفهم بسيمهم لا يسلون الناس الحافا وما تنفقوا من خير فان الله به عليم
normalizedTranslation: [charity is] for the poor who have been restricted for the cause of allah, unable to move about in the land. an ignorant [person] would think them self-sufficient because of their restraint, but you will know them by their [characteristic] sign. they do not ask people persistently [or at all]. and whatever you spend of good - indeed, allah is knowing of it

arabic: ٱلَّذِينَ يُنفِقُونَ أَمۡوَٰلَهُم بِٱلَّيۡلِ وَٱلنَّهَارِ سِرّٗا وَعَلَانِيَةٗ فَلَهُمۡ أَجۡرُهُمۡ عِندَ رَبِّهِمۡ وَلَا خَوۡفٌ عَلَيۡهِمۡ وَلَا هُمۡ يَحۡزَنُونَ
translation: Those who spend their wealth [in Allah 's way] by night and by day, secretly and publicly - they will have their reward with their Lord. And no fear will there be concerning them, nor will they grieve
normalizedArabic: الذين ينفقون امولهم باليل والنهار سرا وعلانيه فلهم اجرهم عند ربهم ولا خوف عليهم ولا هم يحزنون
normalizedTranslation: those who spend their wealth [in allah 's way] by night and by day, secretly and publicly - they will have their reward with their lord. and no fear will there be concerning them, nor will they grieve

arabic: ٱلَّذِينَ يَأۡكُلُونَ ٱلرِّبَوٰاْ لَا يَقُومُونَ إِلَّا كَمَا يَقُومُ ٱلَّذِي يَتَخَبَّطُهُ ٱلشَّيۡطَٰنُ مِنَ ٱلۡمَسِّۚ ذَٰلِكَ بِأَنَّهُمۡ قَالُوٓاْ إِنَّمَا ٱلۡبَيۡعُ مِثۡلُ ٱلرِّبَوٰاْۗ وَأَحَلَّ ٱللَّهُ ٱلۡبَيۡعَ وَحَرَّمَ ٱلرِّبَوٰاْۚ فَمَن جَآءَهُۥ مَوۡعِظَةٞ مِّن رَّبِّهِۦ فَٱنتَهَىٰ فَلَهُۥ مَا سَلَفَ وَأَمۡرُهُۥٓ إِلَى ٱللَّهِۖ وَمَنۡ عَادَ فَأُوْلَـٰٓئِكَ أَصۡحَٰبُ ٱلنَّارِۖ هُمۡ فِيهَا خَٰلِدُونَ
translation: Those who consume interest cannot stand [on the Day of Resurrection] except as one stands who is being beaten by Satan into insanity. That is because they say, "Trade is [just] like interest." But Allah has permitted trade and has forbidden interest. So whoever has received an admonition from his Lord and desists may have what is past, and his affair rests with Allah. But whoever returns to [dealing in interest or usury] - those are the companions of the Fire; they will abide eternally therein
normalizedArabic: الذين ياكلون الربوا لا يقومون الا كما يقوم الذي يتخبطه الشيطن من المس ذلك بانهم قالوا انما البيع مثل الربوا واحل الله البيع وحرم الربوا فمن جاءه موعظه من ربه فانتهي فله ما سلف وامره الي الله ومن عاد فاوليك اصحب النار هم فيها خلدون
normalizedTranslation: those who consume interest cannot stand [on the day of resurrection] except as one stands who is being beaten by satan into insanity. that is because they say, "trade is [just] like interest." but allah has permitted trade and has forbidden interest. so whoever has received an admonition from his lord and desists may have what is past, and his affair rests with allah. but whoever returns to [dealing in interest or usury] - those are the companions of the fire; they will abide eternally therein

arabic: يَمۡحَقُ ٱللَّهُ ٱلرِّبَوٰاْ وَيُرۡبِي ٱلصَّدَقَٰتِۗ وَٱللَّهُ لَا يُحِبُّ كُلَّ كَفَّارٍ أَثِيمٍ
translation: Allah destroys interest and gives increase for charities. And Allah does not like every sinning disbeliever
normalizedArabic: يمحق الله الربوا ويربي الصدقت والله لا يحب كل كفار اثيم
normalizedTranslation: allah destroys interest and gives increase for charities. and allah does not like every sinning disbeliever

arabic: إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُواْ وَعَمِلُواْ ٱلصَّـٰلِحَٰتِ وَأَقَامُواْ ٱلصَّلَوٰةَ وَءَاتَوُاْ ٱلزَّكَوٰةَ لَهُمۡ أَجۡرُهُمۡ عِندَ رَبِّهِمۡ وَلَا خَوۡفٌ عَلَيۡهِمۡ وَلَا هُمۡ يَحۡزَنُونَ
translation: Indeed, those who believe and do righteous deeds and establish prayer and give zakah will have their reward with their Lord, and there will be no fear concerning them, nor will they grieve
normalizedArabic: ان الذين ءامنوا وعملوا الصلحت واقاموا الصلوه وءاتوا الزكوه لهم اجرهم عند ربهم ولا خوف عليهم ولا هم يحزنون
normalizedTranslation: indeed, those who believe and do righteous deeds and establish prayer and give zakah will have their reward with their lord, and there will be no fear concerning them, nor will they grieve

arabic: يَـٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُواْ ٱتَّقُواْ ٱللَّهَ وَذَرُواْ مَا بَقِيَ مِنَ ٱلرِّبَوٰٓاْ إِن كُنتُم مُّؤۡمِنِينَ
translation: O you who have believed, fear Allah and give up what remains [due to you] of interest, if you should be believers
normalizedArabic: يايها الذين ءامنوا اتقوا الله وذروا ما بقي من الربوا ان كنتم مومنين
normalizedTranslation: o you who have believed, fear allah and give up what remains [due to you] of interest, if you should be believers

arabic: فَإِن لَّمۡ تَفۡعَلُواْ فَأۡذَنُواْ بِحَرۡبٖ مِّنَ ٱللَّهِ وَرَسُولِهِۦۖ وَإِن تُبۡتُمۡ فَلَكُمۡ رُءُوسُ أَمۡوَٰلِكُمۡ لَا تَظۡلِمُونَ وَلَا تُظۡلَمُونَ
translation: And if you do not, then be informed of a war [against you] from Allah and His Messenger. But if you repent, you may have your principal - [thus] you do no wrong, nor are you wronged
normalizedArabic: فان لم تفعلوا فاذنوا بحرب من الله ورسوله وان تبتم فلكم رءوس امولكم لا تظلمون ولا تظلمون
normalizedTranslation: and if you do not, then be informed of a war [against you] from allah and his messenger. but if you repent, you may have your principal - [thus] you do no wrong, nor are you wronged

arabic: وَإِن كَانَ ذُو عُسۡرَةٖ فَنَظِرَةٌ إِلَىٰ مَيۡسَرَةٖۚ وَأَن تَصَدَّقُواْ خَيۡرٞ لَّكُمۡ إِن كُنتُمۡ تَعۡلَمُونَ
translation: And if someone is in hardship, then [let there be] postponement until [a time of] ease. But if you give [from your right as] charity, then it is better for you, if you only knew
normalizedArabic: وان كان ذو عسره فنظره الي ميسره وان تصدقوا خير لكم ان كنتم تعلمون
normalizedTranslation: and if someone is in hardship, then [let there be] postponement until [a time of] ease. but if you give [from your right as] charity, then it is better for you, if you only knew

arabic: وَٱتَّقُواْ يَوۡمٗا تُرۡجَعُونَ فِيهِ إِلَى ٱللَّهِۖ ثُمَّ تُوَفَّىٰ كُلُّ نَفۡسٖ مَّا كَسَبَتۡ وَهُمۡ لَا يُظۡلَمُونَ
translation: And fear a Day when you will be returned to Allah. Then every soul will be compensated for what it earned, and they will not be treated unjustly
normalizedArabic: واتقوا يوما ترجعون فيه الي الله ثم توفي كل نفس ما كسبت وهم لا يظلمون
normalizedTranslation: and fear a day when you will be returned to allah. then every soul will be compensated for what it earned, and they will not be treated unjustly

arabic: يَـٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوٓاْ إِذَا تَدَايَنتُم بِدَيۡنٍ إِلَىٰٓ أَجَلٖ مُّسَمّٗى فَٱكۡتُبُوهُۚ وَلۡيَكۡتُب بَّيۡنَكُمۡ كَاتِبُۢ بِٱلۡعَدۡلِۚ وَلَا يَأۡبَ كَاتِبٌ أَن يَكۡتُبَ كَمَا عَلَّمَهُ ٱللَّهُۚ فَلۡيَكۡتُبۡ وَلۡيُمۡلِلِ ٱلَّذِي عَلَيۡهِ ٱلۡحَقُّ وَلۡيَتَّقِ ٱللَّهَ رَبَّهُۥ وَلَا يَبۡخَسۡ مِنۡهُ شَيۡـٔٗاۚ فَإِن كَانَ ٱلَّذِي عَلَيۡهِ ٱلۡحَقُّ سَفِيهًا أَوۡ ضَعِيفًا أَوۡ لَا يَسۡتَطِيعُ أَن يُمِلَّ هُوَ فَلۡيُمۡلِلۡ وَلِيُّهُۥ بِٱلۡعَدۡلِۚ وَٱسۡتَشۡهِدُواْ شَهِيدَيۡنِ مِن رِّجَالِكُمۡۖ فَإِن لَّمۡ يَكُونَا رَجُلَيۡنِ فَرَجُلٞ وَٱمۡرَأَتَانِ مِمَّن تَرۡضَوۡنَ مِنَ ٱلشُّهَدَآءِ أَن تَضِلَّ إِحۡدَىٰهُمَا فَتُذَكِّرَ إِحۡدَىٰهُمَا ٱلۡأُخۡرَىٰۚ وَلَا يَأۡبَ ٱلشُّهَدَآءُ إِذَا مَا دُعُواْۚ وَلَا تَسۡـَٔمُوٓاْ أَن تَكۡتُبُوهُ صَغِيرًا أَوۡ كَبِيرًا إِلَىٰٓ أَجَلِهِۦۚ ذَٰلِكُمۡ أَقۡسَطُ عِندَ ٱللَّهِ وَأَقۡوَمُ لِلشَّهَٰدَةِ وَأَدۡنَىٰٓ أَلَّا تَرۡتَابُوٓاْ إِلَّآ أَن تَكُونَ تِجَٰرَةً حَاضِرَةٗ تُدِيرُونَهَا بَيۡنَكُمۡ فَلَيۡسَ عَلَيۡكُمۡ جُنَاحٌ أَلَّا تَكۡتُبُوهَاۗ وَأَشۡهِدُوٓاْ إِذَا تَبَايَعۡتُمۡۚ وَلَا يُضَآرَّ كَاتِبٞ وَلَا شَهِيدٞۚ وَإِن تَفۡعَلُواْ فَإِنَّهُۥ فُسُوقُۢ بِكُمۡۗ وَٱتَّقُواْ ٱللَّهَۖ وَيُعَلِّمُكُمُ ٱللَّهُۗ وَٱللَّهُ بِكُلِّ شَيۡءٍ عَلِيمٞ
translation: O you who have believed, when you contract a debt for a specified term, write it down. And let a scribe write [it] between you in justice. Let no scribe refuse to write as Allah has taught him. So let him write and let the one who has the obligation dictate. And let him fear Allah, his Lord, and not leave anything out of it. But if the one who has the obligation is of limited understanding or weak or unable to dictate himself, then let his guardian dictate in justice. And bring to witness two witnesses from among your men. And if there are not two men [available], then a man and two women from those whom you accept as witnesses - so that if one of the women errs, then the other can remind her. And let not the witnesses refuse when they are called upon. And do not be [too] weary to write it, whether it is small or large, for its [specified] term. That is more just in the sight of Allah and stronger as evidence and more likely to prevent doubt between you, except when it is an immediate transaction which you conduct among yourselves. For [then] there is no blame upon you if you do not write it. And take witnesses when you conclude a contract. Let no scribe be harmed or any witness. For if you do so, indeed, it is [grave] disobedience in you. And fear Allah. And Allah teaches you. And Allah is Knowing of all things

arabic: ۞وَإِن كُنتُمۡ عَلَىٰ سَفَرٖ وَلَمۡ تَجِدُواْ كَاتِبٗا فَرِهَٰنٞ مَّقۡبُوضَةٞۖ فَإِنۡ أَمِنَ بَعۡضُكُم بَعۡضٗا فَلۡيُؤَدِّ ٱلَّذِي ٱؤۡتُمِنَ أَمَٰنَتَهُۥ وَلۡيَتَّقِ ٱللَّهَ رَبَّهُۥۗ وَلَا تَكۡتُمُواْ ٱلشَّهَٰدَةَۚ وَمَن يَكۡتُمۡهَا فَإِنَّهُۥٓ ءَاثِمٞ قَلۡبُهُۥۗ وَٱللَّهُ بِمَا تَعۡمَلُونَ عَلِيمٞ
translation: And if you are on a journey and cannot find a scribe, then a security deposit [should be] taken. And if one of you entrusts another, then let him who is entrusted discharge his trust [faithfully] and let him fear Allah, his Lord. And do not conceal testimony, for whoever conceals it - his heart is indeed sinful, and Allah is Knowing of what you do

normalizedTranslation: and if you are on a journey and cannot find a scribe, then a security deposit [should be] taken. and if one of you entrusts another, then let him who is entrusted discharge his trust [faithfully] and let him fear allah, his lord. and do not conceal testimony, for whoever conceals it - his heart is indeed sinful, and allah is knowing of what you do

arabic: لِّلَّهِ مَا فِي ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَمَا فِي ٱلۡأَرۡضِۗ وَإِن تُبۡدُواْ مَا فِيٓ أَنفُسِكُمۡ أَوۡ تُخۡفُوهُ يُحَاسِبۡكُم بِهِ ٱللَّهُۖ فَيَغۡفِرُ لِمَن يَشَآءُ وَيُعَذِّبُ مَن يَشَآءُۗ وَٱللَّهُ عَلَىٰ كُلِّ شَيۡءٖ قَدِيرٌ
translation: To Allah belongs whatever is in the heavens and whatever is in the earth. Whether you show what is within yourselves or conceal it, Allah will bring you to account for it. Then He will forgive whom He wills and punish whom He wills, and Allah is over all things competent

normalizedTranslation: to allah belongs whatever is in the heavens and whatever is in the earth. whether you show what is within yourselves or conceal it, allah will bring you to account for it. then he will forgive whom he wills and punish whom he wills, and allah is over all things competent

arabic: ءَامَنَ ٱلرَّسُولُ بِمَآ أُنزِلَ إِلَيۡهِ مِن رَّبِّهِۦ وَٱلۡمُؤۡمِنُونَۚ كُلٌّ ءَامَنَ بِٱللَّهِ وَمَلَـٰٓئِكَتِهِۦ وَكُتُبِهِۦ وَرُسُلِهِۦ لَا نُفَرِّقُ بَيۡنَ أَحَدٖ مِّن رُّسُلِهِۦۚ وَقَالُواْ سَمِعۡنَا وَأَطَعۡنَاۖ غُفۡرَانَكَ رَبَّنَا وَإِلَيۡكَ ٱلۡمَصِيرُ
translation: The Messenger has believed in what was revealed to him from his Lord, and [so have] the believers. All of them have believed in Allah and His angels and His books and His messengers, [saying], "We make no distinction between any of His messengers." And they say, "We hear and we obey. arabic: فَإِنۡ حَآجُّوكَ فَقُلۡ أَسۡلَمۡتُ وَجۡهِيَ لِلَّهِ وَمَنِ ٱتَّبَعَنِۗ وَقُل لِّلَّذِينَ أُوتُواْ ٱلۡكِتَٰبَ وَٱلۡأُمِّيِّـۧنَ ءَأَسۡلَمۡتُمۡۚ فَإِنۡ أَسۡلَمُواْ فَقَدِ ٱهۡتَدَواْۖ وَّإِن تَوَلَّوۡاْ فَإِنَّمَا عَلَيۡكَ ٱلۡبَلَٰغُۗ وَٱللَّهُ بَصِيرُۢ بِٱلۡعِبَادِ

arabic: وَإِذۡ قَالَتِ ٱلۡمَلَـٰٓئِكَةُ يَٰمَرۡيَمُ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ ٱصۡطَفَىٰكِ وَطَهَّرَكِ وَٱصۡطَفَىٰكِ عَلَىٰ نِسَآءِ ٱلۡعَٰلَمِينَ
translation: And [mention] when the angels said, "O Mary, indeed Allah has chosen you and purified you and chosen you above the women of the worlds

normalizedTranslation: and [mention] when the angels said, "o mary, indeed allah has chosen you and purified you and chosen you above the women of the worlds

arabic: يَٰمَرۡيَمُ ٱقۡنُتِي لِرَبِّكِ وَٱسۡجُدِي وَٱرۡكَعِي مَعَ ٱلرَّـٰكِعِينَ
translation: O Mary, be devoutly obedient to your Lord and prostrate and bow with those who bow [in prayer]

normalizedTranslation: o mary, be devoutly obedient to your lord and prostrate and bow with those who bow [in prayer]

arabic: ذَٰلِكَ مِنۡ أَنۢبَآءِ ٱلۡغَيۡبِ نُوحِيهِ إِلَيۡكَۚ وَمَا كُنتَ لَدَيۡهِمۡ إِذۡ يُلۡقُونَ أَقۡلَٰمَهُمۡ أَيُّهُمۡ يَكۡفُلُ مَرۡيَمَ وَمَا كُنتَ لَدَيۡهِمۡ إِذۡ يَخۡتَصِمُونَ
translation: That is from the news of the unseen which We reveal to you, [O Muhammad]. And you were not with them when they cast their pens as to which of them should be responsible for Mary. Nor were you with them when they disputed
normalizedArabic: ذلك من انباء الغيب نوحيه اليك وما كنت لديهم اذ يلقون اقلمهم ايهم يكفل مريم وما كنت لديهم اذ يختصمون
normalizedTranslation: that is from the news of the unseen which we reveal to you, [o muhammad]. and you were not with them when they cast their pens as to which of them should be responsible for mary. nor were you with them when they disputed

arabic: إِذۡ قَالَتِ ٱلۡمَلَـٰٓئِكَةُ يَٰمَرۡيَمُ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ يُبَشِّرُكِ بِكَلِمَةٖ مِّنۡهُ ٱسۡمُهُ ٱلۡمَسِيحُ عِيسَى ٱبۡنُ مَرۡيَمَ وَجِيهٗا فِي ٱلدُّنۡيَا وَٱلۡأٓخِرَةِ وَمِنَ ٱلۡمُقَرَّبِينَ
translation: [And mention] when the angels said, "O Mary, indeed Allah gives you good tidings of a word from Him, whose name will be the Messiah, Jesus, the son of Mary - distinguished in this world and the Hereafter and among those brought near [to Allah]

normalizedTranslation: [and mention] when the angels said, "o mary, indeed allah gives you good tidings of a word from him, whose name will be the messiah, jesus, the son of mary - distinguished in this world and the hereafter and among those brought near [to allah]

arabic: وَيُكَلِّمُ ٱلنَّاسَ فِي ٱلۡمَهۡدِ وَكَهۡلٗا وَمِنَ ٱلصَّـٰلِحِينَ
translation: He will speak to the people in the cradle and in maturity and will be of the righteous

normalizedTranslation: he will speak to the people in the cradle and in maturity and will be of the righteous

arabic: قَالَتۡ رَبِّ أَنَّىٰ يَكُونُ لِي وَلَدٞ وَلَمۡ يَمۡسَسۡنِي بَشَرٞۖ قَالَ كَذَٰلِكِ ٱللَّهُ يَخۡلُقُ مَا يَشَآءُۚ إِذَا قَضَىٰٓ أَمۡرٗا فَإِنَّمَا يَقُولُ لَهُۥ كُن فَيَكُونُ
translation: She said, "My Lord, how will I have a child when no man has touched me?" [The angel] said, "Such is Allah; He creates what He wills. When He decrees a matter, He only says to it, 'Be,' and it is
normalizedArabic: قالت رب اني يكون لي ولد ولم يمسسني بشر قال كذلك الله يخلق ما يشاء اذا قضي امرا فانما يقول له كن فيكون
normalizedTranslation: she said, "my lord, how will i have a child when no man has touched me?" [the angel] said, "such is allah; he creates what he wills. when he decrees a matter, he only says to it, 'be,' and it is

arabic: وَيُعَلِّمُهُ ٱلۡكِتَٰبَ وَٱلۡحِكۡمَةَ وَٱلتَّوۡرَىٰةَ وَٱلۡإِنجِيلَ
translation: And He will teach him writing and wisdom and the Torah and the Gospel
normalizedArabic: ويعلمه الكتب والحكمه والتوريه والانجيل
normalizedTranslation: and he will teach him writing and wisdom and the torah and the gospel

arabic: وَرَسُولًا إِلَىٰ بَنِيٓ إِسۡرَـٰٓءِيلَ أَنِّي قَدۡ جِئۡتُكُم بِـَٔايَةٖ مِّن رَّبِّكُمۡ أَنِّيٓ أَخۡلُقُ لَكُم مِّنَ ٱلطِّينِ كَهَيۡـَٔةِ ٱلطَّيۡرِ فَأَنفُخُ فِيهِ فَيَكُونُ طَيۡرَۢا بِإِذۡنِ ٱللَّهِۖ وَأُبۡرِئُ ٱلۡأَكۡمَهَ وَٱلۡأَبۡرَصَ وَأُحۡيِ ٱلۡمَوۡتَىٰ بِإِذۡنِ ٱللَّهِۖ وَأُنَبِّئُكُم بِمَا تَأۡكُلُونَ وَمَا تَدَّخِرُونَ فِي بُيُوتِكُمۡۚ إِنَّ فِي ذَٰلِكَ لَأٓيَةٗ لَّكُمۡ إِن كُنتُم مُّؤۡمِنِينَ
translation: And [make him] a messenger to the Children of Israel, [who will say], 'Indeed I have come to you with a sign from your Lord in that I design for you from clay [that which is] like the form of a bird, then I breathe into it and it becomes a bird by permission of Allah. And I cure the blind and the leper, and I give life to the dead - by permission of Allah. And I inform you of what you eat and what you store in your houses. Indeed in that is a sign for you, if you are believers
normalizedArabic: ورسولا الي بني اسرءيل اني قد جيتكم بايه من ربكم اني اخلق لكم من الطين كهيه الطير فانفخ فيه فيكون طيرا باذن الله وابري الاكمه والابرص واحي الموتي باذن الله وانبيكم بما تاكلون وما تدخرون في بيوتكم ان في ذلك لايه لكم ان كنتم مومنين
normalizedTranslation: and [make him] a messenger to the children of israel, [who will say], 'indeed i have come to you with a sign from your lord in that i design for you from clay [that which is] like the form of a bird, then i breathe into it and it becomes a bird by permission of allah. and i cure the blind and the leper, and i give life to the dead - by permission of allah. and i inform you of what you eat and what you store in your houses. indeed in that is a sign for you, if you are believers

arabic: وَمُصَدِّقٗا لِّمَا بَيۡنَ يَدَيَّ مِنَ ٱلتَّوۡرَىٰةِ وَلِأُحِلَّ لَكُم بَعۡضَ ٱلَّذِي حُرِّمَ عَلَيۡكُمۡۚ وَجِئۡتُكُم بِـَٔايَةٖ مِّن رَّبِّكُمۡ فَٱتَّقُواْ ٱللَّهَ وَأَطِيعُونِ
translation: And [I have come] confirming what was before me of the Torah and to make lawful for you some of what was forbidden to you. And I have come to you with a sign from your Lord, so fear Allah and obey me
normalizedArabic: ومصدقا لما بين يدي من التوريه ولاحل لكم بعض الذي حرم عليكم وجيتكم بايه من ربكم فاتقوا الله واطيعون
normalizedTranslation: and [i have come] confirming what was before me of the torah and to make lawful for you some of what was forbidden to you. and i have come to you with a sign from your lord, so fear allah and obey me

arabic: إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ رَبِّي وَرَبُّكُمۡ فَٱعۡبُدُوهُۚ هَٰذَا صِرَٰطٞ مُّسۡتَقِيمٞ
translation: Indeed, Allah is my Lord and your Lord, so worship Him. That is the straight path

arabic: ۞فَلَمَّآ أَحَسَّ عِيسَىٰ مِنۡهُمُ ٱلۡكُفۡرَ قَالَ مَنۡ أَنصَارِيٓ إِلَى ٱللَّهِۖ قَالَ ٱلۡحَوَارِيُّونَ نَحۡنُ أَنصَارُ ٱللَّهِ ءَامَنَّا بِٱللَّهِ وَٱشۡهَدۡ بِأَنَّا مُسۡلِمُونَ
translation: But when Jesus felt [persistence in] disbelief from them, he said, "Who are my supporters for [the cause of] Allah?" The disciples said, "We are supporters for Allah. We have believed in Allah and testify that we are Muslims [submitting to Him]

normalizedTranslation: but when jesus felt [persistence in] disbelief from them, he said, "who are my supporters for [the cause of] allah?" the disciples said, "we are supporters for allah. we have believed in allah and testify that we are muslims [submitting to him]

arabic: رَبَّنَآ ءَامَنَّا بِمَآ أَنزَلۡتَ وَٱتَّبَعۡنَا ٱلرَّسُولَ فَٱكۡتُبۡنَا مَعَ ٱلشَّـٰهِدِينَ
translation: Our Lord, we have believed in what You revealed and have followed the messenger Jesus, so register us among the witnesses [to truth]

arabic: وَمَكَرُواْ وَمَكَرَ ٱللَّهُۖ وَٱللَّهُ خَيۡرُ ٱلۡمَٰكِرِينَ
translation: And the disbelievers planned, but Allah planned. And Allah is the best of planners

normalizedTranslation: and the disbelievers planned, but allah planned. and allah is the best of planners

arabic: إِذۡ قَالَ ٱللَّهُ يَٰعِيسَىٰٓ إِنِّي مُتَوَفِّيكَ وَرَافِعُكَ إِلَيَّ وَمُطَهِّرُكَ مِنَ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُواْ وَجَاعِلُ ٱلَّذِينَ ٱتَّبَعُوكَ فَوۡقَ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوٓاْ إِلَىٰ يَوۡمِ ٱلۡقِيَٰمَةِۖ ثُمَّ إِلَيَّ مَرۡجِعُكُمۡ فَأَحۡكُمُ بَيۡنَكُمۡ فِيمَا كُنتُمۡ فِيهِ تَخۡتَلِفُونَ

Then to Me is your return, and I will judge between you concerning that in which you used to differ

arabic: فَأَمَّا ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُواْ فَأُعَذِّبُهُمۡ عَذَابٗا شَدِيدٗا فِي ٱلدُّنۡيَا وَٱلۡأٓخِرَةِ وَمَا لَهُم مِّن نَّـٰصِرِينَ
translation: And as for those who disbelieved, I will punish them with a severe punishment in this world and the Hereafter, and they will have no helpers

normalizedTranslation: and as for those who disbelieved, i will punish them with a severe punishment in this world and the hereafter, and they will have no helpers

arabic: وَأَمَّا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُواْ وَعَمِلُواْ ٱلصَّـٰلِحَٰتِ فَيُوَفِّيهِمۡ أُجُورَهُمۡۗ وَٱللَّهُ لَا يُحِبُّ ٱلظَّـٰلِمِينَ

normalizedTranslation: this is what we recite to you, [o muhammad], of [our] verses and the precise [and wise] message

arabic: إِنَّ مَثَلَ عِيسَىٰ عِندَ ٱللَّهِ كَمَثَلِ ءَادَمَۖ خَلَقَهُۥ مِن تُرَابٖ ثُمَّ قَالَ لَهُۥ كُن فَيَكُونُ

arabic: ٱلۡحَقُّ مِن رَّبِّكَ فَلَا تَكُن مِّنَ ٱلۡمُمۡتَرِينَ

arabic: فَمَنۡ حَآجَّكَ فِيهِ مِنۢ بَعۡدِ مَا جَآءَكَ مِنَ ٱلۡعِلۡمِ فَقُلۡ تَعَالَوۡاْ نَدۡعُ أَبۡنَآءَنَا وَأَبۡنَآءَكُمۡ وَنِسَآءَنَا وَنِسَآءَكُمۡ وَأَنفُسَنَا وَأَنفُسَكُمۡ ثُمَّ نَبۡتَهِلۡ فَنَجۡعَل لَّعۡنَتَ ٱللَّهِ عَلَى ٱلۡكَٰذِبِينَ
translation: Then whoever argues with you about it after [this] knowledge has come to you - say, "Come, let us call our sons and your sons, our women and your women, ourselves and yourselves, then supplicate earnestly [together] and invoke the curse of Allah upon the liars [among us]
normalizedArabic: فمن حاجك فيه من بعد ما جاءك من العلم فقل تعالوا ندع ابناءنا وابناءكم ونساءنا ونساءكم وانفسنا وانفسكم ثم نبتهل فنجعل لعنت الله علي الكذبين
normalizedTranslation: then whoever argues with you about it after [this] knowledge has come to you - say, "come, let us call our sons and your sons, our women and your women, ourselves and yourselves, then supplicate earnestly [together] and invoke the curse of allah upon the liars [among us]

arabic: إِنَّ هَٰذَا لَهُوَ ٱلۡقَصَصُ ٱلۡحَقُّۚ وَمَا مِنۡ إِلَٰهٍ إِلَّا ٱللَّهُۚ وَإِنَّ ٱللَّهَ لَهُوَ ٱلۡعَزِيزُ ٱلۡحَكِيمُ

arabic: كَيۡفَ يَهۡدِي ٱللَّهُ قَوۡمٗا كَفَرُواْ بَعۡدَ إِيمَٰنِهِمۡ وَشَهِدُوٓاْ أَنَّ ٱلرَّسُولَ حَقّٞ وَجَآءَهُمُ ٱلۡبَيِّنَٰتُۚ وَٱللَّهُ لَا يَهۡدِي ٱلۡقَوۡمَ ٱلظَّـٰلِمِينَ
translation: How shall Allah guide a people who disbelieved after their belief and had witnessed that the Messenger is true and clear signs had come to them? And Allah does not guide the wrongdoing people
normalizedArabic: كيف يهدي الله قوما كفروا بعد ايمنهم وشهدوا ان الرسول حق وجاءهم البينت والله لا يهدي القوم الظلمين
normalizedTranslation: how shall allah guide a people who disbelieved after their belief and had witnessed that the messenger is true and clear signs had come to them? and allah does not guide the wrongdoing people

arabic: أُوْلَـٰٓئِكَ جَزَآؤُهُمۡ أَنَّ عَلَيۡهِمۡ لَعۡنَةَ ٱللَّهِ وَٱلۡمَلَـٰٓئِكَةِ وَٱلنَّاسِ أَجۡمَعِينَ
translation: Those - their recompense will be that upon them is the curse of Allah and the angels and the people, all together
normalizedArabic: اوليك جزاوهم ان عليهم لعنه الله والمليكه والناس اجمعين
normalizedTranslation: those - their recompense will be that upon them is the curse of allah and the angels and the people, all together

arabic: خَٰلِدِينَ فِيهَا لَا يُخَفَّفُ عَنۡهُمُ ٱلۡعَذَابُ وَلَا هُمۡ يُنظَرُونَ
translation: Abiding eternally therein. The punishment will not be lightened for them, nor will they be reprieved
normalizedArabic: خلدين فيها لا يخفف عنهم العذاب ولا هم ينظرون
normalizedTranslation: abiding eternally therein. the punishment will not be lightened for them, nor will they be reprieved

arabic: إِلَّا ٱلَّذِينَ تَابُواْ مِنۢ بَعۡدِ ذَٰلِكَ وَأَصۡلَحُواْ فَإِنَّ ٱللَّهَ غَفُورٞ رَّحِيمٌ
translation: Except for those who repent after that and correct themselves. For indeed, Allah is Forgiving and Merciful
normalizedArabic: الا الذين تابوا من بعد ذلك واصلحوا فان الله غفور رحيم
normalizedTranslation: except for those who repent after that and correct themselves. for indeed, allah is forgiving and merciful

arabic: إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُواْ بَعۡدَ إِيمَٰنِهِمۡ ثُمَّ ٱزۡدَادُواْ كُفۡرٗا لَّن تُقۡبَلَ تَوۡبَتُهُمۡ وَأُوْلَـٰٓئِكَ هُمُ ٱلضَّآلُّونَ
translation: Indeed, those who reject the message after their belief and then increase in disbelief - never will their [claimed] repentance be accepted, and they are the ones astray
normalizedArabic: ان الذين كفروا بعد ايمنهم ثم ازدادوا كفرا لن تقبل توبتهم واوليك هم الضالون
normalizedTranslation: indeed, those who reject the message after their belief and then increase in disbelief - never will their [claimed] repentance be accepted, and they are the ones astray

arabic: إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُواْ وَمَاتُواْ وَهُمۡ كُفَّارٞ فَلَن يُقۡبَلَ مِنۡ أَحَدِهِم مِّلۡءُ ٱلۡأَرۡضِ ذَهَبٗا وَلَوِ ٱفۡتَدَىٰ بِهِۦٓۗ أُوْلَـٰٓئِكَ لَهُمۡ عَذَابٌ أَلِيمٞ وَمَا لَهُم مِّن نَّـٰصِرِينَ
translation: Indeed, those who disbelieve and die while they are disbelievers - never would the [whole] capacity of the earth in gold be accepted from one of them if he would [seek to] ransom himself with it. For those there will be a painful punishment, and they will have no helpers
normalizedArabic: ان الذين كفروا وماتوا وهم كفار فلن يقبل من احدهم ملء الارض ذهبا ولو افتدي به اوليك لهم عذاب اليم وما لهم من نصرين
normalizedTranslation: indeed, those who disbelieve and die while they are disbelievers - never would the [whole] capacity of the earth in gold be accepted from one of them if he would [seek to] ransom himself with it. for those there will be a painful punishment, and they will have no helpers

arabic: لَن تَنَالُواْ ٱلۡبِرَّ حَتَّىٰ تُنفِقُواْ مِمَّا تُحِبُّونَۚ وَمَا تُنفِقُواْ مِن شَيۡءٖ فَإِنَّ ٱللَّهَ بِهِۦ عَلِيمٞ
translation: Never will you attain the good [reward] until you spend [in the way of Allah] from that which you love. And whatever you spend - indeed, Allah is Knowing of it
normalizedArabic: لن تنالوا البر حتي تنفقوا مما تحبون وما تنفقوا من شيء فان الله به عليم
normalizedTranslation: never will you attain the good [reward] until you spend [in the way of allah] from that which you love. and whatever you spend - indeed, allah is knowing of it

arabic: ۞كُلُّ ٱلطَّعَامِ كَانَ حِلّٗا لِّبَنِيٓ إِسۡرَـٰٓءِيلَ إِلَّا مَا حَرَّمَ إِسۡرَـٰٓءِيلُ عَلَىٰ نَفۡسِهِۦ مِن قَبۡلِ أَن تُنَزَّلَ ٱلتَّوۡرَىٰةُۚ قُلۡ فَأۡتُواْ بِٱلتَّوۡرَىٰةِ فَٱتۡلُوهَآ إِن كُنتُمۡ صَٰدِقِينَ
translation: All food was lawful to the Children of Israel except what Israel had made unlawful to himself before the Torah was revealed. Say, [O Muhammad], "So bring the Torah and recite it, if you should be truthful
normalizedArabic: كل الطعام كان حلا لبني اسرءيل الا ما حرم اسرءيل علي نفسه من قبل ان تنزل التوريه قل فاتوا بالتوريه فاتلوها ان كنتم صدقين
normalizedTranslation: all food was lawful to the children of israel except what israel had made unlawful to himself before the torah was revealed. say, [o muhammad], "so bring the torah and recite it, if you should be truthful

arabic: فَمَنِ ٱفۡتَرَىٰ عَلَى ٱللَّهِ ٱلۡكَذِبَ مِنۢ بَعۡدِ ذَٰلِكَ فَأُوْلَـٰٓئِكَ هُمُ ٱلظَّـٰلِمُونَ
translation: And whoever invents about Allah untruth after that - then those are [truly] the wrongdoers
normalizedArabic: فمن افتري علي الله الكذب من بعد ذلك فاوليك هم الظلمون
normalizedTranslation: and whoever invents about allah untruth after that - then those are [truly] the wrongdoers

arabic: قُلۡ صَدَقَ ٱللَّهُۗ فَٱتَّبِعُواْ مِلَّةَ إِبۡرَٰهِيمَ حَنِيفٗاۖ وَمَا كَانَ مِنَ ٱلۡمُشۡرِكِينَ
translation: Say, "Allah has told the truth. So follow the religion of Abraham, inclining toward truth; and he was not of the polytheists
normalizedArabic: قل صدق الله فاتبعوا مله ابرهيم حنيفا وما كان من المشركين
normalizedTranslation: say, "allah has told the truth. so follow the religion of abraham, inclining toward truth; and he was not of the polytheists

arabic: إِنَّ أَوَّلَ بَيۡتٖ وُضِعَ لِلنَّاسِ لَلَّذِي بِبَكَّةَ مُبَارَكٗا وَهُدٗى لِّلۡعَٰلَمِينَ
translation: Indeed, the first House [of worship] established for mankind was that at Makkah - blessed and a guidance for the worlds
normalizedArabic: ان اول بيت وضع للناس للذي ببكه مباركا وهدي للعلمين
normalizedTranslation: indeed, the first house [of worship] established for mankind was that at makkah - blessed and a guidance for the worlds

arabic: فِيهِ ءَايَٰتُۢ بَيِّنَٰتٞ مَّقَامُ إِبۡرَٰهِيمَۖ وَمَن دَخَلَهُۥ كَانَ ءَامِنٗاۗ وَلِلَّهِ عَلَى ٱلنَّاسِ حِجُّ ٱلۡبَيۡتِ مَنِ ٱسۡتَطَاعَ إِلَيۡهِ سَبِيلٗاۚ وَمَن كَفَرَ فَإِنَّ ٱللَّهَ غَنِيٌّ عَنِ ٱلۡعَٰلَمِينَ
translation: In it are clear signs [such as] the standing place of Abraham. And whoever enters it shall be safe. And [due] to Allah from the people is a pilgrimage to the House - for whoever is able to find thereto a way. But whoever disbelieves - then indeed, Allah is free from need of the worlds
normalizedArabic: فيه ءايت بينت مقام ابرهيم ومن دخله كان ءامنا ولله علي الناس حج البيت من استطاع اليه سبيلا ومن كفر فان الله غني عن العلمين
normalizedTranslation: in it are clear signs [such as] the standing place of abraham. and whoever enters it shall be safe. and [due] to allah from the people is a pilgrimage to the house - for whoever is able to find thereto a way. but whoever disbelieves - then indeed, allah is free from need of the worlds

arabic: قُلۡ يَـٰٓأَهۡلَ ٱلۡكِتَٰبِ لِمَ تَكۡفُرُونَ بِـَٔايَٰتِ ٱللَّهِ وَٱللَّهُ شَهِيدٌ عَلَىٰ مَا تَعۡمَلُونَ
translation: Say, "O People of the Scripture, why do you disbelieve in the verses of Allah while Allah is Witness over what you do
normalizedArabic: قل ياهل الكتب لم تكفرون بايت الله والله شهيد علي ما تعملون
normalizedTranslation: say, "o people of the scripture, why do you disbelieve in the verses of allah while allah is witness over what you do

arabic: قُلۡ يَـٰٓأَهۡلَ ٱلۡكِتَٰبِ لِمَ تَصُدُّونَ عَن سَبِيلِ ٱللَّهِ مَنۡ ءَامَنَ تَبۡغُونَهَا عِوَجٗا وَأَنتُمۡ شُهَدَآءُۗ وَمَا ٱللَّهُ بِغَٰفِلٍ عَمَّا تَعۡمَلُونَ
translation: Say, "O People of the Scripture, why do you avert from the way of Allah those who believe, seeking to make it [seem] deviant, while you are witnesses [to the truth]? And Allah is not unaware of what you do
normalizedArabic: قل ياهل الكتب لم تصدون عن سبيل الله من ءامن تبغونها عوجا وانتم شهداء وما الله بغفل عما تعملون
normalizedTranslation: say, "o people of the scripture, why do you avert from the way of allah those who believe, seeking to make it [seem] deviant, while you are witnesses [to the truth]? and allah is not unaware of what you do

arabic: يَـٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوٓاْ إِن تُطِيعُواْ فَرِيقٗا مِّنَ ٱلَّذِينَ أُوتُواْ ٱلۡكِتَٰبَ يَرُدُّوكُم بَعۡدَ إِيمَٰنِكُمۡ كَٰفِرِينَ
translation: O you who have believed, if you obey a party of those who were given the Scripture, they would turn you back, after your belief, [to being] unbelievers
normalizedArabic: يايها الذين ءامنوا ان تطيعوا فريقا من الذين اوتوا الكتب يردوكم بعد ايمنكم كفرين
normalizedTranslation: o you who have believed, if you obey a party of those who were given the scripture, they would turn you back, after your belief, [to being] unbelievers

arabic: وَكَيۡفَ تَكۡفُرُونَ وَأَنتُمۡ تُتۡلَىٰ عَلَيۡكُمۡ ءَايَٰتُ ٱللَّهِ وَفِيكُمۡ رَسُولُهُۥۗ وَمَن يَعۡتَصِم بِٱللَّهِ فَقَدۡ هُدِيَ إِلَىٰ صِرَٰطٖ مُّسۡتَقِيمٖ
translation: And how could you disbelieve while to you are being recited the verses of Allah and among you is His Messenger? And whoever holds firmly to Allah has [indeed] been guided to a straight path
normalizedArabic: وكيف تكفرون وانتم تتلي عليكم ءايت الله وفيكم رسوله ومن يعتصم بالله فقد هدي الي صرط مستقيم
normalizedTranslation: and how could you disbelieve while to you are being recited the verses of allah and among you is his messenger? and whoever holds firmly to allah has [indeed] been guided to a straight path

arabic: يَـٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُواْ ٱتَّقُواْ ٱللَّهَ حَقَّ تُقَاتِهِۦ وَلَا تَمُوتُنَّ إِلَّا وَأَنتُم مُّسۡلِمُونَ
translation: O you who have believed, fear Allah as He should be feared and do not die except as Muslims [in submission to Him]
normalizedArabic: يايها الذين ءامنوا اتقوا الله حق تقاته ولا تموتن الا وانتم مسلمون
normalizedTranslation: o you who have believed, fear allah as he should be feared and do not die except as muslims [in submission to him]

arabic: وَٱعۡتَصِمُواْ بِحَبۡلِ ٱللَّهِ جَمِيعٗا وَلَا تَفَرَّقُواْۚ وَٱذۡكُرُواْ نِعۡمَتَ ٱللَّهِ عَلَيۡكُمۡ إِذۡ كُنتُمۡ أَعۡدَآءٗ فَأَلَّفَ بَيۡنَ قُلُوبِكُمۡ فَأَصۡبَحۡتُم بِنِعۡمَتِهِۦٓ إِخۡوَٰنٗا وَكُنتُمۡ عَلَىٰ شَفَا حُفۡرَةٖ مِّنَ ٱلنَّارِ فَأَنقَذَكُم مِّنۡهَاۗ كَذَٰلِكَ يُبَيِّنُ ٱللَّهُ لَكُمۡ ءَايَٰتِهِۦ لَعَلَّكُمۡ تَهۡتَدُونَ
translation: And hold firmly to the rope of Allah all together and do not become divided. And remember the favor of Allah upon you - when you were enemies and He brought your hearts together and you became, by His favor, brothers. And you were on the edge of a pit of the Fire, and He saved you from it. Thus does Allah make clear to you His verses that you may be guided
normalizedArabic: واعتصموا بحبل الله جميعا ولا تفرقوا واذكروا نعمت الله عليكم اذ كنتم اعداء فالف بين قلوبكم فاصبحتم بنعمته اخونا وكنتم علي شفا حفره من النار فانقذكم منها كذلك يبين الله لكم ءايته لعلكم تهتدون
normalizedTranslation: and hold firmly to the rope of allah all together and do not become divided. and remember the favor of allah upon you - when you were enemies and he brought your hearts together and you became, by his favor, brothers. and you were on the edge of a pit of the fire, and he saved you from it. thus does allah make clear to you his verses that you may be guided

arabic: وَلۡتَكُن مِّنكُمۡ أُمَّةٞ يَدۡعُونَ إِلَى ٱلۡخَيۡرِ وَيَأۡمُرُونَ بِٱلۡمَعۡرُوفِ وَيَنۡهَوۡنَ عَنِ ٱلۡمُنكَرِۚ وَأُوْلَـٰٓئِكَ هُمُ ٱلۡمُفۡلِحُونَ
translation: And let there be [arising] from you a nation inviting to [all that is] good, enjoining what is right and forbidding what is wrong, and those will be the successful
normalizedArabic: ولتكن منكم امه يدعون الي الخير ويامرون بالمعروف وينهون عن المنكر واوليك هم المفلحون
normalizedTranslation: and let there be [arising] from you a nation inviting to [all that is] good, enjoining what is right and forbidding what is wrong, and those will be the successful

arabic: وَلَا تَكُونُواْ كَٱلَّذِينَ تَفَرَّقُواْ وَٱخۡتَلَفُواْ مِنۢ بَعۡدِ مَا جَآءَهُمُ ٱلۡبَيِّنَٰتُۚ وَأُوْلَـٰٓئِكَ لَهُمۡ عَذَابٌ عَظِيمٞ
translation: And do not be like the ones who became divided and differed after the clear proofs had come to them. And those will have a great punishment
normalizedArabic: ولا تكونوا كالذين تفرقوا واختلفوا من بعد ما جاءهم البينت واوليك لهم عذاب عظيم
normalizedTranslation: and do not be like the ones who became divided and differed after the clear proofs had come to them. and those will have a great punishment

arabic: يَوۡمَ تَبۡيَضُّ وُجُوهٞ وَتَسۡوَدُّ وُجُوهٞۚ فَأَمَّا ٱلَّذِينَ ٱسۡوَدَّتۡ وُجُوهُهُمۡ أَكَفَرۡتُم بَعۡدَ إِيمَٰنِكُمۡ فَذُوقُواْ ٱلۡعَذَابَ بِمَا كُنتُمۡ تَكۡفُرُونَ
translation: On the Day [some] faces will turn white and [some] faces will turn black. As for those whose faces turn black, [to them it will be said], "Did you disbelieve after your belief? Then taste the punishment for what you used to reject
normalizedArabic: يوم تبيض وجوه وتسود وجوه فاما الذين اسودت وجوههم اكفرتم بعد ايمنكم فذوقوا العذاب بما كنتم تكفرون
normalizedTranslation: on the day [some] faces will turn white and [some] faces will turn black. as for those whose faces turn black, [to them it will be said], "did you disbelieve after your belief? then taste the punishment for what you used to reject

arabic: وَأَمَّا ٱلَّذِينَ ٱبۡيَضَّتۡ وُجُوهُهُمۡ فَفِي رَحۡمَةِ ٱللَّهِۖ هُمۡ فِيهَا خَٰلِدُونَ
translation: But as for those whose faces will turn white, [they will be] within the mercy of Allah. They will abide therein eternally
normalizedArabic: واما الذين ابيضت وجوههم ففي رحمه الله هم فيها خلدون
normalizedTranslation: but as for those whose faces will turn white, [they will be] within the mercy of allah. they will abide therein eternally

arabic: تِلۡكَ ءَايَٰتُ ٱللَّهِ نَتۡلُوهَا عَلَيۡكَ بِٱلۡحَقِّۗ وَمَا ٱللَّهُ يُرِيدُ ظُلۡمٗا لِّلۡعَٰلَمِينَ
translation: These are the verses of Allah. We recite them to you, [O Muhammad], in truth; and Allah wants no injustice to the worlds
normalizedArabic: تلك ءايت الله نتلوها عليك بالحق وما الله يريد ظلما للعلمين
normalizedTranslation: these are the verses of allah. we recite them to you, [o muhammad], in truth; and allah wants no injustice to the worlds

arabic: وَلِلَّهِ مَا فِي ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَمَا فِي ٱلۡأَرۡضِۚ وَإِلَى ٱللَّهِ تُرۡجَعُ ٱلۡأُمُورُ
translation: To Allah belongs whatever is in the heavens and whatever is on the earth. And to Allah will [all] matters be returned
normalizedArabic: ولله ما في السموت وما في الارض والي الله ترجع الامور
normalizedTranslation: to allah belongs whatever is in the heavens and whatever is on the earth. and to allah will [all] matters be returned

arabic: كُنتُمۡ خَيۡرَ أُمَّةٍ أُخۡرِجَتۡ لِلنَّاسِ تَأۡمُرُونَ بِٱلۡمَعۡرُوفِ وَتَنۡهَوۡنَ عَنِ ٱلۡمُنكَرِ وَتُؤۡمِنُونَ بِٱللَّهِۗ وَلَوۡ ءَامَنَ أَهۡلُ ٱلۡكِتَٰبِ لَكَانَ خَيۡرٗا لَّهُمۚ مِّنۡهُمُ ٱلۡمُؤۡمِنُونَ وَأَكۡثَرُهُمُ ٱلۡفَٰسِقُونَ
translation: You are the best nation produced [as an example] for mankind. You enjoin what is right and forbid what is wrong and believe in Allah. If only the People of the Scripture had believed, it would have been better for them. Among them are believers, but most of them are defiantly disobedient
normalizedArabic: كنتم خير امه اخرجت للناس تامرون بالمعروف وتنهون عن المنكر وتومنون بالله ولو ءامن اهل الكتب لكان خيرا لهم منهم المومنون واكثرهم الفسقون
normalizedTranslation: you are the best nation produced [as an example] for mankind. you enjoin what is right and forbid what is wrong and believe in allah. if only the people of the scripture had believed, it would have been better for them. among them are believers, but most of them are defiantly disobedient

arabic: لَن يَضُرُّوكُمۡ إِلَّآ أَذٗىۖ وَإِن يُقَٰتِلُوكُمۡ يُوَلُّوكُمُ ٱلۡأَدۡبَارَ ثُمَّ لَا يُنصَرُونَ
translation: They will not harm you except for [some] annoyance. And if they fight you, they will show you their backs; then they will not be aided
normalizedArabic: لن يضروكم الا اذي وان يقتلوكم يولوكم الادبار ثم لا ينصرون
normalizedTranslation: they will not harm you except for [some] annoyance. and if they fight you, they will show you their backs; then they will not be aided

arabic: ضُرِبَتۡ عَلَيۡهِمُ ٱلذِّلَّةُ أَيۡنَ مَا ثُقِفُوٓاْ إِلَّا بِحَبۡلٖ مِّنَ ٱللَّهِ وَحَبۡلٖ مِّنَ ٱلنَّاسِ وَبَآءُو بِغَضَبٖ مِّنَ ٱللَّهِ وَضُرِبَتۡ عَلَيۡهِمُ ٱلۡمَسۡكَنَةُۚ ذَٰلِكَ بِأَنَّهُمۡ كَانُواْ يَكۡفُرُونَ بِـَٔايَٰتِ ٱللَّهِ وَيَقۡتُلُونَ ٱلۡأَنۢبِيَآءَ بِغَيۡرِ حَقّٖۚ ذَٰلِكَ بِمَا عَصَواْ وَّكَانُواْ يَعۡتَدُونَ
translation: They have been put under humiliation [by Allah] wherever they are overtaken, except for a covenant from Allah and a rope from the Muslims. And they have drawn upon themselves anger from Allah and have been put under destitution. That is because they disbelieved in the verses of Allah and killed the prophets without right. That is because they disobeyed and [habitually] transgressed
normalizedArabic: ضربت عليهم الذله اين ما ثقفوا الا بحبل من الله وحبل من الناس وباءو بغضب من الله وضربت عليهم المسكنه ذلك بانهم كانوا يكفرون بايت الله ويقتلون الانبياء بغير حق ذلك بما عصوا وكانوا يعتدون
normalizedTranslation: they have been put under humiliation [by allah] wherever they are overtaken, except for a covenant from allah and a rope from the muslims. and they have drawn upon themselves anger from allah and have been put under destitution. that is because they disbelieved in the verses of allah and killed the prophets without right. that is because they disobeyed and [habitually] transgressed

arabic: ۞لَيۡسُواْ سَوَآءٗۗ مِّنۡ أَهۡلِ ٱلۡكِتَٰبِ أُمَّةٞ قَآئِمَةٞ يَتۡلُونَ ءَايَٰتِ ٱللَّهِ ءَانَآءَ ٱلَّيۡلِ وَهُمۡ يَسۡجُدُونَ
translation: They are not [all] the same; among the People of the Scripture is a community standing [in obedience], reciting the verses of Allah during periods of the night and prostrating [in prayer]
normalizedArabic: ليسوا سواء من اهل الكتب امه قايمه يتلون ءايت الله ءاناء اليل وهم يسجدون
normalizedTranslation: they are not [all] the same; among the people of the scripture is a community standing [in obedience], reciting the verses of allah during periods of the night and prostrating [in prayer]

arabic: يُؤۡمِنُونَ بِٱللَّهِ وَٱلۡيَوۡمِ ٱلۡأٓخِرِ وَيَأۡمُرُونَ بِٱلۡمَعۡرُوفِ وَيَنۡهَوۡنَ عَنِ ٱلۡمُنكَرِ وَيُسَٰرِعُونَ فِي ٱلۡخَيۡرَٰتِۖ وَأُوْلَـٰٓئِكَ مِنَ ٱلصَّـٰلِحِينَ
translation: They believe in Allah and the Last Day, and they enjoin what is right and forbid what is wrong and hasten to good deeds. And those are among the righteous
normalizedArabic: يومنون بالله واليوم الاخر ويامرون بالمعروف وينهون عن المنكر ويسرعون في الخيرت واوليك من الصلحين
normalizedTranslation: they believe in allah and the last day, and they enjoin what is right and forbid what is wrong and hasten to good deeds. and those are among the righteous

arabic: وَمَا يَفۡعَلُواْ مِنۡ خَيۡرٖ فَلَن يُكۡفَرُوهُۗ وَٱللَّهُ عَلِيمُۢ بِٱلۡمُتَّقِينَ
translation: And whatever good they do - never will it be removed from them. And Allah is Knowing of the righteous
normalizedArabic: وما يفعلوا من خير فلن يكفروه والله عليم بالمتقين
normalizedTranslation: and whatever good they do - never will it be removed from them. and allah is knowing of the righteous

arabic: إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُواْ لَن تُغۡنِيَ عَنۡهُمۡ أَمۡوَٰلُهُمۡ وَلَآ أَوۡلَٰدُهُم مِّنَ ٱللَّهِ شَيۡـٔٗاۖ وَأُوْلَـٰٓئِكَ أَصۡحَٰبُ ٱلنَّارِۖ هُمۡ فِيهَا خَٰلِدُونَ
translation: Indeed, those who disbelieve - never will their wealth or their children avail them against Allah at all, and those are the companions of the Fire; they will abide therein eternally
normalizedArabic: ان الذين كفروا لن تغني عنهم امولهم ولا اولدهم من الله شيا واوليك اصحب النار هم فيها خلدون
normalizedTranslation: indeed, those who disbelieve - never will their wealth or their children avail them against allah at all, and those are the companions of the fire; they will abide therein eternally

arabic: مَثَلُ مَا يُنفِقُونَ فِي هَٰذِهِ ٱلۡحَيَوٰةِ ٱلدُّنۡيَا كَمَثَلِ رِيحٖ فِيهَا صِرٌّ أَصَابَتۡ حَرۡثَ قَوۡمٖ ظَلَمُوٓاْ أَنفُسَهُمۡ فَأَهۡلَكَتۡهُۚ وَمَا ظَلَمَهُمُ ٱللَّهُ وَلَٰكِنۡ أَنفُسَهُمۡ يَظۡلِمُونَ
translation: The example of what they spend in this worldly life is like that of a wind containing frost which strikes the harvest of a people who have wronged themselves and destroys it. And Allah has not wronged them, but they wrong themselves
normalizedArabic: مثل ما ينفقون في هذه الحيوه الدنيا كمثل ريح فيها صر اصابت حرث قوم ظلموا انفسهم فاهلكته وما ظلمهم الله ولكن انفسهم يظلمون
normalizedTranslation: the example of what they spend in this worldly life is like that of a wind containing frost which strikes the harvest of a people who have wronged themselves and destroys it. and allah has not wronged them, but they wrong themselves

arabic: يَـٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُواْ لَا تَتَّخِذُواْ بِطَانَةٗ مِّن دُونِكُمۡ لَا يَأۡلُونَكُمۡ خَبَالٗا وَدُّواْ مَا عَنِتُّمۡ قَدۡ بَدَتِ ٱلۡبَغۡضَآءُ مِنۡ أَفۡوَٰهِهِمۡ وَمَا تُخۡفِي صُدُورُهُمۡ أَكۡبَرُۚ قَدۡ بَيَّنَّا لَكُمُ ٱلۡأٓيَٰتِۖ إِن كُنتُمۡ تَعۡقِلُونَ
translation: O you who have believed, do not take as intimates those other than yourselves, for they will not spare you [any] ruin. They wish you would have hardship. Hatred has already appeared from their mouths, and what their breasts conceal is greater. We have certainly made clear to you the signs, if you will use reason
normalizedArabic: يايها الذين ءامنوا لا تتخذوا بطانه من دونكم لا يالونكم خبالا ودوا ما عنتم قد بدت البغضاء من افوههم وما تخفي صدورهم اكبر قد بينا لكم الايت ان كنتم تعقلون
normalizedTranslation: o you who have believed, do not take as intimates those other than yourselves, for they will not spare you [any] ruin. they wish you would have hardship. hatred has already appeared from their mouths, and what their breasts conceal is greater. we have certainly made clear to you the signs, if you will use reason

arabic: هَـٰٓأَنتُمۡ أُوْلَآءِ تُحِبُّونَهُمۡ وَلَا يُحِبُّونَكُمۡ وَتُؤۡمِنُونَ بِٱلۡكِتَٰبِ كُلِّهِۦ وَإِذَا لَقُوكُمۡ قَالُوٓاْ ءَامَنَّا وَإِذَا خَلَوۡاْ عَضُّواْ عَلَيۡكُمُ ٱلۡأَنَامِلَ مِنَ ٱلۡغَيۡظِۚ قُلۡ مُوتُواْ بِغَيۡظِكُمۡۗ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ عَلِيمُۢ بِذَاتِ ٱلصُّدُورِ
translation: Here you are loving them but they are not loving you, while you believe in the Scripture - all of it. And when they meet you, they say, "We believe." But when they are alone, they bite their fingertips at you in rage. Say, "Die in your rage. Indeed, Allah is Knowing of that within the breasts
normalizedArabic: هانتم اولاء تحبونهم ولا يحبونكم وتومنون بالكتب كله واذا لقوكم قالوا ءامنا واذا خلوا عضوا عليكم الانامل من الغيظ قل موتوا بغيظكم ان الله عليم بذات الصدور
normalizedTranslation: here you are loving them but they are not loving you, while you believe in the scripture - all of it. and when they meet you, they say, "we believe." but when they are alone, they bite their fingertips at you in rage. say, "die in your rage. indeed, allah is knowing of that within the breasts

arabic: إِن تَمۡسَسۡكُمۡ حَسَنَةٞ تَسُؤۡهُمۡ وَإِن تُصِبۡكُمۡ سَيِّئَةٞ يَفۡرَحُواْ بِهَاۖ وَإِن تَصۡبِرُواْ وَتَتَّقُواْ لَا يَضُرُّكُمۡ كَيۡدُهُمۡ شَيۡـًٔاۗ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ بِمَا يَعۡمَلُونَ مُحِيطٞ
translation: If good touches you, it distresses them; but if harm strikes you, they rejoice at it. And if you are patient and fear Allah, their plot will not harm you at all. Indeed, Allah is encompassing of what they do
normalizedArabic: ان تمسسكم حسنه تسوهم وان تصبكم سييه يفرحوا بها وان تصبروا وتتقوا لا يضركم كيدهم شيا ان الله بما يعملون محيط
normalizedTranslation: if good touches you, it distresses them; but if harm strikes you, they rejoice at it. and if you are patient and fear allah, their plot will not harm you at all. indeed, allah is encompassing of what they do

arabic: وَإِذۡ غَدَوۡتَ مِنۡ أَهۡلِكَ تُبَوِّئُ ٱلۡمُؤۡمِنِينَ مَقَٰعِدَ لِلۡقِتَالِۗ وَٱللَّهُ سَمِيعٌ عَلِيمٌ
translation: And [remember] when you, [O Muhammad], left your family in the morning to post the believers at their stations for the battle [of Uhud] - and Allah is Hearing and Knowing
normalizedArabic: واذ غدوت من اهلك تبوي المومنين مقعد للقتال والله سميع عليم
normalizedTranslation: and [remember] when you, [o muhammad], left your family in the morning to post the believers at their stations for the battle [of uhud] - and allah is hearing and knowing

arabic: إِذۡ هَمَّت طَّآئِفَتَانِ مِنكُمۡ أَن تَفۡشَلَا وَٱللَّهُ وَلِيُّهُمَاۗ وَعَلَى ٱللَّهِ فَلۡيَتَوَكَّلِ ٱلۡمُؤۡمِنُونَ
translation: When two parties among you were about to lose courage, but Allah was their ally; and upon Allah the believers should rely
normalizedArabic: اذ همت طايفتان منكم ان تفشلا والله وليهما وعلي الله فليتوكل المومنون
normalizedTranslation: when two parties among you were about to lose courage, but allah was their ally; and upon allah the believers should rely

arabic: وَلَقَدۡ نَصَرَكُمُ ٱللَّهُ بِبَدۡرٖ وَأَنتُمۡ أَذِلَّةٞۖ فَٱتَّقُواْ ٱللَّهَ لَعَلَّكُمۡ تَشۡكُرُونَ
translation: And already had Allah given you victory at [the battle of] Badr while you were few in number. Then fear Allah; perhaps you will be grateful
normalizedArabic: ولقد نصركم الله ببدر وانتم اذله فاتقوا الله لعلكم تشكرون
normalizedTranslation: and already had allah given you victory at [the battle of] badr while you were few in number. then fear allah; perhaps you will be grateful

arabic: إِذۡ تَقُولُ لِلۡمُؤۡمِنِينَ أَلَن يَكۡفِيَكُمۡ أَن يُمِدَّكُمۡ رَبُّكُم بِثَلَٰثَةِ ءَالَٰفٖ مِّنَ ٱلۡمَلَـٰٓئِكَةِ مُنزَلِينَ
translation: [Remember] when you said to the believers, "Is it not sufficient for you that your Lord should reinforce you with three thousand angels sent down
normalizedArabic: اذ تقول للمومنين الن يكفيكم ان يمدكم ربكم بثلثه ءالف من المليكه منزلين
normalizedTranslation: [remember] when you said to the believers, "is it not sufficient for you that your lord should reinforce you with three thousand angels sent down

arabic: بَلَىٰٓۚ إِن تَصۡبِرُواْ وَتَتَّقُواْ وَيَأۡتُوكُم مِّن فَوۡرِهِمۡ هَٰذَا يُمۡدِدۡكُمۡ رَبُّكُم بِخَمۡسَةِ ءَالَٰفٖ مِّنَ ٱلۡمَلَـٰٓئِكَةِ مُسَوِّمِينَ
translation: Yes, if you remain patient and conscious of Allah and the enemy come upon you [attacking] in rage, your Lord will reinforce you with five thousand angels having marks [of distinction]
normalizedArabic: بلي ان تصبروا وتتقوا وياتوكم من فورهم هذا يمددكم ربكم بخمسه ءالف من المليكه مسومين
normalizedTranslation: yes, if you remain patient and conscious of allah and the enemy come upon you [attacking] in rage, your lord will reinforce you with five thousand angels having marks [of distinction]

arabic: وَمَا جَعَلَهُ ٱللَّهُ إِلَّا بُشۡرَىٰ لَكُمۡ وَلِتَطۡمَئِنَّ قُلُوبُكُم بِهِۦۗ وَمَا ٱلنَّصۡرُ إِلَّا مِنۡ عِندِ ٱللَّهِ ٱلۡعَزِيزِ ٱلۡحَكِيمِ
translation: And Allah made it not except as [a sign of] good tidings for you and to reassure your hearts thereby. And victory is not except from Allah, the Exalted in Might, the Wise
normalizedArabic: وما جعله الله الا بشري لكم ولتطمين قلوبكم به وما النصر الا من عند الله العزيز الحكيم
normalizedTranslation: and allah made it not except as [a sign of] good tidings for you and to reassure your hearts thereby. and victory is not except from allah, the exalted in might, the wise

arabic: لِيَقۡطَعَ طَرَفٗا مِّنَ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوٓاْ أَوۡ يَكۡبِتَهُمۡ فَيَنقَلِبُواْ خَآئِبِينَ
translation: That He might cut down a section of the disbelievers or suppress them so that they turn back disappointed
normalizedArabic: ليقطع طرفا من الذين كفروا او يكبتهم فينقلبوا خايبين
normalizedTranslation: that he might cut down a section of the disbelievers or suppress them so that they turn back disappointed

arabic: لَيۡسَ لَكَ مِنَ ٱلۡأَمۡرِ شَيۡءٌ أَوۡ يَتُوبَ عَلَيۡهِمۡ أَوۡ يُعَذِّبَهُمۡ فَإِنَّهُمۡ ظَٰلِمُونَ
translation: Not for you, [O Muhammad, but for Allah], is the decision whether He should [cut them down] or forgive them or punish them, for indeed, they are wrongdoers
normalizedArabic: ليس لك من الامر شيء او يتوب عليهم او يعذبهم فانهم ظلمون
normalizedTranslation: not for you, [o muhammad, but for allah], is the decision whether he should [cut them down] or forgive them or punish them, for indeed, they are wrongdoers

arabic: وَلِلَّهِ مَا فِي ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَمَا فِي ٱلۡأَرۡضِۚ يَغۡفِرُ لِمَن يَشَآءُ وَيُعَذِّبُ مَن يَشَآءُۚ وَٱللَّهُ غَفُورٞ رَّحِيمٞ
translation: And to Allah belongs whatever is in the heavens and whatever is on the earth. He forgives whom He wills and punishes whom He wills. And Allah is Forgiving and Merciful
normalizedArabic: ولله ما في السموت وما في الارض يغفر لمن يشاء ويعذب من يشاء والله غفور رحيم
normalizedTranslation: and to allah belongs whatever is in the heavens and whatever is on the earth. he forgives whom he wills and punishes whom he wills. and allah is forgiving and merciful

arabic: يَـٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُواْ لَا تَأۡكُلُواْ ٱلرِّبَوٰٓاْ أَضۡعَٰفٗا مُّضَٰعَفَةٗۖ وَٱتَّقُواْ ٱللَّهَ لَعَلَّكُمۡ تُفۡلِحُونَ
translation: O you who have believed, do not consume usury, doubled and multiplied, but fear Allah that you may be successful
normalizedArabic: يايها الذين ءامنوا لا تاكلوا الربوا اضعفا مضعفه واتقوا الله لعلكم تفلحون
normalizedTranslation: o you who have believed, do not consume usury, doubled and multiplied, but fear allah that you may be successful

arabic: وَٱتَّقُواْ ٱلنَّارَ ٱلَّتِيٓ أُعِدَّتۡ لِلۡكَٰفِرِينَ
translation: And fear the Fire, which has been prepared for the disbelievers
normalizedArabic: واتقوا النار التي اعدت للكفرين
normalizedTranslation: and fear the fire, which has been prepared for the disbelievers

arabic: وَأَطِيعُواْ ٱللَّهَ وَٱلرَّسُولَ لَعَلَّكُمۡ تُرۡحَمُونَ
translation: And obey Allah and the Messenger that you may obtain mercy
normalizedArabic: واطيعوا الله والرسول لعلكم ترحمون
normalizedTranslation: and obey allah and the messenger that you may obtain mercy

arabic: ۞وَسَارِعُوٓاْ إِلَىٰ مَغۡفِرَةٖ مِّن رَّبِّكُمۡ وَجَنَّةٍ عَرۡضُهَا ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتُ وَٱلۡأَرۡضُ أُعِدَّتۡ لِلۡمُتَّقِينَ
translation: And hasten to forgiveness from your Lord and a garden as wide as the heavens and earth, prepared for the righteous
normalizedArabic: وسارعوا الي مغفره من ربكم وجنه عرضها السموت والارض اعدت للمتقين
normalizedTranslation: and hasten to forgiveness from your lord and a garden as wide as the heavens and earth, prepared for the righteous

arabic: ٱلَّذِينَ يُنفِقُونَ فِي ٱلسَّرَّآءِ وَٱلضَّرَّآءِ وَٱلۡكَٰظِمِينَ ٱلۡغَيۡظَ وَٱلۡعَافِينَ عَنِ ٱلنَّاسِۗ وَٱللَّهُ يُحِبُّ ٱلۡمُحۡسِنِينَ
translation: Who spend [in the cause of Allah] during ease and hardship and who restrain anger and who pardon the people - and Allah loves the doers of good
normalizedArabic: الذين ينفقون في السراء والضراء والكظمين الغيظ والعافين عن الناس والله يحب المحسنين
normalizedTranslation: who spend [in the cause of allah] during ease and hardship and who restrain anger and who pardon the people - and allah loves the doers of good

arabic: وَٱلَّذِينَ إِذَا فَعَلُواْ فَٰحِشَةً أَوۡ ظَلَمُوٓاْ أَنفُسَهُمۡ ذَكَرُواْ ٱللَّهَ فَٱسۡتَغۡفَرُواْ لِذُنُوبِهِمۡ وَمَن يَغۡفِرُ ٱلذُّنُوبَ إِلَّا ٱللَّهُ وَلَمۡ يُصِرُّواْ عَلَىٰ مَا فَعَلُواْ وَهُمۡ يَعۡلَمُونَ
translation: And those who, when they commit an immorality or wrong themselves [by transgression], remember Allah and seek forgiveness for their sins - and who can forgive sins except Allah? - and [who] do not persist in what they have done while they know
normalizedArabic: والذين اذا فعلوا فحشه او ظلموا انفسهم ذكروا الله فاستغفروا لذنوبهم ومن يغفر الذنوب الا الله ولم يصروا علي ما فعلوا وهم يعلمون
normalizedTranslation: and those who, when they commit an immorality or wrong themselves [by transgression], remember allah and seek forgiveness for their sins - and who can forgive sins except allah? - and [who] do not persist in what they have done while they know

arabic: أُوْلَـٰٓئِكَ جَزَآؤُهُم مَّغۡفِرَةٞ مِّن رَّبِّهِمۡ وَجَنَّـٰتٞ تَجۡرِي مِن تَحۡتِهَا ٱلۡأَنۡهَٰرُ خَٰلِدِينَ فِيهَاۚ وَنِعۡمَ أَجۡرُ ٱلۡعَٰمِلِينَ
translation: Those - their reward is forgiveness from their Lord and gardens beneath which rivers flow [in Paradise], wherein they will abide eternally; and excellent is the reward of the [righteous] workers
normalizedArabic: اوليك جزاوهم مغفره من ربهم وجنت تجري من تحتها الانهر خلدين فيها ونعم اجر العملين
normalizedTranslation: those - their reward is forgiveness from their lord and gardens beneath which rivers flow [in paradise], wherein they will abide eternally; and excellent is the reward of the [righteous] workers

arabic: قَدۡ خَلَتۡ مِن قَبۡلِكُمۡ سُنَنٞ فَسِيرُواْ فِي ٱلۡأَرۡضِ فَٱنظُرُواْ كَيۡفَ كَانَ عَٰقِبَةُ ٱلۡمُكَذِّبِينَ
translation: Similar situations [as yours] have passed on before you, so proceed throughout the earth and observe how was the end of those who denied
normalizedArabic: قد خلت من قبلكم سنن فسيروا في الارض فانظروا كيف كان عقبه المكذبين
normalizedTranslation: similar situations [as yours] have passed on before you, so proceed throughout the earth and observe how was the end of those who denied

arabic: هَٰذَا بَيَانٞ لِّلنَّاسِ وَهُدٗى وَمَوۡعِظَةٞ لِّلۡمُتَّقِينَ
translation: This [Qur'an] is a clear statement to [all] the people and a guidance and instruction for those conscious of Allah
normalizedArabic: هذا بيان للناس وهدي وموعظه للمتقين
normalizedTranslation: this [qur'an] is a clear statement to [all] the people and a guidance and instruction for those conscious of allah

arabic: وَلَا تَهِنُواْ وَلَا تَحۡزَنُواْ وَأَنتُمُ ٱلۡأَعۡلَوۡنَ إِن كُنتُم مُّؤۡمِنِينَ
translation: So do not weaken and do not grieve, and you will be superior if you are [true] believers
normalizedArabic: ولا تهنوا ولا تحزنوا وانتم الاعلون ان كنتم مومنين
normalizedTranslation: so do not weaken and do not grieve, and you will be superior if you are [true] believers

arabic: إِن يَمۡسَسۡكُمۡ قَرۡحٞ فَقَدۡ مَسَّ ٱلۡقَوۡمَ قَرۡحٞ مِّثۡلُهُۥۚ وَتِلۡكَ ٱلۡأَيَّامُ نُدَاوِلُهَا بَيۡنَ ٱلنَّاسِ وَلِيَعۡلَمَ ٱللَّهُ ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُواْ وَيَتَّخِذَ مِنكُمۡ شُهَدَآءَۗ وَٱللَّهُ لَا يُحِبُّ ٱلظَّـٰلِمِينَ
translation: If a wound should touch you - there has already touched the [opposing] people a wound similar to it. And these days [of varying conditions] We alternate among the people so that Allah may make evident those who believe and [may] take to Himself from among you martyrs - and Allah does not like the wrongdoers
normalizedArabic: ان يمسسكم قرح فقد مس القوم قرح مثله وتلك الايام نداولها بين الناس وليعلم الله الذين ءامنوا ويتخذ منكم شهداء والله لا يحب الظلمين
normalizedTranslation: if a wound should touch you - there has already touched the [opposing] people a wound similar to it. and these days [of varying conditions] we alternate among the people so that allah may make evident those who believe and [may] take to himself from among you martyrs - and allah does not like the wrongdoers

arabic: وَلِيُمَحِّصَ ٱللَّهُ ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُواْ وَيَمۡحَقَ ٱلۡكَٰفِرِينَ
translation: And that Allah may purify the believers [through trials] and destroy the disbelievers
normalizedArabic: وليمحص الله الذين ءامنوا ويمحق الكفرين
normalizedTranslation: and that allah may purify the believers [through trials] and destroy the disbelievers

arabic: أَمۡ حَسِبۡتُمۡ أَن تَدۡخُلُواْ ٱلۡجَنَّةَ وَلَمَّا يَعۡلَمِ ٱللَّهُ ٱلَّذِينَ جَٰهَدُواْ مِنكُمۡ وَيَعۡلَمَ ٱلصَّـٰبِرِينَ
translation: Or do you think that you will enter Paradise while Allah has not yet made evident those of you who fight in His cause and made evident those who are steadfast
normalizedArabic: ام حسبتم ان تدخلوا الجنه ولما يعلم الله الذين جهدوا منكم ويعلم الصبرين
normalizedTranslation: or do you think that you will enter paradise while allah has not yet made evident those of you who fight in his cause and made evident those who are steadfast

arabic: وَلَقَدۡ كُنتُمۡ تَمَنَّوۡنَ ٱلۡمَوۡتَ مِن قَبۡلِ أَن تَلۡقَوۡهُ فَقَدۡ رَأَيۡتُمُوهُ وَأَنتُمۡ تَنظُرُونَ
translation: And you had certainly wished for martyrdom before you encountered it, and you have [now] seen it [before you] while you were looking on
normalizedArabic: ولقد كنتم تمنون الموت من قبل ان تلقوه فقد رايتموه وانتم تنظرون
normalizedTranslation: and you had certainly wished for martyrdom before you encountered it, and you have [now] seen it [before you] while you were looking on

arabic: وَمَا مُحَمَّدٌ إِلَّا رَسُولٞ قَدۡ خَلَتۡ مِن قَبۡلِهِ ٱلرُّسُلُۚ أَفَإِيْن مَّاتَ أَوۡ قُتِلَ ٱنقَلَبۡتُمۡ عَلَىٰٓ أَعۡقَٰبِكُمۡۚ وَمَن يَنقَلِبۡ عَلَىٰ عَقِبَيۡهِ فَلَن يَضُرَّ ٱللَّهَ شَيۡـٔٗاۚ وَسَيَجۡزِي ٱللَّهُ ٱلشَّـٰكِرِينَ
translation: Muhammad is not but a messenger. [Other] messengers have passed on before him. So if he was to die or be killed, would you turn back on your heels [to unbelief]? And he who turns back on his heels will never harm Allah at all; but Allah will reward the grateful
normalizedArabic: وما محمد الا رسول قد خلت من قبله الرسل افاين مات او قتل انقلبتم علي اعقبكم ومن ينقلب علي عقبيه فلن يضر الله شيا وسيجزي الله الشكرين
normalizedTranslation: muhammad is not but a messenger. [other] messengers have passed on before him. so if he was to die or be killed, would you turn back on your heels [to unbelief]? and he who turns back on his heels will never harm allah at all; but allah will reward the grateful

arabic: وَمَا كَانَ لِنَفۡسٍ أَن تَمُوتَ إِلَّا بِإِذۡنِ ٱللَّهِ كِتَٰبٗا مُّؤَجَّلٗاۗ وَمَن يُرِدۡ ثَوَابَ ٱلدُّنۡيَا نُؤۡتِهِۦ مِنۡهَا وَمَن يُرِدۡ ثَوَابَ ٱلۡأٓخِرَةِ نُؤۡتِهِۦ مِنۡهَاۚ وَسَنَجۡزِي ٱلشَّـٰكِرِينَ
translation: And it is not [possible] for one to die except by permission of Allah at a decree determined. And whoever desires the reward of this world - We will give him thereof; and whoever desires the reward of the Hereafter - We will give him thereof. And we will reward the grateful
normalizedArabic: وما كان لنفس ان تموت الا باذن الله كتبا موجلا ومن يرد ثواب الدنيا نوته منها ومن يرد ثواب الاخره نوته منها وسنجزي الشكرين
normalizedTranslation: and it is not [possible] for one to die except by permission of allah at a decree determined. and whoever desires the reward of this world - we will give him thereof; and whoever desires the reward of the hereafter - we will give him thereof. and we will reward the grateful

arabic: وَكَأَيِّن مِّن نَّبِيّٖ قَٰتَلَ مَعَهُۥ رِبِّيُّونَ كَثِيرٞ فَمَا وَهَنُواْ لِمَآ أَصَابَهُمۡ فِي سَبِيلِ ٱللَّهِ وَمَا ضَعُفُواْ وَمَا ٱسۡتَكَانُواْۗ وَٱللَّهُ يُحِبُّ ٱلصَّـٰبِرِينَ
translation: And how many a prophet [fought and] with him fought many religious scholars. But they never lost assurance due to what afflicted them in the cause of Allah, nor did they weaken or submit. And Allah loves the steadfast
normalizedArabic: وكاين من نبي قتل معه ربيون كثير فما وهنوا لما اصابهم في سبيل الله وما ضعفوا وما استكانوا والله يحب الصبرين
normalizedTranslation: and how many a prophet [fought and] with him fought many religious scholars. but they never lost assurance due to what afflicted them in the cause of allah, nor did they weaken or submit. and allah loves the steadfast

arabic: وَمَا كَانَ قَوۡلَهُمۡ إِلَّآ أَن قَالُواْ رَبَّنَا ٱغۡفِرۡ لَنَا ذُنُوبَنَا وَإِسۡرَافَنَا فِيٓ أَمۡرِنَا وَثَبِّتۡ أَقۡدَامَنَا وَٱنصُرۡنَا عَلَى ٱلۡقَوۡمِ ٱلۡكَٰفِرِينَ
translation: And their words were not but that they said, "Our Lord, forgive us our sins and the excess [committed] in our affairs and plant firmly our feet and give us victory over the disbelieving people
normalizedArabic: وما كان قولهم الا ان قالوا ربنا اغفر لنا ذنوبنا واسرافنا في امرنا وثبت اقدامنا وانصرنا علي القوم الكفرين
normalizedTranslation: and their words were not but that they said, "our lord, forgive us our sins and the excess [committed] in our affairs and plant firmly our feet and give us victory over the disbelieving people

arabic: فَـَٔاتَىٰهُمُ ٱللَّهُ ثَوَابَ ٱلدُّنۡيَا وَحُسۡنَ ثَوَابِ ٱلۡأٓخِرَةِۗ وَٱللَّهُ يُحِبُّ ٱلۡمُحۡسِنِينَ
translation: So Allah gave them the reward of this world and the good reward of the Hereafter. And Allah loves the doers of good
normalizedArabic: فاتيهم الله ثواب الدنيا وحسن ثواب الاخره والله يحب المحسنين
normalizedTranslation: so allah gave them the reward of this world and the good reward of the hereafter. and allah loves the doers of good

arabic: يَـٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوٓاْ إِن تُطِيعُواْ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُواْ يَرُدُّوكُمۡ عَلَىٰٓ أَعۡقَٰبِكُمۡ فَتَنقَلِبُواْ خَٰسِرِينَ
translation: O you who have believed, if you obey those who disbelieve, they will turn you back on your heels, and you will [then] become losers
normalizedArabic: يايها الذين ءامنوا ان تطيعوا الذين كفروا يردوكم علي اعقبكم فتنقلبوا خسرين
normalizedTranslation: o you who have believed, if you obey those who disbelieve, they will turn you back on your heels, and you will [then] become losers

arabic: بَلِ ٱللَّهُ مَوۡلَىٰكُمۡۖ وَهُوَ خَيۡرُ ٱلنَّـٰصِرِينَ
translation: But Allah is your protector, and He is the best of helpers
normalizedArabic: بل الله موليكم وهو خير النصرين
normalizedTranslation: but allah is your protector, and he is the best of helpers

arabic: سَنُلۡقِي فِي قُلُوبِ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُواْ ٱلرُّعۡبَ بِمَآ أَشۡرَكُواْ بِٱللَّهِ مَا لَمۡ يُنَزِّلۡ بِهِۦ سُلۡطَٰنٗاۖ وَمَأۡوَىٰهُمُ ٱلنَّارُۖ وَبِئۡسَ مَثۡوَى ٱلظَّـٰلِمِينَ
translation: We will cast terror into the hearts of those who disbelieve for what they have associated with Allah of which He had not sent down [any] authority. And their refuge will be the Fire, and wretched is the residence of the wrongdoers
normalizedArabic: سنلقي في قلوب الذين كفروا الرعب بما اشركوا بالله ما لم ينزل به سلطنا وماويهم النار وبيس مثوي الظلمين
normalizedTranslation: we will cast terror into the hearts of those who disbelieve for what they have associated with allah of which he had not sent down [any] authority. and their refuge will be the fire, and wretched is the residence of the wrongdoers

arabic: وَلَقَدۡ صَدَقَكُمُ ٱللَّهُ وَعۡدَهُۥٓ إِذۡ تَحُسُّونَهُم بِإِذۡنِهِۦۖ حَتَّىٰٓ إِذَا فَشِلۡتُمۡ وَتَنَٰزَعۡتُمۡ فِي ٱلۡأَمۡرِ وَعَصَيۡتُم مِّنۢ بَعۡدِ مَآ أَرَىٰكُم مَّا تُحِبُّونَۚ مِنكُم مَّن يُرِيدُ ٱلدُّنۡيَا وَمِنكُم مَّن يُرِيدُ ٱلۡأٓخِرَةَۚ ثُمَّ صَرَفَكُمۡ عَنۡهُمۡ لِيَبۡتَلِيَكُمۡۖ وَلَقَدۡ عَفَا عَنكُمۡۗ وَٱللَّهُ ذُو فَضۡلٍ عَلَى ٱلۡمُؤۡمِنِينَ
translation: And Allah had certainly fulfilled His promise to you when you were killing the enemy by His permission until [the time] when you lost courage and fell to disputing about the order [given by the Prophet] and disobeyed after He had shown you that which you love. Among you are some who desire this world, and among you are some who desire the Hereafter. Then he turned you back from them [defeated] that He might test you. And He has already forgiven you, and Allah is the possessor of bounty for the believers
normalizedArabic: ولقد صدقكم الله وعده اذ تحسونهم باذنه حتي اذا فشلتم وتنزعتم في الامر وعصيتم من بعد ما اريكم ما تحبون منكم من يريد الدنيا ومنكم من يريد الاخره ثم صرفكم عنهم ليبتليكم ولقد عفا عنكم والله ذو فضل علي المومنين
normalizedTranslation: and allah had certainly fulfilled his promise to you when you were killing the enemy by his permission until [the time] when you lost courage and fell to disputing about the order [given by the prophet] and disobeyed after he had shown you that which you love. among you are some who desire this world, and among you are some who desire the hereafter. then he turned you back from them [defeated] that he might test you. and he has already forgiven you, and allah is the possessor of bounty for the believers

arabic: ۞إِذۡ تُصۡعِدُونَ وَلَا تَلۡوُۥنَ عَلَىٰٓ أَحَدٖ وَٱلرَّسُولُ يَدۡعُوكُمۡ فِيٓ أُخۡرَىٰكُمۡ فَأَثَٰبَكُمۡ غَمَّۢا بِغَمّٖ لِّكَيۡلَا تَحۡزَنُواْ عَلَىٰ مَا فَاتَكُمۡ وَلَا مَآ أَصَٰبَكُمۡۗ وَٱللَّهُ خَبِيرُۢ بِمَا تَعۡمَلُونَ
translation: [Remember] when you [fled and] climbed [the mountain] without looking aside at anyone while the Messenger was calling you from behind. So Allah repaid you with distress upon distress so you would not grieve for that which had escaped you [of victory and spoils of war] or [for] that which had befallen you [of injury and death]. And Allah is [fully] Acquainted with what you do
normalizedArabic: اذ تصعدون ولا تلون علي احد والرسول يدعوكم في اخريكم فاثبكم غما بغم لكيلا تحزنوا علي ما فاتكم ولا ما اصبكم والله خبير بما تعملون
normalizedTranslation: [remember] when you [fled and] climbed [the mountain] without looking aside at anyone while the messenger was calling you from behind. so allah repaid you with distress upon distress so you would not grieve for that which had escaped you [of victory and spoils of war] or [for] that which had befallen you [of injury and death]. and allah is [fully] acquainted with what you do

arabic: ثُمَّ أَنزَلَ عَلَيۡكُم مِّنۢ بَعۡدِ ٱلۡغَمِّ أَمَنَةٗ نُّعَاسٗا يَغۡشَىٰ طَآئِفَةٗ مِّنكُمۡۖ وَطَآئِفَةٞ قَدۡ أَهَمَّتۡهُمۡ أَنفُسُهُمۡ يَظُنُّونَ بِٱللَّهِ غَيۡرَ ٱلۡحَقِّ ظَنَّ ٱلۡجَٰهِلِيَّةِۖ يَقُولُونَ هَل لَّنَا مِنَ ٱلۡأَمۡرِ مِن شَيۡءٖۗ قُلۡ إِنَّ ٱلۡأَمۡرَ كُلَّهُۥ لِلَّهِۗ يُخۡفُونَ فِيٓ أَنفُسِهِم مَّا لَا يُبۡدُونَ لَكَۖ يَقُولُونَ لَوۡ كَانَ لَنَا مِنَ ٱلۡأَمۡرِ شَيۡءٞ مَّا قُتِلۡنَا هَٰهُنَاۗ قُل لَّوۡ كُنتُمۡ فِي بُيُوتِكُمۡ لَبَرَزَ ٱلَّذِينَ كُتِبَ عَلَيۡهِمُ ٱلۡقَتۡلُ إِلَىٰ مَضَاجِعِهِمۡۖ وَلِيَبۡتَلِيَ ٱللَّهُ مَا فِي صُدُورِكُمۡ وَلِيُمَحِّصَ مَا فِي قُلُوبِكُمۡۚ وَٱللَّهُ عَلِيمُۢ بِذَاتِ ٱلصُّدُورِ
translation: Then after distress, He sent down upon you security [in the form of] drowsiness, overcoming a faction of you, while another faction worried about themselves, thinking of Allah other than the truth - the thought of ignorance, saying, "Is there anything for us [to have done] in this matter?" Say, "Indeed, the matter belongs completely to Allah." They conceal within themselves what they will not reveal to you. They say, "If there was anything we could have done in the matter, some of us would not have been killed right here." Say, "Even if you had been inside your houses, those decreed to be killed would have come out to their death beds." [It was] so that Allah might test what is in your breasts and purify what is in your hearts. And Allah is Knowing of that within the breasts

arabic: إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ تَوَلَّوۡاْ مِنكُمۡ يَوۡمَ ٱلۡتَقَى ٱلۡجَمۡعَانِ إِنَّمَا ٱسۡتَزَلَّهُمُ ٱلشَّيۡطَٰنُ بِبَعۡضِ مَا كَسَبُواْۖ وَلَقَدۡ عَفَا ٱللَّهُ عَنۡهُمۡۗ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ غَفُورٌ حَلِيمٞ
translation: Indeed, those of you who turned back on the day the two armies met, it was Satan who caused them to slip because of some [blame] they had earned. But Allah has already forgiven them. Indeed, Allah is Forgiving and Forbearing

normalizedTranslation: indeed, those of you who turned back on the day the two armies met, it was satan who caused them to slip because of some [blame] they had earned. but allah has already forgiven them. indeed, allah is forgiving and forbearing

arabic: يَـٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُواْ لَا تَكُونُواْ كَٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُواْ وَقَالُواْ لِإِخۡوَٰنِهِمۡ إِذَا ضَرَبُواْ فِي ٱلۡأَرۡضِ أَوۡ كَانُواْ غُزّٗى لَّوۡ كَانُواْ عِندَنَا مَا مَاتُواْ وَمَا قُتِلُواْ لِيَجۡعَلَ ٱللَّهُ ذَٰلِكَ حَسۡرَةٗ فِي قُلُوبِهِمۡۗ وَٱللَّهُ يُحۡيِۦ وَيُمِيتُۗ وَٱللَّهُ بِمَا تَعۡمَلُونَ بَصِيرٞ
translation: O you who have believed, do not be like those who disbelieved and said about their brothers when they traveled through the land or went out to fight, "If they had been with us, they would not have died or have been killed," so Allah makes that [misconception] a regret within their hearts. normalizedTranslation: o you who have believed, do not be like those who disbelieved and said about their brothers when they traveled through the land or went out to fight, "if they had been with us, they would not have died or have been killed," so allah makes that [misconception] a regret within their hearts. and it is allah who gives life and causes death, and allah is seeing of what you do

arabic: وَلَئِن قُتِلۡتُمۡ فِي سَبِيلِ ٱللَّهِ أَوۡ مُتُّمۡ لَمَغۡفِرَةٞ مِّنَ ٱللَّهِ وَرَحۡمَةٌ خَيۡرٞ مِّمَّا يَجۡمَعُونَ
translation: And if you are killed in the cause of Allah or die - then forgiveness from Allah and mercy are better than whatever they accumulate [in this world]
normalizedArabic: ولين قتلتم في سبيل الله او متم لمغفره من الله ورحمه خير مما يجمعون
normalizedTranslation: and if you are killed in the cause of allah or die - then forgiveness from allah and mercy are better than whatever they accumulate [in this world]

arabic: وَلَئِن مُّتُّمۡ أَوۡ قُتِلۡتُمۡ لَإِلَى ٱللَّهِ تُحۡشَرُونَ

normalizedTranslation: and whether you die or are killed, unto allah you will be gathered

arabic: فَبِمَا رَحۡمَةٖ مِّنَ ٱللَّهِ لِنتَ لَهُمۡۖ وَلَوۡ كُنتَ فَظًّا غَلِيظَ ٱلۡقَلۡبِ لَٱنفَضُّواْ مِنۡ حَوۡلِكَۖ فَٱعۡفُ عَنۡهُمۡ وَٱسۡتَغۡفِرۡ لَهُمۡ وَشَاوِرۡهُمۡ فِي ٱلۡأَمۡرِۖ فَإِذَا عَزَمۡتَ فَتَوَكَّلۡ عَلَى ٱللَّهِۚ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ يُحِبُّ ٱلۡمُتَوَكِّلِينَ
translation: So by mercy from Allah, [O Muhammad], you were lenient with them. And if you had been rude [in speech] and harsh in heart, they would have disbanded from about you. normalizedTranslation: so by mercy from allah, [o muhammad], you were lenient with them. and if you had been rude [in speech] and harsh in heart, they would have disbanded from about you. so pardon them and ask forgiveness for them and consult them in the matter. and when you have decided, then rely upon allah. indeed, allah loves those who rely [upon him]

arabic: إِن يَنصُرۡكُمُ ٱللَّهُ فَلَا غَالِبَ لَكُمۡۖ وَإِن يَخۡذُلۡكُمۡ فَمَن ذَا ٱلَّذِي يَنصُرُكُم مِّنۢ بَعۡدِهِۦۗ وَعَلَى ٱللَّهِ فَلۡيَتَوَكَّلِ ٱلۡمُؤۡمِنُونَ
translation: If Allah should aid you, no one can overcome you; but if He should forsake you, who is there that can aid you after Him? And upon Allah let the believers rely

normalizedTranslation: if allah should aid you, no one can overcome you; but if he should forsake you, who is there that can aid you after him? and upon allah let the believers rely

arabic: وَمَا كَانَ لِنَبِيٍّ أَن يَغُلَّۚ وَمَن يَغۡلُلۡ يَأۡتِ بِمَا غَلَّ يَوۡمَ ٱلۡقِيَٰمَةِۚ ثُمَّ تُوَفَّىٰ كُلُّ نَفۡسٖ مَّا كَسَبَتۡ وَهُمۡ لَا يُظۡلَمُونَ
translation: It is not [attributable] to any prophet that he would act unfaithfully [in regard to war booty]. And whoever betrays, [taking unlawfully], will come with what he took on the Day of Resurrection. Then will every soul be [fully] compensated for what it earned, and they will not be wronged

normalizedTranslation: it is not [attributable] to any prophet that he would act unfaithfully [in regard to war booty]. and whoever betrays, [taking unlawfully], will come with what he took on the day of resurrection. then will every soul be [fully] compensated for what it earned, and they will not be wronged

arabic: أَفَمَنِ ٱتَّبَعَ رِضۡوَٰنَ ٱللَّهِ كَمَنۢ بَآءَ بِسَخَطٖ مِّنَ ٱللَّهِ وَمَأۡوَىٰهُ جَهَنَّمُۖ وَبِئۡسَ ٱلۡمَصِيرُ
translation: So is one who pursues the pleasure of Allah like one who brings upon himself the anger of Allah and whose refuge is Hell? And wretched is the destination
normalizedArabic: افمن اتبع رضون الله كمن باء بسخط من الله وماويه جهنم وبيس المصير
normalizedTranslation: so is one who pursues the pleasure of allah like one who brings upon himself the anger of allah and whose refuge is hell? and wretched is the destination

arabic: هُمۡ دَرَجَٰتٌ عِندَ ٱللَّهِۗ وَٱللَّهُ بَصِيرُۢ بِمَا يَعۡمَلُونَ
translation: They are [varying] degrees in the sight of Allah, and Allah is Seeing of whatever they do

normalizedTranslation: they are [varying] degrees in the sight of allah, and allah is seeing of whatever they do

arabic: لَقَدۡ مَنَّ ٱللَّهُ عَلَى ٱلۡمُؤۡمِنِينَ إِذۡ بَعَثَ فِيهِمۡ رَسُولٗا مِّنۡ أَنفُسِهِمۡ يَتۡلُواْ عَلَيۡهِمۡ ءَايَٰتِهِۦ وَيُزَكِّيهِمۡ وَيُعَلِّمُهُمُ ٱلۡكِتَٰبَ وَٱلۡحِكۡمَةَ وَإِن كَانُواْ مِن قَبۡلُ لَفِي ضَلَٰلٖ مُّبِينٍ
translation: Certainly did Allah confer [great] favor upon the believers when He sent among them a Messenger from themselves, reciting to them His verses and purifying them and teaching them the Book and wisdom, although they had been before in manifest error

normalizedTranslation: certainly did allah confer [great] favor upon the believers when he sent among them a messenger from themselves, reciting to them his verses and purifying them and teaching them the book and wisdom, although they had been before in manifest error

translation: Why [is it that] when a [single] disaster struck you [on the day of Uhud], although you had struck [the enemy in the battle of Badr] with one twice as great, you said, "From where is this?" Say, "It is from yourselves." Indeed, Allah is over all things competent

arabic: وَمَآ أَصَٰبَكُمۡ يَوۡمَ ٱلۡتَقَى ٱلۡجَمۡعَانِ فَبِإِذۡنِ ٱللَّهِ وَلِيَعۡلَمَ ٱلۡمُؤۡمِنِينَ

arabic: ٱلَّذِينَ قَالُواْ لِإِخۡوَٰنِهِمۡ وَقَعَدُواْ لَوۡ أَطَاعُونَا مَا قُتِلُواْۗ قُلۡ فَٱدۡرَءُواْ عَنۡ أَنفُسِكُمُ ٱلۡمَوۡتَ إِن كُنتُمۡ صَٰدِقِينَ

arabic: فَرِحِينَ بِمَآ ءَاتَىٰهُمُ ٱللَّهُ مِن فَضۡلِهِۦ وَيَسۡتَبۡشِرُونَ بِٱلَّذِينَ لَمۡ يَلۡحَقُواْ بِهِم مِّنۡ خَلۡفِهِمۡ أَلَّا خَوۡفٌ عَلَيۡهِمۡ وَلَا هُمۡ يَحۡزَنُونَ

normalizedTranslation: rejoicing in what allah has bestowed upon them of his bounty, and they receive good tidings about those [to be martyred] after them who have not yet joined them - that there will be no fear concerning them, nor will they grieve

normalizedTranslation: those to whom hypocrites said, "indeed, the people have gathered against you, so fear them." but it [merely] increased them in faith, and they said, "sufficient for us is allah, and [he is] the best disposer of affairs
