arabic: قَالَ عِيسَى ٱبۡنُ مَرۡيَمَ ٱللَّهُمَّ رَبَّنَآ أَنزِلۡ عَلَيۡنَا مَآئِدَةٗ مِّنَ ٱلسَّمَآءِ تَكُونُ لَنَا عِيدٗا لِّأَوَّلِنَا وَءَاخِرِنَا وَءَايَةٗ مِّنكَۖ وَٱرۡزُقۡنَا وَأَنتَ خَيۡرُ ٱلرَّـٰزِقِينَ
translation: Said Jesus, the son of Mary, "O Allah, our Lord, send down to us a table [spread with food] from the heaven to be for us a festival for the first of us and the last of us and a sign from You. And provide for us, and You are the best of providers
normalizedArabic: قال عيسي ابن مريم اللهم ربنا انزل علينا مايده من السماء تكون لنا عيدا لاولنا وءاخرنا وءايه منك وارزقنا وانت خير الرزقين
normalizedTranslation: said jesus, the son of mary, "o allah, our lord, send down to us a table [spread with food] from the heaven to be for us a festival for the first of us and the last of us and a sign from you. and provide for us, and you are the best of providers

arabic: قَالَ ٱللَّهُ إِنِّي مُنَزِّلُهَا عَلَيۡكُمۡۖ فَمَن يَكۡفُرۡ بَعۡدُ مِنكُمۡ فَإِنِّيٓ أُعَذِّبُهُۥ عَذَابٗا لَّآ أُعَذِّبُهُۥٓ أَحَدٗا مِّنَ ٱلۡعَٰلَمِينَ
translation: Allah said, "Indeed, I will sent it down to you, but whoever disbelieves afterwards from among you - then indeed will I punish him with a punishment by which I have not punished anyone among the worlds
normalizedArabic: قال الله اني منزلها عليكم فمن يكفر بعد منكم فاني اعذبه عذابا لا اعذبه احدا من العلمين
normalizedTranslation: allah said, "indeed, i will sent it down to you, but whoever disbelieves afterwards from among you - then indeed will i punish him with a punishment by which i have not punished anyone among the worlds

arabic: وَإِذۡ قَالَ ٱللَّهُ يَٰعِيسَى ٱبۡنَ مَرۡيَمَ ءَأَنتَ قُلۡتَ لِلنَّاسِ ٱتَّخِذُونِي وَأُمِّيَ إِلَٰهَيۡنِ مِن دُونِ ٱللَّهِۖ قَالَ سُبۡحَٰنَكَ مَا يَكُونُ لِيٓ أَنۡ أَقُولَ مَا لَيۡسَ لِي بِحَقٍّۚ إِن كُنتُ قُلۡتُهُۥ فَقَدۡ عَلِمۡتَهُۥۚ تَعۡلَمُ مَا فِي نَفۡسِي وَلَآ أَعۡلَمُ مَا فِي نَفۡسِكَۚ إِنَّكَ أَنتَ عَلَّـٰمُ ٱلۡغُيُوبِ
translation: And [beware the Day] when Allah will say, "O Jesus, Son of Mary, did you say to the people, 'Take me and my mother as deities besides Allah?'" He will say, "Exalted are You! It was not for me to say that to which I have no right. If I had said it, You would have known it. You know what is within myself, and I do not know what is within Yourself. Indeed, it is You who is Knower of the unseen
normalizedArabic: واذ قال الله يعيسي ابن مريم ءانت قلت للناس اتخذوني وامي الهين من دون الله قال سبحنك ما يكون لي ان اقول ما ليس لي بحق ان كنت قلته فقد علمته تعلم ما في نفسي ولا اعلم ما في نفسك انك انت علم الغيوب
normalizedTranslation: and [beware the day] when allah will say, "o jesus, son of mary, did you say to the people, 'take me and my mother as deities besides allah?'" he will say, "exalted are you! it was not for me to say that to which i have no right. if i had said it, you would have known it. you know what is within myself, and i do not know what is within yourself. indeed, it is you who is knower of the unseen

arabic: مَا قُلۡتُ لَهُمۡ إِلَّا مَآ أَمَرۡتَنِي بِهِۦٓ أَنِ ٱعۡبُدُواْ ٱللَّهَ رَبِّي وَرَبَّكُمۡۚ وَكُنتُ عَلَيۡهِمۡ شَهِيدٗا مَّا دُمۡتُ فِيهِمۡۖ فَلَمَّا تَوَفَّيۡتَنِي كُنتَ أَنتَ ٱلرَّقِيبَ عَلَيۡهِمۡۚ وَأَنتَ عَلَىٰ كُلِّ شَيۡءٖ شَهِيدٌ
translation: I said not to them except what You commanded me - to worship Allah, my Lord and your Lord. And I was a witness over them as long as I was among them; but when You took me up, You were the Observer over them, and You are, over all things, Witness
normalizedArabic: ما قلت لهم الا ما امرتني به ان اعبدوا الله ربي وربكم وكنت عليهم شهيدا ما دمت فيهم فلما توفيتني كنت انت الرقيب عليهم وانت علي كل شيء شهيد
normalizedTranslation: i said not to them except what you commanded me - to worship allah, my lord and your lord. and i was a witness over them as long as i was among them; but when you took me up, you were the observer over them, and you are, over all things, witness

arabic: إِن تُعَذِّبۡهُمۡ فَإِنَّهُمۡ عِبَادُكَۖ وَإِن تَغۡفِرۡ لَهُمۡ فَإِنَّكَ أَنتَ ٱلۡعَزِيزُ ٱلۡحَكِيمُ
translation: If You should punish them - indeed they are Your servants; but if You forgive them - indeed it is You who is the Exalted in Might, the Wise
normalizedArabic: ان تعذبهم فانهم عبادك وان تغفر لهم فانك انت العزيز الحكيم
normalizedTranslation: if you should punish them - indeed they are your servants; but if you forgive them - indeed it is you who is the exalted in might, the wise

arabic: قَالَ ٱللَّهُ هَٰذَا يَوۡمُ يَنفَعُ ٱلصَّـٰدِقِينَ صِدۡقُهُمۡۚ لَهُمۡ جَنَّـٰتٞ تَجۡرِي مِن تَحۡتِهَا ٱلۡأَنۡهَٰرُ خَٰلِدِينَ فِيهَآ أَبَدٗاۖ رَّضِيَ ٱللَّهُ عَنۡهُمۡ وَرَضُواْ عَنۡهُۚ ذَٰلِكَ ٱلۡفَوۡزُ ٱلۡعَظِيمُ
translation: Allah will say, "This is the Day when the truthful will benefit from their truthfulness." For them are gardens [in Paradise] beneath which rivers flow, wherein they will abide forever, Allah being pleased with them, and they with Him. That is the great attainment
normalizedArabic: قال الله هذا يوم ينفع الصدقين صدقهم لهم جنت تجري من تحتها الانهر خلدين فيها ابدا رضي الله عنهم ورضوا عنه ذلك الفوز العظيم
normalizedTranslation: allah will say, "this is the day when the truthful will benefit from their truthfulness." for them are gardens [in paradise] beneath which rivers flow, wherein they will abide forever, allah being pleased with them, and they with him. that is the great attainment

arabic: لِلَّهِ مُلۡكُ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلۡأَرۡضِ وَمَا فِيهِنَّۚ وَهُوَ عَلَىٰ كُلِّ شَيۡءٖ قَدِيرُۢ
translation: To Allah belongs the dominion of the heavens and the earth and whatever is within them. And He is over all things competent
normalizedArabic: لله ملك السموت والارض وما فيهن وهو علي كل شيء قدير
normalizedTranslation: to allah belongs the dominion of the heavens and the earth and whatever is within them. and he is over all things competent

arabic: ٱلۡحَمۡدُ لِلَّهِ ٱلَّذِي خَلَقَ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلۡأَرۡضَ وَجَعَلَ ٱلظُّلُمَٰتِ وَٱلنُّورَۖ ثُمَّ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُواْ بِرَبِّهِمۡ يَعۡدِلُونَ
translation: [All] praise is [due] to Allah, who created the heavens and the earth and made the darkness and the light. Then those who disbelieve equate [others] with their Lord
normalizedArabic: الحمد لله الذي خلق السموت والارض وجعل الظلمت والنور ثم الذين كفروا بربهم يعدلون
normalizedTranslation: [all] praise is [due] to allah, who created the heavens and the earth and made the darkness and the light. then those who disbelieve equate [others] with their lord

arabic: هُوَ ٱلَّذِي خَلَقَكُم مِّن طِينٖ ثُمَّ قَضَىٰٓ أَجَلٗاۖ وَأَجَلٞ مُّسَمًّى عِندَهُۥۖ ثُمَّ أَنتُمۡ تَمۡتَرُونَ
translation: It is He who created you from clay and then decreed a term and a specified time [known] to Him; then [still] you are in dispute
normalizedArabic: هو الذي خلقكم من طين ثم قضي اجلا واجل مسمي عنده ثم انتم تمترون
normalizedTranslation: it is he who created you from clay and then decreed a term and a specified time [known] to him; then [still] you are in dispute

arabic: وَهُوَ ٱللَّهُ فِي ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَفِي ٱلۡأَرۡضِ يَعۡلَمُ سِرَّكُمۡ وَجَهۡرَكُمۡ وَيَعۡلَمُ مَا تَكۡسِبُونَ
translation: And He is Allah, [the only deity] in the heavens and the earth. He knows your secret and what you make public, and He knows that which you earn
normalizedArabic: وهو الله في السموت وفي الارض يعلم سركم وجهركم ويعلم ما تكسبون
normalizedTranslation: and he is allah, [the only deity] in the heavens and the earth. he knows your secret and what you make public, and he knows that which you earn

arabic: وَمَا تَأۡتِيهِم مِّنۡ ءَايَةٖ مِّنۡ ءَايَٰتِ رَبِّهِمۡ إِلَّا كَانُواْ عَنۡهَا مُعۡرِضِينَ
translation: And no sign comes to them from the signs of their Lord except that they turn away therefrom
normalizedArabic: وما تاتيهم من ءايه من ءايت ربهم الا كانوا عنها معرضين
normalizedTranslation: and no sign comes to them from the signs of their lord except that they turn away therefrom

arabic: فَقَدۡ كَذَّبُواْ بِٱلۡحَقِّ لَمَّا جَآءَهُمۡ فَسَوۡفَ يَأۡتِيهِمۡ أَنۢبَـٰٓؤُاْ مَا كَانُواْ بِهِۦ يَسۡتَهۡزِءُونَ
translation: For they had denied the truth when it came to them, but there is going to reach them the news of what they used to ridicule
normalizedArabic: فقد كذبوا بالحق لما جاءهم فسوف ياتيهم انبوا ما كانوا به يستهزءون
normalizedTranslation: for they had denied the truth when it came to them, but there is going to reach them the news of what they used to ridicule

arabic: أَلَمۡ يَرَوۡاْ كَمۡ أَهۡلَكۡنَا مِن قَبۡلِهِم مِّن قَرۡنٖ مَّكَّنَّـٰهُمۡ فِي ٱلۡأَرۡضِ مَا لَمۡ نُمَكِّن لَّكُمۡ وَأَرۡسَلۡنَا ٱلسَّمَآءَ عَلَيۡهِم مِّدۡرَارٗا وَجَعَلۡنَا ٱلۡأَنۡهَٰرَ تَجۡرِي مِن تَحۡتِهِمۡ فَأَهۡلَكۡنَٰهُم بِذُنُوبِهِمۡ وَأَنشَأۡنَا مِنۢ بَعۡدِهِمۡ قَرۡنًا ءَاخَرِينَ
translation: Have they not seen how many generations We destroyed before them which We had established upon the earth as We have not established you? And We sent [rain from] the sky upon them in showers and made rivers flow beneath them; then We destroyed them for their sins and brought forth after them a generation of others
normalizedArabic: الم يروا كم اهلكنا من قبلهم من قرن مكنهم في الارض ما لم نمكن لكم وارسلنا السماء عليهم مدرارا وجعلنا الانهر تجري من تحتهم فاهلكنهم بذنوبهم وانشانا من بعدهم قرنا ءاخرين
normalizedTranslation: have they not seen how many generations we destroyed before them which we had established upon the earth as we have not established you? and we sent [rain from] the sky upon them in showers and made rivers flow beneath them; then we destroyed them for their sins and brought forth after them a generation of others

arabic: وَلَوۡ نَزَّلۡنَا عَلَيۡكَ كِتَٰبٗا فِي قِرۡطَاسٖ فَلَمَسُوهُ بِأَيۡدِيهِمۡ لَقَالَ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوٓاْ إِنۡ هَٰذَآ إِلَّا سِحۡرٞ مُّبِينٞ
translation: And even if We had sent down to you, [O Muhammad], a written scripture on a page and they touched it with their hands, the disbelievers would say, "This is not but obvious magic
normalizedArabic: ولو نزلنا عليك كتبا في قرطاس فلمسوه بايديهم لقال الذين كفروا ان هذا الا سحر مبين
normalizedTranslation: and even if we had sent down to you, [o muhammad], a written scripture on a page and they touched it with their hands, the disbelievers would say, "this is not but obvious magic

arabic: وَقَالُواْ لَوۡلَآ أُنزِلَ عَلَيۡهِ مَلَكٞۖ وَلَوۡ أَنزَلۡنَا مَلَكٗا لَّقُضِيَ ٱلۡأَمۡرُ ثُمَّ لَا يُنظَرُونَ
translation: And they say, "Why was there not sent down to him an angel?" But if We had sent down an angel, the matter would have been decided; then they would not be reprieved
normalizedArabic: وقالوا لولا انزل عليه ملك ولو انزلنا ملكا لقضي الامر ثم لا ينظرون
normalizedTranslation: and they say, "why was there not sent down to him an angel?" but if we had sent down an angel, the matter would have been decided; then they would not be reprieved

arabic: وَلَوۡ جَعَلۡنَٰهُ مَلَكٗا لَّجَعَلۡنَٰهُ رَجُلٗا وَلَلَبَسۡنَا عَلَيۡهِم مَّا يَلۡبِسُونَ
translation: And if We had made him an angel, We would have made him [appear as] a man, and We would have covered them with that in which they cover themselves
normalizedArabic: ولو جعلنه ملكا لجعلنه رجلا وللبسنا عليهم ما يلبسون
normalizedTranslation: and if we had made him an angel, we would have made him [appear as] a man, and we would have covered them with that in which they cover themselves

arabic: وَلَقَدِ ٱسۡتُهۡزِئَ بِرُسُلٖ مِّن قَبۡلِكَ فَحَاقَ بِٱلَّذِينَ سَخِرُواْ مِنۡهُم مَّا كَانُواْ بِهِۦ يَسۡتَهۡزِءُونَ
translation: And already were messengers ridiculed before you, but those who mocked them were enveloped by that which they used to ridicule
normalizedArabic: ولقد استهزي برسل من قبلك فحاق بالذين سخروا منهم ما كانوا به يستهزءون
normalizedTranslation: and already were messengers ridiculed before you, but those who mocked them were enveloped by that which they used to ridicule

arabic: قُلۡ سِيرُواْ فِي ٱلۡأَرۡضِ ثُمَّ ٱنظُرُواْ كَيۡفَ كَانَ عَٰقِبَةُ ٱلۡمُكَذِّبِينَ
translation: Say, "Travel through the land; then observe how was the end of the deniers
normalizedArabic: قل سيروا في الارض ثم انظروا كيف كان عقبه المكذبين
normalizedTranslation: say, "travel through the land; then observe how was the end of the deniers

arabic: قُل لِّمَن مَّا فِي ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلۡأَرۡضِۖ قُل لِّلَّهِۚ كَتَبَ عَلَىٰ نَفۡسِهِ ٱلرَّحۡمَةَۚ لَيَجۡمَعَنَّكُمۡ إِلَىٰ يَوۡمِ ٱلۡقِيَٰمَةِ لَا رَيۡبَ فِيهِۚ ٱلَّذِينَ خَسِرُوٓاْ أَنفُسَهُمۡ فَهُمۡ لَا يُؤۡمِنُونَ
translation: Say, "To whom belongs whatever is in the heavens and earth?" Say, "To Allah." He has decreed upon Himself mercy. He will surely assemble you for the Day of Resurrection, about which there is no doubt. Those who will lose themselves [that Day] do not believe
normalizedArabic: قل لمن ما في السموت والارض قل لله كتب علي نفسه الرحمه ليجمعنكم الي يوم القيمه لا ريب فيه الذين خسروا انفسهم فهم لا يومنون
normalizedTranslation: say, "to whom belongs whatever is in the heavens and earth?" say, "to allah." he has decreed upon himself mercy. he will surely assemble you for the day of resurrection, about which there is no doubt. those who will lose themselves [that day] do not believe

arabic: ۞وَلَهُۥ مَا سَكَنَ فِي ٱلَّيۡلِ وَٱلنَّهَارِۚ وَهُوَ ٱلسَّمِيعُ ٱلۡعَلِيمُ
translation: And to Him belongs that which reposes by night and by day, and He is the Hearing, the Knowing
normalizedArabic: وله ما سكن في اليل والنهار وهو السميع العليم
normalizedTranslation: and to him belongs that which reposes by night and by day, and he is the hearing, the knowing

arabic: قُلۡ أَغَيۡرَ ٱللَّهِ أَتَّخِذُ وَلِيّٗا فَاطِرِ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلۡأَرۡضِ وَهُوَ يُطۡعِمُ وَلَا يُطۡعَمُۗ قُلۡ إِنِّيٓ أُمِرۡتُ أَنۡ أَكُونَ أَوَّلَ مَنۡ أَسۡلَمَۖ وَلَا تَكُونَنَّ مِنَ ٱلۡمُشۡرِكِينَ
translation: Say, "Is it other than Allah I should take as a protector, Creator of the heavens and the earth, while it is He who feeds and is not fed?" Say, [O Muhammad], "Indeed, I have been commanded to be the first [among you] who submit [to Allah] and [was commanded], 'Do not ever be of the polytheists
normalizedArabic: قل اغير الله اتخذ وليا فاطر السموت والارض وهو يطعم ولا يطعم قل اني امرت ان اكون اول من اسلم ولا تكونن من المشركين
normalizedTranslation: say, "is it other than allah i should take as a protector, creator of the heavens and the earth, while it is he who feeds and is not fed?" say, [o muhammad], "indeed, i have been commanded to be the first [among you] who submit [to allah] and [was commanded], 'do not ever be of the polytheists

arabic: قُلۡ إِنِّيٓ أَخَافُ إِنۡ عَصَيۡتُ رَبِّي عَذَابَ يَوۡمٍ عَظِيمٖ
translation: Say, "Indeed I fear, if I should disobey my Lord, the punishment of a tremendous Day
normalizedArabic: قل اني اخاف ان عصيت ربي عذاب يوم عظيم
normalizedTranslation: say, "indeed i fear, if i should disobey my lord, the punishment of a tremendous day

arabic: مَّن يُصۡرَفۡ عَنۡهُ يَوۡمَئِذٖ فَقَدۡ رَحِمَهُۥۚ وَذَٰلِكَ ٱلۡفَوۡزُ ٱلۡمُبِينُ
translation: He from whom it is averted that Day - [Allah] has granted him mercy. And that is the clear attainment
normalizedArabic: من يصرف عنه يوميذ فقد رحمه وذلك الفوز المبين
normalizedTranslation: he from whom it is averted that day - [allah] has granted him mercy. and that is the clear attainment

arabic: وَإِن يَمۡسَسۡكَ ٱللَّهُ بِضُرّٖ فَلَا كَاشِفَ لَهُۥٓ إِلَّا هُوَۖ وَإِن يَمۡسَسۡكَ بِخَيۡرٖ فَهُوَ عَلَىٰ كُلِّ شَيۡءٖ قَدِيرٞ
translation: And if Allah should touch you with adversity, there is no remover of it except Him. And if He touches you with good - then He is over all things competent
normalizedArabic: وان يمسسك الله بضر فلا كاشف له الا هو وان يمسسك بخير فهو علي كل شيء قدير
normalizedTranslation: and if allah should touch you with adversity, there is no remover of it except him. and if he touches you with good - then he is over all things competent

arabic: وَهُوَ ٱلۡقَاهِرُ فَوۡقَ عِبَادِهِۦۚ وَهُوَ ٱلۡحَكِيمُ ٱلۡخَبِيرُ
translation: And He is the subjugator over His servants. And He is the Wise, the Acquainted [with all]
normalizedArabic: وهو القاهر فوق عباده وهو الحكيم الخبير
normalizedTranslation: and he is the subjugator over his servants. and he is the wise, the acquainted [with all]

arabic: قُلۡ أَيُّ شَيۡءٍ أَكۡبَرُ شَهَٰدَةٗۖ قُلِ ٱللَّهُۖ شَهِيدُۢ بَيۡنِي وَبَيۡنَكُمۡۚ وَأُوحِيَ إِلَيَّ هَٰذَا ٱلۡقُرۡءَانُ لِأُنذِرَكُم بِهِۦ وَمَنۢ بَلَغَۚ أَئِنَّكُمۡ لَتَشۡهَدُونَ أَنَّ مَعَ ٱللَّهِ ءَالِهَةً أُخۡرَىٰۚ قُل لَّآ أَشۡهَدُۚ قُلۡ إِنَّمَا هُوَ إِلَٰهٞ وَٰحِدٞ وَإِنَّنِي بَرِيٓءٞ مِّمَّا تُشۡرِكُونَ
translation: Say, "What thing is greatest in testimony?" Say, "Allah is witness between me and you. And this Qur'an was revealed to me that I may warn you thereby and whomever it reaches. Do you [truly] testify that with Allah there are other deities?" Say, "I will not testify [with you]." Say, "Indeed, He is but one God, and indeed, I am free of what you associate [with Him]
normalizedArabic: قل اي شيء اكبر شهده قل الله شهيد بيني وبينكم واوحي الي هذا القرءان لانذركم به ومن بلغ اينكم لتشهدون ان مع الله ءالهه اخري قل لا اشهد قل انما هو اله وحد وانني بريء مما تشركون
normalizedTranslation: say, "what thing is greatest in testimony?" say, "allah is witness between me and you. and this qur'an was revealed to me that i may warn you thereby and whomever it reaches. do you [truly] testify that with allah there are other deities?" say, "i will not testify [with you]." say, "indeed, he is but one god, and indeed, i am free of what you associate [with him]

arabic: ٱلَّذِينَ ءَاتَيۡنَٰهُمُ ٱلۡكِتَٰبَ يَعۡرِفُونَهُۥ كَمَا يَعۡرِفُونَ أَبۡنَآءَهُمُۘ ٱلَّذِينَ خَسِرُوٓاْ أَنفُسَهُمۡ فَهُمۡ لَا يُؤۡمِنُونَ
translation: Those to whom We have given the Scripture recognize it as they recognize their [own] sons. Those who will lose themselves [in the Hereafter] do not believe
normalizedArabic: الذين ءاتينهم الكتب يعرفونه كما يعرفون ابناءهم الذين خسروا انفسهم فهم لا يومنون
normalizedTranslation: those to whom we have given the scripture recognize it as they recognize their [own] sons. those who will lose themselves [in the hereafter] do not believe

arabic: وَمَنۡ أَظۡلَمُ مِمَّنِ ٱفۡتَرَىٰ عَلَى ٱللَّهِ كَذِبًا أَوۡ كَذَّبَ بِـَٔايَٰتِهِۦٓۚ إِنَّهُۥ لَا يُفۡلِحُ ٱلظَّـٰلِمُونَ
translation: And who is more unjust than one who invents about Allah a lie or denies His verses? Indeed, the wrongdoers will not succeed
normalizedArabic: ومن اظلم ممن افتري علي الله كذبا او كذب بايته انه لا يفلح الظلمون
normalizedTranslation: and who is more unjust than one who invents about allah a lie or denies his verses? indeed, the wrongdoers will not succeed

arabic: وَيَوۡمَ نَحۡشُرُهُمۡ جَمِيعٗا ثُمَّ نَقُولُ لِلَّذِينَ أَشۡرَكُوٓاْ أَيۡنَ شُرَكَآؤُكُمُ ٱلَّذِينَ كُنتُمۡ تَزۡعُمُونَ
translation: And [mention, O Muhammad], the Day We will gather them all together; then We will say to those who associated others with Allah, "Where are your 'partners' that you used to claim [with Him]
normalizedArabic: ويوم نحشرهم جميعا ثم نقول للذين اشركوا اين شركاوكم الذين كنتم تزعمون
normalizedTranslation: and [mention, o muhammad], the day we will gather them all together; then we will say to those who associated others with allah, "where are your 'partners' that you used to claim [with him]

arabic: ثُمَّ لَمۡ تَكُن فِتۡنَتُهُمۡ إِلَّآ أَن قَالُواْ وَٱللَّهِ رَبِّنَا مَا كُنَّا مُشۡرِكِينَ
translation: Then there will be no [excuse upon] examination except they will say, "By Allah, our Lord, we were not those who associated
normalizedArabic: ثم لم تكن فتنتهم الا ان قالوا والله ربنا ما كنا مشركين
normalizedTranslation: then there will be no [excuse upon] examination except they will say, "by allah, our lord, we were not those who associated

arabic: ٱنظُرۡ كَيۡفَ كَذَبُواْ عَلَىٰٓ أَنفُسِهِمۡۚ وَضَلَّ عَنۡهُم مَّا كَانُواْ يَفۡتَرُونَ
translation: See how they will lie about themselves. And lost from them will be what they used to invent
normalizedArabic: انظر كيف كذبوا علي انفسهم وضل عنهم ما كانوا يفترون
normalizedTranslation: see how they will lie about themselves. and lost from them will be what they used to invent

arabic: وَمِنۡهُم مَّن يَسۡتَمِعُ إِلَيۡكَۖ وَجَعَلۡنَا عَلَىٰ قُلُوبِهِمۡ أَكِنَّةً أَن يَفۡقَهُوهُ وَفِيٓ ءَاذَانِهِمۡ وَقۡرٗاۚ وَإِن يَرَوۡاْ كُلَّ ءَايَةٖ لَّا يُؤۡمِنُواْ بِهَاۖ حَتَّىٰٓ إِذَا جَآءُوكَ يُجَٰدِلُونَكَ يَقُولُ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوٓاْ إِنۡ هَٰذَآ إِلَّآ أَسَٰطِيرُ ٱلۡأَوَّلِينَ
translation: And among them are those who listen to you, but We have placed over their hearts coverings, lest they understand it, and in their ears deafness. And if they should see every sign, they will not believe in it. Even when they come to you arguing with you, those who disbelieve say, "This is not but legends of the former peoples
normalizedArabic: ومنهم من يستمع اليك وجعلنا علي قلوبهم اكنه ان يفقهوه وفي ءاذانهم وقرا وان يروا كل ءايه لا يومنوا بها حتي اذا جاءوك يجدلونك يقول الذين كفروا ان هذا الا اسطير الاولين
normalizedTranslation: and among them are those who listen to you, but we have placed over their hearts coverings, lest they understand it, and in their ears deafness. and if they should see every sign, they will not believe in it. even when they come to you arguing with you, those who disbelieve say, "this is not but legends of the former peoples

arabic: وَهُمۡ يَنۡهَوۡنَ عَنۡهُ وَيَنۡـَٔوۡنَ عَنۡهُۖ وَإِن يُهۡلِكُونَ إِلَّآ أَنفُسَهُمۡ وَمَا يَشۡعُرُونَ
translation: And they prevent [others] from him and are [themselves] remote from him. And they do not destroy except themselves, but they perceive [it] not
normalizedArabic: وهم ينهون عنه وينون عنه وان يهلكون الا انفسهم وما يشعرون
normalizedTranslation: and they prevent [others] from him and are [themselves] remote from him. and they do not destroy except themselves, but they perceive [it] not

arabic: وَلَوۡ تَرَىٰٓ إِذۡ وُقِفُواْ عَلَى ٱلنَّارِ فَقَالُواْ يَٰلَيۡتَنَا نُرَدُّ وَلَا نُكَذِّبَ بِـَٔايَٰتِ رَبِّنَا وَنَكُونَ مِنَ ٱلۡمُؤۡمِنِينَ
translation: If you could but see when they are made to stand before the Fire and will say, "Oh, would that we could be returned [to life on earth] and not deny the signs of our Lord and be among the believers
normalizedArabic: ولو تري اذ وقفوا علي النار فقالوا يليتنا نرد ولا نكذب بايت ربنا ونكون من المومنين
normalizedTranslation: if you could but see when they are made to stand before the fire and will say, "oh, would that we could be returned [to life on earth] and not deny the signs of our lord and be among the believers

arabic: بَلۡ بَدَا لَهُم مَّا كَانُواْ يُخۡفُونَ مِن قَبۡلُۖ وَلَوۡ رُدُّواْ لَعَادُواْ لِمَا نُهُواْ عَنۡهُ وَإِنَّهُمۡ لَكَٰذِبُونَ
translation: But what they concealed before has [now] appeared to them. And even if they were returned, they would return to that which they were forbidden; and indeed, they are liars
normalizedArabic: بل بدا لهم ما كانوا يخفون من قبل ولو ردوا لعادوا لما نهوا عنه وانهم لكذبون
normalizedTranslation: but what they concealed before has [now] appeared to them. and even if they were returned, they would return to that which they were forbidden; and indeed, they are liars

arabic: وَقَالُوٓاْ إِنۡ هِيَ إِلَّا حَيَاتُنَا ٱلدُّنۡيَا وَمَا نَحۡنُ بِمَبۡعُوثِينَ
translation: And they say, "There is none but our worldly life, and we will not be resurrected
normalizedArabic: وقالوا ان هي الا حياتنا الدنيا وما نحن بمبعوثين
normalizedTranslation: and they say, "there is none but our worldly life, and we will not be resurrected

arabic: وَلَوۡ تَرَىٰٓ إِذۡ وُقِفُواْ عَلَىٰ رَبِّهِمۡۚ قَالَ أَلَيۡسَ هَٰذَا بِٱلۡحَقِّۚ قَالُواْ بَلَىٰ وَرَبِّنَاۚ قَالَ فَذُوقُواْ ٱلۡعَذَابَ بِمَا كُنتُمۡ تَكۡفُرُونَ
translation: If you could but see when they will be made to stand before their Lord. He will say, "Is this not the truth?" They will say, "Yes, by our Lord." He will [then] say, "So taste the punishment because you used to disbelieve
normalizedArabic: ولو تري اذ وقفوا علي ربهم قال اليس هذا بالحق قالوا بلي وربنا قال فذوقوا العذاب بما كنتم تكفرون
normalizedTranslation: if you could but see when they will be made to stand before their lord. he will say, "is this not the truth?" they will say, "yes, by our lord." he will [then] say, "so taste the punishment because you used to disbelieve

arabic: قَدۡ خَسِرَ ٱلَّذِينَ كَذَّبُواْ بِلِقَآءِ ٱللَّهِۖ حَتَّىٰٓ إِذَا جَآءَتۡهُمُ ٱلسَّاعَةُ بَغۡتَةٗ قَالُواْ يَٰحَسۡرَتَنَا عَلَىٰ مَا فَرَّطۡنَا فِيهَا وَهُمۡ يَحۡمِلُونَ أَوۡزَارَهُمۡ عَلَىٰ ظُهُورِهِمۡۚ أَلَا سَآءَ مَا يَزِرُونَ
translation: Those will have lost who deny the meeting with Allah, until when the Hour [of resurrection] comes upon them unexpectedly, they will say, "Oh, [how great is] our regret over what we neglected concerning it," while they bear their burdens on their backs. Unquestionably, evil is that which they bear
normalizedArabic: قد خسر الذين كذبوا بلقاء الله حتي اذا جاءتهم الساعه بغته قالوا يحسرتنا علي ما فرطنا فيها وهم يحملون اوزارهم علي ظهورهم الا ساء ما يزرون
normalizedTranslation: those will have lost who deny the meeting with allah, until when the hour [of resurrection] comes upon them unexpectedly, they will say, "oh, [how great is] our regret over what we neglected concerning it," while they bear their burdens on their backs. unquestionably, evil is that which they bear

arabic: وَمَا ٱلۡحَيَوٰةُ ٱلدُّنۡيَآ إِلَّا لَعِبٞ وَلَهۡوٞۖ وَلَلدَّارُ ٱلۡأٓخِرَةُ خَيۡرٞ لِّلَّذِينَ يَتَّقُونَۚ أَفَلَا تَعۡقِلُونَ
translation: And the worldly life is not but amusement and diversion; but the home of the Hereafter is best for those who fear Allah, so will you not reason
normalizedArabic: وما الحيوه الدنيا الا لعب ولهو وللدار الاخره خير للذين يتقون افلا تعقلون
normalizedTranslation: and the worldly life is not but amusement and diversion; but the home of the hereafter is best for those who fear allah, so will you not reason

arabic: قَدۡ نَعۡلَمُ إِنَّهُۥ لَيَحۡزُنُكَ ٱلَّذِي يَقُولُونَۖ فَإِنَّهُمۡ لَا يُكَذِّبُونَكَ وَلَٰكِنَّ ٱلظَّـٰلِمِينَ بِـَٔايَٰتِ ٱللَّهِ يَجۡحَدُونَ
translation: We know that you, [O Muhammad], are saddened by what they say. And indeed, they do not call you untruthful, but it is the verses of Allah that the wrongdoers reject
normalizedArabic: قد نعلم انه ليحزنك الذي يقولون فانهم لا يكذبونك ولكن الظلمين بايت الله يجحدون
normalizedTranslation: we know that you, [o muhammad], are saddened by what they say. and indeed, they do not call you untruthful, but it is the verses of allah that the wrongdoers reject

arabic: وَلَقَدۡ كُذِّبَتۡ رُسُلٞ مِّن قَبۡلِكَ فَصَبَرُواْ عَلَىٰ مَا كُذِّبُواْ وَأُوذُواْ حَتَّىٰٓ أَتَىٰهُمۡ نَصۡرُنَاۚ وَلَا مُبَدِّلَ لِكَلِمَٰتِ ٱللَّهِۚ وَلَقَدۡ جَآءَكَ مِن نَّبَإِيْ ٱلۡمُرۡسَلِينَ
translation: And certainly were messengers denied before you, but they were patient over [the effects of] denial, and they were harmed until Our victory came to them. And none can alter the words of Allah. And there has certainly come to you some information about the [previous] messengers
normalizedArabic: ولقد كذبت رسل من قبلك فصبروا علي ما كذبوا واوذوا حتي اتيهم نصرنا ولا مبدل لكلمت الله ولقد جاءك من نباي المرسلين
normalizedTranslation: and certainly were messengers denied before you, but they were patient over [the effects of] denial, and they were harmed until our victory came to them. and none can alter the words of allah. and there has certainly come to you some information about the [previous] messengers

arabic: وَإِن كَانَ كَبُرَ عَلَيۡكَ إِعۡرَاضُهُمۡ فَإِنِ ٱسۡتَطَعۡتَ أَن تَبۡتَغِيَ نَفَقٗا فِي ٱلۡأَرۡضِ أَوۡ سُلَّمٗا فِي ٱلسَّمَآءِ فَتَأۡتِيَهُم بِـَٔايَةٖۚ وَلَوۡ شَآءَ ٱللَّهُ لَجَمَعَهُمۡ عَلَى ٱلۡهُدَىٰۚ فَلَا تَكُونَنَّ مِنَ ٱلۡجَٰهِلِينَ
translation: And if their evasion is difficult for you, then if you are able to seek a tunnel into the earth or a stairway into the sky to bring them a sign, [then do so]. But if Allah had willed, He would have united them upon guidance. So never be of the ignorant
normalizedArabic: وان كان كبر عليك اعراضهم فان استطعت ان تبتغي نفقا في الارض او سلما في السماء فتاتيهم بايه ولو شاء الله لجمعهم علي الهدي فلا تكونن من الجهلين
normalizedTranslation: and if their evasion is difficult for you, then if you are able to seek a tunnel into the earth or a stairway into the sky to bring them a sign, [then do so]. but if allah had willed, he would have united them upon guidance. so never be of the ignorant

arabic: ۞إِنَّمَا يَسۡتَجِيبُ ٱلَّذِينَ يَسۡمَعُونَۘ وَٱلۡمَوۡتَىٰ يَبۡعَثُهُمُ ٱللَّهُ ثُمَّ إِلَيۡهِ يُرۡجَعُونَ
translation: Only those who hear will respond. But the dead - Allah will resurrect them; then to Him they will be returned
normalizedArabic: انما يستجيب الذين يسمعون والموتي يبعثهم الله ثم اليه يرجعون
normalizedTranslation: only those who hear will respond. but the dead - allah will resurrect them; then to him they will be returned

arabic: وَقَالُواْ لَوۡلَا نُزِّلَ عَلَيۡهِ ءَايَةٞ مِّن رَّبِّهِۦۚ قُلۡ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ قَادِرٌ عَلَىٰٓ أَن يُنَزِّلَ ءَايَةٗ وَلَٰكِنَّ أَكۡثَرَهُمۡ لَا يَعۡلَمُونَ
translation: And they say, "Why has a sign not been sent down to him from his Lord?" Say, "Indeed, Allah is Able to send down a sign, but most of them do not know
normalizedArabic: وقالوا لولا نزل عليه ءايه من ربه قل ان الله قادر علي ان ينزل ءايه ولكن اكثرهم لا يعلمون
normalizedTranslation: and they say, "why has a sign not been sent down to him from his lord?" say, "indeed, allah is able to send down a sign, but most of them do not know

arabic: وَمَا مِن دَآبَّةٖ فِي ٱلۡأَرۡضِ وَلَا طَـٰٓئِرٖ يَطِيرُ بِجَنَاحَيۡهِ إِلَّآ أُمَمٌ أَمۡثَالُكُمۚ مَّا فَرَّطۡنَا فِي ٱلۡكِتَٰبِ مِن شَيۡءٖۚ ثُمَّ إِلَىٰ رَبِّهِمۡ يُحۡشَرُونَ
translation: And there is no creature on [or within] the earth or bird that flies with its wings except [that they are] communities like you. We have not neglected in the Register a thing. Then unto their Lord they will be gathered
normalizedArabic: وما من دابه في الارض ولا طير يطير بجناحيه الا امم امثالكم ما فرطنا في الكتب من شيء ثم الي ربهم يحشرون
normalizedTranslation: and there is no creature on [or within] the earth or bird that flies with its wings except [that they are] communities like you. we have not neglected in the register a thing. then unto their lord they will be gathered

arabic: وَٱلَّذِينَ كَذَّبُواْ بِـَٔايَٰتِنَا صُمّٞ وَبُكۡمٞ فِي ٱلظُّلُمَٰتِۗ مَن يَشَإِ ٱللَّهُ يُضۡلِلۡهُ وَمَن يَشَأۡ يَجۡعَلۡهُ عَلَىٰ صِرَٰطٖ مُّسۡتَقِيمٖ
translation: But those who deny Our verses are deaf and dumb within darknesses. Whomever Allah wills - He leaves astray; and whomever He wills - He puts him on a straight path
normalizedArabic: والذين كذبوا بايتنا صم وبكم في الظلمت من يشا الله يضلله ومن يشا يجعله علي صرط مستقيم
normalizedTranslation: but those who deny our verses are deaf and dumb within darknesses. whomever allah wills - he leaves astray; and whomever he wills - he puts him on a straight path

arabic: قُلۡ أَرَءَيۡتَكُمۡ إِنۡ أَتَىٰكُمۡ عَذَابُ ٱللَّهِ أَوۡ أَتَتۡكُمُ ٱلسَّاعَةُ أَغَيۡرَ ٱللَّهِ تَدۡعُونَ إِن كُنتُمۡ صَٰدِقِينَ
translation: Say, "Have you considered: if there came to you the punishment of Allah or there came to you the Hour - is it other than Allah you would invoke, if you should be truthful
normalizedArabic: قل ارءيتكم ان اتيكم عذاب الله او اتتكم الساعه اغير الله تدعون ان كنتم صدقين
normalizedTranslation: say, "have you considered: if there came to you the punishment of allah or there came to you the hour - is it other than allah you would invoke, if you should be truthful

arabic: بَلۡ إِيَّاهُ تَدۡعُونَ فَيَكۡشِفُ مَا تَدۡعُونَ إِلَيۡهِ إِن شَآءَ وَتَنسَوۡنَ مَا تُشۡرِكُونَ
translation: No, it is Him [alone] you would invoke, and He would remove that for which you invoked Him if He willed, and you would forget what you associate [with Him]
normalizedArabic: بل اياه تدعون فيكشف ما تدعون اليه ان شاء وتنسون ما تشركون
normalizedTranslation: no, it is him [alone] you would invoke, and he would remove that for which you invoked him if he willed, and you would forget what you associate [with him]

arabic: وَلَقَدۡ أَرۡسَلۡنَآ إِلَىٰٓ أُمَمٖ مِّن قَبۡلِكَ فَأَخَذۡنَٰهُم بِٱلۡبَأۡسَآءِ وَٱلضَّرَّآءِ لَعَلَّهُمۡ يَتَضَرَّعُونَ
translation: And We have already sent [messengers] to nations before you, [O Muhammad]; then We seized them with poverty and hardship that perhaps they might humble themselves [to Us]
normalizedArabic: ولقد ارسلنا الي امم من قبلك فاخذنهم بالباساء والضراء لعلهم يتضرعون
normalizedTranslation: and we have already sent [messengers] to nations before you, [o muhammad]; then we seized them with poverty and hardship that perhaps they might humble themselves [to us]

arabic: فَلَوۡلَآ إِذۡ جَآءَهُم بَأۡسُنَا تَضَرَّعُواْ وَلَٰكِن قَسَتۡ قُلُوبُهُمۡ وَزَيَّنَ لَهُمُ ٱلشَّيۡطَٰنُ مَا كَانُواْ يَعۡمَلُونَ
translation: Then why, when Our punishment came to them, did they not humble themselves? But their hearts became hardened, and Satan made attractive to them that which they were doing
normalizedArabic: فلولا اذ جاءهم باسنا تضرعوا ولكن قست قلوبهم وزين لهم الشيطن ما كانوا يعملون
normalizedTranslation: then why, when our punishment came to them, did they not humble themselves? but their hearts became hardened, and satan made attractive to them that which they were doing

arabic: فَلَمَّا نَسُواْ مَا ذُكِّرُواْ بِهِۦ فَتَحۡنَا عَلَيۡهِمۡ أَبۡوَٰبَ كُلِّ شَيۡءٍ حَتَّىٰٓ إِذَا فَرِحُواْ بِمَآ أُوتُوٓاْ أَخَذۡنَٰهُم بَغۡتَةٗ فَإِذَا هُم مُّبۡلِسُونَ
translation: So when they forgot that by which they had been reminded, We opened to them the doors of every [good] thing until, when they rejoiced in that which they were given, We seized them suddenly, and they were [then] in despair
normalizedArabic: فلما نسوا ما ذكروا به فتحنا عليهم ابوب كل شيء حتي اذا فرحوا بما اوتوا اخذنهم بغته فاذا هم مبلسون
normalizedTranslation: so when they forgot that by which they had been reminded, we opened to them the doors of every [good] thing until, when they rejoiced in that which they were given, we seized them suddenly, and they were [then] in despair

arabic: فَقُطِعَ دَابِرُ ٱلۡقَوۡمِ ٱلَّذِينَ ظَلَمُواْۚ وَٱلۡحَمۡدُ لِلَّهِ رَبِّ ٱلۡعَٰلَمِينَ
translation: So the people that committed wrong were eliminated. And praise to Allah, Lord of the worlds
normalizedArabic: فقطع دابر القوم الذين ظلموا والحمد لله رب العلمين
normalizedTranslation: so the people that committed wrong were eliminated. and praise to allah, lord of the worlds

arabic: قُلۡ أَرَءَيۡتُمۡ إِنۡ أَخَذَ ٱللَّهُ سَمۡعَكُمۡ وَأَبۡصَٰرَكُمۡ وَخَتَمَ عَلَىٰ قُلُوبِكُم مَّنۡ إِلَٰهٌ غَيۡرُ ٱللَّهِ يَأۡتِيكُم بِهِۗ ٱنظُرۡ كَيۡفَ نُصَرِّفُ ٱلۡأٓيَٰتِ ثُمَّ هُمۡ يَصۡدِفُونَ
translation: Say, "Have you considered: if Allah should take away your hearing and your sight and set a seal upon your hearts, which deity other than Allah could bring them [back] to you?" Look how we diversify the verses; then they [still] turn away
normalizedArabic: قل ارءيتم ان اخذ الله سمعكم وابصركم وختم علي قلوبكم من اله غير الله ياتيكم به انظر كيف نصرف الايت ثم هم يصدفون
normalizedTranslation: say, "have you considered: if allah should take away your hearing and your sight and set a seal upon your hearts, which deity other than allah could bring them [back] to you?" look how we diversify the verses; then they [still] turn away

arabic: قُلۡ أَرَءَيۡتَكُمۡ إِنۡ أَتَىٰكُمۡ عَذَابُ ٱللَّهِ بَغۡتَةً أَوۡ جَهۡرَةً هَلۡ يُهۡلَكُ إِلَّا ٱلۡقَوۡمُ ٱلظَّـٰلِمُونَ
translation: Say, "Have you considered: if the punishment of Allah should come to you unexpectedly or manifestly, will any be destroyed but the wrongdoing people
normalizedArabic: قل ارءيتكم ان اتيكم عذاب الله بغته او جهره هل يهلك الا القوم الظلمون
normalizedTranslation: say, "have you considered: if the punishment of allah should come to you unexpectedly or manifestly, will any be destroyed but the wrongdoing people

arabic: وَمَا نُرۡسِلُ ٱلۡمُرۡسَلِينَ إِلَّا مُبَشِّرِينَ وَمُنذِرِينَۖ فَمَنۡ ءَامَنَ وَأَصۡلَحَ فَلَا خَوۡفٌ عَلَيۡهِمۡ وَلَا هُمۡ يَحۡزَنُونَ
translation: And We send not the messengers except as bringers of good tidings and warners. So whoever believes and reforms - there will be no fear concerning them, nor will they grieve
normalizedArabic: وما نرسل المرسلين الا مبشرين ومنذرين فمن ءامن واصلح فلا خوف عليهم ولا هم يحزنون
normalizedTranslation: and we send not the messengers except as bringers of good tidings and warners. so whoever believes and reforms - there will be no fear concerning them, nor will they grieve

arabic: وَٱلَّذِينَ كَذَّبُواْ بِـَٔايَٰتِنَا يَمَسُّهُمُ ٱلۡعَذَابُ بِمَا كَانُواْ يَفۡسُقُونَ
translation: But those who deny Our verses - the punishment will touch them for their defiant disobedience
normalizedArabic: والذين كذبوا بايتنا يمسهم العذاب بما كانوا يفسقون
normalizedTranslation: but those who deny our verses - the punishment will touch them for their defiant disobedience

arabic: قُل لَّآ أَقُولُ لَكُمۡ عِندِي خَزَآئِنُ ٱللَّهِ وَلَآ أَعۡلَمُ ٱلۡغَيۡبَ وَلَآ أَقُولُ لَكُمۡ إِنِّي مَلَكٌۖ إِنۡ أَتَّبِعُ إِلَّا مَا يُوحَىٰٓ إِلَيَّۚ قُلۡ هَلۡ يَسۡتَوِي ٱلۡأَعۡمَىٰ وَٱلۡبَصِيرُۚ أَفَلَا تَتَفَكَّرُونَ
translation: Say, [O Muhammad], "I do not tell you that I have the depositories [containing the provision] of Allah or that I know the unseen, nor do I tell you that I am an angel. I only follow what is revealed to me." Say, "Is the blind equivalent to the seeing? Then will you not give thought
normalizedArabic: قل لا اقول لكم عندي خزاين الله ولا اعلم الغيب ولا اقول لكم اني ملك ان اتبع الا ما يوحي الي قل هل يستوي الاعمي والبصير افلا تتفكرون
normalizedTranslation: say, [o muhammad], "i do not tell you that i have the depositories [containing the provision] of allah or that i know the unseen, nor do i tell you that i am an angel. i only follow what is revealed to me." say, "is the blind equivalent to the seeing? then will you not give thought

arabic: وَأَنذِرۡ بِهِ ٱلَّذِينَ يَخَافُونَ أَن يُحۡشَرُوٓاْ إِلَىٰ رَبِّهِمۡ لَيۡسَ لَهُم مِّن دُونِهِۦ وَلِيّٞ وَلَا شَفِيعٞ لَّعَلَّهُمۡ يَتَّقُونَ
translation: And warn by the Qur'an those who fear that they will be gathered before their Lord - for them besides Him will be no protector and no intercessor - that they might become righteous
normalizedArabic: وانذر به الذين يخافون ان يحشروا الي ربهم ليس لهم من دونه ولي ولا شفيع لعلهم يتقون
normalizedTranslation: and warn by the qur'an those who fear that they will be gathered before their lord - for them besides him will be no protector and no intercessor - that they might become righteous

arabic: وَلَا تَطۡرُدِ ٱلَّذِينَ يَدۡعُونَ رَبَّهُم بِٱلۡغَدَوٰةِ وَٱلۡعَشِيِّ يُرِيدُونَ وَجۡهَهُۥۖ مَا عَلَيۡكَ مِنۡ حِسَابِهِم مِّن شَيۡءٖ وَمَا مِنۡ حِسَابِكَ عَلَيۡهِم مِّن شَيۡءٖ فَتَطۡرُدَهُمۡ فَتَكُونَ مِنَ ٱلظَّـٰلِمِينَ
translation: And do not send away those who call upon their Lord morning and afternoon, seeking His countenance. Not upon you is anything of their account and not upon them is anything of your account. So were you to send them away, you would [then] be of the wrongdoers
normalizedArabic: ولا تطرد الذين يدعون ربهم بالغدوه والعشي يريدون وجهه ما عليك من حسابهم من شيء وما من حسابك عليهم من شيء فتطردهم فتكون من الظلمين
normalizedTranslation: and do not send away those who call upon their lord morning and afternoon, seeking his countenance. not upon you is anything of their account and not upon them is anything of your account. so were you to send them away, you would [then] be of the wrongdoers

arabic: وَكَذَٰلِكَ فَتَنَّا بَعۡضَهُم بِبَعۡضٖ لِّيَقُولُوٓاْ أَهَـٰٓؤُلَآءِ مَنَّ ٱللَّهُ عَلَيۡهِم مِّنۢ بَيۡنِنَآۗ أَلَيۡسَ ٱللَّهُ بِأَعۡلَمَ بِٱلشَّـٰكِرِينَ
translation: And thus We have tried some of them through others that the disbelievers might say, "Is it these whom Allah has favored among us?" Is not Allah most knowing of those who are grateful
normalizedArabic: وكذلك فتنا بعضهم ببعض ليقولوا اهولاء من الله عليهم من بيننا اليس الله باعلم بالشكرين
normalizedTranslation: and thus we have tried some of them through others that the disbelievers might say, "is it these whom allah has favored among us?" is not allah most knowing of those who are grateful

arabic: وَإِذَا جَآءَكَ ٱلَّذِينَ يُؤۡمِنُونَ بِـَٔايَٰتِنَا فَقُلۡ سَلَٰمٌ عَلَيۡكُمۡۖ كَتَبَ رَبُّكُمۡ عَلَىٰ نَفۡسِهِ ٱلرَّحۡمَةَ أَنَّهُۥ مَنۡ عَمِلَ مِنكُمۡ سُوٓءَۢا بِجَهَٰلَةٖ ثُمَّ تَابَ مِنۢ بَعۡدِهِۦ وَأَصۡلَحَ فَأَنَّهُۥ غَفُورٞ رَّحِيمٞ
translation: And when those come to you who believe in Our verses, say, "Peace be upon you. Your Lord has decreed upon Himself mercy: that any of you who does wrong out of ignorance and then repents after that and corrects himself - indeed, He is Forgiving and Merciful
normalizedArabic: واذا جاءك الذين يومنون بايتنا فقل سلم عليكم كتب ربكم علي نفسه الرحمه انه من عمل منكم سوءا بجهله ثم تاب من بعده واصلح فانه غفور رحيم
normalizedTranslation: and when those come to you who believe in our verses, say, "peace be upon you. your lord has decreed upon himself mercy: that any of you who does wrong out of ignorance and then repents after that and corrects himself - indeed, he is forgiving and merciful

arabic: وَكَذَٰلِكَ نُفَصِّلُ ٱلۡأٓيَٰتِ وَلِتَسۡتَبِينَ سَبِيلُ ٱلۡمُجۡرِمِينَ
translation: And thus do We detail the verses, and [thus] the way of the criminals will become evident
normalizedArabic: وكذلك نفصل الايت ولتستبين سبيل المجرمين
normalizedTranslation: and thus do we detail the verses, and [thus] the way of the criminals will become evident

arabic: قُلۡ إِنِّي نُهِيتُ أَنۡ أَعۡبُدَ ٱلَّذِينَ تَدۡعُونَ مِن دُونِ ٱللَّهِۚ قُل لَّآ أَتَّبِعُ أَهۡوَآءَكُمۡ قَدۡ ضَلَلۡتُ إِذٗا وَمَآ أَنَا۠ مِنَ ٱلۡمُهۡتَدِينَ
translation: Say, "Indeed, I have been forbidden to worship those you invoke besides Allah." Say, "I will not follow your desires, for I would then have gone astray, and I would not be of the [rightly] guided
normalizedArabic: قل اني نهيت ان اعبد الذين تدعون من دون الله قل لا اتبع اهواءكم قد ضللت اذا وما انا من المهتدين
normalizedTranslation: say, "indeed, i have been forbidden to worship those you invoke besides allah." say, "i will not follow your desires, for i would then have gone astray, and i would not be of the [rightly] guided

arabic: قُلۡ إِنِّي عَلَىٰ بَيِّنَةٖ مِّن رَّبِّي وَكَذَّبۡتُم بِهِۦۚ مَا عِندِي مَا تَسۡتَعۡجِلُونَ بِهِۦٓۚ إِنِ ٱلۡحُكۡمُ إِلَّا لِلَّهِۖ يَقُصُّ ٱلۡحَقَّۖ وَهُوَ خَيۡرُ ٱلۡفَٰصِلِينَ
translation: Say, "Indeed, I am on clear evidence from my Lord, and you have denied it. I do not have that for which you are impatient. The decision is only for Allah. He relates the truth, and He is the best of deciders
normalizedArabic: قل اني علي بينه من ربي وكذبتم به ما عندي ما تستعجلون به ان الحكم الا لله يقص الحق وهو خير الفصلين
normalizedTranslation: say, "indeed, i am on clear evidence from my lord, and you have denied it. i do not have that for which you are impatient. the decision is only for allah. he relates the truth, and he is the best of deciders

arabic: قُل لَّوۡ أَنَّ عِندِي مَا تَسۡتَعۡجِلُونَ بِهِۦ لَقُضِيَ ٱلۡأَمۡرُ بَيۡنِي وَبَيۡنَكُمۡۗ وَٱللَّهُ أَعۡلَمُ بِٱلظَّـٰلِمِينَ
translation: Say, "If I had that for which you are impatient, the matter would have been decided between me and you, but Allah is most knowing of the wrongdoers
normalizedArabic: قل لو ان عندي ما تستعجلون به لقضي الامر بيني وبينكم والله اعلم بالظلمين
normalizedTranslation: say, "if i had that for which you are impatient, the matter would have been decided between me and you, but allah is most knowing of the wrongdoers

arabic: ۞وَعِندَهُۥ مَفَاتِحُ ٱلۡغَيۡبِ لَا يَعۡلَمُهَآ إِلَّا هُوَۚ وَيَعۡلَمُ مَا فِي ٱلۡبَرِّ وَٱلۡبَحۡرِۚ وَمَا تَسۡقُطُ مِن وَرَقَةٍ إِلَّا يَعۡلَمُهَا وَلَا حَبَّةٖ فِي ظُلُمَٰتِ ٱلۡأَرۡضِ وَلَا رَطۡبٖ وَلَا يَابِسٍ إِلَّا فِي كِتَٰبٖ مُّبِينٖ
translation: And with Him are the keys of the unseen; none knows them except Him. And He knows what is on the land and in the sea. Not a leaf falls but that He knows it. And no grain is there within the darknesses of the earth and no moist or dry [thing] but that it is [written] in a clear record
normalizedArabic: وعنده مفاتح الغيب لا يعلمها الا هو ويعلم ما في البر والبحر وما تسقط من ورقه الا يعلمها ولا حبه في ظلمت الارض ولا رطب ولا يابس الا في كتب مبين
normalizedTranslation: and with him are the keys of the unseen; none knows them except him. and he knows what is on the land and in the sea. not a leaf falls but that he knows it. and no grain is there within the darknesses of the earth and no moist or dry [thing] but that it is [written] in a clear record

arabic: وَهُوَ ٱلَّذِي يَتَوَفَّىٰكُم بِٱلَّيۡلِ وَيَعۡلَمُ مَا جَرَحۡتُم بِٱلنَّهَارِ ثُمَّ يَبۡعَثُكُمۡ فِيهِ لِيُقۡضَىٰٓ أَجَلٞ مُّسَمّٗىۖ ثُمَّ إِلَيۡهِ مَرۡجِعُكُمۡ ثُمَّ يُنَبِّئُكُم بِمَا كُنتُمۡ تَعۡمَلُونَ
translation: And it is He who takes your souls by night and knows what you have committed by day. Then He revives you therein that a specified term may be fulfilled. Then to Him will be your return; then He will inform you about what you used to do
normalizedArabic: وهو الذي يتوفيكم باليل ويعلم ما جرحتم بالنهار ثم يبعثكم فيه ليقضي اجل مسمي ثم اليه مرجعكم ثم ينبيكم بما كنتم تعملون
normalizedTranslation: and it is he who takes your souls by night and knows what you have committed by day. then he revives you therein that a specified term may be fulfilled. then to him will be your return; then he will inform you about what you used to do

arabic: وَهُوَ ٱلۡقَاهِرُ فَوۡقَ عِبَادِهِۦۖ وَيُرۡسِلُ عَلَيۡكُمۡ حَفَظَةً حَتَّىٰٓ إِذَا جَآءَ أَحَدَكُمُ ٱلۡمَوۡتُ تَوَفَّتۡهُ رُسُلُنَا وَهُمۡ لَا يُفَرِّطُونَ
translation: And He is the subjugator over His servants, and He sends over you guardian-angels until, when death comes to one of you, Our messengers take him, and they do not fail [in their duties]
normalizedArabic: وهو القاهر فوق عباده ويرسل عليكم حفظه حتي اذا جاء احدكم الموت توفته رسلنا وهم لا يفرطون
normalizedTranslation: and he is the subjugator over his servants, and he sends over you guardian-angels until, when death comes to one of you, our messengers take him, and they do not fail [in their duties]

arabic: ثُمَّ رُدُّوٓاْ إِلَى ٱللَّهِ مَوۡلَىٰهُمُ ٱلۡحَقِّۚ أَلَا لَهُ ٱلۡحُكۡمُ وَهُوَ أَسۡرَعُ ٱلۡحَٰسِبِينَ
translation: Then they His servants are returned to Allah, their true Lord. Unquestionably, His is the judgement, and He is the swiftest of accountants
normalizedArabic: ثم ردوا الي الله موليهم الحق الا له الحكم وهو اسرع الحسبين
normalizedTranslation: then they his servants are returned to allah, their true lord. unquestionably, his is the judgement, and he is the swiftest of accountants

arabic: قُلۡ مَن يُنَجِّيكُم مِّن ظُلُمَٰتِ ٱلۡبَرِّ وَٱلۡبَحۡرِ تَدۡعُونَهُۥ تَضَرُّعٗا وَخُفۡيَةٗ لَّئِنۡ أَنجَىٰنَا مِنۡ هَٰذِهِۦ لَنَكُونَنَّ مِنَ ٱلشَّـٰكِرِينَ
translation: Say, "Who rescues you from the darknesses of the land and sea [when] you call upon Him imploring [aloud] and privately, 'If He should save us from this [crisis], we will surely be among the thankful

translation: And Ishmael and Elisha and Jonah and Lot - and all [of them] We preferred over the worlds

normalizedTranslation: and ishmael and elisha and jonah and lot - and all [of them] we preferred over the worlds

arabic: وَمِنۡ ءَابَآئِهِمۡ وَذُرِّيَّـٰتِهِمۡ وَإِخۡوَٰنِهِمۡۖ وَٱجۡتَبَيۡنَٰهُمۡ وَهَدَيۡنَٰهُمۡ إِلَىٰ صِرَٰطٖ مُّسۡتَقِيمٖ
translation: And [some] among their fathers and their descendants and their brothers - and We chose them and We guided them to a straight path
normalizedArabic: ومن ءابايهم وذريتهم واخونهم واجتبينهم وهدينهم الي صرط مستقيم
normalizedTranslation: and [some] among their fathers and their descendants and their brothers - and we chose them and we guided them to a straight path

arabic: ذَٰلِكَ هُدَى ٱللَّهِ يَهۡدِي بِهِۦ مَن يَشَآءُ مِنۡ عِبَادِهِۦۚ وَلَوۡ أَشۡرَكُواْ لَحَبِطَ عَنۡهُم مَّا كَانُواْ يَعۡمَلُونَ
translation: That is the guidance of Allah by which He guides whomever He wills of His servants. But if they had associated others with Allah, then worthless for them would be whatever they were doing
normalizedArabic: ذلك هدي الله يهدي به من يشاء من عباده ولو اشركوا لحبط عنهم ما كانوا يعملون
normalizedTranslation: that is the guidance of allah by which he guides whomever he wills of his servants. but if they had associated others with allah, then worthless for them would be whatever they were doing

arabic: أُوْلَـٰٓئِكَ ٱلَّذِينَ ءَاتَيۡنَٰهُمُ ٱلۡكِتَٰبَ وَٱلۡحُكۡمَ وَٱلنُّبُوَّةَۚ فَإِن يَكۡفُرۡ بِهَا هَـٰٓؤُلَآءِ فَقَدۡ وَكَّلۡنَا بِهَا قَوۡمٗا لَّيۡسُواْ بِهَا بِكَٰفِرِينَ
translation: Those are the ones to whom We gave the Scripture and authority and prophethood. But if the disbelievers deny it, then We have entrusted it to a people who are not therein disbelievers
normalizedArabic: اوليك الذين ءاتينهم الكتب والحكم والنبوه فان يكفر بها هولاء فقد وكلنا بها قوما ليسوا بها بكفرين
normalizedTranslation: those are the ones to whom we gave the scripture and authority and prophethood. but if the disbelievers deny it, then we have entrusted it to a people who are not therein disbelievers

arabic: أُوْلَـٰٓئِكَ ٱلَّذِينَ هَدَى ٱللَّهُۖ فَبِهُدَىٰهُمُ ٱقۡتَدِهۡۗ قُل لَّآ أَسۡـَٔلُكُمۡ عَلَيۡهِ أَجۡرًاۖ إِنۡ هُوَ إِلَّا ذِكۡرَىٰ لِلۡعَٰلَمِينَ
translation: Those are the ones whom Allah has guided, so from their guidance take an example. Say, "I ask of you for this message no payment. It is not but a reminder for the worlds

normalizedTranslation: those are the ones whom allah has guided, so from their guidance take an example. say, "i ask of you for this message no payment. it is not but a reminder for the worlds

arabic: وَمَا قَدَرُواْ ٱللَّهَ حَقَّ قَدۡرِهِۦٓ إِذۡ قَالُواْ مَآ أَنزَلَ ٱللَّهُ عَلَىٰ بَشَرٖ مِّن شَيۡءٖۗ قُلۡ مَنۡ أَنزَلَ ٱلۡكِتَٰبَ ٱلَّذِي جَآءَ بِهِۦ مُوسَىٰ نُورٗا وَهُدٗى لِّلنَّاسِۖ تَجۡعَلُونَهُۥ قَرَاطِيسَ تُبۡدُونَهَا وَتُخۡفُونَ كَثِيرٗاۖ وَعُلِّمۡتُم مَّا لَمۡ تَعۡلَمُوٓاْ أَنتُمۡ وَلَآ ءَابَآؤُكُمۡۖ قُلِ ٱللَّهُۖ ثُمَّ ذَرۡهُمۡ فِي خَوۡضِهِمۡ يَلۡعَبُونَ
translation: And they did not appraise Allah with true appraisal when they said, "Allah did not reveal to a human being anything." Say, "Who revealed the Scripture that Moses brought as light and guidance to the people? You [Jews] make it into pages, disclosing [some of] it and concealing much. arabic: وَهَٰذَا كِتَٰبٌ أَنزَلۡنَٰهُ مُبَارَكٞ مُّصَدِّقُ ٱلَّذِي بَيۡنَ يَدَيۡهِ وَلِتُنذِرَ أُمَّ ٱلۡقُرَىٰ وَمَنۡ حَوۡلَهَاۚ وَٱلَّذِينَ يُؤۡمِنُونَ بِٱلۡأٓخِرَةِ يُؤۡمِنُونَ بِهِۦۖ وَهُمۡ عَلَىٰ صَلَاتِهِمۡ يُحَافِظُونَ
translation: And this is a Book which We have sent down, blessed and confirming what was before it, that you may warn the Mother of Cities and those around it. Those who believe in the Hereafter believe in it, and they are maintaining their prayers
normalizedArabic: وهذا كتب انزلنه مبارك مصدق الذي بين يديه ولتنذر ام القري ومن حولها والذين يومنون بالاخره يومنون به وهم علي صلاتهم يحافظون
normalizedTranslation: and this is a book which we have sent down, blessed and confirming what was before it, that you may warn the mother of cities and those around it. those who believe in the hereafter believe in it, and they are maintaining their prayers

arabic: وَمَنۡ أَظۡلَمُ مِمَّنِ ٱفۡتَرَىٰ عَلَى ٱللَّهِ كَذِبًا أَوۡ قَالَ أُوحِيَ إِلَيَّ وَلَمۡ يُوحَ إِلَيۡهِ شَيۡءٞ وَمَن قَالَ سَأُنزِلُ مِثۡلَ مَآ أَنزَلَ ٱللَّهُۗ وَلَوۡ تَرَىٰٓ إِذِ ٱلظَّـٰلِمُونَ فِي غَمَرَٰتِ ٱلۡمَوۡتِ وَٱلۡمَلَـٰٓئِكَةُ بَاسِطُوٓاْ أَيۡدِيهِمۡ أَخۡرِجُوٓاْ أَنفُسَكُمُۖ ٱلۡيَوۡمَ تُجۡزَوۡنَ عَذَابَ ٱلۡهُونِ بِمَا كُنتُمۡ تَقُولُونَ عَلَى ٱللَّهِ غَيۡرَ ٱلۡحَقِّ وَكُنتُمۡ عَنۡ ءَايَٰتِهِۦ تَسۡتَكۡبِرُونَ
translation: And who is more unjust than one who invents a lie about Allah or says, "It has been inspired to me," while nothing has been inspired to him, and one who says, "I will reveal [something] like what Allah revealed." And if you could but see when the wrongdoers are in the overwhelming pangs of death while the angels extend their hands, [saying], "Discharge your souls! Today you will be awarded the punishment of [extreme] humiliation for what you used to say against Allah other than the truth and [that] you were, toward His verses, being arrogant

normalizedTranslation: and who is more unjust than one who invents a lie about allah or says, "it has been inspired to me," while nothing has been inspired to him, and one who says, "i will reveal [something] like what allah revealed." and if you could but see when the wrongdoers are in the overwhelming pangs of death while the angels extend their hands, [saying], "discharge your souls! today you will be awarded the punishment of [extreme] humiliation for what you used to say against allah other than the truth and [that] you were, toward his verses, being arrogant

arabic: وَلَقَدۡ جِئۡتُمُونَا فُرَٰدَىٰ كَمَا خَلَقۡنَٰكُمۡ أَوَّلَ مَرَّةٖ وَتَرَكۡتُم مَّا خَوَّلۡنَٰكُمۡ وَرَآءَ ظُهُورِكُمۡۖ وَمَا نَرَىٰ مَعَكُمۡ شُفَعَآءَكُمُ ٱلَّذِينَ زَعَمۡتُمۡ أَنَّهُمۡ فِيكُمۡ شُرَكَـٰٓؤُاْۚ لَقَد تَّقَطَّعَ بَيۡنَكُمۡ وَضَلَّ عَنكُم مَّا كُنتُمۡ تَزۡعُمُونَ

And We do not see with you your 'intercessors' which you claimed that they were among you associates [of Allah]. It has [all] been severed between you, and lost from you is what you used to claim
normalizedArabic: ولقد جيتمونا فردي كما خلقنكم اول مره وتركتم ما خولنكم وراء ظهوركم وما نري معكم شفعاءكم الذين زعمتم انهم فيكم شركوا لقد تقطع بينكم وضل عنكم ما كنتم تزعمون
normalizedTranslation: [it will be said to them], "and you have certainly come to us alone as we created you the first time, and you have left whatever we bestowed upon you behind you. and we do not see with you your 'intercessors' which you claimed that they were among you associates [of allah]. it has [all] been severed between you, and lost from you is what you used to claim

arabic: ۞إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ فَالِقُ ٱلۡحَبِّ وَٱلنَّوَىٰۖ يُخۡرِجُ ٱلۡحَيَّ مِنَ ٱلۡمَيِّتِ وَمُخۡرِجُ ٱلۡمَيِّتِ مِنَ ٱلۡحَيِّۚ ذَٰلِكُمُ ٱللَّهُۖ فَأَنَّىٰ تُؤۡفَكُونَ
translation: Indeed, Allah is the cleaver of grain and date seeds. He brings the living out of the dead and brings the dead out of the living. That is Allah; so how are you deluded
normalizedArabic: ان الله فالق الحب والنوي يخرج الحي من الميت ومخرج الميت من الحي ذلكم الله فاني توفكون
normalizedTranslation: indeed, allah is the cleaver of grain and date seeds. he brings the living out of the dead and brings the dead out of the living. that is allah; so how are you deluded

arabic: فَالِقُ ٱلۡإِصۡبَاحِ وَجَعَلَ ٱلَّيۡلَ سَكَنٗا وَٱلشَّمۡسَ وَٱلۡقَمَرَ حُسۡبَانٗاۚ ذَٰلِكَ تَقۡدِيرُ ٱلۡعَزِيزِ ٱلۡعَلِيمِ
translation: [He is] the cleaver of daybreak and has made the night for rest and the sun and moon for calculation. That is the determination of the Exalted in Might, the Knowing
normalizedArabic: فالق الاصباح وجعل اليل سكنا والشمس والقمر حسبانا ذلك تقدير العزيز العليم
normalizedTranslation: [he is] the cleaver of daybreak and has made the night for rest and the sun and moon for calculation. that is the determination of the exalted in might, the knowing

arabic: وَهُوَ ٱلَّذِي جَعَلَ لَكُمُ ٱلنُّجُومَ لِتَهۡتَدُواْ بِهَا فِي ظُلُمَٰتِ ٱلۡبَرِّ وَٱلۡبَحۡرِۗ قَدۡ فَصَّلۡنَا ٱلۡأٓيَٰتِ لِقَوۡمٖ يَعۡلَمُونَ
translation: And it is He who placed for you the stars that you may be guided by them through the darknesses of the land and sea. We have detailed the signs for a people who know
normalizedArabic: وهو الذي جعل لكم النجوم لتهتدوا بها في ظلمت البر والبحر قد فصلنا الايت لقوم يعلمون
normalizedTranslation: and it is he who placed for you the stars that you may be guided by them through the darknesses of the land and sea. we have detailed the signs for a people who know

arabic: وَهُوَ ٱلَّذِيٓ أَنشَأَكُم مِّن نَّفۡسٖ وَٰحِدَةٖ فَمُسۡتَقَرّٞ وَمُسۡتَوۡدَعٞۗ قَدۡ فَصَّلۡنَا ٱلۡأٓيَٰتِ لِقَوۡمٖ يَفۡقَهُونَ
translation: And it is He who produced you from one soul and [gave you] a place of dwelling and of storage. We have detailed the signs for a people who understand

normalizedTranslation: and it is he who produced you from one soul and [gave you] a place of dwelling and of storage. we have detailed the signs for a people who understand

arabic: وَهُوَ ٱلَّذِيٓ أَنزَلَ مِنَ ٱلسَّمَآءِ مَآءٗ فَأَخۡرَجۡنَا بِهِۦ نَبَاتَ كُلِّ شَيۡءٖ فَأَخۡرَجۡنَا مِنۡهُ خَضِرٗا نُّخۡرِجُ مِنۡهُ حَبّٗا مُّتَرَاكِبٗا وَمِنَ ٱلنَّخۡلِ مِن طَلۡعِهَا قِنۡوَانٞ دَانِيَةٞ وَجَنَّـٰتٖ مِّنۡ أَعۡنَابٖ وَٱلزَّيۡتُونَ وَٱلرُّمَّانَ مُشۡتَبِهٗا وَغَيۡرَ مُتَشَٰبِهٍۗ ٱنظُرُوٓاْ إِلَىٰ ثَمَرِهِۦٓ إِذَآ أَثۡمَرَ وَيَنۡعِهِۦٓۚ إِنَّ فِي ذَٰلِكُمۡ لَأٓيَٰتٖ لِّقَوۡمٖ يُؤۡمِنُونَ
translation: And it is He who sends down rain from the sky, and We produce thereby the growth of all things. We produce from it greenery from which We produce grains arranged in layers. Look at [each of] its fruit when it yields and [at] its ripening. Indeed in that are signs for a people who believe

normalizedTranslation: and it is he who sends down rain from the sky, and we produce thereby the growth of all things. we produce from it greenery from which we produce grains arranged in layers. and from the palm trees - of its emerging fruit are clusters hanging low. and [we produce] gardens of grapevines and olives and pomegranates, similar yet varied. look at [each of] its fruit when it yields and [at] its ripening. indeed in that are signs for a people who believe

arabic: وَجَعَلُواْ لِلَّهِ شُرَكَآءَ ٱلۡجِنَّ وَخَلَقَهُمۡۖ وَخَرَقُواْ لَهُۥ بَنِينَ وَبَنَٰتِۭ بِغَيۡرِ عِلۡمٖۚ سُبۡحَٰنَهُۥ وَتَعَٰلَىٰ عَمَّا يَصِفُونَ
translation: But they have attributed to Allah partners - the jinn, while He has created them - and have fabricated for Him sons and daughters. Exalted is He and high above what they describe

normalizedTranslation: but they have attributed to allah partners - the jinn, while he has created them - and have fabricated for him sons and daughters. exalted is he and high above what they describe

arabic: بَدِيعُ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلۡأَرۡضِۖ أَنَّىٰ يَكُونُ لَهُۥ وَلَدٞ وَلَمۡ تَكُن لَّهُۥ صَٰحِبَةٞۖ وَخَلَقَ كُلَّ شَيۡءٖۖ وَهُوَ بِكُلِّ شَيۡءٍ عَلِيمٞ
translation: [He is] Originator of the heavens and the earth. How could He have a son when He does not have a companion and He created all things? And He is, of all things, Knowing

normalizedTranslation: [he is] originator of the heavens and the earth. how could he have a son when he does not have a companion and he created all things? and he is, of all things, knowing

arabic: ذَٰلِكُمُ ٱللَّهُ رَبُّكُمۡۖ لَآ إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا هُوَۖ خَٰلِقُ كُلِّ شَيۡءٖ فَٱعۡبُدُوهُۚ وَهُوَ عَلَىٰ كُلِّ شَيۡءٖ وَكِيلٞ

arabic: لَّا تُدۡرِكُهُ ٱلۡأَبۡصَٰرُ وَهُوَ يُدۡرِكُ ٱلۡأَبۡصَٰرَۖ وَهُوَ ٱللَّطِيفُ ٱلۡخَبِيرُ

translation: There has come to you enlightenment from your Lord. So whoever will see does so for [the benefit of] his soul, and whoever is blind [does harm] against it. And [say], "I am not a guardian over you
normalizedArabic: قد جاءكم بصاير من ربكم فمن ابصر فلنفسه ومن عمي فعليها وما انا عليكم بحفيظ
normalizedTranslation: there has come to you enlightenment from your lord. so whoever will see does so for [the benefit of] his soul, and whoever is blind [does harm] against it. and [say], "i am not a guardian over you

arabic: وَكَذَٰلِكَ نُصَرِّفُ ٱلۡأٓيَٰتِ وَلِيَقُولُواْ دَرَسۡتَ وَلِنُبَيِّنَهُۥ لِقَوۡمٖ يَعۡلَمُونَ
translation: And thus do We diversify the verses so the disbelievers will say, "You have studied," and so We may make the Qur'an clear for a people who know
normalizedArabic: وكذلك نصرف الايت وليقولوا درست ولنبينه لقوم يعلمون
normalizedTranslation: and thus do we diversify the verses so the disbelievers will say, "you have studied," and so we may make the qur'an clear for a people who know

arabic: ٱتَّبِعۡ مَآ أُوحِيَ إِلَيۡكَ مِن رَّبِّكَۖ لَآ إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا هُوَۖ وَأَعۡرِضۡ عَنِ ٱلۡمُشۡرِكِينَ
translation: Follow, [O Muhammad], what has been revealed to you from your Lord - there is no deity except Him - and turn away from those who associate others with Allah
normalizedArabic: اتبع ما اوحي اليك من ربك لا اله الا هو واعرض عن المشركين
normalizedTranslation: follow, [o muhammad], what has been revealed to you from your lord - there is no deity except him - and turn away from those who associate others with allah

arabic: وَلَوۡ شَآءَ ٱللَّهُ مَآ أَشۡرَكُواْۗ وَمَا جَعَلۡنَٰكَ عَلَيۡهِمۡ حَفِيظٗاۖ وَمَآ أَنتَ عَلَيۡهِم بِوَكِيلٖ
translation: But if Allah had willed, they would not have associated. And We have not appointed you over them as a guardian, nor are you a manager over them
normalizedArabic: ولو شاء الله ما اشركوا وما جعلنك عليهم حفيظا وما انت عليهم بوكيل
normalizedTranslation: but if allah had willed, they would not have associated. and we have not appointed you over them as a guardian, nor are you a manager over them

arabic: وَلَا تَسُبُّواْ ٱلَّذِينَ يَدۡعُونَ مِن دُونِ ٱللَّهِ فَيَسُبُّواْ ٱللَّهَ عَدۡوَۢا بِغَيۡرِ عِلۡمٖۗ كَذَٰلِكَ زَيَّنَّا لِكُلِّ أُمَّةٍ عَمَلَهُمۡ ثُمَّ إِلَىٰ رَبِّهِم مَّرۡجِعُهُمۡ فَيُنَبِّئُهُم بِمَا كَانُواْ يَعۡمَلُونَ
translation: And do not insult those they invoke other than Allah, lest they insult Allah in enmity without knowledge. Thus We have made pleasing to every community their deeds. Then to their Lord is their return, and He will inform them about what they used to do
normalizedArabic: ولا تسبوا الذين يدعون من دون الله فيسبوا الله عدوا بغير علم كذلك زينا لكل امه عملهم ثم الي ربهم مرجعهم فينبيهم بما كانوا يعملون
normalizedTranslation: and do not insult those they invoke other than allah, lest they insult allah in enmity without knowledge. thus we have made pleasing to every community their deeds. then to their lord is their return, and he will inform them about what they used to do

arabic: وَأَقۡسَمُواْ بِٱللَّهِ جَهۡدَ أَيۡمَٰنِهِمۡ لَئِن جَآءَتۡهُمۡ ءَايَةٞ لَّيُؤۡمِنُنَّ بِهَاۚ قُلۡ إِنَّمَا ٱلۡأٓيَٰتُ عِندَ ٱللَّهِۖ وَمَا يُشۡعِرُكُمۡ أَنَّهَآ إِذَا جَآءَتۡ لَا يُؤۡمِنُونَ
translation: And they swear by Allah their strongest oaths that if a sign came to them, they would surely believe in it. Say, "The signs are only with Allah." And what will make you perceive that even if a sign came, they would not believe
normalizedArabic: واقسموا بالله جهد ايمنهم لين جاءتهم ءايه ليومنن بها قل انما الايت عند الله وما يشعركم انها اذا جاءت لا يومنون
normalizedTranslation: and they swear by allah their strongest oaths that if a sign came to them, they would surely believe in it. say, "the signs are only with allah." and what will make you perceive that even if a sign came, they would not believe

arabic: وَنُقَلِّبُ أَفۡـِٔدَتَهُمۡ وَأَبۡصَٰرَهُمۡ كَمَا لَمۡ يُؤۡمِنُواْ بِهِۦٓ أَوَّلَ مَرَّةٖ وَنَذَرُهُمۡ فِي طُغۡيَٰنِهِمۡ يَعۡمَهُونَ
translation: And We will turn away their hearts and their eyes just as they refused to believe in it the first time. And We will leave them in their transgression, wandering blindly
normalizedArabic: ونقلب افدتهم وابصرهم كما لم يومنوا به اول مره ونذرهم في طغينهم يعمهون
normalizedTranslation: and we will turn away their hearts and their eyes just as they refused to believe in it the first time. and we will leave them in their transgression, wandering blindly

arabic: ۞وَلَوۡ أَنَّنَا نَزَّلۡنَآ إِلَيۡهِمُ ٱلۡمَلَـٰٓئِكَةَ وَكَلَّمَهُمُ ٱلۡمَوۡتَىٰ وَحَشَرۡنَا عَلَيۡهِمۡ كُلَّ شَيۡءٖ قُبُلٗا مَّا كَانُواْ لِيُؤۡمِنُوٓاْ إِلَّآ أَن يَشَآءَ ٱللَّهُ وَلَٰكِنَّ أَكۡثَرَهُمۡ يَجۡهَلُونَ
translation: And even if We had sent down to them the angels [with the message] and the dead spoke to them [of it] and We gathered together every [created] thing in front of them, they would not believe unless Allah should will. But most of them, [of that], are ignorant
normalizedArabic: ولو اننا نزلنا اليهم المليكه وكلمهم الموتي وحشرنا عليهم كل شيء قبلا ما كانوا ليومنوا الا ان يشاء الله ولكن اكثرهم يجهلون
normalizedTranslation: and even if we had sent down to them the angels [with the message] and the dead spoke to them [of it] and we gathered together every [created] thing in front of them, they would not believe unless allah should will. but most of them, [of that], are ignorant

arabic: وَكَذَٰلِكَ جَعَلۡنَا لِكُلِّ نَبِيٍّ عَدُوّٗا شَيَٰطِينَ ٱلۡإِنسِ وَٱلۡجِنِّ يُوحِي بَعۡضُهُمۡ إِلَىٰ بَعۡضٖ زُخۡرُفَ ٱلۡقَوۡلِ غُرُورٗاۚ وَلَوۡ شَآءَ رَبُّكَ مَا فَعَلُوهُۖ فَذَرۡهُمۡ وَمَا يَفۡتَرُونَ
translation: And thus We have made for every prophet an enemy - devils from mankind and jinn, inspiring to one another decorative speech in delusion. But if your Lord had willed, they would not have done it, so leave them and that which they invent
normalizedArabic: وكذلك جعلنا لكل نبي عدوا شيطين الانس والجن يوحي بعضهم الي بعض زخرف القول غرورا ولو شاء ربك ما فعلوه فذرهم وما يفترون
normalizedTranslation: and thus we have made for every prophet an enemy - devils from mankind and jinn, inspiring to one another decorative speech in delusion. but if your lord had willed, they would not have done it, so leave them and that which they invent

arabic: وَلِتَصۡغَىٰٓ إِلَيۡهِ أَفۡـِٔدَةُ ٱلَّذِينَ لَا يُؤۡمِنُونَ بِٱلۡأٓخِرَةِ وَلِيَرۡضَوۡهُ وَلِيَقۡتَرِفُواْ مَا هُم مُّقۡتَرِفُونَ
translation: And [it is] so the hearts of those who disbelieve in the Hereafter will incline toward it and that they will be satisfied with it and that they will commit that which they are committing
normalizedArabic: ولتصغي اليه افده الذين لا يومنون بالاخره وليرضوه وليقترفوا ما هم مقترفون
normalizedTranslation: and [it is] so the hearts of those who disbelieve in the hereafter will incline toward it and that they will be satisfied with it and that they will commit that which they are committing

arabic: أَفَغَيۡرَ ٱللَّهِ أَبۡتَغِي حَكَمٗا وَهُوَ ٱلَّذِيٓ أَنزَلَ إِلَيۡكُمُ ٱلۡكِتَٰبَ مُفَصَّلٗاۚ وَٱلَّذِينَ ءَاتَيۡنَٰهُمُ ٱلۡكِتَٰبَ يَعۡلَمُونَ أَنَّهُۥ مُنَزَّلٞ مِّن رَّبِّكَ بِٱلۡحَقِّۖ فَلَا تَكُونَنَّ مِنَ ٱلۡمُمۡتَرِينَ
translation: [Say], "Then is it other than Allah I should seek as judge while it is He who has revealed to you the Book explained in detail?" And those to whom We [previously] gave the Scripture know that it is sent down from your Lord in truth, so never be among the doubters
normalizedArabic: افغير الله ابتغي حكما وهو الذي انزل اليكم الكتب مفصلا والذين ءاتينهم الكتب يعلمون انه منزل من ربك بالحق فلا تكونن من الممترين
normalizedTranslation: [say], "then is it other than allah i should seek as judge while it is he who has revealed to you the book explained in detail?" and those to whom we [previously] gave the scripture know that it is sent down from your lord in truth, so never be among the doubters

arabic: وَتَمَّتۡ كَلِمَتُ رَبِّكَ صِدۡقٗا وَعَدۡلٗاۚ لَّا مُبَدِّلَ لِكَلِمَٰتِهِۦۚ وَهُوَ ٱلسَّمِيعُ ٱلۡعَلِيمُ
translation: And the word of your Lord has been fulfilled in truth and in justice. None can alter His words, and He is the Hearing, the Knowing
normalizedArabic: وتمت كلمت ربك صدقا وعدلا لا مبدل لكلمته وهو السميع العليم
normalizedTranslation: and the word of your lord has been fulfilled in truth and in justice. none can alter his words, and he is the hearing, the knowing

arabic: وَإِن تُطِعۡ أَكۡثَرَ مَن فِي ٱلۡأَرۡضِ يُضِلُّوكَ عَن سَبِيلِ ٱللَّهِۚ إِن يَتَّبِعُونَ إِلَّا ٱلظَّنَّ وَإِنۡ هُمۡ إِلَّا يَخۡرُصُونَ
translation: And if you obey most of those upon the earth, they will mislead you from the way of Allah. They follow not except assumption, and they are not but falsifying
normalizedArabic: وان تطع اكثر من في الارض يضلوك عن سبيل الله ان يتبعون الا الظن وان هم الا يخرصون
normalizedTranslation: and if you obey most of those upon the earth, they will mislead you from the way of allah. they follow not except assumption, and they are not but falsifying

arabic: إِنَّ رَبَّكَ هُوَ أَعۡلَمُ مَن يَضِلُّ عَن سَبِيلِهِۦۖ وَهُوَ أَعۡلَمُ بِٱلۡمُهۡتَدِينَ
translation: Indeed, your Lord is most knowing of who strays from His way, and He is most knowing of the [rightly] guided
normalizedArabic: ان ربك هو اعلم من يضل عن سبيله وهو اعلم بالمهتدين
normalizedTranslation: indeed, your lord is most knowing of who strays from his way, and he is most knowing of the [rightly] guided

arabic: فَكُلُواْ مِمَّا ذُكِرَ ٱسۡمُ ٱللَّهِ عَلَيۡهِ إِن كُنتُم بِـَٔايَٰتِهِۦ مُؤۡمِنِينَ
translation: So eat of that [meat] upon which the name of Allah has been mentioned, if you are believers in His verses
normalizedArabic: فكلوا مما ذكر اسم الله عليه ان كنتم بايته مومنين
normalizedTranslation: so eat of that [meat] upon which the name of allah has been mentioned, if you are believers in his verses

arabic: وَمَا لَكُمۡ أَلَّا تَأۡكُلُواْ مِمَّا ذُكِرَ ٱسۡمُ ٱللَّهِ عَلَيۡهِ وَقَدۡ فَصَّلَ لَكُم مَّا حَرَّمَ عَلَيۡكُمۡ إِلَّا مَا ٱضۡطُرِرۡتُمۡ إِلَيۡهِۗ وَإِنَّ كَثِيرٗا لَّيُضِلُّونَ بِأَهۡوَآئِهِم بِغَيۡرِ عِلۡمٍۚ إِنَّ رَبَّكَ هُوَ أَعۡلَمُ بِٱلۡمُعۡتَدِينَ
translation: And why should you not eat of that upon which the name of Allah has been mentioned while He has explained in detail to you what He has forbidden you, excepting that to which you are compelled. And indeed do many lead [others] astray through their [own] inclinations without knowledge. Indeed, your Lord - He is most knowing of the transgressors
normalizedArabic: وما لكم الا تاكلوا مما ذكر اسم الله عليه وقد فصل لكم ما حرم عليكم الا ما اضطررتم اليه وان كثيرا ليضلون باهوايهم بغير علم ان ربك هو اعلم بالمعتدين
normalizedTranslation: and why should you not eat of that upon which the name of allah has been mentioned while he has explained in detail to you what he has forbidden you, excepting that to which you are compelled. and indeed do many lead [others] astray through their [own] inclinations without knowledge. indeed, your lord - he is most knowing of the transgressors

arabic: وَذَرُواْ ظَٰهِرَ ٱلۡإِثۡمِ وَبَاطِنَهُۥٓۚ إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ يَكۡسِبُونَ ٱلۡإِثۡمَ سَيُجۡزَوۡنَ بِمَا كَانُواْ يَقۡتَرِفُونَ
translation: And leave what is apparent of sin and what is concealed thereof. Indeed, those who earn [blame for] sin will be recompensed for that which they used to commit
normalizedArabic: وذروا ظهر الاثم وباطنه ان الذين يكسبون الاثم سيجزون بما كانوا يقترفون
normalizedTranslation: and leave what is apparent of sin and what is concealed thereof. indeed, those who earn [blame for] sin will be recompensed for that which they used to commit

arabic: وَلَا تَأۡكُلُواْ مِمَّا لَمۡ يُذۡكَرِ ٱسۡمُ ٱللَّهِ عَلَيۡهِ وَإِنَّهُۥ لَفِسۡقٞۗ وَإِنَّ ٱلشَّيَٰطِينَ لَيُوحُونَ إِلَىٰٓ أَوۡلِيَآئِهِمۡ لِيُجَٰدِلُوكُمۡۖ وَإِنۡ أَطَعۡتُمُوهُمۡ إِنَّكُمۡ لَمُشۡرِكُونَ
translation: And do not eat of that upon which the name of Allah has not been mentioned, for indeed, it is grave disobedience. And indeed do the devils inspire their allies [among men] to dispute with you. And if you were to obey them, indeed, you would be associators [of others with Him]
normalizedArabic: ولا تاكلوا مما لم يذكر اسم الله عليه وانه لفسق وان الشيطين ليوحون الي اوليايهم ليجدلوكم وان اطعتموهم انكم لمشركون
normalizedTranslation: and do not eat of that upon which the name of allah has not been mentioned, for indeed, it is grave disobedience. and indeed do the devils inspire their allies [among men] to dispute with you. and if you were to obey them, indeed, you would be associators [of others with him]

arabic: أَوَمَن كَانَ مَيۡتٗا فَأَحۡيَيۡنَٰهُ وَجَعَلۡنَا لَهُۥ نُورٗا يَمۡشِي بِهِۦ فِي ٱلنَّاسِ كَمَن مَّثَلُهُۥ فِي ٱلظُّلُمَٰتِ لَيۡسَ بِخَارِجٖ مِّنۡهَاۚ كَذَٰلِكَ زُيِّنَ لِلۡكَٰفِرِينَ مَا كَانُواْ يَعۡمَلُونَ
translation: And is one who was dead and We gave him life and made for him light by which to walk among the people like one who is in darkness, never to emerge therefrom? Thus it has been made pleasing to the disbelievers that which they were doing
normalizedArabic: اومن كان ميتا فاحيينه وجعلنا له نورا يمشي به في الناس كمن مثله في الظلمت ليس بخارج منها كذلك زين للكفرين ما كانوا يعملون
normalizedTranslation: and is one who was dead and we gave him life and made for him light by which to walk among the people like one who is in darkness, never to emerge therefrom? thus it has been made pleasing to the disbelievers that which they were doing

arabic: وَكَذَٰلِكَ جَعَلۡنَا فِي كُلِّ قَرۡيَةٍ أَكَٰبِرَ مُجۡرِمِيهَا لِيَمۡكُرُواْ فِيهَاۖ وَمَا يَمۡكُرُونَ إِلَّا بِأَنفُسِهِمۡ وَمَا يَشۡعُرُونَ
translation: And thus We have placed within every city the greatest of its criminals to conspire therein. But they conspire not except against themselves, and they perceive [it] not
normalizedArabic: وكذلك جعلنا في كل قريه اكبر مجرميها ليمكروا فيها وما يمكرون الا بانفسهم وما يشعرون
normalizedTranslation: and thus we have placed within every city the greatest of its criminals to conspire therein. but they conspire not except against themselves, and they perceive [it] not

arabic: وَإِذَا جَآءَتۡهُمۡ ءَايَةٞ قَالُواْ لَن نُّؤۡمِنَ حَتَّىٰ نُؤۡتَىٰ مِثۡلَ مَآ أُوتِيَ رُسُلُ ٱللَّهِۘ ٱللَّهُ أَعۡلَمُ حَيۡثُ يَجۡعَلُ رِسَالَتَهُۥۗ سَيُصِيبُ ٱلَّذِينَ أَجۡرَمُواْ صَغَارٌ عِندَ ٱللَّهِ وَعَذَابٞ شَدِيدُۢ بِمَا كَانُواْ يَمۡكُرُونَ
translation: And when a sign comes to them, they say, "Never will we believe until we are given like that which was given to the messengers of Allah." Allah is most knowing of where He places His message. There will afflict those who committed crimes debasement before Allah and severe punishment for what they used to conspire
normalizedArabic: واذا جاءتهم ءايه قالوا لن نومن حتي نوتي مثل ما اوتي رسل الله الله اعلم حيث يجعل رسالته سيصيب الذين اجرموا صغار عند الله وعذاب شديد بما كانوا يمكرون
normalizedTranslation: and when a sign comes to them, they say, "never will we believe until we are given like that which was given to the messengers of allah." allah is most knowing of where he places his message. there will afflict those who committed crimes debasement before allah and severe punishment for what they used to conspire

arabic: فَمَن يُرِدِ ٱللَّهُ أَن يَهۡدِيَهُۥ يَشۡرَحۡ صَدۡرَهُۥ لِلۡإِسۡلَٰمِۖ وَمَن يُرِدۡ أَن يُضِلَّهُۥ يَجۡعَلۡ صَدۡرَهُۥ ضَيِّقًا حَرَجٗا كَأَنَّمَا يَصَّعَّدُ فِي ٱلسَّمَآءِۚ كَذَٰلِكَ يَجۡعَلُ ٱللَّهُ ٱلرِّجۡسَ عَلَى ٱلَّذِينَ لَا يُؤۡمِنُونَ
translation: So whoever Allah wants to guide - He expands his breast to [contain] Islam; and whoever He wants to misguide - He makes his breast tight and constricted as though he were climbing into the sky. Thus does Allah place defilement upon those who do not believe
normalizedArabic: فمن يرد الله ان يهديه يشرح صدره للاسلم ومن يرد ان يضله يجعل صدره ضيقا حرجا كانما يصعد في السماء كذلك يجعل الله الرجس علي الذين لا يومنون
normalizedTranslation: so whoever allah wants to guide - he expands his breast to [contain] islam; and whoever he wants to misguide - he makes his breast tight and constricted as though he were climbing into the sky. thus does allah place defilement upon those who do not believe

arabic: وَهَٰذَا صِرَٰطُ رَبِّكَ مُسۡتَقِيمٗاۗ قَدۡ فَصَّلۡنَا ٱلۡأٓيَٰتِ لِقَوۡمٖ يَذَّكَّرُونَ
translation: And this is the path of your Lord, [leading] straight. We have detailed the verses for a people who remember
normalizedArabic: وهذا صرط ربك مستقيما قد فصلنا الايت لقوم يذكرون
normalizedTranslation: and this is the path of your lord, [leading] straight. we have detailed the verses for a people who remember

arabic: ۞لَهُمۡ دَارُ ٱلسَّلَٰمِ عِندَ رَبِّهِمۡۖ وَهُوَ وَلِيُّهُم بِمَا كَانُواْ يَعۡمَلُونَ
translation: For them will be the Home of Peace with their Lord. And He will be their protecting friend because of what they used to do
normalizedArabic: لهم دار السلم عند ربهم وهو وليهم بما كانوا يعملون
normalizedTranslation: for them will be the home of peace with their lord. and he will be their protecting friend because of what they used to do

arabic: وَيَوۡمَ يَحۡشُرُهُمۡ جَمِيعٗا يَٰمَعۡشَرَ ٱلۡجِنِّ قَدِ ٱسۡتَكۡثَرۡتُم مِّنَ ٱلۡإِنسِۖ وَقَالَ أَوۡلِيَآؤُهُم مِّنَ ٱلۡإِنسِ رَبَّنَا ٱسۡتَمۡتَعَ بَعۡضُنَا بِبَعۡضٖ وَبَلَغۡنَآ أَجَلَنَا ٱلَّذِيٓ أَجَّلۡتَ لَنَاۚ قَالَ ٱلنَّارُ مَثۡوَىٰكُمۡ خَٰلِدِينَ فِيهَآ إِلَّا مَا شَآءَ ٱللَّهُۚ إِنَّ رَبَّكَ حَكِيمٌ عَلِيمٞ
translation: And [mention, O Muhammad], the Day when He will gather them together [and say], "O company of jinn, you have [misled] many of mankind." And their allies among mankind will say, "Our Lord, some of us made use of others, and we have [now] reached our term, which you appointed for us." He will say, "The Fire is your residence, wherein you will abide eternally, except for what Allah wills. Indeed, your Lord is Wise and Knowing
normalizedArabic: ويوم يحشرهم جميعا يمعشر الجن قد استكثرتم من الانس وقال اولياوهم من الانس ربنا استمتع بعضنا ببعض وبلغنا اجلنا الذي اجلت لنا قال النار مثويكم خلدين فيها الا ما شاء الله ان ربك حكيم عليم
normalizedTranslation: and [mention, o muhammad], the day when he will gather them together [and say], "o company of jinn, you have [misled] many of mankind." and their allies among mankind will say, "our lord, some of us made use of others, and we have [now] reached our term, which you appointed for us." he will say, "the fire is your residence, wherein you will abide eternally, except for what allah wills. indeed, your lord is wise and knowing

arabic: وَكَذَٰلِكَ نُوَلِّي بَعۡضَ ٱلظَّـٰلِمِينَ بَعۡضَۢا بِمَا كَانُواْ يَكۡسِبُونَ
translation: And thus will We make some of the wrongdoers allies of others for what they used to earn
normalizedArabic: وكذلك نولي بعض الظلمين بعضا بما كانوا يكسبون
normalizedTranslation: and thus will we make some of the wrongdoers allies of others for what they used to earn

arabic: يَٰمَعۡشَرَ ٱلۡجِنِّ وَٱلۡإِنسِ أَلَمۡ يَأۡتِكُمۡ رُسُلٞ مِّنكُمۡ يَقُصُّونَ عَلَيۡكُمۡ ءَايَٰتِي وَيُنذِرُونَكُمۡ لِقَآءَ يَوۡمِكُمۡ هَٰذَاۚ قَالُواْ شَهِدۡنَا عَلَىٰٓ أَنفُسِنَاۖ وَغَرَّتۡهُمُ ٱلۡحَيَوٰةُ ٱلدُّنۡيَا وَشَهِدُواْ عَلَىٰٓ أَنفُسِهِمۡ أَنَّهُمۡ كَانُواْ كَٰفِرِينَ
translation: O company of jinn and mankind, did there not come to you messengers from among you, relating to you My verses and warning you of the meeting of this Day of yours?" They will say, "We bear witness against ourselves"; and the worldly life had deluded them, and they will bear witness against themselves that they were disbelievers
