normalizedTranslation: o company of jinn and mankind, did there not come to you messengers from among you, relating to you my verses and warning you of the meeting of this day of yours?" they will say, "we bear witness against ourselves"; and the worldly life had deluded them, and they will bear witness against themselves that they were disbelievers

arabic: ذَٰلِكَ أَن لَّمۡ يَكُن رَّبُّكَ مُهۡلِكَ ٱلۡقُرَىٰ بِظُلۡمٖ وَأَهۡلُهَا غَٰفِلُونَ
translation: That is because your Lord would not destroy the cities for wrongdoing while their people were unaware
normalizedArabic: ذلك ان لم يكن ربك مهلك القري بظلم واهلها غفلون
normalizedTranslation: that is because your lord would not destroy the cities for wrongdoing while their people were unaware

arabic: وَلِكُلّٖ دَرَجَٰتٞ مِّمَّا عَمِلُواْۚ وَمَا رَبُّكَ بِغَٰفِلٍ عَمَّا يَعۡمَلُونَ
translation: And for all are degrees from what they have done. And your Lord is not unaware of what they do
normalizedArabic: ولكل درجت مما عملوا وما ربك بغفل عما يعملون
normalizedTranslation: and for all are degrees from what they have done. and your lord is not unaware of what they do

arabic: وَرَبُّكَ ٱلۡغَنِيُّ ذُو ٱلرَّحۡمَةِۚ إِن يَشَأۡ يُذۡهِبۡكُمۡ وَيَسۡتَخۡلِفۡ مِنۢ بَعۡدِكُم مَّا يَشَآءُ كَمَآ أَنشَأَكُم مِّن ذُرِّيَّةِ قَوۡمٍ ءَاخَرِينَ
translation: And your Lord is the Free of need, the possessor of mercy. If He wills, he can do away with you and give succession after you to whomever He wills, just as He produced you from the descendants of another people
normalizedArabic: وربك الغني ذو الرحمه ان يشا يذهبكم ويستخلف من بعدكم ما يشاء كما انشاكم من ذريه قوم ءاخرين
normalizedTranslation: and your lord is the free of need, the possessor of mercy. if he wills, he can do away with you and give succession after you to whomever he wills, just as he produced you from the descendants of another people

arabic: إِنَّ مَا تُوعَدُونَ لَأٓتٖۖ وَمَآ أَنتُم بِمُعۡجِزِينَ
translation: Indeed, what you are promised is coming, and you will not cause failure [to Allah]
normalizedArabic: ان ما توعدون لات وما انتم بمعجزين
normalizedTranslation: indeed, what you are promised is coming, and you will not cause failure [to allah]

arabic: قُلۡ يَٰقَوۡمِ ٱعۡمَلُواْ عَلَىٰ مَكَانَتِكُمۡ إِنِّي عَامِلٞۖ فَسَوۡفَ تَعۡلَمُونَ مَن تَكُونُ لَهُۥ عَٰقِبَةُ ٱلدَّارِۚ إِنَّهُۥ لَا يُفۡلِحُ ٱلظَّـٰلِمُونَ
translation: Say, "O my people, work according to your position; [for] indeed, I am working. And you are going to know who will have succession in the home. Indeed, the wrongdoers will not succeed
normalizedArabic: قل يقوم اعملوا علي مكانتكم اني عامل فسوف تعلمون من تكون له عقبه الدار انه لا يفلح الظلمون
normalizedTranslation: say, "o my people, work according to your position; [for] indeed, i am working. and you are going to know who will have succession in the home. indeed, the wrongdoers will not succeed

arabic: وَجَعَلُواْ لِلَّهِ مِمَّا ذَرَأَ مِنَ ٱلۡحَرۡثِ وَٱلۡأَنۡعَٰمِ نَصِيبٗا فَقَالُواْ هَٰذَا لِلَّهِ بِزَعۡمِهِمۡ وَهَٰذَا لِشُرَكَآئِنَاۖ فَمَا كَانَ لِشُرَكَآئِهِمۡ فَلَا يَصِلُ إِلَى ٱللَّهِۖ وَمَا كَانَ لِلَّهِ فَهُوَ يَصِلُ إِلَىٰ شُرَكَآئِهِمۡۗ سَآءَ مَا يَحۡكُمُونَ
translation: And the polytheists assign to Allah from that which He created of crops and livestock a share and say, "This is for Allah," by their claim, "and this is for our partners [associated with Him]." But what is for their "partners" does not reach Allah, while what is for Allah - this reaches their "partners." Evil is that which they rule
normalizedArabic: وجعلوا لله مما ذرا من الحرث والانعم نصيبا فقالوا هذا لله بزعمهم وهذا لشركاينا فما كان لشركايهم فلا يصل الي الله وما كان لله فهو يصل الي شركايهم ساء ما يحكمون
normalizedTranslation: and the polytheists assign to allah from that which he created of crops and livestock a share and say, "this is for allah," by their claim, "and this is for our partners [associated with him]." but what is for their "partners" does not reach allah, while what is for allah - this reaches their "partners." evil is that which they rule

arabic: وَكَذَٰلِكَ زَيَّنَ لِكَثِيرٖ مِّنَ ٱلۡمُشۡرِكِينَ قَتۡلَ أَوۡلَٰدِهِمۡ شُرَكَآؤُهُمۡ لِيُرۡدُوهُمۡ وَلِيَلۡبِسُواْ عَلَيۡهِمۡ دِينَهُمۡۖ وَلَوۡ شَآءَ ٱللَّهُ مَا فَعَلُوهُۖ فَذَرۡهُمۡ وَمَا يَفۡتَرُونَ
translation: And likewise, to many of the polytheists their partners have made [to seem] pleasing the killing of their children in order to bring about their destruction and to cover them with confusion in their religion. And if Allah had willed, they would not have done so. So leave them and that which they invent
normalizedArabic: وكذلك زين لكثير من المشركين قتل اولدهم شركاوهم ليردوهم وليلبسوا عليهم دينهم ولو شاء الله ما فعلوه فذرهم وما يفترون
normalizedTranslation: and likewise, to many of the polytheists their partners have made [to seem] pleasing the killing of their children in order to bring about their destruction and to cover them with confusion in their religion. and if allah had willed, they would not have done so. so leave them and that which they invent

arabic: وَقَالُواْ هَٰذِهِۦٓ أَنۡعَٰمٞ وَحَرۡثٌ حِجۡرٞ لَّا يَطۡعَمُهَآ إِلَّا مَن نَّشَآءُ بِزَعۡمِهِمۡ وَأَنۡعَٰمٌ حُرِّمَتۡ ظُهُورُهَا وَأَنۡعَٰمٞ لَّا يَذۡكُرُونَ ٱسۡمَ ٱللَّهِ عَلَيۡهَا ٱفۡتِرَآءً عَلَيۡهِۚ سَيَجۡزِيهِم بِمَا كَانُواْ يَفۡتَرُونَ
translation: And they say, "These animals and crops are forbidden; no one may eat from them except whom we will," by their claim. And there are those [camels] whose backs are forbidden [by them] and those upon which the name of Allah is not mentioned - [all of this] an invention of untruth about Him. He will punish them for what they were inventing
normalizedArabic: وقالوا هذه انعم وحرث حجر لا يطعمها الا من نشاء بزعمهم وانعم حرمت ظهورها وانعم لا يذكرون اسم الله عليها افتراء عليه سيجزيهم بما كانوا يفترون
normalizedTranslation: and they say, "these animals and crops are forbidden; no one may eat from them except whom we will," by their claim. and there are those [camels] whose backs are forbidden [by them] and those upon which the name of allah is not mentioned - [all of this] an invention of untruth about him. he will punish them for what they were inventing

arabic: وَقَالُواْ مَا فِي بُطُونِ هَٰذِهِ ٱلۡأَنۡعَٰمِ خَالِصَةٞ لِّذُكُورِنَا وَمُحَرَّمٌ عَلَىٰٓ أَزۡوَٰجِنَاۖ وَإِن يَكُن مَّيۡتَةٗ فَهُمۡ فِيهِ شُرَكَآءُۚ سَيَجۡزِيهِمۡ وَصۡفَهُمۡۚ إِنَّهُۥ حَكِيمٌ عَلِيمٞ
translation: And they say, "What is in the bellies of these animals is exclusively for our males and forbidden to our females. But if it is [born] dead, then all of them have shares therein." He will punish them for their description. Indeed, He is Wise and Knowing
normalizedArabic: وقالوا ما في بطون هذه الانعم خالصه لذكورنا ومحرم علي ازوجنا وان يكن ميته فهم فيه شركاء سيجزيهم وصفهم انه حكيم عليم
normalizedTranslation: and they say, "what is in the bellies of these animals is exclusively for our males and forbidden to our females. but if it is [born] dead, then all of them have shares therein." he will punish them for their description. indeed, he is wise and knowing

arabic: قَدۡ خَسِرَ ٱلَّذِينَ قَتَلُوٓاْ أَوۡلَٰدَهُمۡ سَفَهَۢا بِغَيۡرِ عِلۡمٖ وَحَرَّمُواْ مَا رَزَقَهُمُ ٱللَّهُ ٱفۡتِرَآءً عَلَى ٱللَّهِۚ قَدۡ ضَلُّواْ وَمَا كَانُواْ مُهۡتَدِينَ
translation: Those will have lost who killed their children in foolishness without knowledge and prohibited what Allah had provided for them, inventing untruth about Allah. They have gone astray and were not [rightly] guided
normalizedArabic: قد خسر الذين قتلوا اولدهم سفها بغير علم وحرموا ما رزقهم الله افتراء علي الله قد ضلوا وما كانوا مهتدين
normalizedTranslation: those will have lost who killed their children in foolishness without knowledge and prohibited what allah had provided for them, inventing untruth about allah. they have gone astray and were not [rightly] guided

arabic: ۞وَهُوَ ٱلَّذِيٓ أَنشَأَ جَنَّـٰتٖ مَّعۡرُوشَٰتٖ وَغَيۡرَ مَعۡرُوشَٰتٖ وَٱلنَّخۡلَ وَٱلزَّرۡعَ مُخۡتَلِفًا أُكُلُهُۥ وَٱلزَّيۡتُونَ وَٱلرُّمَّانَ مُتَشَٰبِهٗا وَغَيۡرَ مُتَشَٰبِهٖۚ كُلُواْ مِن ثَمَرِهِۦٓ إِذَآ أَثۡمَرَ وَءَاتُواْ حَقَّهُۥ يَوۡمَ حَصَادِهِۦۖ وَلَا تُسۡرِفُوٓاْۚ إِنَّهُۥ لَا يُحِبُّ ٱلۡمُسۡرِفِينَ
translation: And He it is who causes gardens to grow, [both] trellised and untrellised, and palm trees and crops of different [kinds of] food and olives and pomegranates, similar and dissimilar. Eat of [each of] its fruit when it yields and give its due [zakah] on the day of its harvest. And be not excessive. Indeed, He does not like those who commit excess

normalizedTranslation: and he it is who causes gardens to grow, [both] trellised and untrellised, and palm trees and crops of different [kinds of] food and olives and pomegranates, similar and dissimilar. eat of [each of] its fruit when it yields and give its due [zakah] on the day of its harvest. and be not excessive. indeed, he does not like those who commit excess

arabic: وَمِنَ ٱلۡأَنۡعَٰمِ حَمُولَةٗ وَفَرۡشٗاۚ كُلُواْ مِمَّا رَزَقَكُمُ ٱللَّهُ وَلَا تَتَّبِعُواْ خُطُوَٰتِ ٱلشَّيۡطَٰنِۚ إِنَّهُۥ لَكُمۡ عَدُوّٞ مُّبِينٞ
translation: And of the grazing livestock are carriers [of burdens] and those [too] small. Eat of what Allah has provided for you and do not follow the footsteps of Satan. Indeed, he is to you a clear enemy

normalizedTranslation: and of the grazing livestock are carriers [of burdens] and those [too] small. eat of what allah has provided for you and do not follow the footsteps of satan. indeed, he is to you a clear enemy

arabic: ثَمَٰنِيَةَ أَزۡوَٰجٖۖ مِّنَ ٱلضَّأۡنِ ٱثۡنَيۡنِ وَمِنَ ٱلۡمَعۡزِ ٱثۡنَيۡنِۗ قُلۡ ءَآلذَّكَرَيۡنِ حَرَّمَ أَمِ ٱلۡأُنثَيَيۡنِ أَمَّا ٱشۡتَمَلَتۡ عَلَيۡهِ أَرۡحَامُ ٱلۡأُنثَيَيۡنِۖ نَبِّـُٔونِي بِعِلۡمٍ إِن كُنتُمۡ صَٰدِقِينَ
translation: [They are] eight mates - of the sheep, two and of the goats, two. Say, "Is it the two males He has forbidden or the two females or that which the wombs of the two females contain? Inform me with knowledge, if you should be truthful

normalizedTranslation: [they are] eight mates - of the sheep, two and of the goats, two. say, "is it the two males he has forbidden or the two females or that which the wombs of the two females contain? inform me with knowledge, if you should be truthful

arabic: وَمِنَ ٱلۡإِبِلِ ٱثۡنَيۡنِ وَمِنَ ٱلۡبَقَرِ ٱثۡنَيۡنِۗ قُلۡ ءَآلذَّكَرَيۡنِ حَرَّمَ أَمِ ٱلۡأُنثَيَيۡنِ أَمَّا ٱشۡتَمَلَتۡ عَلَيۡهِ أَرۡحَامُ ٱلۡأُنثَيَيۡنِۖ أَمۡ كُنتُمۡ شُهَدَآءَ إِذۡ وَصَّىٰكُمُ ٱللَّهُ بِهَٰذَاۚ فَمَنۡ أَظۡلَمُ مِمَّنِ ٱفۡتَرَىٰ عَلَى ٱللَّهِ كَذِبٗا لِّيُضِلَّ ٱلنَّاسَ بِغَيۡرِ عِلۡمٍۚ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ لَا يَهۡدِي ٱلۡقَوۡمَ ٱلظَّـٰلِمِينَ

Indeed, Allah does not guide the wrongdoing people

normalizedTranslation: and of the camels, two and of the cattle, two. say, "is it the two males he has forbidden or the two females or that which the wombs of the two females contain? or were you witnesses when allah charged you with this? then who is more unjust than one who invents a lie about allah to mislead the people by [something] other than knowledge? indeed, allah does not guide the wrongdoing people

arabic: قُل لَّآ أَجِدُ فِي مَآ أُوحِيَ إِلَيَّ مُحَرَّمًا عَلَىٰ طَاعِمٖ يَطۡعَمُهُۥٓ إِلَّآ أَن يَكُونَ مَيۡتَةً أَوۡ دَمٗا مَّسۡفُوحًا أَوۡ لَحۡمَ خِنزِيرٖ فَإِنَّهُۥ رِجۡسٌ أَوۡ فِسۡقًا أُهِلَّ لِغَيۡرِ ٱللَّهِ بِهِۦۚ فَمَنِ ٱضۡطُرَّ غَيۡرَ بَاغٖ وَلَا عَادٖ فَإِنَّ رَبَّكَ غَفُورٞ رَّحِيمٞ
translation: Say, "I do not find within that which was revealed to me [anything] forbidden to one who would eat it unless it be a dead animal or blood spilled out or the flesh of swine - for indeed, it is impure - or it be [that slaughtered in] disobedience, dedicated to other than Allah. But whoever is forced [by necessity], neither desiring [it] nor transgressing [its limit], then indeed, your Lord is Forgiving and Merciful
normalizedArabic: قل لا اجد في ما اوحي الي محرما علي طاعم يطعمه الا ان يكون ميته او دما مسفوحا او لحم خنزير فانه رجس او فسقا اهل لغير الله به فمن اضطر غير باغ ولا عاد فان ربك غفور رحيم
normalizedTranslation: say, "i do not find within that which was revealed to me [anything] forbidden to one who would eat it unless it be a dead animal or blood spilled out or the flesh of swine - for indeed, it is impure - or it be [that slaughtered in] disobedience, dedicated to other than allah. but whoever is forced [by necessity], neither desiring [it] nor transgressing [its limit], then indeed, your lord is forgiving and merciful

arabic: وَعَلَى ٱلَّذِينَ هَادُواْ حَرَّمۡنَا كُلَّ ذِي ظُفُرٖۖ وَمِنَ ٱلۡبَقَرِ وَٱلۡغَنَمِ حَرَّمۡنَا عَلَيۡهِمۡ شُحُومَهُمَآ إِلَّا مَا حَمَلَتۡ ظُهُورُهُمَآ أَوِ ٱلۡحَوَايَآ أَوۡ مَا ٱخۡتَلَطَ بِعَظۡمٖۚ ذَٰلِكَ جَزَيۡنَٰهُم بِبَغۡيِهِمۡۖ وَإِنَّا لَصَٰدِقُونَ
translation: And to those who are Jews We prohibited every animal of uncloven hoof; and of the cattle and the sheep We prohibited to them their fat, except what adheres to their backs or the entrails or what is joined with bone. [By] that We repaid them for their injustice. And indeed, We are truthful

arabic: فَإِن كَذَّبُوكَ فَقُل رَّبُّكُمۡ ذُو رَحۡمَةٖ وَٰسِعَةٖ وَلَا يُرَدُّ بَأۡسُهُۥ عَنِ ٱلۡقَوۡمِ ٱلۡمُجۡرِمِينَ
translation: So if they deny you, [O Muhammad], say, "Your Lord is the possessor of vast mercy; but His punishment cannot be repelled from the people who are criminals

arabic: سَيَقُولُ ٱلَّذِينَ أَشۡرَكُواْ لَوۡ شَآءَ ٱللَّهُ مَآ أَشۡرَكۡنَا وَلَآ ءَابَآؤُنَا وَلَا حَرَّمۡنَا مِن شَيۡءٖۚ كَذَٰلِكَ كَذَّبَ ٱلَّذِينَ مِن قَبۡلِهِمۡ حَتَّىٰ ذَاقُواْ بَأۡسَنَاۗ قُلۡ هَلۡ عِندَكُم مِّنۡ عِلۡمٖ فَتُخۡرِجُوهُ لَنَآۖ إِن تَتَّبِعُونَ إِلَّا ٱلظَّنَّ وَإِنۡ أَنتُمۡ إِلَّا تَخۡرُصُونَ
translation: Those who associated with Allah will say, "If Allah had willed, we would not have associated [anything] and neither would our fathers, nor would we have prohibited anything." normalizedTranslation: those who associated with allah will say, "if allah had willed, we would not have associated [anything] and neither would our fathers, nor would we have prohibited anything." likewise did those before deny until they tasted our punishment. say, "do you have any knowledge that you can produce for us? you follow not except assumption, and you are not but falsifying

arabic: قُلۡ فَلِلَّهِ ٱلۡحُجَّةُ ٱلۡبَٰلِغَةُۖ فَلَوۡ شَآءَ لَهَدَىٰكُمۡ أَجۡمَعِينَ
translation: Say, "With Allah is the far-reaching argument. If He had willed, He would have guided you all

arabic: قُلۡ هَلُمَّ شُهَدَآءَكُمُ ٱلَّذِينَ يَشۡهَدُونَ أَنَّ ٱللَّهَ حَرَّمَ هَٰذَاۖ فَإِن شَهِدُواْ فَلَا تَشۡهَدۡ مَعَهُمۡۚ وَلَا تَتَّبِعۡ أَهۡوَآءَ ٱلَّذِينَ كَذَّبُواْ بِـَٔايَٰتِنَا وَٱلَّذِينَ لَا يُؤۡمِنُونَ بِٱلۡأٓخِرَةِ وَهُم بِرَبِّهِمۡ يَعۡدِلُونَ

normalizedTranslation: say, [o muhammad], "bring forward your witnesses who will testify that allah has prohibited this." and if they testify, do not testify with them. and do not follow the desires of those who deny our verses and those who do not believe in the hereafter, while they equate [others] with their lord

arabic: ۞قُلۡ تَعَالَوۡاْ أَتۡلُ مَا حَرَّمَ رَبُّكُمۡ عَلَيۡكُمۡۖ أَلَّا تُشۡرِكُواْ بِهِۦ شَيۡـٔٗاۖ وَبِٱلۡوَٰلِدَيۡنِ إِحۡسَٰنٗاۖ وَلَا تَقۡتُلُوٓاْ أَوۡلَٰدَكُم مِّنۡ إِمۡلَٰقٖ نَّحۡنُ نَرۡزُقُكُمۡ وَإِيَّاهُمۡۖ وَلَا تَقۡرَبُواْ ٱلۡفَوَٰحِشَ مَا ظَهَرَ مِنۡهَا وَمَا بَطَنَۖ وَلَا تَقۡتُلُواْ ٱلنَّفۡسَ ٱلَّتِي حَرَّمَ ٱللَّهُ إِلَّا بِٱلۡحَقِّۚ ذَٰلِكُمۡ وَصَّىٰكُم بِهِۦ لَعَلَّكُمۡ تَعۡقِلُونَ
translation: Say, "Come, I will recite what your Lord has prohibited to you. arabic: وَلَا تَقۡرَبُواْ مَالَ ٱلۡيَتِيمِ إِلَّا بِٱلَّتِي هِيَ أَحۡسَنُ حَتَّىٰ يَبۡلُغَ أَشُدَّهُۥۚ وَأَوۡفُواْ ٱلۡكَيۡلَ وَٱلۡمِيزَانَ بِٱلۡقِسۡطِۖ لَا نُكَلِّفُ نَفۡسًا إِلَّا وُسۡعَهَاۖ وَإِذَا قُلۡتُمۡ فَٱعۡدِلُواْ وَلَوۡ كَانَ ذَا قُرۡبَىٰۖ وَبِعَهۡدِ ٱللَّهِ أَوۡفُواْۚ ذَٰلِكُمۡ وَصَّىٰكُم بِهِۦ لَعَلَّكُمۡ تَذَكَّرُونَ
translation: And do not approach the orphan's property except in a way that is best until he reaches maturity. And give full measure and weight in justice. normalizedTranslation: and do not approach the orphan's property except in a way that is best until he reaches maturity. and give full measure and weight in justice. we do not charge any soul except [with that within] its capacity. and when you testify, be just, even if [it concerns] a near relative. and the covenant of allah fulfill. this has he instructed you that you may remember

arabic: وَأَنَّ هَٰذَا صِرَٰطِي مُسۡتَقِيمٗا فَٱتَّبِعُوهُۖ وَلَا تَتَّبِعُواْ ٱلسُّبُلَ فَتَفَرَّقَ بِكُمۡ عَن سَبِيلِهِۦۚ ذَٰلِكُمۡ وَصَّىٰكُم بِهِۦ لَعَلَّكُمۡ تَتَّقُونَ

normalizedTranslation: and, [moreover], this is my path, which is straight, so follow it; and do not follow [other] ways, for you will be separated from his way. this has he instructed you that you may become righteous

normalizedTranslation: then we gave moses the scripture, making complete [our favor] upon the one who did good and as a detailed explanation of all things and as guidance and mercy that perhaps in [the matter of] the meeting with their lord they would believe

arabic: وَنَادَىٰٓ أَصۡحَٰبُ ٱلۡجَنَّةِ أَصۡحَٰبَ ٱلنَّارِ أَن قَدۡ وَجَدۡنَا مَا وَعَدَنَا رَبُّنَا حَقّٗا فَهَلۡ وَجَدتُّم مَّا وَعَدَ رَبُّكُمۡ حَقّٗاۖ قَالُواْ نَعَمۡۚ فَأَذَّنَ مُؤَذِّنُۢ بَيۡنَهُمۡ أَن لَّعۡنَةُ ٱللَّهِ عَلَى ٱلظَّـٰلِمِينَ
translation: And the companions of Paradise will call out to the companions of the Fire, "We have already found what our Lord promised us to be true. Have you found what your Lord promised to be true?" They will say, "Yes." Then an announcer will announce among them, "The curse of Allah shall be upon the wrongdoers
normalizedArabic: ونادي اصحب الجنه اصحب النار ان قد وجدنا ما وعدنا ربنا حقا فهل وجدتم ما وعد ربكم حقا قالوا نعم فاذن موذن بينهم ان لعنه الله علي الظلمين
normalizedTranslation: and the companions of paradise will call out to the companions of the fire, "we have already found what our lord promised us to be true. have you found what your lord promised to be true?" they will say, "yes." then an announcer will announce among them, "the curse of allah shall be upon the wrongdoers

arabic: ٱلَّذِينَ يَصُدُّونَ عَن سَبِيلِ ٱللَّهِ وَيَبۡغُونَهَا عِوَجٗا وَهُم بِٱلۡأٓخِرَةِ كَٰفِرُونَ
translation: Who averted [people] from the way of Allah and sought to make it [seem] deviant while they were, concerning the Hereafter, disbelievers
normalizedArabic: الذين يصدون عن سبيل الله ويبغونها عوجا وهم بالاخره كفرون
normalizedTranslation: who averted [people] from the way of allah and sought to make it [seem] deviant while they were, concerning the hereafter, disbelievers

arabic: وَبَيۡنَهُمَا حِجَابٞۚ وَعَلَى ٱلۡأَعۡرَافِ رِجَالٞ يَعۡرِفُونَ كُلَّۢا بِسِيمَىٰهُمۡۚ وَنَادَوۡاْ أَصۡحَٰبَ ٱلۡجَنَّةِ أَن سَلَٰمٌ عَلَيۡكُمۡۚ لَمۡ يَدۡخُلُوهَا وَهُمۡ يَطۡمَعُونَ
translation: And between them will be a partition, and on [its] elevations are men who recognize all by their mark. And they call out to the companions of Paradise, "Peace be upon you." They have not [yet] entered it, but they long intensely
normalizedArabic: وبينهما حجاب وعلي الاعراف رجال يعرفون كلا بسيميهم ونادوا اصحب الجنه ان سلم عليكم لم يدخلوها وهم يطمعون
normalizedTranslation: and between them will be a partition, and on [its] elevations are men who recognize all by their mark. and they call out to the companions of paradise, "peace be upon you." they have not [yet] entered it, but they long intensely

arabic: ۞وَإِذَا صُرِفَتۡ أَبۡصَٰرُهُمۡ تِلۡقَآءَ أَصۡحَٰبِ ٱلنَّارِ قَالُواْ رَبَّنَا لَا تَجۡعَلۡنَا مَعَ ٱلۡقَوۡمِ ٱلظَّـٰلِمِينَ
translation: And when their eyes are turned toward the companions of the Fire, they say, "Our Lord, do not place us with the wrongdoing people
normalizedArabic: واذا صرفت ابصرهم تلقاء اصحب النار قالوا ربنا لا تجعلنا مع القوم الظلمين
normalizedTranslation: and when their eyes are turned toward the companions of the fire, they say, "our lord, do not place us with the wrongdoing people

arabic: وَنَادَىٰٓ أَصۡحَٰبُ ٱلۡأَعۡرَافِ رِجَالٗا يَعۡرِفُونَهُم بِسِيمَىٰهُمۡ قَالُواْ مَآ أَغۡنَىٰ عَنكُمۡ جَمۡعُكُمۡ وَمَا كُنتُمۡ تَسۡتَكۡبِرُونَ
translation: And the companions of the Elevations will call to men [within Hell] whom they recognize by their mark, saying, "Of no avail to you was your gathering and [the fact] that you were arrogant
normalizedArabic: ونادي اصحب الاعراف رجالا يعرفونهم بسيميهم قالوا ما اغني عنكم جمعكم وما كنتم تستكبرون
normalizedTranslation: and the companions of the elevations will call to men [within hell] whom they recognize by their mark, saying, "of no avail to you was your gathering and [the fact] that you were arrogant

arabic: أَهَـٰٓؤُلَآءِ ٱلَّذِينَ أَقۡسَمۡتُمۡ لَا يَنَالُهُمُ ٱللَّهُ بِرَحۡمَةٍۚ ٱدۡخُلُواْ ٱلۡجَنَّةَ لَا خَوۡفٌ عَلَيۡكُمۡ وَلَآ أَنتُمۡ تَحۡزَنُونَ
translation: [Allah will say], "Are these the ones whom you [inhabitants of Hell] swore that Allah would never offer them mercy? Enter Paradise, [O People of the Elevations]. No fear will there be concerning you, nor will you grieve
normalizedArabic: اهولاء الذين اقسمتم لا ينالهم الله برحمه ادخلوا الجنه لا خوف عليكم ولا انتم تحزنون
normalizedTranslation: [allah will say], "are these the ones whom you [inhabitants of hell] swore that allah would never offer them mercy? enter paradise, [o people of the elevations]. no fear will there be concerning you, nor will you grieve

arabic: وَنَادَىٰٓ أَصۡحَٰبُ ٱلنَّارِ أَصۡحَٰبَ ٱلۡجَنَّةِ أَنۡ أَفِيضُواْ عَلَيۡنَا مِنَ ٱلۡمَآءِ أَوۡ مِمَّا رَزَقَكُمُ ٱللَّهُۚ قَالُوٓاْ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ حَرَّمَهُمَا عَلَى ٱلۡكَٰفِرِينَ
translation: And the companions of the Fire will call to the companions of Paradise, "Pour upon us some water or from whatever Allah has provided you." They will say, "Indeed, Allah has forbidden them both to the disbelievers
normalizedArabic: ونادي اصحب النار اصحب الجنه ان افيضوا علينا من الماء او مما رزقكم الله قالوا ان الله حرمهما علي الكفرين
normalizedTranslation: and the companions of the fire will call to the companions of paradise, "pour upon us some water or from whatever allah has provided you." they will say, "indeed, allah has forbidden them both to the disbelievers

arabic: ٱلَّذِينَ ٱتَّخَذُواْ دِينَهُمۡ لَهۡوٗا وَلَعِبٗا وَغَرَّتۡهُمُ ٱلۡحَيَوٰةُ ٱلدُّنۡيَاۚ فَٱلۡيَوۡمَ نَنسَىٰهُمۡ كَمَا نَسُواْ لِقَآءَ يَوۡمِهِمۡ هَٰذَا وَمَا كَانُواْ بِـَٔايَٰتِنَا يَجۡحَدُونَ
translation: Who took their religion as distraction and amusement and whom the worldly life deluded." So today We will forget them just as they forgot the meeting of this Day of theirs and for having rejected Our verses
normalizedArabic: الذين اتخذوا دينهم لهوا ولعبا وغرتهم الحيوه الدنيا فاليوم ننسيهم كما نسوا لقاء يومهم هذا وما كانوا بايتنا يجحدون
normalizedTranslation: who took their religion as distraction and amusement and whom the worldly life deluded." so today we will forget them just as they forgot the meeting of this day of theirs and for having rejected our verses

arabic: وَلَقَدۡ جِئۡنَٰهُم بِكِتَٰبٖ فَصَّلۡنَٰهُ عَلَىٰ عِلۡمٍ هُدٗى وَرَحۡمَةٗ لِّقَوۡمٖ يُؤۡمِنُونَ
translation: And We had certainly brought them a Book which We detailed by knowledge - as guidance and mercy to a people who believe

normalizedTranslation: and we had certainly brought them a book which we detailed by knowledge - as guidance and mercy to a people who believe

arabic: هَلۡ يَنظُرُونَ إِلَّا تَأۡوِيلَهُۥۚ يَوۡمَ يَأۡتِي تَأۡوِيلُهُۥ يَقُولُ ٱلَّذِينَ نَسُوهُ مِن قَبۡلُ قَدۡ جَآءَتۡ رُسُلُ رَبِّنَا بِٱلۡحَقِّ فَهَل لَّنَا مِن شُفَعَآءَ فَيَشۡفَعُواْ لَنَآ أَوۡ نُرَدُّ فَنَعۡمَلَ غَيۡرَ ٱلَّذِي كُنَّا نَعۡمَلُۚ قَدۡ خَسِرُوٓاْ أَنفُسَهُمۡ وَضَلَّ عَنۡهُم مَّا كَانُواْ يَفۡتَرُونَ
translation: Do they await except its result? The Day its result comes those who had ignored it before will say, "The messengers of our Lord had come with the truth, so are there [now] any intercessors to intercede for us or could we be sent back to do other than we used to do?" They will have lost themselves, and lost from them is what they used to invent
normalizedArabic: هل ينظرون الا تاويله يوم ياتي تاويله يقول الذين نسوه من قبل قد جاءت رسل ربنا بالحق فهل لنا من شفعاء فيشفعوا لنا او نرد فنعمل غير الذي كنا نعمل قد خسروا انفسهم وضل عنهم ما كانوا يفترون
normalizedTranslation: do they await except its result? the day its result comes those who had ignored it before will say, "the messengers of our lord had come with the truth, so are there [now] any intercessors to intercede for us or could we be sent back to do other than we used to do?" they will have lost themselves, and lost from them is what they used to invent

arabic: إِنَّ رَبَّكُمُ ٱللَّهُ ٱلَّذِي خَلَقَ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلۡأَرۡضَ فِي سِتَّةِ أَيَّامٖ ثُمَّ ٱسۡتَوَىٰ عَلَى ٱلۡعَرۡشِۖ يُغۡشِي ٱلَّيۡلَ ٱلنَّهَارَ يَطۡلُبُهُۥ حَثِيثٗا وَٱلشَّمۡسَ وَٱلۡقَمَرَ وَٱلنُّجُومَ مُسَخَّرَٰتِۭ بِأَمۡرِهِۦٓۗ أَلَا لَهُ ٱلۡخَلۡقُ وَٱلۡأَمۡرُۗ تَبَارَكَ ٱللَّهُ رَبُّ ٱلۡعَٰلَمِينَ
translation: Indeed, your Lord is Allah, who created the heavens and earth in six days and then established Himself above the Throne. He covers the night with the day, [another night] chasing it rapidly; and [He created] the sun, the moon, and the stars, subjected by His command. Unquestionably, His is the creation and the command; blessed is Allah, Lord of the worlds
normalizedArabic: ان ربكم الله الذي خلق السموت والارض في سته ايام ثم استوي علي العرش يغشي اليل النهار يطلبه حثيثا والشمس والقمر والنجوم مسخرت بامره الا له الخلق والامر تبارك الله رب العلمين
normalizedTranslation: indeed, your lord is allah, who created the heavens and earth in six days and then established himself above the throne. he covers the night with the day, [another night] chasing it rapidly; and [he created] the sun, the moon, and the stars, subjected by his command. unquestionably, his is the creation and the command; blessed is allah, lord of the worlds

arabic: ٱدۡعُواْ رَبَّكُمۡ تَضَرُّعٗا وَخُفۡيَةًۚ إِنَّهُۥ لَا يُحِبُّ ٱلۡمُعۡتَدِينَ
translation: Call upon your Lord in humility and privately; indeed, He does not like transgressors
normalizedArabic: ادعوا ربكم تضرعا وخفيه انه لا يحب المعتدين
normalizedTranslation: call upon your lord in humility and privately; indeed, he does not like transgressors

arabic: وَلَا تُفۡسِدُواْ فِي ٱلۡأَرۡضِ بَعۡدَ إِصۡلَٰحِهَا وَٱدۡعُوهُ خَوۡفٗا وَطَمَعًاۚ إِنَّ رَحۡمَتَ ٱللَّهِ قَرِيبٞ مِّنَ ٱلۡمُحۡسِنِينَ
translation: And cause not corruption upon the earth after its reformation. And invoke Him in fear and aspiration. Indeed, the mercy of Allah is near to the doers of good
normalizedArabic: ولا تفسدوا في الارض بعد اصلحها وادعوه خوفا وطمعا ان رحمت الله قريب من المحسنين
normalizedTranslation: and cause not corruption upon the earth after its reformation. and invoke him in fear and aspiration. indeed, the mercy of allah is near to the doers of good

arabic: وَهُوَ ٱلَّذِي يُرۡسِلُ ٱلرِّيَٰحَ بُشۡرَۢا بَيۡنَ يَدَيۡ رَحۡمَتِهِۦۖ حَتَّىٰٓ إِذَآ أَقَلَّتۡ سَحَابٗا ثِقَالٗا سُقۡنَٰهُ لِبَلَدٖ مَّيِّتٖ فَأَنزَلۡنَا بِهِ ٱلۡمَآءَ فَأَخۡرَجۡنَا بِهِۦ مِن كُلِّ ٱلثَّمَرَٰتِۚ كَذَٰلِكَ نُخۡرِجُ ٱلۡمَوۡتَىٰ لَعَلَّكُمۡ تَذَكَّرُونَ
translation: And it is He who sends the winds as good tidings before His mercy until, when they have carried heavy rainclouds, We drive them to a dead land and We send down rain therein and bring forth thereby [some] of all the fruits. Thus will We bring forth the dead; perhaps you may be reminded
normalizedArabic: وهو الذي يرسل الريح بشرا بين يدي رحمته حتي اذا اقلت سحابا ثقالا سقنه لبلد ميت فانزلنا به الماء فاخرجنا به من كل الثمرت كذلك نخرج الموتي لعلكم تذكرون
normalizedTranslation: and it is he who sends the winds as good tidings before his mercy until, when they have carried heavy rainclouds, we drive them to a dead land and we send down rain therein and bring forth thereby [some] of all the fruits. thus will we bring forth the dead; perhaps you may be reminded

arabic: وَٱلۡبَلَدُ ٱلطَّيِّبُ يَخۡرُجُ نَبَاتُهُۥ بِإِذۡنِ رَبِّهِۦۖ وَٱلَّذِي خَبُثَ لَا يَخۡرُجُ إِلَّا نَكِدٗاۚ كَذَٰلِكَ نُصَرِّفُ ٱلۡأٓيَٰتِ لِقَوۡمٖ يَشۡكُرُونَ
translation: And the good land - its vegetation emerges by permission of its Lord; but that which is bad - nothing emerges except sparsely, with difficulty. Thus do We diversify the signs for a people who are grateful
normalizedArabic: والبلد الطيب يخرج نباته باذن ربه والذي خبث لا يخرج الا نكدا كذلك نصرف الايت لقوم يشكرون
normalizedTranslation: and the good land - its vegetation emerges by permission of its lord; but that which is bad - nothing emerges except sparsely, with difficulty. thus do we diversify the signs for a people who are grateful

arabic: لَقَدۡ أَرۡسَلۡنَا نُوحًا إِلَىٰ قَوۡمِهِۦ فَقَالَ يَٰقَوۡمِ ٱعۡبُدُواْ ٱللَّهَ مَا لَكُم مِّنۡ إِلَٰهٍ غَيۡرُهُۥٓ إِنِّيٓ أَخَافُ عَلَيۡكُمۡ عَذَابَ يَوۡمٍ عَظِيمٖ
translation: We had certainly sent Noah to his people, and he said, "O my people, worship Allah; you have no deity other than Him. Indeed, I fear for you the punishment of a tremendous Day
normalizedArabic: لقد ارسلنا نوحا الي قومه فقال يقوم اعبدوا الله ما لكم من اله غيره اني اخاف عليكم عذاب يوم عظيم
normalizedTranslation: we had certainly sent noah to his people, and he said, "o my people, worship allah; you have no deity other than him. indeed, i fear for you the punishment of a tremendous day

arabic: قَالَ ٱلۡمَلَأُ مِن قَوۡمِهِۦٓ إِنَّا لَنَرَىٰكَ فِي ضَلَٰلٖ مُّبِينٖ
translation: Said the eminent among his people, "Indeed, we see you in clear error
normalizedArabic: قال الملا من قومه انا لنريك في ضلل مبين
normalizedTranslation: said the eminent among his people, "indeed, we see you in clear error

arabic: قَالَ يَٰقَوۡمِ لَيۡسَ بِي ضَلَٰلَةٞ وَلَٰكِنِّي رَسُولٞ مِّن رَّبِّ ٱلۡعَٰلَمِينَ

normalizedTranslation: [noah] said, "o my people, there is not error in me, but i am a messenger from the lord of the worlds

arabic: أُبَلِّغُكُمۡ رِسَٰلَٰتِ رَبِّي وَأَنصَحُ لَكُمۡ وَأَعۡلَمُ مِنَ ٱللَّهِ مَا لَا تَعۡلَمُونَ

arabic: أَوَعَجِبۡتُمۡ أَن جَآءَكُمۡ ذِكۡرٞ مِّن رَّبِّكُمۡ عَلَىٰ رَجُلٖ مِّنكُمۡ لِيُنذِرَكُمۡ وَلِتَتَّقُواْ وَلَعَلَّكُمۡ تُرۡحَمُونَ
translation: Then do you wonder that there has come to you a reminder from your Lord through a man from among you, that he may warn you and that you may fear Allah so you might receive mercy

normalizedTranslation: then do you wonder that there has come to you a reminder from your lord through a man from among you, that he may warn you and that you may fear allah so you might receive mercy

arabic: فَكَذَّبُوهُ فَأَنجَيۡنَٰهُ وَٱلَّذِينَ مَعَهُۥ فِي ٱلۡفُلۡكِ وَأَغۡرَقۡنَا ٱلَّذِينَ كَذَّبُواْ بِـَٔايَٰتِنَآۚ إِنَّهُمۡ كَانُواْ قَوۡمًا عَمِينَ
translation: But they denied him, so We saved him and those who were with him in the ship. And We drowned those who denied Our signs. Indeed, they were a blind people

arabic: ۞وَإِلَىٰ عَادٍ أَخَاهُمۡ هُودٗاۚ قَالَ يَٰقَوۡمِ ٱعۡبُدُواْ ٱللَّهَ مَا لَكُم مِّنۡ إِلَٰهٍ غَيۡرُهُۥٓۚ أَفَلَا تَتَّقُونَ

normalizedTranslation: then do you wonder that there has come to you a reminder from your lord through a man from among you, that he may warn you? and remember when he made you successors after the people of noah and increased you in stature extensively. so remember the favors of allah that you might succeed

arabic: قَالُوٓاْ أَجِئۡتَنَا لِنَعۡبُدَ ٱللَّهَ وَحۡدَهُۥ وَنَذَرَ مَا كَانَ يَعۡبُدُ ءَابَآؤُنَا فَأۡتِنَا بِمَا تَعِدُنَآ إِن كُنتَ مِنَ ٱلصَّـٰدِقِينَ

translation: [Hud] said, "Already have defilement and anger fallen upon you from your Lord. Do you dispute with me concerning [mere] names you have named them, you and your fathers, for which Allah has not sent down any authority? Then wait; indeed, I am with you among those who wait

normalizedTranslation: [hud] said, "already have defilement and anger fallen upon you from your lord. do you dispute with me concerning [mere] names you have named them, you and your fathers, for which allah has not sent down any authority? then wait; indeed, i am with you among those who wait

arabic: فَأَنجَيۡنَٰهُ وَٱلَّذِينَ مَعَهُۥ بِرَحۡمَةٖ مِّنَّا وَقَطَعۡنَا دَابِرَ ٱلَّذِينَ كَذَّبُواْ بِـَٔايَٰتِنَاۖ وَمَا كَانُواْ مُؤۡمِنِينَ

arabic: وَإِلَىٰ ثَمُودَ أَخَاهُمۡ صَٰلِحٗاۚ قَالَ يَٰقَوۡمِ ٱعۡبُدُواْ ٱللَّهَ مَا لَكُم مِّنۡ إِلَٰهٍ غَيۡرُهُۥۖ قَدۡ جَآءَتۡكُم بَيِّنَةٞ مِّن رَّبِّكُمۡۖ هَٰذِهِۦ نَاقَةُ ٱللَّهِ لَكُمۡ ءَايَةٗۖ فَذَرُوهَا تَأۡكُلۡ فِيٓ أَرۡضِ ٱللَّهِۖ وَلَا تَمَسُّوهَا بِسُوٓءٖ فَيَأۡخُذَكُمۡ عَذَابٌ أَلِيمٞ

arabic: وَكَتَبۡنَا لَهُۥ فِي ٱلۡأَلۡوَاحِ مِن كُلِّ شَيۡءٖ مَّوۡعِظَةٗ وَتَفۡصِيلٗا لِّكُلِّ شَيۡءٖ فَخُذۡهَا بِقُوَّةٖ وَأۡمُرۡ قَوۡمَكَ يَأۡخُذُواْ بِأَحۡسَنِهَاۚ سَأُوْرِيكُمۡ دَارَ ٱلۡفَٰسِقِينَ
translation: And We wrote for him on the tablets [something] of all things - instruction and explanation for all things, [saying], "Take them with determination and order your people to take the best of it. I will show you the home of the defiantly disobedient
normalizedArabic: وكتبنا له في الالواح من كل شيء موعظه وتفصيلا لكل شيء فخذها بقوه وامر قومك ياخذوا باحسنها ساوريكم دار الفسقين
normalizedTranslation: and we wrote for him on the tablets [something] of all things - instruction and explanation for all things, [saying], "take them with determination and order your people to take the best of it. i will show you the home of the defiantly disobedient

arabic: سَأَصۡرِفُ عَنۡ ءَايَٰتِيَ ٱلَّذِينَ يَتَكَبَّرُونَ فِي ٱلۡأَرۡضِ بِغَيۡرِ ٱلۡحَقِّ وَإِن يَرَوۡاْ كُلَّ ءَايَةٖ لَّا يُؤۡمِنُواْ بِهَا وَإِن يَرَوۡاْ سَبِيلَ ٱلرُّشۡدِ لَا يَتَّخِذُوهُ سَبِيلٗا وَإِن يَرَوۡاْ سَبِيلَ ٱلۡغَيِّ يَتَّخِذُوهُ سَبِيلٗاۚ ذَٰلِكَ بِأَنَّهُمۡ كَذَّبُواْ بِـَٔايَٰتِنَا وَكَانُواْ عَنۡهَا غَٰفِلِينَ
translation: I will turn away from My signs those who are arrogant upon the earth without right; and if they should see every sign, they will not believe in it. And if they see the way of consciousness, they will not adopt it as a way; but if they see the way of error, they will adopt it as a way. That is because they have denied Our signs and they were heedless of them

arabic: وَٱلَّذِينَ كَذَّبُواْ بِـَٔايَٰتِنَا وَلِقَآءِ ٱلۡأٓخِرَةِ حَبِطَتۡ أَعۡمَٰلُهُمۡۚ هَلۡ يُجۡزَوۡنَ إِلَّا مَا كَانُواْ يَعۡمَلُونَ
translation: Those who denied Our signs and the meeting of the Hereafter - their deeds have become worthless. Are they recompensed except for what they used to do
normalizedArabic: والذين كذبوا بايتنا ولقاء الاخره حبطت اعملهم هل يجزون الا ما كانوا يعملون
normalizedTranslation: those who denied our signs and the meeting of the hereafter - their deeds have become worthless. are they recompensed except for what they used to do

arabic: وَٱتَّخَذَ قَوۡمُ مُوسَىٰ مِنۢ بَعۡدِهِۦ مِنۡ حُلِيِّهِمۡ عِجۡلٗا جَسَدٗا لَّهُۥ خُوَارٌۚ أَلَمۡ يَرَوۡاْ أَنَّهُۥ لَا يُكَلِّمُهُمۡ وَلَا يَهۡدِيهِمۡ سَبِيلًاۘ ٱتَّخَذُوهُ وَكَانُواْ ظَٰلِمِينَ
translation: And the people of Moses made, after [his departure], from their ornaments a calf - an image having a lowing sound. Did they not see that it could neither speak to them nor guide them to a way? They took it [for worship], and they were wrongdoers
normalizedArabic: واتخذ قوم موسي من بعده من حليهم عجلا جسدا له خوار الم يروا انه لا يكلمهم ولا يهديهم سبيلا اتخذوه وكانوا ظلمين
normalizedTranslation: and the people of moses made, after [his departure], from their ornaments a calf - an image having a lowing sound. did they not see that it could neither speak to them nor guide them to a way? they took it [for worship], and they were wrongdoers

arabic: وَلَمَّا سُقِطَ فِيٓ أَيۡدِيهِمۡ وَرَأَوۡاْ أَنَّهُمۡ قَدۡ ضَلُّواْ قَالُواْ لَئِن لَّمۡ يَرۡحَمۡنَا رَبُّنَا وَيَغۡفِرۡ لَنَا لَنَكُونَنَّ مِنَ ٱلۡخَٰسِرِينَ
translation: And when regret overcame them and they saw that they had gone astray, they said, "If our Lord does not have mercy upon us and forgive us, we will surely be among the losers
normalizedArabic: ولما سقط في ايديهم وراوا انهم قد ضلوا قالوا لين لم يرحمنا ربنا ويغفر لنا لنكونن من الخسرين
normalizedTranslation: and when regret overcame them and they saw that they had gone astray, they said, "if our lord does not have mercy upon us and forgive us, we will surely be among the losers

arabic: وَلَمَّا رَجَعَ مُوسَىٰٓ إِلَىٰ قَوۡمِهِۦ غَضۡبَٰنَ أَسِفٗا قَالَ بِئۡسَمَا خَلَفۡتُمُونِي مِنۢ بَعۡدِيٓۖ أَعَجِلۡتُمۡ أَمۡرَ رَبِّكُمۡۖ وَأَلۡقَى ٱلۡأَلۡوَاحَ وَأَخَذَ بِرَأۡسِ أَخِيهِ يَجُرُّهُۥٓ إِلَيۡهِۚ قَالَ ٱبۡنَ أُمَّ إِنَّ ٱلۡقَوۡمَ ٱسۡتَضۡعَفُونِي وَكَادُواْ يَقۡتُلُونَنِي فَلَا تُشۡمِتۡ بِيَ ٱلۡأَعۡدَآءَ وَلَا تَجۡعَلۡنِي مَعَ ٱلۡقَوۡمِ ٱلظَّـٰلِمِينَ
translation: And when Moses returned to his people, angry and grieved, he said, "How wretched is that by which you have replaced me after [my departure]. translation: But those who committed misdeeds and then repented after them and believed - indeed your Lord, thereafter, is Forgiving and Merciful

translation: And when the anger subsided in Moses, he took up the tablets; and in their inscription was guidance and mercy for those who are fearful of their Lord

arabic: وَٱخۡتَارَ مُوسَىٰ قَوۡمَهُۥ سَبۡعِينَ رَجُلٗا لِّمِيقَٰتِنَاۖ فَلَمَّآ أَخَذَتۡهُمُ ٱلرَّجۡفَةُ قَالَ رَبِّ لَوۡ شِئۡتَ أَهۡلَكۡتَهُم مِّن قَبۡلُ وَإِيَّـٰيَۖ أَتُهۡلِكُنَا بِمَا فَعَلَ ٱلسُّفَهَآءُ مِنَّآۖ إِنۡ هِيَ إِلَّا فِتۡنَتُكَ تُضِلُّ بِهَا مَن تَشَآءُ وَتَهۡدِي مَن تَشَآءُۖ أَنتَ وَلِيُّنَا فَٱغۡفِرۡ لَنَا وَٱرۡحَمۡنَاۖ وَأَنتَ خَيۡرُ ٱلۡغَٰفِرِينَ
translation: And Moses chose from his people seventy men for Our appointment. This is not but Your trial by which You send astray whom You will and guide whom You will. You are our Protector, so forgive us and have mercy upon us; and You are the best of forgivers

normalizedTranslation: and moses chose from his people seventy men for our appointment. and when the earthquake seized them, he said, "my lord, if you had willed, you could have destroyed them before and me [as well]. would you destroy us for what the foolish among us have done? this is not but your trial by which you send astray whom you will and guide whom you will. you are our protector, so forgive us and have mercy upon us; and you are the best of forgivers

translation: And decree for us in this world [that which is] good and [also] in the Hereafter; indeed, we have turned back to You." [Allah] said, "My punishment - I afflict with it whom I will, but My mercy encompasses all things." So I will decree it [especially] for those who fear Me and give zakah and those who believe in Our verses

arabic: ٱلَّذِينَ يَتَّبِعُونَ ٱلرَّسُولَ ٱلنَّبِيَّ ٱلۡأُمِّيَّ ٱلَّذِي يَجِدُونَهُۥ مَكۡتُوبًا عِندَهُمۡ فِي ٱلتَّوۡرَىٰةِ وَٱلۡإِنجِيلِ يَأۡمُرُهُم بِٱلۡمَعۡرُوفِ وَيَنۡهَىٰهُمۡ عَنِ ٱلۡمُنكَرِ وَيُحِلُّ لَهُمُ ٱلطَّيِّبَٰتِ وَيُحَرِّمُ عَلَيۡهِمُ ٱلۡخَبَـٰٓئِثَ وَيَضَعُ عَنۡهُمۡ إِصۡرَهُمۡ وَٱلۡأَغۡلَٰلَ ٱلَّتِي كَانَتۡ عَلَيۡهِمۡۚ فَٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُواْ بِهِۦ وَعَزَّرُوهُ وَنَصَرُوهُ وَٱتَّبَعُواْ ٱلنُّورَ ٱلَّذِيٓ أُنزِلَ مَعَهُۥٓ أُوْلَـٰٓئِكَ هُمُ ٱلۡمُفۡلِحُونَ
translation: Those who follow the Messenger, the unlettered prophet, whom they find written in what they have of the Torah and the Gospel, who enjoins upon them what is right and forbids them what is wrong and makes lawful for them the good things and prohibits for them the evil and relieves them of their burden and the shackles which were upon them. So they who have believed in him, honored him, supported him and followed the light which was sent down with him - it is those who will be the successful

normalizedTranslation: those who follow the messenger, the unlettered prophet, whom they find written in what they have of the torah and the gospel, who enjoins upon them what is right and forbids them what is wrong and makes lawful for them the good things and prohibits for them the evil and relieves them of their burden and the shackles which were upon them. so they who have believed in him, honored him, supported him and followed the light which was sent down with him - it is those who will be the successful

arabic: قُلۡ يَـٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلنَّاسُ إِنِّي رَسُولُ ٱللَّهِ إِلَيۡكُمۡ جَمِيعًا ٱلَّذِي لَهُۥ مُلۡكُ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلۡأَرۡضِۖ لَآ إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا هُوَ يُحۡيِۦ وَيُمِيتُۖ فَـَٔامِنُواْ بِٱللَّهِ وَرَسُولِهِ ٱلنَّبِيِّ ٱلۡأُمِّيِّ ٱلَّذِي يُؤۡمِنُ بِٱللَّهِ وَكَلِمَٰتِهِۦ وَٱتَّبِعُوهُ لَعَلَّكُمۡ تَهۡتَدُونَ
translation: Say, [O Muhammad], "O mankind, indeed I am the Messenger of Allah to you all, [from Him] to whom belongs the dominion of the heavens and the earth. There is no deity except Him; He gives life and causes death." So believe in Allah and His Messenger, the unlettered prophet, who believes in Allah and His words, and follow him that you may be guided
normalizedArabic: قل يايها الناس اني رسول الله اليكم جميعا الذي له ملك السموت والارض لا اله الا هو يحي ويميت فامنوا بالله ورسوله النبي الامي الذي يومن بالله وكلمته واتبعوه لعلكم تهتدون
normalizedTranslation: say, [o muhammad], "o mankind, indeed i am the messenger of allah to you all, [from him] to whom belongs the dominion of the heavens and the earth. there is no deity except him; he gives life and causes death." so believe in allah and his messenger, the unlettered prophet, who believes in allah and his words, and follow him that you may be guided

arabic: وَمِن قَوۡمِ مُوسَىٰٓ أُمَّةٞ يَهۡدُونَ بِٱلۡحَقِّ وَبِهِۦ يَعۡدِلُونَ
translation: And among the people of Moses is a community which guides by truth and by it establishes justice

normalizedTranslation: and among the people of moses is a community which guides by truth and by it establishes justice

arabic: وَقَطَّعۡنَٰهُمُ ٱثۡنَتَيۡ عَشۡرَةَ أَسۡبَاطًا أُمَمٗاۚ وَأَوۡحَيۡنَآ إِلَىٰ مُوسَىٰٓ إِذِ ٱسۡتَسۡقَىٰهُ قَوۡمُهُۥٓ أَنِ ٱضۡرِب بِّعَصَاكَ ٱلۡحَجَرَۖ فَٱنۢبَجَسَتۡ مِنۡهُ ٱثۡنَتَا عَشۡرَةَ عَيۡنٗاۖ قَدۡ عَلِمَ كُلُّ أُنَاسٖ مَّشۡرَبَهُمۡۚ وَظَلَّلۡنَا عَلَيۡهِمُ ٱلۡغَمَٰمَ وَأَنزَلۡنَا عَلَيۡهِمُ ٱلۡمَنَّ وَٱلسَّلۡوَىٰۖ كُلُواْ مِن طَيِّبَٰتِ مَا رَزَقۡنَٰكُمۡۚ وَمَا ظَلَمُونَا وَلَٰكِن كَانُوٓاْ أَنفُسَهُمۡ يَظۡلِمُونَ
translation: And We divided them into twelve descendant tribes [as distinct] nations. And We inspired to Moses when his people implored him for water, "Strike with your staff the stone," and there gushed forth from it twelve springs. Every people knew its watering place. And We shaded them with clouds and sent down upon them manna and quails, [saying], "Eat from the good things with which We have provided you." And they wronged Us not, but they were [only] wronging themselves
normalizedArabic: وقطعنهم اثنتي عشره اسباطا امما واوحينا الي موسي اذ استسقيه قومه ان اضرب بعصاك الحجر فانبجست منه اثنتا عشره عينا قد علم كل اناس مشربهم وظللنا عليهم الغمم وانزلنا عليهم المن والسلوي كلوا من طيبت ما رزقنكم وما ظلمونا ولكن كانوا انفسهم يظلمون
normalizedTranslation: and we divided them into twelve descendant tribes [as distinct] nations. and we inspired to moses when his people implored him for water, "strike with your staff the stone," and there gushed forth from it twelve springs. every people knew its watering place. and we shaded them with clouds and sent down upon them manna and quails, [saying], "eat from the good things with which we have provided you." and they wronged us not, but they were [only] wronging themselves

arabic: وَإِذۡ قِيلَ لَهُمُ ٱسۡكُنُواْ هَٰذِهِ ٱلۡقَرۡيَةَ وَكُلُواْ مِنۡهَا حَيۡثُ شِئۡتُمۡ وَقُولُواْ حِطَّةٞ وَٱدۡخُلُواْ ٱلۡبَابَ سُجَّدٗا نَّغۡفِرۡ لَكُمۡ خَطِيٓـَٰٔتِكُمۡۚ سَنَزِيدُ ٱلۡمُحۡسِنِينَ
translation: And [mention, O Muhammad], when it was said to them, "Dwell in this city and eat from it wherever you will and say, 'Relieve us of our burdens,' and enter the gate bowing humbly; We will [then] forgive you your sins. We will increase the doers of good [in goodness and reward]
normalizedArabic: واذ قيل لهم اسكنوا هذه القريه وكلوا منها حيث شيتم وقولوا حطه وادخلوا الباب سجدا نغفر لكم خطيتكم سنزيد المحسنين
normalizedTranslation: and [mention, o muhammad], when it was said to them, "dwell in this city and eat from it wherever you will and say, 'relieve us of our burdens,' and enter the gate bowing humbly; we will [then] forgive you your sins. we will increase the doers of good [in goodness and reward]

arabic: فَبَدَّلَ ٱلَّذِينَ ظَلَمُواْ مِنۡهُمۡ قَوۡلًا غَيۡرَ ٱلَّذِي قِيلَ لَهُمۡ فَأَرۡسَلۡنَا عَلَيۡهِمۡ رِجۡزٗا مِّنَ ٱلسَّمَآءِ بِمَا كَانُواْ يَظۡلِمُونَ
translation: But those who wronged among them changed [the words] to a statement other than that which had been said to them. So We sent upon them a punishment from the sky for the wrong that they were doing
normalizedArabic: فبدل الذين ظلموا منهم قولا غير الذي قيل لهم فارسلنا عليهم رجزا من السماء بما كانوا يظلمون
normalizedTranslation: but those who wronged among them changed [the words] to a statement other than that which had been said to them. so we sent upon them a punishment from the sky for the wrong that they were doing

arabic: وَسۡـَٔلۡهُمۡ عَنِ ٱلۡقَرۡيَةِ ٱلَّتِي كَانَتۡ حَاضِرَةَ ٱلۡبَحۡرِ إِذۡ يَعۡدُونَ فِي ٱلسَّبۡتِ إِذۡ تَأۡتِيهِمۡ حِيتَانُهُمۡ يَوۡمَ سَبۡتِهِمۡ شُرَّعٗا وَيَوۡمَ لَا يَسۡبِتُونَ لَا تَأۡتِيهِمۡۚ كَذَٰلِكَ نَبۡلُوهُم بِمَا كَانُواْ يَفۡسُقُونَ
translation: And ask them about the town that was by the sea - when they transgressed in [the matter of] the sabbath - when their fish came to them openly on their sabbath day, and the day they had no sabbath they did not come to them. Thus did We give them trial because they were defiantly disobedient
normalizedArabic: وسلهم عن القريه التي كانت حاضره البحر اذ يعدون في السبت اذ تاتيهم حيتانهم يوم سبتهم شرعا ويوم لا يسبتون لا تاتيهم كذلك نبلوهم بما كانوا يفسقون
normalizedTranslation: and ask them about the town that was by the sea - when they transgressed in [the matter of] the sabbath - when their fish came to them openly on their sabbath day, and the day they had no sabbath they did not come to them. thus did we give them trial because they were defiantly disobedient

arabic: وَإِذۡ قَالَتۡ أُمَّةٞ مِّنۡهُمۡ لِمَ تَعِظُونَ قَوۡمًا ٱللَّهُ مُهۡلِكُهُمۡ أَوۡ مُعَذِّبُهُمۡ عَذَابٗا شَدِيدٗاۖ قَالُواْ مَعۡذِرَةً إِلَىٰ رَبِّكُمۡ وَلَعَلَّهُمۡ يَتَّقُونَ
translation: And when a community among them said, "Why do you advise [or warn] a people whom Allah is [about] to destroy or to punish with a severe punishment?" they [the advisors] said, "To be absolved before your Lord and perhaps they may fear Him
normalizedArabic: واذ قالت امه منهم لم تعظون قوما الله مهلكهم او معذبهم عذابا شديدا قالوا معذره الي ربكم ولعلهم يتقون
normalizedTranslation: and when a community among them said, "why do you advise [or warn] a people whom allah is [about] to destroy or to punish with a severe punishment?" they [the advisors] said, "to be absolved before your lord and perhaps they may fear him

arabic: فَلَمَّا نَسُواْ مَا ذُكِّرُواْ بِهِۦٓ أَنجَيۡنَا ٱلَّذِينَ يَنۡهَوۡنَ عَنِ ٱلسُّوٓءِ وَأَخَذۡنَا ٱلَّذِينَ ظَلَمُواْ بِعَذَابِۭ بَـِٔيسِۭ بِمَا كَانُواْ يَفۡسُقُونَ
translation: And when they forgot that by which they had been reminded, We saved those who had forbidden evil and seized those who wronged, with a wretched punishment, because they were defiantly disobeying
normalizedArabic: فلما نسوا ما ذكروا به انجينا الذين ينهون عن السوء واخذنا الذين ظلموا بعذاب بيس بما كانوا يفسقون
normalizedTranslation: and when they forgot that by which they had been reminded, we saved those who had forbidden evil and seized those who wronged, with a wretched punishment, because they were defiantly disobeying

arabic: فَلَمَّا عَتَوۡاْ عَن مَّا نُهُواْ عَنۡهُ قُلۡنَا لَهُمۡ كُونُواْ قِرَدَةً خَٰسِـِٔينَ
translation: So when they were insolent about that which they had been forbidden, We said to them, "Be apes, despised
normalizedArabic: فلما عتوا عن ما نهوا عنه قلنا لهم كونوا قرده خسين
normalizedTranslation: so when they were insolent about that which they had been forbidden, we said to them, "be apes, despised

arabic: وَإِذۡ تَأَذَّنَ رَبُّكَ لَيَبۡعَثَنَّ عَلَيۡهِمۡ إِلَىٰ يَوۡمِ ٱلۡقِيَٰمَةِ مَن يَسُومُهُمۡ سُوٓءَ ٱلۡعَذَابِۗ إِنَّ رَبَّكَ لَسَرِيعُ ٱلۡعِقَابِ وَإِنَّهُۥ لَغَفُورٞ رَّحِيمٞ
translation: And [mention] when your Lord declared that He would surely [continue to] send upon them until the Day of Resurrection those who would afflict them with the worst torment. Indeed, your Lord is swift in penalty; but indeed, He is Forgiving and Merciful
normalizedArabic: واذ تاذن ربك ليبعثن عليهم الي يوم القيمه من يسومهم سوء العذاب ان ربك لسريع العقاب وانه لغفور رحيم
normalizedTranslation: and [mention] when your lord declared that he would surely [continue to] send upon them until the day of resurrection those who would afflict them with the worst torment. indeed, your lord is swift in penalty; but indeed, he is forgiving and merciful

arabic: وَقَطَّعۡنَٰهُمۡ فِي ٱلۡأَرۡضِ أُمَمٗاۖ مِّنۡهُمُ ٱلصَّـٰلِحُونَ وَمِنۡهُمۡ دُونَ ذَٰلِكَۖ وَبَلَوۡنَٰهُم بِٱلۡحَسَنَٰتِ وَٱلسَّيِّـَٔاتِ لَعَلَّهُمۡ يَرۡجِعُونَ
translation: And We divided them throughout the earth into nations. Of them some were righteous, and of them some were otherwise. And We tested them with good [times] and bad that perhaps they would return [to obedience]
normalizedArabic: وقطعنهم في الارض امما منهم الصلحون ومنهم دون ذلك وبلونهم بالحسنت والسيات لعلهم يرجعون
normalizedTranslation: and we divided them throughout the earth into nations. of them some were righteous, and of them some were otherwise. and we tested them with good [times] and bad that perhaps they would return [to obedience]

arabic: فَخَلَفَ مِنۢ بَعۡدِهِمۡ خَلۡفٞ وَرِثُواْ ٱلۡكِتَٰبَ يَأۡخُذُونَ عَرَضَ هَٰذَا ٱلۡأَدۡنَىٰ وَيَقُولُونَ سَيُغۡفَرُ لَنَا وَإِن يَأۡتِهِمۡ عَرَضٞ مِّثۡلُهُۥ يَأۡخُذُوهُۚ أَلَمۡ يُؤۡخَذۡ عَلَيۡهِم مِّيثَٰقُ ٱلۡكِتَٰبِ أَن لَّا يَقُولُواْ عَلَى ٱللَّهِ إِلَّا ٱلۡحَقَّ وَدَرَسُواْ مَا فِيهِۗ وَٱلدَّارُ ٱلۡأٓخِرَةُ خَيۡرٞ لِّلَّذِينَ يَتَّقُونَۚ أَفَلَا تَعۡقِلُونَ
translation: And there followed them successors who inherited the Scripture [while] taking the commodities of this lower life and saying, "It will be forgiven for us." And if an offer like it comes to them, they will [again] take it. Was not the covenant of the Scripture taken from them that they would not say about Allah except the truth, and they studied what was in it? And the home of the Hereafter is better for those who fear Allah, so will you not use reason

arabic: وَٱلَّذِينَ يُمَسِّكُونَ بِٱلۡكِتَٰبِ وَأَقَامُواْ ٱلصَّلَوٰةَ إِنَّا لَا نُضِيعُ أَجۡرَ ٱلۡمُصۡلِحِينَ
translation: But those who hold fast to the Book and establish prayer - indeed, We will not allow to be lost the reward of the reformers

arabic: ۞وَإِذۡ نَتَقۡنَا ٱلۡجَبَلَ فَوۡقَهُمۡ كَأَنَّهُۥ ظُلَّةٞ وَظَنُّوٓاْ أَنَّهُۥ وَاقِعُۢ بِهِمۡ خُذُواْ مَآ ءَاتَيۡنَٰكُم بِقُوَّةٖ وَٱذۡكُرُواْ مَا فِيهِ لَعَلَّكُمۡ تَتَّقُونَ
translation: And [mention] when We raised the mountain above them as if it was a dark cloud and they were certain that it would fall upon them, [and Allah said], "Take what We have given you with determination and remember what is in it that you might fear Allah

translation: And [mention] when your Lord took from the children of Adam - from their loins - their descendants and made them testify of themselves, [saying to them], "Am I not your Lord?" They said, "Yes, we have testified." [This] - lest you should say on the day of Resurrection, "Indeed, we were of this unaware

arabic: وَٱتۡلُ عَلَيۡهِمۡ نَبَأَ ٱلَّذِيٓ ءَاتَيۡنَٰهُ ءَايَٰتِنَا فَٱنسَلَخَ مِنۡهَا فَأَتۡبَعَهُ ٱلشَّيۡطَٰنُ فَكَانَ مِنَ ٱلۡغَاوِينَ
translation: And recite to them, [O Muhammad], the news of him to whom we gave [knowledge of] Our signs, but he detached himself from them; so Satan pursued him, and he became of the deviators

arabic: وَلَوۡ شِئۡنَا لَرَفَعۡنَٰهُ بِهَا وَلَٰكِنَّهُۥٓ أَخۡلَدَ إِلَى ٱلۡأَرۡضِ وَٱتَّبَعَ هَوَىٰهُۚ فَمَثَلُهُۥ كَمَثَلِ ٱلۡكَلۡبِ إِن تَحۡمِلۡ عَلَيۡهِ يَلۡهَثۡ أَوۡ تَتۡرُكۡهُ يَلۡهَثۚ ذَّـٰلِكَ مَثَلُ ٱلۡقَوۡمِ ٱلَّذِينَ كَذَّبُواْ بِـَٔايَٰتِنَاۚ فَٱقۡصُصِ ٱلۡقَصَصَ لَعَلَّهُمۡ يَتَفَكَّرُونَ
translation: And if We had willed, we could have elevated him thereby, but he adhered [instead] to the earth and followed his own desire. arabic: مَن يَهۡدِ ٱللَّهُ فَهُوَ ٱلۡمُهۡتَدِيۖ وَمَن يُضۡلِلۡ فَأُوْلَـٰٓئِكَ هُمُ ٱلۡخَٰسِرُونَ

translation: And We have certainly created for Hell many of the jinn and mankind. normalizedArabic: ولقد ذرانا لجهنم كثيرا من الجن والانس لهم قلوب لا يفقهون بها ولهم اعين لا يبصرون بها ولهم ءاذان لا يسمعون بها اوليك كالانعم بل هم اضل اوليك هم الغفلون
normalizedTranslation: and we have certainly created for hell many of the jinn and mankind. they have hearts with which they do not understand, they have eyes with which they do not see, and they have ears with which they do not hear. those are like livestock; rather, they are more astray. it is they who are the heedless

arabic: وَلِلَّهِ ٱلۡأَسۡمَآءُ ٱلۡحُسۡنَىٰ فَٱدۡعُوهُ بِهَاۖ وَذَرُواْ ٱلَّذِينَ يُلۡحِدُونَ فِيٓ أَسۡمَـٰٓئِهِۦۚ سَيُجۡزَوۡنَ مَا كَانُواْ يَعۡمَلُونَ
translation: And to Allah belong the best names, so invoke Him by them. And leave [the company of] those who practice deviation concerning His names. They will be recompensed for what they have been doing
normalizedArabic: ولله الاسماء الحسني فادعوه بها وذروا الذين يلحدون في اسميه سيجزون ما كانوا يعملون
normalizedTranslation: and to allah belong the best names, so invoke him by them. and leave [the company of] those who practice deviation concerning his names. they will be recompensed for what they have been doing

arabic: وَمِمَّنۡ خَلَقۡنَآ أُمَّةٞ يَهۡدُونَ بِٱلۡحَقِّ وَبِهِۦ يَعۡدِلُونَ
translation: And among those We created is a community which guides by truth and thereby establishes justice
normalizedArabic: وممن خلقنا امه يهدون بالحق وبه يعدلون
normalizedTranslation: and among those we created is a community which guides by truth and thereby establishes justice

arabic: وَٱلَّذِينَ كَذَّبُواْ بِـَٔايَٰتِنَا سَنَسۡتَدۡرِجُهُم مِّنۡ حَيۡثُ لَا يَعۡلَمُونَ
translation: But those who deny Our signs - We will progressively lead them [to destruction] from where they do not know
normalizedArabic: والذين كذبوا بايتنا سنستدرجهم من حيث لا يعلمون
normalizedTranslation: but those who deny our signs - we will progressively lead them [to destruction] from where they do not know

arabic: وَأُمۡلِي لَهُمۡۚ إِنَّ كَيۡدِي مَتِينٌ
translation: And I will give them time. Indeed, my plan is firm
normalizedArabic: واملي لهم ان كيدي متين
normalizedTranslation: and i will give them time. indeed, my plan is firm

arabic: أَوَلَمۡ يَتَفَكَّرُواْۗ مَا بِصَاحِبِهِم مِّن جِنَّةٍۚ إِنۡ هُوَ إِلَّا نَذِيرٞ مُّبِينٌ
translation: Then do they not give thought? There is in their companion [Muhammad] no madness. He is not but a clear warner
normalizedArabic: اولم يتفكروا ما بصاحبهم من جنه ان هو الا نذير مبين
normalizedTranslation: then do they not give thought? there is in their companion [muhammad] no madness. he is not but a clear warner

arabic: أَوَلَمۡ يَنظُرُواْ فِي مَلَكُوتِ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلۡأَرۡضِ وَمَا خَلَقَ ٱللَّهُ مِن شَيۡءٖ وَأَنۡ عَسَىٰٓ أَن يَكُونَ قَدِ ٱقۡتَرَبَ أَجَلُهُمۡۖ فَبِأَيِّ حَدِيثِۭ بَعۡدَهُۥ يُؤۡمِنُونَ
translation: Do they not look into the realm of the heavens and the earth and everything that Allah has created and [think] that perhaps their appointed time has come near? So in what statement hereafter will they believe
normalizedArabic: اولم ينظروا في ملكوت السموت والارض وما خلق الله من شيء وان عسي ان يكون قد اقترب اجلهم فباي حديث بعده يومنون
normalizedTranslation: do they not look into the realm of the heavens and the earth and everything that allah has created and [think] that perhaps their appointed time has come near? so in what statement hereafter will they believe

arabic: مَن يُضۡلِلِ ٱللَّهُ فَلَا هَادِيَ لَهُۥۚ وَيَذَرُهُمۡ فِي طُغۡيَٰنِهِمۡ يَعۡمَهُونَ
translation: Whoever Allah sends astray - there is no guide for him. And He leaves them in their transgression, wandering blindly
normalizedArabic: من يضلل الله فلا هادي له ويذرهم في طغينهم يعمهون
normalizedTranslation: whoever allah sends astray - there is no guide for him. and he leaves them in their transgression, wandering blindly

arabic: يَسۡـَٔلُونَكَ عَنِ ٱلسَّاعَةِ أَيَّانَ مُرۡسَىٰهَاۖ قُلۡ إِنَّمَا عِلۡمُهَا عِندَ رَبِّيۖ لَا يُجَلِّيهَا لِوَقۡتِهَآ إِلَّا هُوَۚ ثَقُلَتۡ فِي ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلۡأَرۡضِۚ لَا تَأۡتِيكُمۡ إِلَّا بَغۡتَةٗۗ يَسۡـَٔلُونَكَ كَأَنَّكَ حَفِيٌّ عَنۡهَاۖ قُلۡ إِنَّمَا عِلۡمُهَا عِندَ ٱللَّهِ وَلَٰكِنَّ أَكۡثَرَ ٱلنَّاسِ لَا يَعۡلَمُونَ
translation: They ask you, [O Muhammad], about the Hour: when is its arrival? Say, "Its knowledge is only with my Lord. None will reveal its time except Him. It lays heavily upon the heavens and the earth. It will not come upon you except unexpectedly." They ask you as if you are familiar with it. Say, "Its knowledge is only with Allah, but most of the people do not know
normalizedArabic: يسلونك عن الساعه ايان مرسيها قل انما علمها عند ربي لا يجليها لوقتها الا هو ثقلت في السموت والارض لا تاتيكم الا بغته يسلونك كانك حفي عنها قل انما علمها عند الله ولكن اكثر الناس لا يعلمون
normalizedTranslation: they ask you, [o muhammad], about the hour: when is its arrival? say, "its knowledge is only with my lord. none will reveal its time except him. it lays heavily upon the heavens and the earth. it will not come upon you except unexpectedly." they ask you as if you are familiar with it. say, "its knowledge is only with allah, but most of the people do not know

arabic: قُل لَّآ أَمۡلِكُ لِنَفۡسِي نَفۡعٗا وَلَا ضَرًّا إِلَّا مَا شَآءَ ٱللَّهُۚ وَلَوۡ كُنتُ أَعۡلَمُ ٱلۡغَيۡبَ لَٱسۡتَكۡثَرۡتُ مِنَ ٱلۡخَيۡرِ وَمَا مَسَّنِيَ ٱلسُّوٓءُۚ إِنۡ أَنَا۠ إِلَّا نَذِيرٞ وَبَشِيرٞ لِّقَوۡمٖ يُؤۡمِنُونَ
translation: Say, "I hold not for myself [the power of] benefit or harm, except what Allah has willed. And if I knew the unseen, I could have acquired much wealth, and no harm would have touched me. I am not except a warner and a bringer of good tidings to a people who believe
normalizedArabic: قل لا املك لنفسي نفعا ولا ضرا الا ما شاء الله ولو كنت اعلم الغيب لاستكثرت من الخير وما مسني السوء ان انا الا نذير وبشير لقوم يومنون
normalizedTranslation: say, "i hold not for myself [the power of] benefit or harm, except what allah has willed. and if i knew the unseen, i could have acquired much wealth, and no harm would have touched me. i am not except a warner and a bringer of good tidings to a people who believe

arabic: ۞هُوَ ٱلَّذِي خَلَقَكُم مِّن نَّفۡسٖ وَٰحِدَةٖ وَجَعَلَ مِنۡهَا زَوۡجَهَا لِيَسۡكُنَ إِلَيۡهَاۖ فَلَمَّا تَغَشَّىٰهَا حَمَلَتۡ حَمۡلًا خَفِيفٗا فَمَرَّتۡ بِهِۦۖ فَلَمَّآ أَثۡقَلَت دَّعَوَا ٱللَّهَ رَبَّهُمَا لَئِنۡ ءَاتَيۡتَنَا صَٰلِحٗا لَّنَكُونَنَّ مِنَ ٱلشَّـٰكِرِينَ
translation: It is He who created you from one soul and created from it its mate that he might dwell in security with her. And when he covers her, she carries a light burden and continues therein. And when it becomes heavy, they both invoke Allah, their Lord, "If You should give us a good [child], we will surely be among the grateful
normalizedArabic: هو الذي خلقكم من نفس وحده وجعل منها زوجها ليسكن اليها فلما تغشيها حملت حملا خفيفا فمرت به فلما اثقلت دعوا الله ربهما لين ءاتيتنا صلحا لنكونن من الشكرين
normalizedTranslation: it is he who created you from one soul and created from it its mate that he might dwell in security with her. and when he covers her, she carries a light burden and continues therein. and when it becomes heavy, they both invoke allah, their lord, "if you should give us a good [child], we will surely be among the grateful

arabic: فَلَمَّآ ءَاتَىٰهُمَا صَٰلِحٗا جَعَلَا لَهُۥ شُرَكَآءَ فِيمَآ ءَاتَىٰهُمَاۚ فَتَعَٰلَى ٱللَّهُ عَمَّا يُشۡرِكُونَ
translation: But when He gives them a good [child], they ascribe partners to Him concerning that which He has given them. Exalted is Allah above what they associate with Him
normalizedArabic: فلما ءاتيهما صلحا جعلا له شركاء فيما ءاتيهما فتعلي الله عما يشركون
normalizedTranslation: but when he gives them a good [child], they ascribe partners to him concerning that which he has given them. exalted is allah above what they associate with him

arabic: أَيُشۡرِكُونَ مَا لَا يَخۡلُقُ شَيۡـٔٗا وَهُمۡ يُخۡلَقُونَ
translation: Do they associate with Him those who create nothing and they are [themselves] created
normalizedArabic: ايشركون ما لا يخلق شيا وهم يخلقون
normalizedTranslation: do they associate with him those who create nothing and they are [themselves] created

arabic: وَلَا يَسۡتَطِيعُونَ لَهُمۡ نَصۡرٗا وَلَآ أَنفُسَهُمۡ يَنصُرُونَ
translation: And the false deities are unable to [give] them help, nor can they help themselves
normalizedArabic: ولا يستطيعون لهم نصرا ولا انفسهم ينصرون
normalizedTranslation: and the false deities are unable to [give] them help, nor can they help themselves

arabic: وَإِن تَدۡعُوهُمۡ إِلَى ٱلۡهُدَىٰ لَا يَتَّبِعُوكُمۡۚ سَوَآءٌ عَلَيۡكُمۡ أَدَعَوۡتُمُوهُمۡ أَمۡ أَنتُمۡ صَٰمِتُونَ
translation: And if you [believers] invite them to guidance, they will not follow you. It is all the same for you whether you invite them or you are silent
normalizedArabic: وان تدعوهم الي الهدي لا يتبعوكم سواء عليكم ادعوتموهم ام انتم صمتون
normalizedTranslation: and if you [believers] invite them to guidance, they will not follow you. it is all the same for you whether you invite them or you are silent

arabic: إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ تَدۡعُونَ مِن دُونِ ٱللَّهِ عِبَادٌ أَمۡثَالُكُمۡۖ فَٱدۡعُوهُمۡ فَلۡيَسۡتَجِيبُواْ لَكُمۡ إِن كُنتُمۡ صَٰدِقِينَ
translation: Indeed, those you [polytheists] call upon besides Allah are servants like you. So call upon them and let them respond to you, if you should be truthful
normalizedArabic: ان الذين تدعون من دون الله عباد امثالكم فادعوهم فليستجيبوا لكم ان كنتم صدقين
normalizedTranslation: indeed, those you [polytheists] call upon besides allah are servants like you. so call upon them and let them respond to you, if you should be truthful

arabic: أَلَهُمۡ أَرۡجُلٞ يَمۡشُونَ بِهَآۖ أَمۡ لَهُمۡ أَيۡدٖ يَبۡطِشُونَ بِهَآۖ أَمۡ لَهُمۡ أَعۡيُنٞ يُبۡصِرُونَ بِهَآۖ أَمۡ لَهُمۡ ءَاذَانٞ يَسۡمَعُونَ بِهَاۗ قُلِ ٱدۡعُواْ شُرَكَآءَكُمۡ ثُمَّ كِيدُونِ فَلَا تُنظِرُونِ
translation: Do they have feet by which they walk? Or do they have hands by which they strike? Or do they have eyes by which they see? Or do they have ears by which they hear? Say, [O Muhammad], "Call your 'partners' and then conspire against me and give me no respite
normalizedArabic: الهم ارجل يمشون بها ام لهم ايد يبطشون بها ام لهم اعين يبصرون بها ام لهم ءاذان يسمعون بها قل ادعوا شركاءكم ثم كيدون فلا تنظرون
normalizedTranslation: do they have feet by which they walk? or do they have hands by which they strike? or do they have eyes by which they see? or do they have ears by which they hear? say, [o muhammad], "call your 'partners' and then conspire against me and give me no respite

arabic: إِنَّ وَلِـِّۧيَ ٱللَّهُ ٱلَّذِي نَزَّلَ ٱلۡكِتَٰبَۖ وَهُوَ يَتَوَلَّى ٱلصَّـٰلِحِينَ
translation: Indeed, my protector is Allah, who has sent down the Book; and He is an ally to the righteous
normalizedArabic: ان ولي الله الذي نزل الكتب وهو يتولي الصلحين
normalizedTranslation: indeed, my protector is allah, who has sent down the book; and he is an ally to the righteous

arabic: وَٱلَّذِينَ تَدۡعُونَ مِن دُونِهِۦ لَا يَسۡتَطِيعُونَ نَصۡرَكُمۡ وَلَآ أَنفُسَهُمۡ يَنصُرُونَ
translation: And those you call upon besides Him are unable to help you, nor can they help themselves
normalizedArabic: والذين تدعون من دونه لا يستطيعون نصركم ولا انفسهم ينصرون
normalizedTranslation: and those you call upon besides him are unable to help you, nor can they help themselves

arabic: وَإِن تَدۡعُوهُمۡ إِلَى ٱلۡهُدَىٰ لَا يَسۡمَعُواْۖ وَتَرَىٰهُمۡ يَنظُرُونَ إِلَيۡكَ وَهُمۡ لَا يُبۡصِرُونَ
translation: And if you invite them to guidance, they do not hear; and you see them looking at you while they do not see
normalizedArabic: وان تدعوهم الي الهدي لا يسمعوا وتريهم ينظرون اليك وهم لا يبصرون
normalizedTranslation: and if you invite them to guidance, they do not hear; and you see them looking at you while they do not see

arabic: خُذِ ٱلۡعَفۡوَ وَأۡمُرۡ بِٱلۡعُرۡفِ وَأَعۡرِضۡ عَنِ ٱلۡجَٰهِلِينَ
translation: Take what is given freely, enjoin what is good, and turn away from the ignorant
normalizedArabic: خذ العفو وامر بالعرف واعرض عن الجهلين
normalizedTranslation: take what is given freely, enjoin what is good, and turn away from the ignorant

arabic: وَإِمَّا يَنزَغَنَّكَ مِنَ ٱلشَّيۡطَٰنِ نَزۡغٞ فَٱسۡتَعِذۡ بِٱللَّهِۚ إِنَّهُۥ سَمِيعٌ عَلِيمٌ
translation: And if an evil suggestion comes to you from Satan, then seek refuge in Allah. Indeed, He is Hearing and Knowing
normalizedArabic: واما ينزغنك من الشيطن نزغ فاستعذ بالله انه سميع عليم
normalizedTranslation: and if an evil suggestion comes to you from satan, then seek refuge in allah. indeed, he is hearing and knowing

arabic: إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ ٱتَّقَوۡاْ إِذَا مَسَّهُمۡ طَـٰٓئِفٞ مِّنَ ٱلشَّيۡطَٰنِ تَذَكَّرُواْ فَإِذَا هُم مُّبۡصِرُونَ
translation: Indeed, those who fear Allah - when an impulse touches them from Satan, they remember [Him] and at once they have insight
normalizedArabic: ان الذين اتقوا اذا مسهم طيف من الشيطن تذكروا فاذا هم مبصرون
normalizedTranslation: indeed, those who fear allah - when an impulse touches them from satan, they remember [him] and at once they have insight

arabic: وَإِخۡوَٰنُهُمۡ يَمُدُّونَهُمۡ فِي ٱلۡغَيِّ ثُمَّ لَا يُقۡصِرُونَ
translation: But their brothers - the devils increase them in error; then they do not stop short
normalizedArabic: واخونهم يمدونهم في الغي ثم لا يقصرون
normalizedTranslation: but their brothers - the devils increase them in error; then they do not stop short

arabic: وَإِذَا لَمۡ تَأۡتِهِم بِـَٔايَةٖ قَالُواْ لَوۡلَا ٱجۡتَبَيۡتَهَاۚ قُلۡ إِنَّمَآ أَتَّبِعُ مَا يُوحَىٰٓ إِلَيَّ مِن رَّبِّيۚ هَٰذَا بَصَآئِرُ مِن رَّبِّكُمۡ وَهُدٗى وَرَحۡمَةٞ لِّقَوۡمٖ يُؤۡمِنُونَ
translation: And when you, [O Muhammad], do not bring them a sign, they say, "Why have you not contrived it?" Say, "I only follow what is revealed to me from my Lord. This [Qur'an] is enlightenment from your Lord and guidance and mercy for a people who believe
normalizedArabic: واذا لم تاتهم بايه قالوا لولا اجتبيتها قل انما اتبع ما يوحي الي من ربي هذا بصاير من ربكم وهدي ورحمه لقوم يومنون
normalizedTranslation: and when you, [o muhammad], do not bring them a sign, they say, "why have you not contrived it?" say, "i only follow what is revealed to me from my lord. this [qur'an] is enlightenment from your lord and guidance and mercy for a people who believe

arabic: وَإِذَا قُرِئَ ٱلۡقُرۡءَانُ فَٱسۡتَمِعُواْ لَهُۥ وَأَنصِتُواْ لَعَلَّكُمۡ تُرۡحَمُونَ
translation: So when the Qur'an is recited, then listen to it and pay attention that you may receive mercy
normalizedArabic: واذا قري القرءان فاستمعوا له وانصتوا لعلكم ترحمون
normalizedTranslation: so when the qur'an is recited, then listen to it and pay attention that you may receive mercy

arabic: وَٱذۡكُر رَّبَّكَ فِي نَفۡسِكَ تَضَرُّعٗا وَخِيفَةٗ وَدُونَ ٱلۡجَهۡرِ مِنَ ٱلۡقَوۡلِ بِٱلۡغُدُوِّ وَٱلۡأٓصَالِ وَلَا تَكُن مِّنَ ٱلۡغَٰفِلِينَ
translation: And remember your Lord within yourself in humility and in fear without being apparent in speech - in the mornings and the evenings. And do not be among the heedless
normalizedArabic: واذكر ربك في نفسك تضرعا وخيفه ودون الجهر من القول بالغدو والاصال ولا تكن من الغفلين
normalizedTranslation: and remember your lord within yourself in humility and in fear without being apparent in speech - in the mornings and the evenings. and do not be among the heedless

arabic: إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ عِندَ رَبِّكَ لَا يَسۡتَكۡبِرُونَ عَنۡ عِبَادَتِهِۦ وَيُسَبِّحُونَهُۥ وَلَهُۥ يَسۡجُدُونَۤ۩
translation: Indeed, those who are near your Lord are not prevented by arrogance from His worship, and they exalt Him, and to Him they prostrate
normalizedArabic: ان الذين عند ربك لا يستكبرون عن عبادته ويسبحونه وله يسجدون
normalizedTranslation: indeed, those who are near your lord are not prevented by arrogance from his worship, and they exalt him, and to him they prostrate

arabic: يَسۡـَٔلُونَكَ عَنِ ٱلۡأَنفَالِۖ قُلِ ٱلۡأَنفَالُ لِلَّهِ وَٱلرَّسُولِۖ فَٱتَّقُواْ ٱللَّهَ وَأَصۡلِحُواْ ذَاتَ بَيۡنِكُمۡۖ وَأَطِيعُواْ ٱللَّهَ وَرَسُولَهُۥٓ إِن كُنتُم مُّؤۡمِنِينَ
translation: They ask you, [O Muhammad], about the bounties [of war]. Say, "The [decision concerning] bounties is for Allah and the Messenger." So fear Allah and amend that which is between you and obey Allah and His Messenger, if you should be believers
normalizedArabic: يسلونك عن الانفال قل الانفال لله والرسول فاتقوا الله واصلحوا ذات بينكم واطيعوا الله ورسوله ان كنتم مومنين
normalizedTranslation: they ask you, [o muhammad], about the bounties [of war]. say, "the [decision concerning] bounties is for allah and the messenger." so fear allah and amend that which is between you and obey allah and his messenger, if you should be believers

arabic: إِنَّمَا ٱلۡمُؤۡمِنُونَ ٱلَّذِينَ إِذَا ذُكِرَ ٱللَّهُ وَجِلَتۡ قُلُوبُهُمۡ وَإِذَا تُلِيَتۡ عَلَيۡهِمۡ ءَايَٰتُهُۥ زَادَتۡهُمۡ إِيمَٰنٗا وَعَلَىٰ رَبِّهِمۡ يَتَوَكَّلُونَ
translation: The believers are only those who, when Allah is mentioned, their hearts become fearful, and when His verses are recited to them, it increases them in faith; and upon their Lord they rely
normalizedArabic: انما المومنون الذين اذا ذكر الله وجلت قلوبهم واذا تليت عليهم ءايته زادتهم ايمنا وعلي ربهم يتوكلون
normalizedTranslation: the believers are only those who, when allah is mentioned, their hearts become fearful, and when his verses are recited to them, it increases them in faith; and upon their lord they rely

arabic: ٱلَّذِينَ يُقِيمُونَ ٱلصَّلَوٰةَ وَمِمَّا رَزَقۡنَٰهُمۡ يُنفِقُونَ
translation: The ones who establish prayer, and from what We have provided them, they spend
normalizedArabic: الذين يقيمون الصلوه ومما رزقنهم ينفقون
normalizedTranslation: the ones who establish prayer, and from what we have provided them, they spend

arabic: أُوْلَـٰٓئِكَ هُمُ ٱلۡمُؤۡمِنُونَ حَقّٗاۚ لَّهُمۡ دَرَجَٰتٌ عِندَ رَبِّهِمۡ وَمَغۡفِرَةٞ وَرِزۡقٞ كَرِيمٞ
translation: Those are the believers, truly. For them are degrees [of high position] with their Lord and forgiveness and noble provision
normalizedArabic: اوليك هم المومنون حقا لهم درجت عند ربهم ومغفره ورزق كريم
normalizedTranslation: those are the believers, truly. for them are degrees [of high position] with their lord and forgiveness and noble provision

arabic: كَمَآ أَخۡرَجَكَ رَبُّكَ مِنۢ بَيۡتِكَ بِٱلۡحَقِّ وَإِنَّ فَرِيقٗا مِّنَ ٱلۡمُؤۡمِنِينَ لَكَٰرِهُونَ
translation: [It is] just as when your Lord brought you out of your home [for the battle of Badr] in truth, while indeed, a party among the believers were unwilling
normalizedArabic: كما اخرجك ربك من بيتك بالحق وان فريقا من المومنين لكرهون
normalizedTranslation: [it is] just as when your lord brought you out of your home [for the battle of badr] in truth, while indeed, a party among the believers were unwilling

arabic: يُجَٰدِلُونَكَ فِي ٱلۡحَقِّ بَعۡدَ مَا تَبَيَّنَ كَأَنَّمَا يُسَاقُونَ إِلَى ٱلۡمَوۡتِ وَهُمۡ يَنظُرُونَ
translation: Arguing with you concerning the truth after it had become clear, as if they were being driven toward death while they were looking on
normalizedArabic: يجدلونك في الحق بعد ما تبين كانما يساقون الي الموت وهم ينظرون
normalizedTranslation: arguing with you concerning the truth after it had become clear, as if they were being driven toward death while they were looking on

arabic: وَإِذۡ يَعِدُكُمُ ٱللَّهُ إِحۡدَى ٱلطَّآئِفَتَيۡنِ أَنَّهَا لَكُمۡ وَتَوَدُّونَ أَنَّ غَيۡرَ ذَاتِ ٱلشَّوۡكَةِ تَكُونُ لَكُمۡ وَيُرِيدُ ٱللَّهُ أَن يُحِقَّ ٱلۡحَقَّ بِكَلِمَٰتِهِۦ وَيَقۡطَعَ دَابِرَ ٱلۡكَٰفِرِينَ
translation: [Remember, O believers], when Allah promised you one of the two groups - that it would be yours - and you wished that the unarmed one would be yours. But Allah intended to establish the truth by His words and to eliminate the disbelievers
normalizedArabic: واذ يعدكم الله احدي الطايفتين انها لكم وتودون ان غير ذات الشوكه تكون لكم ويريد الله ان يحق الحق بكلمته ويقطع دابر الكفرين
normalizedTranslation: [remember, o believers], when allah promised you one of the two groups - that it would be yours - and you wished that the unarmed one would be yours. but allah intended to establish the truth by his words and to eliminate the disbelievers

arabic: لِيُحِقَّ ٱلۡحَقَّ وَيُبۡطِلَ ٱلۡبَٰطِلَ وَلَوۡ كَرِهَ ٱلۡمُجۡرِمُونَ
translation: That He should establish the truth and abolish falsehood, even if the criminals disliked it
normalizedArabic: ليحق الحق ويبطل البطل ولو كره المجرمون
normalizedTranslation: that he should establish the truth and abolish falsehood, even if the criminals disliked it

arabic: إِذۡ تَسۡتَغِيثُونَ رَبَّكُمۡ فَٱسۡتَجَابَ لَكُمۡ أَنِّي مُمِدُّكُم بِأَلۡفٖ مِّنَ ٱلۡمَلَـٰٓئِكَةِ مُرۡدِفِينَ
translation: [Remember] when you asked help of your Lord, and He answered you, "Indeed, I will reinforce you with a thousand from the angels, following one another
normalizedArabic: اذ تستغيثون ربكم فاستجاب لكم اني ممدكم بالف من المليكه مردفين
normalizedTranslation: [remember] when you asked help of your lord, and he answered you, "indeed, i will reinforce you with a thousand from the angels, following one another

arabic: وَمَا جَعَلَهُ ٱللَّهُ إِلَّا بُشۡرَىٰ وَلِتَطۡمَئِنَّ بِهِۦ قُلُوبُكُمۡۚ وَمَا ٱلنَّصۡرُ إِلَّا مِنۡ عِندِ ٱللَّهِۚ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ عَزِيزٌ حَكِيمٌ
translation: And Allah made it not but good tidings and so that your hearts would be assured thereby. And victory is not but from Allah. Indeed, Allah is Exalted in Might and Wise
normalizedArabic: وما جعله الله الا بشري ولتطمين به قلوبكم وما النصر الا من عند الله ان الله عزيز حكيم
normalizedTranslation: and allah made it not but good tidings and so that your hearts would be assured thereby. and victory is not but from allah. indeed, allah is exalted in might and wise

arabic: إِذۡ يُغَشِّيكُمُ ٱلنُّعَاسَ أَمَنَةٗ مِّنۡهُ وَيُنَزِّلُ عَلَيۡكُم مِّنَ ٱلسَّمَآءِ مَآءٗ لِّيُطَهِّرَكُم بِهِۦ وَيُذۡهِبَ عَنكُمۡ رِجۡزَ ٱلشَّيۡطَٰنِ وَلِيَرۡبِطَ عَلَىٰ قُلُوبِكُمۡ وَيُثَبِّتَ بِهِ ٱلۡأَقۡدَامَ
translation: [Remember] when He overwhelmed you with drowsiness [giving] security from Him and sent down upon you from the sky, rain by which to purify you and remove from you the evil [suggestions] of Satan and to make steadfast your hearts and plant firmly thereby your feet
normalizedArabic: اذ يغشيكم النعاس امنه منه وينزل عليكم من السماء ماء ليطهركم به ويذهب عنكم رجز الشيطن وليربط علي قلوبكم ويثبت به الاقدام
normalizedTranslation: [remember] when he overwhelmed you with drowsiness [giving] security from him and sent down upon you from the sky, rain by which to purify you and remove from you the evil [suggestions] of satan and to make steadfast your hearts and plant firmly thereby your feet

arabic: إِذۡ يُوحِي رَبُّكَ إِلَى ٱلۡمَلَـٰٓئِكَةِ أَنِّي مَعَكُمۡ فَثَبِّتُواْ ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُواْۚ سَأُلۡقِي فِي قُلُوبِ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُواْ ٱلرُّعۡبَ فَٱضۡرِبُواْ فَوۡقَ ٱلۡأَعۡنَاقِ وَٱضۡرِبُواْ مِنۡهُمۡ كُلَّ بَنَانٖ
translation: [Remember] when your Lord inspired to the angels, "I am with you, so strengthen those who have believed. I will cast terror into the hearts of those who disbelieved, so strike [them] upon the necks and strike from them every fingertip
normalizedArabic: اذ يوحي ربك الي المليكه اني معكم فثبتوا الذين ءامنوا سالقي في قلوب الذين كفروا الرعب فاضربوا فوق الاعناق واضربوا منهم كل بنان
normalizedTranslation: [remember] when your lord inspired to the angels, "i am with you, so strengthen those who have believed. i will cast terror into the hearts of those who disbelieved, so strike [them] upon the necks and strike from them every fingertip

arabic: ذَٰلِكَ بِأَنَّهُمۡ شَآقُّواْ ٱللَّهَ وَرَسُولَهُۥۚ وَمَن يُشَاقِقِ ٱللَّهَ وَرَسُولَهُۥ فَإِنَّ ٱللَّهَ شَدِيدُ ٱلۡعِقَابِ
translation: That is because they opposed Allah and His Messenger. And whoever opposes Allah and His Messenger - indeed, Allah is severe in penalty
normalizedArabic: ذلك بانهم شاقوا الله ورسوله ومن يشاقق الله ورسوله فان الله شديد العقاب
normalizedTranslation: that is because they opposed allah and his messenger. and whoever opposes allah and his messenger - indeed, allah is severe in penalty

arabic: ذَٰلِكُمۡ فَذُوقُوهُ وَأَنَّ لِلۡكَٰفِرِينَ عَذَابَ ٱلنَّارِ
translation: That [is yours], so taste it." And indeed for the disbelievers is the punishment of the Fire
normalizedArabic: ذلكم فذوقوه وان للكفرين عذاب النار
normalizedTranslation: that [is yours], so taste it." and indeed for the disbelievers is the punishment of the fire

arabic: يَـٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوٓاْ إِذَا لَقِيتُمُ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُواْ زَحۡفٗا فَلَا تُوَلُّوهُمُ ٱلۡأَدۡبَارَ
translation: O you who have believed, when you meet those who disbelieve advancing [for battle], do not turn to them your backs [in flight]
normalizedArabic: يايها الذين ءامنوا اذا لقيتم الذين كفروا زحفا فلا تولوهم الادبار
normalizedTranslation: o you who have believed, when you meet those who disbelieve advancing [for battle], do not turn to them your backs [in flight]

arabic: وَمَن يُوَلِّهِمۡ يَوۡمَئِذٖ دُبُرَهُۥٓ إِلَّا مُتَحَرِّفٗا لِّقِتَالٍ أَوۡ مُتَحَيِّزًا إِلَىٰ فِئَةٖ فَقَدۡ بَآءَ بِغَضَبٖ مِّنَ ٱللَّهِ وَمَأۡوَىٰهُ جَهَنَّمُۖ وَبِئۡسَ ٱلۡمَصِيرُ
translation: And whoever turns his back to them on such a day, unless swerving [as a strategy] for war or joining [another] company, has certainly returned with anger [upon him] from Allah, and his refuge is Hell - and wretched is the destination
normalizedArabic: ومن يولهم يوميذ دبره الا متحرفا لقتال او متحيزا الي فيه فقد باء بغضب من الله وماويه جهنم وبيس المصير
normalizedTranslation: and whoever turns his back to them on such a day, unless swerving [as a strategy] for war or joining [another] company, has certainly returned with anger [upon him] from allah, and his refuge is hell - and wretched is the destination

arabic: فَلَمۡ تَقۡتُلُوهُمۡ وَلَٰكِنَّ ٱللَّهَ قَتَلَهُمۡۚ وَمَا رَمَيۡتَ إِذۡ رَمَيۡتَ وَلَٰكِنَّ ٱللَّهَ رَمَىٰ وَلِيُبۡلِيَ ٱلۡمُؤۡمِنِينَ مِنۡهُ بَلَآءً حَسَنًاۚ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ سَمِيعٌ عَلِيمٞ
translation: And you did not kill them, but it was Allah who killed them. And you threw not, [O Muhammad], when you threw, but it was Allah who threw that He might test the believers with a good test. Indeed, Allah is Hearing and Knowing

normalizedTranslation: and you did not kill them, but it was allah who killed them. and you threw not, [o muhammad], when you threw, but it was allah who threw that he might test the believers with a good test. indeed, allah is hearing and knowing

arabic: ذَٰلِكُمۡ وَأَنَّ ٱللَّهَ مُوهِنُ كَيۡدِ ٱلۡكَٰفِرِينَ
translation: That [is so], and [also] that Allah will weaken the plot of the disbelievers

normalizedTranslation: that [is so], and [also] that allah will weaken the plot of the disbelievers

arabic: إِن تَسۡتَفۡتِحُواْ فَقَدۡ جَآءَكُمُ ٱلۡفَتۡحُۖ وَإِن تَنتَهُواْ فَهُوَ خَيۡرٞ لَّكُمۡۖ وَإِن تَعُودُواْ نَعُدۡ وَلَن تُغۡنِيَ عَنكُمۡ فِئَتُكُمۡ شَيۡـٔٗا وَلَوۡ كَثُرَتۡ وَأَنَّ ٱللَّهَ مَعَ ٱلۡمُؤۡمِنِينَ
translation: If you [disbelievers] seek the victory - the defeat has come to you. And if you desist [from hostilities], it is best for you; but if you return [to war], We will return, and never will you be availed by your [large] company at all, even if it should increase; and [that is] because Allah is with the believers
normalizedArabic: ان تستفتحوا فقد جاءكم الفتح وان تنتهوا فهو خير لكم وان تعودوا نعد ولن تغني عنكم فيتكم شيا ولو كثرت وان الله مع المومنين
normalizedTranslation: if you [disbelievers] seek the victory - the defeat has come to you. and if you desist [from hostilities], it is best for you; but if you return [to war], we will return, and never will you be availed by your [large] company at all, even if it should increase; and [that is] because allah is with the believers

arabic: يَـٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوٓاْ أَطِيعُواْ ٱللَّهَ وَرَسُولَهُۥ وَلَا تَوَلَّوۡاْ عَنۡهُ وَأَنتُمۡ تَسۡمَعُونَ
translation: O you who have believed, obey Allah and His Messenger and do not turn from him while you hear [his order]

normalizedTranslation: o you who have believed, obey allah and his messenger and do not turn from him while you hear [his order]

arabic: وَلَا تَكُونُواْ كَٱلَّذِينَ قَالُواْ سَمِعۡنَا وَهُمۡ لَا يَسۡمَعُونَ

normalizedTranslation: and do not be like those who say, "we have heard," while they do not hear

arabic: ۞إِنَّ شَرَّ ٱلدَّوَآبِّ عِندَ ٱللَّهِ ٱلصُّمُّ ٱلۡبُكۡمُ ٱلَّذِينَ لَا يَعۡقِلُونَ
translation: Indeed, the worst of living creatures in the sight of Allah are the deaf and dumb who do not use reason
