normalizedArabic: افمن اسس بنينه علي تقوي من الله ورضون خير ام من اسس بنينه علي شفا جرف هار فانهار به في نار جهنم والله لا يهدي القوم الظلمين
normalizedTranslation: then is one who laid the foundation of his building on righteousness [with fear] from allah and [seeking] his approval better or one who laid the foundation of his building on the edge of a bank about to collapse, so it collapsed with him into the fire of hell? and allah does not guide the wrongdoing people

arabic: لَا يَزَالُ بُنۡيَٰنُهُمُ ٱلَّذِي بَنَوۡاْ رِيبَةٗ فِي قُلُوبِهِمۡ إِلَّآ أَن تَقَطَّعَ قُلُوبُهُمۡۗ وَٱللَّهُ عَلِيمٌ حَكِيمٌ
translation: Their building which they built will not cease to be a [cause of] skepticism in their hearts until their hearts are stopped. And Allah is Knowing and Wise
normalizedArabic: لا يزال بنينهم الذي بنوا ريبه في قلوبهم الا ان تقطع قلوبهم والله عليم حكيم
normalizedTranslation: their building which they built will not cease to be a [cause of] skepticism in their hearts until their hearts are stopped. and allah is knowing and wise

arabic: ۞إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ ٱشۡتَرَىٰ مِنَ ٱلۡمُؤۡمِنِينَ أَنفُسَهُمۡ وَأَمۡوَٰلَهُم بِأَنَّ لَهُمُ ٱلۡجَنَّةَۚ يُقَٰتِلُونَ فِي سَبِيلِ ٱللَّهِ فَيَقۡتُلُونَ وَيُقۡتَلُونَۖ وَعۡدًا عَلَيۡهِ حَقّٗا فِي ٱلتَّوۡرَىٰةِ وَٱلۡإِنجِيلِ وَٱلۡقُرۡءَانِۚ وَمَنۡ أَوۡفَىٰ بِعَهۡدِهِۦ مِنَ ٱللَّهِۚ فَٱسۡتَبۡشِرُواْ بِبَيۡعِكُمُ ٱلَّذِي بَايَعۡتُم بِهِۦۚ وَذَٰلِكَ هُوَ ٱلۡفَوۡزُ ٱلۡعَظِيمُ
translation: Indeed, Allah has purchased from the believers their lives and their properties [in exchange] for that they will have Paradise. They fight in the cause of Allah, so they kill and are killed. [It is] a true promise [binding] upon Him in the Torah and the Gospel and the Qur'an. And who is truer to his covenant than Allah? So rejoice in your transaction which you have contracted. And it is that which is the great attainment
normalizedArabic: ان الله اشتري من المومنين انفسهم وامولهم بان لهم الجنه يقتلون في سبيل الله فيقتلون ويقتلون وعدا عليه حقا في التوريه والانجيل والقرءان ومن اوفي بعهده من الله فاستبشروا ببيعكم الذي بايعتم به وذلك هو الفوز العظيم
normalizedTranslation: indeed, allah has purchased from the believers their lives and their properties [in exchange] for that they will have paradise. they fight in the cause of allah, so they kill and are killed. [it is] a true promise [binding] upon him in the torah and the gospel and the qur'an. and who is truer to his covenant than allah? so rejoice in your transaction which you have contracted. and it is that which is the great attainment

arabic: ٱلتَّـٰٓئِبُونَ ٱلۡعَٰبِدُونَ ٱلۡحَٰمِدُونَ ٱلسَّـٰٓئِحُونَ ٱلرَّـٰكِعُونَ ٱلسَّـٰجِدُونَ ٱلۡأٓمِرُونَ بِٱلۡمَعۡرُوفِ وَٱلنَّاهُونَ عَنِ ٱلۡمُنكَرِ وَٱلۡحَٰفِظُونَ لِحُدُودِ ٱللَّهِۗ وَبَشِّرِ ٱلۡمُؤۡمِنِينَ
translation: [Such believers are] the repentant, the worshippers, the praisers [of Allah], the travelers [for His cause], those who bow and prostrate [in prayer], those who enjoin what is right and forbid what is wrong, and those who observe the limits [set by] Allah. And give good tidings to the believers
normalizedArabic: التيبون العبدون الحمدون السيحون الركعون السجدون الامرون بالمعروف والناهون عن المنكر والحفظون لحدود الله وبشر المومنين
normalizedTranslation: [such believers are] the repentant, the worshippers, the praisers [of allah], the travelers [for his cause], those who bow and prostrate [in prayer], those who enjoin what is right and forbid what is wrong, and those who observe the limits [set by] allah. and give good tidings to the believers

arabic: مَا كَانَ لِلنَّبِيِّ وَٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوٓاْ أَن يَسۡتَغۡفِرُواْ لِلۡمُشۡرِكِينَ وَلَوۡ كَانُوٓاْ أُوْلِي قُرۡبَىٰ مِنۢ بَعۡدِ مَا تَبَيَّنَ لَهُمۡ أَنَّهُمۡ أَصۡحَٰبُ ٱلۡجَحِيمِ
translation: It is not for the Prophet and those who have believed to ask forgiveness for the polytheists, even if they were relatives, after it has become clear to them that they are companions of Hellfire
normalizedArabic: ما كان للنبي والذين ءامنوا ان يستغفروا للمشركين ولو كانوا اولي قربي من بعد ما تبين لهم انهم اصحب الجحيم
normalizedTranslation: it is not for the prophet and those who have believed to ask forgiveness for the polytheists, even if they were relatives, after it has become clear to them that they are companions of hellfire

arabic: وَمَا كَانَ ٱسۡتِغۡفَارُ إِبۡرَٰهِيمَ لِأَبِيهِ إِلَّا عَن مَّوۡعِدَةٖ وَعَدَهَآ إِيَّاهُ فَلَمَّا تَبَيَّنَ لَهُۥٓ أَنَّهُۥ عَدُوّٞ لِّلَّهِ تَبَرَّأَ مِنۡهُۚ إِنَّ إِبۡرَٰهِيمَ لَأَوَّـٰهٌ حَلِيمٞ
translation: And the request of forgiveness of Abraham for his father was only because of a promise he had made to him. But when it became apparent to Abraham that his father was an enemy to Allah, he disassociated himself from him. Indeed was Abraham compassionate and patient
normalizedArabic: وما كان استغفار ابرهيم لابيه الا عن موعده وعدها اياه فلما تبين له انه عدو لله تبرا منه ان ابرهيم لاوه حليم
normalizedTranslation: and the request of forgiveness of abraham for his father was only because of a promise he had made to him. but when it became apparent to abraham that his father was an enemy to allah, he disassociated himself from him. indeed was abraham compassionate and patient

arabic: وَمَا كَانَ ٱللَّهُ لِيُضِلَّ قَوۡمَۢا بَعۡدَ إِذۡ هَدَىٰهُمۡ حَتَّىٰ يُبَيِّنَ لَهُم مَّا يَتَّقُونَۚ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ بِكُلِّ شَيۡءٍ عَلِيمٌ
translation: And Allah would not let a people stray after He has guided them until He makes clear to them what they should avoid. Indeed, Allah is Knowing of all things
normalizedArabic: وما كان الله ليضل قوما بعد اذ هديهم حتي يبين لهم ما يتقون ان الله بكل شيء عليم
normalizedTranslation: and allah would not let a people stray after he has guided them until he makes clear to them what they should avoid. indeed, allah is knowing of all things

arabic: إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ لَهُۥ مُلۡكُ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلۡأَرۡضِۖ يُحۡيِۦ وَيُمِيتُۚ وَمَا لَكُم مِّن دُونِ ٱللَّهِ مِن وَلِيّٖ وَلَا نَصِيرٖ
translation: Indeed, to Allah belongs the dominion of the heavens and the earth; He gives life and causes death. And you have not besides Allah any protector or any helper
normalizedArabic: ان الله له ملك السموت والارض يحي ويميت وما لكم من دون الله من ولي ولا نصير
normalizedTranslation: indeed, to allah belongs the dominion of the heavens and the earth; he gives life and causes death. and you have not besides allah any protector or any helper

arabic: لَّقَد تَّابَ ٱللَّهُ عَلَى ٱلنَّبِيِّ وَٱلۡمُهَٰجِرِينَ وَٱلۡأَنصَارِ ٱلَّذِينَ ٱتَّبَعُوهُ فِي سَاعَةِ ٱلۡعُسۡرَةِ مِنۢ بَعۡدِ مَا كَادَ يَزِيغُ قُلُوبُ فَرِيقٖ مِّنۡهُمۡ ثُمَّ تَابَ عَلَيۡهِمۡۚ إِنَّهُۥ بِهِمۡ رَءُوفٞ رَّحِيمٞ
translation: Allah has already forgiven the Prophet and the Muhajireen and the Ansar who followed him in the hour of difficulty after the hearts of a party of them had almost inclined [to doubt], and then He forgave them. Indeed, He was to them Kind and Merciful
normalizedArabic: لقد تاب الله علي النبي والمهجرين والانصار الذين اتبعوه في ساعه العسره من بعد ما كاد يزيغ قلوب فريق منهم ثم تاب عليهم انه بهم رءوف رحيم
normalizedTranslation: allah has already forgiven the prophet and the muhajireen and the ansar who followed him in the hour of difficulty after the hearts of a party of them had almost inclined [to doubt], and then he forgave them. indeed, he was to them kind and merciful

arabic: وَعَلَى ٱلثَّلَٰثَةِ ٱلَّذِينَ خُلِّفُواْ حَتَّىٰٓ إِذَا ضَاقَتۡ عَلَيۡهِمُ ٱلۡأَرۡضُ بِمَا رَحُبَتۡ وَضَاقَتۡ عَلَيۡهِمۡ أَنفُسُهُمۡ وَظَنُّوٓاْ أَن لَّا مَلۡجَأَ مِنَ ٱللَّهِ إِلَّآ إِلَيۡهِ ثُمَّ تَابَ عَلَيۡهِمۡ لِيَتُوبُوٓاْۚ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ هُوَ ٱلتَّوَّابُ ٱلرَّحِيمُ
translation: And [He also forgave] the three who were left behind [and regretted their error] to the point that the earth closed in on them in spite of its vastness and their souls confined them and they were certain that there is no refuge from Allah except in Him. Then He turned to them so they could repent. Indeed, Allah is the Accepting of repentance, the Merciful
normalizedArabic: وعلي الثلثه الذين خلفوا حتي اذا ضاقت عليهم الارض بما رحبت وضاقت عليهم انفسهم وظنوا ان لا ملجا من الله الا اليه ثم تاب عليهم ليتوبوا ان الله هو التواب الرحيم
normalizedTranslation: and [he also forgave] the three who were left behind [and regretted their error] to the point that the earth closed in on them in spite of its vastness and their souls confined them and they were certain that there is no refuge from allah except in him. then he turned to them so they could repent. indeed, allah is the accepting of repentance, the merciful

arabic: يَـٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُواْ ٱتَّقُواْ ٱللَّهَ وَكُونُواْ مَعَ ٱلصَّـٰدِقِينَ
translation: O you who have believed, fear Allah and be with those who are true
normalizedArabic: يايها الذين ءامنوا اتقوا الله وكونوا مع الصدقين
normalizedTranslation: o you who have believed, fear allah and be with those who are true

arabic: مَا كَانَ لِأَهۡلِ ٱلۡمَدِينَةِ وَمَنۡ حَوۡلَهُم مِّنَ ٱلۡأَعۡرَابِ أَن يَتَخَلَّفُواْ عَن رَّسُولِ ٱللَّهِ وَلَا يَرۡغَبُواْ بِأَنفُسِهِمۡ عَن نَّفۡسِهِۦۚ ذَٰلِكَ بِأَنَّهُمۡ لَا يُصِيبُهُمۡ ظَمَأٞ وَلَا نَصَبٞ وَلَا مَخۡمَصَةٞ فِي سَبِيلِ ٱللَّهِ وَلَا يَطَـُٔونَ مَوۡطِئٗا يَغِيظُ ٱلۡكُفَّارَ وَلَا يَنَالُونَ مِنۡ عَدُوّٖ نَّيۡلًا إِلَّا كُتِبَ لَهُم بِهِۦ عَمَلٞ صَٰلِحٌۚ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ لَا يُضِيعُ أَجۡرَ ٱلۡمُحۡسِنِينَ
translation: It was not [proper] for the people of Madinah and those surrounding them of the bedouins that they remain behind after [the departure of] the Messenger of Allah or that they prefer themselves over his self. That is because they are not afflicted by thirst or fatigue or hunger in the cause of Allah, nor do they tread on any ground that enrages the disbelievers, nor do they inflict upon an enemy any infliction but that is registered for them as a righteous deed. Indeed, Allah does not allow to be lost the reward of the doers of good
normalizedArabic: ما كان لاهل المدينه ومن حولهم من الاعراب ان يتخلفوا عن رسول الله ولا يرغبوا بانفسهم عن نفسه ذلك بانهم لا يصيبهم ظما ولا نصب ولا مخمصه في سبيل الله ولا يطون موطيا يغيظ الكفار ولا ينالون من عدو نيلا الا كتب لهم به عمل صلح ان الله لا يضيع اجر المحسنين
normalizedTranslation: it was not [proper] for the people of madinah and those surrounding them of the bedouins that they remain behind after [the departure of] the messenger of allah or that they prefer themselves over his self. that is because they are not afflicted by thirst or fatigue or hunger in the cause of allah, nor do they tread on any ground that enrages the disbelievers, nor do they inflict upon an enemy any infliction but that is registered for them as a righteous deed. indeed, allah does not allow to be lost the reward of the doers of good

arabic: وَلَا يُنفِقُونَ نَفَقَةٗ صَغِيرَةٗ وَلَا كَبِيرَةٗ وَلَا يَقۡطَعُونَ وَادِيًا إِلَّا كُتِبَ لَهُمۡ لِيَجۡزِيَهُمُ ٱللَّهُ أَحۡسَنَ مَا كَانُواْ يَعۡمَلُونَ
translation: Nor do they spend an expenditure, small or large, or cross a valley but that it is registered for them that Allah may reward them for the best of what they were doing
normalizedArabic: ولا ينفقون نفقه صغيره ولا كبيره ولا يقطعون واديا الا كتب لهم ليجزيهم الله احسن ما كانوا يعملون
normalizedTranslation: nor do they spend an expenditure, small or large, or cross a valley but that it is registered for them that allah may reward them for the best of what they were doing

arabic: ۞وَمَا كَانَ ٱلۡمُؤۡمِنُونَ لِيَنفِرُواْ كَآفَّةٗۚ فَلَوۡلَا نَفَرَ مِن كُلِّ فِرۡقَةٖ مِّنۡهُمۡ طَآئِفَةٞ لِّيَتَفَقَّهُواْ فِي ٱلدِّينِ وَلِيُنذِرُواْ قَوۡمَهُمۡ إِذَا رَجَعُوٓاْ إِلَيۡهِمۡ لَعَلَّهُمۡ يَحۡذَرُونَ
translation: And it is not for the believers to go forth [to battle] all at once. For there should separate from every division of them a group [remaining] to obtain understanding in the religion and warn their people when they return to them that they might be cautious
normalizedArabic: وما كان المومنون لينفروا كافه فلولا نفر من كل فرقه منهم طايفه ليتفقهوا في الدين ولينذروا قومهم اذا رجعوا اليهم لعلهم يحذرون
normalizedTranslation: and it is not for the believers to go forth [to battle] all at once. for there should separate from every division of them a group [remaining] to obtain understanding in the religion and warn their people when they return to them that they might be cautious

arabic: يَـٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُواْ قَٰتِلُواْ ٱلَّذِينَ يَلُونَكُم مِّنَ ٱلۡكُفَّارِ وَلۡيَجِدُواْ فِيكُمۡ غِلۡظَةٗۚ وَٱعۡلَمُوٓاْ أَنَّ ٱللَّهَ مَعَ ٱلۡمُتَّقِينَ
translation: O you who have believed, fight those adjacent to you of the disbelievers and let them find in you harshness. And know that Allah is with the righteous
normalizedArabic: يايها الذين ءامنوا قتلوا الذين يلونكم من الكفار وليجدوا فيكم غلظه واعلموا ان الله مع المتقين
normalizedTranslation: o you who have believed, fight those adjacent to you of the disbelievers and let them find in you harshness. and know that allah is with the righteous

arabic: وَإِذَا مَآ أُنزِلَتۡ سُورَةٞ فَمِنۡهُم مَّن يَقُولُ أَيُّكُمۡ زَادَتۡهُ هَٰذِهِۦٓ إِيمَٰنٗاۚ فَأَمَّا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُواْ فَزَادَتۡهُمۡ إِيمَٰنٗا وَهُمۡ يَسۡتَبۡشِرُونَ
translation: And whenever a surah is revealed, there are among the hypocrites those who say, "Which of you has this increased faith?" As for those who believed, it has increased them in faith, while they are rejoicing
normalizedArabic: واذا ما انزلت سوره فمنهم من يقول ايكم زادته هذه ايمنا فاما الذين ءامنوا فزادتهم ايمنا وهم يستبشرون
normalizedTranslation: and whenever a surah is revealed, there are among the hypocrites those who say, "which of you has this increased faith?" as for those who believed, it has increased them in faith, while they are rejoicing

arabic: وَأَمَّا ٱلَّذِينَ فِي قُلُوبِهِم مَّرَضٞ فَزَادَتۡهُمۡ رِجۡسًا إِلَىٰ رِجۡسِهِمۡ وَمَاتُواْ وَهُمۡ كَٰفِرُونَ
translation: But as for those in whose hearts is disease, it has [only] increased them in evil [in addition] to their evil. And they will have died while they are disbelievers
normalizedArabic: واما الذين في قلوبهم مرض فزادتهم رجسا الي رجسهم وماتوا وهم كفرون
normalizedTranslation: but as for those in whose hearts is disease, it has [only] increased them in evil [in addition] to their evil. and they will have died while they are disbelievers

arabic: أَوَلَا يَرَوۡنَ أَنَّهُمۡ يُفۡتَنُونَ فِي كُلِّ عَامٖ مَّرَّةً أَوۡ مَرَّتَيۡنِ ثُمَّ لَا يَتُوبُونَ وَلَا هُمۡ يَذَّكَّرُونَ
translation: Do they not see that they are tried every year once or twice but then they do not repent nor do they remember
normalizedArabic: اولا يرون انهم يفتنون في كل عام مره او مرتين ثم لا يتوبون ولا هم يذكرون
normalizedTranslation: do they not see that they are tried every year once or twice but then they do not repent nor do they remember

arabic: وَإِذَا مَآ أُنزِلَتۡ سُورَةٞ نَّظَرَ بَعۡضُهُمۡ إِلَىٰ بَعۡضٍ هَلۡ يَرَىٰكُم مِّنۡ أَحَدٖ ثُمَّ ٱنصَرَفُواْۚ صَرَفَ ٱللَّهُ قُلُوبَهُم بِأَنَّهُمۡ قَوۡمٞ لَّا يَفۡقَهُونَ
translation: And whenever a surah is revealed, they look at each other, [saying], "Does anyone see you?" and then they dismiss themselves. Allah has dismissed their hearts because they are a people who do not understand
normalizedArabic: واذا ما انزلت سوره نظر بعضهم الي بعض هل يريكم من احد ثم انصرفوا صرف الله قلوبهم بانهم قوم لا يفقهون
normalizedTranslation: and whenever a surah is revealed, they look at each other, [saying], "does anyone see you?" and then they dismiss themselves. allah has dismissed their hearts because they are a people who do not understand

arabic: لَقَدۡ جَآءَكُمۡ رَسُولٞ مِّنۡ أَنفُسِكُمۡ عَزِيزٌ عَلَيۡهِ مَا عَنِتُّمۡ حَرِيصٌ عَلَيۡكُم بِٱلۡمُؤۡمِنِينَ رَءُوفٞ رَّحِيمٞ
translation: There has certainly come to you a Messenger from among yourselves. Grievous to him is what you suffer; [he is] concerned over you and to the believers is kind and merciful
normalizedArabic: لقد جاءكم رسول من انفسكم عزيز عليه ما عنتم حريص عليكم بالمومنين رءوف رحيم
normalizedTranslation: there has certainly come to you a messenger from among yourselves. grievous to him is what you suffer; [he is] concerned over you and to the believers is kind and merciful

arabic: فَإِن تَوَلَّوۡاْ فَقُلۡ حَسۡبِيَ ٱللَّهُ لَآ إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا هُوَۖ عَلَيۡهِ تَوَكَّلۡتُۖ وَهُوَ رَبُّ ٱلۡعَرۡشِ ٱلۡعَظِيمِ
translation: But if they turn away, [O Muhammad], say, "Sufficient for me is Allah; there is no deity except Him. On Him I have relied, and He is the Lord of the Great Throne
normalizedArabic: فان تولوا فقل حسبي الله لا اله الا هو عليه توكلت وهو رب العرش العظيم
normalizedTranslation: but if they turn away, [o muhammad], say, "sufficient for me is allah; there is no deity except him. on him i have relied, and he is the lord of the great throne

arabic: الٓرۚ تِلۡكَ ءَايَٰتُ ٱلۡكِتَٰبِ ٱلۡحَكِيمِ
translation: Alif, Lam, Ra. These are the verses of the wise Book
normalizedArabic: الر تلك ءايت الكتب الحكيم
normalizedTranslation: alif, lam, ra. these are the verses of the wise book

arabic: أَكَانَ لِلنَّاسِ عَجَبًا أَنۡ أَوۡحَيۡنَآ إِلَىٰ رَجُلٖ مِّنۡهُمۡ أَنۡ أَنذِرِ ٱلنَّاسَ وَبَشِّرِ ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوٓاْ أَنَّ لَهُمۡ قَدَمَ صِدۡقٍ عِندَ رَبِّهِمۡۗ قَالَ ٱلۡكَٰفِرُونَ إِنَّ هَٰذَا لَسَٰحِرٞ مُّبِينٌ
translation: Have the people been amazed that We revealed [revelation] to a man from among them, [saying], "Warn mankind and give good tidings to those who believe that they will have a [firm] precedence of honor with their Lord"? [But] the disbelievers say, "Indeed, this is an obvious magician
normalizedArabic: اكان للناس عجبا ان اوحينا الي رجل منهم ان انذر الناس وبشر الذين ءامنوا ان لهم قدم صدق عند ربهم قال الكفرون ان هذا لسحر مبين
normalizedTranslation: have the people been amazed that we revealed [revelation] to a man from among them, [saying], "warn mankind and give good tidings to those who believe that they will have a [firm] precedence of honor with their lord"? [but] the disbelievers say, "indeed, this is an obvious magician

arabic: إِنَّ رَبَّكُمُ ٱللَّهُ ٱلَّذِي خَلَقَ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلۡأَرۡضَ فِي سِتَّةِ أَيَّامٖ ثُمَّ ٱسۡتَوَىٰ عَلَى ٱلۡعَرۡشِۖ يُدَبِّرُ ٱلۡأَمۡرَۖ مَا مِن شَفِيعٍ إِلَّا مِنۢ بَعۡدِ إِذۡنِهِۦۚ ذَٰلِكُمُ ٱللَّهُ رَبُّكُمۡ فَٱعۡبُدُوهُۚ أَفَلَا تَذَكَّرُونَ
translation: Indeed, your Lord is Allah, who created the heavens and the earth in six days and then established Himself above the Throne, arranging the matter [of His creation]. There is no intercessor except after His permission. That is Allah, your Lord, so worship Him. Then will you not remember
normalizedArabic: ان ربكم الله الذي خلق السموت والارض في سته ايام ثم استوي علي العرش يدبر الامر ما من شفيع الا من بعد اذنه ذلكم الله ربكم فاعبدوه افلا تذكرون
normalizedTranslation: indeed, your lord is allah, who created the heavens and the earth in six days and then established himself above the throne, arranging the matter [of his creation]. there is no intercessor except after his permission. that is allah, your lord, so worship him. then will you not remember

arabic: إِلَيۡهِ مَرۡجِعُكُمۡ جَمِيعٗاۖ وَعۡدَ ٱللَّهِ حَقًّاۚ إِنَّهُۥ يَبۡدَؤُاْ ٱلۡخَلۡقَ ثُمَّ يُعِيدُهُۥ لِيَجۡزِيَ ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُواْ وَعَمِلُواْ ٱلصَّـٰلِحَٰتِ بِٱلۡقِسۡطِۚ وَٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُواْ لَهُمۡ شَرَابٞ مِّنۡ حَمِيمٖ وَعَذَابٌ أَلِيمُۢ بِمَا كَانُواْ يَكۡفُرُونَ
translation: To Him is your return all together. [It is] the promise of Allah [which is] truth. Indeed, He begins the [process of] creation and then repeats it that He may reward those who have believed and done righteous deeds, in justice. But those who disbelieved will have a drink of scalding water and a painful punishment for what they used to deny
normalizedArabic: اليه مرجعكم جميعا وعد الله حقا انه يبدوا الخلق ثم يعيده ليجزي الذين ءامنوا وعملوا الصلحت بالقسط والذين كفروا لهم شراب من حميم وعذاب اليم بما كانوا يكفرون
normalizedTranslation: to him is your return all together. [it is] the promise of allah [which is] truth. indeed, he begins the [process of] creation and then repeats it that he may reward those who have believed and done righteous deeds, in justice. but those who disbelieved will have a drink of scalding water and a painful punishment for what they used to deny

arabic: هُوَ ٱلَّذِي جَعَلَ ٱلشَّمۡسَ ضِيَآءٗ وَٱلۡقَمَرَ نُورٗا وَقَدَّرَهُۥ مَنَازِلَ لِتَعۡلَمُواْ عَدَدَ ٱلسِّنِينَ وَٱلۡحِسَابَۚ مَا خَلَقَ ٱللَّهُ ذَٰلِكَ إِلَّا بِٱلۡحَقِّۚ يُفَصِّلُ ٱلۡأٓيَٰتِ لِقَوۡمٖ يَعۡلَمُونَ
translation: It is He who made the sun a shining light and the moon a derived light and determined for it phases - that you may know the number of years and account [of time]. Allah has not created this except in truth. He details the signs for a people who know
normalizedArabic: هو الذي جعل الشمس ضياء والقمر نورا وقدره منازل لتعلموا عدد السنين والحساب ما خلق الله ذلك الا بالحق يفصل الايت لقوم يعلمون
normalizedTranslation: it is he who made the sun a shining light and the moon a derived light and determined for it phases - that you may know the number of years and account [of time]. allah has not created this except in truth. he details the signs for a people who know

arabic: إِنَّ فِي ٱخۡتِلَٰفِ ٱلَّيۡلِ وَٱلنَّهَارِ وَمَا خَلَقَ ٱللَّهُ فِي ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلۡأَرۡضِ لَأٓيَٰتٖ لِّقَوۡمٖ يَتَّقُونَ
translation: Indeed, in the alternation of the night and the day and [in] what Allah has created in the heavens and the earth are signs for a people who fear Allah
normalizedArabic: ان في اختلف اليل والنهار وما خلق الله في السموت والارض لايت لقوم يتقون
normalizedTranslation: indeed, in the alternation of the night and the day and [in] what allah has created in the heavens and the earth are signs for a people who fear allah

arabic: إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ لَا يَرۡجُونَ لِقَآءَنَا وَرَضُواْ بِٱلۡحَيَوٰةِ ٱلدُّنۡيَا وَٱطۡمَأَنُّواْ بِهَا وَٱلَّذِينَ هُمۡ عَنۡ ءَايَٰتِنَا غَٰفِلُونَ
translation: Indeed, those who do not expect the meeting with Us and are satisfied with the life of this world and feel secure therein and those who are heedless of Our signs
normalizedArabic: ان الذين لا يرجون لقاءنا ورضوا بالحيوه الدنيا واطمانوا بها والذين هم عن ءايتنا غفلون
normalizedTranslation: indeed, those who do not expect the meeting with us and are satisfied with the life of this world and feel secure therein and those who are heedless of our signs

arabic: أُوْلَـٰٓئِكَ مَأۡوَىٰهُمُ ٱلنَّارُ بِمَا كَانُواْ يَكۡسِبُونَ
translation: For those their refuge will be the Fire because of what they used to earn
normalizedArabic: اوليك ماويهم النار بما كانوا يكسبون
normalizedTranslation: for those their refuge will be the fire because of what they used to earn

arabic: إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُواْ وَعَمِلُواْ ٱلصَّـٰلِحَٰتِ يَهۡدِيهِمۡ رَبُّهُم بِإِيمَٰنِهِمۡۖ تَجۡرِي مِن تَحۡتِهِمُ ٱلۡأَنۡهَٰرُ فِي جَنَّـٰتِ ٱلنَّعِيمِ
translation: Indeed, those who have believed and done righteous deeds - their Lord will guide them because of their faith. Beneath them rivers will flow in the Gardens of Pleasure
normalizedArabic: ان الذين ءامنوا وعملوا الصلحت يهديهم ربهم بايمنهم تجري من تحتهم الانهر في جنت النعيم
normalizedTranslation: indeed, those who have believed and done righteous deeds - their lord will guide them because of their faith. beneath them rivers will flow in the gardens of pleasure

arabic: دَعۡوَىٰهُمۡ فِيهَا سُبۡحَٰنَكَ ٱللَّهُمَّ وَتَحِيَّتُهُمۡ فِيهَا سَلَٰمٞۚ وَءَاخِرُ دَعۡوَىٰهُمۡ أَنِ ٱلۡحَمۡدُ لِلَّهِ رَبِّ ٱلۡعَٰلَمِينَ
translation: Their call therein will be, "Exalted are You, O Allah," and their greeting therein will be, "Peace." And the last of their call will be, "Praise to Allah, Lord of the worlds
normalizedArabic: دعويهم فيها سبحنك اللهم وتحيتهم فيها سلم وءاخر دعويهم ان الحمد لله رب العلمين
normalizedTranslation: their call therein will be, "exalted are you, o allah," and their greeting therein will be, "peace." and the last of their call will be, "praise to allah, lord of the worlds

arabic: ۞وَلَوۡ يُعَجِّلُ ٱللَّهُ لِلنَّاسِ ٱلشَّرَّ ٱسۡتِعۡجَالَهُم بِٱلۡخَيۡرِ لَقُضِيَ إِلَيۡهِمۡ أَجَلُهُمۡۖ فَنَذَرُ ٱلَّذِينَ لَا يَرۡجُونَ لِقَآءَنَا فِي طُغۡيَٰنِهِمۡ يَعۡمَهُونَ
translation: And if Allah was to hasten for the people the evil [they invoke] as He hastens for them the good, their term would have been ended for them. But We leave the ones who do not expect the meeting with Us, in their transgression, wandering blindly
normalizedArabic: ولو يعجل الله للناس الشر استعجالهم بالخير لقضي اليهم اجلهم فنذر الذين لا يرجون لقاءنا في طغينهم يعمهون
normalizedTranslation: and if allah was to hasten for the people the evil [they invoke] as he hastens for them the good, their term would have been ended for them. but we leave the ones who do not expect the meeting with us, in their transgression, wandering blindly

arabic: وَإِذَا مَسَّ ٱلۡإِنسَٰنَ ٱلضُّرُّ دَعَانَا لِجَنۢبِهِۦٓ أَوۡ قَاعِدًا أَوۡ قَآئِمٗا فَلَمَّا كَشَفۡنَا عَنۡهُ ضُرَّهُۥ مَرَّ كَأَن لَّمۡ يَدۡعُنَآ إِلَىٰ ضُرّٖ مَّسَّهُۥۚ كَذَٰلِكَ زُيِّنَ لِلۡمُسۡرِفِينَ مَا كَانُواْ يَعۡمَلُونَ
translation: And when affliction touches man, he calls upon Us, whether lying on his side or sitting or standing; but when We remove from him his affliction, he continues [in disobedience] as if he had never called upon Us to [remove] an affliction that touched him. Thus is made pleasing to the transgressors that which they have been doing
normalizedArabic: واذا مس الانسن الضر دعانا لجنبه او قاعدا او قايما فلما كشفنا عنه ضره مر كان لم يدعنا الي ضر مسه كذلك زين للمسرفين ما كانوا يعملون
normalizedTranslation: and when affliction touches man, he calls upon us, whether lying on his side or sitting or standing; but when we remove from him his affliction, he continues [in disobedience] as if he had never called upon us to [remove] an affliction that touched him. thus is made pleasing to the transgressors that which they have been doing

arabic: وَلَقَدۡ أَهۡلَكۡنَا ٱلۡقُرُونَ مِن قَبۡلِكُمۡ لَمَّا ظَلَمُواْ وَجَآءَتۡهُمۡ رُسُلُهُم بِٱلۡبَيِّنَٰتِ وَمَا كَانُواْ لِيُؤۡمِنُواْۚ كَذَٰلِكَ نَجۡزِي ٱلۡقَوۡمَ ٱلۡمُجۡرِمِينَ
translation: And We had already destroyed generations before you when they wronged, and their messengers had come to them with clear proofs, but they were not to believe. Thus do We recompense the criminal people
normalizedArabic: ولقد اهلكنا القرون من قبلكم لما ظلموا وجاءتهم رسلهم بالبينت وما كانوا ليومنوا كذلك نجزي القوم المجرمين
normalizedTranslation: and we had already destroyed generations before you when they wronged, and their messengers had come to them with clear proofs, but they were not to believe. thus do we recompense the criminal people

arabic: ثُمَّ جَعَلۡنَٰكُمۡ خَلَـٰٓئِفَ فِي ٱلۡأَرۡضِ مِنۢ بَعۡدِهِمۡ لِنَنظُرَ كَيۡفَ تَعۡمَلُونَ
translation: Then We made you successors in the land after them so that We may observe how you will do
normalizedArabic: ثم جعلنكم خليف في الارض من بعدهم لننظر كيف تعملون
normalizedTranslation: then we made you successors in the land after them so that we may observe how you will do

arabic: وَإِذَا تُتۡلَىٰ عَلَيۡهِمۡ ءَايَاتُنَا بَيِّنَٰتٖ قَالَ ٱلَّذِينَ لَا يَرۡجُونَ لِقَآءَنَا ٱئۡتِ بِقُرۡءَانٍ غَيۡرِ هَٰذَآ أَوۡ بَدِّلۡهُۚ قُلۡ مَا يَكُونُ لِيٓ أَنۡ أُبَدِّلَهُۥ مِن تِلۡقَآيِٕ نَفۡسِيٓۖ إِنۡ أَتَّبِعُ إِلَّا مَا يُوحَىٰٓ إِلَيَّۖ إِنِّيٓ أَخَافُ إِنۡ عَصَيۡتُ رَبِّي عَذَابَ يَوۡمٍ عَظِيمٖ
translation: And when Our verses are recited to them as clear evidences, those who do not expect the meeting with Us say, "Bring us a Qur'an other than this or change it." Say, [O Muhammad], "It is not for me to change it on my own accord. I only follow what is revealed to me. Indeed I fear, if I should disobey my Lord, the punishment of a tremendous Day
normalizedArabic: واذا تتلي عليهم ءاياتنا بينت قال الذين لا يرجون لقاءنا ايت بقرءان غير هذا او بدله قل ما يكون لي ان ابدله من تلقاي نفسي ان اتبع الا ما يوحي الي اني اخاف ان عصيت ربي عذاب يوم عظيم
normalizedTranslation: and when our verses are recited to them as clear evidences, those who do not expect the meeting with us say, "bring us a qur'an other than this or change it." say, [o muhammad], "it is not for me to change it on my own accord. i only follow what is revealed to me. indeed i fear, if i should disobey my lord, the punishment of a tremendous day

arabic: قُل لَّوۡ شَآءَ ٱللَّهُ مَا تَلَوۡتُهُۥ عَلَيۡكُمۡ وَلَآ أَدۡرَىٰكُم بِهِۦۖ فَقَدۡ لَبِثۡتُ فِيكُمۡ عُمُرٗا مِّن قَبۡلِهِۦٓۚ أَفَلَا تَعۡقِلُونَ
translation: Say, "If Allah had willed, I would not have recited it to you, nor would He have made it known to you, for I had remained among you a lifetime before it. Then will you not reason
normalizedArabic: قل لو شاء الله ما تلوته عليكم ولا ادريكم به فقد لبثت فيكم عمرا من قبله افلا تعقلون
normalizedTranslation: say, "if allah had willed, i would not have recited it to you, nor would he have made it known to you, for i had remained among you a lifetime before it. then will you not reason

arabic: فَمَنۡ أَظۡلَمُ مِمَّنِ ٱفۡتَرَىٰ عَلَى ٱللَّهِ كَذِبًا أَوۡ كَذَّبَ بِـَٔايَٰتِهِۦٓۚ إِنَّهُۥ لَا يُفۡلِحُ ٱلۡمُجۡرِمُونَ
translation: So who is more unjust than he who invents a lie about Allah or denies His signs? Indeed, the criminals will not succeed
normalizedArabic: فمن اظلم ممن افتري علي الله كذبا او كذب بايته انه لا يفلح المجرمون
normalizedTranslation: so who is more unjust than he who invents a lie about allah or denies his signs? indeed, the criminals will not succeed

arabic: وَيَعۡبُدُونَ مِن دُونِ ٱللَّهِ مَا لَا يَضُرُّهُمۡ وَلَا يَنفَعُهُمۡ وَيَقُولُونَ هَـٰٓؤُلَآءِ شُفَعَـٰٓؤُنَا عِندَ ٱللَّهِۚ قُلۡ أَتُنَبِّـُٔونَ ٱللَّهَ بِمَا لَا يَعۡلَمُ فِي ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَلَا فِي ٱلۡأَرۡضِۚ سُبۡحَٰنَهُۥ وَتَعَٰلَىٰ عَمَّا يُشۡرِكُونَ
translation: And they worship other than Allah that which neither harms them nor benefits them, and they say, "These are our intercessors with Allah " Say, "Do you inform Allah of something He does not know in the heavens or on the earth?" Exalted is He and high above what they associate with Him
normalizedArabic: ويعبدون من دون الله ما لا يضرهم ولا ينفعهم ويقولون هولاء شفعونا عند الله قل اتنبون الله بما لا يعلم في السموت ولا في الارض سبحنه وتعلي عما يشركون
normalizedTranslation: and they worship other than allah that which neither harms them nor benefits them, and they say, "these are our intercessors with allah " say, "do you inform allah of something he does not know in the heavens or on the earth?" exalted is he and high above what they associate with him

arabic: وَمَا كَانَ ٱلنَّاسُ إِلَّآ أُمَّةٗ وَٰحِدَةٗ فَٱخۡتَلَفُواْۚ وَلَوۡلَا كَلِمَةٞ سَبَقَتۡ مِن رَّبِّكَ لَقُضِيَ بَيۡنَهُمۡ فِيمَا فِيهِ يَخۡتَلِفُونَ
translation: And mankind was not but one community [united in religion], but [then] they differed. And if not for a word that preceded from your Lord, it would have been judged between them [immediately] concerning that over which they differ
normalizedArabic: وما كان الناس الا امه وحده فاختلفوا ولولا كلمه سبقت من ربك لقضي بينهم فيما فيه يختلفون
normalizedTranslation: and mankind was not but one community [united in religion], but [then] they differed. and if not for a word that preceded from your lord, it would have been judged between them [immediately] concerning that over which they differ

arabic: وَيَقُولُونَ لَوۡلَآ أُنزِلَ عَلَيۡهِ ءَايَةٞ مِّن رَّبِّهِۦۖ فَقُلۡ إِنَّمَا ٱلۡغَيۡبُ لِلَّهِ فَٱنتَظِرُوٓاْ إِنِّي مَعَكُم مِّنَ ٱلۡمُنتَظِرِينَ
translation: And they say, "Why is a sign not sent down to him from his Lord?" So say, "The unseen is only for Allah [to administer], so wait; indeed, I am with you among those who wait
normalizedArabic: ويقولون لولا انزل عليه ءايه من ربه فقل انما الغيب لله فانتظروا اني معكم من المنتظرين
normalizedTranslation: and they say, "why is a sign not sent down to him from his lord?" so say, "the unseen is only for allah [to administer], so wait; indeed, i am with you among those who wait

arabic: وَإِذَآ أَذَقۡنَا ٱلنَّاسَ رَحۡمَةٗ مِّنۢ بَعۡدِ ضَرَّآءَ مَسَّتۡهُمۡ إِذَا لَهُم مَّكۡرٞ فِيٓ ءَايَاتِنَاۚ قُلِ ٱللَّهُ أَسۡرَعُ مَكۡرًاۚ إِنَّ رُسُلَنَا يَكۡتُبُونَ مَا تَمۡكُرُونَ
translation: And when We give the people a taste of mercy after adversity has touched them, at once they conspire against Our verses. Say, "Allah is swifter in strategy." Indeed, Our messengers record that which you conspire
normalizedArabic: واذا اذقنا الناس رحمه من بعد ضراء مستهم اذا لهم مكر في ءاياتنا قل الله اسرع مكرا ان رسلنا يكتبون ما تمكرون
normalizedTranslation: and when we give the people a taste of mercy after adversity has touched them, at once they conspire against our verses. say, "allah is swifter in strategy." indeed, our messengers record that which you conspire

arabic: هُوَ ٱلَّذِي يُسَيِّرُكُمۡ فِي ٱلۡبَرِّ وَٱلۡبَحۡرِۖ حَتَّىٰٓ إِذَا كُنتُمۡ فِي ٱلۡفُلۡكِ وَجَرَيۡنَ بِهِم بِرِيحٖ طَيِّبَةٖ وَفَرِحُواْ بِهَا جَآءَتۡهَا رِيحٌ عَاصِفٞ وَجَآءَهُمُ ٱلۡمَوۡجُ مِن كُلِّ مَكَانٖ وَظَنُّوٓاْ أَنَّهُمۡ أُحِيطَ بِهِمۡ دَعَوُاْ ٱللَّهَ مُخۡلِصِينَ لَهُ ٱلدِّينَ لَئِنۡ أَنجَيۡتَنَا مِنۡ هَٰذِهِۦ لَنَكُونَنَّ مِنَ ٱلشَّـٰكِرِينَ
translation: It is He who enables you to travel on land and sea until, when you are in ships and they sail with them by a good wind and they rejoice therein, there comes a storm wind and the waves come upon them from everywhere and they assume that they are surrounded, supplicating Allah, sincere to Him in religion, "If You should save us from this, we will surely be among the thankful
normalizedArabic: هو الذي يسيركم في البر والبحر حتي اذا كنتم في الفلك وجرين بهم بريح طيبه وفرحوا بها جاءتها ريح عاصف وجاءهم الموج من كل مكان وظنوا انهم احيط بهم دعوا الله مخلصين له الدين لين انجيتنا من هذه لنكونن من الشكرين
normalizedTranslation: it is he who enables you to travel on land and sea until, when you are in ships and they sail with them by a good wind and they rejoice therein, there comes a storm wind and the waves come upon them from everywhere and they assume that they are surrounded, supplicating allah, sincere to him in religion, "if you should save us from this, we will surely be among the thankful

arabic: فَلَمَّآ أَنجَىٰهُمۡ إِذَا هُمۡ يَبۡغُونَ فِي ٱلۡأَرۡضِ بِغَيۡرِ ٱلۡحَقِّۗ يَـٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلنَّاسُ إِنَّمَا بَغۡيُكُمۡ عَلَىٰٓ أَنفُسِكُمۖ مَّتَٰعَ ٱلۡحَيَوٰةِ ٱلدُّنۡيَاۖ ثُمَّ إِلَيۡنَا مَرۡجِعُكُمۡ فَنُنَبِّئُكُم بِمَا كُنتُمۡ تَعۡمَلُونَ
translation: But when He saves them, at once they commit injustice upon the earth without right. O mankind, your injustice is only against yourselves, [being merely] the enjoyment of worldly life. Then to Us is your return, and We will inform you of what you used to do
normalizedArabic: فلما انجيهم اذا هم يبغون في الارض بغير الحق يايها الناس انما بغيكم علي انفسكم متع الحيوه الدنيا ثم الينا مرجعكم فننبيكم بما كنتم تعملون
normalizedTranslation: but when he saves them, at once they commit injustice upon the earth without right. o mankind, your injustice is only against yourselves, [being merely] the enjoyment of worldly life. then to us is your return, and we will inform you of what you used to do

arabic: إِنَّمَا مَثَلُ ٱلۡحَيَوٰةِ ٱلدُّنۡيَا كَمَآءٍ أَنزَلۡنَٰهُ مِنَ ٱلسَّمَآءِ فَٱخۡتَلَطَ بِهِۦ نَبَاتُ ٱلۡأَرۡضِ مِمَّا يَأۡكُلُ ٱلنَّاسُ وَٱلۡأَنۡعَٰمُ حَتَّىٰٓ إِذَآ أَخَذَتِ ٱلۡأَرۡضُ زُخۡرُفَهَا وَٱزَّيَّنَتۡ وَظَنَّ أَهۡلُهَآ أَنَّهُمۡ قَٰدِرُونَ عَلَيۡهَآ أَتَىٰهَآ أَمۡرُنَا لَيۡلًا أَوۡ نَهَارٗا فَجَعَلۡنَٰهَا حَصِيدٗا كَأَن لَّمۡ تَغۡنَ بِٱلۡأَمۡسِۚ كَذَٰلِكَ نُفَصِّلُ ٱلۡأٓيَٰتِ لِقَوۡمٖ يَتَفَكَّرُونَ
translation: The example of [this] worldly life is but like rain which We have sent down from the sky that the plants of the earth absorb - [those] from which men and livestock eat - until, when the earth has taken on its adornment and is beautified and its people suppose that they have capability over it, there comes to it Our command by night or by day, and We make it as a harvest, as if it had not flourished yesterday. Thus do We explain in detail the signs for a people who give thought
normalizedArabic: انما مثل الحيوه الدنيا كماء انزلنه من السماء فاختلط به نبات الارض مما ياكل الناس والانعم حتي اذا اخذت الارض زخرفها وازينت وظن اهلها انهم قدرون عليها اتيها امرنا ليلا او نهارا فجعلنها حصيدا كان لم تغن بالامس كذلك نفصل الايت لقوم يتفكرون
normalizedTranslation: the example of [this] worldly life is but like rain which we have sent down from the sky that the plants of the earth absorb - [those] from which men and livestock eat - until, when the earth has taken on its adornment and is beautified and its people suppose that they have capability over it, there comes to it our command by night or by day, and we make it as a harvest, as if it had not flourished yesterday. thus do we explain in detail the signs for a people who give thought

arabic: وَٱللَّهُ يَدۡعُوٓاْ إِلَىٰ دَارِ ٱلسَّلَٰمِ وَيَهۡدِي مَن يَشَآءُ إِلَىٰ صِرَٰطٖ مُّسۡتَقِيمٖ
translation: And Allah invites to the Home of Peace and guides whom He wills to a straight path
normalizedArabic: والله يدعوا الي دار السلم ويهدي من يشاء الي صرط مستقيم
normalizedTranslation: and allah invites to the home of peace and guides whom he wills to a straight path

arabic: ۞لِّلَّذِينَ أَحۡسَنُواْ ٱلۡحُسۡنَىٰ وَزِيَادَةٞۖ وَلَا يَرۡهَقُ وُجُوهَهُمۡ قَتَرٞ وَلَا ذِلَّةٌۚ أُوْلَـٰٓئِكَ أَصۡحَٰبُ ٱلۡجَنَّةِۖ هُمۡ فِيهَا خَٰلِدُونَ
translation: For them who have done good is the best [reward] and extra. No darkness will cover their faces, nor humiliation. Those are companions of Paradise; they will abide therein eternally
normalizedArabic: للذين احسنوا الحسني وزياده ولا يرهق وجوههم قتر ولا ذله اوليك اصحب الجنه هم فيها خلدون
normalizedTranslation: for them who have done good is the best [reward] and extra. no darkness will cover their faces, nor humiliation. those are companions of paradise; they will abide therein eternally

arabic: وَٱلَّذِينَ كَسَبُواْ ٱلسَّيِّـَٔاتِ جَزَآءُ سَيِّئَةِۭ بِمِثۡلِهَا وَتَرۡهَقُهُمۡ ذِلَّةٞۖ مَّا لَهُم مِّنَ ٱللَّهِ مِنۡ عَاصِمٖۖ كَأَنَّمَآ أُغۡشِيَتۡ وُجُوهُهُمۡ قِطَعٗا مِّنَ ٱلَّيۡلِ مُظۡلِمًاۚ أُوْلَـٰٓئِكَ أَصۡحَٰبُ ٱلنَّارِۖ هُمۡ فِيهَا خَٰلِدُونَ
translation: But they who have earned [blame for] evil doings - the recompense of an evil deed is its equivalent, and humiliation will cover them. They will have from Allah no protector. It will be as if their faces are covered with pieces of the night - so dark [are they]. Those are the companions of the Fire; they will abide therein eternally
normalizedArabic: والذين كسبوا السيات جزاء سييه بمثلها وترهقهم ذله ما لهم من الله من عاصم كانما اغشيت وجوههم قطعا من اليل مظلما اوليك اصحب النار هم فيها خلدون
normalizedTranslation: but they who have earned [blame for] evil doings - the recompense of an evil deed is its equivalent, and humiliation will cover them. they will have from allah no protector. it will be as if their faces are covered with pieces of the night - so dark [are they]. those are the companions of the fire; they will abide therein eternally

arabic: وَيَوۡمَ نَحۡشُرُهُمۡ جَمِيعٗا ثُمَّ نَقُولُ لِلَّذِينَ أَشۡرَكُواْ مَكَانَكُمۡ أَنتُمۡ وَشُرَكَآؤُكُمۡۚ فَزَيَّلۡنَا بَيۡنَهُمۡۖ وَقَالَ شُرَكَآؤُهُم مَّا كُنتُمۡ إِيَّانَا تَعۡبُدُونَ
translation: And [mention, O Muhammad], the Day We will gather them all together - then We will say to those who associated others with Allah, "[Remain in] your place, you and your 'partners.' " Then We will separate them, and their "partners" will say, "You did not used to worship us
normalizedArabic: ويوم نحشرهم جميعا ثم نقول للذين اشركوا مكانكم انتم وشركاوكم فزيلنا بينهم وقال شركاوهم ما كنتم ايانا تعبدون
normalizedTranslation: and [mention, o muhammad], the day we will gather them all together - then we will say to those who associated others with allah, "[remain in] your place, you and your 'partners.' " then we will separate them, and their "partners" will say, "you did not used to worship us

arabic: فَكَفَىٰ بِٱللَّهِ شَهِيدَۢا بَيۡنَنَا وَبَيۡنَكُمۡ إِن كُنَّا عَنۡ عِبَادَتِكُمۡ لَغَٰفِلِينَ
translation: And sufficient is Allah as a witness between us and you that we were of your worship unaware
normalizedArabic: فكفي بالله شهيدا بيننا وبينكم ان كنا عن عبادتكم لغفلين
normalizedTranslation: and sufficient is allah as a witness between us and you that we were of your worship unaware

arabic: هُنَالِكَ تَبۡلُواْ كُلُّ نَفۡسٖ مَّآ أَسۡلَفَتۡۚ وَرُدُّوٓاْ إِلَى ٱللَّهِ مَوۡلَىٰهُمُ ٱلۡحَقِّۖ وَضَلَّ عَنۡهُم مَّا كَانُواْ يَفۡتَرُونَ
translation: There, [on that Day], every soul will be put to trial for what it did previously, and they will be returned to Allah, their master, the Truth, and lost from them is whatever they used to invent
normalizedArabic: هنالك تبلوا كل نفس ما اسلفت وردوا الي الله موليهم الحق وضل عنهم ما كانوا يفترون
normalizedTranslation: there, [on that day], every soul will be put to trial for what it did previously, and they will be returned to allah, their master, the truth, and lost from them is whatever they used to invent

arabic: قُلۡ مَن يَرۡزُقُكُم مِّنَ ٱلسَّمَآءِ وَٱلۡأَرۡضِ أَمَّن يَمۡلِكُ ٱلسَّمۡعَ وَٱلۡأَبۡصَٰرَ وَمَن يُخۡرِجُ ٱلۡحَيَّ مِنَ ٱلۡمَيِّتِ وَيُخۡرِجُ ٱلۡمَيِّتَ مِنَ ٱلۡحَيِّ وَمَن يُدَبِّرُ ٱلۡأَمۡرَۚ فَسَيَقُولُونَ ٱللَّهُۚ فَقُلۡ أَفَلَا تَتَّقُونَ
translation: Say, "Who provides for you from the heaven and the earth? Or who controls hearing and sight and who brings the living out of the dead and brings the dead out of the living and who arranges [every] matter?" They will say, "Allah," so say, "Then will you not fear Him
normalizedArabic: قل من يرزقكم من السماء والارض امن يملك السمع والابصر ومن يخرج الحي من الميت ويخرج الميت من الحي ومن يدبر الامر فسيقولون الله فقل افلا تتقون
normalizedTranslation: say, "who provides for you from the heaven and the earth? or who controls hearing and sight and who brings the living out of the dead and brings the dead out of the living and who arranges [every] matter?" they will say, "allah," so say, "then will you not fear him

arabic: فَذَٰلِكُمُ ٱللَّهُ رَبُّكُمُ ٱلۡحَقُّۖ فَمَاذَا بَعۡدَ ٱلۡحَقِّ إِلَّا ٱلضَّلَٰلُۖ فَأَنَّىٰ تُصۡرَفُونَ
translation: For that is Allah, your Lord, the Truth. And what can be beyond truth except error? So how are you averted
normalizedArabic: فذلكم الله ربكم الحق فماذا بعد الحق الا الضلل فاني تصرفون
normalizedTranslation: for that is allah, your lord, the truth. and what can be beyond truth except error? so how are you averted

arabic: كَذَٰلِكَ حَقَّتۡ كَلِمَتُ رَبِّكَ عَلَى ٱلَّذِينَ فَسَقُوٓاْ أَنَّهُمۡ لَا يُؤۡمِنُونَ
translation: Thus the word of your Lord has come into effect upon those who defiantly disobeyed - that they will not believe
normalizedArabic: كذلك حقت كلمت ربك علي الذين فسقوا انهم لا يومنون
normalizedTranslation: thus the word of your lord has come into effect upon those who defiantly disobeyed - that they will not believe

arabic: قُلۡ هَلۡ مِن شُرَكَآئِكُم مَّن يَبۡدَؤُاْ ٱلۡخَلۡقَ ثُمَّ يُعِيدُهُۥۚ قُلِ ٱللَّهُ يَبۡدَؤُاْ ٱلۡخَلۡقَ ثُمَّ يُعِيدُهُۥۖ فَأَنَّىٰ تُؤۡفَكُونَ
translation: Say, "Are there of your 'partners' any who begins creation and then repeats it?" Say, "Allah begins creation and then repeats it, so how are you deluded
normalizedArabic: قل هل من شركايكم من يبدوا الخلق ثم يعيده قل الله يبدوا الخلق ثم يعيده فاني توفكون
normalizedTranslation: say, "are there of your 'partners' any who begins creation and then repeats it?" say, "allah begins creation and then repeats it, so how are you deluded

arabic: قُلۡ هَلۡ مِن شُرَكَآئِكُم مَّن يَهۡدِيٓ إِلَى ٱلۡحَقِّۚ قُلِ ٱللَّهُ يَهۡدِي لِلۡحَقِّۗ أَفَمَن يَهۡدِيٓ إِلَى ٱلۡحَقِّ أَحَقُّ أَن يُتَّبَعَ أَمَّن لَّا يَهِدِّيٓ إِلَّآ أَن يُهۡدَىٰۖ فَمَا لَكُمۡ كَيۡفَ تَحۡكُمُونَ
translation: Say, "Are there of your 'partners' any who guides to the truth?" Say, "Allah guides to the truth. So is He who guides to the truth more worthy to be followed or he who guides not unless he is guided? Then what is [wrong] with you - how do you judge
normalizedArabic: قل هل من شركايكم من يهدي الي الحق قل الله يهدي للحق افمن يهدي الي الحق احق ان يتبع امن لا يهدي الا ان يهدي فما لكم كيف تحكمون
normalizedTranslation: say, "are there of your 'partners' any who guides to the truth?" say, "allah guides to the truth. so is he who guides to the truth more worthy to be followed or he who guides not unless he is guided? then what is [wrong] with you - how do you judge

arabic: وَمَا يَتَّبِعُ أَكۡثَرُهُمۡ إِلَّا ظَنًّاۚ إِنَّ ٱلظَّنَّ لَا يُغۡنِي مِنَ ٱلۡحَقِّ شَيۡـًٔاۚ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ عَلِيمُۢ بِمَا يَفۡعَلُونَ
translation: And most of them follow not except assumption. Indeed, assumption avails not against the truth at all. Indeed, Allah is Knowing of what they do
normalizedArabic: وما يتبع اكثرهم الا ظنا ان الظن لا يغني من الحق شيا ان الله عليم بما يفعلون
normalizedTranslation: and most of them follow not except assumption. indeed, assumption avails not against the truth at all. indeed, allah is knowing of what they do

arabic: وَمَا كَانَ هَٰذَا ٱلۡقُرۡءَانُ أَن يُفۡتَرَىٰ مِن دُونِ ٱللَّهِ وَلَٰكِن تَصۡدِيقَ ٱلَّذِي بَيۡنَ يَدَيۡهِ وَتَفۡصِيلَ ٱلۡكِتَٰبِ لَا رَيۡبَ فِيهِ مِن رَّبِّ ٱلۡعَٰلَمِينَ
translation: And it was not [possible] for this Qur'an to be produced by other than Allah, but [it is] a confirmation of what was before it and a detailed explanation of the [former] Scripture, about which there is no doubt, from the Lord of the worlds
normalizedArabic: وما كان هذا القرءان ان يفتري من دون الله ولكن تصديق الذي بين يديه وتفصيل الكتب لا ريب فيه من رب العلمين
normalizedTranslation: and it was not [possible] for this qur'an to be produced by other than allah, but [it is] a confirmation of what was before it and a detailed explanation of the [former] scripture, about which there is no doubt, from the lord of the worlds

arabic: أَمۡ يَقُولُونَ ٱفۡتَرَىٰهُۖ قُلۡ فَأۡتُواْ بِسُورَةٖ مِّثۡلِهِۦ وَٱدۡعُواْ مَنِ ٱسۡتَطَعۡتُم مِّن دُونِ ٱللَّهِ إِن كُنتُمۡ صَٰدِقِينَ
translation: Or do they say [about the Prophet], "He invented it?" Say, "Then bring forth a surah like it and call upon [for assistance] whomever you can besides Allah, if you should be truthful
normalizedArabic: ام يقولون افتريه قل فاتوا بسوره مثله وادعوا من استطعتم من دون الله ان كنتم صدقين
normalizedTranslation: or do they say [about the prophet], "he invented it?" say, "then bring forth a surah like it and call upon [for assistance] whomever you can besides allah, if you should be truthful

arabic: بَلۡ كَذَّبُواْ بِمَا لَمۡ يُحِيطُواْ بِعِلۡمِهِۦ وَلَمَّا يَأۡتِهِمۡ تَأۡوِيلُهُۥۚ كَذَٰلِكَ كَذَّبَ ٱلَّذِينَ مِن قَبۡلِهِمۡۖ فَٱنظُرۡ كَيۡفَ كَانَ عَٰقِبَةُ ٱلظَّـٰلِمِينَ
translation: Rather, they have denied that which they encompass not in knowledge and whose interpretation has not yet come to them. Thus did those before them deny. Then observe how was the end of the wrongdoers
normalizedArabic: بل كذبوا بما لم يحيطوا بعلمه ولما ياتهم تاويله كذلك كذب الذين من قبلهم فانظر كيف كان عقبه الظلمين
normalizedTranslation: rather, they have denied that which they encompass not in knowledge and whose interpretation has not yet come to them. thus did those before them deny. then observe how was the end of the wrongdoers

arabic: وَمِنۡهُم مَّن يُؤۡمِنُ بِهِۦ وَمِنۡهُم مَّن لَّا يُؤۡمِنُ بِهِۦۚ وَرَبُّكَ أَعۡلَمُ بِٱلۡمُفۡسِدِينَ
translation: And of them are those who believe in it, and of them are those who do not believe in it. And your Lord is most knowing of the corrupters
normalizedArabic: ومنهم من يومن به ومنهم من لا يومن به وربك اعلم بالمفسدين
normalizedTranslation: and of them are those who believe in it, and of them are those who do not believe in it. and your lord is most knowing of the corrupters

arabic: وَإِن كَذَّبُوكَ فَقُل لِّي عَمَلِي وَلَكُمۡ عَمَلُكُمۡۖ أَنتُم بَرِيٓـُٔونَ مِمَّآ أَعۡمَلُ وَأَنَا۠ بَرِيٓءٞ مِّمَّا تَعۡمَلُونَ
translation: And if they deny you, [O Muhammad], then say, "For me are my deeds, and for you are your deeds. You are disassociated from what I do, and I am disassociated from what you do
normalizedArabic: وان كذبوك فقل لي عملي ولكم عملكم انتم بريون مما اعمل وانا بريء مما تعملون
normalizedTranslation: and if they deny you, [o muhammad], then say, "for me are my deeds, and for you are your deeds. you are disassociated from what i do, and i am disassociated from what you do

arabic: وَمِنۡهُم مَّن يَسۡتَمِعُونَ إِلَيۡكَۚ أَفَأَنتَ تُسۡمِعُ ٱلصُّمَّ وَلَوۡ كَانُواْ لَا يَعۡقِلُونَ
translation: And among them are those who listen to you. But can you cause the deaf to hear, although they will not use reason
normalizedArabic: ومنهم من يستمعون اليك افانت تسمع الصم ولو كانوا لا يعقلون
normalizedTranslation: and among them are those who listen to you. but can you cause the deaf to hear, although they will not use reason

arabic: وَمِنۡهُم مَّن يَنظُرُ إِلَيۡكَۚ أَفَأَنتَ تَهۡدِي ٱلۡعُمۡيَ وَلَوۡ كَانُواْ لَا يُبۡصِرُونَ
translation: And among them are those who look at you. But can you guide the blind although they will not [attempt to] see
normalizedArabic: ومنهم من ينظر اليك افانت تهدي العمي ولو كانوا لا يبصرون
normalizedTranslation: and among them are those who look at you. but can you guide the blind although they will not [attempt to] see

arabic: إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ لَا يَظۡلِمُ ٱلنَّاسَ شَيۡـٔٗا وَلَٰكِنَّ ٱلنَّاسَ أَنفُسَهُمۡ يَظۡلِمُونَ
translation: Indeed, Allah does not wrong the people at all, but it is the people who are wronging themselves
normalizedArabic: ان الله لا يظلم الناس شيا ولكن الناس انفسهم يظلمون
normalizedTranslation: indeed, allah does not wrong the people at all, but it is the people who are wronging themselves

arabic: وَيَوۡمَ يَحۡشُرُهُمۡ كَأَن لَّمۡ يَلۡبَثُوٓاْ إِلَّا سَاعَةٗ مِّنَ ٱلنَّهَارِ يَتَعَارَفُونَ بَيۡنَهُمۡۚ قَدۡ خَسِرَ ٱلَّذِينَ كَذَّبُواْ بِلِقَآءِ ٱللَّهِ وَمَا كَانُواْ مُهۡتَدِينَ
translation: And on the Day when He will gather them, [it will be] as if they had not remained [in the world] but an hour of the day, [and] they will know each other. Those will have lost who denied the meeting with Allah and were not guided
normalizedArabic: ويوم يحشرهم كان لم يلبثوا الا ساعه من النهار يتعارفون بينهم قد خسر الذين كذبوا بلقاء الله وما كانوا مهتدين
normalizedTranslation: and on the day when he will gather them, [it will be] as if they had not remained [in the world] but an hour of the day, [and] they will know each other. those will have lost who denied the meeting with allah and were not guided

arabic: وَإِمَّا نُرِيَنَّكَ بَعۡضَ ٱلَّذِي نَعِدُهُمۡ أَوۡ نَتَوَفَّيَنَّكَ فَإِلَيۡنَا مَرۡجِعُهُمۡ ثُمَّ ٱللَّهُ شَهِيدٌ عَلَىٰ مَا يَفۡعَلُونَ
translation: And whether We show you some of what We promise them, [O Muhammad], or We take you in death, to Us is their return; then, [either way], Allah is a witness concerning what they are doing
normalizedArabic: واما نرينك بعض الذي نعدهم او نتوفينك فالينا مرجعهم ثم الله شهيد علي ما يفعلون
normalizedTranslation: and whether we show you some of what we promise them, [o muhammad], or we take you in death, to us is their return; then, [either way], allah is a witness concerning what they are doing

arabic: وَلِكُلِّ أُمَّةٖ رَّسُولٞۖ فَإِذَا جَآءَ رَسُولُهُمۡ قُضِيَ بَيۡنَهُم بِٱلۡقِسۡطِ وَهُمۡ لَا يُظۡلَمُونَ
translation: And for every nation is a messenger. So when their messenger comes, it will be judged between them in justice, and they will not be wronged
normalizedArabic: ولكل امه رسول فاذا جاء رسولهم قضي بينهم بالقسط وهم لا يظلمون
normalizedTranslation: and for every nation is a messenger. so when their messenger comes, it will be judged between them in justice, and they will not be wronged

arabic: وَيَقُولُونَ مَتَىٰ هَٰذَا ٱلۡوَعۡدُ إِن كُنتُمۡ صَٰدِقِينَ
translation: And they say, "When is [the fulfillment of] this promise, if you should be truthful
normalizedArabic: ويقولون متي هذا الوعد ان كنتم صدقين
normalizedTranslation: and they say, "when is [the fulfillment of] this promise, if you should be truthful

arabic: قُل لَّآ أَمۡلِكُ لِنَفۡسِي ضَرّٗا وَلَا نَفۡعًا إِلَّا مَا شَآءَ ٱللَّهُۗ لِكُلِّ أُمَّةٍ أَجَلٌۚ إِذَا جَآءَ أَجَلُهُمۡ فَلَا يَسۡتَـٔۡخِرُونَ سَاعَةٗ وَلَا يَسۡتَقۡدِمُونَ
translation: Say, "I possess not for myself any harm or benefit except what Allah should will. For every nation is a [specified] term. When their time has come, then they will not remain behind an hour, nor will they precede [it]
normalizedArabic: قل لا املك لنفسي ضرا ولا نفعا الا ما شاء الله لكل امه اجل اذا جاء اجلهم فلا يستخرون ساعه ولا يستقدمون
normalizedTranslation: say, "i possess not for myself any harm or benefit except what allah should will. for every nation is a [specified] term. when their time has come, then they will not remain behind an hour, nor will they precede [it]

arabic: قُلۡ أَرَءَيۡتُمۡ إِنۡ أَتَىٰكُمۡ عَذَابُهُۥ بَيَٰتًا أَوۡ نَهَارٗا مَّاذَا يَسۡتَعۡجِلُ مِنۡهُ ٱلۡمُجۡرِمُونَ
translation: Say, "Have you considered: if His punishment should come to you by night or by day - for which [aspect] of it would the criminals be impatient
normalizedArabic: قل ارءيتم ان اتيكم عذابه بيتا او نهارا ماذا يستعجل منه المجرمون
normalizedTranslation: say, "have you considered: if his punishment should come to you by night or by day - for which [aspect] of it would the criminals be impatient

arabic: أَثُمَّ إِذَا مَا وَقَعَ ءَامَنتُم بِهِۦٓۚ ءَآلۡـَٰٔنَ وَقَدۡ كُنتُم بِهِۦ تَسۡتَعۡجِلُونَ
translation: Then is it that when it has [actually] occurred you will believe in it? Now? And you were [once] for it impatient
normalizedArabic: اثم اذا ما وقع ءامنتم به ءالن وقد كنتم به تستعجلون
normalizedTranslation: then is it that when it has [actually] occurred you will believe in it? now? and you were [once] for it impatient

arabic: ثُمَّ قِيلَ لِلَّذِينَ ظَلَمُواْ ذُوقُواْ عَذَابَ ٱلۡخُلۡدِ هَلۡ تُجۡزَوۡنَ إِلَّا بِمَا كُنتُمۡ تَكۡسِبُونَ
translation: Then it will be said to those who had wronged, "Taste the punishment of eternity; are you being recompensed except for what you used to earn
normalizedArabic: ثم قيل للذين ظلموا ذوقوا عذاب الخلد هل تجزون الا بما كنتم تكسبون
normalizedTranslation: then it will be said to those who had wronged, "taste the punishment of eternity; are you being recompensed except for what you used to earn

arabic: ۞وَيَسۡتَنۢبِـُٔونَكَ أَحَقٌّ هُوَۖ قُلۡ إِي وَرَبِّيٓ إِنَّهُۥ لَحَقّٞۖ وَمَآ أَنتُم بِمُعۡجِزِينَ
translation: And they ask information of you, [O Muhammad], "Is it true?" Say, "Yes, by my Lord. Indeed, it is truth; and you will not cause failure [to Allah]
normalizedArabic: ويستنبونك احق هو قل اي وربي انه لحق وما انتم بمعجزين
normalizedTranslation: and they ask information of you, [o muhammad], "is it true?" say, "yes, by my lord. indeed, it is truth; and you will not cause failure [to allah]

arabic: وَلَوۡ أَنَّ لِكُلِّ نَفۡسٖ ظَلَمَتۡ مَا فِي ٱلۡأَرۡضِ لَٱفۡتَدَتۡ بِهِۦۗ وَأَسَرُّواْ ٱلنَّدَامَةَ لَمَّا رَأَوُاْ ٱلۡعَذَابَۖ وَقُضِيَ بَيۡنَهُم بِٱلۡقِسۡطِ وَهُمۡ لَا يُظۡلَمُونَ
translation: And if each soul that wronged had everything on earth, it would offer it in ransom. And they will confide regret when they see the punishment; and they will be judged in justice, and they will not be wronged
normalizedArabic: ولو ان لكل نفس ظلمت ما في الارض لافتدت به واسروا الندامه لما راوا العذاب وقضي بينهم بالقسط وهم لا يظلمون
normalizedTranslation: and if each soul that wronged had everything on earth, it would offer it in ransom. and they will confide regret when they see the punishment; and they will be judged in justice, and they will not be wronged

arabic: أَلَآ إِنَّ لِلَّهِ مَا فِي ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلۡأَرۡضِۗ أَلَآ إِنَّ وَعۡدَ ٱللَّهِ حَقّٞ وَلَٰكِنَّ أَكۡثَرَهُمۡ لَا يَعۡلَمُونَ
translation: Unquestionably, to Allah belongs whatever is in the heavens and the earth. Unquestionably, the promise of Allah is truth, but most of them do not know
normalizedArabic: الا ان لله ما في السموت والارض الا ان وعد الله حق ولكن اكثرهم لا يعلمون
normalizedTranslation: unquestionably, to allah belongs whatever is in the heavens and the earth. unquestionably, the promise of allah is truth, but most of them do not know

arabic: هُوَ يُحۡيِۦ وَيُمِيتُ وَإِلَيۡهِ تُرۡجَعُونَ
translation: He gives life and causes death, and to Him you will be returned
normalizedArabic: هو يحي ويميت واليه ترجعون
normalizedTranslation: he gives life and causes death, and to him you will be returned

arabic: يَـٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلنَّاسُ قَدۡ جَآءَتۡكُم مَّوۡعِظَةٞ مِّن رَّبِّكُمۡ وَشِفَآءٞ لِّمَا فِي ٱلصُّدُورِ وَهُدٗى وَرَحۡمَةٞ لِّلۡمُؤۡمِنِينَ
translation: O mankind, there has to come to you instruction from your Lord and healing for what is in the breasts and guidance and mercy for the believers
normalizedArabic: يايها الناس قد جاءتكم موعظه من ربكم وشفاء لما في الصدور وهدي ورحمه للمومنين
normalizedTranslation: o mankind, there has to come to you instruction from your lord and healing for what is in the breasts and guidance and mercy for the believers

arabic: قُلۡ بِفَضۡلِ ٱللَّهِ وَبِرَحۡمَتِهِۦ فَبِذَٰلِكَ فَلۡيَفۡرَحُواْ هُوَ خَيۡرٞ مِّمَّا يَجۡمَعُونَ
translation: Say, "In the bounty of Allah and in His mercy - in that let them rejoice; it is better than what they accumulate
normalizedArabic: قل بفضل الله وبرحمته فبذلك فليفرحوا هو خير مما يجمعون
normalizedTranslation: say, "in the bounty of allah and in his mercy - in that let them rejoice; it is better than what they accumulate

arabic: قُلۡ أَرَءَيۡتُم مَّآ أَنزَلَ ٱللَّهُ لَكُم مِّن رِّزۡقٖ فَجَعَلۡتُم مِّنۡهُ حَرَامٗا وَحَلَٰلٗا قُلۡ ءَآللَّهُ أَذِنَ لَكُمۡۖ أَمۡ عَلَى ٱللَّهِ تَفۡتَرُونَ
translation: Say, "Have you seen what Allah has sent down to you of provision of which you have made [some] lawful and [some] unlawful?" Say, "Has Allah permitted you [to do so], or do you invent [something] about Allah
normalizedArabic: قل ارءيتم ما انزل الله لكم من رزق فجعلتم منه حراما وحللا قل ءالله اذن لكم ام علي الله تفترون
normalizedTranslation: say, "have you seen what allah has sent down to you of provision of which you have made [some] lawful and [some] unlawful?" say, "has allah permitted you [to do so], or do you invent [something] about allah

arabic: وَمَا ظَنُّ ٱلَّذِينَ يَفۡتَرُونَ عَلَى ٱللَّهِ ٱلۡكَذِبَ يَوۡمَ ٱلۡقِيَٰمَةِۗ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ لَذُو فَضۡلٍ عَلَى ٱلنَّاسِ وَلَٰكِنَّ أَكۡثَرَهُمۡ لَا يَشۡكُرُونَ
translation: And what will be the supposition of those who invent falsehood about Allah on the Day of Resurrection? Indeed, Allah is full of bounty to the people, but most of them are not grateful
normalizedArabic: وما ظن الذين يفترون علي الله الكذب يوم القيمه ان الله لذو فضل علي الناس ولكن اكثرهم لا يشكرون
normalizedTranslation: and what will be the supposition of those who invent falsehood about allah on the day of resurrection? indeed, allah is full of bounty to the people, but most of them are not grateful

arabic: وَمَا تَكُونُ فِي شَأۡنٖ وَمَا تَتۡلُواْ مِنۡهُ مِن قُرۡءَانٖ وَلَا تَعۡمَلُونَ مِنۡ عَمَلٍ إِلَّا كُنَّا عَلَيۡكُمۡ شُهُودًا إِذۡ تُفِيضُونَ فِيهِۚ وَمَا يَعۡزُبُ عَن رَّبِّكَ مِن مِّثۡقَالِ ذَرَّةٖ فِي ٱلۡأَرۡضِ وَلَا فِي ٱلسَّمَآءِ وَلَآ أَصۡغَرَ مِن ذَٰلِكَ وَلَآ أَكۡبَرَ إِلَّا فِي كِتَٰبٖ مُّبِينٍ
translation: And, [O Muhammad], you are not [engaged] in any matter or recite any of the Qur'an and you [people] do not do any deed except that We are witness over you when you are involved in it. And not absent from your Lord is any [part] of an atom's weight within the earth or within the heaven or [anything] smaller than that or greater but that it is in a clear register
normalizedArabic: وما تكون في شان وما تتلوا منه من قرءان ولا تعملون من عمل الا كنا عليكم شهودا اذ تفيضون فيه وما يعزب عن ربك من مثقال ذره في الارض ولا في السماء ولا اصغر من ذلك ولا اكبر الا في كتب مبين
normalizedTranslation: and, [o muhammad], you are not [engaged] in any matter or recite any of the qur'an and you [people] do not do any deed except that we are witness over you when you are involved in it. and not absent from your lord is any [part] of an atom's weight within the earth or within the heaven or [anything] smaller than that or greater but that it is in a clear register

arabic: أَلَآ إِنَّ أَوۡلِيَآءَ ٱللَّهِ لَا خَوۡفٌ عَلَيۡهِمۡ وَلَا هُمۡ يَحۡزَنُونَ
translation: Unquestionably, [for] the allies of Allah there will be no fear concerning them, nor will they grieve
normalizedArabic: الا ان اولياء الله لا خوف عليهم ولا هم يحزنون
normalizedTranslation: unquestionably, [for] the allies of allah there will be no fear concerning them, nor will they grieve

arabic: ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُواْ وَكَانُواْ يَتَّقُونَ
translation: Those who believed and were fearing Allah
normalizedArabic: الذين ءامنوا وكانوا يتقون
normalizedTranslation: those who believed and were fearing allah

arabic: لَهُمُ ٱلۡبُشۡرَىٰ فِي ٱلۡحَيَوٰةِ ٱلدُّنۡيَا وَفِي ٱلۡأٓخِرَةِۚ لَا تَبۡدِيلَ لِكَلِمَٰتِ ٱللَّهِۚ ذَٰلِكَ هُوَ ٱلۡفَوۡزُ ٱلۡعَظِيمُ
translation: For them are good tidings in the worldly life and in the Hereafter. No change is there in the words of Allah. That is what is the great attainment
normalizedArabic: لهم البشري في الحيوه الدنيا وفي الاخره لا تبديل لكلمت الله ذلك هو الفوز العظيم
normalizedTranslation: for them are good tidings in the worldly life and in the hereafter. no change is there in the words of allah. that is what is the great attainment

arabic: وَلَا يَحۡزُنكَ قَوۡلُهُمۡۘ إِنَّ ٱلۡعِزَّةَ لِلَّهِ جَمِيعًاۚ هُوَ ٱلسَّمِيعُ ٱلۡعَلِيمُ
translation: And let not their speech grieve you. Indeed, honor [due to power] belongs to Allah entirely. He is the Hearing, the Knowing
normalizedArabic: ولا يحزنك قولهم ان العزه لله جميعا هو السميع العليم
normalizedTranslation: and let not their speech grieve you. indeed, honor [due to power] belongs to allah entirely. he is the hearing, the knowing

arabic: أَلَآ إِنَّ لِلَّهِ مَن فِي ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَمَن فِي ٱلۡأَرۡضِۗ وَمَا يَتَّبِعُ ٱلَّذِينَ يَدۡعُونَ مِن دُونِ ٱللَّهِ شُرَكَآءَۚ إِن يَتَّبِعُونَ إِلَّا ٱلظَّنَّ وَإِنۡ هُمۡ إِلَّا يَخۡرُصُونَ
translation: Unquestionably, to Allah belongs whoever is in the heavens and whoever is on the earth. And those who invoke other than Allah do not [actually] follow [His] "partners." They follow not except assumption, and they are not but falsifying
normalizedArabic: الا ان لله من في السموت ومن في الارض وما يتبع الذين يدعون من دون الله شركاء ان يتبعون الا الظن وان هم الا يخرصون
normalizedTranslation: unquestionably, to allah belongs whoever is in the heavens and whoever is on the earth. and those who invoke other than allah do not [actually] follow [his] "partners." they follow not except assumption, and they are not but falsifying

arabic: هُوَ ٱلَّذِي جَعَلَ لَكُمُ ٱلَّيۡلَ لِتَسۡكُنُواْ فِيهِ وَٱلنَّهَارَ مُبۡصِرًاۚ إِنَّ فِي ذَٰلِكَ لَأٓيَٰتٖ لِّقَوۡمٖ يَسۡمَعُونَ
translation: It is He who made for you the night to rest therein and the day, giving sight. Indeed in that are signs for a people who listen
normalizedArabic: هو الذي جعل لكم اليل لتسكنوا فيه والنهار مبصرا ان في ذلك لايت لقوم يسمعون
normalizedTranslation: it is he who made for you the night to rest therein and the day, giving sight. indeed in that are signs for a people who listen

arabic: قَالُواْ ٱتَّخَذَ ٱللَّهُ وَلَدٗاۗ سُبۡحَٰنَهُۥۖ هُوَ ٱلۡغَنِيُّۖ لَهُۥ مَا فِي ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَمَا فِي ٱلۡأَرۡضِۚ إِنۡ عِندَكُم مِّن سُلۡطَٰنِۭ بِهَٰذَآۚ أَتَقُولُونَ عَلَى ٱللَّهِ مَا لَا تَعۡلَمُونَ
translation: They have said, "Allah has taken a son." Exalted is He; He is the [one] Free of need. To Him belongs whatever is in the heavens and whatever is in the earth. You have no authority for this [claim]. Do you say about Allah that which you do not know
normalizedArabic: قالوا اتخذ الله ولدا سبحنه هو الغني له ما في السموت وما في الارض ان عندكم من سلطن بهذا اتقولون علي الله ما لا تعلمون
normalizedTranslation: they have said, "allah has taken a son." exalted is he; he is the [one] free of need. to him belongs whatever is in the heavens and whatever is in the earth. you have no authority for this [claim]. do you say about allah that which you do not know

arabic: قُلۡ إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ يَفۡتَرُونَ عَلَى ٱللَّهِ ٱلۡكَذِبَ لَا يُفۡلِحُونَ
translation: Say, "Indeed, those who invent falsehood about Allah will not succeed
normalizedArabic: قل ان الذين يفترون علي الله الكذب لا يفلحون
normalizedTranslation: say, "indeed, those who invent falsehood about allah will not succeed

arabic: مَتَٰعٞ فِي ٱلدُّنۡيَا ثُمَّ إِلَيۡنَا مَرۡجِعُهُمۡ ثُمَّ نُذِيقُهُمُ ٱلۡعَذَابَ ٱلشَّدِيدَ بِمَا كَانُواْ يَكۡفُرُونَ
translation: [For them is brief] enjoyment in this world; then to Us is their return; then We will make them taste the severe punishment because they used to disbelieve

normalizedTranslation: [for them is brief] enjoyment in this world; then to us is their return; then we will make them taste the severe punishment because they used to disbelieve

arabic: ۞وَٱتۡلُ عَلَيۡهِمۡ نَبَأَ نُوحٍ إِذۡ قَالَ لِقَوۡمِهِۦ يَٰقَوۡمِ إِن كَانَ كَبُرَ عَلَيۡكُم مَّقَامِي وَتَذۡكِيرِي بِـَٔايَٰتِ ٱللَّهِ فَعَلَى ٱللَّهِ تَوَكَّلۡتُ فَأَجۡمِعُوٓاْ أَمۡرَكُمۡ وَشُرَكَآءَكُمۡ ثُمَّ لَا يَكُنۡ أَمۡرُكُمۡ عَلَيۡكُمۡ غُمَّةٗ ثُمَّ ٱقۡضُوٓاْ إِلَيَّ وَلَا تُنظِرُونِ
translation: And recite to them the news of Noah, when he said to his people, "O my people, if my residence and my reminding of the signs of Allah has become burdensome upon you - then I have relied upon Allah. So resolve upon your plan and [call upon] your associates. Then let not your plan be obscure to you. Then carry it out upon me and do not give me respite
normalizedArabic: واتل عليهم نبا نوح اذ قال لقومه يقوم ان كان كبر عليكم مقامي وتذكيري بايت الله فعلي الله توكلت فاجمعوا امركم وشركاءكم ثم لا يكن امركم عليكم غمه ثم اقضوا الي ولا تنظرون
normalizedTranslation: and recite to them the news of noah, when he said to his people, "o my people, if my residence and my reminding of the signs of allah has become burdensome upon you - then i have relied upon allah. so resolve upon your plan and [call upon] your associates. then let not your plan be obscure to you. then carry it out upon me and do not give me respite

arabic: فَإِن تَوَلَّيۡتُمۡ فَمَا سَأَلۡتُكُم مِّنۡ أَجۡرٍۖ إِنۡ أَجۡرِيَ إِلَّا عَلَى ٱللَّهِۖ وَأُمِرۡتُ أَنۡ أَكُونَ مِنَ ٱلۡمُسۡلِمِينَ
translation: And if you turn away [from my advice] then no payment have I asked of you. My reward is only from Allah, and I have been commanded to be of the Muslims
normalizedArabic: فان توليتم فما سالتكم من اجر ان اجري الا علي الله وامرت ان اكون من المسلمين
normalizedTranslation: and if you turn away [from my advice] then no payment have i asked of you. my reward is only from allah, and i have been commanded to be of the muslims

arabic: فَكَذَّبُوهُ فَنَجَّيۡنَٰهُ وَمَن مَّعَهُۥ فِي ٱلۡفُلۡكِ وَجَعَلۡنَٰهُمۡ خَلَـٰٓئِفَ وَأَغۡرَقۡنَا ٱلَّذِينَ كَذَّبُواْ بِـَٔايَٰتِنَاۖ فَٱنظُرۡ كَيۡفَ كَانَ عَٰقِبَةُ ٱلۡمُنذَرِينَ
translation: And they denied him, so We saved him and those with him in the ship and made them successors, and We drowned those who denied Our signs. Then see how was the end of those who were warned

normalizedTranslation: and they denied him, so we saved him and those with him in the ship and made them successors, and we drowned those who denied our signs. then see how was the end of those who were warned

arabic: ثُمَّ بَعَثۡنَا مِنۢ بَعۡدِهِۦ رُسُلًا إِلَىٰ قَوۡمِهِمۡ فَجَآءُوهُم بِٱلۡبَيِّنَٰتِ فَمَا كَانُواْ لِيُؤۡمِنُواْ بِمَا كَذَّبُواْ بِهِۦ مِن قَبۡلُۚ كَذَٰلِكَ نَطۡبَعُ عَلَىٰ قُلُوبِ ٱلۡمُعۡتَدِينَ

normalizedTranslation: then we sent after him messengers to their peoples, and they came to them with clear proofs. but they were not to believe in that which they had denied before. thus we seal over the hearts of the transgressors
