normalizedArabic: فاليوم ننجيك ببدنك لتكون لمن خلفك ءايه وان كثيرا من الناس عن ءايتنا لغفلون
normalizedTranslation: so today we will save you in body that you may be to those who succeed you a sign. and indeed, many among the people, of our signs, are heedless

arabic: وَلَقَدۡ بَوَّأۡنَا بَنِيٓ إِسۡرَـٰٓءِيلَ مُبَوَّأَ صِدۡقٖ وَرَزَقۡنَٰهُم مِّنَ ٱلطَّيِّبَٰتِ فَمَا ٱخۡتَلَفُواْ حَتَّىٰ جَآءَهُمُ ٱلۡعِلۡمُۚ إِنَّ رَبَّكَ يَقۡضِي بَيۡنَهُمۡ يَوۡمَ ٱلۡقِيَٰمَةِ فِيمَا كَانُواْ فِيهِ يَخۡتَلِفُونَ
translation: And We had certainty settled the Children of Israel in an agreeable settlement and provided them with good things. And they did not differ until [after] knowledge had come to them. Indeed, your Lord will judge between them on the Day of Resurrection concerning that over which they used to differ
normalizedArabic: ولقد بوانا بني اسرءيل مبوا صدق ورزقنهم من الطيبت فما اختلفوا حتي جاءهم العلم ان ربك يقضي بينهم يوم القيمه فيما كانوا فيه يختلفون
normalizedTranslation: and we had certainty settled the children of israel in an agreeable settlement and provided them with good things. and they did not differ until [after] knowledge had come to them. indeed, your lord will judge between them on the day of resurrection concerning that over which they used to differ

arabic: فَإِن كُنتَ فِي شَكّٖ مِّمَّآ أَنزَلۡنَآ إِلَيۡكَ فَسۡـَٔلِ ٱلَّذِينَ يَقۡرَءُونَ ٱلۡكِتَٰبَ مِن قَبۡلِكَۚ لَقَدۡ جَآءَكَ ٱلۡحَقُّ مِن رَّبِّكَ فَلَا تَكُونَنَّ مِنَ ٱلۡمُمۡتَرِينَ
translation: So if you are in doubt, [O Muhammad], about that which We have revealed to you, then ask those who have been reading the Scripture before you. The truth has certainly come to you from your Lord, so never be among the doubters
normalizedArabic: فان كنت في شك مما انزلنا اليك فسل الذين يقرءون الكتب من قبلك لقد جاءك الحق من ربك فلا تكونن من الممترين
normalizedTranslation: so if you are in doubt, [o muhammad], about that which we have revealed to you, then ask those who have been reading the scripture before you. the truth has certainly come to you from your lord, so never be among the doubters

arabic: وَلَا تَكُونَنَّ مِنَ ٱلَّذِينَ كَذَّبُواْ بِـَٔايَٰتِ ٱللَّهِ فَتَكُونَ مِنَ ٱلۡخَٰسِرِينَ
translation: And never be of those who deny the signs of Allah and [thus] be among the losers
normalizedArabic: ولا تكونن من الذين كذبوا بايت الله فتكون من الخسرين
normalizedTranslation: and never be of those who deny the signs of allah and [thus] be among the losers

arabic: إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ حَقَّتۡ عَلَيۡهِمۡ كَلِمَتُ رَبِّكَ لَا يُؤۡمِنُونَ
translation: Indeed, those upon whom the word of your Lord has come into effect will not believe
normalizedArabic: ان الذين حقت عليهم كلمت ربك لا يومنون
normalizedTranslation: indeed, those upon whom the word of your lord has come into effect will not believe

arabic: وَلَوۡ جَآءَتۡهُمۡ كُلُّ ءَايَةٍ حَتَّىٰ يَرَوُاْ ٱلۡعَذَابَ ٱلۡأَلِيمَ
translation: Even if every sign should come to them, until they see the painful punishment
normalizedArabic: ولو جاءتهم كل ءايه حتي يروا العذاب الاليم
normalizedTranslation: even if every sign should come to them, until they see the painful punishment

arabic: فَلَوۡلَا كَانَتۡ قَرۡيَةٌ ءَامَنَتۡ فَنَفَعَهَآ إِيمَٰنُهَآ إِلَّا قَوۡمَ يُونُسَ لَمَّآ ءَامَنُواْ كَشَفۡنَا عَنۡهُمۡ عَذَابَ ٱلۡخِزۡيِ فِي ٱلۡحَيَوٰةِ ٱلدُّنۡيَا وَمَتَّعۡنَٰهُمۡ إِلَىٰ حِينٖ
translation: Then has there not been a [single] city that believed so its faith benefited it except the people of Jonah? When they believed, We removed from them the punishment of disgrace in worldly life and gave them enjoyment for a time
normalizedArabic: فلولا كانت قريه ءامنت فنفعها ايمنها الا قوم يونس لما ءامنوا كشفنا عنهم عذاب الخزي في الحيوه الدنيا ومتعنهم الي حين
normalizedTranslation: then has there not been a [single] city that believed so its faith benefited it except the people of jonah? when they believed, we removed from them the punishment of disgrace in worldly life and gave them enjoyment for a time

arabic: وَلَوۡ شَآءَ رَبُّكَ لَأٓمَنَ مَن فِي ٱلۡأَرۡضِ كُلُّهُمۡ جَمِيعًاۚ أَفَأَنتَ تُكۡرِهُ ٱلنَّاسَ حَتَّىٰ يَكُونُواْ مُؤۡمِنِينَ
translation: And had your Lord willed, those on earth would have believed - all of them entirely. Then, [O Muhammad], would you compel the people in order that they become believers
normalizedArabic: ولو شاء ربك لامن من في الارض كلهم جميعا افانت تكره الناس حتي يكونوا مومنين
normalizedTranslation: and had your lord willed, those on earth would have believed - all of them entirely. then, [o muhammad], would you compel the people in order that they become believers

arabic: وَمَا كَانَ لِنَفۡسٍ أَن تُؤۡمِنَ إِلَّا بِإِذۡنِ ٱللَّهِۚ وَيَجۡعَلُ ٱلرِّجۡسَ عَلَى ٱلَّذِينَ لَا يَعۡقِلُونَ
translation: And it is not for a soul to believe except by permission of Allah, and He will place defilement upon those who will not use reason
normalizedArabic: وما كان لنفس ان تومن الا باذن الله ويجعل الرجس علي الذين لا يعقلون
normalizedTranslation: and it is not for a soul to believe except by permission of allah, and he will place defilement upon those who will not use reason

arabic: قُلِ ٱنظُرُواْ مَاذَا فِي ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلۡأَرۡضِۚ وَمَا تُغۡنِي ٱلۡأٓيَٰتُ وَٱلنُّذُرُ عَن قَوۡمٖ لَّا يُؤۡمِنُونَ
translation: Say, "Observe what is in the heavens and earth." But of no avail will be signs or warners to a people who do not believe
normalizedArabic: قل انظروا ماذا في السموت والارض وما تغني الايت والنذر عن قوم لا يومنون
normalizedTranslation: say, "observe what is in the heavens and earth." but of no avail will be signs or warners to a people who do not believe

arabic: فَهَلۡ يَنتَظِرُونَ إِلَّا مِثۡلَ أَيَّامِ ٱلَّذِينَ خَلَوۡاْ مِن قَبۡلِهِمۡۚ قُلۡ فَٱنتَظِرُوٓاْ إِنِّي مَعَكُم مِّنَ ٱلۡمُنتَظِرِينَ
translation: So do they wait except for like [what occurred in] the days of those who passed on before them? Say, "Then wait; indeed, I am with you among those who wait
normalizedArabic: فهل ينتظرون الا مثل ايام الذين خلوا من قبلهم قل فانتظروا اني معكم من المنتظرين
normalizedTranslation: so do they wait except for like [what occurred in] the days of those who passed on before them? say, "then wait; indeed, i am with you among those who wait

arabic: ثُمَّ نُنَجِّي رُسُلَنَا وَٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُواْۚ كَذَٰلِكَ حَقًّا عَلَيۡنَا نُنجِ ٱلۡمُؤۡمِنِينَ
translation: Then We will save our messengers and those who have believed. Thus, it is an obligation upon Us that We save the believers
normalizedArabic: ثم ننجي رسلنا والذين ءامنوا كذلك حقا علينا ننج المومنين
normalizedTranslation: then we will save our messengers and those who have believed. thus, it is an obligation upon us that we save the believers

arabic: قُلۡ يَـٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلنَّاسُ إِن كُنتُمۡ فِي شَكّٖ مِّن دِينِي فَلَآ أَعۡبُدُ ٱلَّذِينَ تَعۡبُدُونَ مِن دُونِ ٱللَّهِ وَلَٰكِنۡ أَعۡبُدُ ٱللَّهَ ٱلَّذِي يَتَوَفَّىٰكُمۡۖ وَأُمِرۡتُ أَنۡ أَكُونَ مِنَ ٱلۡمُؤۡمِنِينَ
translation: Say, [O Muhammad], "O people, if you are in doubt as to my religion - then I do not worship those which you worship besides Allah; but I worship Allah, who causes your death. And I have been commanded to be of the believers
normalizedArabic: قل يايها الناس ان كنتم في شك من ديني فلا اعبد الذين تعبدون من دون الله ولكن اعبد الله الذي يتوفيكم وامرت ان اكون من المومنين
normalizedTranslation: say, [o muhammad], "o people, if you are in doubt as to my religion - then i do not worship those which you worship besides allah; but i worship allah, who causes your death. and i have been commanded to be of the believers

arabic: وَأَنۡ أَقِمۡ وَجۡهَكَ لِلدِّينِ حَنِيفٗا وَلَا تَكُونَنَّ مِنَ ٱلۡمُشۡرِكِينَ
translation: And [commanded], 'Direct your face toward the religion, inclining to truth, and never be of those who associate others with Allah
normalizedArabic: وان اقم وجهك للدين حنيفا ولا تكونن من المشركين
normalizedTranslation: and [commanded], 'direct your face toward the religion, inclining to truth, and never be of those who associate others with allah

arabic: وَلَا تَدۡعُ مِن دُونِ ٱللَّهِ مَا لَا يَنفَعُكَ وَلَا يَضُرُّكَۖ فَإِن فَعَلۡتَ فَإِنَّكَ إِذٗا مِّنَ ٱلظَّـٰلِمِينَ
translation: And do not invoke besides Allah that which neither benefits you nor harms you, for if you did, then indeed you would be of the wrongdoers
normalizedArabic: ولا تدع من دون الله ما لا ينفعك ولا يضرك فان فعلت فانك اذا من الظلمين
normalizedTranslation: and do not invoke besides allah that which neither benefits you nor harms you, for if you did, then indeed you would be of the wrongdoers

arabic: وَإِن يَمۡسَسۡكَ ٱللَّهُ بِضُرّٖ فَلَا كَاشِفَ لَهُۥٓ إِلَّا هُوَۖ وَإِن يُرِدۡكَ بِخَيۡرٖ فَلَا رَآدَّ لِفَضۡلِهِۦۚ يُصِيبُ بِهِۦ مَن يَشَآءُ مِنۡ عِبَادِهِۦۚ وَهُوَ ٱلۡغَفُورُ ٱلرَّحِيمُ
translation: And if Allah should touch you with adversity, there is no remover of it except Him; and if He intends for you good, then there is no repeller of His bounty. He causes it to reach whom He wills of His servants. And He is the Forgiving, the Merciful
normalizedArabic: وان يمسسك الله بضر فلا كاشف له الا هو وان يردك بخير فلا راد لفضله يصيب به من يشاء من عباده وهو الغفور الرحيم
normalizedTranslation: and if allah should touch you with adversity, there is no remover of it except him; and if he intends for you good, then there is no repeller of his bounty. he causes it to reach whom he wills of his servants. and he is the forgiving, the merciful

arabic: قُلۡ يَـٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلنَّاسُ قَدۡ جَآءَكُمُ ٱلۡحَقُّ مِن رَّبِّكُمۡۖ فَمَنِ ٱهۡتَدَىٰ فَإِنَّمَا يَهۡتَدِي لِنَفۡسِهِۦۖ وَمَن ضَلَّ فَإِنَّمَا يَضِلُّ عَلَيۡهَاۖ وَمَآ أَنَا۠ عَلَيۡكُم بِوَكِيلٖ
translation: Say, "O mankind, the truth has come to you from your Lord, so whoever is guided is only guided for [the benefit of] his soul, and whoever goes astray only goes astray [in violation] against it. And I am not over you a manager
normalizedArabic: قل يايها الناس قد جاءكم الحق من ربكم فمن اهتدي فانما يهتدي لنفسه ومن ضل فانما يضل عليها وما انا عليكم بوكيل
normalizedTranslation: say, "o mankind, the truth has come to you from your lord, so whoever is guided is only guided for [the benefit of] his soul, and whoever goes astray only goes astray [in violation] against it. and i am not over you a manager

arabic: وَٱتَّبِعۡ مَا يُوحَىٰٓ إِلَيۡكَ وَٱصۡبِرۡ حَتَّىٰ يَحۡكُمَ ٱللَّهُۚ وَهُوَ خَيۡرُ ٱلۡحَٰكِمِينَ
translation: And follow what is revealed to you, [O Muhammad], and be patient until Allah will judge. And He is the best of judges
normalizedArabic: واتبع ما يوحي اليك واصبر حتي يحكم الله وهو خير الحكمين
normalizedTranslation: and follow what is revealed to you, [o muhammad], and be patient until allah will judge. and he is the best of judges

arabic: الٓرۚ كِتَٰبٌ أُحۡكِمَتۡ ءَايَٰتُهُۥ ثُمَّ فُصِّلَتۡ مِن لَّدُنۡ حَكِيمٍ خَبِيرٍ
translation: Alif, Lam, Ra. [This is] a Book whose verses are perfected and then presented in detail from [one who is] Wise and Acquainted
normalizedArabic: الر كتب احكمت ءايته ثم فصلت من لدن حكيم خبير
normalizedTranslation: alif, lam, ra. [this is] a book whose verses are perfected and then presented in detail from [one who is] wise and acquainted

arabic: أَلَّا تَعۡبُدُوٓاْ إِلَّا ٱللَّهَۚ إِنَّنِي لَكُم مِّنۡهُ نَذِيرٞ وَبَشِيرٞ
translation: [Through a messenger, saying], "Do not worship except Allah. Indeed, I am to you from Him a warner and a bringer of good tidings
normalizedArabic: الا تعبدوا الا الله انني لكم منه نذير وبشير
normalizedTranslation: [through a messenger, saying], "do not worship except allah. indeed, i am to you from him a warner and a bringer of good tidings

arabic: وَأَنِ ٱسۡتَغۡفِرُواْ رَبَّكُمۡ ثُمَّ تُوبُوٓاْ إِلَيۡهِ يُمَتِّعۡكُم مَّتَٰعًا حَسَنًا إِلَىٰٓ أَجَلٖ مُّسَمّٗى وَيُؤۡتِ كُلَّ ذِي فَضۡلٖ فَضۡلَهُۥۖ وَإِن تَوَلَّوۡاْ فَإِنِّيٓ أَخَافُ عَلَيۡكُمۡ عَذَابَ يَوۡمٖ كَبِيرٍ
translation: And [saying], "Seek forgiveness of your Lord and repent to Him, [and] He will let you enjoy a good provision for a specified term and give every doer of favor his favor. But if you turn away, then indeed, I fear for you the punishment of a great Day
normalizedArabic: وان استغفروا ربكم ثم توبوا اليه يمتعكم متعا حسنا الي اجل مسمي ويوت كل ذي فضل فضله وان تولوا فاني اخاف عليكم عذاب يوم كبير
normalizedTranslation: and [saying], "seek forgiveness of your lord and repent to him, [and] he will let you enjoy a good provision for a specified term and give every doer of favor his favor. but if you turn away, then indeed, i fear for you the punishment of a great day

arabic: إِلَى ٱللَّهِ مَرۡجِعُكُمۡۖ وَهُوَ عَلَىٰ كُلِّ شَيۡءٖ قَدِيرٌ
translation: To Allah is your return, and He is over all things competent
normalizedArabic: الي الله مرجعكم وهو علي كل شيء قدير
normalizedTranslation: to allah is your return, and he is over all things competent

arabic: أَلَآ إِنَّهُمۡ يَثۡنُونَ صُدُورَهُمۡ لِيَسۡتَخۡفُواْ مِنۡهُۚ أَلَا حِينَ يَسۡتَغۡشُونَ ثِيَابَهُمۡ يَعۡلَمُ مَا يُسِرُّونَ وَمَا يُعۡلِنُونَۚ إِنَّهُۥ عَلِيمُۢ بِذَاتِ ٱلصُّدُورِ
translation: Unquestionably, they the disbelievers turn away their breasts to hide themselves from Him. Unquestionably, [even] when they cover themselves in their clothing, Allah knows what they conceal and what they declare. Indeed, He is Knowing of that within the breasts
normalizedArabic: الا انهم يثنون صدورهم ليستخفوا منه الا حين يستغشون ثيابهم يعلم ما يسرون وما يعلنون انه عليم بذات الصدور
normalizedTranslation: unquestionably, they the disbelievers turn away their breasts to hide themselves from him. unquestionably, [even] when they cover themselves in their clothing, allah knows what they conceal and what they declare. indeed, he is knowing of that within the breasts

arabic: ۞وَمَا مِن دَآبَّةٖ فِي ٱلۡأَرۡضِ إِلَّا عَلَى ٱللَّهِ رِزۡقُهَا وَيَعۡلَمُ مُسۡتَقَرَّهَا وَمُسۡتَوۡدَعَهَاۚ كُلّٞ فِي كِتَٰبٖ مُّبِينٖ
translation: And there is no creature on earth but that upon Allah is its provision, and He knows its place of dwelling and place of storage. All is in a clear register
normalizedArabic: وما من دابه في الارض الا علي الله رزقها ويعلم مستقرها ومستودعها كل في كتب مبين
normalizedTranslation: and there is no creature on earth but that upon allah is its provision, and he knows its place of dwelling and place of storage. all is in a clear register

arabic: وَهُوَ ٱلَّذِي خَلَقَ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلۡأَرۡضَ فِي سِتَّةِ أَيَّامٖ وَكَانَ عَرۡشُهُۥ عَلَى ٱلۡمَآءِ لِيَبۡلُوَكُمۡ أَيُّكُمۡ أَحۡسَنُ عَمَلٗاۗ وَلَئِن قُلۡتَ إِنَّكُم مَّبۡعُوثُونَ مِنۢ بَعۡدِ ٱلۡمَوۡتِ لَيَقُولَنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوٓاْ إِنۡ هَٰذَآ إِلَّا سِحۡرٞ مُّبِينٞ
translation: And it is He who created the heavens and the earth in six days - and His Throne had been upon water - that He might test you as to which of you is best in deed. But if you say, "Indeed, you are resurrected after death," those who disbelieve will surely say, "This is not but obvious magic
normalizedArabic: وهو الذي خلق السموت والارض في سته ايام وكان عرشه علي الماء ليبلوكم ايكم احسن عملا ولين قلت انكم مبعوثون من بعد الموت ليقولن الذين كفروا ان هذا الا سحر مبين
normalizedTranslation: and it is he who created the heavens and the earth in six days - and his throne had been upon water - that he might test you as to which of you is best in deed. but if you say, "indeed, you are resurrected after death," those who disbelieve will surely say, "this is not but obvious magic

arabic: وَلَئِنۡ أَخَّرۡنَا عَنۡهُمُ ٱلۡعَذَابَ إِلَىٰٓ أُمَّةٖ مَّعۡدُودَةٖ لَّيَقُولُنَّ مَا يَحۡبِسُهُۥٓۗ أَلَا يَوۡمَ يَأۡتِيهِمۡ لَيۡسَ مَصۡرُوفًا عَنۡهُمۡ وَحَاقَ بِهِم مَّا كَانُواْ بِهِۦ يَسۡتَهۡزِءُونَ
translation: And if We hold back from them the punishment for a limited time, they will surely say, "What detains it?" Unquestionably, on the Day it comes to them, it will not be averted from them, and they will be enveloped by what they used to ridicule
normalizedArabic: ولين اخرنا عنهم العذاب الي امه معدوده ليقولن ما يحبسه الا يوم ياتيهم ليس مصروفا عنهم وحاق بهم ما كانوا به يستهزءون

arabic: وَلَئِنۡ أَذَقۡنَا ٱلۡإِنسَٰنَ مِنَّا رَحۡمَةٗ ثُمَّ نَزَعۡنَٰهَا مِنۡهُ إِنَّهُۥ لَيَـُٔوسٞ كَفُورٞ

translation: But if We give him a taste of favor after hardship has touched him, he will surely say, "Bad times have left me." Indeed, he is exultant and boastful

arabic: فَلَعَلَّكَ تَارِكُۢ بَعۡضَ مَا يُوحَىٰٓ إِلَيۡكَ وَضَآئِقُۢ بِهِۦ صَدۡرُكَ أَن يَقُولُواْ لَوۡلَآ أُنزِلَ عَلَيۡهِ كَنزٌ أَوۡ جَآءَ مَعَهُۥ مَلَكٌۚ إِنَّمَآ أَنتَ نَذِيرٞۚ وَٱللَّهُ عَلَىٰ كُلِّ شَيۡءٖ وَكِيلٌ
translation: Then would you possibly leave [out] some of what is revealed to you, or is your breast constrained by it because they say, "Why has there not been sent down to him a treasure or come with him an angel?" But you are only a warner. And Allah is Disposer of all things

normalizedTranslation: then would you possibly leave [out] some of what is revealed to you, or is your breast constrained by it because they say, "why has there not been sent down to him a treasure or come with him an angel?" but you are only a warner. and allah is disposer of all things

normalizedTranslation: or do they say, "he invented it"? say, "then bring ten surahs like it that have been invented and call upon [for assistance] whomever you can besides allah, if you should be truthful

arabic: مَن كَانَ يُرِيدُ ٱلۡحَيَوٰةَ ٱلدُّنۡيَا وَزِينَتَهَا نُوَفِّ إِلَيۡهِمۡ أَعۡمَٰلَهُمۡ فِيهَا وَهُمۡ فِيهَا لَا يُبۡخَسُونَ
translation: Whoever desires the life of this world and its adornments - We fully repay them for their deeds therein, and they therein will not be deprived

arabic: أُوْلَـٰٓئِكَ ٱلَّذِينَ لَيۡسَ لَهُمۡ فِي ٱلۡأٓخِرَةِ إِلَّا ٱلنَّارُۖ وَحَبِطَ مَا صَنَعُواْ فِيهَا وَبَٰطِلٞ مَّا كَانُواْ يَعۡمَلُونَ

arabic: قَالُواْ يَٰنُوحُ قَدۡ جَٰدَلۡتَنَا فَأَكۡثَرۡتَ جِدَٰلَنَا فَأۡتِنَا بِمَا تَعِدُنَآ إِن كُنتَ مِنَ ٱلصَّـٰدِقِينَ
translation: They said, "O Noah, you have disputed us and been frequent in dispute of us. So bring us what you threaten us, if you should be of the truthful

normalizedTranslation: they said, "o noah, you have disputed us and been frequent in dispute of us. so bring us what you threaten us, if you should be of the truthful

arabic: قَالَ إِنَّمَا يَأۡتِيكُم بِهِ ٱللَّهُ إِن شَآءَ وَمَآ أَنتُم بِمُعۡجِزِينَ
translation: He said, "Allah will only bring it to you if He wills, and you will not cause [Him] failure
normalizedArabic: قال انما ياتيكم به الله ان شاء وما انتم بمعجزين
normalizedTranslation: he said, "allah will only bring it to you if he wills, and you will not cause [him] failure

arabic: وَلَا يَنفَعُكُمۡ نُصۡحِيٓ إِنۡ أَرَدتُّ أَنۡ أَنصَحَ لَكُمۡ إِن كَانَ ٱللَّهُ يُرِيدُ أَن يُغۡوِيَكُمۡۚ هُوَ رَبُّكُمۡ وَإِلَيۡهِ تُرۡجَعُونَ
translation: And my advice will not benefit you - although I wished to advise you - If Allah should intend to put you in error. He is your Lord, and to Him you will be returned
normalizedArabic: ولا ينفعكم نصحي ان اردت ان انصح لكم ان كان الله يريد ان يغويكم هو ربكم واليه ترجعون
normalizedTranslation: and my advice will not benefit you - although i wished to advise you - if allah should intend to put you in error. he is your lord, and to him you will be returned

arabic: أَمۡ يَقُولُونَ ٱفۡتَرَىٰهُۖ قُلۡ إِنِ ٱفۡتَرَيۡتُهُۥ فَعَلَيَّ إِجۡرَامِي وَأَنَا۠ بَرِيٓءٞ مِّمَّا تُجۡرِمُونَ
translation: Or do they say [about Prophet Muhammad], "He invented it"? Say, "If I have invented it, then upon me is [the consequence of] my crime; but I am innocent of what [crimes] you commit
normalizedArabic: ام يقولون افتريه قل ان افتريته فعلي اجرامي وانا بريء مما تجرمون
normalizedTranslation: or do they say [about prophet muhammad], "he invented it"? say, "if i have invented it, then upon me is [the consequence of] my crime; but i am innocent of what [crimes] you commit

arabic: وَأُوحِيَ إِلَىٰ نُوحٍ أَنَّهُۥ لَن يُؤۡمِنَ مِن قَوۡمِكَ إِلَّا مَن قَدۡ ءَامَنَ فَلَا تَبۡتَئِسۡ بِمَا كَانُواْ يَفۡعَلُونَ
translation: And it was revealed to Noah that, "No one will believe from your people except those who have already believed, so do not be distressed by what they have been doing
normalizedArabic: واوحي الي نوح انه لن يومن من قومك الا من قد ءامن فلا تبتيس بما كانوا يفعلون
normalizedTranslation: and it was revealed to noah that, "no one will believe from your people except those who have already believed, so do not be distressed by what they have been doing

arabic: وَٱصۡنَعِ ٱلۡفُلۡكَ بِأَعۡيُنِنَا وَوَحۡيِنَا وَلَا تُخَٰطِبۡنِي فِي ٱلَّذِينَ ظَلَمُوٓاْ إِنَّهُم مُّغۡرَقُونَ
translation: And construct the ship under Our observation and Our inspiration and do not address Me concerning those who have wronged; indeed, they are [to be] drowned
normalizedArabic: واصنع الفلك باعيننا ووحينا ولا تخطبني في الذين ظلموا انهم مغرقون
normalizedTranslation: and construct the ship under our observation and our inspiration and do not address me concerning those who have wronged; indeed, they are [to be] drowned

arabic: وَيَصۡنَعُ ٱلۡفُلۡكَ وَكُلَّمَا مَرَّ عَلَيۡهِ مَلَأٞ مِّن قَوۡمِهِۦ سَخِرُواْ مِنۡهُۚ قَالَ إِن تَسۡخَرُواْ مِنَّا فَإِنَّا نَسۡخَرُ مِنكُمۡ كَمَا تَسۡخَرُونَ
translation: And he constructed the ship, and whenever an assembly of the eminent of his people passed by him, they ridiculed him. He said, "If you ridicule us, then we will ridicule you just as you ridicule
normalizedArabic: ويصنع الفلك وكلما مر عليه ملا من قومه سخروا منه قال ان تسخروا منا فانا نسخر منكم كما تسخرون
normalizedTranslation: and he constructed the ship, and whenever an assembly of the eminent of his people passed by him, they ridiculed him. he said, "if you ridicule us, then we will ridicule you just as you ridicule

arabic: فَسَوۡفَ تَعۡلَمُونَ مَن يَأۡتِيهِ عَذَابٞ يُخۡزِيهِ وَيَحِلُّ عَلَيۡهِ عَذَابٞ مُّقِيمٌ
translation: And you are going to know who will get a punishment that will disgrace him [on earth] and upon whom will descend an enduring punishment [in the Hereafter]
normalizedArabic: فسوف تعلمون من ياتيه عذاب يخزيه ويحل عليه عذاب مقيم
normalizedTranslation: and you are going to know who will get a punishment that will disgrace him [on earth] and upon whom will descend an enduring punishment [in the hereafter]

arabic: حَتَّىٰٓ إِذَا جَآءَ أَمۡرُنَا وَفَارَ ٱلتَّنُّورُ قُلۡنَا ٱحۡمِلۡ فِيهَا مِن كُلّٖ زَوۡجَيۡنِ ٱثۡنَيۡنِ وَأَهۡلَكَ إِلَّا مَن سَبَقَ عَلَيۡهِ ٱلۡقَوۡلُ وَمَنۡ ءَامَنَۚ وَمَآ ءَامَنَ مَعَهُۥٓ إِلَّا قَلِيلٞ
translation: [So it was], until when Our command came and the oven overflowed, We said, "Load upon the ship of each [creature] two mates and your family, except those about whom the word has preceded, and [include] whoever has believed." But none had believed with him, except a few
normalizedArabic: حتي اذا جاء امرنا وفار التنور قلنا احمل فيها من كل زوجين اثنين واهلك الا من سبق عليه القول ومن ءامن وما ءامن معه الا قليل
normalizedTranslation: [so it was], until when our command came and the oven overflowed, we said, "load upon the ship of each [creature] two mates and your family, except those about whom the word has preceded, and [include] whoever has believed." but none had believed with him, except a few

arabic: ۞وَقَالَ ٱرۡكَبُواْ فِيهَا بِسۡمِ ٱللَّهِ مَجۡرٜىٰهَا وَمُرۡسَىٰهَآۚ إِنَّ رَبِّي لَغَفُورٞ رَّحِيمٞ
translation: And [Noah] said, "Embark therein; in the name of Allah is its course and its anchorage. Indeed, my Lord is Forgiving and Merciful

normalizedTranslation: and [noah] said, "embark therein; in the name of allah is its course and its anchorage. indeed, my lord is forgiving and merciful

translation: And it sailed with them through waves like mountains, and Noah called to his son who was apart [from them], "O my son, come aboard with us and be not with the disbelievers

normalizedTranslation: and it sailed with them through waves like mountains, and noah called to his son who was apart [from them], "o my son, come aboard with us and be not with the disbelievers

arabic: قَالَ سَـَٔاوِيٓ إِلَىٰ جَبَلٖ يَعۡصِمُنِي مِنَ ٱلۡمَآءِۚ قَالَ لَا عَاصِمَ ٱلۡيَوۡمَ مِنۡ أَمۡرِ ٱللَّهِ إِلَّا مَن رَّحِمَۚ وَحَالَ بَيۡنَهُمَا ٱلۡمَوۡجُ فَكَانَ مِنَ ٱلۡمُغۡرَقِينَ

normalizedTranslation: [but] he said, "i will take refuge on a mountain to protect me from the water." [noah] said, "there is no protector today from the decree of allah, except for whom he gives mercy." and the waves came between them, and he was among the drowned

arabic: وَقِيلَ يَـٰٓأَرۡضُ ٱبۡلَعِي مَآءَكِ وَيَٰسَمَآءُ أَقۡلِعِي وَغِيضَ ٱلۡمَآءُ وَقُضِيَ ٱلۡأَمۡرُ وَٱسۡتَوَتۡ عَلَى ٱلۡجُودِيِّۖ وَقِيلَ بُعۡدٗا لِّلۡقَوۡمِ ٱلظَّـٰلِمِينَ
translation: And it was said, "O earth, swallow your water, and O sky, withhold [your rain]." And the water subsided, and the matter was accomplished, and the ship came to rest on the [mountain of] Judiyy. And it was said, "Away with the wrongdoing people

normalizedTranslation: and it was said, "o earth, swallow your water, and o sky, withhold [your rain]." and the water subsided, and the matter was accomplished, and the ship came to rest on the [mountain of] judiyy. and it was said, "away with the wrongdoing people

translation: And Noah called to his Lord and said, "My Lord, indeed my son is of my family; and indeed, Your promise is true; and You are the most just of judges

normalizedTranslation: that is from the news of the unseen which we reveal to you, [o muhammad]. you knew it not, neither you nor your people, before this. so be patient; indeed, the [best] outcome is for the righteous

translation: Indeed, I have relied upon Allah, my Lord and your Lord. There is no creature but that He holds its forelock. Indeed, my Lord is on a path [that is] straight

translation: And to Thamud [We sent] their brother Salih. He said, "O my people, worship Allah; you have no deity other than Him. He has produced you from the earth and settled you in it, so ask forgiveness of Him and then repent to Him. Indeed, my Lord is near and responsive

normalizedTranslation: and to thamud [we sent] their brother salih. he said, "o my people, worship allah; you have no deity other than him. he has produced you from the earth and settled you in it, so ask forgiveness of him and then repent to him. indeed, my lord is near and responsive

arabic: قَالُواْ يَٰصَٰلِحُ قَدۡ كُنتَ فِينَا مَرۡجُوّٗا قَبۡلَ هَٰذَآۖ أَتَنۡهَىٰنَآ أَن نَّعۡبُدَ مَا يَعۡبُدُ ءَابَآؤُنَا وَإِنَّنَا لَفِي شَكّٖ مِّمَّا تَدۡعُونَآ إِلَيۡهِ مُرِيبٖ
translation: They said, "O Salih, you were among us a man of promise before this. Do you forbid us to worship what our fathers worshipped? And indeed we are, about that to which you invite us, in disquieting doubt

normalizedTranslation: they said, "o salih, you were among us a man of promise before this. do you forbid us to worship what our fathers worshipped? and indeed we are, about that to which you invite us, in disquieting doubt

arabic: قَالَ يَٰقَوۡمِ أَرَءَيۡتُمۡ إِن كُنتُ عَلَىٰ بَيِّنَةٖ مِّن رَّبِّي وَءَاتَىٰنِي مِنۡهُ رَحۡمَةٗ فَمَن يَنصُرُنِي مِنَ ٱللَّهِ إِنۡ عَصَيۡتُهُۥۖ فَمَا تَزِيدُونَنِي غَيۡرَ تَخۡسِيرٖ

normalizedTranslation: he said, "o my people, have you considered: if i should be upon clear evidence from my lord and he has given me mercy from himself, who would protect me from allah if i disobeyed him? so you would not increase me except in loss

arabic: فَلَمَّا جَآءَ أَمۡرُنَا جَعَلۡنَا عَٰلِيَهَا سَافِلَهَا وَأَمۡطَرۡنَا عَلَيۡهَا حِجَارَةٗ مِّن سِجِّيلٖ مَّنضُودٖ
translation: So when Our command came, We made the highest part [of the city] its lowest and rained upon them stones of layered hard clay, [which were]
normalizedArabic: فلما جاء امرنا جعلنا عليها سافلها وامطرنا عليها حجاره من سجيل منضود
normalizedTranslation: so when our command came, we made the highest part [of the city] its lowest and rained upon them stones of layered hard clay, [which were]

arabic: مُّسَوَّمَةً عِندَ رَبِّكَۖ وَمَا هِيَ مِنَ ٱلظَّـٰلِمِينَ بِبَعِيدٖ
translation: Marked from your Lord. And Allah 's punishment is not from the wrongdoers [very] far
normalizedArabic: مسومه عند ربك وما هي من الظلمين ببعيد
normalizedTranslation: marked from your lord. and allah 's punishment is not from the wrongdoers [very] far

arabic: ۞وَإِلَىٰ مَدۡيَنَ أَخَاهُمۡ شُعَيۡبٗاۚ قَالَ يَٰقَوۡمِ ٱعۡبُدُواْ ٱللَّهَ مَا لَكُم مِّنۡ إِلَٰهٍ غَيۡرُهُۥۖ وَلَا تَنقُصُواْ ٱلۡمِكۡيَالَ وَٱلۡمِيزَانَۖ إِنِّيٓ أَرَىٰكُم بِخَيۡرٖ وَإِنِّيٓ أَخَافُ عَلَيۡكُمۡ عَذَابَ يَوۡمٖ مُّحِيطٖ
translation: And to Madyan [We sent] their brother Shu'ayb. He said, "O my people, worship Allah; you have no deity other than Him. And do not decrease from the measure and the scale. Indeed, I see you in prosperity, but indeed, I fear for you the punishment of an all-encompassing Day
normalizedArabic: والي مدين اخاهم شعيبا قال يقوم اعبدوا الله ما لكم من اله غيره ولا تنقصوا المكيال والميزان اني اريكم بخير واني اخاف عليكم عذاب يوم محيط
normalizedTranslation: and to madyan [we sent] their brother shu'ayb. he said, "o my people, worship allah; you have no deity other than him. and do not decrease from the measure and the scale. indeed, i see you in prosperity, but indeed, i fear for you the punishment of an all-encompassing day

arabic: وَيَٰقَوۡمِ أَوۡفُواْ ٱلۡمِكۡيَالَ وَٱلۡمِيزَانَ بِٱلۡقِسۡطِۖ وَلَا تَبۡخَسُواْ ٱلنَّاسَ أَشۡيَآءَهُمۡ وَلَا تَعۡثَوۡاْ فِي ٱلۡأَرۡضِ مُفۡسِدِينَ
translation: And O my people, give full measure and weight in justice and do not deprive the people of their due and do not commit abuse on the earth, spreading corruption
normalizedArabic: ويقوم اوفوا المكيال والميزان بالقسط ولا تبخسوا الناس اشياءهم ولا تعثوا في الارض مفسدين
normalizedTranslation: and o my people, give full measure and weight in justice and do not deprive the people of their due and do not commit abuse on the earth, spreading corruption

arabic: بَقِيَّتُ ٱللَّهِ خَيۡرٞ لَّكُمۡ إِن كُنتُم مُّؤۡمِنِينَۚ وَمَآ أَنَا۠ عَلَيۡكُم بِحَفِيظٖ
translation: What remains [lawful] from Allah is best for you, if you would be believers. But I am not a guardian over you
normalizedArabic: بقيت الله خير لكم ان كنتم مومنين وما انا عليكم بحفيظ
normalizedTranslation: what remains [lawful] from allah is best for you, if you would be believers. but i am not a guardian over you

arabic: قَالُواْ يَٰشُعَيۡبُ أَصَلَوٰتُكَ تَأۡمُرُكَ أَن نَّتۡرُكَ مَا يَعۡبُدُ ءَابَآؤُنَآ أَوۡ أَن نَّفۡعَلَ فِيٓ أَمۡوَٰلِنَا مَا نَشَـٰٓؤُاْۖ إِنَّكَ لَأَنتَ ٱلۡحَلِيمُ ٱلرَّشِيدُ
translation: They said, "O Shu'ayb, does your prayer command you that we should leave what our fathers worship or not do with our wealth what we please? Indeed, you are the forbearing, the discerning
normalizedArabic: قالوا يشعيب اصلوتك تامرك ان نترك ما يعبد ءاباونا او ان نفعل في امولنا ما نشوا انك لانت الحليم الرشيد
normalizedTranslation: they said, "o shu'ayb, does your prayer command you that we should leave what our fathers worship or not do with our wealth what we please? indeed, you are the forbearing, the discerning

arabic: قَالَ يَٰقَوۡمِ أَرَءَيۡتُمۡ إِن كُنتُ عَلَىٰ بَيِّنَةٖ مِّن رَّبِّي وَرَزَقَنِي مِنۡهُ رِزۡقًا حَسَنٗاۚ وَمَآ أُرِيدُ أَنۡ أُخَالِفَكُمۡ إِلَىٰ مَآ أَنۡهَىٰكُمۡ عَنۡهُۚ إِنۡ أُرِيدُ إِلَّا ٱلۡإِصۡلَٰحَ مَا ٱسۡتَطَعۡتُۚ وَمَا تَوۡفِيقِيٓ إِلَّا بِٱللَّهِۚ عَلَيۡهِ تَوَكَّلۡتُ وَإِلَيۡهِ أُنِيبُ
translation: He said, "O my people, have you considered: if I am upon clear evidence from my Lord and He has provided me with a good provision from Him...? And I do not intend to differ from you in that which I have forbidden you; I only intend reform as much as I am able. And my success is not but through Allah. Upon him I have relied, and to Him I return
normalizedArabic: قال يقوم ارءيتم ان كنت علي بينه من ربي ورزقني منه رزقا حسنا وما اريد ان اخالفكم الي ما انهيكم عنه ان اريد الا الاصلح ما استطعت وما توفيقي الا بالله عليه توكلت واليه انيب
normalizedTranslation: he said, "o my people, have you considered: if i am upon clear evidence from my lord and he has provided me with a good provision from him...? and i do not intend to differ from you in that which i have forbidden you; i only intend reform as much as i am able. and my success is not but through allah. upon him i have relied, and to him i return

arabic: وَيَٰقَوۡمِ لَا يَجۡرِمَنَّكُمۡ شِقَاقِيٓ أَن يُصِيبَكُم مِّثۡلُ مَآ أَصَابَ قَوۡمَ نُوحٍ أَوۡ قَوۡمَ هُودٍ أَوۡ قَوۡمَ صَٰلِحٖۚ وَمَا قَوۡمُ لُوطٖ مِّنكُم بِبَعِيدٖ
translation: And O my people, let not [your] dissension from me cause you to be struck by that similar to what struck the people of Noah or the people of Hud or the people of Salih. And the people of Lot are not from you far away
normalizedArabic: ويقوم لا يجرمنكم شقاقي ان يصيبكم مثل ما اصاب قوم نوح او قوم هود او قوم صلح وما قوم لوط منكم ببعيد
normalizedTranslation: and o my people, let not [your] dissension from me cause you to be struck by that similar to what struck the people of noah or the people of hud or the people of salih. and the people of lot are not from you far away

arabic: وَٱسۡتَغۡفِرُواْ رَبَّكُمۡ ثُمَّ تُوبُوٓاْ إِلَيۡهِۚ إِنَّ رَبِّي رَحِيمٞ وَدُودٞ
translation: And ask forgiveness of your Lord and then repent to Him. Indeed, my Lord is Merciful and Affectionate
normalizedArabic: واستغفروا ربكم ثم توبوا اليه ان ربي رحيم ودود
normalizedTranslation: and ask forgiveness of your lord and then repent to him. indeed, my lord is merciful and affectionate

arabic: قَالُواْ يَٰشُعَيۡبُ مَا نَفۡقَهُ كَثِيرٗا مِّمَّا تَقُولُ وَإِنَّا لَنَرَىٰكَ فِينَا ضَعِيفٗاۖ وَلَوۡلَا رَهۡطُكَ لَرَجَمۡنَٰكَۖ وَمَآ أَنتَ عَلَيۡنَا بِعَزِيزٖ
translation: They said, "O Shu'ayb, we do not understand much of what you say, and indeed, we consider you among us as weak. And if not for your family, we would have stoned you [to death]; and you are not to us one respected
normalizedArabic: قالوا يشعيب ما نفقه كثيرا مما تقول وانا لنريك فينا ضعيفا ولولا رهطك لرجمنك وما انت علينا بعزيز
normalizedTranslation: they said, "o shu'ayb, we do not understand much of what you say, and indeed, we consider you among us as weak. and if not for your family, we would have stoned you [to death]; and you are not to us one respected

arabic: قَالَ يَٰقَوۡمِ أَرَهۡطِيٓ أَعَزُّ عَلَيۡكُم مِّنَ ٱللَّهِ وَٱتَّخَذۡتُمُوهُ وَرَآءَكُمۡ ظِهۡرِيًّاۖ إِنَّ رَبِّي بِمَا تَعۡمَلُونَ مُحِيطٞ
translation: He said, "O my people, is my family more respected for power by you than Allah? But you put Him behind your backs [in neglect]. Indeed, my Lord is encompassing of what you do
normalizedArabic: قال يقوم ارهطي اعز عليكم من الله واتخذتموه وراءكم ظهريا ان ربي بما تعملون محيط
normalizedTranslation: he said, "o my people, is my family more respected for power by you than allah? but you put him behind your backs [in neglect]. indeed, my lord is encompassing of what you do

arabic: وَيَٰقَوۡمِ ٱعۡمَلُواْ عَلَىٰ مَكَانَتِكُمۡ إِنِّي عَٰمِلٞۖ سَوۡفَ تَعۡلَمُونَ مَن يَأۡتِيهِ عَذَابٞ يُخۡزِيهِ وَمَنۡ هُوَ كَٰذِبٞۖ وَٱرۡتَقِبُوٓاْ إِنِّي مَعَكُمۡ رَقِيبٞ
translation: And O my people, work according to your position; indeed, I am working. You are going to know to whom will come a punishment that will disgrace him and who is a liar. So watch; indeed, I am with you a watcher, [awaiting the outcome]
normalizedArabic: ويقوم اعملوا علي مكانتكم اني عمل سوف تعلمون من ياتيه عذاب يخزيه ومن هو كذب وارتقبوا اني معكم رقيب
normalizedTranslation: and o my people, work according to your position; indeed, i am working. you are going to know to whom will come a punishment that will disgrace him and who is a liar. so watch; indeed, i am with you a watcher, [awaiting the outcome]

arabic: وَلَمَّا جَآءَ أَمۡرُنَا نَجَّيۡنَا شُعَيۡبٗا وَٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُواْ مَعَهُۥ بِرَحۡمَةٖ مِّنَّا وَأَخَذَتِ ٱلَّذِينَ ظَلَمُواْ ٱلصَّيۡحَةُ فَأَصۡبَحُواْ فِي دِيَٰرِهِمۡ جَٰثِمِينَ
translation: And when Our command came, We saved Shu'ayb and those who believed with him, by mercy from Us. And the shriek seized those who had wronged, and they became within their homes [corpses] fallen prone
normalizedArabic: ولما جاء امرنا نجينا شعيبا والذين ءامنوا معه برحمه منا واخذت الذين ظلموا الصيحه فاصبحوا في ديرهم جثمين
normalizedTranslation: and when our command came, we saved shu'ayb and those who believed with him, by mercy from us. and the shriek seized those who had wronged, and they became within their homes [corpses] fallen prone

arabic: كَأَن لَّمۡ يَغۡنَوۡاْ فِيهَآۗ أَلَا بُعۡدٗا لِّمَدۡيَنَ كَمَا بَعِدَتۡ ثَمُودُ
translation: As if they had never prospered therein. Then, away with Madyan as Thamud was taken away
normalizedArabic: كان لم يغنوا فيها الا بعدا لمدين كما بعدت ثمود
normalizedTranslation: as if they had never prospered therein. then, away with madyan as thamud was taken away

arabic: وَلَقَدۡ أَرۡسَلۡنَا مُوسَىٰ بِـَٔايَٰتِنَا وَسُلۡطَٰنٖ مُّبِينٍ
translation: And We did certainly send Moses with Our signs and a clear authority
normalizedArabic: ولقد ارسلنا موسي بايتنا وسلطن مبين
normalizedTranslation: and we did certainly send moses with our signs and a clear authority

arabic: إِلَىٰ فِرۡعَوۡنَ وَمَلَإِيْهِۦ فَٱتَّبَعُوٓاْ أَمۡرَ فِرۡعَوۡنَۖ وَمَآ أَمۡرُ فِرۡعَوۡنَ بِرَشِيدٖ
translation: To Pharaoh and his establishment, but they followed the command of Pharaoh, and the command of Pharaoh was not [at all] discerning
normalizedArabic: الي فرعون وملايه فاتبعوا امر فرعون وما امر فرعون برشيد
normalizedTranslation: to pharaoh and his establishment, but they followed the command of pharaoh, and the command of pharaoh was not [at all] discerning

arabic: يَقۡدُمُ قَوۡمَهُۥ يَوۡمَ ٱلۡقِيَٰمَةِ فَأَوۡرَدَهُمُ ٱلنَّارَۖ وَبِئۡسَ ٱلۡوِرۡدُ ٱلۡمَوۡرُودُ
translation: He will precede his people on the Day of Resurrection and lead them into the Fire; and wretched is the place to which they are led
normalizedArabic: يقدم قومه يوم القيمه فاوردهم النار وبيس الورد المورود
normalizedTranslation: he will precede his people on the day of resurrection and lead them into the fire; and wretched is the place to which they are led

arabic: وَأُتۡبِعُواْ فِي هَٰذِهِۦ لَعۡنَةٗ وَيَوۡمَ ٱلۡقِيَٰمَةِۚ بِئۡسَ ٱلرِّفۡدُ ٱلۡمَرۡفُودُ
translation: And they were followed in this [world] with a curse and on the Day of Resurrection. And wretched is the gift which is given
normalizedArabic: واتبعوا في هذه لعنه ويوم القيمه بيس الرفد المرفود
normalizedTranslation: and they were followed in this [world] with a curse and on the day of resurrection. and wretched is the gift which is given

arabic: ذَٰلِكَ مِنۡ أَنۢبَآءِ ٱلۡقُرَىٰ نَقُصُّهُۥ عَلَيۡكَۖ مِنۡهَا قَآئِمٞ وَحَصِيدٞ
translation: That is from the news of the cities, which We relate to you; of them, some are [still] standing and some are [as] a harvest [mowed down]
normalizedArabic: ذلك من انباء القري نقصه عليك منها قايم وحصيد
normalizedTranslation: that is from the news of the cities, which we relate to you; of them, some are [still] standing and some are [as] a harvest [mowed down]

arabic: وَمَا ظَلَمۡنَٰهُمۡ وَلَٰكِن ظَلَمُوٓاْ أَنفُسَهُمۡۖ فَمَآ أَغۡنَتۡ عَنۡهُمۡ ءَالِهَتُهُمُ ٱلَّتِي يَدۡعُونَ مِن دُونِ ٱللَّهِ مِن شَيۡءٖ لَّمَّا جَآءَ أَمۡرُ رَبِّكَۖ وَمَا زَادُوهُمۡ غَيۡرَ تَتۡبِيبٖ
translation: And We did not wrong them, but they wronged themselves. And they were not availed at all by their gods which they invoked other than Allah when there came the command of your Lord. And they did not increase them in other than ruin
normalizedArabic: وما ظلمنهم ولكن ظلموا انفسهم فما اغنت عنهم ءالهتهم التي يدعون من دون الله من شيء لما جاء امر ربك وما زادوهم غير تتبيب
normalizedTranslation: and we did not wrong them, but they wronged themselves. and they were not availed at all by their gods which they invoked other than allah when there came the command of your lord. and they did not increase them in other than ruin

arabic: وَكَذَٰلِكَ أَخۡذُ رَبِّكَ إِذَآ أَخَذَ ٱلۡقُرَىٰ وَهِيَ ظَٰلِمَةٌۚ إِنَّ أَخۡذَهُۥٓ أَلِيمٞ شَدِيدٌ
translation: And thus is the seizure of your Lord when He seizes the cities while they are committing wrong. Indeed, His seizure is painful and severe
normalizedArabic: وكذلك اخذ ربك اذا اخذ القري وهي ظلمه ان اخذه اليم شديد
normalizedTranslation: and thus is the seizure of your lord when he seizes the cities while they are committing wrong. indeed, his seizure is painful and severe

arabic: إِنَّ فِي ذَٰلِكَ لَأٓيَةٗ لِّمَنۡ خَافَ عَذَابَ ٱلۡأٓخِرَةِۚ ذَٰلِكَ يَوۡمٞ مَّجۡمُوعٞ لَّهُ ٱلنَّاسُ وَذَٰلِكَ يَوۡمٞ مَّشۡهُودٞ
translation: Indeed in that is a sign for those who fear the punishment of the Hereafter. That is a Day for which the people will be collected, and that is a Day [which will be] witnessed
normalizedArabic: ان في ذلك لايه لمن خاف عذاب الاخره ذلك يوم مجموع له الناس وذلك يوم مشهود
normalizedTranslation: indeed in that is a sign for those who fear the punishment of the hereafter. that is a day for which the people will be collected, and that is a day [which will be] witnessed

arabic: وَمَا نُؤَخِّرُهُۥٓ إِلَّا لِأَجَلٖ مَّعۡدُودٖ
translation: And We do not delay it except for a limited term
normalizedArabic: وما نوخره الا لاجل معدود
normalizedTranslation: and we do not delay it except for a limited term

arabic: يَوۡمَ يَأۡتِ لَا تَكَلَّمُ نَفۡسٌ إِلَّا بِإِذۡنِهِۦۚ فَمِنۡهُمۡ شَقِيّٞ وَسَعِيدٞ
translation: The Day it comes no soul will speak except by His permission. And among them will be the wretched and the prosperous
normalizedArabic: يوم يات لا تكلم نفس الا باذنه فمنهم شقي وسعيد
normalizedTranslation: the day it comes no soul will speak except by his permission. and among them will be the wretched and the prosperous

arabic: فَأَمَّا ٱلَّذِينَ شَقُواْ فَفِي ٱلنَّارِ لَهُمۡ فِيهَا زَفِيرٞ وَشَهِيقٌ
translation: As for those who were [destined to be] wretched, they will be in the Fire. For them therein is [violent] exhaling and inhaling
normalizedArabic: فاما الذين شقوا ففي النار لهم فيها زفير وشهيق
normalizedTranslation: as for those who were [destined to be] wretched, they will be in the fire. for them therein is [violent] exhaling and inhaling

arabic: خَٰلِدِينَ فِيهَا مَا دَامَتِ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتُ وَٱلۡأَرۡضُ إِلَّا مَا شَآءَ رَبُّكَۚ إِنَّ رَبَّكَ فَعَّالٞ لِّمَا يُرِيدُ
translation: [They will be] abiding therein as long as the heavens and the earth endure, except what your Lord should will. Indeed, your Lord is an effecter of what He intends
normalizedArabic: خلدين فيها ما دامت السموت والارض الا ما شاء ربك ان ربك فعال لما يريد
normalizedTranslation: [they will be] abiding therein as long as the heavens and the earth endure, except what your lord should will. indeed, your lord is an effecter of what he intends

arabic: ۞وَأَمَّا ٱلَّذِينَ سُعِدُواْ فَفِي ٱلۡجَنَّةِ خَٰلِدِينَ فِيهَا مَا دَامَتِ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتُ وَٱلۡأَرۡضُ إِلَّا مَا شَآءَ رَبُّكَۖ عَطَآءً غَيۡرَ مَجۡذُوذٖ
translation: And as for those who were [destined to be] prosperous, they will be in Paradise, abiding therein as long as the heavens and the earth endure, except what your Lord should will - a bestowal uninterrupted
normalizedArabic: واما الذين سعدوا ففي الجنه خلدين فيها ما دامت السموت والارض الا ما شاء ربك عطاء غير مجذوذ
normalizedTranslation: and as for those who were [destined to be] prosperous, they will be in paradise, abiding therein as long as the heavens and the earth endure, except what your lord should will - a bestowal uninterrupted

arabic: فَلَا تَكُ فِي مِرۡيَةٖ مِّمَّا يَعۡبُدُ هَـٰٓؤُلَآءِۚ مَا يَعۡبُدُونَ إِلَّا كَمَا يَعۡبُدُ ءَابَآؤُهُم مِّن قَبۡلُۚ وَإِنَّا لَمُوَفُّوهُمۡ نَصِيبَهُمۡ غَيۡرَ مَنقُوصٖ
translation: So do not be in doubt, [O Muhammad], as to what these [polytheists] are worshipping. They worship not except as their fathers worshipped before. And indeed, We will give them their share undiminished
normalizedArabic: فلا تك في مريه مما يعبد هولاء ما يعبدون الا كما يعبد ءاباوهم من قبل وانا لموفوهم نصيبهم غير منقوص
normalizedTranslation: so do not be in doubt, [o muhammad], as to what these [polytheists] are worshipping. they worship not except as their fathers worshipped before. and indeed, we will give them their share undiminished

arabic: وَلَقَدۡ ءَاتَيۡنَا مُوسَى ٱلۡكِتَٰبَ فَٱخۡتُلِفَ فِيهِۚ وَلَوۡلَا كَلِمَةٞ سَبَقَتۡ مِن رَّبِّكَ لَقُضِيَ بَيۡنَهُمۡۚ وَإِنَّهُمۡ لَفِي شَكّٖ مِّنۡهُ مُرِيبٖ
translation: And We had certainly given Moses the Scripture, but it came under disagreement. And if not for a word that preceded from your Lord, it would have been judged between them. And indeed they are, concerning the Qur'an, in disquieting doubt
normalizedArabic: ولقد ءاتينا موسي الكتب فاختلف فيه ولولا كلمه سبقت من ربك لقضي بينهم وانهم لفي شك منه مريب
normalizedTranslation: and we had certainly given moses the scripture, but it came under disagreement. and if not for a word that preceded from your lord, it would have been judged between them. and indeed they are, concerning the qur'an, in disquieting doubt

arabic: وَإِنَّ كُلّٗا لَّمَّا لَيُوَفِّيَنَّهُمۡ رَبُّكَ أَعۡمَٰلَهُمۡۚ إِنَّهُۥ بِمَا يَعۡمَلُونَ خَبِيرٞ
translation: And indeed, each [of the believers and disbelievers] - your Lord will fully compensate them for their deeds. Indeed, He is Acquainted with what they do
normalizedArabic: وان كلا لما ليوفينهم ربك اعملهم انه بما يعملون خبير
normalizedTranslation: and indeed, each [of the believers and disbelievers] - your lord will fully compensate them for their deeds. indeed, he is acquainted with what they do

arabic: فَٱسۡتَقِمۡ كَمَآ أُمِرۡتَ وَمَن تَابَ مَعَكَ وَلَا تَطۡغَوۡاْۚ إِنَّهُۥ بِمَا تَعۡمَلُونَ بَصِيرٞ
translation: So remain on a right course as you have been commanded, [you] and those who have turned back with you [to Allah], and do not transgress. Indeed, He is Seeing of what you do
normalizedArabic: فاستقم كما امرت ومن تاب معك ولا تطغوا انه بما تعملون بصير
normalizedTranslation: so remain on a right course as you have been commanded, [you] and those who have turned back with you [to allah], and do not transgress. indeed, he is seeing of what you do

arabic: وَلَا تَرۡكَنُوٓاْ إِلَى ٱلَّذِينَ ظَلَمُواْ فَتَمَسَّكُمُ ٱلنَّارُ وَمَا لَكُم مِّن دُونِ ٱللَّهِ مِنۡ أَوۡلِيَآءَ ثُمَّ لَا تُنصَرُونَ
translation: And do not incline toward those who do wrong, lest you be touched by the Fire, and you would not have other than Allah any protectors; then you would not be helped
normalizedArabic: ولا تركنوا الي الذين ظلموا فتمسكم النار وما لكم من دون الله من اولياء ثم لا تنصرون
normalizedTranslation: and do not incline toward those who do wrong, lest you be touched by the fire, and you would not have other than allah any protectors; then you would not be helped

arabic: وَأَقِمِ ٱلصَّلَوٰةَ طَرَفَيِ ٱلنَّهَارِ وَزُلَفٗا مِّنَ ٱلَّيۡلِۚ إِنَّ ٱلۡحَسَنَٰتِ يُذۡهِبۡنَ ٱلسَّيِّـَٔاتِۚ ذَٰلِكَ ذِكۡرَىٰ لِلذَّـٰكِرِينَ
translation: And establish prayer at the two ends of the day and at the approach of the night. Indeed, good deeds do away with misdeeds. That is a reminder for those who remember
normalizedArabic: واقم الصلوه طرفي النهار وزلفا من اليل ان الحسنت يذهبن السيات ذلك ذكري للذكرين
normalizedTranslation: and establish prayer at the two ends of the day and at the approach of the night. indeed, good deeds do away with misdeeds. that is a reminder for those who remember

arabic: وَٱصۡبِرۡ فَإِنَّ ٱللَّهَ لَا يُضِيعُ أَجۡرَ ٱلۡمُحۡسِنِينَ
translation: And be patient, for indeed, Allah does not allow to be lost the reward of those who do good
normalizedArabic: واصبر فان الله لا يضيع اجر المحسنين
normalizedTranslation: and be patient, for indeed, allah does not allow to be lost the reward of those who do good

arabic: فَلَوۡلَا كَانَ مِنَ ٱلۡقُرُونِ مِن قَبۡلِكُمۡ أُوْلُواْ بَقِيَّةٖ يَنۡهَوۡنَ عَنِ ٱلۡفَسَادِ فِي ٱلۡأَرۡضِ إِلَّا قَلِيلٗا مِّمَّنۡ أَنجَيۡنَا مِنۡهُمۡۗ وَٱتَّبَعَ ٱلَّذِينَ ظَلَمُواْ مَآ أُتۡرِفُواْ فِيهِ وَكَانُواْ مُجۡرِمِينَ
translation: So why were there not among the generations before you those of enduring discrimination forbidding corruption on earth - except a few of those We saved from among them? But those who wronged pursued what luxury they were given therein, and they were criminals
normalizedArabic: فلولا كان من القرون من قبلكم اولوا بقيه ينهون عن الفساد في الارض الا قليلا ممن انجينا منهم واتبع الذين ظلموا ما اترفوا فيه وكانوا مجرمين
normalizedTranslation: so why were there not among the generations before you those of enduring discrimination forbidding corruption on earth - except a few of those we saved from among them? but those who wronged pursued what luxury they were given therein, and they were criminals

arabic: وَمَا كَانَ رَبُّكَ لِيُهۡلِكَ ٱلۡقُرَىٰ بِظُلۡمٖ وَأَهۡلُهَا مُصۡلِحُونَ
translation: And your Lord would not have destroyed the cities unjustly while their people were reformers
normalizedArabic: وما كان ربك ليهلك القري بظلم واهلها مصلحون
normalizedTranslation: and your lord would not have destroyed the cities unjustly while their people were reformers

arabic: وَلَوۡ شَآءَ رَبُّكَ لَجَعَلَ ٱلنَّاسَ أُمَّةٗ وَٰحِدَةٗۖ وَلَا يَزَالُونَ مُخۡتَلِفِينَ
translation: And if your Lord had willed, He could have made mankind one community; but they will not cease to differ
normalizedArabic: ولو شاء ربك لجعل الناس امه وحده ولا يزالون مختلفين
normalizedTranslation: and if your lord had willed, he could have made mankind one community; but they will not cease to differ

arabic: إِلَّا مَن رَّحِمَ رَبُّكَۚ وَلِذَٰلِكَ خَلَقَهُمۡۗ وَتَمَّتۡ كَلِمَةُ رَبِّكَ لَأَمۡلَأَنَّ جَهَنَّمَ مِنَ ٱلۡجِنَّةِ وَٱلنَّاسِ أَجۡمَعِينَ
translation: Except whom your Lord has given mercy, and for that He created them. But the word of your Lord is to be fulfilled that, "I will surely fill Hell with jinn and men all together
normalizedArabic: الا من رحم ربك ولذلك خلقهم وتمت كلمه ربك لاملان جهنم من الجنه والناس اجمعين
normalizedTranslation: except whom your lord has given mercy, and for that he created them. but the word of your lord is to be fulfilled that, "i will surely fill hell with jinn and men all together

arabic: وَكُلّٗا نَّقُصُّ عَلَيۡكَ مِنۡ أَنۢبَآءِ ٱلرُّسُلِ مَا نُثَبِّتُ بِهِۦ فُؤَادَكَۚ وَجَآءَكَ فِي هَٰذِهِ ٱلۡحَقُّ وَمَوۡعِظَةٞ وَذِكۡرَىٰ لِلۡمُؤۡمِنِينَ
translation: And each [story] We relate to you from the news of the messengers is that by which We make firm your heart. And there has come to you, in this, the truth and an instruction and a reminder for the believers
normalizedArabic: وكلا نقص عليك من انباء الرسل ما نثبت به فوادك وجاءك في هذه الحق وموعظه وذكري للمومنين
normalizedTranslation: and each [story] we relate to you from the news of the messengers is that by which we make firm your heart. and there has come to you, in this, the truth and an instruction and a reminder for the believers

arabic: وَقُل لِّلَّذِينَ لَا يُؤۡمِنُونَ ٱعۡمَلُواْ عَلَىٰ مَكَانَتِكُمۡ إِنَّا عَٰمِلُونَ
translation: And say to those who do not believe, "Work according to your position; indeed, we are working
normalizedArabic: وقل للذين لا يومنون اعملوا علي مكانتكم انا عملون
normalizedTranslation: and say to those who do not believe, "work according to your position; indeed, we are working

arabic: وَٱنتَظِرُوٓاْ إِنَّا مُنتَظِرُونَ
translation: And wait, indeed, we are waiting
normalizedArabic: وانتظروا انا منتظرون
normalizedTranslation: and wait, indeed, we are waiting

arabic: وَلِلَّهِ غَيۡبُ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلۡأَرۡضِ وَإِلَيۡهِ يُرۡجَعُ ٱلۡأَمۡرُ كُلُّهُۥ فَٱعۡبُدۡهُ وَتَوَكَّلۡ عَلَيۡهِۚ وَمَا رَبُّكَ بِغَٰفِلٍ عَمَّا تَعۡمَلُونَ
translation: And to Allah belong the unseen [aspects] of the heavens and the earth and to Him will be returned the matter, all of it, so worship Him and rely upon Him. And your Lord is not unaware of that which you do
normalizedArabic: ولله غيب السموت والارض واليه يرجع الامر كله فاعبده وتوكل عليه وما ربك بغفل عما تعملون
normalizedTranslation: and to allah belong the unseen [aspects] of the heavens and the earth and to him will be returned the matter, all of it, so worship him and rely upon him. and your lord is not unaware of that which you do

arabic: الٓرۚ تِلۡكَ ءَايَٰتُ ٱلۡكِتَٰبِ ٱلۡمُبِينِ
translation: Alif, Lam, Ra. These are the verses of the clear Book
normalizedArabic: الر تلك ءايت الكتب المبين
normalizedTranslation: alif, lam, ra. these are the verses of the clear book

arabic: إِنَّآ أَنزَلۡنَٰهُ قُرۡءَٰنًا عَرَبِيّٗا لَّعَلَّكُمۡ تَعۡقِلُونَ
translation: Indeed, We have sent it down as an Arabic Qur'an that you might understand
normalizedArabic: انا انزلنه قرءنا عربيا لعلكم تعقلون
normalizedTranslation: indeed, we have sent it down as an arabic qur'an that you might understand

arabic: نَحۡنُ نَقُصُّ عَلَيۡكَ أَحۡسَنَ ٱلۡقَصَصِ بِمَآ أَوۡحَيۡنَآ إِلَيۡكَ هَٰذَا ٱلۡقُرۡءَانَ وَإِن كُنتَ مِن قَبۡلِهِۦ لَمِنَ ٱلۡغَٰفِلِينَ
translation: We relate to you, [O Muhammad], the best of stories in what We have revealed to you of this Qur'an although you were, before it, among the unaware
normalizedArabic: نحن نقص عليك احسن القصص بما اوحينا اليك هذا القرءان وان كنت من قبله لمن الغفلين
normalizedTranslation: we relate to you, [o muhammad], the best of stories in what we have revealed to you of this qur'an although you were, before it, among the unaware

arabic: إِذۡ قَالَ يُوسُفُ لِأَبِيهِ يَـٰٓأَبَتِ إِنِّي رَأَيۡتُ أَحَدَ عَشَرَ كَوۡكَبٗا وَٱلشَّمۡسَ وَٱلۡقَمَرَ رَأَيۡتُهُمۡ لِي سَٰجِدِينَ
translation: [Of these stories mention] when Joseph said to his father, "O my father, indeed I have seen [in a dream] eleven stars and the sun and the moon; I saw them prostrating to me
normalizedArabic: اذ قال يوسف لابيه يابت اني رايت احد عشر كوكبا والشمس والقمر رايتهم لي سجدين
normalizedTranslation: [of these stories mention] when joseph said to his father, "o my father, indeed i have seen [in a dream] eleven stars and the sun and the moon; i saw them prostrating to me

arabic: قَالَ يَٰبُنَيَّ لَا تَقۡصُصۡ رُءۡيَاكَ عَلَىٰٓ إِخۡوَتِكَ فَيَكِيدُواْ لَكَ كَيۡدًاۖ إِنَّ ٱلشَّيۡطَٰنَ لِلۡإِنسَٰنِ عَدُوّٞ مُّبِينٞ
translation: He said, "O my son, do not relate your vision to your brothers or they will contrive against you a plan. Indeed Satan, to man, is a manifest enemy
normalizedArabic: قال يبني لا تقصص رءياك علي اخوتك فيكيدوا لك كيدا ان الشيطن للانسن عدو مبين
normalizedTranslation: he said, "o my son, do not relate your vision to your brothers or they will contrive against you a plan. indeed satan, to man, is a manifest enemy

arabic: وَكَذَٰلِكَ يَجۡتَبِيكَ رَبُّكَ وَيُعَلِّمُكَ مِن تَأۡوِيلِ ٱلۡأَحَادِيثِ وَيُتِمُّ نِعۡمَتَهُۥ عَلَيۡكَ وَعَلَىٰٓ ءَالِ يَعۡقُوبَ كَمَآ أَتَمَّهَا عَلَىٰٓ أَبَوَيۡكَ مِن قَبۡلُ إِبۡرَٰهِيمَ وَإِسۡحَٰقَۚ إِنَّ رَبَّكَ عَلِيمٌ حَكِيمٞ
translation: And thus will your Lord choose you and teach you the interpretation of narratives and complete His favor upon you and upon the family of Jacob, as He completed it upon your fathers before, Abraham and Isaac. Indeed, your Lord is Knowing and Wise
normalizedArabic: وكذلك يجتبيك ربك ويعلمك من تاويل الاحاديث ويتم نعمته عليك وعلي ءال يعقوب كما اتمها علي ابويك من قبل ابرهيم واسحق ان ربك عليم حكيم
normalizedTranslation: and thus will your lord choose you and teach you the interpretation of narratives and complete his favor upon you and upon the family of jacob, as he completed it upon your fathers before, abraham and isaac. indeed, your lord is knowing and wise

arabic: ۞لَّقَدۡ كَانَ فِي يُوسُفَ وَإِخۡوَتِهِۦٓ ءَايَٰتٞ لِّلسَّآئِلِينَ
translation: Certainly were there in Joseph and his brothers signs for those who ask
normalizedArabic: لقد كان في يوسف واخوته ءايت للسايلين
normalizedTranslation: certainly were there in joseph and his brothers signs for those who ask

arabic: إِذۡ قَالُواْ لَيُوسُفُ وَأَخُوهُ أَحَبُّ إِلَىٰٓ أَبِينَا مِنَّا وَنَحۡنُ عُصۡبَةٌ إِنَّ أَبَانَا لَفِي ضَلَٰلٖ مُّبِينٍ
translation: When they said, "Joseph and his brother are more beloved to our father than we, while we are a clan. Indeed, our father is in clear error
normalizedArabic: اذ قالوا ليوسف واخوه احب الي ابينا منا ونحن عصبه ان ابانا لفي ضلل مبين
normalizedTranslation: when they said, "joseph and his brother are more beloved to our father than we, while we are a clan. indeed, our father is in clear error

arabic: ٱقۡتُلُواْ يُوسُفَ أَوِ ٱطۡرَحُوهُ أَرۡضٗا يَخۡلُ لَكُمۡ وَجۡهُ أَبِيكُمۡ وَتَكُونُواْ مِنۢ بَعۡدِهِۦ قَوۡمٗا صَٰلِحِينَ
translation: Kill Joseph or cast him out to [another] land; the countenance of your father will [then] be only for you, and you will be after that a righteous people
normalizedArabic: اقتلوا يوسف او اطرحوه ارضا يخل لكم وجه ابيكم وتكونوا من بعده قوما صلحين
normalizedTranslation: kill joseph or cast him out to [another] land; the countenance of your father will [then] be only for you, and you will be after that a righteous people

arabic: قَالَ قَآئِلٞ مِّنۡهُمۡ لَا تَقۡتُلُواْ يُوسُفَ وَأَلۡقُوهُ فِي غَيَٰبَتِ ٱلۡجُبِّ يَلۡتَقِطۡهُ بَعۡضُ ٱلسَّيَّارَةِ إِن كُنتُمۡ فَٰعِلِينَ
translation: Said a speaker among them, "Do not kill Joseph but throw him into the bottom of the well; some travelers will pick him up - if you would do [something]
normalizedArabic: قال قايل منهم لا تقتلوا يوسف والقوه في غيبت الجب يلتقطه بعض السياره ان كنتم فعلين
normalizedTranslation: said a speaker among them, "do not kill joseph but throw him into the bottom of the well; some travelers will pick him up - if you would do [something]

arabic: قَالُواْ يَـٰٓأَبَانَا مَا لَكَ لَا تَأۡمَ۬نَّا عَلَىٰ يُوسُفَ وَإِنَّا لَهُۥ لَنَٰصِحُونَ
translation: They said, "O our father, why do you not entrust us with Joseph while indeed, we are to him sincere counselors
normalizedArabic: قالوا يابانا ما لك لا تامنا علي يوسف وانا له لنصحون
normalizedTranslation: they said, "o our father, why do you not entrust us with joseph while indeed, we are to him sincere counselors

arabic: أَرۡسِلۡهُ مَعَنَا غَدٗا يَرۡتَعۡ وَيَلۡعَبۡ وَإِنَّا لَهُۥ لَحَٰفِظُونَ
translation: Send him with us tomorrow that he may eat well and play. And indeed, we will be his guardians
normalizedArabic: ارسله معنا غدا يرتع ويلعب وانا له لحفظون
normalizedTranslation: send him with us tomorrow that he may eat well and play. and indeed, we will be his guardians

arabic: قَالَ إِنِّي لَيَحۡزُنُنِيٓ أَن تَذۡهَبُواْ بِهِۦ وَأَخَافُ أَن يَأۡكُلَهُ ٱلذِّئۡبُ وَأَنتُمۡ عَنۡهُ غَٰفِلُونَ
translation: [Jacob] said, "Indeed, it saddens me that you should take him, and I fear that a wolf would eat him while you are of him unaware
normalizedArabic: قال اني ليحزنني ان تذهبوا به واخاف ان ياكله الذيب وانتم عنه غفلون
normalizedTranslation: [jacob] said, "indeed, it saddens me that you should take him, and i fear that a wolf would eat him while you are of him unaware

arabic: قَالُواْ لَئِنۡ أَكَلَهُ ٱلذِّئۡبُ وَنَحۡنُ عُصۡبَةٌ إِنَّآ إِذٗا لَّخَٰسِرُونَ

arabic: قَالَ لَا يَأۡتِيكُمَا طَعَامٞ تُرۡزَقَانِهِۦٓ إِلَّا نَبَّأۡتُكُمَا بِتَأۡوِيلِهِۦ قَبۡلَ أَن يَأۡتِيَكُمَاۚ ذَٰلِكُمَا مِمَّا عَلَّمَنِي رَبِّيٓۚ إِنِّي تَرَكۡتُ مِلَّةَ قَوۡمٖ لَّا يُؤۡمِنُونَ بِٱللَّهِ وَهُم بِٱلۡأٓخِرَةِ هُمۡ كَٰفِرُونَ
translation: He said, "You will not receive food that is provided to you except that I will inform you of its interpretation before it comes to you. That is from what my Lord has taught me. Indeed, I have left the religion of a people who do not believe in Allah, and they, in the Hereafter, are disbelievers

normalizedTranslation: he said, "you will not receive food that is provided to you except that i will inform you of its interpretation before it comes to you. that is from what my lord has taught me. indeed, i have left the religion of a people who do not believe in allah, and they, in the hereafter, are disbelievers

arabic: وَٱتَّبَعۡتُ مِلَّةَ ءَابَآءِيٓ إِبۡرَٰهِيمَ وَإِسۡحَٰقَ وَيَعۡقُوبَۚ مَا كَانَ لَنَآ أَن نُّشۡرِكَ بِٱللَّهِ مِن شَيۡءٖۚ ذَٰلِكَ مِن فَضۡلِ ٱللَّهِ عَلَيۡنَا وَعَلَى ٱلنَّاسِ وَلَٰكِنَّ أَكۡثَرَ ٱلنَّاسِ لَا يَشۡكُرُونَ
translation: And I have followed the religion of my fathers, Abraham, Isaac and Jacob. And it was not for us to associate anything with Allah. That is from the favor of Allah upon us and upon the people, but most of the people are not grateful

normalizedTranslation: and i have followed the religion of my fathers, abraham, isaac and jacob. and it was not for us to associate anything with allah. that is from the favor of allah upon us and upon the people, but most of the people are not grateful

arabic: يَٰصَٰحِبَيِ ٱلسِّجۡنِ ءَأَرۡبَابٞ مُّتَفَرِّقُونَ خَيۡرٌ أَمِ ٱللَّهُ ٱلۡوَٰحِدُ ٱلۡقَهَّارُ
translation: O [my] two companions of prison, are separate lords better or Allah, the One, the Prevailing

arabic: مَا تَعۡبُدُونَ مِن دُونِهِۦٓ إِلَّآ أَسۡمَآءٗ سَمَّيۡتُمُوهَآ أَنتُمۡ وَءَابَآؤُكُم مَّآ أَنزَلَ ٱللَّهُ بِهَا مِن سُلۡطَٰنٍۚ إِنِ ٱلۡحُكۡمُ إِلَّا لِلَّهِ أَمَرَ أَلَّا تَعۡبُدُوٓاْ إِلَّآ إِيَّاهُۚ ذَٰلِكَ ٱلدِّينُ ٱلۡقَيِّمُ وَلَٰكِنَّ أَكۡثَرَ ٱلنَّاسِ لَا يَعۡلَمُونَ
translation: You worship not besides Him except [mere] names you have named them, you and your fathers, for which Allah has sent down no authority. Legislation is not but for Allah. He has commanded that you worship not except Him. That is the correct religion, but most of the people do not know
normalizedArabic: ما تعبدون من دونه الا اسماء سميتموها انتم وءاباوكم ما انزل الله بها من سلطن ان الحكم الا لله امر الا تعبدوا الا اياه ذلك الدين القيم ولكن اكثر الناس لا يعلمون
normalizedTranslation: you worship not besides him except [mere] names you have named them, you and your fathers, for which allah has sent down no authority. legislation is not but for allah. he has commanded that you worship not except him. that is the correct religion, but most of the people do not know

arabic: يَٰصَٰحِبَيِ ٱلسِّجۡنِ أَمَّآ أَحَدُكُمَا فَيَسۡقِي رَبَّهُۥ خَمۡرٗاۖ وَأَمَّا ٱلۡأٓخَرُ فَيُصۡلَبُ فَتَأۡكُلُ ٱلطَّيۡرُ مِن رَّأۡسِهِۦۚ قُضِيَ ٱلۡأَمۡرُ ٱلَّذِي فِيهِ تَسۡتَفۡتِيَانِ
translation: O two companions of prison, as for one of you, he will give drink to his master of wine; but as for the other, he will be crucified, and the birds will eat from his head. The matter has been decreed about which you both inquire

normalizedTranslation: o two companions of prison, as for one of you, he will give drink to his master of wine; but as for the other, he will be crucified, and the birds will eat from his head. the matter has been decreed about which you both inquire

translation: And he said to the one whom he knew would go free, "Mention me before your master." But Satan made him forget the mention [to] his master, and Joseph remained in prison several years

normalizedTranslation: and he said to the one whom he knew would go free, "mention me before your master." but satan made him forget the mention [to] his master, and joseph remained in prison several years

translation: And [subsequently] the king said, "Indeed, I have seen [in a dream] seven fat cows being eaten by seven [that were] lean, and seven green spikes [of grain] and others [that were] dry. O eminent ones, explain to me my vision, if you should interpret visions
