arabic: قَالَ بَلۡ سَوَّلَتۡ لَكُمۡ أَنفُسُكُمۡ أَمۡرٗاۖ فَصَبۡرٞ جَمِيلٌۖ عَسَى ٱللَّهُ أَن يَأۡتِيَنِي بِهِمۡ جَمِيعًاۚ إِنَّهُۥ هُوَ ٱلۡعَلِيمُ ٱلۡحَكِيمُ
translation: [Jacob] said, "Rather, your souls have enticed you to something, so patience is most fitting. Perhaps Allah will bring them to me all together. Indeed it is He who is the Knowing, the Wise
normalizedArabic: قال بل سولت لكم انفسكم امرا فصبر جميل عسي الله ان ياتيني بهم جميعا انه هو العليم الحكيم
normalizedTranslation: [jacob] said, "rather, your souls have enticed you to something, so patience is most fitting. perhaps allah will bring them to me all together. indeed it is he who is the knowing, the wise

arabic: وَتَوَلَّىٰ عَنۡهُمۡ وَقَالَ يَـٰٓأَسَفَىٰ عَلَىٰ يُوسُفَ وَٱبۡيَضَّتۡ عَيۡنَاهُ مِنَ ٱلۡحُزۡنِ فَهُوَ كَظِيمٞ
translation: And he turned away from them and said, "Oh, my sorrow over Joseph," and his eyes became white from grief, for he was [of that] a suppressor
normalizedArabic: وتولي عنهم وقال ياسفي علي يوسف وابيضت عيناه من الحزن فهو كظيم
normalizedTranslation: and he turned away from them and said, "oh, my sorrow over joseph," and his eyes became white from grief, for he was [of that] a suppressor

arabic: قَالُواْ تَٱللَّهِ تَفۡتَؤُاْ تَذۡكُرُ يُوسُفَ حَتَّىٰ تَكُونَ حَرَضًا أَوۡ تَكُونَ مِنَ ٱلۡهَٰلِكِينَ
translation: They said, "By Allah, you will not cease remembering Joseph until you become fatally ill or become of those who perish
normalizedArabic: قالوا تالله تفتوا تذكر يوسف حتي تكون حرضا او تكون من الهلكين
normalizedTranslation: they said, "by allah, you will not cease remembering joseph until you become fatally ill or become of those who perish

arabic: قَالَ إِنَّمَآ أَشۡكُواْ بَثِّي وَحُزۡنِيٓ إِلَى ٱللَّهِ وَأَعۡلَمُ مِنَ ٱللَّهِ مَا لَا تَعۡلَمُونَ
translation: He said, "I only complain of my suffering and my grief to Allah, and I know from Allah that which you do not know
normalizedArabic: قال انما اشكوا بثي وحزني الي الله واعلم من الله ما لا تعلمون
normalizedTranslation: he said, "i only complain of my suffering and my grief to allah, and i know from allah that which you do not know

arabic: يَٰبَنِيَّ ٱذۡهَبُواْ فَتَحَسَّسُواْ مِن يُوسُفَ وَأَخِيهِ وَلَا تَاْيۡـَٔسُواْ مِن رَّوۡحِ ٱللَّهِۖ إِنَّهُۥ لَا يَاْيۡـَٔسُ مِن رَّوۡحِ ٱللَّهِ إِلَّا ٱلۡقَوۡمُ ٱلۡكَٰفِرُونَ
translation: O my sons, go and find out about Joseph and his brother and despair not of relief from Allah. Indeed, no one despairs of relief from Allah except the disbelieving people
normalizedArabic: يبني اذهبوا فتحسسوا من يوسف واخيه ولا تايسوا من روح الله انه لا يايس من روح الله الا القوم الكفرون
normalizedTranslation: o my sons, go and find out about joseph and his brother and despair not of relief from allah. indeed, no one despairs of relief from allah except the disbelieving people

arabic: فَلَمَّا دَخَلُواْ عَلَيۡهِ قَالُواْ يَـٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلۡعَزِيزُ مَسَّنَا وَأَهۡلَنَا ٱلضُّرُّ وَجِئۡنَا بِبِضَٰعَةٖ مُّزۡجَىٰةٖ فَأَوۡفِ لَنَا ٱلۡكَيۡلَ وَتَصَدَّقۡ عَلَيۡنَآۖ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ يَجۡزِي ٱلۡمُتَصَدِّقِينَ
translation: So when they entered upon Joseph, they said, "O 'Azeez, adversity has touched us and our family, and we have come with goods poor in quality, but give us full measure and be charitable to us. Indeed, Allah rewards the charitable
normalizedArabic: فلما دخلوا عليه قالوا يايها العزيز مسنا واهلنا الضر وجينا ببضعه مزجيه فاوف لنا الكيل وتصدق علينا ان الله يجزي المتصدقين
normalizedTranslation: so when they entered upon joseph, they said, "o 'azeez, adversity has touched us and our family, and we have come with goods poor in quality, but give us full measure and be charitable to us. indeed, allah rewards the charitable

arabic: قَالَ هَلۡ عَلِمۡتُم مَّا فَعَلۡتُم بِيُوسُفَ وَأَخِيهِ إِذۡ أَنتُمۡ جَٰهِلُونَ
translation: He said, "Do you know what you did with Joseph and his brother when you were ignorant
normalizedArabic: قال هل علمتم ما فعلتم بيوسف واخيه اذ انتم جهلون
normalizedTranslation: he said, "do you know what you did with joseph and his brother when you were ignorant

arabic: قَالُوٓاْ أَءِنَّكَ لَأَنتَ يُوسُفُۖ قَالَ أَنَا۠ يُوسُفُ وَهَٰذَآ أَخِيۖ قَدۡ مَنَّ ٱللَّهُ عَلَيۡنَآۖ إِنَّهُۥ مَن يَتَّقِ وَيَصۡبِرۡ فَإِنَّ ٱللَّهَ لَا يُضِيعُ أَجۡرَ ٱلۡمُحۡسِنِينَ
translation: They said, "Are you indeed Joseph?" He said "I am Joseph, and this is my brother. Allah has certainly favored us. Indeed, he who fears Allah and is patient, then indeed, Allah does not allow to be lost the reward of those who do good
normalizedArabic: قالوا اءنك لانت يوسف قال انا يوسف وهذا اخي قد من الله علينا انه من يتق ويصبر فان الله لا يضيع اجر المحسنين
normalizedTranslation: they said, "are you indeed joseph?" he said "i am joseph, and this is my brother. allah has certainly favored us. indeed, he who fears allah and is patient, then indeed, allah does not allow to be lost the reward of those who do good

arabic: قَالُواْ تَٱللَّهِ لَقَدۡ ءَاثَرَكَ ٱللَّهُ عَلَيۡنَا وَإِن كُنَّا لَخَٰطِـِٔينَ
translation: They said, "By Allah, certainly has Allah preferred you over us, and indeed, we have been sinners
normalizedArabic: قالوا تالله لقد ءاثرك الله علينا وان كنا لخطين
normalizedTranslation: they said, "by allah, certainly has allah preferred you over us, and indeed, we have been sinners

arabic: قَالَ لَا تَثۡرِيبَ عَلَيۡكُمُ ٱلۡيَوۡمَۖ يَغۡفِرُ ٱللَّهُ لَكُمۡۖ وَهُوَ أَرۡحَمُ ٱلرَّـٰحِمِينَ
translation: He said, "No blame will there be upon you today. Allah will forgive you; and He is the most merciful of the merciful
normalizedArabic: قال لا تثريب عليكم اليوم يغفر الله لكم وهو ارحم الرحمين
normalizedTranslation: he said, "no blame will there be upon you today. allah will forgive you; and he is the most merciful of the merciful

arabic: ٱذۡهَبُواْ بِقَمِيصِي هَٰذَا فَأَلۡقُوهُ عَلَىٰ وَجۡهِ أَبِي يَأۡتِ بَصِيرٗا وَأۡتُونِي بِأَهۡلِكُمۡ أَجۡمَعِينَ
translation: Take this, my shirt, and cast it over the face of my father; he will become seeing. And bring me your family, all together
normalizedArabic: اذهبوا بقميصي هذا فالقوه علي وجه ابي يات بصيرا واتوني باهلكم اجمعين
normalizedTranslation: take this, my shirt, and cast it over the face of my father; he will become seeing. and bring me your family, all together

arabic: وَلَمَّا فَصَلَتِ ٱلۡعِيرُ قَالَ أَبُوهُمۡ إِنِّي لَأَجِدُ رِيحَ يُوسُفَۖ لَوۡلَآ أَن تُفَنِّدُونِ
translation: And when the caravan departed [from Egypt], their father said, "Indeed, I find the smell of Joseph [and would say that he was alive] if you did not think me weakened in mind
normalizedArabic: ولما فصلت العير قال ابوهم اني لاجد ريح يوسف لولا ان تفندون
normalizedTranslation: and when the caravan departed [from egypt], their father said, "indeed, i find the smell of joseph [and would say that he was alive] if you did not think me weakened in mind

arabic: قَالُواْ تَٱللَّهِ إِنَّكَ لَفِي ضَلَٰلِكَ ٱلۡقَدِيمِ
translation: They said, "By Allah, indeed you are in your [same] old error
normalizedArabic: قالوا تالله انك لفي ضللك القديم
normalizedTranslation: they said, "by allah, indeed you are in your [same] old error

arabic: فَلَمَّآ أَن جَآءَ ٱلۡبَشِيرُ أَلۡقَىٰهُ عَلَىٰ وَجۡهِهِۦ فَٱرۡتَدَّ بَصِيرٗاۖ قَالَ أَلَمۡ أَقُل لَّكُمۡ إِنِّيٓ أَعۡلَمُ مِنَ ٱللَّهِ مَا لَا تَعۡلَمُونَ
translation: And when the bearer of good tidings arrived, he cast it over his face, and he returned [once again] seeing. He said, "Did I not tell you that I know from Allah that which you do not know
normalizedArabic: فلما ان جاء البشير القيه علي وجهه فارتد بصيرا قال الم اقل لكم اني اعلم من الله ما لا تعلمون
normalizedTranslation: and when the bearer of good tidings arrived, he cast it over his face, and he returned [once again] seeing. he said, "did i not tell you that i know from allah that which you do not know

arabic: قَالُواْ يَـٰٓأَبَانَا ٱسۡتَغۡفِرۡ لَنَا ذُنُوبَنَآ إِنَّا كُنَّا خَٰطِـِٔينَ
translation: They said, "O our father, ask for us forgiveness of our sins; indeed, we have been sinners
normalizedArabic: قالوا يابانا استغفر لنا ذنوبنا انا كنا خطين
normalizedTranslation: they said, "o our father, ask for us forgiveness of our sins; indeed, we have been sinners

arabic: قَالَ سَوۡفَ أَسۡتَغۡفِرُ لَكُمۡ رَبِّيٓۖ إِنَّهُۥ هُوَ ٱلۡغَفُورُ ٱلرَّحِيمُ
translation: He said, "I will ask forgiveness for you from my Lord. Indeed, it is He who is the Forgiving, the Merciful
normalizedArabic: قال سوف استغفر لكم ربي انه هو الغفور الرحيم
normalizedTranslation: he said, "i will ask forgiveness for you from my lord. indeed, it is he who is the forgiving, the merciful

arabic: فَلَمَّا دَخَلُواْ عَلَىٰ يُوسُفَ ءَاوَىٰٓ إِلَيۡهِ أَبَوَيۡهِ وَقَالَ ٱدۡخُلُواْ مِصۡرَ إِن شَآءَ ٱللَّهُ ءَامِنِينَ
translation: And when they entered upon Joseph, he took his parents to himself and said, "Enter Egypt, Allah willing, safe [and secure]
normalizedArabic: فلما دخلوا علي يوسف ءاوي اليه ابويه وقال ادخلوا مصر ان شاء الله ءامنين
normalizedTranslation: and when they entered upon joseph, he took his parents to himself and said, "enter egypt, allah willing, safe [and secure]

arabic: وَرَفَعَ أَبَوَيۡهِ عَلَى ٱلۡعَرۡشِ وَخَرُّواْ لَهُۥ سُجَّدٗاۖ وَقَالَ يَـٰٓأَبَتِ هَٰذَا تَأۡوِيلُ رُءۡيَٰيَ مِن قَبۡلُ قَدۡ جَعَلَهَا رَبِّي حَقّٗاۖ وَقَدۡ أَحۡسَنَ بِيٓ إِذۡ أَخۡرَجَنِي مِنَ ٱلسِّجۡنِ وَجَآءَ بِكُم مِّنَ ٱلۡبَدۡوِ مِنۢ بَعۡدِ أَن نَّزَغَ ٱلشَّيۡطَٰنُ بَيۡنِي وَبَيۡنَ إِخۡوَتِيٓۚ إِنَّ رَبِّي لَطِيفٞ لِّمَا يَشَآءُۚ إِنَّهُۥ هُوَ ٱلۡعَلِيمُ ٱلۡحَكِيمُ
translation: And he raised his parents upon the throne, and they bowed to him in prostration. And he said, "O my father, this is the explanation of my vision of before. My Lord has made it reality. And He was certainly good to me when He took me out of prison and brought you [here] from bedouin life after Satan had induced [estrangement] between me and my brothers. Indeed, my Lord is Subtle in what He wills. Indeed, it is He who is the Knowing, the Wise
normalizedArabic: ورفع ابويه علي العرش وخروا له سجدا وقال يابت هذا تاويل رءيي من قبل قد جعلها ربي حقا وقد احسن بي اذ اخرجني من السجن وجاء بكم من البدو من بعد ان نزغ الشيطن بيني وبين اخوتي ان ربي لطيف لما يشاء انه هو العليم الحكيم
normalizedTranslation: and he raised his parents upon the throne, and they bowed to him in prostration. and he said, "o my father, this is the explanation of my vision of before. my lord has made it reality. and he was certainly good to me when he took me out of prison and brought you [here] from bedouin life after satan had induced [estrangement] between me and my brothers. indeed, my lord is subtle in what he wills. indeed, it is he who is the knowing, the wise

arabic: ۞رَبِّ قَدۡ ءَاتَيۡتَنِي مِنَ ٱلۡمُلۡكِ وَعَلَّمۡتَنِي مِن تَأۡوِيلِ ٱلۡأَحَادِيثِۚ فَاطِرَ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلۡأَرۡضِ أَنتَ وَلِيِّۦ فِي ٱلدُّنۡيَا وَٱلۡأٓخِرَةِۖ تَوَفَّنِي مُسۡلِمٗا وَأَلۡحِقۡنِي بِٱلصَّـٰلِحِينَ
translation: My Lord, You have given me [something] of sovereignty and taught me of the interpretation of dreams. Creator of the heavens and earth, You are my protector in this world and in the Hereafter. Cause me to die a Muslim and join me with the righteous
normalizedArabic: رب قد ءاتيتني من الملك وعلمتني من تاويل الاحاديث فاطر السموت والارض انت ولي في الدنيا والاخره توفني مسلما والحقني بالصلحين
normalizedTranslation: my lord, you have given me [something] of sovereignty and taught me of the interpretation of dreams. creator of the heavens and earth, you are my protector in this world and in the hereafter. cause me to die a muslim and join me with the righteous

arabic: ذَٰلِكَ مِنۡ أَنۢبَآءِ ٱلۡغَيۡبِ نُوحِيهِ إِلَيۡكَۖ وَمَا كُنتَ لَدَيۡهِمۡ إِذۡ أَجۡمَعُوٓاْ أَمۡرَهُمۡ وَهُمۡ يَمۡكُرُونَ
translation: That is from the news of the unseen which We reveal, [O Muhammad], to you. And you were not with them when they put together their plan while they conspired
normalizedArabic: ذلك من انباء الغيب نوحيه اليك وما كنت لديهم اذ اجمعوا امرهم وهم يمكرون
normalizedTranslation: that is from the news of the unseen which we reveal, [o muhammad], to you. and you were not with them when they put together their plan while they conspired

arabic: وَمَآ أَكۡثَرُ ٱلنَّاسِ وَلَوۡ حَرَصۡتَ بِمُؤۡمِنِينَ
translation: And most of the people, although you strive [for it], are not believers
normalizedArabic: وما اكثر الناس ولو حرصت بمومنين
normalizedTranslation: and most of the people, although you strive [for it], are not believers

arabic: وَمَا تَسۡـَٔلُهُمۡ عَلَيۡهِ مِنۡ أَجۡرٍۚ إِنۡ هُوَ إِلَّا ذِكۡرٞ لِّلۡعَٰلَمِينَ
translation: And you do not ask of them for it any payment. It is not except a reminder to the worlds
normalizedArabic: وما تسلهم عليه من اجر ان هو الا ذكر للعلمين
normalizedTranslation: and you do not ask of them for it any payment. it is not except a reminder to the worlds

arabic: وَكَأَيِّن مِّنۡ ءَايَةٖ فِي ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلۡأَرۡضِ يَمُرُّونَ عَلَيۡهَا وَهُمۡ عَنۡهَا مُعۡرِضُونَ
translation: And how many a sign within the heavens and earth do they pass over while they, therefrom, are turning away
normalizedArabic: وكاين من ءايه في السموت والارض يمرون عليها وهم عنها معرضون
normalizedTranslation: and how many a sign within the heavens and earth do they pass over while they, therefrom, are turning away

arabic: وَمَا يُؤۡمِنُ أَكۡثَرُهُم بِٱللَّهِ إِلَّا وَهُم مُّشۡرِكُونَ
translation: And most of them believe not in Allah except while they associate others with Him
normalizedArabic: وما يومن اكثرهم بالله الا وهم مشركون
normalizedTranslation: and most of them believe not in allah except while they associate others with him

arabic: أَفَأَمِنُوٓاْ أَن تَأۡتِيَهُمۡ غَٰشِيَةٞ مِّنۡ عَذَابِ ٱللَّهِ أَوۡ تَأۡتِيَهُمُ ٱلسَّاعَةُ بَغۡتَةٗ وَهُمۡ لَا يَشۡعُرُونَ
translation: Then do they feel secure that there will not come to them an overwhelming [aspect] of the punishment of Allah or that the Hour will not come upon them suddenly while they do not perceive
normalizedArabic: افامنوا ان تاتيهم غشيه من عذاب الله او تاتيهم الساعه بغته وهم لا يشعرون
normalizedTranslation: then do they feel secure that there will not come to them an overwhelming [aspect] of the punishment of allah or that the hour will not come upon them suddenly while they do not perceive

arabic: قُلۡ هَٰذِهِۦ سَبِيلِيٓ أَدۡعُوٓاْ إِلَى ٱللَّهِۚ عَلَىٰ بَصِيرَةٍ أَنَا۠ وَمَنِ ٱتَّبَعَنِيۖ وَسُبۡحَٰنَ ٱللَّهِ وَمَآ أَنَا۠ مِنَ ٱلۡمُشۡرِكِينَ
translation: Say, "This is my way; I invite to Allah with insight, I and those who follow me. And exalted is Allah; and I am not of those who associate others with Him
normalizedArabic: قل هذه سبيلي ادعوا الي الله علي بصيره انا ومن اتبعني وسبحن الله وما انا من المشركين
normalizedTranslation: say, "this is my way; i invite to allah with insight, i and those who follow me. and exalted is allah; and i am not of those who associate others with him

arabic: وَمَآ أَرۡسَلۡنَا مِن قَبۡلِكَ إِلَّا رِجَالٗا نُّوحِيٓ إِلَيۡهِم مِّنۡ أَهۡلِ ٱلۡقُرَىٰٓۗ أَفَلَمۡ يَسِيرُواْ فِي ٱلۡأَرۡضِ فَيَنظُرُواْ كَيۡفَ كَانَ عَٰقِبَةُ ٱلَّذِينَ مِن قَبۡلِهِمۡۗ وَلَدَارُ ٱلۡأٓخِرَةِ خَيۡرٞ لِّلَّذِينَ ٱتَّقَوۡاْۚ أَفَلَا تَعۡقِلُونَ
translation: And We sent not before you [as messengers] except men to whom We revealed from among the people of cities. So have they not traveled through the earth and observed how was the end of those before them? And the home of the Hereafter is best for those who fear Allah; then will you not reason
normalizedArabic: وما ارسلنا من قبلك الا رجالا نوحي اليهم من اهل القري افلم يسيروا في الارض فينظروا كيف كان عقبه الذين من قبلهم ولدار الاخره خير للذين اتقوا افلا تعقلون
normalizedTranslation: and we sent not before you [as messengers] except men to whom we revealed from among the people of cities. so have they not traveled through the earth and observed how was the end of those before them? and the home of the hereafter is best for those who fear allah; then will you not reason

arabic: حَتَّىٰٓ إِذَا ٱسۡتَيۡـَٔسَ ٱلرُّسُلُ وَظَنُّوٓاْ أَنَّهُمۡ قَدۡ كُذِبُواْ جَآءَهُمۡ نَصۡرُنَا فَنُجِّيَ مَن نَّشَآءُۖ وَلَا يُرَدُّ بَأۡسُنَا عَنِ ٱلۡقَوۡمِ ٱلۡمُجۡرِمِينَ
translation: [They continued] until, when the messengers despaired and were certain that they had been denied, there came to them Our victory, and whoever We willed was saved. And Our punishment cannot be repelled from the people who are criminals
normalizedArabic: حتي اذا استيس الرسل وظنوا انهم قد كذبوا جاءهم نصرنا فنجي من نشاء ولا يرد باسنا عن القوم المجرمين
normalizedTranslation: [they continued] until, when the messengers despaired and were certain that they had been denied, there came to them our victory, and whoever we willed was saved. and our punishment cannot be repelled from the people who are criminals

arabic: لَقَدۡ كَانَ فِي قَصَصِهِمۡ عِبۡرَةٞ لِّأُوْلِي ٱلۡأَلۡبَٰبِۗ مَا كَانَ حَدِيثٗا يُفۡتَرَىٰ وَلَٰكِن تَصۡدِيقَ ٱلَّذِي بَيۡنَ يَدَيۡهِ وَتَفۡصِيلَ كُلِّ شَيۡءٖ وَهُدٗى وَرَحۡمَةٗ لِّقَوۡمٖ يُؤۡمِنُونَ
translation: There was certainly in their stories a lesson for those of understanding. Never was the Qur'an a narration invented, but a confirmation of what was before it and a detailed explanation of all things and guidance and mercy for a people who believe
normalizedArabic: لقد كان في قصصهم عبره لاولي الالبب ما كان حديثا يفتري ولكن تصديق الذي بين يديه وتفصيل كل شيء وهدي ورحمه لقوم يومنون
normalizedTranslation: there was certainly in their stories a lesson for those of understanding. never was the qur'an a narration invented, but a confirmation of what was before it and a detailed explanation of all things and guidance and mercy for a people who believe

arabic: الٓمٓرۚ تِلۡكَ ءَايَٰتُ ٱلۡكِتَٰبِۗ وَٱلَّذِيٓ أُنزِلَ إِلَيۡكَ مِن رَّبِّكَ ٱلۡحَقُّ وَلَٰكِنَّ أَكۡثَرَ ٱلنَّاسِ لَا يُؤۡمِنُونَ
translation: Alif, Lam, Meem, Ra. These are the verses of the Book; and what has been revealed to you from your Lord is the truth, but most of the people do not believe
normalizedArabic: المر تلك ءايت الكتب والذي انزل اليك من ربك الحق ولكن اكثر الناس لا يومنون
normalizedTranslation: alif, lam, meem, ra. these are the verses of the book; and what has been revealed to you from your lord is the truth, but most of the people do not believe

arabic: ٱللَّهُ ٱلَّذِي رَفَعَ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ بِغَيۡرِ عَمَدٖ تَرَوۡنَهَاۖ ثُمَّ ٱسۡتَوَىٰ عَلَى ٱلۡعَرۡشِۖ وَسَخَّرَ ٱلشَّمۡسَ وَٱلۡقَمَرَۖ كُلّٞ يَجۡرِي لِأَجَلٖ مُّسَمّٗىۚ يُدَبِّرُ ٱلۡأَمۡرَ يُفَصِّلُ ٱلۡأٓيَٰتِ لَعَلَّكُم بِلِقَآءِ رَبِّكُمۡ تُوقِنُونَ
translation: It is Allah who erected the heavens without pillars that you [can] see; then He established Himself above the Throne and made subject the sun and the moon, each running [its course] for a specified term. He arranges [each] matter; He details the signs that you may, of the meeting with your Lord, be certain
normalizedArabic: الله الذي رفع السموت بغير عمد ترونها ثم استوي علي العرش وسخر الشمس والقمر كل يجري لاجل مسمي يدبر الامر يفصل الايت لعلكم بلقاء ربكم توقنون
normalizedTranslation: it is allah who erected the heavens without pillars that you [can] see; then he established himself above the throne and made subject the sun and the moon, each running [its course] for a specified term. he arranges [each] matter; he details the signs that you may, of the meeting with your lord, be certain

arabic: وَهُوَ ٱلَّذِي مَدَّ ٱلۡأَرۡضَ وَجَعَلَ فِيهَا رَوَٰسِيَ وَأَنۡهَٰرٗاۖ وَمِن كُلِّ ٱلثَّمَرَٰتِ جَعَلَ فِيهَا زَوۡجَيۡنِ ٱثۡنَيۡنِۖ يُغۡشِي ٱلَّيۡلَ ٱلنَّهَارَۚ إِنَّ فِي ذَٰلِكَ لَأٓيَٰتٖ لِّقَوۡمٖ يَتَفَكَّرُونَ
translation: And it is He who spread the earth and placed therein firmly set mountains and rivers; and from all of the fruits He made therein two mates; He causes the night to cover the day. Indeed in that are signs for a people who give thought
normalizedArabic: وهو الذي مد الارض وجعل فيها روسي وانهرا ومن كل الثمرت جعل فيها زوجين اثنين يغشي اليل النهار ان في ذلك لايت لقوم يتفكرون
normalizedTranslation: and it is he who spread the earth and placed therein firmly set mountains and rivers; and from all of the fruits he made therein two mates; he causes the night to cover the day. indeed in that are signs for a people who give thought

arabic: وَفِي ٱلۡأَرۡضِ قِطَعٞ مُّتَجَٰوِرَٰتٞ وَجَنَّـٰتٞ مِّنۡ أَعۡنَٰبٖ وَزَرۡعٞ وَنَخِيلٞ صِنۡوَانٞ وَغَيۡرُ صِنۡوَانٖ يُسۡقَىٰ بِمَآءٖ وَٰحِدٖ وَنُفَضِّلُ بَعۡضَهَا عَلَىٰ بَعۡضٖ فِي ٱلۡأُكُلِۚ إِنَّ فِي ذَٰلِكَ لَأٓيَٰتٖ لِّقَوۡمٖ يَعۡقِلُونَ
translation: And within the land are neighboring plots and gardens of grapevines and crops and palm trees, [growing] several from a root or otherwise, watered with one water; but We make some of them exceed others in [quality of] fruit. Indeed in that are signs for a people who reason
normalizedArabic: وفي الارض قطع متجورت وجنت من اعنب وزرع ونخيل صنوان وغير صنوان يسقي بماء وحد ونفضل بعضها علي بعض في الاكل ان في ذلك لايت لقوم يعقلون
normalizedTranslation: and within the land are neighboring plots and gardens of grapevines and crops and palm trees, [growing] several from a root or otherwise, watered with one water; but we make some of them exceed others in [quality of] fruit. indeed in that are signs for a people who reason

arabic: ۞وَإِن تَعۡجَبۡ فَعَجَبٞ قَوۡلُهُمۡ أَءِذَا كُنَّا تُرَٰبًا أَءِنَّا لَفِي خَلۡقٖ جَدِيدٍۗ أُوْلَـٰٓئِكَ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُواْ بِرَبِّهِمۡۖ وَأُوْلَـٰٓئِكَ ٱلۡأَغۡلَٰلُ فِيٓ أَعۡنَاقِهِمۡۖ وَأُوْلَـٰٓئِكَ أَصۡحَٰبُ ٱلنَّارِۖ هُمۡ فِيهَا خَٰلِدُونَ
translation: And if you are astonished, [O Muhammad] - then astonishing is their saying, "When we are dust, will we indeed be [brought] into a new creation?" Those are the ones who have disbelieved in their Lord, and those will have shackles upon their necks, and those are the companions of the Fire; they will abide therein eternally
normalizedArabic: وان تعجب فعجب قولهم اءذا كنا تربا اءنا لفي خلق جديد اوليك الذين كفروا بربهم واوليك الاغلل في اعناقهم واوليك اصحب النار هم فيها خلدون
normalizedTranslation: and if you are astonished, [o muhammad] - then astonishing is their saying, "when we are dust, will we indeed be [brought] into a new creation?" those are the ones who have disbelieved in their lord, and those will have shackles upon their necks, and those are the companions of the fire; they will abide therein eternally

arabic: وَيَسۡتَعۡجِلُونَكَ بِٱلسَّيِّئَةِ قَبۡلَ ٱلۡحَسَنَةِ وَقَدۡ خَلَتۡ مِن قَبۡلِهِمُ ٱلۡمَثُلَٰتُۗ وَإِنَّ رَبَّكَ لَذُو مَغۡفِرَةٖ لِّلنَّاسِ عَلَىٰ ظُلۡمِهِمۡۖ وَإِنَّ رَبَّكَ لَشَدِيدُ ٱلۡعِقَابِ
translation: They impatiently urge you to bring about evil before good, while there has already occurred before them similar punishments [to what they demand]. And indeed, your Lord is full of forgiveness for the people despite their wrongdoing, and indeed, your Lord is severe in penalty
normalizedArabic: ويستعجلونك بالسييه قبل الحسنه وقد خلت من قبلهم المثلت وان ربك لذو مغفره للناس علي ظلمهم وان ربك لشديد العقاب
normalizedTranslation: they impatiently urge you to bring about evil before good, while there has already occurred before them similar punishments [to what they demand]. and indeed, your lord is full of forgiveness for the people despite their wrongdoing, and indeed, your lord is severe in penalty

arabic: وَيَقُولُ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُواْ لَوۡلَآ أُنزِلَ عَلَيۡهِ ءَايَةٞ مِّن رَّبِّهِۦٓۗ إِنَّمَآ أَنتَ مُنذِرٞۖ وَلِكُلِّ قَوۡمٍ هَادٍ
translation: And those who disbelieved say, "Why has a sign not been sent down to him from his Lord?" You are only a warner, and for every people is a guide
normalizedArabic: ويقول الذين كفروا لولا انزل عليه ءايه من ربه انما انت منذر ولكل قوم هاد
normalizedTranslation: and those who disbelieved say, "why has a sign not been sent down to him from his lord?" you are only a warner, and for every people is a guide

arabic: ٱللَّهُ يَعۡلَمُ مَا تَحۡمِلُ كُلُّ أُنثَىٰ وَمَا تَغِيضُ ٱلۡأَرۡحَامُ وَمَا تَزۡدَادُۚ وَكُلُّ شَيۡءٍ عِندَهُۥ بِمِقۡدَارٍ
translation: Allah knows what every female carries and what the wombs lose [prematurely] or exceed. And everything with Him is by due measure
normalizedArabic: الله يعلم ما تحمل كل انثي وما تغيض الارحام وما تزداد وكل شيء عنده بمقدار
normalizedTranslation: allah knows what every female carries and what the wombs lose [prematurely] or exceed. and everything with him is by due measure

arabic: عَٰلِمُ ٱلۡغَيۡبِ وَٱلشَّهَٰدَةِ ٱلۡكَبِيرُ ٱلۡمُتَعَالِ
translation: [He is] Knower of the unseen and the witnessed, the Grand, the Exalted
normalizedArabic: علم الغيب والشهده الكبير المتعال
normalizedTranslation: [he is] knower of the unseen and the witnessed, the grand, the exalted

arabic: سَوَآءٞ مِّنكُم مَّنۡ أَسَرَّ ٱلۡقَوۡلَ وَمَن جَهَرَ بِهِۦ وَمَنۡ هُوَ مُسۡتَخۡفِۭ بِٱلَّيۡلِ وَسَارِبُۢ بِٱلنَّهَارِ
translation: It is the same [to Him] concerning you whether one conceals [his] speech or one publicizes it and whether one is hidden by night or conspicuous [among others] by day
normalizedArabic: سواء منكم من اسر القول ومن جهر به ومن هو مستخف باليل وسارب بالنهار
normalizedTranslation: it is the same [to him] concerning you whether one conceals [his] speech or one publicizes it and whether one is hidden by night or conspicuous [among others] by day

arabic: لَهُۥ مُعَقِّبَٰتٞ مِّنۢ بَيۡنِ يَدَيۡهِ وَمِنۡ خَلۡفِهِۦ يَحۡفَظُونَهُۥ مِنۡ أَمۡرِ ٱللَّهِۗ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ لَا يُغَيِّرُ مَا بِقَوۡمٍ حَتَّىٰ يُغَيِّرُواْ مَا بِأَنفُسِهِمۡۗ وَإِذَآ أَرَادَ ٱللَّهُ بِقَوۡمٖ سُوٓءٗا فَلَا مَرَدَّ لَهُۥۚ وَمَا لَهُم مِّن دُونِهِۦ مِن وَالٍ
translation: For each one are successive [angels] before and behind him who protect him by the decree of Allah. Indeed, Allah will not change the condition of a people until they change what is in themselves. And when Allah intends for a people ill, there is no repelling it. And there is not for them besides Him any patron
normalizedArabic: له معقبت من بين يديه ومن خلفه يحفظونه من امر الله ان الله لا يغير ما بقوم حتي يغيروا ما بانفسهم واذا اراد الله بقوم سوءا فلا مرد له وما لهم من دونه من وال
normalizedTranslation: for each one are successive [angels] before and behind him who protect him by the decree of allah. indeed, allah will not change the condition of a people until they change what is in themselves. and when allah intends for a people ill, there is no repelling it. and there is not for them besides him any patron

arabic: هُوَ ٱلَّذِي يُرِيكُمُ ٱلۡبَرۡقَ خَوۡفٗا وَطَمَعٗا وَيُنشِئُ ٱلسَّحَابَ ٱلثِّقَالَ
translation: It is He who shows you lightening, [causing] fear and aspiration, and generates the heavy clouds
normalizedArabic: هو الذي يريكم البرق خوفا وطمعا وينشي السحاب الثقال
normalizedTranslation: it is he who shows you lightening, [causing] fear and aspiration, and generates the heavy clouds

arabic: وَيُسَبِّحُ ٱلرَّعۡدُ بِحَمۡدِهِۦ وَٱلۡمَلَـٰٓئِكَةُ مِنۡ خِيفَتِهِۦ وَيُرۡسِلُ ٱلصَّوَٰعِقَ فَيُصِيبُ بِهَا مَن يَشَآءُ وَهُمۡ يُجَٰدِلُونَ فِي ٱللَّهِ وَهُوَ شَدِيدُ ٱلۡمِحَالِ
translation: And the thunder exalts [Allah] with praise of Him - and the angels [as well] from fear of Him - and He sends thunderbolts and strikes therewith whom He wills while they dispute about Allah; and He is severe in assault
normalizedArabic: ويسبح الرعد بحمده والمليكه من خيفته ويرسل الصوعق فيصيب بها من يشاء وهم يجدلون في الله وهو شديد المحال
normalizedTranslation: and the thunder exalts [allah] with praise of him - and the angels [as well] from fear of him - and he sends thunderbolts and strikes therewith whom he wills while they dispute about allah; and he is severe in assault

arabic: لَهُۥ دَعۡوَةُ ٱلۡحَقِّۚ وَٱلَّذِينَ يَدۡعُونَ مِن دُونِهِۦ لَا يَسۡتَجِيبُونَ لَهُم بِشَيۡءٍ إِلَّا كَبَٰسِطِ كَفَّيۡهِ إِلَى ٱلۡمَآءِ لِيَبۡلُغَ فَاهُ وَمَا هُوَ بِبَٰلِغِهِۦۚ وَمَا دُعَآءُ ٱلۡكَٰفِرِينَ إِلَّا فِي ضَلَٰلٖ
translation: To Him [alone] is the supplication of truth. And those they call upon besides Him do not respond to them with a thing, except as one who stretches his hands toward water [from afar, calling it] to reach his mouth, but it will not reach it [thus]. And the supplication of the disbelievers is not but in error [i.e. futility]
normalizedArabic: له دعوه الحق والذين يدعون من دونه لا يستجيبون لهم بشيء الا كبسط كفيه الي الماء ليبلغ فاه وما هو ببلغه وما دعاء الكفرين الا في ضلل
normalizedTranslation: to him [alone] is the supplication of truth. and those they call upon besides him do not respond to them with a thing, except as one who stretches his hands toward water [from afar, calling it] to reach his mouth, but it will not reach it [thus]. and the supplication of the disbelievers is not but in error [i.e. futility]

arabic: وَلِلَّهِۤ يَسۡجُدُۤ مَن فِي ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلۡأَرۡضِ طَوۡعٗا وَكَرۡهٗا وَظِلَٰلُهُم بِٱلۡغُدُوِّ وَٱلۡأٓصَالِ۩
translation: And to Allah prostrates whoever is within the heavens and the earth, willingly or by compulsion, and their shadows [as well] in the mornings and the afternoons
normalizedArabic: ولله يسجد من في السموت والارض طوعا وكرها وظللهم بالغدو والاصال
normalizedTranslation: and to allah prostrates whoever is within the heavens and the earth, willingly or by compulsion, and their shadows [as well] in the mornings and the afternoons

arabic: قُلۡ مَن رَّبُّ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلۡأَرۡضِ قُلِ ٱللَّهُۚ قُلۡ أَفَٱتَّخَذۡتُم مِّن دُونِهِۦٓ أَوۡلِيَآءَ لَا يَمۡلِكُونَ لِأَنفُسِهِمۡ نَفۡعٗا وَلَا ضَرّٗاۚ قُلۡ هَلۡ يَسۡتَوِي ٱلۡأَعۡمَىٰ وَٱلۡبَصِيرُ أَمۡ هَلۡ تَسۡتَوِي ٱلظُّلُمَٰتُ وَٱلنُّورُۗ أَمۡ جَعَلُواْ لِلَّهِ شُرَكَآءَ خَلَقُواْ كَخَلۡقِهِۦ فَتَشَٰبَهَ ٱلۡخَلۡقُ عَلَيۡهِمۡۚ قُلِ ٱللَّهُ خَٰلِقُ كُلِّ شَيۡءٖ وَهُوَ ٱلۡوَٰحِدُ ٱلۡقَهَّـٰرُ
translation: Say, "Who is Lord of the heavens and earth?" Say, "Allah." Say, "Have you then taken besides Him allies not possessing [even] for themselves any benefit or any harm?" Say, "Is the blind equivalent to the seeing? Or is darkness equivalent to light? Or have they attributed to Allah partners who created like His creation so that the creation [of each] seemed similar to them?" Say, "Allah is the Creator of all things, and He is the One, the Prevailing
normalizedArabic: قل من رب السموت والارض قل الله قل افاتخذتم من دونه اولياء لا يملكون لانفسهم نفعا ولا ضرا قل هل يستوي الاعمي والبصير ام هل تستوي الظلمت والنور ام جعلوا لله شركاء خلقوا كخلقه فتشبه الخلق عليهم قل الله خلق كل شيء وهو الوحد القهر
normalizedTranslation: say, "who is lord of the heavens and earth?" say, "allah." say, "have you then taken besides him allies not possessing [even] for themselves any benefit or any harm?" say, "is the blind equivalent to the seeing? or is darkness equivalent to light? or have they attributed to allah partners who created like his creation so that the creation [of each] seemed similar to them?" say, "allah is the creator of all things, and he is the one, the prevailing

arabic: أَنزَلَ مِنَ ٱلسَّمَآءِ مَآءٗ فَسَالَتۡ أَوۡدِيَةُۢ بِقَدَرِهَا فَٱحۡتَمَلَ ٱلسَّيۡلُ زَبَدٗا رَّابِيٗاۖ وَمِمَّا يُوقِدُونَ عَلَيۡهِ فِي ٱلنَّارِ ٱبۡتِغَآءَ حِلۡيَةٍ أَوۡ مَتَٰعٖ زَبَدٞ مِّثۡلُهُۥۚ كَذَٰلِكَ يَضۡرِبُ ٱللَّهُ ٱلۡحَقَّ وَٱلۡبَٰطِلَۚ فَأَمَّا ٱلزَّبَدُ فَيَذۡهَبُ جُفَآءٗۖ وَأَمَّا مَا يَنفَعُ ٱلنَّاسَ فَيَمۡكُثُ فِي ٱلۡأَرۡضِۚ كَذَٰلِكَ يَضۡرِبُ ٱللَّهُ ٱلۡأَمۡثَالَ
translation: He sends down from the sky, rain, and valleys flow according to their capacity, and the torrent carries a rising foam. And from that [ore] which they heat in the fire, desiring adornments and utensils, is a foam like it. Thus Allah presents [the example of] truth and falsehood. As for the foam, it vanishes, [being] cast off; but as for that which benefits the people, it remains on the earth. Thus does Allah present examples
normalizedArabic: انزل من السماء ماء فسالت اوديه بقدرها فاحتمل السيل زبدا رابيا ومما يوقدون عليه في النار ابتغاء حليه او متع زبد مثله كذلك يضرب الله الحق والبطل فاما الزبد فيذهب جفاء واما ما ينفع الناس فيمكث في الارض كذلك يضرب الله الامثال
normalizedTranslation: he sends down from the sky, rain, and valleys flow according to their capacity, and the torrent carries a rising foam. and from that [ore] which they heat in the fire, desiring adornments and utensils, is a foam like it. thus allah presents [the example of] truth and falsehood. as for the foam, it vanishes, [being] cast off; but as for that which benefits the people, it remains on the earth. thus does allah present examples

arabic: لِلَّذِينَ ٱسۡتَجَابُواْ لِرَبِّهِمُ ٱلۡحُسۡنَىٰۚ وَٱلَّذِينَ لَمۡ يَسۡتَجِيبُواْ لَهُۥ لَوۡ أَنَّ لَهُم مَّا فِي ٱلۡأَرۡضِ جَمِيعٗا وَمِثۡلَهُۥ مَعَهُۥ لَٱفۡتَدَوۡاْ بِهِۦٓۚ أُوْلَـٰٓئِكَ لَهُمۡ سُوٓءُ ٱلۡحِسَابِ وَمَأۡوَىٰهُمۡ جَهَنَّمُۖ وَبِئۡسَ ٱلۡمِهَادُ
translation: For those who have responded to their Lord is the best [reward], but those who did not respond to Him - if they had all that is in the earth entirely and the like of it with it, they would [attempt to] ransom themselves thereby. Those will have the worst account, and their refuge is Hell, and wretched is the resting place
normalizedArabic: للذين استجابوا لربهم الحسني والذين لم يستجيبوا له لو ان لهم ما في الارض جميعا ومثله معه لافتدوا به اوليك لهم سوء الحساب وماويهم جهنم وبيس المهاد
normalizedTranslation: for those who have responded to their lord is the best [reward], but those who did not respond to him - if they had all that is in the earth entirely and the like of it with it, they would [attempt to] ransom themselves thereby. those will have the worst account, and their refuge is hell, and wretched is the resting place

arabic: ۞أَفَمَن يَعۡلَمُ أَنَّمَآ أُنزِلَ إِلَيۡكَ مِن رَّبِّكَ ٱلۡحَقُّ كَمَنۡ هُوَ أَعۡمَىٰٓۚ إِنَّمَا يَتَذَكَّرُ أُوْلُواْ ٱلۡأَلۡبَٰبِ
translation: Then is he who knows that what has been revealed to you from your Lord is the truth like one who is blind? They will only be reminded who are people of understanding
normalizedArabic: افمن يعلم انما انزل اليك من ربك الحق كمن هو اعمي انما يتذكر اولوا الالبب
normalizedTranslation: then is he who knows that what has been revealed to you from your lord is the truth like one who is blind? they will only be reminded who are people of understanding

arabic: ٱلَّذِينَ يُوفُونَ بِعَهۡدِ ٱللَّهِ وَلَا يَنقُضُونَ ٱلۡمِيثَٰقَ
translation: Those who fulfill the covenant of Allah and do not break the contract
normalizedArabic: الذين يوفون بعهد الله ولا ينقضون الميثق
normalizedTranslation: those who fulfill the covenant of allah and do not break the contract

arabic: وَٱلَّذِينَ يَصِلُونَ مَآ أَمَرَ ٱللَّهُ بِهِۦٓ أَن يُوصَلَ وَيَخۡشَوۡنَ رَبَّهُمۡ وَيَخَافُونَ سُوٓءَ ٱلۡحِسَابِ
translation: And those who join that which Allah has ordered to be joined and fear their Lord and are afraid of the evil of [their] account
normalizedArabic: والذين يصلون ما امر الله به ان يوصل ويخشون ربهم ويخافون سوء الحساب
normalizedTranslation: and those who join that which allah has ordered to be joined and fear their lord and are afraid of the evil of [their] account

arabic: وَٱلَّذِينَ صَبَرُواْ ٱبۡتِغَآءَ وَجۡهِ رَبِّهِمۡ وَأَقَامُواْ ٱلصَّلَوٰةَ وَأَنفَقُواْ مِمَّا رَزَقۡنَٰهُمۡ سِرّٗا وَعَلَانِيَةٗ وَيَدۡرَءُونَ بِٱلۡحَسَنَةِ ٱلسَّيِّئَةَ أُوْلَـٰٓئِكَ لَهُمۡ عُقۡبَى ٱلدَّارِ
translation: And those who are patient, seeking the countenance of their Lord, and establish prayer and spend from what We have provided for them secretly and publicly and prevent evil with good - those will have the good consequence of [this] home
normalizedArabic: والذين صبروا ابتغاء وجه ربهم واقاموا الصلوه وانفقوا مما رزقنهم سرا وعلانيه ويدرءون بالحسنه السييه اوليك لهم عقبي الدار
normalizedTranslation: and those who are patient, seeking the countenance of their lord, and establish prayer and spend from what we have provided for them secretly and publicly and prevent evil with good - those will have the good consequence of [this] home

arabic: جَنَّـٰتُ عَدۡنٖ يَدۡخُلُونَهَا وَمَن صَلَحَ مِنۡ ءَابَآئِهِمۡ وَأَزۡوَٰجِهِمۡ وَذُرِّيَّـٰتِهِمۡۖ وَٱلۡمَلَـٰٓئِكَةُ يَدۡخُلُونَ عَلَيۡهِم مِّن كُلِّ بَابٖ
translation: Gardens of perpetual residence; they will enter them with whoever were righteous among their fathers, their spouses and their descendants. And the angels will enter upon them from every gate, [saying]
normalizedArabic: جنت عدن يدخلونها ومن صلح من ءابايهم وازوجهم وذريتهم والمليكه يدخلون عليهم من كل باب
normalizedTranslation: gardens of perpetual residence; they will enter them with whoever were righteous among their fathers, their spouses and their descendants. and the angels will enter upon them from every gate, [saying]

arabic: سَلَٰمٌ عَلَيۡكُم بِمَا صَبَرۡتُمۡۚ فَنِعۡمَ عُقۡبَى ٱلدَّارِ
translation: Peace be upon you for what you patiently endured. And excellent is the final home
normalizedArabic: سلم عليكم بما صبرتم فنعم عقبي الدار
normalizedTranslation: peace be upon you for what you patiently endured. and excellent is the final home

arabic: وَٱلَّذِينَ يَنقُضُونَ عَهۡدَ ٱللَّهِ مِنۢ بَعۡدِ مِيثَٰقِهِۦ وَيَقۡطَعُونَ مَآ أَمَرَ ٱللَّهُ بِهِۦٓ أَن يُوصَلَ وَيُفۡسِدُونَ فِي ٱلۡأَرۡضِ أُوْلَـٰٓئِكَ لَهُمُ ٱللَّعۡنَةُ وَلَهُمۡ سُوٓءُ ٱلدَّارِ
translation: But those who break the covenant of Allah after contracting it and sever that which Allah has ordered to be joined and spread corruption on earth - for them is the curse, and they will have the worst home
normalizedArabic: والذين ينقضون عهد الله من بعد ميثقه ويقطعون ما امر الله به ان يوصل ويفسدون في الارض اوليك لهم اللعنه ولهم سوء الدار
normalizedTranslation: but those who break the covenant of allah after contracting it and sever that which allah has ordered to be joined and spread corruption on earth - for them is the curse, and they will have the worst home

arabic: ٱللَّهُ يَبۡسُطُ ٱلرِّزۡقَ لِمَن يَشَآءُ وَيَقۡدِرُۚ وَفَرِحُواْ بِٱلۡحَيَوٰةِ ٱلدُّنۡيَا وَمَا ٱلۡحَيَوٰةُ ٱلدُّنۡيَا فِي ٱلۡأٓخِرَةِ إِلَّا مَتَٰعٞ
translation: Allah extends provision for whom He wills and restricts [it]. And they rejoice in the worldly life, while the worldly life is not, compared to the Hereafter, except [brief] enjoyment

normalizedTranslation: allah extends provision for whom he wills and restricts [it]. and they rejoice in the worldly life, while the worldly life is not, compared to the hereafter, except [brief] enjoyment

arabic: وَيَقُولُ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُواْ لَوۡلَآ أُنزِلَ عَلَيۡهِ ءَايَةٞ مِّن رَّبِّهِۦۚ قُلۡ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ يُضِلُّ مَن يَشَآءُ وَيَهۡدِيٓ إِلَيۡهِ مَنۡ أَنَابَ
translation: And those who disbelieved say, "Why has a sign not been sent down to him from his Lord?" Say, [O Muhammad], "Indeed, Allah leaves astray whom He wills and guides to Himself whoever turns back [to Him]
normalizedArabic: ويقول الذين كفروا لولا انزل عليه ءايه من ربه قل ان الله يضل من يشاء ويهدي اليه من اناب
normalizedTranslation: and those who disbelieved say, "why has a sign not been sent down to him from his lord?" say, [o muhammad], "indeed, allah leaves astray whom he wills and guides to himself whoever turns back [to him]

arabic: ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُواْ وَتَطۡمَئِنُّ قُلُوبُهُم بِذِكۡرِ ٱللَّهِۗ أَلَا بِذِكۡرِ ٱللَّهِ تَطۡمَئِنُّ ٱلۡقُلُوبُ
translation: Those who have believed and whose hearts are assured by the remembrance of Allah. Unquestionably, by the remembrance of Allah hearts are assured

normalizedTranslation: those who have believed and whose hearts are assured by the remembrance of allah. unquestionably, by the remembrance of allah hearts are assured

arabic: ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُواْ وَعَمِلُواْ ٱلصَّـٰلِحَٰتِ طُوبَىٰ لَهُمۡ وَحُسۡنُ مَـَٔابٖ
translation: Those who have believed and done righteous deeds - a good state is theirs and a good return
normalizedArabic: الذين ءامنوا وعملوا الصلحت طوبي لهم وحسن ماب
normalizedTranslation: those who have believed and done righteous deeds - a good state is theirs and a good return

arabic: كَذَٰلِكَ أَرۡسَلۡنَٰكَ فِيٓ أُمَّةٖ قَدۡ خَلَتۡ مِن قَبۡلِهَآ أُمَمٞ لِّتَتۡلُوَاْ عَلَيۡهِمُ ٱلَّذِيٓ أَوۡحَيۡنَآ إِلَيۡكَ وَهُمۡ يَكۡفُرُونَ بِٱلرَّحۡمَٰنِۚ قُلۡ هُوَ رَبِّي لَآ إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا هُوَ عَلَيۡهِ تَوَكَّلۡتُ وَإِلَيۡهِ مَتَابِ
translation: Thus have We sent you to a community before which [other] communities have passed on so you might recite to them that which We revealed to you, while they disbelieve in the Most Merciful. Say, "He is my Lord; there is no deity except Him. Upon Him I rely, and to Him is my return
normalizedArabic: كذلك ارسلنك في امه قد خلت من قبلها امم لتتلوا عليهم الذي اوحينا اليك وهم يكفرون بالرحمن قل هو ربي لا اله الا هو عليه توكلت واليه متاب
normalizedTranslation: thus have we sent you to a community before which [other] communities have passed on so you might recite to them that which we revealed to you, while they disbelieve in the most merciful. say, "he is my lord; there is no deity except him. upon him i rely, and to him is my return

arabic: وَلَوۡ أَنَّ قُرۡءَانٗا سُيِّرَتۡ بِهِ ٱلۡجِبَالُ أَوۡ قُطِّعَتۡ بِهِ ٱلۡأَرۡضُ أَوۡ كُلِّمَ بِهِ ٱلۡمَوۡتَىٰۗ بَل لِّلَّهِ ٱلۡأَمۡرُ جَمِيعًاۗ أَفَلَمۡ يَاْيۡـَٔسِ ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوٓاْ أَن لَّوۡ يَشَآءُ ٱللَّهُ لَهَدَى ٱلنَّاسَ جَمِيعٗاۗ وَلَا يَزَالُ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُواْ تُصِيبُهُم بِمَا صَنَعُواْ قَارِعَةٌ أَوۡ تَحُلُّ قَرِيبٗا مِّن دَارِهِمۡ حَتَّىٰ يَأۡتِيَ وَعۡدُ ٱللَّهِۚ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ لَا يُخۡلِفُ ٱلۡمِيعَادَ
translation: And if there was any qur'an by which the mountains would be removed or the earth would be broken apart or the dead would be made to speak, [it would be this Qur'an], but to Allah belongs the affair entirely. Then have those who believed not accepted that had Allah willed, He would have guided the people, all of them? And those who disbelieve do not cease to be struck, for what they have done, by calamity - or it will descend near their home - until there comes the promise of Allah. Indeed, Allah does not fail in [His] promise
normalizedArabic: ولو ان قرءانا سيرت به الجبال او قطعت به الارض او كلم به الموتي بل لله الامر جميعا افلم يايس الذين ءامنوا ان لو يشاء الله لهدي الناس جميعا ولا يزال الذين كفروا تصيبهم بما صنعوا قارعه او تحل قريبا من دارهم حتي ياتي وعد الله ان الله لا يخلف الميعاد
normalizedTranslation: and if there was any qur'an by which the mountains would be removed or the earth would be broken apart or the dead would be made to speak, [it would be this qur'an], but to allah belongs the affair entirely. then have those who believed not accepted that had allah willed, he would have guided the people, all of them? and those who disbelieve do not cease to be struck, for what they have done, by calamity - or it will descend near their home - until there comes the promise of allah. indeed, allah does not fail in [his] promise

arabic: وَلَقَدِ ٱسۡتُهۡزِئَ بِرُسُلٖ مِّن قَبۡلِكَ فَأَمۡلَيۡتُ لِلَّذِينَ كَفَرُواْ ثُمَّ أَخَذۡتُهُمۡۖ فَكَيۡفَ كَانَ عِقَابِ
translation: And already were [other] messengers ridiculed before you, and I extended the time of those who disbelieved; then I seized them, and how [terrible] was My penalty
normalizedArabic: ولقد استهزي برسل من قبلك فامليت للذين كفروا ثم اخذتهم فكيف كان عقاب
normalizedTranslation: and already were [other] messengers ridiculed before you, and i extended the time of those who disbelieved; then i seized them, and how [terrible] was my penalty

arabic: أَفَمَنۡ هُوَ قَآئِمٌ عَلَىٰ كُلِّ نَفۡسِۭ بِمَا كَسَبَتۡۗ وَجَعَلُواْ لِلَّهِ شُرَكَآءَ قُلۡ سَمُّوهُمۡۚ أَمۡ تُنَبِّـُٔونَهُۥ بِمَا لَا يَعۡلَمُ فِي ٱلۡأَرۡضِ أَم بِظَٰهِرٖ مِّنَ ٱلۡقَوۡلِۗ بَلۡ زُيِّنَ لِلَّذِينَ كَفَرُواْ مَكۡرُهُمۡ وَصُدُّواْ عَنِ ٱلسَّبِيلِۗ وَمَن يُضۡلِلِ ٱللَّهُ فَمَا لَهُۥ مِنۡ هَادٖ
translation: Then is He who is a maintainer of every soul, [knowing] what it has earned, [like any other]? But to Allah they have attributed partners. Say, "Name them. Or do you inform Him of that which He knows not upon the earth or of what is apparent of speech?" Rather, their [own] plan has been made attractive to those who disbelieve, and they have been averted from the way. And whomever Allah leaves astray - there will be for him no guide

normalizedTranslation: then is he who is a maintainer of every soul, [knowing] what it has earned, [like any other]? but to allah they have attributed partners. say, "name them. or do you inform him of that which he knows not upon the earth or of what is apparent of speech?" rather, their [own] plan has been made attractive to those who disbelieve, and they have been averted from the way. and whomever allah leaves astray - there will be for him no guide

arabic: لَّهُمۡ عَذَابٞ فِي ٱلۡحَيَوٰةِ ٱلدُّنۡيَاۖ وَلَعَذَابُ ٱلۡأٓخِرَةِ أَشَقُّۖ وَمَا لَهُم مِّنَ ٱللَّهِ مِن وَاقٖ
translation: For them will be punishment in the life of [this] world, and the punishment of the Hereafter is more severe. And they will not have from Allah any protector

normalizedTranslation: for them will be punishment in the life of [this] world, and the punishment of the hereafter is more severe. and they will not have from allah any protector

arabic: ۞مَّثَلُ ٱلۡجَنَّةِ ٱلَّتِي وُعِدَ ٱلۡمُتَّقُونَۖ تَجۡرِي مِن تَحۡتِهَا ٱلۡأَنۡهَٰرُۖ أُكُلُهَا دَآئِمٞ وَظِلُّهَاۚ تِلۡكَ عُقۡبَى ٱلَّذِينَ ٱتَّقَواْۚ وَّعُقۡبَى ٱلۡكَٰفِرِينَ ٱلنَّارُ
translation: The example of Paradise, which the righteous have been promised, is [that] beneath it rivers flow. Its fruit is lasting, and its shade. That is the consequence for the righteous, and the consequence for the disbelievers is the Fire
normalizedArabic: مثل الجنه التي وعد المتقون تجري من تحتها الانهر اكلها دايم وظلها تلك عقبي الذين اتقوا وعقبي الكفرين النار
normalizedTranslation: the example of paradise, which the righteous have been promised, is [that] beneath it rivers flow. its fruit is lasting, and its shade. that is the consequence for the righteous, and the consequence for the disbelievers is the fire

arabic: وَٱلَّذِينَ ءَاتَيۡنَٰهُمُ ٱلۡكِتَٰبَ يَفۡرَحُونَ بِمَآ أُنزِلَ إِلَيۡكَۖ وَمِنَ ٱلۡأَحۡزَابِ مَن يُنكِرُ بَعۡضَهُۥۚ قُلۡ إِنَّمَآ أُمِرۡتُ أَنۡ أَعۡبُدَ ٱللَّهَ وَلَآ أُشۡرِكَ بِهِۦٓۚ إِلَيۡهِ أَدۡعُواْ وَإِلَيۡهِ مَـَٔابِ
translation: And [the believers among] those to whom We have given the [previous] Scripture rejoice at what has been revealed to you, [O Muhammad], but among the [opposing] factions are those who deny part of it. Say, "I have only been commanded to worship Allah and not associate [anything] with Him. To Him I invite, and to Him is my return
normalizedArabic: والذين ءاتينهم الكتب يفرحون بما انزل اليك ومن الاحزاب من ينكر بعضه قل انما امرت ان اعبد الله ولا اشرك به اليه ادعوا واليه ماب
normalizedTranslation: and [the believers among] those to whom we have given the [previous] scripture rejoice at what has been revealed to you, [o muhammad], but among the [opposing] factions are those who deny part of it. say, "i have only been commanded to worship allah and not associate [anything] with him. to him i invite, and to him is my return

arabic: وَكَذَٰلِكَ أَنزَلۡنَٰهُ حُكۡمًا عَرَبِيّٗاۚ وَلَئِنِ ٱتَّبَعۡتَ أَهۡوَآءَهُم بَعۡدَ مَا جَآءَكَ مِنَ ٱلۡعِلۡمِ مَا لَكَ مِنَ ٱللَّهِ مِن وَلِيّٖ وَلَا وَاقٖ
translation: And thus We have revealed it as an Arabic legislation. And if you should follow their inclinations after what has come to you of knowledge, you would not have against Allah any ally or any protector
normalizedArabic: وكذلك انزلنه حكما عربيا ولين اتبعت اهواءهم بعد ما جاءك من العلم ما لك من الله من ولي ولا واق
normalizedTranslation: and thus we have revealed it as an arabic legislation. and if you should follow their inclinations after what has come to you of knowledge, you would not have against allah any ally or any protector

arabic: وَلَقَدۡ أَرۡسَلۡنَا رُسُلٗا مِّن قَبۡلِكَ وَجَعَلۡنَا لَهُمۡ أَزۡوَٰجٗا وَذُرِّيَّةٗۚ وَمَا كَانَ لِرَسُولٍ أَن يَأۡتِيَ بِـَٔايَةٍ إِلَّا بِإِذۡنِ ٱللَّهِۗ لِكُلِّ أَجَلٖ كِتَابٞ
translation: And We have already sent messengers before you and assigned to them wives and descendants. And it was not for a messenger to come with a sign except by permission of Allah. For every term is a decree
normalizedArabic: ولقد ارسلنا رسلا من قبلك وجعلنا لهم ازوجا وذريه وما كان لرسول ان ياتي بايه الا باذن الله لكل اجل كتاب
normalizedTranslation: and we have already sent messengers before you and assigned to them wives and descendants. and it was not for a messenger to come with a sign except by permission of allah. for every term is a decree

arabic: يَمۡحُواْ ٱللَّهُ مَا يَشَآءُ وَيُثۡبِتُۖ وَعِندَهُۥٓ أُمُّ ٱلۡكِتَٰبِ
translation: Allah eliminates what He wills or confirms, and with Him is the Mother of the Book
normalizedArabic: يمحوا الله ما يشاء ويثبت وعنده ام الكتب
normalizedTranslation: allah eliminates what he wills or confirms, and with him is the mother of the book

arabic: وَإِن مَّا نُرِيَنَّكَ بَعۡضَ ٱلَّذِي نَعِدُهُمۡ أَوۡ نَتَوَفَّيَنَّكَ فَإِنَّمَا عَلَيۡكَ ٱلۡبَلَٰغُ وَعَلَيۡنَا ٱلۡحِسَابُ
translation: And whether We show you part of what We promise them or take you in death, upon you is only the [duty of] notification, and upon Us is the account
normalizedArabic: وان ما نرينك بعض الذي نعدهم او نتوفينك فانما عليك البلغ وعلينا الحساب
normalizedTranslation: and whether we show you part of what we promise them or take you in death, upon you is only the [duty of] notification, and upon us is the account

arabic: أَوَلَمۡ يَرَوۡاْ أَنَّا نَأۡتِي ٱلۡأَرۡضَ نَنقُصُهَا مِنۡ أَطۡرَافِهَاۚ وَٱللَّهُ يَحۡكُمُ لَا مُعَقِّبَ لِحُكۡمِهِۦۚ وَهُوَ سَرِيعُ ٱلۡحِسَابِ
translation: Have they not seen that We set upon the land, reducing it from its borders? And Allah decides; there is no adjuster of His decision. And He is swift in account
normalizedArabic: اولم يروا انا ناتي الارض ننقصها من اطرافها والله يحكم لا معقب لحكمه وهو سريع الحساب
normalizedTranslation: have they not seen that we set upon the land, reducing it from its borders? and allah decides; there is no adjuster of his decision. and he is swift in account

arabic: وَقَدۡ مَكَرَ ٱلَّذِينَ مِن قَبۡلِهِمۡ فَلِلَّهِ ٱلۡمَكۡرُ جَمِيعٗاۖ يَعۡلَمُ مَا تَكۡسِبُ كُلُّ نَفۡسٖۗ وَسَيَعۡلَمُ ٱلۡكُفَّـٰرُ لِمَنۡ عُقۡبَى ٱلدَّارِ
translation: And those before them had plotted, but to Allah belongs the plan entirely. He knows what every soul earns, and the disbelievers will know for whom is the final home
normalizedArabic: وقد مكر الذين من قبلهم فلله المكر جميعا يعلم ما تكسب كل نفس وسيعلم الكفر لمن عقبي الدار
normalizedTranslation: and those before them had plotted, but to allah belongs the plan entirely. he knows what every soul earns, and the disbelievers will know for whom is the final home

arabic: وَيَقُولُ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُواْ لَسۡتَ مُرۡسَلٗاۚ قُلۡ كَفَىٰ بِٱللَّهِ شَهِيدَۢا بَيۡنِي وَبَيۡنَكُمۡ وَمَنۡ عِندَهُۥ عِلۡمُ ٱلۡكِتَٰبِ
translation: And those who have disbelieved say, "You are not a messenger." Say, [O Muhammad], "Sufficient is Allah as Witness between me and you, and [the witness of] whoever has knowledge of the Scripture
normalizedArabic: ويقول الذين كفروا لست مرسلا قل كفي بالله شهيدا بيني وبينكم ومن عنده علم الكتب
normalizedTranslation: and those who have disbelieved say, "you are not a messenger." say, [o muhammad], "sufficient is allah as witness between me and you, and [the witness of] whoever has knowledge of the scripture

arabic: الٓرۚ كِتَٰبٌ أَنزَلۡنَٰهُ إِلَيۡكَ لِتُخۡرِجَ ٱلنَّاسَ مِنَ ٱلظُّلُمَٰتِ إِلَى ٱلنُّورِ بِإِذۡنِ رَبِّهِمۡ إِلَىٰ صِرَٰطِ ٱلۡعَزِيزِ ٱلۡحَمِيدِ
translation: Alif, Lam, Ra. [This is] a Book which We have revealed to you, [O Muhammad], that you might bring mankind out of darknesses into the light by permission of their Lord - to the path of the Exalted in Might, the Praiseworthy
normalizedArabic: الر كتب انزلنه اليك لتخرج الناس من الظلمت الي النور باذن ربهم الي صرط العزيز الحميد
normalizedTranslation: alif, lam, ra. [this is] a book which we have revealed to you, [o muhammad], that you might bring mankind out of darknesses into the light by permission of their lord - to the path of the exalted in might, the praiseworthy

arabic: ٱللَّهِ ٱلَّذِي لَهُۥ مَا فِي ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَمَا فِي ٱلۡأَرۡضِۗ وَوَيۡلٞ لِّلۡكَٰفِرِينَ مِنۡ عَذَابٖ شَدِيدٍ
translation: Allah, to whom belongs whatever is in the heavens and whatever is on the earth. And woe to the disbelievers from a severe punishment
normalizedArabic: الله الذي له ما في السموت وما في الارض وويل للكفرين من عذاب شديد
normalizedTranslation: allah, to whom belongs whatever is in the heavens and whatever is on the earth. and woe to the disbelievers from a severe punishment

arabic: ٱلَّذِينَ يَسۡتَحِبُّونَ ٱلۡحَيَوٰةَ ٱلدُّنۡيَا عَلَى ٱلۡأٓخِرَةِ وَيَصُدُّونَ عَن سَبِيلِ ٱللَّهِ وَيَبۡغُونَهَا عِوَجًاۚ أُوْلَـٰٓئِكَ فِي ضَلَٰلِۭ بَعِيدٖ
translation: The ones who prefer the worldly life over the Hereafter and avert [people] from the way of Allah, seeking to make it (seem) deviant. Those are in extreme error

normalizedTranslation: the ones who prefer the worldly life over the hereafter and avert [people] from the way of allah, seeking to make it (seem) deviant. those are in extreme error

arabic: وَمَآ أَرۡسَلۡنَا مِن رَّسُولٍ إِلَّا بِلِسَانِ قَوۡمِهِۦ لِيُبَيِّنَ لَهُمۡۖ فَيُضِلُّ ٱللَّهُ مَن يَشَآءُ وَيَهۡدِي مَن يَشَآءُۚ وَهُوَ ٱلۡعَزِيزُ ٱلۡحَكِيمُ
translation: And We did not send any messenger except [speaking] in the language of his people to state clearly for them, and Allah sends astray [thereby] whom He wills and guides whom He wills. And He is the Exalted in Might, the Wise

normalizedTranslation: and we did not send any messenger except [speaking] in the language of his people to state clearly for them, and allah sends astray [thereby] whom he wills and guides whom he wills. and he is the exalted in might, the wise

arabic: وَلَقَدۡ أَرۡسَلۡنَا مُوسَىٰ بِـَٔايَٰتِنَآ أَنۡ أَخۡرِجۡ قَوۡمَكَ مِنَ ٱلظُّلُمَٰتِ إِلَى ٱلنُّورِ وَذَكِّرۡهُم بِأَيَّىٰمِ ٱللَّهِۚ إِنَّ فِي ذَٰلِكَ لَأٓيَٰتٖ لِّكُلِّ صَبَّارٖ شَكُورٖ
translation: And We certainly sent Moses with Our signs, [saying], "Bring out your people from darknesses into the light and remind them of the days of Allah." Indeed in that are signs for everyone patient and grateful

normalizedTranslation: and we certainly sent moses with our signs, [saying], "bring out your people from darknesses into the light and remind them of the days of allah." indeed in that are signs for everyone patient and grateful

translation: And [recall, O Children of Israel], when Moses said to His people, "Remember the favor of Allah upon you when He saved you from the people of Pharaoh, who were afflicting you with the worst torment and were slaughtering your [newborn] sons and keeping your females alive. And in that was a great trial from your Lord

normalizedTranslation: and [recall, o children of israel], when moses said to his people, "remember the favor of allah upon you when he saved you from the people of pharaoh, who were afflicting you with the worst torment and were slaughtering your [newborn] sons and keeping your females alive. and in that was a great trial from your lord

translation: And Moses said, "If you should disbelieve, you and whoever is on the earth entirely - indeed, Allah is Free of need and Praiseworthy

normalizedTranslation: and moses said, "if you should disbelieve, you and whoever is on the earth entirely - indeed, allah is free of need and praiseworthy

arabic: ۞قَالَتۡ رُسُلُهُمۡ أَفِي ٱللَّهِ شَكّٞ فَاطِرِ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلۡأَرۡضِۖ يَدۡعُوكُمۡ لِيَغۡفِرَ لَكُم مِّن ذُنُوبِكُمۡ وَيُؤَخِّرَكُمۡ إِلَىٰٓ أَجَلٖ مُّسَمّٗىۚ قَالُوٓاْ إِنۡ أَنتُمۡ إِلَّا بَشَرٞ مِّثۡلُنَا تُرِيدُونَ أَن تَصُدُّونَا عَمَّا كَانَ يَعۡبُدُ ءَابَآؤُنَا فَأۡتُونَا بِسُلۡطَٰنٖ مُّبِينٖ
