normalizedArabic: وما لنا الا نتوكل علي الله وقد هدينا سبلنا ولنصبرن علي ما ءاذيتمونا وعلي الله فليتوكل المتوكلون
normalizedTranslation: and why should we not rely upon allah while he has guided us to our [good] ways. and we will surely be patient against whatever harm you should cause us. and upon allah let those who would rely [indeed] rely

arabic: وَقَالَ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُواْ لِرُسُلِهِمۡ لَنُخۡرِجَنَّكُم مِّنۡ أَرۡضِنَآ أَوۡ لَتَعُودُنَّ فِي مِلَّتِنَاۖ فَأَوۡحَىٰٓ إِلَيۡهِمۡ رَبُّهُمۡ لَنُهۡلِكَنَّ ٱلظَّـٰلِمِينَ
translation: And those who disbelieved said to their messengers, "We will surely drive you out of our land, or you must return to our religion." So their Lord inspired to them, "We will surely destroy the wrongdoers
normalizedArabic: وقال الذين كفروا لرسلهم لنخرجنكم من ارضنا او لتعودن في ملتنا فاوحي اليهم ربهم لنهلكن الظلمين
normalizedTranslation: and those who disbelieved said to their messengers, "we will surely drive you out of our land, or you must return to our religion." so their lord inspired to them, "we will surely destroy the wrongdoers

arabic: وَلَنُسۡكِنَنَّكُمُ ٱلۡأَرۡضَ مِنۢ بَعۡدِهِمۡۚ ذَٰلِكَ لِمَنۡ خَافَ مَقَامِي وَخَافَ وَعِيدِ
translation: And We will surely cause you to dwell in the land after them. That is for he who fears My position and fears My threat
normalizedArabic: ولنسكننكم الارض من بعدهم ذلك لمن خاف مقامي وخاف وعيد
normalizedTranslation: and we will surely cause you to dwell in the land after them. that is for he who fears my position and fears my threat

arabic: وَٱسۡتَفۡتَحُواْ وَخَابَ كُلُّ جَبَّارٍ عَنِيدٖ
translation: And they requested victory from Allah, and disappointed, [therefore], was every obstinate tyrant
normalizedArabic: واستفتحوا وخاب كل جبار عنيد
normalizedTranslation: and they requested victory from allah, and disappointed, [therefore], was every obstinate tyrant

arabic: مِّن وَرَآئِهِۦ جَهَنَّمُ وَيُسۡقَىٰ مِن مَّآءٖ صَدِيدٖ
translation: Before him is Hell, and he will be given a drink of purulent water
normalizedArabic: من ورايه جهنم ويسقي من ماء صديد
normalizedTranslation: before him is hell, and he will be given a drink of purulent water

arabic: يَتَجَرَّعُهُۥ وَلَا يَكَادُ يُسِيغُهُۥ وَيَأۡتِيهِ ٱلۡمَوۡتُ مِن كُلِّ مَكَانٖ وَمَا هُوَ بِمَيِّتٖۖ وَمِن وَرَآئِهِۦ عَذَابٌ غَلِيظٞ
translation: He will gulp it but will hardly [be able to] swallow it. And death will come to him from everywhere, but he is not to die. And before him is a massive punishment
normalizedArabic: يتجرعه ولا يكاد يسيغه وياتيه الموت من كل مكان وما هو بميت ومن ورايه عذاب غليظ
normalizedTranslation: he will gulp it but will hardly [be able to] swallow it. and death will come to him from everywhere, but he is not to die. and before him is a massive punishment

arabic: مَّثَلُ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُواْ بِرَبِّهِمۡۖ أَعۡمَٰلُهُمۡ كَرَمَادٍ ٱشۡتَدَّتۡ بِهِ ٱلرِّيحُ فِي يَوۡمٍ عَاصِفٖۖ لَّا يَقۡدِرُونَ مِمَّا كَسَبُواْ عَلَىٰ شَيۡءٖۚ ذَٰلِكَ هُوَ ٱلضَّلَٰلُ ٱلۡبَعِيدُ
translation: The example of those who disbelieve in their Lord is [that] their deeds are like ashes which the wind blows forcefully on a stormy day; they are unable [to keep] from what they earned a [single] thing. That is what is extreme error
normalizedArabic: مثل الذين كفروا بربهم اعملهم كرماد اشتدت به الريح في يوم عاصف لا يقدرون مما كسبوا علي شيء ذلك هو الضلل البعيد
normalizedTranslation: the example of those who disbelieve in their lord is [that] their deeds are like ashes which the wind blows forcefully on a stormy day; they are unable [to keep] from what they earned a [single] thing. that is what is extreme error

arabic: أَلَمۡ تَرَ أَنَّ ٱللَّهَ خَلَقَ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلۡأَرۡضَ بِٱلۡحَقِّۚ إِن يَشَأۡ يُذۡهِبۡكُمۡ وَيَأۡتِ بِخَلۡقٖ جَدِيدٖ
translation: Have you not seen that Allah created the heavens and the earth in truth? If He wills, He can do away with you and produce a new creation
normalizedArabic: الم تر ان الله خلق السموت والارض بالحق ان يشا يذهبكم ويات بخلق جديد
normalizedTranslation: have you not seen that allah created the heavens and the earth in truth? if he wills, he can do away with you and produce a new creation

arabic: وَمَا ذَٰلِكَ عَلَى ٱللَّهِ بِعَزِيزٖ
translation: And that is not difficult for Allah
normalizedArabic: وما ذلك علي الله بعزيز
normalizedTranslation: and that is not difficult for allah

arabic: وَبَرَزُواْ لِلَّهِ جَمِيعٗا فَقَالَ ٱلضُّعَفَـٰٓؤُاْ لِلَّذِينَ ٱسۡتَكۡبَرُوٓاْ إِنَّا كُنَّا لَكُمۡ تَبَعٗا فَهَلۡ أَنتُم مُّغۡنُونَ عَنَّا مِنۡ عَذَابِ ٱللَّهِ مِن شَيۡءٖۚ قَالُواْ لَوۡ هَدَىٰنَا ٱللَّهُ لَهَدَيۡنَٰكُمۡۖ سَوَآءٌ عَلَيۡنَآ أَجَزِعۡنَآ أَمۡ صَبَرۡنَا مَا لَنَا مِن مَّحِيصٖ
translation: And they will come out [for judgement] before Allah all together, and the weak will say to those who were arrogant, "Indeed, we were your followers, so can you avail us anything against the punishment of Allah?" They will say, "If Allah had guided us, we would have guided you. It is all the same for us whether we show intolerance or are patient: there is for us no place of escape
normalizedArabic: وبرزوا لله جميعا فقال الضعفوا للذين استكبروا انا كنا لكم تبعا فهل انتم مغنون عنا من عذاب الله من شيء قالوا لو هدينا الله لهدينكم سواء علينا اجزعنا ام صبرنا ما لنا من محيص
normalizedTranslation: and they will come out [for judgement] before allah all together, and the weak will say to those who were arrogant, "indeed, we were your followers, so can you avail us anything against the punishment of allah?" they will say, "if allah had guided us, we would have guided you. it is all the same for us whether we show intolerance or are patient: there is for us no place of escape

arabic: وَقَالَ ٱلشَّيۡطَٰنُ لَمَّا قُضِيَ ٱلۡأَمۡرُ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ وَعَدَكُمۡ وَعۡدَ ٱلۡحَقِّ وَوَعَدتُّكُمۡ فَأَخۡلَفۡتُكُمۡۖ وَمَا كَانَ لِيَ عَلَيۡكُم مِّن سُلۡطَٰنٍ إِلَّآ أَن دَعَوۡتُكُمۡ فَٱسۡتَجَبۡتُمۡ لِيۖ فَلَا تَلُومُونِي وَلُومُوٓاْ أَنفُسَكُمۖ مَّآ أَنَا۠ بِمُصۡرِخِكُمۡ وَمَآ أَنتُم بِمُصۡرِخِيَّ إِنِّي كَفَرۡتُ بِمَآ أَشۡرَكۡتُمُونِ مِن قَبۡلُۗ إِنَّ ٱلظَّـٰلِمِينَ لَهُمۡ عَذَابٌ أَلِيمٞ
translation: And Satan will say when the matter has been concluded, "Indeed, Allah had promised you the promise of truth. And I promised you, but I betrayed you. But I had no authority over you except that I invited you, and you responded to me. So do not blame me; but blame yourselves. I cannot be called to your aid, nor can you be called to my aid. Indeed, I deny your association of me [with Allah] before. Indeed, for the wrongdoers is a painful punishment
normalizedArabic: وقال الشيطن لما قضي الامر ان الله وعدكم وعد الحق ووعدتكم فاخلفتكم وما كان لي عليكم من سلطن الا ان دعوتكم فاستجبتم لي فلا تلوموني ولوموا انفسكم ما انا بمصرخكم وما انتم بمصرخي اني كفرت بما اشركتمون من قبل ان الظلمين لهم عذاب اليم
normalizedTranslation: and satan will say when the matter has been concluded, "indeed, allah had promised you the promise of truth. and i promised you, but i betrayed you. but i had no authority over you except that i invited you, and you responded to me. so do not blame me; but blame yourselves. i cannot be called to your aid, nor can you be called to my aid. indeed, i deny your association of me [with allah] before. indeed, for the wrongdoers is a painful punishment

arabic: وَأُدۡخِلَ ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُواْ وَعَمِلُواْ ٱلصَّـٰلِحَٰتِ جَنَّـٰتٖ تَجۡرِي مِن تَحۡتِهَا ٱلۡأَنۡهَٰرُ خَٰلِدِينَ فِيهَا بِإِذۡنِ رَبِّهِمۡۖ تَحِيَّتُهُمۡ فِيهَا سَلَٰمٌ
translation: And those who believed and did righteous deeds will be admitted to gardens beneath which rivers flow, abiding eternally therein by permission of their Lord; and their greeting therein will be, "Peace
normalizedArabic: وادخل الذين ءامنوا وعملوا الصلحت جنت تجري من تحتها الانهر خلدين فيها باذن ربهم تحيتهم فيها سلم
normalizedTranslation: and those who believed and did righteous deeds will be admitted to gardens beneath which rivers flow, abiding eternally therein by permission of their lord; and their greeting therein will be, "peace

arabic: أَلَمۡ تَرَ كَيۡفَ ضَرَبَ ٱللَّهُ مَثَلٗا كَلِمَةٗ طَيِّبَةٗ كَشَجَرَةٖ طَيِّبَةٍ أَصۡلُهَا ثَابِتٞ وَفَرۡعُهَا فِي ٱلسَّمَآءِ
translation: Have you not considered how Allah presents an example, [making] a good word like a good tree, whose root is firmly fixed and its branches [high] in the sky
normalizedArabic: الم تر كيف ضرب الله مثلا كلمه طيبه كشجره طيبه اصلها ثابت وفرعها في السماء
normalizedTranslation: have you not considered how allah presents an example, [making] a good word like a good tree, whose root is firmly fixed and its branches [high] in the sky

arabic: تُؤۡتِيٓ أُكُلَهَا كُلَّ حِينِۭ بِإِذۡنِ رَبِّهَاۗ وَيَضۡرِبُ ٱللَّهُ ٱلۡأَمۡثَالَ لِلنَّاسِ لَعَلَّهُمۡ يَتَذَكَّرُونَ
translation: It produces its fruit all the time, by permission of its Lord. And Allah presents examples for the people that perhaps they will be reminded
normalizedArabic: توتي اكلها كل حين باذن ربها ويضرب الله الامثال للناس لعلهم يتذكرون
normalizedTranslation: it produces its fruit all the time, by permission of its lord. and allah presents examples for the people that perhaps they will be reminded

arabic: وَمَثَلُ كَلِمَةٍ خَبِيثَةٖ كَشَجَرَةٍ خَبِيثَةٍ ٱجۡتُثَّتۡ مِن فَوۡقِ ٱلۡأَرۡضِ مَا لَهَا مِن قَرَارٖ
translation: And the example of a bad word is like a bad tree, uprooted from the surface of the earth, not having any stability
normalizedArabic: ومثل كلمه خبيثه كشجره خبيثه اجتثت من فوق الارض ما لها من قرار
normalizedTranslation: and the example of a bad word is like a bad tree, uprooted from the surface of the earth, not having any stability

arabic: يُثَبِّتُ ٱللَّهُ ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُواْ بِٱلۡقَوۡلِ ٱلثَّابِتِ فِي ٱلۡحَيَوٰةِ ٱلدُّنۡيَا وَفِي ٱلۡأٓخِرَةِۖ وَيُضِلُّ ٱللَّهُ ٱلظَّـٰلِمِينَۚ وَيَفۡعَلُ ٱللَّهُ مَا يَشَآءُ
translation: Allah keeps firm those who believe, with the firm word, in worldly life and in the Hereafter. And Allah sends astray the wrongdoers. And Allah does what He wills
normalizedArabic: يثبت الله الذين ءامنوا بالقول الثابت في الحيوه الدنيا وفي الاخره ويضل الله الظلمين ويفعل الله ما يشاء
normalizedTranslation: allah keeps firm those who believe, with the firm word, in worldly life and in the hereafter. and allah sends astray the wrongdoers. and allah does what he wills

arabic: ۞أَلَمۡ تَرَ إِلَى ٱلَّذِينَ بَدَّلُواْ نِعۡمَتَ ٱللَّهِ كُفۡرٗا وَأَحَلُّواْ قَوۡمَهُمۡ دَارَ ٱلۡبَوَارِ
translation: Have you not considered those who exchanged the favor of Allah for disbelief and settled their people [in] the home of ruin
normalizedArabic: الم تر الي الذين بدلوا نعمت الله كفرا واحلوا قومهم دار البوار
normalizedTranslation: have you not considered those who exchanged the favor of allah for disbelief and settled their people [in] the home of ruin

arabic: جَهَنَّمَ يَصۡلَوۡنَهَاۖ وَبِئۡسَ ٱلۡقَرَارُ
translation: [It is] Hell, which they will [enter to] burn, and wretched is the settlement
normalizedArabic: جهنم يصلونها وبيس القرار
normalizedTranslation: [it is] hell, which they will [enter to] burn, and wretched is the settlement

arabic: وَجَعَلُواْ لِلَّهِ أَندَادٗا لِّيُضِلُّواْ عَن سَبِيلِهِۦۗ قُلۡ تَمَتَّعُواْ فَإِنَّ مَصِيرَكُمۡ إِلَى ٱلنَّارِ
translation: And they have attributed to Allah equals to mislead [people] from His way. Say, "Enjoy yourselves, for indeed, your destination is the Fire
normalizedArabic: وجعلوا لله اندادا ليضلوا عن سبيله قل تمتعوا فان مصيركم الي النار
normalizedTranslation: and they have attributed to allah equals to mislead [people] from his way. say, "enjoy yourselves, for indeed, your destination is the fire

arabic: قُل لِّعِبَادِيَ ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُواْ يُقِيمُواْ ٱلصَّلَوٰةَ وَيُنفِقُواْ مِمَّا رَزَقۡنَٰهُمۡ سِرّٗا وَعَلَانِيَةٗ مِّن قَبۡلِ أَن يَأۡتِيَ يَوۡمٞ لَّا بَيۡعٞ فِيهِ وَلَا خِلَٰلٌ
translation: [O Muhammad], tell My servants who have believed to establish prayer and spend from what We have provided them, secretly and publicly, before a Day comes in which there will be no exchange, nor any friendships
normalizedArabic: قل لعبادي الذين ءامنوا يقيموا الصلوه وينفقوا مما رزقنهم سرا وعلانيه من قبل ان ياتي يوم لا بيع فيه ولا خلل
normalizedTranslation: [o muhammad], tell my servants who have believed to establish prayer and spend from what we have provided them, secretly and publicly, before a day comes in which there will be no exchange, nor any friendships

arabic: ٱللَّهُ ٱلَّذِي خَلَقَ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلۡأَرۡضَ وَأَنزَلَ مِنَ ٱلسَّمَآءِ مَآءٗ فَأَخۡرَجَ بِهِۦ مِنَ ٱلثَّمَرَٰتِ رِزۡقٗا لَّكُمۡۖ وَسَخَّرَ لَكُمُ ٱلۡفُلۡكَ لِتَجۡرِيَ فِي ٱلۡبَحۡرِ بِأَمۡرِهِۦۖ وَسَخَّرَ لَكُمُ ٱلۡأَنۡهَٰرَ
translation: It is Allah who created the heavens and the earth and sent down rain from the sky and produced thereby some fruits as provision for you and subjected for you the ships to sail through the sea by His command and subjected for you the rivers
normalizedArabic: الله الذي خلق السموت والارض وانزل من السماء ماء فاخرج به من الثمرت رزقا لكم وسخر لكم الفلك لتجري في البحر بامره وسخر لكم الانهر
normalizedTranslation: it is allah who created the heavens and the earth and sent down rain from the sky and produced thereby some fruits as provision for you and subjected for you the ships to sail through the sea by his command and subjected for you the rivers

arabic: وَسَخَّرَ لَكُمُ ٱلشَّمۡسَ وَٱلۡقَمَرَ دَآئِبَيۡنِۖ وَسَخَّرَ لَكُمُ ٱلَّيۡلَ وَٱلنَّهَارَ
translation: And He subjected for you the sun and the moon, continuous [in orbit], and subjected for you the night and the day
normalizedArabic: وسخر لكم الشمس والقمر دايبين وسخر لكم اليل والنهار
normalizedTranslation: and he subjected for you the sun and the moon, continuous [in orbit], and subjected for you the night and the day

arabic: وَءَاتَىٰكُم مِّن كُلِّ مَا سَأَلۡتُمُوهُۚ وَإِن تَعُدُّواْ نِعۡمَتَ ٱللَّهِ لَا تُحۡصُوهَآۗ إِنَّ ٱلۡإِنسَٰنَ لَظَلُومٞ كَفَّارٞ
translation: And He gave you from all you asked of Him. And if you should count the favor of Allah, you could not enumerate them. Indeed, mankind is [generally] most unjust and ungrateful
normalizedArabic: وءاتيكم من كل ما سالتموه وان تعدوا نعمت الله لا تحصوها ان الانسن لظلوم كفار
normalizedTranslation: and he gave you from all you asked of him. and if you should count the favor of allah, you could not enumerate them. indeed, mankind is [generally] most unjust and ungrateful

arabic: وَإِذۡ قَالَ إِبۡرَٰهِيمُ رَبِّ ٱجۡعَلۡ هَٰذَا ٱلۡبَلَدَ ءَامِنٗا وَٱجۡنُبۡنِي وَبَنِيَّ أَن نَّعۡبُدَ ٱلۡأَصۡنَامَ
translation: And [mention, O Muhammad], when Abraham said, "My Lord, make this city [Makkah] secure and keep me and my sons away from worshipping idols
normalizedArabic: واذ قال ابرهيم رب اجعل هذا البلد ءامنا واجنبني وبني ان نعبد الاصنام
normalizedTranslation: and [mention, o muhammad], when abraham said, "my lord, make this city [makkah] secure and keep me and my sons away from worshipping idols

arabic: رَبِّ إِنَّهُنَّ أَضۡلَلۡنَ كَثِيرٗا مِّنَ ٱلنَّاسِۖ فَمَن تَبِعَنِي فَإِنَّهُۥ مِنِّيۖ وَمَنۡ عَصَانِي فَإِنَّكَ غَفُورٞ رَّحِيمٞ
translation: My Lord, indeed they have led astray many among the people. So whoever follows me - then he is of me; and whoever disobeys me - indeed, You are [yet] Forgiving and Merciful
normalizedArabic: رب انهن اضللن كثيرا من الناس فمن تبعني فانه مني ومن عصاني فانك غفور رحيم
normalizedTranslation: my lord, indeed they have led astray many among the people. so whoever follows me - then he is of me; and whoever disobeys me - indeed, you are [yet] forgiving and merciful

arabic: رَّبَّنَآ إِنِّيٓ أَسۡكَنتُ مِن ذُرِّيَّتِي بِوَادٍ غَيۡرِ ذِي زَرۡعٍ عِندَ بَيۡتِكَ ٱلۡمُحَرَّمِ رَبَّنَا لِيُقِيمُواْ ٱلصَّلَوٰةَ فَٱجۡعَلۡ أَفۡـِٔدَةٗ مِّنَ ٱلنَّاسِ تَهۡوِيٓ إِلَيۡهِمۡ وَٱرۡزُقۡهُم مِّنَ ٱلثَّمَرَٰتِ لَعَلَّهُمۡ يَشۡكُرُونَ
translation: Our Lord, I have settled some of my descendants in an uncultivated valley near Your sacred House, our Lord, that they may establish prayer. So make hearts among the people incline toward them and provide for them from the fruits that they might be grateful
normalizedArabic: ربنا اني اسكنت من ذريتي بواد غير ذي زرع عند بيتك المحرم ربنا ليقيموا الصلوه فاجعل افده من الناس تهوي اليهم وارزقهم من الثمرت لعلهم يشكرون
normalizedTranslation: our lord, i have settled some of my descendants in an uncultivated valley near your sacred house, our lord, that they may establish prayer. so make hearts among the people incline toward them and provide for them from the fruits that they might be grateful

arabic: رَبَّنَآ إِنَّكَ تَعۡلَمُ مَا نُخۡفِي وَمَا نُعۡلِنُۗ وَمَا يَخۡفَىٰ عَلَى ٱللَّهِ مِن شَيۡءٖ فِي ٱلۡأَرۡضِ وَلَا فِي ٱلسَّمَآءِ
translation: Our Lord, indeed You know what we conceal and what we declare, and nothing is hidden from Allah on the earth or in the heaven
normalizedArabic: ربنا انك تعلم ما نخفي وما نعلن وما يخفي علي الله من شيء في الارض ولا في السماء
normalizedTranslation: our lord, indeed you know what we conceal and what we declare, and nothing is hidden from allah on the earth or in the heaven

arabic: ٱلۡحَمۡدُ لِلَّهِ ٱلَّذِي وَهَبَ لِي عَلَى ٱلۡكِبَرِ إِسۡمَٰعِيلَ وَإِسۡحَٰقَۚ إِنَّ رَبِّي لَسَمِيعُ ٱلدُّعَآءِ
translation: Praise to Allah, who has granted to me in old age Ishmael and Isaac. Indeed, my Lord is the Hearer of supplication
normalizedArabic: الحمد لله الذي وهب لي علي الكبر اسمعيل واسحق ان ربي لسميع الدعاء
normalizedTranslation: praise to allah, who has granted to me in old age ishmael and isaac. indeed, my lord is the hearer of supplication

arabic: رَبِّ ٱجۡعَلۡنِي مُقِيمَ ٱلصَّلَوٰةِ وَمِن ذُرِّيَّتِيۚ رَبَّنَا وَتَقَبَّلۡ دُعَآءِ
translation: My Lord, make me an establisher of prayer, and [many] from my descendants. Our Lord, and accept my supplication
normalizedArabic: رب اجعلني مقيم الصلوه ومن ذريتي ربنا وتقبل دعاء
normalizedTranslation: my lord, make me an establisher of prayer, and [many] from my descendants. our lord, and accept my supplication

arabic: رَبَّنَا ٱغۡفِرۡ لِي وَلِوَٰلِدَيَّ وَلِلۡمُؤۡمِنِينَ يَوۡمَ يَقُومُ ٱلۡحِسَابُ
translation: Our Lord, forgive me and my parents and the believers the Day the account is established
normalizedArabic: ربنا اغفر لي ولولدي وللمومنين يوم يقوم الحساب
normalizedTranslation: our lord, forgive me and my parents and the believers the day the account is established

arabic: وَلَا تَحۡسَبَنَّ ٱللَّهَ غَٰفِلًا عَمَّا يَعۡمَلُ ٱلظَّـٰلِمُونَۚ إِنَّمَا يُؤَخِّرُهُمۡ لِيَوۡمٖ تَشۡخَصُ فِيهِ ٱلۡأَبۡصَٰرُ
translation: And never think that Allah is unaware of what the wrongdoers do. He only delays them for a Day when eyes will stare [in horror]
normalizedArabic: ولا تحسبن الله غفلا عما يعمل الظلمون انما يوخرهم ليوم تشخص فيه الابصر
normalizedTranslation: and never think that allah is unaware of what the wrongdoers do. he only delays them for a day when eyes will stare [in horror]

arabic: مُهۡطِعِينَ مُقۡنِعِي رُءُوسِهِمۡ لَا يَرۡتَدُّ إِلَيۡهِمۡ طَرۡفُهُمۡۖ وَأَفۡـِٔدَتُهُمۡ هَوَآءٞ
translation: Racing ahead, their heads raised up, their glance does not come back to them, and their hearts are void
normalizedArabic: مهطعين مقنعي رءوسهم لا يرتد اليهم طرفهم وافدتهم هواء
normalizedTranslation: racing ahead, their heads raised up, their glance does not come back to them, and their hearts are void

arabic: وَأَنذِرِ ٱلنَّاسَ يَوۡمَ يَأۡتِيهِمُ ٱلۡعَذَابُ فَيَقُولُ ٱلَّذِينَ ظَلَمُواْ رَبَّنَآ أَخِّرۡنَآ إِلَىٰٓ أَجَلٖ قَرِيبٖ نُّجِبۡ دَعۡوَتَكَ وَنَتَّبِعِ ٱلرُّسُلَۗ أَوَلَمۡ تَكُونُوٓاْ أَقۡسَمۡتُم مِّن قَبۡلُ مَا لَكُم مِّن زَوَالٖ
translation: And, [O Muhammad], warn the people of a Day when the punishment will come to them and those who did wrong will say, "Our Lord, delay us for a short term; we will answer Your call and follow the messengers." [But it will be said], "Had you not sworn, before, that for you there would be no cessation
normalizedArabic: وانذر الناس يوم ياتيهم العذاب فيقول الذين ظلموا ربنا اخرنا الي اجل قريب نجب دعوتك ونتبع الرسل اولم تكونوا اقسمتم من قبل ما لكم من زوال
normalizedTranslation: and, [o muhammad], warn the people of a day when the punishment will come to them and those who did wrong will say, "our lord, delay us for a short term; we will answer your call and follow the messengers." [but it will be said], "had you not sworn, before, that for you there would be no cessation

arabic: وَسَكَنتُمۡ فِي مَسَٰكِنِ ٱلَّذِينَ ظَلَمُوٓاْ أَنفُسَهُمۡ وَتَبَيَّنَ لَكُمۡ كَيۡفَ فَعَلۡنَا بِهِمۡ وَضَرَبۡنَا لَكُمُ ٱلۡأَمۡثَالَ
translation: And you lived among the dwellings of those who wronged themselves, and it had become clear to you how We dealt with them. And We presented for you [many] examples
normalizedArabic: وسكنتم في مسكن الذين ظلموا انفسهم وتبين لكم كيف فعلنا بهم وضربنا لكم الامثال
normalizedTranslation: and you lived among the dwellings of those who wronged themselves, and it had become clear to you how we dealt with them. and we presented for you [many] examples

arabic: وَقَدۡ مَكَرُواْ مَكۡرَهُمۡ وَعِندَ ٱللَّهِ مَكۡرُهُمۡ وَإِن كَانَ مَكۡرُهُمۡ لِتَزُولَ مِنۡهُ ٱلۡجِبَالُ
translation: And they had planned their plan, but with Allah is [recorded] their plan, even if their plan had been [sufficient] to do away with the mountains
normalizedArabic: وقد مكروا مكرهم وعند الله مكرهم وان كان مكرهم لتزول منه الجبال
normalizedTranslation: and they had planned their plan, but with allah is [recorded] their plan, even if their plan had been [sufficient] to do away with the mountains

arabic: فَلَا تَحۡسَبَنَّ ٱللَّهَ مُخۡلِفَ وَعۡدِهِۦ رُسُلَهُۥٓۚ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ عَزِيزٞ ذُو ٱنتِقَامٖ
translation: So never think that Allah will fail in His promise to His messengers. Indeed, Allah is Exalted in Might and Owner of Retribution
normalizedArabic: فلا تحسبن الله مخلف وعده رسله ان الله عزيز ذو انتقام
normalizedTranslation: so never think that allah will fail in his promise to his messengers. indeed, allah is exalted in might and owner of retribution

arabic: يَوۡمَ تُبَدَّلُ ٱلۡأَرۡضُ غَيۡرَ ٱلۡأَرۡضِ وَٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتُۖ وَبَرَزُواْ لِلَّهِ ٱلۡوَٰحِدِ ٱلۡقَهَّارِ
translation: [It will be] on the Day the earth will be replaced by another earth, and the heavens [as well], and all creatures will come out before Allah, the One, the Prevailing
normalizedArabic: يوم تبدل الارض غير الارض والسموت وبرزوا لله الوحد القهار
normalizedTranslation: [it will be] on the day the earth will be replaced by another earth, and the heavens [as well], and all creatures will come out before allah, the one, the prevailing

arabic: وَتَرَى ٱلۡمُجۡرِمِينَ يَوۡمَئِذٖ مُّقَرَّنِينَ فِي ٱلۡأَصۡفَادِ
translation: And you will see the criminals that Day bound together in shackles
normalizedArabic: وتري المجرمين يوميذ مقرنين في الاصفاد
normalizedTranslation: and you will see the criminals that day bound together in shackles

arabic: سَرَابِيلُهُم مِّن قَطِرَانٖ وَتَغۡشَىٰ وُجُوهَهُمُ ٱلنَّارُ
translation: Their garments of liquid pitch and their faces covered by the Fire
normalizedArabic: سرابيلهم من قطران وتغشي وجوههم النار
normalizedTranslation: their garments of liquid pitch and their faces covered by the fire

arabic: لِيَجۡزِيَ ٱللَّهُ كُلَّ نَفۡسٖ مَّا كَسَبَتۡۚ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ سَرِيعُ ٱلۡحِسَابِ
translation: So that Allah will recompense every soul for what it earned. Indeed, Allah is swift in account
normalizedArabic: ليجزي الله كل نفس ما كسبت ان الله سريع الحساب
normalizedTranslation: so that allah will recompense every soul for what it earned. indeed, allah is swift in account

arabic: هَٰذَا بَلَٰغٞ لِّلنَّاسِ وَلِيُنذَرُواْ بِهِۦ وَلِيَعۡلَمُوٓاْ أَنَّمَا هُوَ إِلَٰهٞ وَٰحِدٞ وَلِيَذَّكَّرَ أُوْلُواْ ٱلۡأَلۡبَٰبِ
translation: This [Qur'an] is notification for the people that they may be warned thereby and that they may know that He is but one God and that those of understanding will be reminded
normalizedArabic: هذا بلغ للناس ولينذروا به وليعلموا انما هو اله وحد وليذكر اولوا الالبب
normalizedTranslation: this [qur'an] is notification for the people that they may be warned thereby and that they may know that he is but one god and that those of understanding will be reminded

arabic: الٓرۚ تِلۡكَ ءَايَٰتُ ٱلۡكِتَٰبِ وَقُرۡءَانٖ مُّبِينٖ
translation: Alif, Lam, Ra. These are the verses of the Book and a clear Qur'an
normalizedArabic: الر تلك ءايت الكتب وقرءان مبين
normalizedTranslation: alif, lam, ra. these are the verses of the book and a clear qur'an

arabic: رُّبَمَا يَوَدُّ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُواْ لَوۡ كَانُواْ مُسۡلِمِينَ
translation: Perhaps those who disbelieve will wish that they had been Muslims
normalizedArabic: ربما يود الذين كفروا لو كانوا مسلمين
normalizedTranslation: perhaps those who disbelieve will wish that they had been muslims

arabic: ذَرۡهُمۡ يَأۡكُلُواْ وَيَتَمَتَّعُواْ وَيُلۡهِهِمُ ٱلۡأَمَلُۖ فَسَوۡفَ يَعۡلَمُونَ
translation: Let them eat and enjoy themselves and be diverted by [false] hope, for they are going to know
normalizedArabic: ذرهم ياكلوا ويتمتعوا ويلههم الامل فسوف يعلمون
normalizedTranslation: let them eat and enjoy themselves and be diverted by [false] hope, for they are going to know

arabic: وَمَآ أَهۡلَكۡنَا مِن قَرۡيَةٍ إِلَّا وَلَهَا كِتَابٞ مَّعۡلُومٞ
translation: And We did not destroy any city but that for it was a known decree
normalizedArabic: وما اهلكنا من قريه الا ولها كتاب معلوم
normalizedTranslation: and we did not destroy any city but that for it was a known decree

arabic: مَّا تَسۡبِقُ مِنۡ أُمَّةٍ أَجَلَهَا وَمَا يَسۡتَـٔۡخِرُونَ
translation: No nation will precede its term, nor will they remain thereafter
normalizedArabic: ما تسبق من امه اجلها وما يستخرون
normalizedTranslation: no nation will precede its term, nor will they remain thereafter

arabic: وَقَالُواْ يَـٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلَّذِي نُزِّلَ عَلَيۡهِ ٱلذِّكۡرُ إِنَّكَ لَمَجۡنُونٞ
translation: And they say, "O you upon whom the message has been sent down, indeed you are mad
normalizedArabic: وقالوا يايها الذي نزل عليه الذكر انك لمجنون
normalizedTranslation: and they say, "o you upon whom the message has been sent down, indeed you are mad

arabic: لَّوۡمَا تَأۡتِينَا بِٱلۡمَلَـٰٓئِكَةِ إِن كُنتَ مِنَ ٱلصَّـٰدِقِينَ
translation: Why do you not bring us the angels, if you should be among the truthful
normalizedArabic: لوما تاتينا بالمليكه ان كنت من الصدقين
normalizedTranslation: why do you not bring us the angels, if you should be among the truthful

arabic: مَا نُنَزِّلُ ٱلۡمَلَـٰٓئِكَةَ إِلَّا بِٱلۡحَقِّ وَمَا كَانُوٓاْ إِذٗا مُّنظَرِينَ
translation: We do not send down the angels except with truth; and the disbelievers would not then be reprieved
normalizedArabic: ما ننزل المليكه الا بالحق وما كانوا اذا منظرين
normalizedTranslation: we do not send down the angels except with truth; and the disbelievers would not then be reprieved

arabic: إِنَّا نَحۡنُ نَزَّلۡنَا ٱلذِّكۡرَ وَإِنَّا لَهُۥ لَحَٰفِظُونَ
translation: Indeed, it is We who sent down the Qur'an and indeed, We will be its guardian
normalizedArabic: انا نحن نزلنا الذكر وانا له لحفظون
normalizedTranslation: indeed, it is we who sent down the qur'an and indeed, we will be its guardian

arabic: وَلَقَدۡ أَرۡسَلۡنَا مِن قَبۡلِكَ فِي شِيَعِ ٱلۡأَوَّلِينَ
translation: And We had certainly sent [messengers] before you, [O Muhammad], among the sects of the former peoples
normalizedArabic: ولقد ارسلنا من قبلك في شيع الاولين
normalizedTranslation: and we had certainly sent [messengers] before you, [o muhammad], among the sects of the former peoples

arabic: وَمَا يَأۡتِيهِم مِّن رَّسُولٍ إِلَّا كَانُواْ بِهِۦ يَسۡتَهۡزِءُونَ
translation: And no messenger would come to them except that they ridiculed him
normalizedArabic: وما ياتيهم من رسول الا كانوا به يستهزءون
normalizedTranslation: and no messenger would come to them except that they ridiculed him

arabic: كَذَٰلِكَ نَسۡلُكُهُۥ فِي قُلُوبِ ٱلۡمُجۡرِمِينَ
translation: Thus do We insert denial into the hearts of the criminals
normalizedArabic: كذلك نسلكه في قلوب المجرمين
normalizedTranslation: thus do we insert denial into the hearts of the criminals

arabic: لَا يُؤۡمِنُونَ بِهِۦ وَقَدۡ خَلَتۡ سُنَّةُ ٱلۡأَوَّلِينَ
translation: They will not believe in it, while there has already occurred the precedent of the former peoples
normalizedArabic: لا يومنون به وقد خلت سنه الاولين
normalizedTranslation: they will not believe in it, while there has already occurred the precedent of the former peoples

arabic: وَلَوۡ فَتَحۡنَا عَلَيۡهِم بَابٗا مِّنَ ٱلسَّمَآءِ فَظَلُّواْ فِيهِ يَعۡرُجُونَ
translation: And [even] if We opened to them a gate from the heaven and they continued therein to ascend
normalizedArabic: ولو فتحنا عليهم بابا من السماء فظلوا فيه يعرجون
normalizedTranslation: and [even] if we opened to them a gate from the heaven and they continued therein to ascend

arabic: لَقَالُوٓاْ إِنَّمَا سُكِّرَتۡ أَبۡصَٰرُنَا بَلۡ نَحۡنُ قَوۡمٞ مَّسۡحُورُونَ
translation: They would say, "Our eyes have only been dazzled. Rather, we are a people affected by magic
normalizedArabic: لقالوا انما سكرت ابصرنا بل نحن قوم مسحورون
normalizedTranslation: they would say, "our eyes have only been dazzled. rather, we are a people affected by magic

arabic: وَلَقَدۡ جَعَلۡنَا فِي ٱلسَّمَآءِ بُرُوجٗا وَزَيَّنَّـٰهَا لِلنَّـٰظِرِينَ
translation: And We have placed within the heaven great stars and have beautified it for the observers
normalizedArabic: ولقد جعلنا في السماء بروجا وزينها للنظرين
normalizedTranslation: and we have placed within the heaven great stars and have beautified it for the observers

arabic: وَحَفِظۡنَٰهَا مِن كُلِّ شَيۡطَٰنٖ رَّجِيمٍ
translation: And We have protected it from every devil expelled [from the mercy of Allah]
normalizedArabic: وحفظنها من كل شيطن رجيم
normalizedTranslation: and we have protected it from every devil expelled [from the mercy of allah]

arabic: إِلَّا مَنِ ٱسۡتَرَقَ ٱلسَّمۡعَ فَأَتۡبَعَهُۥ شِهَابٞ مُّبِينٞ
translation: Except one who steals a hearing and is pursued by a clear burning flame
normalizedArabic: الا من استرق السمع فاتبعه شهاب مبين
normalizedTranslation: except one who steals a hearing and is pursued by a clear burning flame

arabic: وَٱلۡأَرۡضَ مَدَدۡنَٰهَا وَأَلۡقَيۡنَا فِيهَا رَوَٰسِيَ وَأَنۢبَتۡنَا فِيهَا مِن كُلِّ شَيۡءٖ مَّوۡزُونٖ
translation: And the earth - We have spread it and cast therein firmly set mountains and caused to grow therein [something] of every well-balanced thing
normalizedArabic: والارض مددنها والقينا فيها روسي وانبتنا فيها من كل شيء موزون
normalizedTranslation: and the earth - we have spread it and cast therein firmly set mountains and caused to grow therein [something] of every well-balanced thing

arabic: وَجَعَلۡنَا لَكُمۡ فِيهَا مَعَٰيِشَ وَمَن لَّسۡتُمۡ لَهُۥ بِرَٰزِقِينَ
translation: And We have made for you therein means of living and [for] those for whom you are not providers
normalizedArabic: وجعلنا لكم فيها معيش ومن لستم له برزقين
normalizedTranslation: and we have made for you therein means of living and [for] those for whom you are not providers

arabic: وَإِن مِّن شَيۡءٍ إِلَّا عِندَنَا خَزَآئِنُهُۥ وَمَا نُنَزِّلُهُۥٓ إِلَّا بِقَدَرٖ مَّعۡلُومٖ
translation: And there is not a thing but that with Us are its depositories, and We do not send it down except according to a known measure
normalizedArabic: وان من شيء الا عندنا خزاينه وما ننزله الا بقدر معلوم
normalizedTranslation: and there is not a thing but that with us are its depositories, and we do not send it down except according to a known measure

arabic: وَأَرۡسَلۡنَا ٱلرِّيَٰحَ لَوَٰقِحَ فَأَنزَلۡنَا مِنَ ٱلسَّمَآءِ مَآءٗ فَأَسۡقَيۡنَٰكُمُوهُ وَمَآ أَنتُمۡ لَهُۥ بِخَٰزِنِينَ
translation: And We have sent the fertilizing winds and sent down water from the sky and given you drink from it. And you are not its retainers
normalizedArabic: وارسلنا الريح لوقح فانزلنا من السماء ماء فاسقينكموه وما انتم له بخزنين
normalizedTranslation: and we have sent the fertilizing winds and sent down water from the sky and given you drink from it. and you are not its retainers

arabic: وَإِنَّا لَنَحۡنُ نُحۡيِۦ وَنُمِيتُ وَنَحۡنُ ٱلۡوَٰرِثُونَ
translation: And indeed, it is We who give life and cause death, and We are the Inheritor
normalizedArabic: وانا لنحن نحي ونميت ونحن الورثون
normalizedTranslation: and indeed, it is we who give life and cause death, and we are the inheritor

arabic: وَلَقَدۡ عَلِمۡنَا ٱلۡمُسۡتَقۡدِمِينَ مِنكُمۡ وَلَقَدۡ عَلِمۡنَا ٱلۡمُسۡتَـٔۡخِرِينَ
translation: And We have already known the preceding [generations] among you, and We have already known the later [ones to come]
normalizedArabic: ولقد علمنا المستقدمين منكم ولقد علمنا المستخرين
normalizedTranslation: and we have already known the preceding [generations] among you, and we have already known the later [ones to come]

arabic: وَإِنَّ رَبَّكَ هُوَ يَحۡشُرُهُمۡۚ إِنَّهُۥ حَكِيمٌ عَلِيمٞ
translation: And indeed, your Lord will gather them; indeed, He is Wise and Knowing
normalizedArabic: وان ربك هو يحشرهم انه حكيم عليم
normalizedTranslation: and indeed, your lord will gather them; indeed, he is wise and knowing

arabic: وَلَقَدۡ خَلَقۡنَا ٱلۡإِنسَٰنَ مِن صَلۡصَٰلٖ مِّنۡ حَمَإٖ مَّسۡنُونٖ
translation: And We did certainly create man out of clay from an altered black mud
normalizedArabic: ولقد خلقنا الانسن من صلصل من حما مسنون
normalizedTranslation: and we did certainly create man out of clay from an altered black mud

arabic: وَٱلۡجَآنَّ خَلَقۡنَٰهُ مِن قَبۡلُ مِن نَّارِ ٱلسَّمُومِ
translation: And the jinn We created before from scorching fire
normalizedArabic: والجان خلقنه من قبل من نار السموم
normalizedTranslation: and the jinn we created before from scorching fire

arabic: وَإِذۡ قَالَ رَبُّكَ لِلۡمَلَـٰٓئِكَةِ إِنِّي خَٰلِقُۢ بَشَرٗا مِّن صَلۡصَٰلٖ مِّنۡ حَمَإٖ مَّسۡنُونٖ
translation: And [mention, O Muhammad], when your Lord said to the angels, "I will create a human being out of clay from an altered black mud
normalizedArabic: واذ قال ربك للمليكه اني خلق بشرا من صلصل من حما مسنون
normalizedTranslation: and [mention, o muhammad], when your lord said to the angels, "i will create a human being out of clay from an altered black mud

arabic: فَإِذَا سَوَّيۡتُهُۥ وَنَفَخۡتُ فِيهِ مِن رُّوحِي فَقَعُواْ لَهُۥ سَٰجِدِينَ
translation: And when I have proportioned him and breathed into him of My [created] soul, then fall down to him in prostration
normalizedArabic: فاذا سويته ونفخت فيه من روحي فقعوا له سجدين
normalizedTranslation: and when i have proportioned him and breathed into him of my [created] soul, then fall down to him in prostration

arabic: فَسَجَدَ ٱلۡمَلَـٰٓئِكَةُ كُلُّهُمۡ أَجۡمَعُونَ
translation: So the angels prostrated - all of them entirely
normalizedArabic: فسجد المليكه كلهم اجمعون
normalizedTranslation: so the angels prostrated - all of them entirely

arabic: إِلَّآ إِبۡلِيسَ أَبَىٰٓ أَن يَكُونَ مَعَ ٱلسَّـٰجِدِينَ
translation: Except Iblees, he refused to be with those who prostrated
normalizedArabic: الا ابليس ابي ان يكون مع السجدين
normalizedTranslation: except iblees, he refused to be with those who prostrated

arabic: قَالَ يَـٰٓإِبۡلِيسُ مَا لَكَ أَلَّا تَكُونَ مَعَ ٱلسَّـٰجِدِينَ
translation: [Allah] said, O Iblees, what is [the matter] with you that you are not with those who prostrate
normalizedArabic: قال يابليس ما لك الا تكون مع السجدين
normalizedTranslation: [allah] said, o iblees, what is [the matter] with you that you are not with those who prostrate

arabic: قَالَ لَمۡ أَكُن لِّأَسۡجُدَ لِبَشَرٍ خَلَقۡتَهُۥ مِن صَلۡصَٰلٖ مِّنۡ حَمَإٖ مَّسۡنُونٖ
translation: He said, "Never would I prostrate to a human whom You created out of clay from an altered black mud
normalizedArabic: قال لم اكن لاسجد لبشر خلقته من صلصل من حما مسنون
normalizedTranslation: he said, "never would i prostrate to a human whom you created out of clay from an altered black mud

arabic: قَالَ فَٱخۡرُجۡ مِنۡهَا فَإِنَّكَ رَجِيمٞ
translation: [Allah] said, "Then get out of it, for indeed, you are expelled
normalizedArabic: قال فاخرج منها فانك رجيم
normalizedTranslation: [allah] said, "then get out of it, for indeed, you are expelled

arabic: وَإِنَّ عَلَيۡكَ ٱللَّعۡنَةَ إِلَىٰ يَوۡمِ ٱلدِّينِ
translation: And indeed, upon you is the curse until the Day of Recompense
normalizedArabic: وان عليك اللعنه الي يوم الدين
normalizedTranslation: and indeed, upon you is the curse until the day of recompense

arabic: قَالَ رَبِّ فَأَنظِرۡنِيٓ إِلَىٰ يَوۡمِ يُبۡعَثُونَ
translation: He said, "My Lord, then reprieve me until the Day they are resurrected
normalizedArabic: قال رب فانظرني الي يوم يبعثون
normalizedTranslation: he said, "my lord, then reprieve me until the day they are resurrected

arabic: قَالَ فَإِنَّكَ مِنَ ٱلۡمُنظَرِينَ
translation: [Allah] said, "So indeed, you are of those reprieved
normalizedArabic: قال فانك من المنظرين
normalizedTranslation: [allah] said, "so indeed, you are of those reprieved

arabic: إِلَىٰ يَوۡمِ ٱلۡوَقۡتِ ٱلۡمَعۡلُومِ
translation: Until the Day of the time well-known
normalizedArabic: الي يوم الوقت المعلوم
normalizedTranslation: until the day of the time well-known

arabic: قَالَ رَبِّ بِمَآ أَغۡوَيۡتَنِي لَأُزَيِّنَنَّ لَهُمۡ فِي ٱلۡأَرۡضِ وَلَأُغۡوِيَنَّهُمۡ أَجۡمَعِينَ
translation: [Iblees] said, "My Lord, because You have put me in error, I will surely make [disobedience] attractive to them on earth, and I will mislead them all
normalizedArabic: قال رب بما اغويتني لازينن لهم في الارض ولاغوينهم اجمعين
normalizedTranslation: [iblees] said, "my lord, because you have put me in error, i will surely make [disobedience] attractive to them on earth, and i will mislead them all

arabic: إِلَّا عِبَادَكَ مِنۡهُمُ ٱلۡمُخۡلَصِينَ
translation: Except, among them, Your chosen servants
normalizedArabic: الا عبادك منهم المخلصين
normalizedTranslation: except, among them, your chosen servants

arabic: قَالَ هَٰذَا صِرَٰطٌ عَلَيَّ مُسۡتَقِيمٌ
translation: [Allah] said, "This is a path [of return] to Me [that is] straight
normalizedArabic: قال هذا صرط علي مستقيم
normalizedTranslation: [allah] said, "this is a path [of return] to me [that is] straight

arabic: إِنَّ عِبَادِي لَيۡسَ لَكَ عَلَيۡهِمۡ سُلۡطَٰنٌ إِلَّا مَنِ ٱتَّبَعَكَ مِنَ ٱلۡغَاوِينَ
translation: Indeed, My servants - no authority will you have over them, except those who follow you of the deviators
normalizedArabic: ان عبادي ليس لك عليهم سلطن الا من اتبعك من الغاوين
normalizedTranslation: indeed, my servants - no authority will you have over them, except those who follow you of the deviators

arabic: وَإِنَّ جَهَنَّمَ لَمَوۡعِدُهُمۡ أَجۡمَعِينَ
translation: And indeed, Hell is the promised place for them all
normalizedArabic: وان جهنم لموعدهم اجمعين
normalizedTranslation: and indeed, hell is the promised place for them all

arabic: لَهَا سَبۡعَةُ أَبۡوَٰبٖ لِّكُلِّ بَابٖ مِّنۡهُمۡ جُزۡءٞ مَّقۡسُومٌ
translation: It has seven gates; for every gate is of them a portion designated
normalizedArabic: لها سبعه ابوب لكل باب منهم جزء مقسوم
normalizedTranslation: it has seven gates; for every gate is of them a portion designated

arabic: إِنَّ ٱلۡمُتَّقِينَ فِي جَنَّـٰتٖ وَعُيُونٍ
translation: Indeed, the righteous will be within gardens and springs
normalizedArabic: ان المتقين في جنت وعيون
normalizedTranslation: indeed, the righteous will be within gardens and springs

arabic: ٱدۡخُلُوهَا بِسَلَٰمٍ ءَامِنِينَ
translation: [Having been told], "Enter it in peace, safe [and secure]
normalizedArabic: ادخلوها بسلم ءامنين
normalizedTranslation: [having been told], "enter it in peace, safe [and secure]

arabic: وَنَزَعۡنَا مَا فِي صُدُورِهِم مِّنۡ غِلٍّ إِخۡوَٰنًا عَلَىٰ سُرُرٖ مُّتَقَٰبِلِينَ
translation: And We will remove whatever is in their breasts of resentment, [so they will be] brothers, on thrones facing each other
normalizedArabic: ونزعنا ما في صدورهم من غل اخونا علي سرر متقبلين
normalizedTranslation: and we will remove whatever is in their breasts of resentment, [so they will be] brothers, on thrones facing each other

arabic: لَا يَمَسُّهُمۡ فِيهَا نَصَبٞ وَمَا هُم مِّنۡهَا بِمُخۡرَجِينَ
translation: No fatigue will touch them therein, nor from it will they [ever] be removed
normalizedArabic: لا يمسهم فيها نصب وما هم منها بمخرجين
normalizedTranslation: no fatigue will touch them therein, nor from it will they [ever] be removed

arabic: ۞نَبِّئۡ عِبَادِيٓ أَنِّيٓ أَنَا ٱلۡغَفُورُ ٱلرَّحِيمُ
translation: [O Muhammad], inform My servants that it is I who am the Forgiving, the Merciful
normalizedArabic: نبي عبادي اني انا الغفور الرحيم
normalizedTranslation: [o muhammad], inform my servants that it is i who am the forgiving, the merciful

arabic: وَأَنَّ عَذَابِي هُوَ ٱلۡعَذَابُ ٱلۡأَلِيمُ
translation: And that it is My punishment which is the painful punishment
normalizedArabic: وان عذابي هو العذاب الاليم
normalizedTranslation: and that it is my punishment which is the painful punishment

arabic: وَنَبِّئۡهُمۡ عَن ضَيۡفِ إِبۡرَٰهِيمَ
translation: And inform them about the guests of Abraham
normalizedArabic: ونبيهم عن ضيف ابرهيم
normalizedTranslation: and inform them about the guests of abraham

arabic: إِذۡ دَخَلُواْ عَلَيۡهِ فَقَالُواْ سَلَٰمٗا قَالَ إِنَّا مِنكُمۡ وَجِلُونَ
translation: When they entered upon him and said, "Peace." [Abraham] said, "Indeed, we are fearful of you
normalizedArabic: اذ دخلوا عليه فقالوا سلما قال انا منكم وجلون
normalizedTranslation: when they entered upon him and said, "peace." [abraham] said, "indeed, we are fearful of you

arabic: قَالُواْ لَا تَوۡجَلۡ إِنَّا نُبَشِّرُكَ بِغُلَٰمٍ عَلِيمٖ
translation: [The angels] said, "Fear not. Indeed, we give you good tidings of a learned boy
normalizedArabic: قالوا لا توجل انا نبشرك بغلم عليم
normalizedTranslation: [the angels] said, "fear not. indeed, we give you good tidings of a learned boy

arabic: قَالَ أَبَشَّرۡتُمُونِي عَلَىٰٓ أَن مَّسَّنِيَ ٱلۡكِبَرُ فَبِمَ تُبَشِّرُونَ
translation: He said, "Have you given me good tidings although old age has come upon me? Then of what [wonder] do you inform
normalizedArabic: قال ابشرتموني علي ان مسني الكبر فبم تبشرون
normalizedTranslation: he said, "have you given me good tidings although old age has come upon me? then of what [wonder] do you inform

arabic: قَالُواْ بَشَّرۡنَٰكَ بِٱلۡحَقِّ فَلَا تَكُن مِّنَ ٱلۡقَٰنِطِينَ
translation: They said, "We have given you good tidings in truth, so do not be of the despairing
normalizedArabic: قالوا بشرنك بالحق فلا تكن من القنطين
normalizedTranslation: they said, "we have given you good tidings in truth, so do not be of the despairing

arabic: قَالَ وَمَن يَقۡنَطُ مِن رَّحۡمَةِ رَبِّهِۦٓ إِلَّا ٱلضَّآلُّونَ
translation: He said, "And who despairs of the mercy of his Lord except for those astray
normalizedArabic: قال ومن يقنط من رحمه ربه الا الضالون
normalizedTranslation: he said, "and who despairs of the mercy of his lord except for those astray

arabic: قَالَ فَمَا خَطۡبُكُمۡ أَيُّهَا ٱلۡمُرۡسَلُونَ
translation: [Abraham] said, "Then what is your business [here], O messengers
normalizedArabic: قال فما خطبكم ايها المرسلون
normalizedTranslation: [abraham] said, "then what is your business [here], o messengers

arabic: قَالُوٓاْ إِنَّآ أُرۡسِلۡنَآ إِلَىٰ قَوۡمٖ مُّجۡرِمِينَ
translation: They said, "Indeed, we have been sent to a people of criminals
normalizedArabic: قالوا انا ارسلنا الي قوم مجرمين
normalizedTranslation: they said, "indeed, we have been sent to a people of criminals

arabic: إِلَّآ ءَالَ لُوطٍ إِنَّا لَمُنَجُّوهُمۡ أَجۡمَعِينَ
translation: Except the family of Lot; indeed, we will save them all
normalizedArabic: الا ءال لوط انا لمنجوهم اجمعين
normalizedTranslation: except the family of lot; indeed, we will save them all

arabic: إِلَّا ٱمۡرَأَتَهُۥ قَدَّرۡنَآ إِنَّهَا لَمِنَ ٱلۡغَٰبِرِينَ
translation: Except his wife." Allah decreed that she is of those who remain behind
normalizedArabic: الا امراته قدرنا انها لمن الغبرين
normalizedTranslation: except his wife." allah decreed that she is of those who remain behind

arabic: فَلَمَّا جَآءَ ءَالَ لُوطٍ ٱلۡمُرۡسَلُونَ
translation: And when the messengers came to the family of Lot
normalizedArabic: فلما جاء ءال لوط المرسلون
normalizedTranslation: and when the messengers came to the family of lot

arabic: قَالَ إِنَّكُمۡ قَوۡمٞ مُّنكَرُونَ
translation: He said, "Indeed, you are people unknown
normalizedArabic: قال انكم قوم منكرون
normalizedTranslation: he said, "indeed, you are people unknown

arabic: قَالُواْ بَلۡ جِئۡنَٰكَ بِمَا كَانُواْ فِيهِ يَمۡتَرُونَ
translation: They said, "But we have come to you with that about which they were disputing
normalizedArabic: قالوا بل جينك بما كانوا فيه يمترون
normalizedTranslation: they said, "but we have come to you with that about which they were disputing

arabic: وَأَتَيۡنَٰكَ بِٱلۡحَقِّ وَإِنَّا لَصَٰدِقُونَ
translation: And we have come to you with truth, and indeed, we are truthful
normalizedArabic: واتينك بالحق وانا لصدقون
normalizedTranslation: and we have come to you with truth, and indeed, we are truthful

arabic: فَأَسۡرِ بِأَهۡلِكَ بِقِطۡعٖ مِّنَ ٱلَّيۡلِ وَٱتَّبِعۡ أَدۡبَٰرَهُمۡ وَلَا يَلۡتَفِتۡ مِنكُمۡ أَحَدٞ وَٱمۡضُواْ حَيۡثُ تُؤۡمَرُونَ
translation: So set out with your family during a portion of the night and follow behind them and let not anyone among you look back and continue on to where you are commanded
normalizedArabic: فاسر باهلك بقطع من اليل واتبع ادبرهم ولا يلتفت منكم احد وامضوا حيث تومرون
normalizedTranslation: so set out with your family during a portion of the night and follow behind them and let not anyone among you look back and continue on to where you are commanded

arabic: وَقَضَيۡنَآ إِلَيۡهِ ذَٰلِكَ ٱلۡأَمۡرَ أَنَّ دَابِرَ هَـٰٓؤُلَآءِ مَقۡطُوعٞ مُّصۡبِحِينَ
translation: And We conveyed to him [the decree] of that matter: that those [sinners] would be eliminated by early morning
normalizedArabic: وقضينا اليه ذلك الامر ان دابر هولاء مقطوع مصبحين
normalizedTranslation: and we conveyed to him [the decree] of that matter: that those [sinners] would be eliminated by early morning

arabic: وَجَآءَ أَهۡلُ ٱلۡمَدِينَةِ يَسۡتَبۡشِرُونَ
translation: And the people of the city came rejoicing
normalizedArabic: وجاء اهل المدينه يستبشرون
normalizedTranslation: and the people of the city came rejoicing

arabic: قَالَ إِنَّ هَـٰٓؤُلَآءِ ضَيۡفِي فَلَا تَفۡضَحُونِ
translation: [Lot] said, "Indeed, these are my guests, so do not shame me
normalizedArabic: قال ان هولاء ضيفي فلا تفضحون
normalizedTranslation: [lot] said, "indeed, these are my guests, so do not shame me

arabic: وَٱتَّقُواْ ٱللَّهَ وَلَا تُخۡزُونِ
translation: And fear Allah and do not disgrace me
normalizedArabic: واتقوا الله ولا تخزون
normalizedTranslation: and fear allah and do not disgrace me

arabic: قَالُوٓاْ أَوَلَمۡ نَنۡهَكَ عَنِ ٱلۡعَٰلَمِينَ
translation: They said, "Have we not forbidden you from [protecting] people
normalizedArabic: قالوا اولم ننهك عن العلمين
normalizedTranslation: they said, "have we not forbidden you from [protecting] people

arabic: قَالَ هَـٰٓؤُلَآءِ بَنَاتِيٓ إِن كُنتُمۡ فَٰعِلِينَ
translation: [Lot] said, "These are my daughters - if you would be doers [of lawful marriage]
normalizedArabic: قال هولاء بناتي ان كنتم فعلين
normalizedTranslation: [lot] said, "these are my daughters - if you would be doers [of lawful marriage]

arabic: لَعَمۡرُكَ إِنَّهُمۡ لَفِي سَكۡرَتِهِمۡ يَعۡمَهُونَ
translation: By your life, [O Muhammad], indeed they were, in their intoxication, wandering blindly
normalizedArabic: لعمرك انهم لفي سكرتهم يعمهون
normalizedTranslation: by your life, [o muhammad], indeed they were, in their intoxication, wandering blindly

arabic: فَأَخَذَتۡهُمُ ٱلصَّيۡحَةُ مُشۡرِقِينَ
translation: So the shriek seized them at sunrise
normalizedArabic: فاخذتهم الصيحه مشرقين
normalizedTranslation: so the shriek seized them at sunrise

arabic: فَجَعَلۡنَا عَٰلِيَهَا سَافِلَهَا وَأَمۡطَرۡنَا عَلَيۡهِمۡ حِجَارَةٗ مِّن سِجِّيلٍ
translation: And We made the highest part [of the city] its lowest and rained upon them stones of hard clay
normalizedArabic: فجعلنا عليها سافلها وامطرنا عليهم حجاره من سجيل
normalizedTranslation: and we made the highest part [of the city] its lowest and rained upon them stones of hard clay

arabic: إِنَّ فِي ذَٰلِكَ لَأٓيَٰتٖ لِّلۡمُتَوَسِّمِينَ
translation: Indeed in that are signs for those who discern
normalizedArabic: ان في ذلك لايت للمتوسمين
normalizedTranslation: indeed in that are signs for those who discern

arabic: وَإِنَّهَا لَبِسَبِيلٖ مُّقِيمٍ
translation: And indeed, those cities are [situated] on an established road
normalizedArabic: وانها لبسبيل مقيم
normalizedTranslation: and indeed, those cities are [situated] on an established road

arabic: إِنَّ فِي ذَٰلِكَ لَأٓيَةٗ لِّلۡمُؤۡمِنِينَ
translation: Indeed in that is a sign for the believers
normalizedArabic: ان في ذلك لايه للمومنين
normalizedTranslation: indeed in that is a sign for the believers

arabic: وَإِن كَانَ أَصۡحَٰبُ ٱلۡأَيۡكَةِ لَظَٰلِمِينَ
translation: And the companions of the thicket were [also] wrongdoers
normalizedArabic: وان كان اصحب الايكه لظلمين
normalizedTranslation: and the companions of the thicket were [also] wrongdoers

arabic: فَٱنتَقَمۡنَا مِنۡهُمۡ وَإِنَّهُمَا لَبِإِمَامٖ مُّبِينٖ
translation: So We took retribution from them, and indeed, both [cities] are on a clear highway
normalizedArabic: فانتقمنا منهم وانهما لبامام مبين
normalizedTranslation: so we took retribution from them, and indeed, both [cities] are on a clear highway

arabic: وَلَقَدۡ كَذَّبَ أَصۡحَٰبُ ٱلۡحِجۡرِ ٱلۡمُرۡسَلِينَ
translation: And certainly did the companions of Thamud deny the messengers
normalizedArabic: ولقد كذب اصحب الحجر المرسلين
normalizedTranslation: and certainly did the companions of thamud deny the messengers

arabic: وَءَاتَيۡنَٰهُمۡ ءَايَٰتِنَا فَكَانُواْ عَنۡهَا مُعۡرِضِينَ
translation: And We gave them Our signs, but from them they were turning away
normalizedArabic: وءاتينهم ءايتنا فكانوا عنها معرضين
normalizedTranslation: and we gave them our signs, but from them they were turning away

arabic: وَكَانُواْ يَنۡحِتُونَ مِنَ ٱلۡجِبَالِ بُيُوتًا ءَامِنِينَ
translation: And they used to carve from the mountains, houses, feeling secure
normalizedArabic: وكانوا ينحتون من الجبال بيوتا ءامنين
normalizedTranslation: and they used to carve from the mountains, houses, feeling secure

arabic: فَأَخَذَتۡهُمُ ٱلصَّيۡحَةُ مُصۡبِحِينَ
translation: But the shriek seized them at early morning
normalizedArabic: فاخذتهم الصيحه مصبحين
normalizedTranslation: but the shriek seized them at early morning

arabic: فَمَآ أَغۡنَىٰ عَنۡهُم مَّا كَانُواْ يَكۡسِبُونَ
translation: So nothing availed them [from] what they used to earn
normalizedArabic: فما اغني عنهم ما كانوا يكسبون
normalizedTranslation: so nothing availed them [from] what they used to earn

arabic: وَمَا خَلَقۡنَا ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلۡأَرۡضَ وَمَا بَيۡنَهُمَآ إِلَّا بِٱلۡحَقِّۗ وَإِنَّ ٱلسَّاعَةَ لَأٓتِيَةٞۖ فَٱصۡفَحِ ٱلصَّفۡحَ ٱلۡجَمِيلَ
translation: And We have not created the heavens and earth and that between them except in truth. And indeed, the Hour is coming; so forgive with gracious forgiveness
normalizedArabic: وما خلقنا السموت والارض وما بينهما الا بالحق وان الساعه لاتيه فاصفح الصفح الجميل
normalizedTranslation: and we have not created the heavens and earth and that between them except in truth. and indeed, the hour is coming; so forgive with gracious forgiveness

arabic: إِنَّ رَبَّكَ هُوَ ٱلۡخَلَّـٰقُ ٱلۡعَلِيمُ
translation: Indeed, your Lord - He is the Knowing Creator
normalizedArabic: ان ربك هو الخلق العليم
normalizedTranslation: indeed, your lord - he is the knowing creator

arabic: وَلَقَدۡ ءَاتَيۡنَٰكَ سَبۡعٗا مِّنَ ٱلۡمَثَانِي وَٱلۡقُرۡءَانَ ٱلۡعَظِيمَ
translation: And We have certainly given you, [O Muhammad], seven of the often repeated [verses] and the great Qur'an
normalizedArabic: ولقد ءاتينك سبعا من المثاني والقرءان العظيم
normalizedTranslation: and we have certainly given you, [o muhammad], seven of the often repeated [verses] and the great qur'an

arabic: لَا تَمُدَّنَّ عَيۡنَيۡكَ إِلَىٰ مَا مَتَّعۡنَا بِهِۦٓ أَزۡوَٰجٗا مِّنۡهُمۡ وَلَا تَحۡزَنۡ عَلَيۡهِمۡ وَٱخۡفِضۡ جَنَاحَكَ لِلۡمُؤۡمِنِينَ
translation: Do not extend your eyes toward that by which We have given enjoyment to [certain] categories of the disbelievers, and do not grieve over them. And lower your wing to the believers
normalizedArabic: لا تمدن عينيك الي ما متعنا به ازوجا منهم ولا تحزن عليهم واخفض جناحك للمومنين
normalizedTranslation: do not extend your eyes toward that by which we have given enjoyment to [certain] categories of the disbelievers, and do not grieve over them. and lower your wing to the believers

arabic: وَقُلۡ إِنِّيٓ أَنَا ٱلنَّذِيرُ ٱلۡمُبِينُ
translation: And say, "Indeed, I am the clear warner
normalizedArabic: وقل اني انا النذير المبين
normalizedTranslation: and say, "indeed, i am the clear warner

arabic: كَمَآ أَنزَلۡنَا عَلَى ٱلۡمُقۡتَسِمِينَ
translation: Just as We had revealed [scriptures] to the separators
normalizedArabic: كما انزلنا علي المقتسمين
normalizedTranslation: just as we had revealed [scriptures] to the separators

arabic: ٱلَّذِينَ جَعَلُواْ ٱلۡقُرۡءَانَ عِضِينَ
translation: Who have made the Qur'an into portions
normalizedArabic: الذين جعلوا القرءان عضين
normalizedTranslation: who have made the qur'an into portions

arabic: فَوَرَبِّكَ لَنَسۡـَٔلَنَّهُمۡ أَجۡمَعِينَ
translation: So by your Lord, We will surely question them all
normalizedArabic: فوربك لنسلنهم اجمعين
normalizedTranslation: so by your lord, we will surely question them all

arabic: عَمَّا كَانُواْ يَعۡمَلُونَ
translation: About what they used to do
normalizedArabic: عما كانوا يعملون
normalizedTranslation: about what they used to do

arabic: فَٱصۡدَعۡ بِمَا تُؤۡمَرُ وَأَعۡرِضۡ عَنِ ٱلۡمُشۡرِكِينَ
translation: Then declare what you are commanded and turn away from the polytheists
normalizedArabic: فاصدع بما تومر واعرض عن المشركين
normalizedTranslation: then declare what you are commanded and turn away from the polytheists

arabic: إِنَّا كَفَيۡنَٰكَ ٱلۡمُسۡتَهۡزِءِينَ
translation: Indeed, We are sufficient for you against the mockers
normalizedArabic: انا كفينك المستهزءين
normalizedTranslation: indeed, we are sufficient for you against the mockers

arabic: ٱلَّذِينَ يَجۡعَلُونَ مَعَ ٱللَّهِ إِلَٰهًا ءَاخَرَۚ فَسَوۡفَ يَعۡلَمُونَ
translation: Who make [equal] with Allah another deity. But they are going to know
normalizedArabic: الذين يجعلون مع الله الها ءاخر فسوف يعلمون
normalizedTranslation: who make [equal] with allah another deity. but they are going to know

arabic: وَلَقَدۡ نَعۡلَمُ أَنَّكَ يَضِيقُ صَدۡرُكَ بِمَا يَقُولُونَ
translation: And We already know that your breast is constrained by what they say
normalizedArabic: ولقد نعلم انك يضيق صدرك بما يقولون
normalizedTranslation: and we already know that your breast is constrained by what they say

arabic: فَسَبِّحۡ بِحَمۡدِ رَبِّكَ وَكُن مِّنَ ٱلسَّـٰجِدِينَ
translation: So exalt [Allah] with praise of your Lord and be of those who prostrate [to Him]
normalizedArabic: فسبح بحمد ربك وكن من السجدين
normalizedTranslation: so exalt [allah] with praise of your lord and be of those who prostrate [to him]

arabic: وَٱعۡبُدۡ رَبَّكَ حَتَّىٰ يَأۡتِيَكَ ٱلۡيَقِينُ
translation: And worship your Lord until there comes to you the certainty (death)
normalizedArabic: واعبد ربك حتي ياتيك اليقين
normalizedTranslation: and worship your lord until there comes to you the certainty (death)

arabic: أَتَىٰٓ أَمۡرُ ٱللَّهِ فَلَا تَسۡتَعۡجِلُوهُۚ سُبۡحَٰنَهُۥ وَتَعَٰلَىٰ عَمَّا يُشۡرِكُونَ
translation: The command of Allah is coming, so be not impatient for it. Exalted is He and high above what they associate with Him
normalizedArabic: اتي امر الله فلا تستعجلوه سبحنه وتعلي عما يشركون
normalizedTranslation: the command of allah is coming, so be not impatient for it. exalted is he and high above what they associate with him

arabic: يُنَزِّلُ ٱلۡمَلَـٰٓئِكَةَ بِٱلرُّوحِ مِنۡ أَمۡرِهِۦ عَلَىٰ مَن يَشَآءُ مِنۡ عِبَادِهِۦٓ أَنۡ أَنذِرُوٓاْ أَنَّهُۥ لَآ إِلَٰهَ إِلَّآ أَنَا۠ فَٱتَّقُونِ
translation: He sends down the angels, with the inspiration of His command, upon whom He wills of His servants, [telling them], "Warn that there is no deity except Me; so fear Me
normalizedArabic: ينزل المليكه بالروح من امره علي من يشاء من عباده ان انذروا انه لا اله الا انا فاتقون
normalizedTranslation: he sends down the angels, with the inspiration of his command, upon whom he wills of his servants, [telling them], "warn that there is no deity except me; so fear me

arabic: خَلَقَ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلۡأَرۡضَ بِٱلۡحَقِّۚ تَعَٰلَىٰ عَمَّا يُشۡرِكُونَ
translation: He created the heavens and earth in truth. High is He above what they associate with Him
normalizedArabic: خلق السموت والارض بالحق تعلي عما يشركون
normalizedTranslation: he created the heavens and earth in truth. high is he above what they associate with him

arabic: خَلَقَ ٱلۡإِنسَٰنَ مِن نُّطۡفَةٖ فَإِذَا هُوَ خَصِيمٞ مُّبِينٞ
translation: He created man from a sperm-drop; then at once, he is a clear adversary
normalizedArabic: خلق الانسن من نطفه فاذا هو خصيم مبين
normalizedTranslation: he created man from a sperm-drop; then at once, he is a clear adversary

arabic: وَٱلۡأَنۡعَٰمَ خَلَقَهَاۖ لَكُمۡ فِيهَا دِفۡءٞ وَمَنَٰفِعُ وَمِنۡهَا تَأۡكُلُونَ
translation: And the grazing livestock He has created for you; in them is warmth and [numerous] benefits, and from them you eat
normalizedArabic: والانعم خلقها لكم فيها دفء ومنفع ومنها تاكلون
normalizedTranslation: and the grazing livestock he has created for you; in them is warmth and [numerous] benefits, and from them you eat

arabic: وَلَكُمۡ فِيهَا جَمَالٌ حِينَ تُرِيحُونَ وَحِينَ تَسۡرَحُونَ
translation: And for you in them is [the enjoyment of] beauty when you bring them in [for the evening] and when you send them out [to pasture]
normalizedArabic: ولكم فيها جمال حين تريحون وحين تسرحون
normalizedTranslation: and for you in them is [the enjoyment of] beauty when you bring them in [for the evening] and when you send them out [to pasture]

arabic: وَتَحۡمِلُ أَثۡقَالَكُمۡ إِلَىٰ بَلَدٖ لَّمۡ تَكُونُواْ بَٰلِغِيهِ إِلَّا بِشِقِّ ٱلۡأَنفُسِۚ إِنَّ رَبَّكُمۡ لَرَءُوفٞ رَّحِيمٞ
translation: And they carry your loads to a land you could not have reached except with difficulty to yourselves. Indeed, your Lord is Kind and Merciful
normalizedArabic: وتحمل اثقالكم الي بلد لم تكونوا بلغيه الا بشق الانفس ان ربكم لرءوف رحيم
normalizedTranslation: and they carry your loads to a land you could not have reached except with difficulty to yourselves. indeed, your lord is kind and merciful

arabic: وَٱلۡخَيۡلَ وَٱلۡبِغَالَ وَٱلۡحَمِيرَ لِتَرۡكَبُوهَا وَزِينَةٗۚ وَيَخۡلُقُ مَا لَا تَعۡلَمُونَ
translation: And [He created] the horses, mules and donkeys for you to ride and [as] adornment. And He creates that which you do not know
normalizedArabic: والخيل والبغال والحمير لتركبوها وزينه ويخلق ما لا تعلمون
normalizedTranslation: and [he created] the horses, mules and donkeys for you to ride and [as] adornment. and he creates that which you do not know

arabic: وَعَلَى ٱللَّهِ قَصۡدُ ٱلسَّبِيلِ وَمِنۡهَا جَآئِرٞۚ وَلَوۡ شَآءَ لَهَدَىٰكُمۡ أَجۡمَعِينَ
translation: And upon Allah is the direction of the [right] way, and among the various paths are those deviating. And if He willed, He could have guided you all
normalizedArabic: وعلي الله قصد السبيل ومنها جاير ولو شاء لهديكم اجمعين
normalizedTranslation: and upon allah is the direction of the [right] way, and among the various paths are those deviating. and if he willed, he could have guided you all

arabic: هُوَ ٱلَّذِيٓ أَنزَلَ مِنَ ٱلسَّمَآءِ مَآءٗۖ لَّكُم مِّنۡهُ شَرَابٞ وَمِنۡهُ شَجَرٞ فِيهِ تُسِيمُونَ
translation: It is He who sends down rain from the sky; from it is drink and from it is foliage in which you pasture [animals]
normalizedArabic: هو الذي انزل من السماء ماء لكم منه شراب ومنه شجر فيه تسيمون
normalizedTranslation: it is he who sends down rain from the sky; from it is drink and from it is foliage in which you pasture [animals]

arabic: يُنۢبِتُ لَكُم بِهِ ٱلزَّرۡعَ وَٱلزَّيۡتُونَ وَٱلنَّخِيلَ وَٱلۡأَعۡنَٰبَ وَمِن كُلِّ ٱلثَّمَرَٰتِۚ إِنَّ فِي ذَٰلِكَ لَأٓيَةٗ لِّقَوۡمٖ يَتَفَكَّرُونَ
translation: He causes to grow for you thereby the crops, olives, palm trees, grapevines, and from all the fruits. Indeed in that is a sign for a people who give thought
normalizedArabic: ينبت لكم به الزرع والزيتون والنخيل والاعنب ومن كل الثمرت ان في ذلك لايه لقوم يتفكرون
normalizedTranslation: he causes to grow for you thereby the crops, olives, palm trees, grapevines, and from all the fruits. indeed in that is a sign for a people who give thought

arabic: وَسَخَّرَ لَكُمُ ٱلَّيۡلَ وَٱلنَّهَارَ وَٱلشَّمۡسَ وَٱلۡقَمَرَۖ وَٱلنُّجُومُ مُسَخَّرَٰتُۢ بِأَمۡرِهِۦٓۚ إِنَّ فِي ذَٰلِكَ لَأٓيَٰتٖ لِّقَوۡمٖ يَعۡقِلُونَ
translation: And He has subjected for you the night and day and the sun and moon, and the stars are subjected by His command. Indeed in that are signs for a people who reason
normalizedArabic: وسخر لكم اليل والنهار والشمس والقمر والنجوم مسخرت بامره ان في ذلك لايت لقوم يعقلون
normalizedTranslation: and he has subjected for you the night and day and the sun and moon, and the stars are subjected by his command. indeed in that are signs for a people who reason

arabic: وَمَا ذَرَأَ لَكُمۡ فِي ٱلۡأَرۡضِ مُخۡتَلِفًا أَلۡوَٰنُهُۥٓۚ إِنَّ فِي ذَٰلِكَ لَأٓيَةٗ لِّقَوۡمٖ يَذَّكَّرُونَ
translation: And [He has subjected] whatever He multiplied for you on the earth of varying colors. Indeed in that is a sign for a people who remember
normalizedArabic: وما ذرا لكم في الارض مختلفا الونه ان في ذلك لايه لقوم يذكرون
normalizedTranslation: and [he has subjected] whatever he multiplied for you on the earth of varying colors. indeed in that is a sign for a people who remember

arabic: وَهُوَ ٱلَّذِي سَخَّرَ ٱلۡبَحۡرَ لِتَأۡكُلُواْ مِنۡهُ لَحۡمٗا طَرِيّٗا وَتَسۡتَخۡرِجُواْ مِنۡهُ حِلۡيَةٗ تَلۡبَسُونَهَاۖ وَتَرَى ٱلۡفُلۡكَ مَوَاخِرَ فِيهِ وَلِتَبۡتَغُواْ مِن فَضۡلِهِۦ وَلَعَلَّكُمۡ تَشۡكُرُونَ
translation: And it is He who subjected the sea for you to eat from it tender meat and to extract from it ornaments which you wear. And you see the ships plowing through it, and [He subjected it] that you may seek of His bounty; and perhaps you will be grateful
normalizedArabic: وهو الذي سخر البحر لتاكلوا منه لحما طريا وتستخرجوا منه حليه تلبسونها وتري الفلك مواخر فيه ولتبتغوا من فضله ولعلكم تشكرون
normalizedTranslation: and it is he who subjected the sea for you to eat from it tender meat and to extract from it ornaments which you wear. and you see the ships plowing through it, and [he subjected it] that you may seek of his bounty; and perhaps you will be grateful

arabic: وَأَلۡقَىٰ فِي ٱلۡأَرۡضِ رَوَٰسِيَ أَن تَمِيدَ بِكُمۡ وَأَنۡهَٰرٗا وَسُبُلٗا لَّعَلَّكُمۡ تَهۡتَدُونَ
translation: And He has cast into the earth firmly set mountains, lest it shift with you, and [made] rivers and roads, that you may be guided
normalizedArabic: والقي في الارض روسي ان تميد بكم وانهرا وسبلا لعلكم تهتدون
normalizedTranslation: and he has cast into the earth firmly set mountains, lest it shift with you, and [made] rivers and roads, that you may be guided

arabic: وَعَلَٰمَٰتٖۚ وَبِٱلنَّجۡمِ هُمۡ يَهۡتَدُونَ
translation: And landmarks. And by the stars they are [also] guided
normalizedArabic: وعلمت وبالنجم هم يهتدون
normalizedTranslation: and landmarks. and by the stars they are [also] guided

arabic: أَفَمَن يَخۡلُقُ كَمَن لَّا يَخۡلُقُۚ أَفَلَا تَذَكَّرُونَ
translation: Then is He who creates like one who does not create? So will you not be reminded
normalizedArabic: افمن يخلق كمن لا يخلق افلا تذكرون
normalizedTranslation: then is he who creates like one who does not create? so will you not be reminded

arabic: وَإِن تَعُدُّواْ نِعۡمَةَ ٱللَّهِ لَا تُحۡصُوهَآۗ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ لَغَفُورٞ رَّحِيمٞ
translation: And if you should count the favors of Allah, you could not enumerate them. Indeed, Allah is Forgiving and Merciful
normalizedArabic: وان تعدوا نعمه الله لا تحصوها ان الله لغفور رحيم
normalizedTranslation: and if you should count the favors of allah, you could not enumerate them. indeed, allah is forgiving and merciful

arabic: وَٱللَّهُ يَعۡلَمُ مَا تُسِرُّونَ وَمَا تُعۡلِنُونَ
translation: And Allah knows what you conceal and what you declare
normalizedArabic: والله يعلم ما تسرون وما تعلنون
normalizedTranslation: and allah knows what you conceal and what you declare

arabic: وَٱلَّذِينَ يَدۡعُونَ مِن دُونِ ٱللَّهِ لَا يَخۡلُقُونَ شَيۡـٔٗا وَهُمۡ يُخۡلَقُونَ
translation: And those they invoke other than Allah create nothing, and they [themselves] are created
normalizedArabic: والذين يدعون من دون الله لا يخلقون شيا وهم يخلقون
normalizedTranslation: and those they invoke other than allah create nothing, and they [themselves] are created

arabic: أَمۡوَٰتٌ غَيۡرُ أَحۡيَآءٖۖ وَمَا يَشۡعُرُونَ أَيَّانَ يُبۡعَثُونَ
translation: They are, [in fact], dead, not alive, and they do not perceive when they will be resurrected
normalizedArabic: اموت غير احياء وما يشعرون ايان يبعثون
normalizedTranslation: they are, [in fact], dead, not alive, and they do not perceive when they will be resurrected

arabic: إِلَٰهُكُمۡ إِلَٰهٞ وَٰحِدٞۚ فَٱلَّذِينَ لَا يُؤۡمِنُونَ بِٱلۡأٓخِرَةِ قُلُوبُهُم مُّنكِرَةٞ وَهُم مُّسۡتَكۡبِرُونَ
translation: Your god is one God. But those who do not believe in the Hereafter - their hearts are disapproving, and they are arrogant
normalizedArabic: الهكم اله وحد فالذين لا يومنون بالاخره قلوبهم منكره وهم مستكبرون
normalizedTranslation: your god is one god. but those who do not believe in the hereafter - their hearts are disapproving, and they are arrogant

arabic: لَا جَرَمَ أَنَّ ٱللَّهَ يَعۡلَمُ مَا يُسِرُّونَ وَمَا يُعۡلِنُونَۚ إِنَّهُۥ لَا يُحِبُّ ٱلۡمُسۡتَكۡبِرِينَ
translation: Assuredly, Allah knows what they conceal and what they declare. Indeed, He does not like the arrogant
normalizedArabic: لا جرم ان الله يعلم ما يسرون وما يعلنون انه لا يحب المستكبرين
normalizedTranslation: assuredly, allah knows what they conceal and what they declare. indeed, he does not like the arrogant

arabic: وَإِذَا قِيلَ لَهُم مَّاذَآ أَنزَلَ رَبُّكُمۡ قَالُوٓاْ أَسَٰطِيرُ ٱلۡأَوَّلِينَ
translation: And when it is said to them, "What has your Lord sent down?" They say, "Legends of the former peoples
normalizedArabic: واذا قيل لهم ماذا انزل ربكم قالوا اسطير الاولين
normalizedTranslation: and when it is said to them, "what has your lord sent down?" they say, "legends of the former peoples

arabic: لِيَحۡمِلُوٓاْ أَوۡزَارَهُمۡ كَامِلَةٗ يَوۡمَ ٱلۡقِيَٰمَةِ وَمِنۡ أَوۡزَارِ ٱلَّذِينَ يُضِلُّونَهُم بِغَيۡرِ عِلۡمٍۗ أَلَا سَآءَ مَا يَزِرُونَ
translation: That they may bear their own burdens in full on the Day of Resurrection and some of the burdens of those whom they misguide without knowledge. Unquestionably, evil is that which they bear
normalizedArabic: ليحملوا اوزارهم كامله يوم القيمه ومن اوزار الذين يضلونهم بغير علم الا ساء ما يزرون
normalizedTranslation: that they may bear their own burdens in full on the day of resurrection and some of the burdens of those whom they misguide without knowledge. unquestionably, evil is that which they bear

arabic: قَدۡ مَكَرَ ٱلَّذِينَ مِن قَبۡلِهِمۡ فَأَتَى ٱللَّهُ بُنۡيَٰنَهُم مِّنَ ٱلۡقَوَاعِدِ فَخَرَّ عَلَيۡهِمُ ٱلسَّقۡفُ مِن فَوۡقِهِمۡ وَأَتَىٰهُمُ ٱلۡعَذَابُ مِنۡ حَيۡثُ لَا يَشۡعُرُونَ
translation: Those before them had already plotted, but Allah came at their building from the foundations, so the roof fell upon them from above them, and the punishment came to them from where they did not perceive
normalizedArabic: قد مكر الذين من قبلهم فاتي الله بنينهم من القواعد فخر عليهم السقف من فوقهم واتيهم العذاب من حيث لا يشعرون
normalizedTranslation: those before them had already plotted, but allah came at their building from the foundations, so the roof fell upon them from above them, and the punishment came to them from where they did not perceive

arabic: ثُمَّ يَوۡمَ ٱلۡقِيَٰمَةِ يُخۡزِيهِمۡ وَيَقُولُ أَيۡنَ شُرَكَآءِيَ ٱلَّذِينَ كُنتُمۡ تُشَـٰٓقُّونَ فِيهِمۡۚ قَالَ ٱلَّذِينَ أُوتُواْ ٱلۡعِلۡمَ إِنَّ ٱلۡخِزۡيَ ٱلۡيَوۡمَ وَٱلسُّوٓءَ عَلَى ٱلۡكَٰفِرِينَ
translation: Then on the Day of Resurrection He will disgrace them and say, "Where are My 'partners' for whom you used to oppose [the believers]?" Those who were given knowledge will say, "Indeed disgrace, this Day, and evil are upon the disbelievers
normalizedArabic: ثم يوم القيمه يخزيهم ويقول اين شركاءي الذين كنتم تشقون فيهم قال الذين اوتوا العلم ان الخزي اليوم والسوء علي الكفرين
normalizedTranslation: then on the day of resurrection he will disgrace them and say, "where are my 'partners' for whom you used to oppose [the believers]?" those who were given knowledge will say, "indeed disgrace, this day, and evil are upon the disbelievers

arabic: ٱلَّذِينَ تَتَوَفَّىٰهُمُ ٱلۡمَلَـٰٓئِكَةُ ظَالِمِيٓ أَنفُسِهِمۡۖ فَأَلۡقَوُاْ ٱلسَّلَمَ مَا كُنَّا نَعۡمَلُ مِن سُوٓءِۭۚ بَلَىٰٓۚ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ عَلِيمُۢ بِمَا كُنتُمۡ تَعۡمَلُونَ
translation: The ones whom the angels take in death [while] wronging themselves, and [who] then offer submission, [saying], "We were not doing any evil." But, yes! Indeed, Allah is Knowing of what you used to do
normalizedArabic: الذين تتوفيهم المليكه ظالمي انفسهم فالقوا السلم ما كنا نعمل من سوء بلي ان الله عليم بما كنتم تعملون
normalizedTranslation: the ones whom the angels take in death [while] wronging themselves, and [who] then offer submission, [saying], "we were not doing any evil." but, yes! indeed, allah is knowing of what you used to do

arabic: فَٱدۡخُلُوٓاْ أَبۡوَٰبَ جَهَنَّمَ خَٰلِدِينَ فِيهَاۖ فَلَبِئۡسَ مَثۡوَى ٱلۡمُتَكَبِّرِينَ
translation: So enter the gates of Hell to abide eternally therein, and how wretched is the residence of the arrogant
normalizedArabic: فادخلوا ابوب جهنم خلدين فيها فلبيس مثوي المتكبرين
normalizedTranslation: so enter the gates of hell to abide eternally therein, and how wretched is the residence of the arrogant

arabic: ۞وَقِيلَ لِلَّذِينَ ٱتَّقَوۡاْ مَاذَآ أَنزَلَ رَبُّكُمۡۚ قَالُواْ خَيۡرٗاۗ لِّلَّذِينَ أَحۡسَنُواْ فِي هَٰذِهِ ٱلدُّنۡيَا حَسَنَةٞۚ وَلَدَارُ ٱلۡأٓخِرَةِ خَيۡرٞۚ وَلَنِعۡمَ دَارُ ٱلۡمُتَّقِينَ
translation: And it will be said to those who feared Allah, "What did your Lord send down?" They will say, "[That which is] good." For those who do good in this world is good; and the home of the Hereafter is better. And how excellent is the home of the righteous

normalizedTranslation: and it will be said to those who feared allah, "what did your lord send down?" they will say, "[that which is] good." for those who do good in this world is good; and the home of the hereafter is better. and how excellent is the home of the righteous

arabic: جَنَّـٰتُ عَدۡنٖ يَدۡخُلُونَهَا تَجۡرِي مِن تَحۡتِهَا ٱلۡأَنۡهَٰرُۖ لَهُمۡ فِيهَا مَا يَشَآءُونَۚ كَذَٰلِكَ يَجۡزِي ٱللَّهُ ٱلۡمُتَّقِينَ
translation: Gardens of perpetual residence, which they will enter, beneath which rivers flow. They will have therein whatever they wish. Thus does Allah reward the righteous
normalizedArabic: جنت عدن يدخلونها تجري من تحتها الانهر لهم فيها ما يشاءون كذلك يجزي الله المتقين
normalizedTranslation: gardens of perpetual residence, which they will enter, beneath which rivers flow. they will have therein whatever they wish. thus does allah reward the righteous

arabic: ٱلَّذِينَ تَتَوَفَّىٰهُمُ ٱلۡمَلَـٰٓئِكَةُ طَيِّبِينَ يَقُولُونَ سَلَٰمٌ عَلَيۡكُمُ ٱدۡخُلُواْ ٱلۡجَنَّةَ بِمَا كُنتُمۡ تَعۡمَلُونَ
translation: The ones whom the angels take in death, [being] good and pure; [the angels] will say, "Peace be upon you. Enter Paradise for what you used to do

normalizedTranslation: the ones whom the angels take in death, [being] good and pure; [the angels] will say, "peace be upon you. enter paradise for what you used to do

arabic: هَلۡ يَنظُرُونَ إِلَّآ أَن تَأۡتِيَهُمُ ٱلۡمَلَـٰٓئِكَةُ أَوۡ يَأۡتِيَ أَمۡرُ رَبِّكَۚ كَذَٰلِكَ فَعَلَ ٱلَّذِينَ مِن قَبۡلِهِمۡۚ وَمَا ظَلَمَهُمُ ٱللَّهُ وَلَٰكِن كَانُوٓاْ أَنفُسَهُمۡ يَظۡلِمُونَ
translation: Do the disbelievers await [anything] except that the angels should come to them or there comes the command of your Lord? Thus did those do before them. And Allah wronged them not, but they had been wronging themselves

normalizedTranslation: do the disbelievers await [anything] except that the angels should come to them or there comes the command of your lord? thus did those do before them. and allah wronged them not, but they had been wronging themselves

arabic: فَأَصَابَهُمۡ سَيِّـَٔاتُ مَا عَمِلُواْ وَحَاقَ بِهِم مَّا كَانُواْ بِهِۦ يَسۡتَهۡزِءُونَ
translation: So they were struck by the evil consequences of what they did and were enveloped by what they used to ridicule

normalizedTranslation: so they were struck by the evil consequences of what they did and were enveloped by what they used to ridicule

arabic: وَقَالَ ٱلَّذِينَ أَشۡرَكُواْ لَوۡ شَآءَ ٱللَّهُ مَا عَبَدۡنَا مِن دُونِهِۦ مِن شَيۡءٖ نَّحۡنُ وَلَآ ءَابَآؤُنَا وَلَا حَرَّمۡنَا مِن دُونِهِۦ مِن شَيۡءٖۚ كَذَٰلِكَ فَعَلَ ٱلَّذِينَ مِن قَبۡلِهِمۡۚ فَهَلۡ عَلَى ٱلرُّسُلِ إِلَّا ٱلۡبَلَٰغُ ٱلۡمُبِينُ
translation: And those who associate others with Allah say, "If Allah had willed, we would not have worshipped anything other than Him, neither we nor our fathers, nor would we have forbidden anything through other than Him." Thus did those do before them. So is there upon the messengers except [the duty of] clear notification
normalizedArabic: وقال الذين اشركوا لو شاء الله ما عبدنا من دونه من شيء نحن ولا ءاباونا ولا حرمنا من دونه من شيء كذلك فعل الذين من قبلهم فهل علي الرسل الا البلغ المبين
normalizedTranslation: and those who associate others with allah say, "if allah had willed, we would not have worshipped anything other than him, neither we nor our fathers, nor would we have forbidden anything through other than him." thus did those do before them. so is there upon the messengers except [the duty of] clear notification

arabic: وَلَقَدۡ بَعَثۡنَا فِي كُلِّ أُمَّةٖ رَّسُولًا أَنِ ٱعۡبُدُواْ ٱللَّهَ وَٱجۡتَنِبُواْ ٱلطَّـٰغُوتَۖ فَمِنۡهُم مَّنۡ هَدَى ٱللَّهُ وَمِنۡهُم مَّنۡ حَقَّتۡ عَلَيۡهِ ٱلضَّلَٰلَةُۚ فَسِيرُواْ فِي ٱلۡأَرۡضِ فَٱنظُرُواْ كَيۡفَ كَانَ عَٰقِبَةُ ٱلۡمُكَذِّبِينَ
translation: And We certainly sent into every nation a messenger, [saying], "Worship Allah and avoid Taghut." And among them were those whom Allah guided, and among them were those upon whom error was [deservedly] decreed. So proceed through the earth and observe how was the end of the deniers
normalizedArabic: ولقد بعثنا في كل امه رسولا ان اعبدوا الله واجتنبوا الطغوت فمنهم من هدي الله ومنهم من حقت عليه الضلله فسيروا في الارض فانظروا كيف كان عقبه المكذبين
normalizedTranslation: and we certainly sent into every nation a messenger, [saying], "worship allah and avoid taghut." and among them were those whom allah guided, and among them were those upon whom error was [deservedly] decreed. so proceed through the earth and observe how was the end of the deniers

arabic: إِن تَحۡرِصۡ عَلَىٰ هُدَىٰهُمۡ فَإِنَّ ٱللَّهَ لَا يَهۡدِي مَن يُضِلُّۖ وَمَا لَهُم مِّن نَّـٰصِرِينَ
translation: [Even] if you should strive for their guidance, [O Muhammad], indeed, Allah does not guide those He sends astray, and they will have no helpers
normalizedArabic: ان تحرص علي هديهم فان الله لا يهدي من يضل وما لهم من نصرين
normalizedTranslation: [even] if you should strive for their guidance, [o muhammad], indeed, allah does not guide those he sends astray, and they will have no helpers

arabic: وَأَقۡسَمُواْ بِٱللَّهِ جَهۡدَ أَيۡمَٰنِهِمۡ لَا يَبۡعَثُ ٱللَّهُ مَن يَمُوتُۚ بَلَىٰ وَعۡدًا عَلَيۡهِ حَقّٗا وَلَٰكِنَّ أَكۡثَرَ ٱلنَّاسِ لَا يَعۡلَمُونَ
translation: And they swear by Allah their strongest oaths [that] Allah will not resurrect one who dies. But yes - [it is] a true promise [binding] upon Him, but most of the people do not know
normalizedArabic: واقسموا بالله جهد ايمنهم لا يبعث الله من يموت بلي وعدا عليه حقا ولكن اكثر الناس لا يعلمون
normalizedTranslation: and they swear by allah their strongest oaths [that] allah will not resurrect one who dies. but yes - [it is] a true promise [binding] upon him, but most of the people do not know

arabic: لِيُبَيِّنَ لَهُمُ ٱلَّذِي يَخۡتَلِفُونَ فِيهِ وَلِيَعۡلَمَ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوٓاْ أَنَّهُمۡ كَانُواْ كَٰذِبِينَ
translation: [It is] so He will make clear to them [the truth of] that wherein they differ and so those who have disbelieved may know that they were liars
normalizedArabic: ليبين لهم الذي يختلفون فيه وليعلم الذين كفروا انهم كانوا كذبين
normalizedTranslation: [it is] so he will make clear to them [the truth of] that wherein they differ and so those who have disbelieved may know that they were liars

arabic: إِنَّمَا قَوۡلُنَا لِشَيۡءٍ إِذَآ أَرَدۡنَٰهُ أَن نَّقُولَ لَهُۥ كُن فَيَكُونُ
translation: Indeed, Our word to a thing when We intend it is but that We say to it, "Be," and it is

normalizedTranslation: indeed, our word to a thing when we intend it is but that we say to it, "be," and it is

arabic: وَٱلَّذِينَ هَاجَرُواْ فِي ٱللَّهِ مِنۢ بَعۡدِ مَا ظُلِمُواْ لَنُبَوِّئَنَّهُمۡ فِي ٱلدُّنۡيَا حَسَنَةٗۖ وَلَأَجۡرُ ٱلۡأٓخِرَةِ أَكۡبَرُۚ لَوۡ كَانُواْ يَعۡلَمُونَ
translation: And those who emigrated for [the cause of] Allah after they had been wronged - We will surely settle them in this world in a good place; but the reward of the Hereafter is greater, if only they could know
normalizedArabic: والذين هاجروا في الله من بعد ما ظلموا لنبوينهم في الدنيا حسنه ولاجر الاخره اكبر لو كانوا يعلمون
normalizedTranslation: and those who emigrated for [the cause of] allah after they had been wronged - we will surely settle them in this world in a good place; but the reward of the hereafter is greater, if only they could know

arabic: ٱلَّذِينَ صَبَرُواْ وَعَلَىٰ رَبِّهِمۡ يَتَوَكَّلُونَ
translation: [They are] those who endured patiently and upon their Lord relied
normalizedArabic: الذين صبروا وعلي ربهم يتوكلون
normalizedTranslation: [they are] those who endured patiently and upon their lord relied

arabic: وَمَآ أَرۡسَلۡنَا مِن قَبۡلِكَ إِلَّا رِجَالٗا نُّوحِيٓ إِلَيۡهِمۡۖ فَسۡـَٔلُوٓاْ أَهۡلَ ٱلذِّكۡرِ إِن كُنتُمۡ لَا تَعۡلَمُونَ
translation: And We sent not before you except men to whom We revealed [Our message]. So ask the people of the message if you do not know
