normalizedTranslation: and we sent not before you except men to whom we revealed [our message]. so ask the people of the message if you do not know

arabic: بِٱلۡبَيِّنَٰتِ وَٱلزُّبُرِۗ وَأَنزَلۡنَآ إِلَيۡكَ ٱلذِّكۡرَ لِتُبَيِّنَ لِلنَّاسِ مَا نُزِّلَ إِلَيۡهِمۡ وَلَعَلَّهُمۡ يَتَفَكَّرُونَ
translation: [We sent them] with clear proofs and written ordinances. And We revealed to you the message that you may make clear to the people what was sent down to them and that they might give thought
normalizedArabic: بالبينت والزبر وانزلنا اليك الذكر لتبين للناس ما نزل اليهم ولعلهم يتفكرون
normalizedTranslation: [we sent them] with clear proofs and written ordinances. and we revealed to you the message that you may make clear to the people what was sent down to them and that they might give thought

arabic: أَفَأَمِنَ ٱلَّذِينَ مَكَرُواْ ٱلسَّيِّـَٔاتِ أَن يَخۡسِفَ ٱللَّهُ بِهِمُ ٱلۡأَرۡضَ أَوۡ يَأۡتِيَهُمُ ٱلۡعَذَابُ مِنۡ حَيۡثُ لَا يَشۡعُرُونَ
translation: Then, do those who have planned evil deeds feel secure that Allah will not cause the earth to swallow them or that the punishment will not come upon them from where they do not perceive
normalizedArabic: افامن الذين مكروا السيات ان يخسف الله بهم الارض او ياتيهم العذاب من حيث لا يشعرون
normalizedTranslation: then, do those who have planned evil deeds feel secure that allah will not cause the earth to swallow them or that the punishment will not come upon them from where they do not perceive

arabic: أَوۡ يَأۡخُذَهُمۡ فِي تَقَلُّبِهِمۡ فَمَا هُم بِمُعۡجِزِينَ
translation: Or that He would not seize them during their [usual] activity, and they could not cause failure
normalizedArabic: او ياخذهم في تقلبهم فما هم بمعجزين
normalizedTranslation: or that he would not seize them during their [usual] activity, and they could not cause failure

arabic: أَوۡ يَأۡخُذَهُمۡ عَلَىٰ تَخَوُّفٖ فَإِنَّ رَبَّكُمۡ لَرَءُوفٞ رَّحِيمٌ
translation: Or that He would not seize them gradually [in a state of dread]? But indeed, your Lord is Kind and Merciful
normalizedArabic: او ياخذهم علي تخوف فان ربكم لرءوف رحيم
normalizedTranslation: or that he would not seize them gradually [in a state of dread]? but indeed, your lord is kind and merciful

arabic: أَوَلَمۡ يَرَوۡاْ إِلَىٰ مَا خَلَقَ ٱللَّهُ مِن شَيۡءٖ يَتَفَيَّؤُاْ ظِلَٰلُهُۥ عَنِ ٱلۡيَمِينِ وَٱلشَّمَآئِلِ سُجَّدٗا لِّلَّهِ وَهُمۡ دَٰخِرُونَ
translation: Have they not considered what things Allah has created? Their shadows incline to the right and to the left, prostrating to Allah, while they are humble
normalizedArabic: اولم يروا الي ما خلق الله من شيء يتفيوا ظلله عن اليمين والشمايل سجدا لله وهم دخرون
normalizedTranslation: have they not considered what things allah has created? their shadows incline to the right and to the left, prostrating to allah, while they are humble

arabic: وَلِلَّهِۤ يَسۡجُدُۤ مَا فِي ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَمَا فِي ٱلۡأَرۡضِ مِن دَآبَّةٖ وَٱلۡمَلَـٰٓئِكَةُ وَهُمۡ لَا يَسۡتَكۡبِرُونَ
translation: And to Allah prostrates whatever is in the heavens and whatever is on the earth of creatures, and the angels [as well], and they are not arrogant
normalizedArabic: ولله يسجد ما في السموت وما في الارض من دابه والمليكه وهم لا يستكبرون
normalizedTranslation: and to allah prostrates whatever is in the heavens and whatever is on the earth of creatures, and the angels [as well], and they are not arrogant

arabic: يَخَافُونَ رَبَّهُم مِّن فَوۡقِهِمۡ وَيَفۡعَلُونَ مَا يُؤۡمَرُونَ۩
translation: They fear their Lord above them, and they do what they are commanded
normalizedArabic: يخافون ربهم من فوقهم ويفعلون ما يومرون
normalizedTranslation: they fear their lord above them, and they do what they are commanded

arabic: ۞وَقَالَ ٱللَّهُ لَا تَتَّخِذُوٓاْ إِلَٰهَيۡنِ ٱثۡنَيۡنِۖ إِنَّمَا هُوَ إِلَٰهٞ وَٰحِدٞ فَإِيَّـٰيَ فَٱرۡهَبُونِ
translation: And Allah has said, "Do not take for yourselves two deities. He is but one God, so fear only Me
normalizedArabic: وقال الله لا تتخذوا الهين اثنين انما هو اله وحد فايي فارهبون
normalizedTranslation: and allah has said, "do not take for yourselves two deities. he is but one god, so fear only me

arabic: وَلَهُۥ مَا فِي ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلۡأَرۡضِ وَلَهُ ٱلدِّينُ وَاصِبًاۚ أَفَغَيۡرَ ٱللَّهِ تَتَّقُونَ
translation: And to Him belongs whatever is in the heavens and the earth, and to Him is [due] worship constantly. Then is it other than Allah that you fear
normalizedArabic: وله ما في السموت والارض وله الدين واصبا افغير الله تتقون
normalizedTranslation: and to him belongs whatever is in the heavens and the earth, and to him is [due] worship constantly. then is it other than allah that you fear

arabic: وَمَا بِكُم مِّن نِّعۡمَةٖ فَمِنَ ٱللَّهِۖ ثُمَّ إِذَا مَسَّكُمُ ٱلضُّرُّ فَإِلَيۡهِ تَجۡـَٔرُونَ
translation: And whatever you have of favor - it is from Allah. Then when adversity touches you, to Him you cry for help
normalizedArabic: وما بكم من نعمه فمن الله ثم اذا مسكم الضر فاليه تجرون
normalizedTranslation: and whatever you have of favor - it is from allah. then when adversity touches you, to him you cry for help

arabic: ثُمَّ إِذَا كَشَفَ ٱلضُّرَّ عَنكُمۡ إِذَا فَرِيقٞ مِّنكُم بِرَبِّهِمۡ يُشۡرِكُونَ
translation: Then when He removes the adversity from you, at once a party of you associates others with their Lord
normalizedArabic: ثم اذا كشف الضر عنكم اذا فريق منكم بربهم يشركون
normalizedTranslation: then when he removes the adversity from you, at once a party of you associates others with their lord

arabic: لِيَكۡفُرُواْ بِمَآ ءَاتَيۡنَٰهُمۡۚ فَتَمَتَّعُواْ فَسَوۡفَ تَعۡلَمُونَ
translation: So they will deny what We have given them. Then enjoy yourselves, for you are going to know
normalizedArabic: ليكفروا بما ءاتينهم فتمتعوا فسوف تعلمون
normalizedTranslation: so they will deny what we have given them. then enjoy yourselves, for you are going to know

arabic: وَيَجۡعَلُونَ لِمَا لَا يَعۡلَمُونَ نَصِيبٗا مِّمَّا رَزَقۡنَٰهُمۡۗ تَٱللَّهِ لَتُسۡـَٔلُنَّ عَمَّا كُنتُمۡ تَفۡتَرُونَ
translation: And they assign to what they do not know a portion of that which We have provided them. By Allah, you will surely be questioned about what you used to invent
normalizedArabic: ويجعلون لما لا يعلمون نصيبا مما رزقنهم تالله لتسلن عما كنتم تفترون
normalizedTranslation: and they assign to what they do not know a portion of that which we have provided them. by allah, you will surely be questioned about what you used to invent

arabic: وَيَجۡعَلُونَ لِلَّهِ ٱلۡبَنَٰتِ سُبۡحَٰنَهُۥ وَلَهُم مَّا يَشۡتَهُونَ
translation: And they attribute to Allah daughters - exalted is He - and for them is what they desire
normalizedArabic: ويجعلون لله البنت سبحنه ولهم ما يشتهون
normalizedTranslation: and they attribute to allah daughters - exalted is he - and for them is what they desire

arabic: وَإِذَا بُشِّرَ أَحَدُهُم بِٱلۡأُنثَىٰ ظَلَّ وَجۡهُهُۥ مُسۡوَدّٗا وَهُوَ كَظِيمٞ
translation: And when one of them is informed of [the birth of] a female, his face becomes dark, and he suppresses grief
normalizedArabic: واذا بشر احدهم بالانثي ظل وجهه مسودا وهو كظيم
normalizedTranslation: and when one of them is informed of [the birth of] a female, his face becomes dark, and he suppresses grief

arabic: يَتَوَٰرَىٰ مِنَ ٱلۡقَوۡمِ مِن سُوٓءِ مَا بُشِّرَ بِهِۦٓۚ أَيُمۡسِكُهُۥ عَلَىٰ هُونٍ أَمۡ يَدُسُّهُۥ فِي ٱلتُّرَابِۗ أَلَا سَآءَ مَا يَحۡكُمُونَ
translation: He hides himself from the people because of the ill of which he has been informed. Should he keep it in humiliation or bury it in the ground? Unquestionably, evil is what they decide
normalizedArabic: يتوري من القوم من سوء ما بشر به ايمسكه علي هون ام يدسه في التراب الا ساء ما يحكمون
normalizedTranslation: he hides himself from the people because of the ill of which he has been informed. should he keep it in humiliation or bury it in the ground? unquestionably, evil is what they decide

arabic: لِلَّذِينَ لَا يُؤۡمِنُونَ بِٱلۡأٓخِرَةِ مَثَلُ ٱلسَّوۡءِۖ وَلِلَّهِ ٱلۡمَثَلُ ٱلۡأَعۡلَىٰۚ وَهُوَ ٱلۡعَزِيزُ ٱلۡحَكِيمُ
translation: For those who do not believe in the Hereafter is the description of evil; and for Allah is the highest attribute. And He is Exalted in Might, the Wise
normalizedArabic: للذين لا يومنون بالاخره مثل السوء ولله المثل الاعلي وهو العزيز الحكيم
normalizedTranslation: for those who do not believe in the hereafter is the description of evil; and for allah is the highest attribute. and he is exalted in might, the wise

arabic: وَلَوۡ يُؤَاخِذُ ٱللَّهُ ٱلنَّاسَ بِظُلۡمِهِم مَّا تَرَكَ عَلَيۡهَا مِن دَآبَّةٖ وَلَٰكِن يُؤَخِّرُهُمۡ إِلَىٰٓ أَجَلٖ مُّسَمّٗىۖ فَإِذَا جَآءَ أَجَلُهُمۡ لَا يَسۡتَـٔۡخِرُونَ سَاعَةٗ وَلَا يَسۡتَقۡدِمُونَ
translation: And if Allah were to impose blame on the people for their wrongdoing, He would not have left upon the earth any creature, but He defers them for a specified term. And when their term has come, they will not remain behind an hour, nor will they precede [it]
normalizedArabic: ولو يواخذ الله الناس بظلمهم ما ترك عليها من دابه ولكن يوخرهم الي اجل مسمي فاذا جاء اجلهم لا يستخرون ساعه ولا يستقدمون
normalizedTranslation: and if allah were to impose blame on the people for their wrongdoing, he would not have left upon the earth any creature, but he defers them for a specified term. and when their term has come, they will not remain behind an hour, nor will they precede [it]

arabic: وَيَجۡعَلُونَ لِلَّهِ مَا يَكۡرَهُونَۚ وَتَصِفُ أَلۡسِنَتُهُمُ ٱلۡكَذِبَ أَنَّ لَهُمُ ٱلۡحُسۡنَىٰۚ لَا جَرَمَ أَنَّ لَهُمُ ٱلنَّارَ وَأَنَّهُم مُّفۡرَطُونَ
translation: And they attribute to Allah that which they dislike, and their tongues assert the lie that they will have the best [from Him]. Assuredly, they will have the Fire, and they will be [therein] neglected
normalizedArabic: ويجعلون لله ما يكرهون وتصف السنتهم الكذب ان لهم الحسني لا جرم ان لهم النار وانهم مفرطون
normalizedTranslation: and they attribute to allah that which they dislike, and their tongues assert the lie that they will have the best [from him]. assuredly, they will have the fire, and they will be [therein] neglected

arabic: تَٱللَّهِ لَقَدۡ أَرۡسَلۡنَآ إِلَىٰٓ أُمَمٖ مِّن قَبۡلِكَ فَزَيَّنَ لَهُمُ ٱلشَّيۡطَٰنُ أَعۡمَٰلَهُمۡ فَهُوَ وَلِيُّهُمُ ٱلۡيَوۡمَ وَلَهُمۡ عَذَابٌ أَلِيمٞ
translation: By Allah, We did certainly send [messengers] to nations before you, but Satan made their deeds attractive to them. And he is the disbelievers' ally today [as well], and they will have a painful punishment
normalizedArabic: تالله لقد ارسلنا الي امم من قبلك فزين لهم الشيطن اعملهم فهو وليهم اليوم ولهم عذاب اليم
normalizedTranslation: by allah, we did certainly send [messengers] to nations before you, but satan made their deeds attractive to them. and he is the disbelievers' ally today [as well], and they will have a painful punishment

arabic: وَمَآ أَنزَلۡنَا عَلَيۡكَ ٱلۡكِتَٰبَ إِلَّا لِتُبَيِّنَ لَهُمُ ٱلَّذِي ٱخۡتَلَفُواْ فِيهِ وَهُدٗى وَرَحۡمَةٗ لِّقَوۡمٖ يُؤۡمِنُونَ
translation: And We have not revealed to you the Book, [O Muhammad], except for you to make clear to them that wherein they have differed and as guidance and mercy for a people who believe
normalizedArabic: وما انزلنا عليك الكتب الا لتبين لهم الذي اختلفوا فيه وهدي ورحمه لقوم يومنون
normalizedTranslation: and we have not revealed to you the book, [o muhammad], except for you to make clear to them that wherein they have differed and as guidance and mercy for a people who believe

arabic: وَٱللَّهُ أَنزَلَ مِنَ ٱلسَّمَآءِ مَآءٗ فَأَحۡيَا بِهِ ٱلۡأَرۡضَ بَعۡدَ مَوۡتِهَآۚ إِنَّ فِي ذَٰلِكَ لَأٓيَةٗ لِّقَوۡمٖ يَسۡمَعُونَ
translation: And Allah has sent down rain from the sky and given life thereby to the earth after its lifelessness. Indeed in that is a sign for a people who listen
normalizedArabic: والله انزل من السماء ماء فاحيا به الارض بعد موتها ان في ذلك لايه لقوم يسمعون
normalizedTranslation: and allah has sent down rain from the sky and given life thereby to the earth after its lifelessness. indeed in that is a sign for a people who listen

arabic: وَإِنَّ لَكُمۡ فِي ٱلۡأَنۡعَٰمِ لَعِبۡرَةٗۖ نُّسۡقِيكُم مِّمَّا فِي بُطُونِهِۦ مِنۢ بَيۡنِ فَرۡثٖ وَدَمٖ لَّبَنًا خَالِصٗا سَآئِغٗا لِّلشَّـٰرِبِينَ
translation: And indeed, for you in grazing livestock is a lesson. We give you drink from what is in their bellies - between excretion and blood - pure milk, palatable to drinkers
normalizedArabic: وان لكم في الانعم لعبره نسقيكم مما في بطونه من بين فرث ودم لبنا خالصا سايغا للشربين
normalizedTranslation: and indeed, for you in grazing livestock is a lesson. we give you drink from what is in their bellies - between excretion and blood - pure milk, palatable to drinkers

arabic: وَمِن ثَمَرَٰتِ ٱلنَّخِيلِ وَٱلۡأَعۡنَٰبِ تَتَّخِذُونَ مِنۡهُ سَكَرٗا وَرِزۡقًا حَسَنًاۚ إِنَّ فِي ذَٰلِكَ لَأٓيَةٗ لِّقَوۡمٖ يَعۡقِلُونَ
translation: And from the fruits of the palm trees and grapevines you take intoxicant and good provision. Indeed in that is a sign for a people who reason
normalizedArabic: ومن ثمرت النخيل والاعنب تتخذون منه سكرا ورزقا حسنا ان في ذلك لايه لقوم يعقلون
normalizedTranslation: and from the fruits of the palm trees and grapevines you take intoxicant and good provision. indeed in that is a sign for a people who reason

arabic: وَأَوۡحَىٰ رَبُّكَ إِلَى ٱلنَّحۡلِ أَنِ ٱتَّخِذِي مِنَ ٱلۡجِبَالِ بُيُوتٗا وَمِنَ ٱلشَّجَرِ وَمِمَّا يَعۡرِشُونَ
translation: And your Lord inspired to the bee, "Take for yourself among the mountains, houses, and among the trees and [in] that which they construct
normalizedArabic: واوحي ربك الي النحل ان اتخذي من الجبال بيوتا ومن الشجر ومما يعرشون
normalizedTranslation: and your lord inspired to the bee, "take for yourself among the mountains, houses, and among the trees and [in] that which they construct

arabic: ثُمَّ كُلِي مِن كُلِّ ٱلثَّمَرَٰتِ فَٱسۡلُكِي سُبُلَ رَبِّكِ ذُلُلٗاۚ يَخۡرُجُ مِنۢ بُطُونِهَا شَرَابٞ مُّخۡتَلِفٌ أَلۡوَٰنُهُۥ فِيهِ شِفَآءٞ لِّلنَّاسِۚ إِنَّ فِي ذَٰلِكَ لَأٓيَةٗ لِّقَوۡمٖ يَتَفَكَّرُونَ
translation: Then eat from all the fruits and follow the ways of your Lord laid down [for you]." There emerges from their bellies a drink, varying in colors, in which there is healing for people. Indeed in that is a sign for a people who give thought
normalizedArabic: ثم كلي من كل الثمرت فاسلكي سبل ربك ذللا يخرج من بطونها شراب مختلف الونه فيه شفاء للناس ان في ذلك لايه لقوم يتفكرون
normalizedTranslation: then eat from all the fruits and follow the ways of your lord laid down [for you]." there emerges from their bellies a drink, varying in colors, in which there is healing for people. indeed in that is a sign for a people who give thought

arabic: وَٱللَّهُ خَلَقَكُمۡ ثُمَّ يَتَوَفَّىٰكُمۡۚ وَمِنكُم مَّن يُرَدُّ إِلَىٰٓ أَرۡذَلِ ٱلۡعُمُرِ لِكَيۡ لَا يَعۡلَمَ بَعۡدَ عِلۡمٖ شَيۡـًٔاۚ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ عَلِيمٞ قَدِيرٞ
translation: And Allah created you; then He will take you in death. And among you is he who is reversed to the most decrepit [old] age so that he will not know, after [having had] knowledge, a thing. Indeed, Allah is Knowing and Competent
normalizedArabic: والله خلقكم ثم يتوفيكم ومنكم من يرد الي ارذل العمر لكي لا يعلم بعد علم شيا ان الله عليم قدير
normalizedTranslation: and allah created you; then he will take you in death. and among you is he who is reversed to the most decrepit [old] age so that he will not know, after [having had] knowledge, a thing. indeed, allah is knowing and competent

arabic: وَٱللَّهُ فَضَّلَ بَعۡضَكُمۡ عَلَىٰ بَعۡضٖ فِي ٱلرِّزۡقِۚ فَمَا ٱلَّذِينَ فُضِّلُواْ بِرَآدِّي رِزۡقِهِمۡ عَلَىٰ مَا مَلَكَتۡ أَيۡمَٰنُهُمۡ فَهُمۡ فِيهِ سَوَآءٌۚ أَفَبِنِعۡمَةِ ٱللَّهِ يَجۡحَدُونَ
translation: And Allah has favored some of you over others in provision. But those who were favored would not hand over their provision to those whom their right hands possess so they would be equal to them therein. Then is it the favor of Allah they reject
normalizedArabic: والله فضل بعضكم علي بعض في الرزق فما الذين فضلوا برادي رزقهم علي ما ملكت ايمنهم فهم فيه سواء افبنعمه الله يجحدون
normalizedTranslation: and allah has favored some of you over others in provision. but those who were favored would not hand over their provision to those whom their right hands possess so they would be equal to them therein. then is it the favor of allah they reject

arabic: وَٱللَّهُ جَعَلَ لَكُم مِّنۡ أَنفُسِكُمۡ أَزۡوَٰجٗا وَجَعَلَ لَكُم مِّنۡ أَزۡوَٰجِكُم بَنِينَ وَحَفَدَةٗ وَرَزَقَكُم مِّنَ ٱلطَّيِّبَٰتِۚ أَفَبِٱلۡبَٰطِلِ يُؤۡمِنُونَ وَبِنِعۡمَتِ ٱللَّهِ هُمۡ يَكۡفُرُونَ
translation: And Allah has made for you from yourselves mates and has made for you from your mates sons and grandchildren and has provided for you from the good things. Then in falsehood do they believe and in the favor of Allah they disbelieve
normalizedArabic: والله جعل لكم من انفسكم ازوجا وجعل لكم من ازوجكم بنين وحفده ورزقكم من الطيبت افبالبطل يومنون وبنعمت الله هم يكفرون
normalizedTranslation: and allah has made for you from yourselves mates and has made for you from your mates sons and grandchildren and has provided for you from the good things. then in falsehood do they believe and in the favor of allah they disbelieve

arabic: وَيَعۡبُدُونَ مِن دُونِ ٱللَّهِ مَا لَا يَمۡلِكُ لَهُمۡ رِزۡقٗا مِّنَ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلۡأَرۡضِ شَيۡـٔٗا وَلَا يَسۡتَطِيعُونَ
translation: And they worship besides Allah that which does not possess for them [the power of] provision from the heavens and the earth at all, and [in fact], they are unable
normalizedArabic: ويعبدون من دون الله ما لا يملك لهم رزقا من السموت والارض شيا ولا يستطيعون
normalizedTranslation: and they worship besides allah that which does not possess for them [the power of] provision from the heavens and the earth at all, and [in fact], they are unable

arabic: فَلَا تَضۡرِبُواْ لِلَّهِ ٱلۡأَمۡثَالَۚ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ يَعۡلَمُ وَأَنتُمۡ لَا تَعۡلَمُونَ
translation: So do not assert similarities to Allah. Indeed, Allah knows and you do not know
normalizedArabic: فلا تضربوا لله الامثال ان الله يعلم وانتم لا تعلمون
normalizedTranslation: so do not assert similarities to allah. indeed, allah knows and you do not know

arabic: ۞ضَرَبَ ٱللَّهُ مَثَلًا عَبۡدٗا مَّمۡلُوكٗا لَّا يَقۡدِرُ عَلَىٰ شَيۡءٖ وَمَن رَّزَقۡنَٰهُ مِنَّا رِزۡقًا حَسَنٗا فَهُوَ يُنفِقُ مِنۡهُ سِرّٗا وَجَهۡرًاۖ هَلۡ يَسۡتَوُۥنَۚ ٱلۡحَمۡدُ لِلَّهِۚ بَلۡ أَكۡثَرُهُمۡ لَا يَعۡلَمُونَ
translation: Allah presents an example: a slave [who is] owned and unable to do a thing and he to whom We have provided from Us good provision, so he spends from it secretly and publicly. Can they be equal? Praise to Allah! But most of them do not know
normalizedArabic: ضرب الله مثلا عبدا مملوكا لا يقدر علي شيء ومن رزقنه منا رزقا حسنا فهو ينفق منه سرا وجهرا هل يستون الحمد لله بل اكثرهم لا يعلمون
normalizedTranslation: allah presents an example: a slave [who is] owned and unable to do a thing and he to whom we have provided from us good provision, so he spends from it secretly and publicly. can they be equal? praise to allah! but most of them do not know

arabic: وَضَرَبَ ٱللَّهُ مَثَلٗا رَّجُلَيۡنِ أَحَدُهُمَآ أَبۡكَمُ لَا يَقۡدِرُ عَلَىٰ شَيۡءٖ وَهُوَ كَلٌّ عَلَىٰ مَوۡلَىٰهُ أَيۡنَمَا يُوَجِّههُّ لَا يَأۡتِ بِخَيۡرٍ هَلۡ يَسۡتَوِي هُوَ وَمَن يَأۡمُرُ بِٱلۡعَدۡلِ وَهُوَ عَلَىٰ صِرَٰطٖ مُّسۡتَقِيمٖ
translation: And Allah presents an example of two men, one of them dumb and unable to do a thing, while he is a burden to his guardian. Wherever he directs him, he brings no good. Is he equal to one who commands justice, while he is on a straight path
normalizedArabic: وضرب الله مثلا رجلين احدهما ابكم لا يقدر علي شيء وهو كل علي موليه اينما يوجهه لا يات بخير هل يستوي هو ومن يامر بالعدل وهو علي صرط مستقيم
normalizedTranslation: and allah presents an example of two men, one of them dumb and unable to do a thing, while he is a burden to his guardian. wherever he directs him, he brings no good. is he equal to one who commands justice, while he is on a straight path

arabic: وَلِلَّهِ غَيۡبُ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلۡأَرۡضِۚ وَمَآ أَمۡرُ ٱلسَّاعَةِ إِلَّا كَلَمۡحِ ٱلۡبَصَرِ أَوۡ هُوَ أَقۡرَبُۚ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ عَلَىٰ كُلِّ شَيۡءٖ قَدِيرٞ
translation: And to Allah belongs the unseen [aspects] of the heavens and the earth. And the command for the Hour is not but as a glance of the eye or even nearer. Indeed, Allah is over all things competent
normalizedArabic: ولله غيب السموت والارض وما امر الساعه الا كلمح البصر او هو اقرب ان الله علي كل شيء قدير
normalizedTranslation: and to allah belongs the unseen [aspects] of the heavens and the earth. and the command for the hour is not but as a glance of the eye or even nearer. indeed, allah is over all things competent

arabic: وَٱللَّهُ أَخۡرَجَكُم مِّنۢ بُطُونِ أُمَّهَٰتِكُمۡ لَا تَعۡلَمُونَ شَيۡـٔٗا وَجَعَلَ لَكُمُ ٱلسَّمۡعَ وَٱلۡأَبۡصَٰرَ وَٱلۡأَفۡـِٔدَةَ لَعَلَّكُمۡ تَشۡكُرُونَ
translation: And Allah has extracted you from the wombs of your mothers not knowing a thing, and He made for you hearing and vision and intellect that perhaps you would be grateful
normalizedArabic: والله اخرجكم من بطون امهتكم لا تعلمون شيا وجعل لكم السمع والابصر والافده لعلكم تشكرون
normalizedTranslation: and allah has extracted you from the wombs of your mothers not knowing a thing, and he made for you hearing and vision and intellect that perhaps you would be grateful

arabic: أَلَمۡ يَرَوۡاْ إِلَى ٱلطَّيۡرِ مُسَخَّرَٰتٖ فِي جَوِّ ٱلسَّمَآءِ مَا يُمۡسِكُهُنَّ إِلَّا ٱللَّهُۚ إِنَّ فِي ذَٰلِكَ لَأٓيَٰتٖ لِّقَوۡمٖ يُؤۡمِنُونَ
translation: Do they not see the birds controlled in the atmosphere of the sky? None holds them up except Allah. Indeed in that are signs for a people who believe
normalizedArabic: الم يروا الي الطير مسخرت في جو السماء ما يمسكهن الا الله ان في ذلك لايت لقوم يومنون
normalizedTranslation: do they not see the birds controlled in the atmosphere of the sky? none holds them up except allah. indeed in that are signs for a people who believe

arabic: وَٱللَّهُ جَعَلَ لَكُم مِّنۢ بُيُوتِكُمۡ سَكَنٗا وَجَعَلَ لَكُم مِّن جُلُودِ ٱلۡأَنۡعَٰمِ بُيُوتٗا تَسۡتَخِفُّونَهَا يَوۡمَ ظَعۡنِكُمۡ وَيَوۡمَ إِقَامَتِكُمۡ وَمِنۡ أَصۡوَافِهَا وَأَوۡبَارِهَا وَأَشۡعَارِهَآ أَثَٰثٗا وَمَتَٰعًا إِلَىٰ حِينٖ
translation: And Allah has made for you from your homes a place of rest and made for you from the hides of the animals tents which you find light on your day of travel and your day of encampment; and from their wool, fur and hair is furnishing and enjoyment for a time
normalizedArabic: والله جعل لكم من بيوتكم سكنا وجعل لكم من جلود الانعم بيوتا تستخفونها يوم ظعنكم ويوم اقامتكم ومن اصوافها واوبارها واشعارها اثثا ومتعا الي حين
normalizedTranslation: and allah has made for you from your homes a place of rest and made for you from the hides of the animals tents which you find light on your day of travel and your day of encampment; and from their wool, fur and hair is furnishing and enjoyment for a time

arabic: وَٱللَّهُ جَعَلَ لَكُم مِّمَّا خَلَقَ ظِلَٰلٗا وَجَعَلَ لَكُم مِّنَ ٱلۡجِبَالِ أَكۡنَٰنٗا وَجَعَلَ لَكُمۡ سَرَٰبِيلَ تَقِيكُمُ ٱلۡحَرَّ وَسَرَٰبِيلَ تَقِيكُم بَأۡسَكُمۡۚ كَذَٰلِكَ يُتِمُّ نِعۡمَتَهُۥ عَلَيۡكُمۡ لَعَلَّكُمۡ تُسۡلِمُونَ
translation: And Allah has made for you, from that which He has created, shadows and has made for you from the mountains, shelters and has made for you garments which protect you from the heat and garments which protect you from your [enemy in] battle. Thus does He complete His favor upon you that you might submit [to Him]
normalizedArabic: والله جعل لكم مما خلق ظللا وجعل لكم من الجبال اكننا وجعل لكم سربيل تقيكم الحر وسربيل تقيكم باسكم كذلك يتم نعمته عليكم لعلكم تسلمون
normalizedTranslation: and allah has made for you, from that which he has created, shadows and has made for you from the mountains, shelters and has made for you garments which protect you from the heat and garments which protect you from your [enemy in] battle. thus does he complete his favor upon you that you might submit [to him]

arabic: فَإِن تَوَلَّوۡاْ فَإِنَّمَا عَلَيۡكَ ٱلۡبَلَٰغُ ٱلۡمُبِينُ
translation: But if they turn away, [O Muhammad] - then only upon you is [responsibility for] clear notification
normalizedArabic: فان تولوا فانما عليك البلغ المبين
normalizedTranslation: but if they turn away, [o muhammad] - then only upon you is [responsibility for] clear notification

arabic: يَعۡرِفُونَ نِعۡمَتَ ٱللَّهِ ثُمَّ يُنكِرُونَهَا وَأَكۡثَرُهُمُ ٱلۡكَٰفِرُونَ
translation: They recognize the favor of Allah; then they deny it. And most of them are disbelievers
normalizedArabic: يعرفون نعمت الله ثم ينكرونها واكثرهم الكفرون
normalizedTranslation: they recognize the favor of allah; then they deny it. and most of them are disbelievers

arabic: وَيَوۡمَ نَبۡعَثُ مِن كُلِّ أُمَّةٖ شَهِيدٗا ثُمَّ لَا يُؤۡذَنُ لِلَّذِينَ كَفَرُواْ وَلَا هُمۡ يُسۡتَعۡتَبُونَ
translation: And [mention] the Day when We will resurrect from every nation a witness. Then it will not be permitted to the disbelievers [to apologize or make excuses], nor will they be asked to appease [Allah]
normalizedArabic: ويوم نبعث من كل امه شهيدا ثم لا يوذن للذين كفروا ولا هم يستعتبون
normalizedTranslation: and [mention] the day when we will resurrect from every nation a witness. then it will not be permitted to the disbelievers [to apologize or make excuses], nor will they be asked to appease [allah]

arabic: وَإِذَا رَءَا ٱلَّذِينَ ظَلَمُواْ ٱلۡعَذَابَ فَلَا يُخَفَّفُ عَنۡهُمۡ وَلَا هُمۡ يُنظَرُونَ
translation: And when those who wronged see the punishment, it will not be lightened for them, nor will they be reprieved
normalizedArabic: واذا رءا الذين ظلموا العذاب فلا يخفف عنهم ولا هم ينظرون
normalizedTranslation: and when those who wronged see the punishment, it will not be lightened for them, nor will they be reprieved

arabic: وَإِذَا رَءَا ٱلَّذِينَ أَشۡرَكُواْ شُرَكَآءَهُمۡ قَالُواْ رَبَّنَا هَـٰٓؤُلَآءِ شُرَكَآؤُنَا ٱلَّذِينَ كُنَّا نَدۡعُواْ مِن دُونِكَۖ فَأَلۡقَوۡاْ إِلَيۡهِمُ ٱلۡقَوۡلَ إِنَّكُمۡ لَكَٰذِبُونَ
translation: And when those who associated others with Allah see their "partners," they will say," Our Lord, these are our partners [to You] whom we used to invoke besides You." But they will throw at them the statement, "Indeed, you are liars
normalizedArabic: واذا رءا الذين اشركوا شركاءهم قالوا ربنا هولاء شركاونا الذين كنا ندعوا من دونك فالقوا اليهم القول انكم لكذبون
normalizedTranslation: and when those who associated others with allah see their "partners," they will say," our lord, these are our partners [to you] whom we used to invoke besides you." but they will throw at them the statement, "indeed, you are liars

arabic: وَأَلۡقَوۡاْ إِلَى ٱللَّهِ يَوۡمَئِذٍ ٱلسَّلَمَۖ وَضَلَّ عَنۡهُم مَّا كَانُواْ يَفۡتَرُونَ
translation: And they will impart to Allah that Day [their] submission, and lost from them is what they used to invent
normalizedArabic: والقوا الي الله يوميذ السلم وضل عنهم ما كانوا يفترون
normalizedTranslation: and they will impart to allah that day [their] submission, and lost from them is what they used to invent

arabic: ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُواْ وَصَدُّواْ عَن سَبِيلِ ٱللَّهِ زِدۡنَٰهُمۡ عَذَابٗا فَوۡقَ ٱلۡعَذَابِ بِمَا كَانُواْ يُفۡسِدُونَ
translation: Those who disbelieved and averted [others] from the way of Allah - We will increase them in punishment over [their] punishment for what corruption they were causing
normalizedArabic: الذين كفروا وصدوا عن سبيل الله زدنهم عذابا فوق العذاب بما كانوا يفسدون
normalizedTranslation: those who disbelieved and averted [others] from the way of allah - we will increase them in punishment over [their] punishment for what corruption they were causing

arabic: وَيَوۡمَ نَبۡعَثُ فِي كُلِّ أُمَّةٖ شَهِيدًا عَلَيۡهِم مِّنۡ أَنفُسِهِمۡۖ وَجِئۡنَا بِكَ شَهِيدًا عَلَىٰ هَـٰٓؤُلَآءِۚ وَنَزَّلۡنَا عَلَيۡكَ ٱلۡكِتَٰبَ تِبۡيَٰنٗا لِّكُلِّ شَيۡءٖ وَهُدٗى وَرَحۡمَةٗ وَبُشۡرَىٰ لِلۡمُسۡلِمِينَ
translation: And [mention] the Day when We will resurrect among every nation a witness over them from themselves. And We will bring you, [O Muhammad], as a witness over your nation. And We have sent down to you the Book as clarification for all things and as guidance and mercy and good tidings for the Muslims
normalizedArabic: ويوم نبعث في كل امه شهيدا عليهم من انفسهم وجينا بك شهيدا علي هولاء ونزلنا عليك الكتب تبينا لكل شيء وهدي ورحمه وبشري للمسلمين
normalizedTranslation: and [mention] the day when we will resurrect among every nation a witness over them from themselves. and we will bring you, [o muhammad], as a witness over your nation. and we have sent down to you the book as clarification for all things and as guidance and mercy and good tidings for the muslims

arabic: ۞إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ يَأۡمُرُ بِٱلۡعَدۡلِ وَٱلۡإِحۡسَٰنِ وَإِيتَآيِٕ ذِي ٱلۡقُرۡبَىٰ وَيَنۡهَىٰ عَنِ ٱلۡفَحۡشَآءِ وَٱلۡمُنكَرِ وَٱلۡبَغۡيِۚ يَعِظُكُمۡ لَعَلَّكُمۡ تَذَكَّرُونَ
translation: Indeed, Allah orders justice and good conduct and giving to relatives and forbids immorality and bad conduct and oppression. He admonishes you that perhaps you will be reminded
normalizedArabic: ان الله يامر بالعدل والاحسن وايتاي ذي القربي وينهي عن الفحشاء والمنكر والبغي يعظكم لعلكم تذكرون
normalizedTranslation: indeed, allah orders justice and good conduct and giving to relatives and forbids immorality and bad conduct and oppression. he admonishes you that perhaps you will be reminded

arabic: وَأَوۡفُواْ بِعَهۡدِ ٱللَّهِ إِذَا عَٰهَدتُّمۡ وَلَا تَنقُضُواْ ٱلۡأَيۡمَٰنَ بَعۡدَ تَوۡكِيدِهَا وَقَدۡ جَعَلۡتُمُ ٱللَّهَ عَلَيۡكُمۡ كَفِيلًاۚ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ يَعۡلَمُ مَا تَفۡعَلُونَ
translation: And fulfill the covenant of Allah when you have taken it, [O believers], and do not break oaths after their confirmation while you have made Allah, over you, a witness. Indeed, Allah knows what you do
normalizedArabic: واوفوا بعهد الله اذا عهدتم ولا تنقضوا الايمن بعد توكيدها وقد جعلتم الله عليكم كفيلا ان الله يعلم ما تفعلون
normalizedTranslation: and fulfill the covenant of allah when you have taken it, [o believers], and do not break oaths after their confirmation while you have made allah, over you, a witness. indeed, allah knows what you do

arabic: وَلَا تَكُونُواْ كَٱلَّتِي نَقَضَتۡ غَزۡلَهَا مِنۢ بَعۡدِ قُوَّةٍ أَنكَٰثٗا تَتَّخِذُونَ أَيۡمَٰنَكُمۡ دَخَلَۢا بَيۡنَكُمۡ أَن تَكُونَ أُمَّةٌ هِيَ أَرۡبَىٰ مِنۡ أُمَّةٍۚ إِنَّمَا يَبۡلُوكُمُ ٱللَّهُ بِهِۦۚ وَلَيُبَيِّنَنَّ لَكُمۡ يَوۡمَ ٱلۡقِيَٰمَةِ مَا كُنتُمۡ فِيهِ تَخۡتَلِفُونَ
translation: And do not be like she who untwisted her spun thread after it was strong [by] taking your oaths as [means of] deceit between you because one community is more plentiful [in number or wealth] than another community. Allah only tries you thereby. And He will surely make clear to you on the Day of Resurrection that over which you used to differ
normalizedArabic: ولا تكونوا كالتي نقضت غزلها من بعد قوه انكثا تتخذون ايمنكم دخلا بينكم ان تكون امه هي اربي من امه انما يبلوكم الله به وليبينن لكم يوم القيمه ما كنتم فيه تختلفون
normalizedTranslation: and do not be like she who untwisted her spun thread after it was strong [by] taking your oaths as [means of] deceit between you because one community is more plentiful [in number or wealth] than another community. allah only tries you thereby. and he will surely make clear to you on the day of resurrection that over which you used to differ

arabic: وَلَوۡ شَآءَ ٱللَّهُ لَجَعَلَكُمۡ أُمَّةٗ وَٰحِدَةٗ وَلَٰكِن يُضِلُّ مَن يَشَآءُ وَيَهۡدِي مَن يَشَآءُۚ وَلَتُسۡـَٔلُنَّ عَمَّا كُنتُمۡ تَعۡمَلُونَ
translation: And if Allah had willed, He could have made you [of] one religion, but He causes to stray whom He wills and guides whom He wills. And you will surely be questioned about what you used to do
normalizedArabic: ولو شاء الله لجعلكم امه وحده ولكن يضل من يشاء ويهدي من يشاء ولتسلن عما كنتم تعملون
normalizedTranslation: and if allah had willed, he could have made you [of] one religion, but he causes to stray whom he wills and guides whom he wills. and you will surely be questioned about what you used to do

arabic: وَلَا تَتَّخِذُوٓاْ أَيۡمَٰنَكُمۡ دَخَلَۢا بَيۡنَكُمۡ فَتَزِلَّ قَدَمُۢ بَعۡدَ ثُبُوتِهَا وَتَذُوقُواْ ٱلسُّوٓءَ بِمَا صَدَدتُّمۡ عَن سَبِيلِ ٱللَّهِ وَلَكُمۡ عَذَابٌ عَظِيمٞ
translation: And do not take your oaths as [means of] deceit between you, lest a foot slip after it was [once] firm, and you would taste evil [in this world] for what [people] you diverted from the way of Allah, and you would have [in the Hereafter] a great punishment
normalizedArabic: ولا تتخذوا ايمنكم دخلا بينكم فتزل قدم بعد ثبوتها وتذوقوا السوء بما صددتم عن سبيل الله ولكم عذاب عظيم
normalizedTranslation: and do not take your oaths as [means of] deceit between you, lest a foot slip after it was [once] firm, and you would taste evil [in this world] for what [people] you diverted from the way of allah, and you would have [in the hereafter] a great punishment

arabic: وَلَا تَشۡتَرُواْ بِعَهۡدِ ٱللَّهِ ثَمَنٗا قَلِيلًاۚ إِنَّمَا عِندَ ٱللَّهِ هُوَ خَيۡرٞ لَّكُمۡ إِن كُنتُمۡ تَعۡلَمُونَ
translation: And do not exchange the covenant of Allah for a small price. Indeed, what is with Allah is best for you, if only you could know
normalizedArabic: ولا تشتروا بعهد الله ثمنا قليلا انما عند الله هو خير لكم ان كنتم تعلمون
normalizedTranslation: and do not exchange the covenant of allah for a small price. indeed, what is with allah is best for you, if only you could know

arabic: مَا عِندَكُمۡ يَنفَدُ وَمَا عِندَ ٱللَّهِ بَاقٖۗ وَلَنَجۡزِيَنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ صَبَرُوٓاْ أَجۡرَهُم بِأَحۡسَنِ مَا كَانُواْ يَعۡمَلُونَ
translation: Whatever you have will end, but what Allah has is lasting. And We will surely give those who were patient their reward according to the best of what they used to do
normalizedArabic: ما عندكم ينفد وما عند الله باق ولنجزين الذين صبروا اجرهم باحسن ما كانوا يعملون
normalizedTranslation: whatever you have will end, but what allah has is lasting. and we will surely give those who were patient their reward according to the best of what they used to do

arabic: مَنۡ عَمِلَ صَٰلِحٗا مِّن ذَكَرٍ أَوۡ أُنثَىٰ وَهُوَ مُؤۡمِنٞ فَلَنُحۡيِيَنَّهُۥ حَيَوٰةٗ طَيِّبَةٗۖ وَلَنَجۡزِيَنَّهُمۡ أَجۡرَهُم بِأَحۡسَنِ مَا كَانُواْ يَعۡمَلُونَ
translation: Whoever does righteousness, whether male or female, while he is a believer - We will surely cause him to live a good life, and We will surely give them their reward [in the Hereafter] according to the best of what they used to do
normalizedArabic: من عمل صلحا من ذكر او انثي وهو مومن فلنحيينه حيوه طيبه ولنجزينهم اجرهم باحسن ما كانوا يعملون
normalizedTranslation: whoever does righteousness, whether male or female, while he is a believer - we will surely cause him to live a good life, and we will surely give them their reward [in the hereafter] according to the best of what they used to do

arabic: فَإِذَا قَرَأۡتَ ٱلۡقُرۡءَانَ فَٱسۡتَعِذۡ بِٱللَّهِ مِنَ ٱلشَّيۡطَٰنِ ٱلرَّجِيمِ
translation: So when you recite the Qur'an, [first] seek refuge in Allah from Satan, the expelled [from His mercy]
normalizedArabic: فاذا قرات القرءان فاستعذ بالله من الشيطن الرجيم
normalizedTranslation: so when you recite the qur'an, [first] seek refuge in allah from satan, the expelled [from his mercy]

arabic: إِنَّهُۥ لَيۡسَ لَهُۥ سُلۡطَٰنٌ عَلَى ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُواْ وَعَلَىٰ رَبِّهِمۡ يَتَوَكَّلُونَ
translation: Indeed, there is for him no authority over those who have believed and rely upon their Lord
normalizedArabic: انه ليس له سلطن علي الذين ءامنوا وعلي ربهم يتوكلون
normalizedTranslation: indeed, there is for him no authority over those who have believed and rely upon their lord

arabic: إِنَّمَا سُلۡطَٰنُهُۥ عَلَى ٱلَّذِينَ يَتَوَلَّوۡنَهُۥ وَٱلَّذِينَ هُم بِهِۦ مُشۡرِكُونَ
translation: His authority is only over those who take him as an ally and those who through him associate others with Allah
normalizedArabic: انما سلطنه علي الذين يتولونه والذين هم به مشركون
normalizedTranslation: his authority is only over those who take him as an ally and those who through him associate others with allah

arabic: وَإِذَا بَدَّلۡنَآ ءَايَةٗ مَّكَانَ ءَايَةٖ وَٱللَّهُ أَعۡلَمُ بِمَا يُنَزِّلُ قَالُوٓاْ إِنَّمَآ أَنتَ مُفۡتَرِۭۚ بَلۡ أَكۡثَرُهُمۡ لَا يَعۡلَمُونَ
translation: And when We substitute a verse in place of a verse - and Allah is most knowing of what He sends down - they say, "You, [O Muhammad], are but an inventor [of lies]." But most of them do not know
normalizedArabic: واذا بدلنا ءايه مكان ءايه والله اعلم بما ينزل قالوا انما انت مفتر بل اكثرهم لا يعلمون
normalizedTranslation: and when we substitute a verse in place of a verse - and allah is most knowing of what he sends down - they say, "you, [o muhammad], are but an inventor [of lies]." but most of them do not know

arabic: قُلۡ نَزَّلَهُۥ رُوحُ ٱلۡقُدُسِ مِن رَّبِّكَ بِٱلۡحَقِّ لِيُثَبِّتَ ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُواْ وَهُدٗى وَبُشۡرَىٰ لِلۡمُسۡلِمِينَ
translation: Say, [O Muhammad], "The Pure Spirit has brought it down from your Lord in truth to make firm those who believe and as guidance and good tidings to the Muslims
normalizedArabic: قل نزله روح القدس من ربك بالحق ليثبت الذين ءامنوا وهدي وبشري للمسلمين
normalizedTranslation: say, [o muhammad], "the pure spirit has brought it down from your lord in truth to make firm those who believe and as guidance and good tidings to the muslims

arabic: وَلَقَدۡ نَعۡلَمُ أَنَّهُمۡ يَقُولُونَ إِنَّمَا يُعَلِّمُهُۥ بَشَرٞۗ لِّسَانُ ٱلَّذِي يُلۡحِدُونَ إِلَيۡهِ أَعۡجَمِيّٞ وَهَٰذَا لِسَانٌ عَرَبِيّٞ مُّبِينٌ
translation: And We certainly know that they say, "It is only a human being who teaches the Prophet." The tongue of the one they refer to is foreign, and this Qur'an is [in] a clear Arabic language
normalizedArabic: ولقد نعلم انهم يقولون انما يعلمه بشر لسان الذي يلحدون اليه اعجمي وهذا لسان عربي مبين
normalizedTranslation: and we certainly know that they say, "it is only a human being who teaches the prophet." the tongue of the one they refer to is foreign, and this qur'an is [in] a clear arabic language

arabic: إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ لَا يُؤۡمِنُونَ بِـَٔايَٰتِ ٱللَّهِ لَا يَهۡدِيهِمُ ٱللَّهُ وَلَهُمۡ عَذَابٌ أَلِيمٌ
translation: Indeed, those who do not believe in the verses of Allah - Allah will not guide them, and for them is a painful punishment
normalizedArabic: ان الذين لا يومنون بايت الله لا يهديهم الله ولهم عذاب اليم
normalizedTranslation: indeed, those who do not believe in the verses of allah - allah will not guide them, and for them is a painful punishment

arabic: إِنَّمَا يَفۡتَرِي ٱلۡكَذِبَ ٱلَّذِينَ لَا يُؤۡمِنُونَ بِـَٔايَٰتِ ٱللَّهِۖ وَأُوْلَـٰٓئِكَ هُمُ ٱلۡكَٰذِبُونَ
translation: They only invent falsehood who do not believe in the verses of Allah, and it is those who are the liars
normalizedArabic: انما يفتري الكذب الذين لا يومنون بايت الله واوليك هم الكذبون
normalizedTranslation: they only invent falsehood who do not believe in the verses of allah, and it is those who are the liars

arabic: مَن كَفَرَ بِٱللَّهِ مِنۢ بَعۡدِ إِيمَٰنِهِۦٓ إِلَّا مَنۡ أُكۡرِهَ وَقَلۡبُهُۥ مُطۡمَئِنُّۢ بِٱلۡإِيمَٰنِ وَلَٰكِن مَّن شَرَحَ بِٱلۡكُفۡرِ صَدۡرٗا فَعَلَيۡهِمۡ غَضَبٞ مِّنَ ٱللَّهِ وَلَهُمۡ عَذَابٌ عَظِيمٞ
translation: Whoever disbelieves in Allah after his belief... except for one who is forced [to renounce his religion] while his heart is secure in faith. But those who [willingly] open their breasts to disbelief, upon them is wrath from Allah, and for them is a great punishment
normalizedArabic: من كفر بالله من بعد ايمنه الا من اكره وقلبه مطمين بالايمن ولكن من شرح بالكفر صدرا فعليهم غضب من الله ولهم عذاب عظيم
normalizedTranslation: whoever disbelieves in allah after his belief... except for one who is forced [to renounce his religion] while his heart is secure in faith. but those who [willingly] open their breasts to disbelief, upon them is wrath from allah, and for them is a great punishment

arabic: ذَٰلِكَ بِأَنَّهُمُ ٱسۡتَحَبُّواْ ٱلۡحَيَوٰةَ ٱلدُّنۡيَا عَلَى ٱلۡأٓخِرَةِ وَأَنَّ ٱللَّهَ لَا يَهۡدِي ٱلۡقَوۡمَ ٱلۡكَٰفِرِينَ
translation: That is because they preferred the worldly life over the Hereafter and that Allah does not guide the disbelieving people
normalizedArabic: ذلك بانهم استحبوا الحيوه الدنيا علي الاخره وان الله لا يهدي القوم الكفرين
normalizedTranslation: that is because they preferred the worldly life over the hereafter and that allah does not guide the disbelieving people

arabic: أُوْلَـٰٓئِكَ ٱلَّذِينَ طَبَعَ ٱللَّهُ عَلَىٰ قُلُوبِهِمۡ وَسَمۡعِهِمۡ وَأَبۡصَٰرِهِمۡۖ وَأُوْلَـٰٓئِكَ هُمُ ٱلۡغَٰفِلُونَ
translation: Those are the ones over whose hearts and hearing and vision Allah has sealed, and it is those who are the heedless
normalizedArabic: اوليك الذين طبع الله علي قلوبهم وسمعهم وابصرهم واوليك هم الغفلون
normalizedTranslation: those are the ones over whose hearts and hearing and vision allah has sealed, and it is those who are the heedless

arabic: لَا جَرَمَ أَنَّهُمۡ فِي ٱلۡأٓخِرَةِ هُمُ ٱلۡخَٰسِرُونَ
translation: Assuredly, it is they, in the Hereafter, who will be the losers
normalizedArabic: لا جرم انهم في الاخره هم الخسرون
normalizedTranslation: assuredly, it is they, in the hereafter, who will be the losers

arabic: ثُمَّ إِنَّ رَبَّكَ لِلَّذِينَ هَاجَرُواْ مِنۢ بَعۡدِ مَا فُتِنُواْ ثُمَّ جَٰهَدُواْ وَصَبَرُوٓاْ إِنَّ رَبَّكَ مِنۢ بَعۡدِهَا لَغَفُورٞ رَّحِيمٞ
translation: Then, indeed your Lord, to those who emigrated after they had been compelled [to renounce their religion] and thereafter fought [for the cause of Allah] and were patient - indeed, your Lord, after that, is Forgiving and Merciful
normalizedArabic: ثم ان ربك للذين هاجروا من بعد ما فتنوا ثم جهدوا وصبروا ان ربك من بعدها لغفور رحيم
normalizedTranslation: then, indeed your lord, to those who emigrated after they had been compelled [to renounce their religion] and thereafter fought [for the cause of allah] and were patient - indeed, your lord, after that, is forgiving and merciful

arabic: ۞يَوۡمَ تَأۡتِي كُلُّ نَفۡسٖ تُجَٰدِلُ عَن نَّفۡسِهَا وَتُوَفَّىٰ كُلُّ نَفۡسٖ مَّا عَمِلَتۡ وَهُمۡ لَا يُظۡلَمُونَ
translation: On the Day when every soul will come disputing for itself, and every soul will be fully compensated for what it did, and they will not be wronged
normalizedArabic: يوم تاتي كل نفس تجدل عن نفسها وتوفي كل نفس ما عملت وهم لا يظلمون
normalizedTranslation: on the day when every soul will come disputing for itself, and every soul will be fully compensated for what it did, and they will not be wronged

arabic: وَضَرَبَ ٱللَّهُ مَثَلٗا قَرۡيَةٗ كَانَتۡ ءَامِنَةٗ مُّطۡمَئِنَّةٗ يَأۡتِيهَا رِزۡقُهَا رَغَدٗا مِّن كُلِّ مَكَانٖ فَكَفَرَتۡ بِأَنۡعُمِ ٱللَّهِ فَأَذَٰقَهَا ٱللَّهُ لِبَاسَ ٱلۡجُوعِ وَٱلۡخَوۡفِ بِمَا كَانُواْ يَصۡنَعُونَ
translation: And Allah presents an example: a city which was safe and secure, its provision coming to it in abundance from every location, but it denied the favors of Allah. So Allah made it taste the envelopment of hunger and fear for what they had been doing
normalizedArabic: وضرب الله مثلا قريه كانت ءامنه مطمينه ياتيها رزقها رغدا من كل مكان فكفرت بانعم الله فاذقها الله لباس الجوع والخوف بما كانوا يصنعون
normalizedTranslation: and allah presents an example: a city which was safe and secure, its provision coming to it in abundance from every location, but it denied the favors of allah. so allah made it taste the envelopment of hunger and fear for what they had been doing

arabic: وَلَقَدۡ جَآءَهُمۡ رَسُولٞ مِّنۡهُمۡ فَكَذَّبُوهُ فَأَخَذَهُمُ ٱلۡعَذَابُ وَهُمۡ ظَٰلِمُونَ
translation: And there had certainly come to them a Messenger from among themselves, but they denied him; so punishment overtook them while they were wrongdoers
normalizedArabic: ولقد جاءهم رسول منهم فكذبوه فاخذهم العذاب وهم ظلمون
normalizedTranslation: and there had certainly come to them a messenger from among themselves, but they denied him; so punishment overtook them while they were wrongdoers

arabic: فَكُلُواْ مِمَّا رَزَقَكُمُ ٱللَّهُ حَلَٰلٗا طَيِّبٗا وَٱشۡكُرُواْ نِعۡمَتَ ٱللَّهِ إِن كُنتُمۡ إِيَّاهُ تَعۡبُدُونَ
translation: Then eat of what Allah has provided for you [which is] lawful and good. And be grateful for the favor of Allah, if it is [indeed] Him that you worship
normalizedArabic: فكلوا مما رزقكم الله حللا طيبا واشكروا نعمت الله ان كنتم اياه تعبدون
normalizedTranslation: then eat of what allah has provided for you [which is] lawful and good. and be grateful for the favor of allah, if it is [indeed] him that you worship

arabic: إِنَّمَا حَرَّمَ عَلَيۡكُمُ ٱلۡمَيۡتَةَ وَٱلدَّمَ وَلَحۡمَ ٱلۡخِنزِيرِ وَمَآ أُهِلَّ لِغَيۡرِ ٱللَّهِ بِهِۦۖ فَمَنِ ٱضۡطُرَّ غَيۡرَ بَاغٖ وَلَا عَادٖ فَإِنَّ ٱللَّهَ غَفُورٞ رَّحِيمٞ
translation: He has only forbidden to you dead animals, blood, the flesh of swine, and that which has been dedicated to other than Allah. But whoever is forced [by necessity], neither desiring [it] nor transgressing [its limit] - then indeed, Allah is Forgiving and Merciful
normalizedArabic: انما حرم عليكم الميته والدم ولحم الخنزير وما اهل لغير الله به فمن اضطر غير باغ ولا عاد فان الله غفور رحيم
normalizedTranslation: he has only forbidden to you dead animals, blood, the flesh of swine, and that which has been dedicated to other than allah. but whoever is forced [by necessity], neither desiring [it] nor transgressing [its limit] - then indeed, allah is forgiving and merciful

arabic: وَلَا تَقُولُواْ لِمَا تَصِفُ أَلۡسِنَتُكُمُ ٱلۡكَذِبَ هَٰذَا حَلَٰلٞ وَهَٰذَا حَرَامٞ لِّتَفۡتَرُواْ عَلَى ٱللَّهِ ٱلۡكَذِبَۚ إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ يَفۡتَرُونَ عَلَى ٱللَّهِ ٱلۡكَذِبَ لَا يُفۡلِحُونَ
translation: And do not say about what your tongues assert of untruth, "This is lawful and this is unlawful," to invent falsehood about Allah. Indeed, those who invent falsehood about Allah will not succeed
normalizedArabic: ولا تقولوا لما تصف السنتكم الكذب هذا حلل وهذا حرام لتفتروا علي الله الكذب ان الذين يفترون علي الله الكذب لا يفلحون
normalizedTranslation: and do not say about what your tongues assert of untruth, "this is lawful and this is unlawful," to invent falsehood about allah. indeed, those who invent falsehood about allah will not succeed

arabic: مَتَٰعٞ قَلِيلٞ وَلَهُمۡ عَذَابٌ أَلِيمٞ
translation: [It is but] a brief enjoyment, and they will have a painful punishment
normalizedArabic: متع قليل ولهم عذاب اليم
normalizedTranslation: [it is but] a brief enjoyment, and they will have a painful punishment

arabic: وَعَلَى ٱلَّذِينَ هَادُواْ حَرَّمۡنَا مَا قَصَصۡنَا عَلَيۡكَ مِن قَبۡلُۖ وَمَا ظَلَمۡنَٰهُمۡ وَلَٰكِن كَانُوٓاْ أَنفُسَهُمۡ يَظۡلِمُونَ
translation: And to those who are Jews We have prohibited that which We related to you before. And We did not wrong them [thereby], but they were wronging themselves
normalizedArabic: وعلي الذين هادوا حرمنا ما قصصنا عليك من قبل وما ظلمنهم ولكن كانوا انفسهم يظلمون
normalizedTranslation: and to those who are jews we have prohibited that which we related to you before. and we did not wrong them [thereby], but they were wronging themselves

arabic: ثُمَّ إِنَّ رَبَّكَ لِلَّذِينَ عَمِلُواْ ٱلسُّوٓءَ بِجَهَٰلَةٖ ثُمَّ تَابُواْ مِنۢ بَعۡدِ ذَٰلِكَ وَأَصۡلَحُوٓاْ إِنَّ رَبَّكَ مِنۢ بَعۡدِهَا لَغَفُورٞ رَّحِيمٌ
translation: Then, indeed your Lord, to those who have done wrong out of ignorance and then repent after that and correct themselves - indeed, your Lord, thereafter, is Forgiving and Merciful
normalizedArabic: ثم ان ربك للذين عملوا السوء بجهله ثم تابوا من بعد ذلك واصلحوا ان ربك من بعدها لغفور رحيم
normalizedTranslation: then, indeed your lord, to those who have done wrong out of ignorance and then repent after that and correct themselves - indeed, your lord, thereafter, is forgiving and merciful

arabic: إِنَّ إِبۡرَٰهِيمَ كَانَ أُمَّةٗ قَانِتٗا لِّلَّهِ حَنِيفٗا وَلَمۡ يَكُ مِنَ ٱلۡمُشۡرِكِينَ
translation: Indeed, Abraham was a [comprehensive] leader, devoutly obedient to Allah, inclining toward truth, and he was not of those who associate others with Allah
normalizedArabic: ان ابرهيم كان امه قانتا لله حنيفا ولم يك من المشركين
normalizedTranslation: indeed, abraham was a [comprehensive] leader, devoutly obedient to allah, inclining toward truth, and he was not of those who associate others with allah

arabic: شَاكِرٗا لِّأَنۡعُمِهِۚ ٱجۡتَبَىٰهُ وَهَدَىٰهُ إِلَىٰ صِرَٰطٖ مُّسۡتَقِيمٖ
translation: [He was] grateful for His favors. Allah chose him and guided him to a straight path
normalizedArabic: شاكرا لانعمه اجتبيه وهديه الي صرط مستقيم
normalizedTranslation: [he was] grateful for his favors. allah chose him and guided him to a straight path

arabic: وَءَاتَيۡنَٰهُ فِي ٱلدُّنۡيَا حَسَنَةٗۖ وَإِنَّهُۥ فِي ٱلۡأٓخِرَةِ لَمِنَ ٱلصَّـٰلِحِينَ
translation: And We gave him good in this world, and indeed, in the Hereafter he will be among the righteous
normalizedArabic: وءاتينه في الدنيا حسنه وانه في الاخره لمن الصلحين
normalizedTranslation: and we gave him good in this world, and indeed, in the hereafter he will be among the righteous

arabic: ثُمَّ أَوۡحَيۡنَآ إِلَيۡكَ أَنِ ٱتَّبِعۡ مِلَّةَ إِبۡرَٰهِيمَ حَنِيفٗاۖ وَمَا كَانَ مِنَ ٱلۡمُشۡرِكِينَ
translation: Then We revealed to you, [O Muhammad], to follow the religion of Abraham, inclining toward truth; and he was not of those who associate with Allah
normalizedArabic: ثم اوحينا اليك ان اتبع مله ابرهيم حنيفا وما كان من المشركين
normalizedTranslation: then we revealed to you, [o muhammad], to follow the religion of abraham, inclining toward truth; and he was not of those who associate with allah

arabic: إِنَّمَا جُعِلَ ٱلسَّبۡتُ عَلَى ٱلَّذِينَ ٱخۡتَلَفُواْ فِيهِۚ وَإِنَّ رَبَّكَ لَيَحۡكُمُ بَيۡنَهُمۡ يَوۡمَ ٱلۡقِيَٰمَةِ فِيمَا كَانُواْ فِيهِ يَخۡتَلِفُونَ
translation: The sabbath was only appointed for those who differed over it. And indeed, your Lord will judge between them on the Day of Resurrection concerning that over which they used to differ
normalizedArabic: انما جعل السبت علي الذين اختلفوا فيه وان ربك ليحكم بينهم يوم القيمه فيما كانوا فيه يختلفون
normalizedTranslation: the sabbath was only appointed for those who differed over it. and indeed, your lord will judge between them on the day of resurrection concerning that over which they used to differ

arabic: ٱدۡعُ إِلَىٰ سَبِيلِ رَبِّكَ بِٱلۡحِكۡمَةِ وَٱلۡمَوۡعِظَةِ ٱلۡحَسَنَةِۖ وَجَٰدِلۡهُم بِٱلَّتِي هِيَ أَحۡسَنُۚ إِنَّ رَبَّكَ هُوَ أَعۡلَمُ بِمَن ضَلَّ عَن سَبِيلِهِۦ وَهُوَ أَعۡلَمُ بِٱلۡمُهۡتَدِينَ
translation: Invite to the way of your Lord with wisdom and good instruction, and argue with them in a way that is best. Indeed, your Lord is most knowing of who has strayed from His way, and He is most knowing of who is [rightly] guided
normalizedArabic: ادع الي سبيل ربك بالحكمه والموعظه الحسنه وجدلهم بالتي هي احسن ان ربك هو اعلم بمن ضل عن سبيله وهو اعلم بالمهتدين
normalizedTranslation: invite to the way of your lord with wisdom and good instruction, and argue with them in a way that is best. indeed, your lord is most knowing of who has strayed from his way, and he is most knowing of who is [rightly] guided

arabic: وَإِنۡ عَاقَبۡتُمۡ فَعَاقِبُواْ بِمِثۡلِ مَا عُوقِبۡتُم بِهِۦۖ وَلَئِن صَبَرۡتُمۡ لَهُوَ خَيۡرٞ لِّلصَّـٰبِرِينَ
translation: And if you punish [an enemy, O believers], punish with an equivalent of that with which you were harmed. But if you are patient - it is better for those who are patient
normalizedArabic: وان عاقبتم فعاقبوا بمثل ما عوقبتم به ولين صبرتم لهو خير للصبرين
normalizedTranslation: and if you punish [an enemy, o believers], punish with an equivalent of that with which you were harmed. but if you are patient - it is better for those who are patient

arabic: وَٱصۡبِرۡ وَمَا صَبۡرُكَ إِلَّا بِٱللَّهِۚ وَلَا تَحۡزَنۡ عَلَيۡهِمۡ وَلَا تَكُ فِي ضَيۡقٖ مِّمَّا يَمۡكُرُونَ
translation: And be patient, [O Muhammad], and your patience is not but through Allah. And do not grieve over them and do not be in distress over what they conspire
normalizedArabic: واصبر وما صبرك الا بالله ولا تحزن عليهم ولا تك في ضيق مما يمكرون
normalizedTranslation: and be patient, [o muhammad], and your patience is not but through allah. and do not grieve over them and do not be in distress over what they conspire

arabic: إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ مَعَ ٱلَّذِينَ ٱتَّقَواْ وَّٱلَّذِينَ هُم مُّحۡسِنُونَ
translation: Indeed, Allah is with those who fear Him and those who are doers of good
normalizedArabic: ان الله مع الذين اتقوا والذين هم محسنون
normalizedTranslation: indeed, allah is with those who fear him and those who are doers of good

arabic: سُبۡحَٰنَ ٱلَّذِيٓ أَسۡرَىٰ بِعَبۡدِهِۦ لَيۡلٗا مِّنَ ٱلۡمَسۡجِدِ ٱلۡحَرَامِ إِلَى ٱلۡمَسۡجِدِ ٱلۡأَقۡصَا ٱلَّذِي بَٰرَكۡنَا حَوۡلَهُۥ لِنُرِيَهُۥ مِنۡ ءَايَٰتِنَآۚ إِنَّهُۥ هُوَ ٱلسَّمِيعُ ٱلۡبَصِيرُ
translation: Exalted is He who took His Servant by night from al-Masjid al-Haram to al-Masjid al-Aqsa, whose surroundings We have blessed, to show him of Our signs. Indeed, He is the Hearing, the Seeing
normalizedArabic: سبحن الذي اسري بعبده ليلا من المسجد الحرام الي المسجد الاقصا الذي بركنا حوله لنريه من ءايتنا انه هو السميع البصير
normalizedTranslation: exalted is he who took his servant by night from al-masjid al-haram to al-masjid al-aqsa, whose surroundings we have blessed, to show him of our signs. indeed, he is the hearing, the seeing

arabic: وَءَاتَيۡنَا مُوسَى ٱلۡكِتَٰبَ وَجَعَلۡنَٰهُ هُدٗى لِّبَنِيٓ إِسۡرَـٰٓءِيلَ أَلَّا تَتَّخِذُواْ مِن دُونِي وَكِيلٗا
translation: And We gave Moses the Scripture and made it a guidance for the Children of Israel that you not take other than Me as Disposer of affairs
normalizedArabic: وءاتينا موسي الكتب وجعلنه هدي لبني اسرءيل الا تتخذوا من دوني وكيلا
normalizedTranslation: and we gave moses the scripture and made it a guidance for the children of israel that you not take other than me as disposer of affairs

arabic: ذُرِّيَّةَ مَنۡ حَمَلۡنَا مَعَ نُوحٍۚ إِنَّهُۥ كَانَ عَبۡدٗا شَكُورٗا
translation: O descendants of those We carried [in the ship] with Noah. Indeed, he was a grateful servant
normalizedArabic: ذريه من حملنا مع نوح انه كان عبدا شكورا
normalizedTranslation: o descendants of those we carried [in the ship] with noah. indeed, he was a grateful servant

arabic: وَقَضَيۡنَآ إِلَىٰ بَنِيٓ إِسۡرَـٰٓءِيلَ فِي ٱلۡكِتَٰبِ لَتُفۡسِدُنَّ فِي ٱلۡأَرۡضِ مَرَّتَيۡنِ وَلَتَعۡلُنَّ عُلُوّٗا كَبِيرٗا
translation: And We conveyed to the Children of Israel in the Scripture that, "You will surely cause corruption on the earth twice, and you will surely reach [a degree of] great haughtiness
normalizedArabic: وقضينا الي بني اسرءيل في الكتب لتفسدن في الارض مرتين ولتعلن علوا كبيرا
normalizedTranslation: and we conveyed to the children of israel in the scripture that, "you will surely cause corruption on the earth twice, and you will surely reach [a degree of] great haughtiness

arabic: فَإِذَا جَآءَ وَعۡدُ أُولَىٰهُمَا بَعَثۡنَا عَلَيۡكُمۡ عِبَادٗا لَّنَآ أُوْلِي بَأۡسٖ شَدِيدٖ فَجَاسُواْ خِلَٰلَ ٱلدِّيَارِۚ وَكَانَ وَعۡدٗا مَّفۡعُولٗا
translation: So when the [time of] promise came for the first of them, We sent against you servants of Ours - those of great military might, and they probed [even] into the homes, and it was a promise fulfilled
normalizedArabic: فاذا جاء وعد اوليهما بعثنا عليكم عبادا لنا اولي باس شديد فجاسوا خلل الديار وكان وعدا مفعولا
normalizedTranslation: so when the [time of] promise came for the first of them, we sent against you servants of ours - those of great military might, and they probed [even] into the homes, and it was a promise fulfilled

arabic: ثُمَّ رَدَدۡنَا لَكُمُ ٱلۡكَرَّةَ عَلَيۡهِمۡ وَأَمۡدَدۡنَٰكُم بِأَمۡوَٰلٖ وَبَنِينَ وَجَعَلۡنَٰكُمۡ أَكۡثَرَ نَفِيرًا
translation: Then We gave back to you a return victory over them. And We reinforced you with wealth and sons and made you more numerous in manpower
normalizedArabic: ثم رددنا لكم الكره عليهم وامددنكم بامول وبنين وجعلنكم اكثر نفيرا
normalizedTranslation: then we gave back to you a return victory over them. and we reinforced you with wealth and sons and made you more numerous in manpower

arabic: إِنۡ أَحۡسَنتُمۡ أَحۡسَنتُمۡ لِأَنفُسِكُمۡۖ وَإِنۡ أَسَأۡتُمۡ فَلَهَاۚ فَإِذَا جَآءَ وَعۡدُ ٱلۡأٓخِرَةِ لِيَسُـُٔواْ وُجُوهَكُمۡ وَلِيَدۡخُلُواْ ٱلۡمَسۡجِدَ كَمَا دَخَلُوهُ أَوَّلَ مَرَّةٖ وَلِيُتَبِّرُواْ مَا عَلَوۡاْ تَتۡبِيرًا
translation: [And said], "If you do good, you do good for yourselves; and if you do evil, [you do it] to yourselves." Then when the final promise came, [We sent your enemies] to sadden your faces and to enter the temple in Jerusalem, as they entered it the first time, and to destroy what they had taken over with [total] destruction
normalizedArabic: ان احسنتم احسنتم لانفسكم وان اساتم فلها فاذا جاء وعد الاخره ليسوا وجوهكم وليدخلوا المسجد كما دخلوه اول مره وليتبروا ما علوا تتبيرا
normalizedTranslation: [and said], "if you do good, you do good for yourselves; and if you do evil, [you do it] to yourselves." then when the final promise came, [we sent your enemies] to sadden your faces and to enter the temple in jerusalem, as they entered it the first time, and to destroy what they had taken over with [total] destruction

arabic: عَسَىٰ رَبُّكُمۡ أَن يَرۡحَمَكُمۡۚ وَإِنۡ عُدتُّمۡ عُدۡنَاۚ وَجَعَلۡنَا جَهَنَّمَ لِلۡكَٰفِرِينَ حَصِيرًا
translation: [Then Allah said], "It is expected, [if you repent], that your Lord will have mercy upon you. But if you return [to sin], We will return [to punishment]. And We have made Hell, for the disbelievers, a prison-bed
normalizedArabic: عسي ربكم ان يرحمكم وان عدتم عدنا وجعلنا جهنم للكفرين حصيرا
normalizedTranslation: [then allah said], "it is expected, [if you repent], that your lord will have mercy upon you. but if you return [to sin], we will return [to punishment]. and we have made hell, for the disbelievers, a prison-bed

arabic: إِنَّ هَٰذَا ٱلۡقُرۡءَانَ يَهۡدِي لِلَّتِي هِيَ أَقۡوَمُ وَيُبَشِّرُ ٱلۡمُؤۡمِنِينَ ٱلَّذِينَ يَعۡمَلُونَ ٱلصَّـٰلِحَٰتِ أَنَّ لَهُمۡ أَجۡرٗا كَبِيرٗا
translation: Indeed, this Qur'an guides to that which is most suitable and gives good tidings to the believers who do righteous deeds that they will have a great reward
normalizedArabic: ان هذا القرءان يهدي للتي هي اقوم ويبشر المومنين الذين يعملون الصلحت ان لهم اجرا كبيرا
normalizedTranslation: indeed, this qur'an guides to that which is most suitable and gives good tidings to the believers who do righteous deeds that they will have a great reward

arabic: وَأَنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ لَا يُؤۡمِنُونَ بِٱلۡأٓخِرَةِ أَعۡتَدۡنَا لَهُمۡ عَذَابًا أَلِيمٗا
translation: And that those who do not believe in the Hereafter - We have prepared for them a painful punishment
normalizedArabic: وان الذين لا يومنون بالاخره اعتدنا لهم عذابا اليما
normalizedTranslation: and that those who do not believe in the hereafter - we have prepared for them a painful punishment

arabic: وَيَدۡعُ ٱلۡإِنسَٰنُ بِٱلشَّرِّ دُعَآءَهُۥ بِٱلۡخَيۡرِۖ وَكَانَ ٱلۡإِنسَٰنُ عَجُولٗا
translation: And man supplicates for evil as he supplicates for good, and man is ever hasty
normalizedArabic: ويدع الانسن بالشر دعاءه بالخير وكان الانسن عجولا
normalizedTranslation: and man supplicates for evil as he supplicates for good, and man is ever hasty

arabic: وَجَعَلۡنَا ٱلَّيۡلَ وَٱلنَّهَارَ ءَايَتَيۡنِۖ فَمَحَوۡنَآ ءَايَةَ ٱلَّيۡلِ وَجَعَلۡنَآ ءَايَةَ ٱلنَّهَارِ مُبۡصِرَةٗ لِّتَبۡتَغُواْ فَضۡلٗا مِّن رَّبِّكُمۡ وَلِتَعۡلَمُواْ عَدَدَ ٱلسِّنِينَ وَٱلۡحِسَابَۚ وَكُلَّ شَيۡءٖ فَصَّلۡنَٰهُ تَفۡصِيلٗا
translation: And We have made the night and day two signs, and We erased the sign of the night and made the sign of the day visible that you may seek bounty from your Lord and may know the number of years and the account [of time]. And everything We have set out in detail
normalizedArabic: وجعلنا اليل والنهار ءايتين فمحونا ءايه اليل وجعلنا ءايه النهار مبصره لتبتغوا فضلا من ربكم ولتعلموا عدد السنين والحساب وكل شيء فصلنه تفصيلا
normalizedTranslation: and we have made the night and day two signs, and we erased the sign of the night and made the sign of the day visible that you may seek bounty from your lord and may know the number of years and the account [of time]. and everything we have set out in detail

arabic: وَكُلَّ إِنسَٰنٍ أَلۡزَمۡنَٰهُ طَـٰٓئِرَهُۥ فِي عُنُقِهِۦۖ وَنُخۡرِجُ لَهُۥ يَوۡمَ ٱلۡقِيَٰمَةِ كِتَٰبٗا يَلۡقَىٰهُ مَنشُورًا
translation: And [for] every person We have imposed his fate upon his neck, and We will produce for him on the Day of Resurrection a record which he will encounter spread open
normalizedArabic: وكل انسن الزمنه طيره في عنقه ونخرج له يوم القيمه كتبا يلقيه منشورا
normalizedTranslation: and [for] every person we have imposed his fate upon his neck, and we will produce for him on the day of resurrection a record which he will encounter spread open

arabic: ٱقۡرَأۡ كِتَٰبَكَ كَفَىٰ بِنَفۡسِكَ ٱلۡيَوۡمَ عَلَيۡكَ حَسِيبٗا
translation: [It will be said], "Read your record. Sufficient is yourself against you this Day as accountant
normalizedArabic: اقرا كتبك كفي بنفسك اليوم عليك حسيبا
normalizedTranslation: [it will be said], "read your record. sufficient is yourself against you this day as accountant

arabic: مَّنِ ٱهۡتَدَىٰ فَإِنَّمَا يَهۡتَدِي لِنَفۡسِهِۦۖ وَمَن ضَلَّ فَإِنَّمَا يَضِلُّ عَلَيۡهَاۚ وَلَا تَزِرُ وَازِرَةٞ وِزۡرَ أُخۡرَىٰۗ وَمَا كُنَّا مُعَذِّبِينَ حَتَّىٰ نَبۡعَثَ رَسُولٗا
translation: Whoever is guided is only guided for [the benefit of] his soul. And whoever errs only errs against it. And no bearer of burdens will bear the burden of another. And never would We punish until We sent a messenger
normalizedArabic: من اهتدي فانما يهتدي لنفسه ومن ضل فانما يضل عليها ولا تزر وازره وزر اخري وما كنا معذبين حتي نبعث رسولا
normalizedTranslation: whoever is guided is only guided for [the benefit of] his soul. and whoever errs only errs against it. and no bearer of burdens will bear the burden of another. and never would we punish until we sent a messenger

arabic: وَإِذَآ أَرَدۡنَآ أَن نُّهۡلِكَ قَرۡيَةً أَمَرۡنَا مُتۡرَفِيهَا فَفَسَقُواْ فِيهَا فَحَقَّ عَلَيۡهَا ٱلۡقَوۡلُ فَدَمَّرۡنَٰهَا تَدۡمِيرٗا
translation: And when We intend to destroy a city, We command its affluent but they defiantly disobey therein; so the word comes into effect upon it, and We destroy it with [complete] destruction
normalizedArabic: واذا اردنا ان نهلك قريه امرنا مترفيها ففسقوا فيها فحق عليها القول فدمرنها تدميرا
normalizedTranslation: and when we intend to destroy a city, we command its affluent but they defiantly disobey therein; so the word comes into effect upon it, and we destroy it with [complete] destruction

arabic: وَكَمۡ أَهۡلَكۡنَا مِنَ ٱلۡقُرُونِ مِنۢ بَعۡدِ نُوحٖۗ وَكَفَىٰ بِرَبِّكَ بِذُنُوبِ عِبَادِهِۦ خَبِيرَۢا بَصِيرٗا
translation: And how many have We destroyed from the generations after Noah. And sufficient is your Lord, concerning the sins of His servants, as Acquainted and Seeing
normalizedArabic: وكم اهلكنا من القرون من بعد نوح وكفي بربك بذنوب عباده خبيرا بصيرا
normalizedTranslation: and how many have we destroyed from the generations after noah. and sufficient is your lord, concerning the sins of his servants, as acquainted and seeing

arabic: مَّن كَانَ يُرِيدُ ٱلۡعَاجِلَةَ عَجَّلۡنَا لَهُۥ فِيهَا مَا نَشَآءُ لِمَن نُّرِيدُ ثُمَّ جَعَلۡنَا لَهُۥ جَهَنَّمَ يَصۡلَىٰهَا مَذۡمُومٗا مَّدۡحُورٗا
translation: Whoever should desire the immediate - We hasten for him from it what We will to whom We intend. Then We have made for him Hell, which he will [enter to] burn, censured and banished
normalizedArabic: من كان يريد العاجله عجلنا له فيها ما نشاء لمن نريد ثم جعلنا له جهنم يصليها مذموما مدحورا
normalizedTranslation: whoever should desire the immediate - we hasten for him from it what we will to whom we intend. then we have made for him hell, which he will [enter to] burn, censured and banished

arabic: وَمَنۡ أَرَادَ ٱلۡأٓخِرَةَ وَسَعَىٰ لَهَا سَعۡيَهَا وَهُوَ مُؤۡمِنٞ فَأُوْلَـٰٓئِكَ كَانَ سَعۡيُهُم مَّشۡكُورٗا
translation: But whoever desires the Hereafter and exerts the effort due to it while he is a believer - it is those whose effort is ever appreciated [by Allah]
normalizedArabic: ومن اراد الاخره وسعي لها سعيها وهو مومن فاوليك كان سعيهم مشكورا
normalizedTranslation: but whoever desires the hereafter and exerts the effort due to it while he is a believer - it is those whose effort is ever appreciated [by allah]

arabic: كُلّٗا نُّمِدُّ هَـٰٓؤُلَآءِ وَهَـٰٓؤُلَآءِ مِنۡ عَطَآءِ رَبِّكَۚ وَمَا كَانَ عَطَآءُ رَبِّكَ مَحۡظُورًا
translation: To each [category] We extend - to these and to those - from the gift of your Lord. And never has the gift of your Lord been restricted
normalizedArabic: كلا نمد هولاء وهولاء من عطاء ربك وما كان عطاء ربك محظورا
normalizedTranslation: to each [category] we extend - to these and to those - from the gift of your lord. and never has the gift of your lord been restricted

arabic: ٱنظُرۡ كَيۡفَ فَضَّلۡنَا بَعۡضَهُمۡ عَلَىٰ بَعۡضٖۚ وَلَلۡأٓخِرَةُ أَكۡبَرُ دَرَجَٰتٖ وَأَكۡبَرُ تَفۡضِيلٗا
translation: Look how We have favored [in provision] some of them over others. But the Hereafter is greater in degrees [of difference] and greater in distinction
normalizedArabic: انظر كيف فضلنا بعضهم علي بعض وللاخره اكبر درجت واكبر تفضيلا
normalizedTranslation: look how we have favored [in provision] some of them over others. but the hereafter is greater in degrees [of difference] and greater in distinction

arabic: لَّا تَجۡعَلۡ مَعَ ٱللَّهِ إِلَٰهًا ءَاخَرَ فَتَقۡعُدَ مَذۡمُومٗا مَّخۡذُولٗا
translation: Do not make [as equal] with Allah another deity and [thereby] become censured and forsaken
normalizedArabic: لا تجعل مع الله الها ءاخر فتقعد مذموما مخذولا
normalizedTranslation: do not make [as equal] with allah another deity and [thereby] become censured and forsaken

arabic: ۞وَقَضَىٰ رَبُّكَ أَلَّا تَعۡبُدُوٓاْ إِلَّآ إِيَّاهُ وَبِٱلۡوَٰلِدَيۡنِ إِحۡسَٰنًاۚ إِمَّا يَبۡلُغَنَّ عِندَكَ ٱلۡكِبَرَ أَحَدُهُمَآ أَوۡ كِلَاهُمَا فَلَا تَقُل لَّهُمَآ أُفّٖ وَلَا تَنۡهَرۡهُمَا وَقُل لَّهُمَا قَوۡلٗا كَرِيمٗا
translation: And your Lord has decreed that you not worship except Him, and to parents, good treatment. Whether one or both of them reach old age [while] with you, say not to them [so much as], "uff," and do not repel them but speak to them a noble word
normalizedArabic: وقضي ربك الا تعبدوا الا اياه وبالولدين احسنا اما يبلغن عندك الكبر احدهما او كلاهما فلا تقل لهما اف ولا تنهرهما وقل لهما قولا كريما
normalizedTranslation: and your lord has decreed that you not worship except him, and to parents, good treatment. whether one or both of them reach old age [while] with you, say not to them [so much as], "uff," and do not repel them but speak to them a noble word

arabic: وَٱخۡفِضۡ لَهُمَا جَنَاحَ ٱلذُّلِّ مِنَ ٱلرَّحۡمَةِ وَقُل رَّبِّ ٱرۡحَمۡهُمَا كَمَا رَبَّيَانِي صَغِيرٗا
translation: And lower to them the wing of humility out of mercy and say, "My Lord, have mercy upon them as they brought me up [when I was] small
normalizedArabic: واخفض لهما جناح الذل من الرحمه وقل رب ارحمهما كما ربياني صغيرا
normalizedTranslation: and lower to them the wing of humility out of mercy and say, "my lord, have mercy upon them as they brought me up [when i was] small

arabic: رَّبُّكُمۡ أَعۡلَمُ بِمَا فِي نُفُوسِكُمۡۚ إِن تَكُونُواْ صَٰلِحِينَ فَإِنَّهُۥ كَانَ لِلۡأَوَّـٰبِينَ غَفُورٗا
translation: Your Lord is most knowing of what is within yourselves. If you should be righteous [in intention] - then indeed He is ever, to the often returning [to Him], Forgiving
normalizedArabic: ربكم اعلم بما في نفوسكم ان تكونوا صلحين فانه كان للاوبين غفورا
normalizedTranslation: your lord is most knowing of what is within yourselves. if you should be righteous [in intention] - then indeed he is ever, to the often returning [to him], forgiving

arabic: وَءَاتِ ذَا ٱلۡقُرۡبَىٰ حَقَّهُۥ وَٱلۡمِسۡكِينَ وَٱبۡنَ ٱلسَّبِيلِ وَلَا تُبَذِّرۡ تَبۡذِيرًا
translation: And give the relative his right, and [also] the poor and the traveler, and do not spend wastefully
normalizedArabic: وءات ذا القربي حقه والمسكين وابن السبيل ولا تبذر تبذيرا
normalizedTranslation: and give the relative his right, and [also] the poor and the traveler, and do not spend wastefully

arabic: إِنَّ ٱلۡمُبَذِّرِينَ كَانُوٓاْ إِخۡوَٰنَ ٱلشَّيَٰطِينِۖ وَكَانَ ٱلشَّيۡطَٰنُ لِرَبِّهِۦ كَفُورٗا
translation: Indeed, the wasteful are brothers of the devils, and ever has Satan been to his Lord ungrateful
normalizedArabic: ان المبذرين كانوا اخون الشيطين وكان الشيطن لربه كفورا
normalizedTranslation: indeed, the wasteful are brothers of the devils, and ever has satan been to his lord ungrateful

arabic: وَإِمَّا تُعۡرِضَنَّ عَنۡهُمُ ٱبۡتِغَآءَ رَحۡمَةٖ مِّن رَّبِّكَ تَرۡجُوهَا فَقُل لَّهُمۡ قَوۡلٗا مَّيۡسُورٗا
translation: And if you [must] turn away from the needy awaiting mercy from your Lord which you expect, then speak to them a gentle word
normalizedArabic: واما تعرضن عنهم ابتغاء رحمه من ربك ترجوها فقل لهم قولا ميسورا
normalizedTranslation: and if you [must] turn away from the needy awaiting mercy from your lord which you expect, then speak to them a gentle word

arabic: وَلَا تَجۡعَلۡ يَدَكَ مَغۡلُولَةً إِلَىٰ عُنُقِكَ وَلَا تَبۡسُطۡهَا كُلَّ ٱلۡبَسۡطِ فَتَقۡعُدَ مَلُومٗا مَّحۡسُورًا
translation: And do not make your hand [as] chained to your neck or extend it completely and [thereby] become blamed and insolvent
normalizedArabic: ولا تجعل يدك مغلوله الي عنقك ولا تبسطها كل البسط فتقعد ملوما محسورا
normalizedTranslation: and do not make your hand [as] chained to your neck or extend it completely and [thereby] become blamed and insolvent

arabic: إِنَّ رَبَّكَ يَبۡسُطُ ٱلرِّزۡقَ لِمَن يَشَآءُ وَيَقۡدِرُۚ إِنَّهُۥ كَانَ بِعِبَادِهِۦ خَبِيرَۢا بَصِيرٗا
translation: Indeed, your Lord extends provision for whom He wills and restricts [it]. Indeed He is ever, concerning His servants, Acquainted and Seeing
normalizedArabic: ان ربك يبسط الرزق لمن يشاء ويقدر انه كان بعباده خبيرا بصيرا
normalizedTranslation: indeed, your lord extends provision for whom he wills and restricts [it]. indeed he is ever, concerning his servants, acquainted and seeing

arabic: وَلَا تَقۡتُلُوٓاْ أَوۡلَٰدَكُمۡ خَشۡيَةَ إِمۡلَٰقٖۖ نَّحۡنُ نَرۡزُقُهُمۡ وَإِيَّاكُمۡۚ إِنَّ قَتۡلَهُمۡ كَانَ خِطۡـٔٗا كَبِيرٗا
translation: And do not kill your children for fear of poverty. We provide for them and for you. Indeed, their killing is ever a great sin
normalizedArabic: ولا تقتلوا اولدكم خشيه املق نحن نرزقهم واياكم ان قتلهم كان خطا كبيرا
normalizedTranslation: and do not kill your children for fear of poverty. we provide for them and for you. indeed, their killing is ever a great sin

arabic: وَلَا تَقۡرَبُواْ ٱلزِّنَىٰٓۖ إِنَّهُۥ كَانَ فَٰحِشَةٗ وَسَآءَ سَبِيلٗا
translation: And do not approach unlawful sexual intercourse. Indeed, it is ever an immorality and is evil as a way
normalizedArabic: ولا تقربوا الزني انه كان فحشه وساء سبيلا
normalizedTranslation: and do not approach unlawful sexual intercourse. indeed, it is ever an immorality and is evil as a way

arabic: وَلَا تَقۡتُلُواْ ٱلنَّفۡسَ ٱلَّتِي حَرَّمَ ٱللَّهُ إِلَّا بِٱلۡحَقِّۗ وَمَن قُتِلَ مَظۡلُومٗا فَقَدۡ جَعَلۡنَا لِوَلِيِّهِۦ سُلۡطَٰنٗا فَلَا يُسۡرِف فِّي ٱلۡقَتۡلِۖ إِنَّهُۥ كَانَ مَنصُورٗا
translation: And do not kill the soul which Allah has forbidden, except by right. And whoever is killed unjustly - We have given his heir authority, but let him not exceed limits in [the matter of] taking life. Indeed, he has been supported [by the law]
normalizedArabic: ولا تقتلوا النفس التي حرم الله الا بالحق ومن قتل مظلوما فقد جعلنا لوليه سلطنا فلا يسرف في القتل انه كان منصورا
normalizedTranslation: and do not kill the soul which allah has forbidden, except by right. and whoever is killed unjustly - we have given his heir authority, but let him not exceed limits in [the matter of] taking life. indeed, he has been supported [by the law]

arabic: وَلَا تَقۡرَبُواْ مَالَ ٱلۡيَتِيمِ إِلَّا بِٱلَّتِي هِيَ أَحۡسَنُ حَتَّىٰ يَبۡلُغَ أَشُدَّهُۥۚ وَأَوۡفُواْ بِٱلۡعَهۡدِۖ إِنَّ ٱلۡعَهۡدَ كَانَ مَسۡـُٔولٗا
translation: And do not approach the property of an orphan, except in the way that is best, until he reaches maturity. And fulfill [every] commitment. Indeed, the commitment is ever [that about which one will be] questioned
normalizedArabic: ولا تقربوا مال اليتيم الا بالتي هي احسن حتي يبلغ اشده واوفوا بالعهد ان العهد كان مسولا
normalizedTranslation: and do not approach the property of an orphan, except in the way that is best, until he reaches maturity. and fulfill [every] commitment. indeed, the commitment is ever [that about which one will be] questioned

arabic: وَأَوۡفُواْ ٱلۡكَيۡلَ إِذَا كِلۡتُمۡ وَزِنُواْ بِٱلۡقِسۡطَاسِ ٱلۡمُسۡتَقِيمِۚ ذَٰلِكَ خَيۡرٞ وَأَحۡسَنُ تَأۡوِيلٗا
translation: And give full measure when you measure, and weigh with an even balance. That is the best [way] and best in result
normalizedArabic: واوفوا الكيل اذا كلتم وزنوا بالقسطاس المستقيم ذلك خير واحسن تاويلا
normalizedTranslation: and give full measure when you measure, and weigh with an even balance. that is the best [way] and best in result

arabic: وَلَا تَقۡفُ مَا لَيۡسَ لَكَ بِهِۦ عِلۡمٌۚ إِنَّ ٱلسَّمۡعَ وَٱلۡبَصَرَ وَٱلۡفُؤَادَ كُلُّ أُوْلَـٰٓئِكَ كَانَ عَنۡهُ مَسۡـُٔولٗا
translation: And do not pursue that of which you have no knowledge. Indeed, the hearing, the sight and the heart - about all those [one] will be questioned
normalizedArabic: ولا تقف ما ليس لك به علم ان السمع والبصر والفواد كل اوليك كان عنه مسولا
normalizedTranslation: and do not pursue that of which you have no knowledge. indeed, the hearing, the sight and the heart - about all those [one] will be questioned

arabic: وَلَا تَمۡشِ فِي ٱلۡأَرۡضِ مَرَحًاۖ إِنَّكَ لَن تَخۡرِقَ ٱلۡأَرۡضَ وَلَن تَبۡلُغَ ٱلۡجِبَالَ طُولٗا
translation: And do not walk upon the earth exultantly. Indeed, you will never tear the earth [apart], and you will never reach the mountains in height
normalizedArabic: ولا تمش في الارض مرحا انك لن تخرق الارض ولن تبلغ الجبال طولا
normalizedTranslation: and do not walk upon the earth exultantly. indeed, you will never tear the earth [apart], and you will never reach the mountains in height

arabic: كُلُّ ذَٰلِكَ كَانَ سَيِّئُهُۥ عِندَ رَبِّكَ مَكۡرُوهٗا
translation: All that - its evil is ever, in the sight of your Lord, detested
normalizedArabic: كل ذلك كان سييه عند ربك مكروها
normalizedTranslation: all that - its evil is ever, in the sight of your lord, detested

arabic: ذَٰلِكَ مِمَّآ أَوۡحَىٰٓ إِلَيۡكَ رَبُّكَ مِنَ ٱلۡحِكۡمَةِۗ وَلَا تَجۡعَلۡ مَعَ ٱللَّهِ إِلَٰهًا ءَاخَرَ فَتُلۡقَىٰ فِي جَهَنَّمَ مَلُومٗا مَّدۡحُورًا
translation: That is from what your Lord has revealed to you, [O Muhammad], of wisdom. And, [O mankind], do not make [as equal] with Allah another deity, lest you be thrown into Hell, blamed and banished
normalizedArabic: ذلك مما اوحي اليك ربك من الحكمه ولا تجعل مع الله الها ءاخر فتلقي في جهنم ملوما مدحورا
normalizedTranslation: that is from what your lord has revealed to you, [o muhammad], of wisdom. and, [o mankind], do not make [as equal] with allah another deity, lest you be thrown into hell, blamed and banished

arabic: أَفَأَصۡفَىٰكُمۡ رَبُّكُم بِٱلۡبَنِينَ وَٱتَّخَذَ مِنَ ٱلۡمَلَـٰٓئِكَةِ إِنَٰثًاۚ إِنَّكُمۡ لَتَقُولُونَ قَوۡلًا عَظِيمٗا
translation: Then, has your Lord chosen you for [having] sons and taken from among the angels daughters? Indeed, you say a grave saying
normalizedArabic: افاصفيكم ربكم بالبنين واتخذ من المليكه انثا انكم لتقولون قولا عظيما
normalizedTranslation: then, has your lord chosen you for [having] sons and taken from among the angels daughters? indeed, you say a grave saying

arabic: وَلَقَدۡ صَرَّفۡنَا فِي هَٰذَا ٱلۡقُرۡءَانِ لِيَذَّكَّرُواْ وَمَا يَزِيدُهُمۡ إِلَّا نُفُورٗا
translation: And We have certainly diversified [the contents] in this Qur'an that mankind may be reminded, but it does not increase the disbelievers except in aversion
normalizedArabic: ولقد صرفنا في هذا القرءان ليذكروا وما يزيدهم الا نفورا
normalizedTranslation: and we have certainly diversified [the contents] in this qur'an that mankind may be reminded, but it does not increase the disbelievers except in aversion

arabic: قُل لَّوۡ كَانَ مَعَهُۥٓ ءَالِهَةٞ كَمَا يَقُولُونَ إِذٗا لَّٱبۡتَغَوۡاْ إِلَىٰ ذِي ٱلۡعَرۡشِ سَبِيلٗا
translation: Say, [O Muhammad], "If there had been with Him [other] gods, as they say, then they [each] would have sought to the Owner of the Throne a way
normalizedArabic: قل لو كان معه ءالهه كما يقولون اذا لابتغوا الي ذي العرش سبيلا
normalizedTranslation: say, [o muhammad], "if there had been with him [other] gods, as they say, then they [each] would have sought to the owner of the throne a way

arabic: سُبۡحَٰنَهُۥ وَتَعَٰلَىٰ عَمَّا يَقُولُونَ عُلُوّٗا كَبِيرٗا
translation: Exalted is He and high above what they say by great sublimity
normalizedArabic: سبحنه وتعلي عما يقولون علوا كبيرا
normalizedTranslation: exalted is he and high above what they say by great sublimity

arabic: تُسَبِّحُ لَهُ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتُ ٱلسَّبۡعُ وَٱلۡأَرۡضُ وَمَن فِيهِنَّۚ وَإِن مِّن شَيۡءٍ إِلَّا يُسَبِّحُ بِحَمۡدِهِۦ وَلَٰكِن لَّا تَفۡقَهُونَ تَسۡبِيحَهُمۡۚ إِنَّهُۥ كَانَ حَلِيمًا غَفُورٗا
translation: The seven heavens and the earth and whatever is in them exalt Him. And there is not a thing except that it exalts [Allah] by His praise, but you do not understand their [way of] exalting. Indeed, He is ever Forbearing and Forgiving
normalizedArabic: تسبح له السموت السبع والارض ومن فيهن وان من شيء الا يسبح بحمده ولكن لا تفقهون تسبيحهم انه كان حليما غفورا
normalizedTranslation: the seven heavens and the earth and whatever is in them exalt him. and there is not a thing except that it exalts [allah] by his praise, but you do not understand their [way of] exalting. indeed, he is ever forbearing and forgiving

arabic: وَإِذَا قَرَأۡتَ ٱلۡقُرۡءَانَ جَعَلۡنَا بَيۡنَكَ وَبَيۡنَ ٱلَّذِينَ لَا يُؤۡمِنُونَ بِٱلۡأٓخِرَةِ حِجَابٗا مَّسۡتُورٗا
translation: And when you recite the Qur'an, We put between you and those who do not believe in the Hereafter a concealed partition
normalizedArabic: واذا قرات القرءان جعلنا بينك وبين الذين لا يومنون بالاخره حجابا مستورا
normalizedTranslation: and when you recite the qur'an, we put between you and those who do not believe in the hereafter a concealed partition

arabic: وَجَعَلۡنَا عَلَىٰ قُلُوبِهِمۡ أَكِنَّةً أَن يَفۡقَهُوهُ وَفِيٓ ءَاذَانِهِمۡ وَقۡرٗاۚ وَإِذَا ذَكَرۡتَ رَبَّكَ فِي ٱلۡقُرۡءَانِ وَحۡدَهُۥ وَلَّوۡاْ عَلَىٰٓ أَدۡبَٰرِهِمۡ نُفُورٗا
translation: And We have placed over their hearts coverings, lest they understand it, and in their ears deafness. And when you mention your Lord alone in the Qur'an, they turn back in aversion
normalizedArabic: وجعلنا علي قلوبهم اكنه ان يفقهوه وفي ءاذانهم وقرا واذا ذكرت ربك في القرءان وحده ولوا علي ادبرهم نفورا
normalizedTranslation: and we have placed over their hearts coverings, lest they understand it, and in their ears deafness. and when you mention your lord alone in the qur'an, they turn back in aversion

arabic: نَّحۡنُ أَعۡلَمُ بِمَا يَسۡتَمِعُونَ بِهِۦٓ إِذۡ يَسۡتَمِعُونَ إِلَيۡكَ وَإِذۡ هُمۡ نَجۡوَىٰٓ إِذۡ يَقُولُ ٱلظَّـٰلِمُونَ إِن تَتَّبِعُونَ إِلَّا رَجُلٗا مَّسۡحُورًا
translation: We are most knowing of how they listen to it when they listen to you and [of] when they are in private conversation, when the wrongdoers say, "You follow not but a man affected by magic
normalizedArabic: نحن اعلم بما يستمعون به اذ يستمعون اليك واذ هم نجوي اذ يقول الظلمون ان تتبعون الا رجلا مسحورا
normalizedTranslation: we are most knowing of how they listen to it when they listen to you and [of] when they are in private conversation, when the wrongdoers say, "you follow not but a man affected by magic

arabic: ٱنظُرۡ كَيۡفَ ضَرَبُواْ لَكَ ٱلۡأَمۡثَالَ فَضَلُّواْ فَلَا يَسۡتَطِيعُونَ سَبِيلٗا
translation: Look how they strike for you comparisons; but they have strayed, so they cannot [find] a way
normalizedArabic: انظر كيف ضربوا لك الامثال فضلوا فلا يستطيعون سبيلا
normalizedTranslation: look how they strike for you comparisons; but they have strayed, so they cannot [find] a way

arabic: وَقَالُوٓاْ أَءِذَا كُنَّا عِظَٰمٗا وَرُفَٰتًا أَءِنَّا لَمَبۡعُوثُونَ خَلۡقٗا جَدِيدٗا
translation: And they say, "When we are bones and crumbled particles, will we [truly] be resurrected as a new creation

normalizedTranslation: and they say, "when we are bones and crumbled particles, will we [truly] be resurrected as a new creation

arabic: رَّبُّكُمۡ أَعۡلَمُ بِكُمۡۖ إِن يَشَأۡ يَرۡحَمۡكُمۡ أَوۡ إِن يَشَأۡ يُعَذِّبۡكُمۡۚ وَمَآ أَرۡسَلۡنَٰكَ عَلَيۡهِمۡ وَكِيلٗا

translation: And your Lord is most knowing of whoever is in the heavens and the earth. And We have made some of the prophets exceed others [in various ways], and to David We gave the book [of Psalms]

arabic: قُلِ ٱدۡعُواْ ٱلَّذِينَ زَعَمۡتُم مِّن دُونِهِۦ فَلَا يَمۡلِكُونَ كَشۡفَ ٱلضُّرِّ عَنكُمۡ وَلَا تَحۡوِيلًا
