arabic: وَذَا ٱلنُّونِ إِذ ذَّهَبَ مُغَٰضِبٗا فَظَنَّ أَن لَّن نَّقۡدِرَ عَلَيۡهِ فَنَادَىٰ فِي ٱلظُّلُمَٰتِ أَن لَّآ إِلَٰهَ إِلَّآ أَنتَ سُبۡحَٰنَكَ إِنِّي كُنتُ مِنَ ٱلظَّـٰلِمِينَ
translation: And [mention] the man of the fish, when he went off in anger and thought that We would not decree [anything] upon him. And he called out within the darknesses, "There is no deity except You; exalted are You. Indeed, I have been of the wrongdoers
normalizedArabic: وذا النون اذ ذهب مغضبا فظن ان لن نقدر عليه فنادي في الظلمت ان لا اله الا انت سبحنك اني كنت من الظلمين
normalizedTranslation: and [mention] the man of the fish, when he went off in anger and thought that we would not decree [anything] upon him. and he called out within the darknesses, "there is no deity except you; exalted are you. indeed, i have been of the wrongdoers

arabic: فَٱسۡتَجَبۡنَا لَهُۥ وَنَجَّيۡنَٰهُ مِنَ ٱلۡغَمِّۚ وَكَذَٰلِكَ نُـۨجِي ٱلۡمُؤۡمِنِينَ
translation: So We responded to him and saved him from the distress. And thus do We save the believers
normalizedArabic: فاستجبنا له ونجينه من الغم وكذلك نجي المومنين
normalizedTranslation: so we responded to him and saved him from the distress. and thus do we save the believers

arabic: وَزَكَرِيَّآ إِذۡ نَادَىٰ رَبَّهُۥ رَبِّ لَا تَذَرۡنِي فَرۡدٗا وَأَنتَ خَيۡرُ ٱلۡوَٰرِثِينَ
translation: And [mention] Zechariah, when he called to his Lord, "My Lord, do not leave me alone [with no heir], while you are the best of inheritors
normalizedArabic: وزكريا اذ نادي ربه رب لا تذرني فردا وانت خير الورثين
normalizedTranslation: and [mention] zechariah, when he called to his lord, "my lord, do not leave me alone [with no heir], while you are the best of inheritors

arabic: فَٱسۡتَجَبۡنَا لَهُۥ وَوَهَبۡنَا لَهُۥ يَحۡيَىٰ وَأَصۡلَحۡنَا لَهُۥ زَوۡجَهُۥٓۚ إِنَّهُمۡ كَانُواْ يُسَٰرِعُونَ فِي ٱلۡخَيۡرَٰتِ وَيَدۡعُونَنَا رَغَبٗا وَرَهَبٗاۖ وَكَانُواْ لَنَا خَٰشِعِينَ
translation: So We responded to him, and We gave to him John, and amended for him his wife. Indeed, they used to hasten to good deeds and supplicate Us in hope and fear, and they were to Us humbly submissive
normalizedArabic: فاستجبنا له ووهبنا له يحيي واصلحنا له زوجه انهم كانوا يسرعون في الخيرت ويدعوننا رغبا ورهبا وكانوا لنا خشعين
normalizedTranslation: so we responded to him, and we gave to him john, and amended for him his wife. indeed, they used to hasten to good deeds and supplicate us in hope and fear, and they were to us humbly submissive

arabic: وَٱلَّتِيٓ أَحۡصَنَتۡ فَرۡجَهَا فَنَفَخۡنَا فِيهَا مِن رُّوحِنَا وَجَعَلۡنَٰهَا وَٱبۡنَهَآ ءَايَةٗ لِّلۡعَٰلَمِينَ
translation: And [mention] the one who guarded her chastity, so We blew into her [garment] through Our angel [Gabriel], and We made her and her son a sign for the worlds
normalizedArabic: والتي احصنت فرجها فنفخنا فيها من روحنا وجعلنها وابنها ءايه للعلمين
normalizedTranslation: and [mention] the one who guarded her chastity, so we blew into her [garment] through our angel [gabriel], and we made her and her son a sign for the worlds

arabic: إِنَّ هَٰذِهِۦٓ أُمَّتُكُمۡ أُمَّةٗ وَٰحِدَةٗ وَأَنَا۠ رَبُّكُمۡ فَٱعۡبُدُونِ
translation: Indeed this, your religion, is one religion, and I am your Lord, so worship Me
normalizedArabic: ان هذه امتكم امه وحده وانا ربكم فاعبدون
normalizedTranslation: indeed this, your religion, is one religion, and i am your lord, so worship me

arabic: وَتَقَطَّعُوٓاْ أَمۡرَهُم بَيۡنَهُمۡۖ كُلٌّ إِلَيۡنَا رَٰجِعُونَ
translation: And [yet] they divided their affair among themselves, [but] all to Us will return
normalizedArabic: وتقطعوا امرهم بينهم كل الينا رجعون
normalizedTranslation: and [yet] they divided their affair among themselves, [but] all to us will return

arabic: فَمَن يَعۡمَلۡ مِنَ ٱلصَّـٰلِحَٰتِ وَهُوَ مُؤۡمِنٞ فَلَا كُفۡرَانَ لِسَعۡيِهِۦ وَإِنَّا لَهُۥ كَٰتِبُونَ
translation: So whoever does righteous deeds while he is a believer - no denial will there be for his effort, and indeed We, of it, are recorders
normalizedArabic: فمن يعمل من الصلحت وهو مومن فلا كفران لسعيه وانا له كتبون
normalizedTranslation: so whoever does righteous deeds while he is a believer - no denial will there be for his effort, and indeed we, of it, are recorders

arabic: وَحَرَٰمٌ عَلَىٰ قَرۡيَةٍ أَهۡلَكۡنَٰهَآ أَنَّهُمۡ لَا يَرۡجِعُونَ
translation: And there is prohibition upon [the people of] a city which We have destroyed that they will [ever] return
normalizedArabic: وحرم علي قريه اهلكنها انهم لا يرجعون
normalizedTranslation: and there is prohibition upon [the people of] a city which we have destroyed that they will [ever] return

arabic: حَتَّىٰٓ إِذَا فُتِحَتۡ يَأۡجُوجُ وَمَأۡجُوجُ وَهُم مِّن كُلِّ حَدَبٖ يَنسِلُونَ
translation: Until when [the dam of] Gog and Magog has been opened and they, from every elevation, descend
normalizedArabic: حتي اذا فتحت ياجوج وماجوج وهم من كل حدب ينسلون
normalizedTranslation: until when [the dam of] gog and magog has been opened and they, from every elevation, descend

arabic: وَٱقۡتَرَبَ ٱلۡوَعۡدُ ٱلۡحَقُّ فَإِذَا هِيَ شَٰخِصَةٌ أَبۡصَٰرُ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُواْ يَٰوَيۡلَنَا قَدۡ كُنَّا فِي غَفۡلَةٖ مِّنۡ هَٰذَا بَلۡ كُنَّا ظَٰلِمِينَ
translation: And [when] the true promise has approached; then suddenly the eyes of those who disbelieved will be staring [in horror, while they say], "O woe to us; we had been unmindful of this; rather, we were wrongdoers
normalizedArabic: واقترب الوعد الحق فاذا هي شخصه ابصر الذين كفروا يويلنا قد كنا في غفله من هذا بل كنا ظلمين
normalizedTranslation: and [when] the true promise has approached; then suddenly the eyes of those who disbelieved will be staring [in horror, while they say], "o woe to us; we had been unmindful of this; rather, we were wrongdoers

arabic: إِنَّكُمۡ وَمَا تَعۡبُدُونَ مِن دُونِ ٱللَّهِ حَصَبُ جَهَنَّمَ أَنتُمۡ لَهَا وَٰرِدُونَ
translation: Indeed, you [disbelievers] and what you worship other than Allah are the firewood of Hell. You will be coming to [enter] it
normalizedArabic: انكم وما تعبدون من دون الله حصب جهنم انتم لها وردون
normalizedTranslation: indeed, you [disbelievers] and what you worship other than allah are the firewood of hell. you will be coming to [enter] it

arabic: لَوۡ كَانَ هَـٰٓؤُلَآءِ ءَالِهَةٗ مَّا وَرَدُوهَاۖ وَكُلّٞ فِيهَا خَٰلِدُونَ
translation: Had these [false deities] been [actual] gods, they would not have come to it, but all are eternal therein
normalizedArabic: لو كان هولاء ءالهه ما وردوها وكل فيها خلدون
normalizedTranslation: had these [false deities] been [actual] gods, they would not have come to it, but all are eternal therein

arabic: لَهُمۡ فِيهَا زَفِيرٞ وَهُمۡ فِيهَا لَا يَسۡمَعُونَ
translation: For them therein is heavy sighing, and they therein will not hear
normalizedArabic: لهم فيها زفير وهم فيها لا يسمعون
normalizedTranslation: for them therein is heavy sighing, and they therein will not hear

arabic: إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ سَبَقَتۡ لَهُم مِّنَّا ٱلۡحُسۡنَىٰٓ أُوْلَـٰٓئِكَ عَنۡهَا مُبۡعَدُونَ
translation: Indeed, those for whom the best [reward] has preceded from Us - they are from it far removed
normalizedArabic: ان الذين سبقت لهم منا الحسني اوليك عنها مبعدون
normalizedTranslation: indeed, those for whom the best [reward] has preceded from us - they are from it far removed

arabic: لَا يَسۡمَعُونَ حَسِيسَهَاۖ وَهُمۡ فِي مَا ٱشۡتَهَتۡ أَنفُسُهُمۡ خَٰلِدُونَ
translation: They will not hear its sound, while they are, in that which their souls desire, abiding eternally
normalizedArabic: لا يسمعون حسيسها وهم في ما اشتهت انفسهم خلدون
normalizedTranslation: they will not hear its sound, while they are, in that which their souls desire, abiding eternally

arabic: لَا يَحۡزُنُهُمُ ٱلۡفَزَعُ ٱلۡأَكۡبَرُ وَتَتَلَقَّىٰهُمُ ٱلۡمَلَـٰٓئِكَةُ هَٰذَا يَوۡمُكُمُ ٱلَّذِي كُنتُمۡ تُوعَدُونَ
translation: They will not be grieved by the greatest terror, and the angels will meet them, [saying], "This is your Day which you have been promised
normalizedArabic: لا يحزنهم الفزع الاكبر وتتلقيهم المليكه هذا يومكم الذي كنتم توعدون
normalizedTranslation: they will not be grieved by the greatest terror, and the angels will meet them, [saying], "this is your day which you have been promised

arabic: يَوۡمَ نَطۡوِي ٱلسَّمَآءَ كَطَيِّ ٱلسِّجِلِّ لِلۡكُتُبِۚ كَمَا بَدَأۡنَآ أَوَّلَ خَلۡقٖ نُّعِيدُهُۥۚ وَعۡدًا عَلَيۡنَآۚ إِنَّا كُنَّا فَٰعِلِينَ
translation: The Day when We will fold the heaven like the folding of a [written] sheet for the records. As We began the first creation, We will repeat it. [That is] a promise binding upon Us. Indeed, We will do it
normalizedArabic: يوم نطوي السماء كطي السجل للكتب كما بدانا اول خلق نعيده وعدا علينا انا كنا فعلين
normalizedTranslation: the day when we will fold the heaven like the folding of a [written] sheet for the records. as we began the first creation, we will repeat it. [that is] a promise binding upon us. indeed, we will do it

arabic: وَلَقَدۡ كَتَبۡنَا فِي ٱلزَّبُورِ مِنۢ بَعۡدِ ٱلذِّكۡرِ أَنَّ ٱلۡأَرۡضَ يَرِثُهَا عِبَادِيَ ٱلصَّـٰلِحُونَ
translation: And We have already written in the book [of Psalms] after the [previous] mention that the land [of Paradise] is inherited by My righteous servants

normalizedTranslation: and we have already written in the book [of psalms] after the [previous] mention that the land [of paradise] is inherited by my righteous servants

arabic: إِنَّ فِي هَٰذَا لَبَلَٰغٗا لِّقَوۡمٍ عَٰبِدِينَ
translation: Indeed, in this [Qur'an] is notification for a worshipping people
normalizedArabic: ان في هذا لبلغا لقوم عبدين
normalizedTranslation: indeed, in this [qur'an] is notification for a worshipping people

arabic: وَمَآ أَرۡسَلۡنَٰكَ إِلَّا رَحۡمَةٗ لِّلۡعَٰلَمِينَ
translation: And We have not sent you, [O Muhammad], except as a mercy to the worlds
normalizedArabic: وما ارسلنك الا رحمه للعلمين
normalizedTranslation: and we have not sent you, [o muhammad], except as a mercy to the worlds

arabic: قُلۡ إِنَّمَا يُوحَىٰٓ إِلَيَّ أَنَّمَآ إِلَٰهُكُمۡ إِلَٰهٞ وَٰحِدٞۖ فَهَلۡ أَنتُم مُّسۡلِمُونَ
translation: Say, "It is only revealed to me that your god is but one God; so will you be Muslims [in submission to Him]
normalizedArabic: قل انما يوحي الي انما الهكم اله وحد فهل انتم مسلمون
normalizedTranslation: say, "it is only revealed to me that your god is but one god; so will you be muslims [in submission to him]

arabic: فَإِن تَوَلَّوۡاْ فَقُلۡ ءَاذَنتُكُمۡ عَلَىٰ سَوَآءٖۖ وَإِنۡ أَدۡرِيٓ أَقَرِيبٌ أَم بَعِيدٞ مَّا تُوعَدُونَ
translation: But if they turn away, then say, "I have announced to [all of] you equally. And I know not whether near or far is that which you are promised
normalizedArabic: فان تولوا فقل ءاذنتكم علي سواء وان ادري اقريب ام بعيد ما توعدون
normalizedTranslation: but if they turn away, then say, "i have announced to [all of] you equally. and i know not whether near or far is that which you are promised

arabic: إِنَّهُۥ يَعۡلَمُ ٱلۡجَهۡرَ مِنَ ٱلۡقَوۡلِ وَيَعۡلَمُ مَا تَكۡتُمُونَ
translation: Indeed, He knows what is declared of speech, and He knows what you conceal
normalizedArabic: انه يعلم الجهر من القول ويعلم ما تكتمون
normalizedTranslation: indeed, he knows what is declared of speech, and he knows what you conceal

arabic: وَإِنۡ أَدۡرِي لَعَلَّهُۥ فِتۡنَةٞ لَّكُمۡ وَمَتَٰعٌ إِلَىٰ حِينٖ
translation: And I know not; perhaps it is a trial for you and enjoyment for a time
normalizedArabic: وان ادري لعله فتنه لكم ومتع الي حين
normalizedTranslation: and i know not; perhaps it is a trial for you and enjoyment for a time

arabic: قَٰلَ رَبِّ ٱحۡكُم بِٱلۡحَقِّۗ وَرَبُّنَا ٱلرَّحۡمَٰنُ ٱلۡمُسۡتَعَانُ عَلَىٰ مَا تَصِفُونَ
translation: [The Prophet] has said, "My Lord, judge [between us] in truth. And our Lord is the Most Merciful, the one whose help is sought against that which you describe
normalizedArabic: قل رب احكم بالحق وربنا الرحمن المستعان علي ما تصفون
normalizedTranslation: [the prophet] has said, "my lord, judge [between us] in truth. and our lord is the most merciful, the one whose help is sought against that which you describe

arabic: يَـٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلنَّاسُ ٱتَّقُواْ رَبَّكُمۡۚ إِنَّ زَلۡزَلَةَ ٱلسَّاعَةِ شَيۡءٌ عَظِيمٞ
translation: O mankind, fear your Lord. Indeed, the convulsion of the [final] Hour is a terrible thing
normalizedArabic: يايها الناس اتقوا ربكم ان زلزله الساعه شيء عظيم
normalizedTranslation: o mankind, fear your lord. indeed, the convulsion of the [final] hour is a terrible thing

arabic: يَوۡمَ تَرَوۡنَهَا تَذۡهَلُ كُلُّ مُرۡضِعَةٍ عَمَّآ أَرۡضَعَتۡ وَتَضَعُ كُلُّ ذَاتِ حَمۡلٍ حَمۡلَهَا وَتَرَى ٱلنَّاسَ سُكَٰرَىٰ وَمَا هُم بِسُكَٰرَىٰ وَلَٰكِنَّ عَذَابَ ٱللَّهِ شَدِيدٞ
translation: On the Day you see it every nursing mother will be distracted from that [child] she was nursing, and every pregnant woman will abort her pregnancy, and you will see the people [appearing] intoxicated while they are not intoxicated; but the punishment of Allah is severe
normalizedArabic: يوم ترونها تذهل كل مرضعه عما ارضعت وتضع كل ذات حمل حملها وتري الناس سكري وما هم بسكري ولكن عذاب الله شديد
normalizedTranslation: on the day you see it every nursing mother will be distracted from that [child] she was nursing, and every pregnant woman will abort her pregnancy, and you will see the people [appearing] intoxicated while they are not intoxicated; but the punishment of allah is severe

arabic: وَمِنَ ٱلنَّاسِ مَن يُجَٰدِلُ فِي ٱللَّهِ بِغَيۡرِ عِلۡمٖ وَيَتَّبِعُ كُلَّ شَيۡطَٰنٖ مَّرِيدٖ
translation: And of the people is he who disputes about Allah without knowledge and follows every rebellious devil
normalizedArabic: ومن الناس من يجدل في الله بغير علم ويتبع كل شيطن مريد
normalizedTranslation: and of the people is he who disputes about allah without knowledge and follows every rebellious devil

arabic: كُتِبَ عَلَيۡهِ أَنَّهُۥ مَن تَوَلَّاهُ فَأَنَّهُۥ يُضِلُّهُۥ وَيَهۡدِيهِ إِلَىٰ عَذَابِ ٱلسَّعِيرِ
translation: It has been decreed for every devil that whoever turns to him - he will misguide him and will lead him to the punishment of the Blaze
normalizedArabic: كتب عليه انه من تولاه فانه يضله ويهديه الي عذاب السعير
normalizedTranslation: it has been decreed for every devil that whoever turns to him - he will misguide him and will lead him to the punishment of the blaze

arabic: يَـٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلنَّاسُ إِن كُنتُمۡ فِي رَيۡبٖ مِّنَ ٱلۡبَعۡثِ فَإِنَّا خَلَقۡنَٰكُم مِّن تُرَابٖ ثُمَّ مِن نُّطۡفَةٖ ثُمَّ مِنۡ عَلَقَةٖ ثُمَّ مِن مُّضۡغَةٖ مُّخَلَّقَةٖ وَغَيۡرِ مُخَلَّقَةٖ لِّنُبَيِّنَ لَكُمۡۚ وَنُقِرُّ فِي ٱلۡأَرۡحَامِ مَا نَشَآءُ إِلَىٰٓ أَجَلٖ مُّسَمّٗى ثُمَّ نُخۡرِجُكُمۡ طِفۡلٗا ثُمَّ لِتَبۡلُغُوٓاْ أَشُدَّكُمۡۖ وَمِنكُم مَّن يُتَوَفَّىٰ وَمِنكُم مَّن يُرَدُّ إِلَىٰٓ أَرۡذَلِ ٱلۡعُمُرِ لِكَيۡلَا يَعۡلَمَ مِنۢ بَعۡدِ عِلۡمٖ شَيۡـٔٗاۚ وَتَرَى ٱلۡأَرۡضَ هَامِدَةٗ فَإِذَآ أَنزَلۡنَا عَلَيۡهَا ٱلۡمَآءَ ٱهۡتَزَّتۡ وَرَبَتۡ وَأَنۢبَتَتۡ مِن كُلِّ زَوۡجِۭ بَهِيجٖ
translation: O People, if you should be in doubt about the Resurrection, then [consider that] indeed, We created you from dust, then from a sperm-drop, then from a clinging clot, and then from a lump of flesh, formed and unformed - that We may show you. And We settle in the wombs whom We will for a specified term, then We bring you out as a child, and then [We develop you] that you may reach your [time of] maturity. And among you is he who is taken in [early] death, and among you is he who is returned to the most decrepit [old] age so that he knows, after [once having] knowledge, nothing. And you see the earth barren, but when We send down upon it rain, it quivers and swells and grows [something] of every beautiful kind

arabic: ذَٰلِكَ بِأَنَّ ٱللَّهَ هُوَ ٱلۡحَقُّ وَأَنَّهُۥ يُحۡيِ ٱلۡمَوۡتَىٰ وَأَنَّهُۥ عَلَىٰ كُلِّ شَيۡءٖ قَدِيرٞ

normalizedArabic: ثم ليقضوا تفثهم وليوفوا نذورهم وليطوفوا بالبيت العتيق
normalizedTranslation: then let them end their untidiness and fulfill their vows and perform tawaf around the ancient house

arabic: ذَٰلِكَۖ وَمَن يُعَظِّمۡ حُرُمَٰتِ ٱللَّهِ فَهُوَ خَيۡرٞ لَّهُۥ عِندَ رَبِّهِۦۗ وَأُحِلَّتۡ لَكُمُ ٱلۡأَنۡعَٰمُ إِلَّا مَا يُتۡلَىٰ عَلَيۡكُمۡۖ فَٱجۡتَنِبُواْ ٱلرِّجۡسَ مِنَ ٱلۡأَوۡثَٰنِ وَٱجۡتَنِبُواْ قَوۡلَ ٱلزُّورِ
translation: That [has been commanded], and whoever honors the sacred ordinances of Allah - it is best for him in the sight of his Lord. And permitted to you are the grazing livestock, except what is recited to you. So avoid the uncleanliness of idols and avoid false statement
normalizedArabic: ذلك ومن يعظم حرمت الله فهو خير له عند ربه واحلت لكم الانعم الا ما يتلي عليكم فاجتنبوا الرجس من الاوثن واجتنبوا قول الزور
normalizedTranslation: that [has been commanded], and whoever honors the sacred ordinances of allah - it is best for him in the sight of his lord. and permitted to you are the grazing livestock, except what is recited to you. so avoid the uncleanliness of idols and avoid false statement

arabic: حُنَفَآءَ لِلَّهِ غَيۡرَ مُشۡرِكِينَ بِهِۦۚ وَمَن يُشۡرِكۡ بِٱللَّهِ فَكَأَنَّمَا خَرَّ مِنَ ٱلسَّمَآءِ فَتَخۡطَفُهُ ٱلطَّيۡرُ أَوۡ تَهۡوِي بِهِ ٱلرِّيحُ فِي مَكَانٖ سَحِيقٖ
translation: Inclining [only] to Allah, not associating [anything] with Him. And he who associates with Allah - it is as though he had fallen from the sky and was snatched by the birds or the wind carried him down into a remote place
normalizedArabic: حنفاء لله غير مشركين به ومن يشرك بالله فكانما خر من السماء فتخطفه الطير او تهوي به الريح في مكان سحيق
normalizedTranslation: inclining [only] to allah, not associating [anything] with him. and he who associates with allah - it is as though he had fallen from the sky and was snatched by the birds or the wind carried him down into a remote place

arabic: ذَٰلِكَۖ وَمَن يُعَظِّمۡ شَعَـٰٓئِرَ ٱللَّهِ فَإِنَّهَا مِن تَقۡوَى ٱلۡقُلُوبِ
translation: That [is so]. And whoever honors the symbols of Allah - indeed, it is from the piety of hearts
normalizedArabic: ذلك ومن يعظم شعير الله فانها من تقوي القلوب
normalizedTranslation: that [is so]. and whoever honors the symbols of allah - indeed, it is from the piety of hearts

arabic: لَكُمۡ فِيهَا مَنَٰفِعُ إِلَىٰٓ أَجَلٖ مُّسَمّٗى ثُمَّ مَحِلُّهَآ إِلَى ٱلۡبَيۡتِ ٱلۡعَتِيقِ
translation: For you the animals marked for sacrifice are benefits for a specified term; then their place of sacrifice is at the ancient House
normalizedArabic: لكم فيها منفع الي اجل مسمي ثم محلها الي البيت العتيق
normalizedTranslation: for you the animals marked for sacrifice are benefits for a specified term; then their place of sacrifice is at the ancient house

arabic: وَلِكُلِّ أُمَّةٖ جَعَلۡنَا مَنسَكٗا لِّيَذۡكُرُواْ ٱسۡمَ ٱللَّهِ عَلَىٰ مَا رَزَقَهُم مِّنۢ بَهِيمَةِ ٱلۡأَنۡعَٰمِۗ فَإِلَٰهُكُمۡ إِلَٰهٞ وَٰحِدٞ فَلَهُۥٓ أَسۡلِمُواْۗ وَبَشِّرِ ٱلۡمُخۡبِتِينَ
translation: And for all religion We have appointed a rite [of sacrifice] that they may mention the name of Allah over what He has provided for them of [sacrificial] animals. For your god is one God, so to Him submit. And, [O Muhammad], give good tidings to the humble [before their Lord]
normalizedArabic: ولكل امه جعلنا منسكا ليذكروا اسم الله علي ما رزقهم من بهيمه الانعم فالهكم اله وحد فله اسلموا وبشر المخبتين
normalizedTranslation: and for all religion we have appointed a rite [of sacrifice] that they may mention the name of allah over what he has provided for them of [sacrificial] animals. for your god is one god, so to him submit. and, [o muhammad], give good tidings to the humble [before their lord]

arabic: ٱلَّذِينَ إِذَا ذُكِرَ ٱللَّهُ وَجِلَتۡ قُلُوبُهُمۡ وَٱلصَّـٰبِرِينَ عَلَىٰ مَآ أَصَابَهُمۡ وَٱلۡمُقِيمِي ٱلصَّلَوٰةِ وَمِمَّا رَزَقۡنَٰهُمۡ يُنفِقُونَ
translation: Who, when Allah is mentioned, their hearts are fearful, and [to] the patient over what has afflicted them, and the establishers of prayer and those who spend from what We have provided them
normalizedArabic: الذين اذا ذكر الله وجلت قلوبهم والصبرين علي ما اصابهم والمقيمي الصلوه ومما رزقنهم ينفقون
normalizedTranslation: who, when allah is mentioned, their hearts are fearful, and [to] the patient over what has afflicted them, and the establishers of prayer and those who spend from what we have provided them

arabic: وَٱلۡبُدۡنَ جَعَلۡنَٰهَا لَكُم مِّن شَعَـٰٓئِرِ ٱللَّهِ لَكُمۡ فِيهَا خَيۡرٞۖ فَٱذۡكُرُواْ ٱسۡمَ ٱللَّهِ عَلَيۡهَا صَوَآفَّۖ فَإِذَا وَجَبَتۡ جُنُوبُهَا فَكُلُواْ مِنۡهَا وَأَطۡعِمُواْ ٱلۡقَانِعَ وَٱلۡمُعۡتَرَّۚ كَذَٰلِكَ سَخَّرۡنَٰهَا لَكُمۡ لَعَلَّكُمۡ تَشۡكُرُونَ
translation: And the camels and cattle We have appointed for you as among the symbols of Allah; for you therein is good. So mention the name of Allah upon them when lined up [for sacrifice]; and when they are [lifeless] on their sides, then eat from them and feed the needy and the beggar. Thus have We subjected them to you that you may be grateful
normalizedArabic: والبدن جعلنها لكم من شعير الله لكم فيها خير فاذكروا اسم الله عليها صواف فاذا وجبت جنوبها فكلوا منها واطعموا القانع والمعتر كذلك سخرنها لكم لعلكم تشكرون
normalizedTranslation: and the camels and cattle we have appointed for you as among the symbols of allah; for you therein is good. so mention the name of allah upon them when lined up [for sacrifice]; and when they are [lifeless] on their sides, then eat from them and feed the needy and the beggar. thus have we subjected them to you that you may be grateful

arabic: لَن يَنَالَ ٱللَّهَ لُحُومُهَا وَلَا دِمَآؤُهَا وَلَٰكِن يَنَالُهُ ٱلتَّقۡوَىٰ مِنكُمۡۚ كَذَٰلِكَ سَخَّرَهَا لَكُمۡ لِتُكَبِّرُواْ ٱللَّهَ عَلَىٰ مَا هَدَىٰكُمۡۗ وَبَشِّرِ ٱلۡمُحۡسِنِينَ
translation: Their meat will not reach Allah, nor will their blood, but what reaches Him is piety from you. Thus have We subjected them to you that you may glorify Allah for that [to] which He has guided you; and give good tidings to the doers of good
normalizedArabic: لن ينال الله لحومها ولا دماوها ولكن يناله التقوي منكم كذلك سخرها لكم لتكبروا الله علي ما هديكم وبشر المحسنين
normalizedTranslation: their meat will not reach allah, nor will their blood, but what reaches him is piety from you. thus have we subjected them to you that you may glorify allah for that [to] which he has guided you; and give good tidings to the doers of good

arabic: ۞إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ يُدَٰفِعُ عَنِ ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوٓاْۗ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ لَا يُحِبُّ كُلَّ خَوَّانٖ كَفُورٍ
translation: Indeed, Allah defends those who have believed. Indeed, Allah does not like everyone treacherous and ungrateful
normalizedArabic: ان الله يدفع عن الذين ءامنوا ان الله لا يحب كل خوان كفور
normalizedTranslation: indeed, allah defends those who have believed. indeed, allah does not like everyone treacherous and ungrateful

arabic: أُذِنَ لِلَّذِينَ يُقَٰتَلُونَ بِأَنَّهُمۡ ظُلِمُواْۚ وَإِنَّ ٱللَّهَ عَلَىٰ نَصۡرِهِمۡ لَقَدِيرٌ
translation: Permission [to fight] has been given to those who are being fought, because they were wronged. And indeed, Allah is competent to give them victory
normalizedArabic: اذن للذين يقتلون بانهم ظلموا وان الله علي نصرهم لقدير
normalizedTranslation: permission [to fight] has been given to those who are being fought, because they were wronged. and indeed, allah is competent to give them victory

arabic: ٱلَّذِينَ أُخۡرِجُواْ مِن دِيَٰرِهِم بِغَيۡرِ حَقٍّ إِلَّآ أَن يَقُولُواْ رَبُّنَا ٱللَّهُۗ وَلَوۡلَا دَفۡعُ ٱللَّهِ ٱلنَّاسَ بَعۡضَهُم بِبَعۡضٖ لَّهُدِّمَتۡ صَوَٰمِعُ وَبِيَعٞ وَصَلَوَٰتٞ وَمَسَٰجِدُ يُذۡكَرُ فِيهَا ٱسۡمُ ٱللَّهِ كَثِيرٗاۗ وَلَيَنصُرَنَّ ٱللَّهُ مَن يَنصُرُهُۥٓۚ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ لَقَوِيٌّ عَزِيزٌ
translation: [They are] those who have been evicted from their homes without right - only because they say, "Our Lord is Allah." And were it not that Allah checks the people, some by means of others, there would have been demolished monasteries, churches, synagogues, and mosques in which the name of Allah is much mentioned. And Allah will surely support those who support Him. Indeed, Allah is Powerful and Exalted in Might
normalizedArabic: الذين اخرجوا من ديرهم بغير حق الا ان يقولوا ربنا الله ولولا دفع الله الناس بعضهم ببعض لهدمت صومع وبيع وصلوت ومسجد يذكر فيها اسم الله كثيرا ولينصرن الله من ينصره ان الله لقوي عزيز
normalizedTranslation: [they are] those who have been evicted from their homes without right - only because they say, "our lord is allah." and were it not that allah checks the people, some by means of others, there would have been demolished monasteries, churches, synagogues, and mosques in which the name of allah is much mentioned. and allah will surely support those who support him. indeed, allah is powerful and exalted in might

arabic: ٱلَّذِينَ إِن مَّكَّنَّـٰهُمۡ فِي ٱلۡأَرۡضِ أَقَامُواْ ٱلصَّلَوٰةَ وَءَاتَوُاْ ٱلزَّكَوٰةَ وَأَمَرُواْ بِٱلۡمَعۡرُوفِ وَنَهَوۡاْ عَنِ ٱلۡمُنكَرِۗ وَلِلَّهِ عَٰقِبَةُ ٱلۡأُمُورِ
translation: [And they are] those who, if We give them authority in the land, establish prayer and give zakah and enjoin what is right and forbid what is wrong. And to Allah belongs the outcome of [all] matters
normalizedArabic: الذين ان مكنهم في الارض اقاموا الصلوه وءاتوا الزكوه وامروا بالمعروف ونهوا عن المنكر ولله عقبه الامور
normalizedTranslation: [and they are] those who, if we give them authority in the land, establish prayer and give zakah and enjoin what is right and forbid what is wrong. and to allah belongs the outcome of [all] matters

arabic: وَإِن يُكَذِّبُوكَ فَقَدۡ كَذَّبَتۡ قَبۡلَهُمۡ قَوۡمُ نُوحٖ وَعَادٞ وَثَمُودُ
translation: And if they deny you, [O Muhammad] - so, before them, did the people of Noah and 'Aad and Thamud deny [their prophets]
normalizedArabic: وان يكذبوك فقد كذبت قبلهم قوم نوح وعاد وثمود
normalizedTranslation: and if they deny you, [o muhammad] - so, before them, did the people of noah and 'aad and thamud deny [their prophets]

arabic: وَقَوۡمُ إِبۡرَٰهِيمَ وَقَوۡمُ لُوطٖ
translation: And the people of Abraham and the people of Lot
normalizedArabic: وقوم ابرهيم وقوم لوط
normalizedTranslation: and the people of abraham and the people of lot

arabic: وَأَصۡحَٰبُ مَدۡيَنَۖ وَكُذِّبَ مُوسَىٰۖ فَأَمۡلَيۡتُ لِلۡكَٰفِرِينَ ثُمَّ أَخَذۡتُهُمۡۖ فَكَيۡفَ كَانَ نَكِيرِ
translation: And the inhabitants of Madyan. And Moses was denied, so I prolonged enjoyment for the disbelievers; then I seized them, and how [terrible] was My reproach
normalizedArabic: واصحب مدين وكذب موسي فامليت للكفرين ثم اخذتهم فكيف كان نكير
normalizedTranslation: and the inhabitants of madyan. and moses was denied, so i prolonged enjoyment for the disbelievers; then i seized them, and how [terrible] was my reproach

arabic: فَكَأَيِّن مِّن قَرۡيَةٍ أَهۡلَكۡنَٰهَا وَهِيَ ظَالِمَةٞ فَهِيَ خَاوِيَةٌ عَلَىٰ عُرُوشِهَا وَبِئۡرٖ مُّعَطَّلَةٖ وَقَصۡرٖ مَّشِيدٍ
translation: And how many a city did We destroy while it was committing wrong - so it is [now] fallen into ruin - and [how many] an abandoned well and [how many] a lofty palace
normalizedArabic: فكاين من قريه اهلكنها وهي ظالمه فهي خاويه علي عروشها وبير معطله وقصر مشيد
normalizedTranslation: and how many a city did we destroy while it was committing wrong - so it is [now] fallen into ruin - and [how many] an abandoned well and [how many] a lofty palace

arabic: أَفَلَمۡ يَسِيرُواْ فِي ٱلۡأَرۡضِ فَتَكُونَ لَهُمۡ قُلُوبٞ يَعۡقِلُونَ بِهَآ أَوۡ ءَاذَانٞ يَسۡمَعُونَ بِهَاۖ فَإِنَّهَا لَا تَعۡمَى ٱلۡأَبۡصَٰرُ وَلَٰكِن تَعۡمَى ٱلۡقُلُوبُ ٱلَّتِي فِي ٱلصُّدُورِ
translation: So have they not traveled through the earth and have hearts by which to reason and ears by which to hear? For indeed, it is not eyes that are blinded, but blinded are the hearts which are within the breasts
normalizedArabic: افلم يسيروا في الارض فتكون لهم قلوب يعقلون بها او ءاذان يسمعون بها فانها لا تعمي الابصر ولكن تعمي القلوب التي في الصدور
normalizedTranslation: so have they not traveled through the earth and have hearts by which to reason and ears by which to hear? for indeed, it is not eyes that are blinded, but blinded are the hearts which are within the breasts

arabic: وَيَسۡتَعۡجِلُونَكَ بِٱلۡعَذَابِ وَلَن يُخۡلِفَ ٱللَّهُ وَعۡدَهُۥۚ وَإِنَّ يَوۡمًا عِندَ رَبِّكَ كَأَلۡفِ سَنَةٖ مِّمَّا تَعُدُّونَ
translation: And they urge you to hasten the punishment. But Allah will never fail in His promise. And indeed, a day with your Lord is like a thousand years of those which you count
normalizedArabic: ويستعجلونك بالعذاب ولن يخلف الله وعده وان يوما عند ربك كالف سنه مما تعدون
normalizedTranslation: and they urge you to hasten the punishment. but allah will never fail in his promise. and indeed, a day with your lord is like a thousand years of those which you count

arabic: وَكَأَيِّن مِّن قَرۡيَةٍ أَمۡلَيۡتُ لَهَا وَهِيَ ظَالِمَةٞ ثُمَّ أَخَذۡتُهَا وَإِلَيَّ ٱلۡمَصِيرُ
translation: And for how many a city did I prolong enjoyment while it was committing wrong. Then I seized it, and to Me is the [final] destination
normalizedArabic: وكاين من قريه امليت لها وهي ظالمه ثم اخذتها والي المصير
normalizedTranslation: and for how many a city did i prolong enjoyment while it was committing wrong. then i seized it, and to me is the [final] destination

arabic: قُلۡ يَـٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلنَّاسُ إِنَّمَآ أَنَا۠ لَكُمۡ نَذِيرٞ مُّبِينٞ
translation: Say, "O people, I am only to you a clear warner
normalizedArabic: قل يايها الناس انما انا لكم نذير مبين
normalizedTranslation: say, "o people, i am only to you a clear warner

arabic: فَٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُواْ وَعَمِلُواْ ٱلصَّـٰلِحَٰتِ لَهُم مَّغۡفِرَةٞ وَرِزۡقٞ كَرِيمٞ
translation: And those who have believed and done righteous deeds - for them is forgiveness and noble provision
normalizedArabic: فالذين ءامنوا وعملوا الصلحت لهم مغفره ورزق كريم
normalizedTranslation: and those who have believed and done righteous deeds - for them is forgiveness and noble provision

arabic: وَٱلَّذِينَ سَعَوۡاْ فِيٓ ءَايَٰتِنَا مُعَٰجِزِينَ أُوْلَـٰٓئِكَ أَصۡحَٰبُ ٱلۡجَحِيمِ
translation: But the ones who strove against Our verses, [seeking] to cause failure - those are the companions of Hellfire
normalizedArabic: والذين سعوا في ءايتنا معجزين اوليك اصحب الجحيم
normalizedTranslation: but the ones who strove against our verses, [seeking] to cause failure - those are the companions of hellfire

arabic: وَمَآ أَرۡسَلۡنَا مِن قَبۡلِكَ مِن رَّسُولٖ وَلَا نَبِيٍّ إِلَّآ إِذَا تَمَنَّىٰٓ أَلۡقَى ٱلشَّيۡطَٰنُ فِيٓ أُمۡنِيَّتِهِۦ فَيَنسَخُ ٱللَّهُ مَا يُلۡقِي ٱلشَّيۡطَٰنُ ثُمَّ يُحۡكِمُ ٱللَّهُ ءَايَٰتِهِۦۗ وَٱللَّهُ عَلِيمٌ حَكِيمٞ
translation: And We did not send before you any messenger or prophet except that when he spoke [or recited], Satan threw into it [some misunderstanding]. But Allah abolishes that which Satan throws in; then Allah makes precise His verses. And Allah is Knowing and Wise
normalizedArabic: وما ارسلنا من قبلك من رسول ولا نبي الا اذا تمني القي الشيطن في امنيته فينسخ الله ما يلقي الشيطن ثم يحكم الله ءايته والله عليم حكيم
normalizedTranslation: and we did not send before you any messenger or prophet except that when he spoke [or recited], satan threw into it [some misunderstanding]. but allah abolishes that which satan throws in; then allah makes precise his verses. and allah is knowing and wise

arabic: لِّيَجۡعَلَ مَا يُلۡقِي ٱلشَّيۡطَٰنُ فِتۡنَةٗ لِّلَّذِينَ فِي قُلُوبِهِم مَّرَضٞ وَٱلۡقَاسِيَةِ قُلُوبُهُمۡۗ وَإِنَّ ٱلظَّـٰلِمِينَ لَفِي شِقَاقِۭ بَعِيدٖ
translation: [That is] so He may make what Satan throws in a trial for those within whose hearts is disease and those hard of heart. And indeed, the wrongdoers are in extreme dissension
normalizedArabic: ليجعل ما يلقي الشيطن فتنه للذين في قلوبهم مرض والقاسيه قلوبهم وان الظلمين لفي شقاق بعيد
normalizedTranslation: [that is] so he may make what satan throws in a trial for those within whose hearts is disease and those hard of heart. and indeed, the wrongdoers are in extreme dissension

arabic: وَلِيَعۡلَمَ ٱلَّذِينَ أُوتُواْ ٱلۡعِلۡمَ أَنَّهُ ٱلۡحَقُّ مِن رَّبِّكَ فَيُؤۡمِنُواْ بِهِۦ فَتُخۡبِتَ لَهُۥ قُلُوبُهُمۡۗ وَإِنَّ ٱللَّهَ لَهَادِ ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوٓاْ إِلَىٰ صِرَٰطٖ مُّسۡتَقِيمٖ
translation: And so those who were given knowledge may know that it is the truth from your Lord and [therefore] believe in it, and their hearts humbly submit to it. And indeed is Allah the Guide of those who have believed to a straight path
normalizedArabic: وليعلم الذين اوتوا العلم انه الحق من ربك فيومنوا به فتخبت له قلوبهم وان الله لهاد الذين ءامنوا الي صرط مستقيم
normalizedTranslation: and so those who were given knowledge may know that it is the truth from your lord and [therefore] believe in it, and their hearts humbly submit to it. and indeed is allah the guide of those who have believed to a straight path

arabic: وَلَا يَزَالُ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُواْ فِي مِرۡيَةٖ مِّنۡهُ حَتَّىٰ تَأۡتِيَهُمُ ٱلسَّاعَةُ بَغۡتَةً أَوۡ يَأۡتِيَهُمۡ عَذَابُ يَوۡمٍ عَقِيمٍ
translation: But those who disbelieve will not cease to be in doubt of it until the Hour comes upon them unexpectedly or there comes to them the punishment of a barren Day
normalizedArabic: ولا يزال الذين كفروا في مريه منه حتي تاتيهم الساعه بغته او ياتيهم عذاب يوم عقيم
normalizedTranslation: but those who disbelieve will not cease to be in doubt of it until the hour comes upon them unexpectedly or there comes to them the punishment of a barren day

arabic: ٱلۡمُلۡكُ يَوۡمَئِذٖ لِّلَّهِ يَحۡكُمُ بَيۡنَهُمۡۚ فَٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُواْ وَعَمِلُواْ ٱلصَّـٰلِحَٰتِ فِي جَنَّـٰتِ ٱلنَّعِيمِ
translation: [All] sovereignty that Day is for Allah; He will judge between them. So they who believed and did righteous deeds will be in the Gardens of Pleasure
normalizedArabic: الملك يوميذ لله يحكم بينهم فالذين ءامنوا وعملوا الصلحت في جنت النعيم
normalizedTranslation: [all] sovereignty that day is for allah; he will judge between them. so they who believed and did righteous deeds will be in the gardens of pleasure

arabic: وَٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُواْ وَكَذَّبُواْ بِـَٔايَٰتِنَا فَأُوْلَـٰٓئِكَ لَهُمۡ عَذَابٞ مُّهِينٞ
translation: And they who disbelieved and denied Our signs - for those there will be a humiliating punishment
normalizedArabic: والذين كفروا وكذبوا بايتنا فاوليك لهم عذاب مهين
normalizedTranslation: and they who disbelieved and denied our signs - for those there will be a humiliating punishment

arabic: وَٱلَّذِينَ هَاجَرُواْ فِي سَبِيلِ ٱللَّهِ ثُمَّ قُتِلُوٓاْ أَوۡ مَاتُواْ لَيَرۡزُقَنَّهُمُ ٱللَّهُ رِزۡقًا حَسَنٗاۚ وَإِنَّ ٱللَّهَ لَهُوَ خَيۡرُ ٱلرَّـٰزِقِينَ
translation: And those who emigrated for the cause of Allah and then were killed or died - Allah will surely provide for them a good provision. And indeed, it is Allah who is the best of providers
normalizedArabic: والذين هاجروا في سبيل الله ثم قتلوا او ماتوا ليرزقنهم الله رزقا حسنا وان الله لهو خير الرزقين
normalizedTranslation: and those who emigrated for the cause of allah and then were killed or died - allah will surely provide for them a good provision. and indeed, it is allah who is the best of providers

arabic: لَيُدۡخِلَنَّهُم مُّدۡخَلٗا يَرۡضَوۡنَهُۥۚ وَإِنَّ ٱللَّهَ لَعَلِيمٌ حَلِيمٞ
translation: He will surely cause them to enter an entrance with which they will be pleased, and indeed, Allah is Knowing and Forbearing
normalizedArabic: ليدخلنهم مدخلا يرضونه وان الله لعليم حليم
normalizedTranslation: he will surely cause them to enter an entrance with which they will be pleased, and indeed, allah is knowing and forbearing

arabic: ۞ذَٰلِكَۖ وَمَنۡ عَاقَبَ بِمِثۡلِ مَا عُوقِبَ بِهِۦ ثُمَّ بُغِيَ عَلَيۡهِ لَيَنصُرَنَّهُ ٱللَّهُۚ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ لَعَفُوٌّ غَفُورٞ
translation: That [is so]. And whoever responds [to injustice] with the equivalent of that with which he was harmed and then is tyrannized - Allah will surely aid him. Indeed, Allah is Pardoning and Forgiving
normalizedArabic: ذلك ومن عاقب بمثل ما عوقب به ثم بغي عليه لينصرنه الله ان الله لعفو غفور
normalizedTranslation: that [is so]. and whoever responds [to injustice] with the equivalent of that with which he was harmed and then is tyrannized - allah will surely aid him. indeed, allah is pardoning and forgiving

arabic: ذَٰلِكَ بِأَنَّ ٱللَّهَ يُولِجُ ٱلَّيۡلَ فِي ٱلنَّهَارِ وَيُولِجُ ٱلنَّهَارَ فِي ٱلَّيۡلِ وَأَنَّ ٱللَّهَ سَمِيعُۢ بَصِيرٞ
translation: That is because Allah causes the night to enter the day and causes the day to enter the night and because Allah is Hearing and Seeing
normalizedArabic: ذلك بان الله يولج اليل في النهار ويولج النهار في اليل وان الله سميع بصير
normalizedTranslation: that is because allah causes the night to enter the day and causes the day to enter the night and because allah is hearing and seeing

arabic: ذَٰلِكَ بِأَنَّ ٱللَّهَ هُوَ ٱلۡحَقُّ وَأَنَّ مَا يَدۡعُونَ مِن دُونِهِۦ هُوَ ٱلۡبَٰطِلُ وَأَنَّ ٱللَّهَ هُوَ ٱلۡعَلِيُّ ٱلۡكَبِيرُ
translation: That is because Allah is the Truth, and that which they call upon other than Him is falsehood, and because Allah is the Most High, the Grand
normalizedArabic: ذلك بان الله هو الحق وان ما يدعون من دونه هو البطل وان الله هو العلي الكبير
normalizedTranslation: that is because allah is the truth, and that which they call upon other than him is falsehood, and because allah is the most high, the grand

arabic: أَلَمۡ تَرَ أَنَّ ٱللَّهَ أَنزَلَ مِنَ ٱلسَّمَآءِ مَآءٗ فَتُصۡبِحُ ٱلۡأَرۡضُ مُخۡضَرَّةًۚ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ لَطِيفٌ خَبِيرٞ
translation: Do you not see that Allah has sent down rain from the sky and the earth becomes green? Indeed, Allah is Subtle and Acquainted
normalizedArabic: الم تر ان الله انزل من السماء ماء فتصبح الارض مخضره ان الله لطيف خبير
normalizedTranslation: do you not see that allah has sent down rain from the sky and the earth becomes green? indeed, allah is subtle and acquainted

arabic: لَّهُۥ مَا فِي ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَمَا فِي ٱلۡأَرۡضِۚ وَإِنَّ ٱللَّهَ لَهُوَ ٱلۡغَنِيُّ ٱلۡحَمِيدُ
translation: To Him belongs what is in the heavens and what is on the earth. And indeed, Allah is the Free of need, the Praiseworthy
normalizedArabic: له ما في السموت وما في الارض وان الله لهو الغني الحميد
normalizedTranslation: to him belongs what is in the heavens and what is on the earth. and indeed, allah is the free of need, the praiseworthy

arabic: أَلَمۡ تَرَ أَنَّ ٱللَّهَ سَخَّرَ لَكُم مَّا فِي ٱلۡأَرۡضِ وَٱلۡفُلۡكَ تَجۡرِي فِي ٱلۡبَحۡرِ بِأَمۡرِهِۦ وَيُمۡسِكُ ٱلسَّمَآءَ أَن تَقَعَ عَلَى ٱلۡأَرۡضِ إِلَّا بِإِذۡنِهِۦٓۚ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ بِٱلنَّاسِ لَرَءُوفٞ رَّحِيمٞ
translation: Do you not see that Allah has subjected to you whatever is on the earth and the ships which run through the sea by His command? And He restrains the sky from falling upon the earth, unless by His permission. Indeed Allah, to the people, is Kind and Merciful
normalizedArabic: الم تر ان الله سخر لكم ما في الارض والفلك تجري في البحر بامره ويمسك السماء ان تقع علي الارض الا باذنه ان الله بالناس لرءوف رحيم
normalizedTranslation: do you not see that allah has subjected to you whatever is on the earth and the ships which run through the sea by his command? and he restrains the sky from falling upon the earth, unless by his permission. indeed allah, to the people, is kind and merciful

arabic: وَهُوَ ٱلَّذِيٓ أَحۡيَاكُمۡ ثُمَّ يُمِيتُكُمۡ ثُمَّ يُحۡيِيكُمۡۗ إِنَّ ٱلۡإِنسَٰنَ لَكَفُورٞ
translation: And He is the one who gave you life; then He causes you to die and then will [again] give you life. Indeed, mankind is ungrateful
normalizedArabic: وهو الذي احياكم ثم يميتكم ثم يحييكم ان الانسن لكفور
normalizedTranslation: and he is the one who gave you life; then he causes you to die and then will [again] give you life. indeed, mankind is ungrateful

arabic: لِّكُلِّ أُمَّةٖ جَعَلۡنَا مَنسَكًا هُمۡ نَاسِكُوهُۖ فَلَا يُنَٰزِعُنَّكَ فِي ٱلۡأَمۡرِۚ وَٱدۡعُ إِلَىٰ رَبِّكَۖ إِنَّكَ لَعَلَىٰ هُدٗى مُّسۡتَقِيمٖ
translation: For every religion We have appointed rites which they perform. So, [O Muhammad], let the disbelievers not contend with you over the matter but invite them to your Lord. Indeed, you are upon straight guidance
normalizedArabic: لكل امه جعلنا منسكا هم ناسكوه فلا ينزعنك في الامر وادع الي ربك انك لعلي هدي مستقيم
normalizedTranslation: for every religion we have appointed rites which they perform. so, [o muhammad], let the disbelievers not contend with you over the matter but invite them to your lord. indeed, you are upon straight guidance

arabic: وَإِن جَٰدَلُوكَ فَقُلِ ٱللَّهُ أَعۡلَمُ بِمَا تَعۡمَلُونَ
translation: And if they dispute with you, then say, "Allah is most knowing of what you do
normalizedArabic: وان جدلوك فقل الله اعلم بما تعملون
normalizedTranslation: and if they dispute with you, then say, "allah is most knowing of what you do

arabic: ٱللَّهُ يَحۡكُمُ بَيۡنَكُمۡ يَوۡمَ ٱلۡقِيَٰمَةِ فِيمَا كُنتُمۡ فِيهِ تَخۡتَلِفُونَ
translation: Allah will judge between you on the Day of Resurrection concerning that over which you used to differ
normalizedArabic: الله يحكم بينكم يوم القيمه فيما كنتم فيه تختلفون
normalizedTranslation: allah will judge between you on the day of resurrection concerning that over which you used to differ

arabic: أَلَمۡ تَعۡلَمۡ أَنَّ ٱللَّهَ يَعۡلَمُ مَا فِي ٱلسَّمَآءِ وَٱلۡأَرۡضِۚ إِنَّ ذَٰلِكَ فِي كِتَٰبٍۚ إِنَّ ذَٰلِكَ عَلَى ٱللَّهِ يَسِيرٞ
translation: Do you not know that Allah knows what is in the heaven and earth? Indeed, that is in a Record. Indeed that, for Allah, is easy
normalizedArabic: الم تعلم ان الله يعلم ما في السماء والارض ان ذلك في كتب ان ذلك علي الله يسير
normalizedTranslation: do you not know that allah knows what is in the heaven and earth? indeed, that is in a record. indeed that, for allah, is easy

arabic: وَيَعۡبُدُونَ مِن دُونِ ٱللَّهِ مَا لَمۡ يُنَزِّلۡ بِهِۦ سُلۡطَٰنٗا وَمَا لَيۡسَ لَهُم بِهِۦ عِلۡمٞۗ وَمَا لِلظَّـٰلِمِينَ مِن نَّصِيرٖ
translation: And they worship besides Allah that for which He has not sent down authority and that of which they have no knowledge. And there will not be for the wrongdoers any helper
normalizedArabic: ويعبدون من دون الله ما لم ينزل به سلطنا وما ليس لهم به علم وما للظلمين من نصير
normalizedTranslation: and they worship besides allah that for which he has not sent down authority and that of which they have no knowledge. and there will not be for the wrongdoers any helper

arabic: وَإِذَا تُتۡلَىٰ عَلَيۡهِمۡ ءَايَٰتُنَا بَيِّنَٰتٖ تَعۡرِفُ فِي وُجُوهِ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُواْ ٱلۡمُنكَرَۖ يَكَادُونَ يَسۡطُونَ بِٱلَّذِينَ يَتۡلُونَ عَلَيۡهِمۡ ءَايَٰتِنَاۗ قُلۡ أَفَأُنَبِّئُكُم بِشَرّٖ مِّن ذَٰلِكُمُۚ ٱلنَّارُ وَعَدَهَا ٱللَّهُ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُواْۖ وَبِئۡسَ ٱلۡمَصِيرُ
translation: And when Our verses are recited to them as clear evidences, you recognize in the faces of those who disbelieve disapproval. They are almost on the verge of assaulting those who recite to them Our verses. Say, "Then shall I inform you of [what is] worse than that? [It is] the Fire which Allah has promised those who disbelieve, and wretched is the destination
normalizedArabic: واذا تتلي عليهم ءايتنا بينت تعرف في وجوه الذين كفروا المنكر يكادون يسطون بالذين يتلون عليهم ءايتنا قل افانبيكم بشر من ذلكم النار وعدها الله الذين كفروا وبيس المصير
normalizedTranslation: and when our verses are recited to them as clear evidences, you recognize in the faces of those who disbelieve disapproval. they are almost on the verge of assaulting those who recite to them our verses. say, "then shall i inform you of [what is] worse than that? [it is] the fire which allah has promised those who disbelieve, and wretched is the destination

arabic: يَـٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلنَّاسُ ضُرِبَ مَثَلٞ فَٱسۡتَمِعُواْ لَهُۥٓۚ إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ تَدۡعُونَ مِن دُونِ ٱللَّهِ لَن يَخۡلُقُواْ ذُبَابٗا وَلَوِ ٱجۡتَمَعُواْ لَهُۥۖ وَإِن يَسۡلُبۡهُمُ ٱلذُّبَابُ شَيۡـٔٗا لَّا يَسۡتَنقِذُوهُ مِنۡهُۚ ضَعُفَ ٱلطَّالِبُ وَٱلۡمَطۡلُوبُ
translation: O people, an example is presented, so listen to it. Indeed, those you invoke besides Allah will never create [as much as] a fly, even if they gathered together for that purpose. And if the fly should steal away from them a [tiny] thing, they could not recover it from him. Weak are the pursuer and pursued
normalizedArabic: يايها الناس ضرب مثل فاستمعوا له ان الذين تدعون من دون الله لن يخلقوا ذبابا ولو اجتمعوا له وان يسلبهم الذباب شيا لا يستنقذوه منه ضعف الطالب والمطلوب
normalizedTranslation: o people, an example is presented, so listen to it. indeed, those you invoke besides allah will never create [as much as] a fly, even if they gathered together for that purpose. and if the fly should steal away from them a [tiny] thing, they could not recover it from him. weak are the pursuer and pursued

arabic: مَا قَدَرُواْ ٱللَّهَ حَقَّ قَدۡرِهِۦٓۚ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ لَقَوِيٌّ عَزِيزٌ
translation: They have not appraised Allah with true appraisal. Indeed, Allah is Powerful and Exalted in Might
normalizedArabic: ما قدروا الله حق قدره ان الله لقوي عزيز
normalizedTranslation: they have not appraised allah with true appraisal. indeed, allah is powerful and exalted in might

arabic: ٱللَّهُ يَصۡطَفِي مِنَ ٱلۡمَلَـٰٓئِكَةِ رُسُلٗا وَمِنَ ٱلنَّاسِۚ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ سَمِيعُۢ بَصِيرٞ
translation: Allah chooses from the angels messengers and from the people. Indeed, Allah is Hearing and Seeing
normalizedArabic: الله يصطفي من المليكه رسلا ومن الناس ان الله سميع بصير
normalizedTranslation: allah chooses from the angels messengers and from the people. indeed, allah is hearing and seeing

arabic: يَعۡلَمُ مَا بَيۡنَ أَيۡدِيهِمۡ وَمَا خَلۡفَهُمۡۚ وَإِلَى ٱللَّهِ تُرۡجَعُ ٱلۡأُمُورُ
translation: He knows what is [presently] before them and what will be after them. And to Allah will be returned [all] matters
normalizedArabic: يعلم ما بين ايديهم وما خلفهم والي الله ترجع الامور
normalizedTranslation: he knows what is [presently] before them and what will be after them. and to allah will be returned [all] matters

arabic: يَـٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُواْ ٱرۡكَعُواْ وَٱسۡجُدُواْۤ وَٱعۡبُدُواْ رَبَّكُمۡ وَٱفۡعَلُواْ ٱلۡخَيۡرَ لَعَلَّكُمۡ تُفۡلِحُونَ۩
translation: O you who have believed, bow and prostrate and worship your Lord and do good - that you may succeed
normalizedArabic: يايها الذين ءامنوا اركعوا واسجدوا واعبدوا ربكم وافعلوا الخير لعلكم تفلحون
normalizedTranslation: o you who have believed, bow and prostrate and worship your lord and do good - that you may succeed

arabic: وَجَٰهِدُواْ فِي ٱللَّهِ حَقَّ جِهَادِهِۦۚ هُوَ ٱجۡتَبَىٰكُمۡ وَمَا جَعَلَ عَلَيۡكُمۡ فِي ٱلدِّينِ مِنۡ حَرَجٖۚ مِّلَّةَ أَبِيكُمۡ إِبۡرَٰهِيمَۚ هُوَ سَمَّىٰكُمُ ٱلۡمُسۡلِمِينَ مِن قَبۡلُ وَفِي هَٰذَا لِيَكُونَ ٱلرَّسُولُ شَهِيدًا عَلَيۡكُمۡ وَتَكُونُواْ شُهَدَآءَ عَلَى ٱلنَّاسِۚ فَأَقِيمُواْ ٱلصَّلَوٰةَ وَءَاتُواْ ٱلزَّكَوٰةَ وَٱعۡتَصِمُواْ بِٱللَّهِ هُوَ مَوۡلَىٰكُمۡۖ فَنِعۡمَ ٱلۡمَوۡلَىٰ وَنِعۡمَ ٱلنَّصِيرُ
translation: And strive for Allah with the striving due to Him. He has chosen you and has not placed upon you in the religion any difficulty. [It is] the religion of your father, Abraham. Allah named you "Muslims" before [in former scriptures] and in this [revelation] that the Messenger may be a witness over you and you may be witnesses over the people. So establish prayer and give zakah and hold fast to Allah. He is your protector; and excellent is the protector, and excellent is the helper

arabic: قَالَ رَبِّ ٱنصُرۡنِي بِمَا كَذَّبُونِ
translation: He said, "My Lord, support me because they have denied me
normalizedArabic: قال رب انصرني بما كذبون
normalizedTranslation: he said, "my lord, support me because they have denied me

arabic: قَالَ عَمَّا قَلِيلٖ لَّيُصۡبِحُنَّ نَٰدِمِينَ
translation: [Allah] said, "After a little, they will surely become regretful
normalizedArabic: قال عما قليل ليصبحن ندمين
normalizedTranslation: [allah] said, "after a little, they will surely become regretful

arabic: فَأَخَذَتۡهُمُ ٱلصَّيۡحَةُ بِٱلۡحَقِّ فَجَعَلۡنَٰهُمۡ غُثَآءٗۚ فَبُعۡدٗا لِّلۡقَوۡمِ ٱلظَّـٰلِمِينَ
translation: So the shriek seized them in truth, and We made them as [plant] stubble. Then away with the wrongdoing people
normalizedArabic: فاخذتهم الصيحه بالحق فجعلنهم غثاء فبعدا للقوم الظلمين
normalizedTranslation: so the shriek seized them in truth, and we made them as [plant] stubble. then away with the wrongdoing people

arabic: ثُمَّ أَنشَأۡنَا مِنۢ بَعۡدِهِمۡ قُرُونًا ءَاخَرِينَ
translation: Then We produced after them other generations
normalizedArabic: ثم انشانا من بعدهم قرونا ءاخرين
normalizedTranslation: then we produced after them other generations

arabic: مَا تَسۡبِقُ مِنۡ أُمَّةٍ أَجَلَهَا وَمَا يَسۡتَـٔۡخِرُونَ
translation: No nation will precede its time [of termination], nor will they remain [thereafter]
normalizedArabic: ما تسبق من امه اجلها وما يستخرون
normalizedTranslation: no nation will precede its time [of termination], nor will they remain [thereafter]

arabic: ثُمَّ أَرۡسَلۡنَا رُسُلَنَا تَتۡرَاۖ كُلَّ مَا جَآءَ أُمَّةٗ رَّسُولُهَا كَذَّبُوهُۖ فَأَتۡبَعۡنَا بَعۡضَهُم بَعۡضٗا وَجَعَلۡنَٰهُمۡ أَحَادِيثَۚ فَبُعۡدٗا لِّقَوۡمٖ لَّا يُؤۡمِنُونَ
translation: Then We sent Our messengers in succession. Every time there came to a nation its messenger, they denied him, so We made them follow one another [to destruction], and We made them narrations. So away with a people who do not believe
normalizedArabic: ثم ارسلنا رسلنا تترا كل ما جاء امه رسولها كذبوه فاتبعنا بعضهم بعضا وجعلنهم احاديث فبعدا لقوم لا يومنون
normalizedTranslation: then we sent our messengers in succession. every time there came to a nation its messenger, they denied him, so we made them follow one another [to destruction], and we made them narrations. so away with a people who do not believe

arabic: ثُمَّ أَرۡسَلۡنَا مُوسَىٰ وَأَخَاهُ هَٰرُونَ بِـَٔايَٰتِنَا وَسُلۡطَٰنٖ مُّبِينٍ
translation: Then We sent Moses and his brother Aaron with Our signs and a clear authority
normalizedArabic: ثم ارسلنا موسي واخاه هرون بايتنا وسلطن مبين
normalizedTranslation: then we sent moses and his brother aaron with our signs and a clear authority

arabic: إِلَىٰ فِرۡعَوۡنَ وَمَلَإِيْهِۦ فَٱسۡتَكۡبَرُواْ وَكَانُواْ قَوۡمًا عَالِينَ
translation: To Pharaoh and his establishment, but they were arrogant and were a haughty people
normalizedArabic: الي فرعون وملايه فاستكبروا وكانوا قوما عالين
normalizedTranslation: to pharaoh and his establishment, but they were arrogant and were a haughty people

arabic: فَقَالُوٓاْ أَنُؤۡمِنُ لِبَشَرَيۡنِ مِثۡلِنَا وَقَوۡمُهُمَا لَنَا عَٰبِدُونَ
translation: They said, "Should we believe two men like ourselves while their people are for us in servitude
normalizedArabic: فقالوا انومن لبشرين مثلنا وقومهما لنا عبدون
normalizedTranslation: they said, "should we believe two men like ourselves while their people are for us in servitude

arabic: فَكَذَّبُوهُمَا فَكَانُواْ مِنَ ٱلۡمُهۡلَكِينَ
translation: So they denied them and were of those destroyed
normalizedArabic: فكذبوهما فكانوا من المهلكين
normalizedTranslation: so they denied them and were of those destroyed

arabic: وَلَقَدۡ ءَاتَيۡنَا مُوسَى ٱلۡكِتَٰبَ لَعَلَّهُمۡ يَهۡتَدُونَ
translation: And We certainly gave Moses the Scripture that perhaps they would be guided
normalizedArabic: ولقد ءاتينا موسي الكتب لعلهم يهتدون
normalizedTranslation: and we certainly gave moses the scripture that perhaps they would be guided

arabic: وَجَعَلۡنَا ٱبۡنَ مَرۡيَمَ وَأُمَّهُۥٓ ءَايَةٗ وَءَاوَيۡنَٰهُمَآ إِلَىٰ رَبۡوَةٖ ذَاتِ قَرَارٖ وَمَعِينٖ
translation: And We made the son of Mary and his mother a sign and sheltered them within a high ground having level [areas] and flowing water
normalizedArabic: وجعلنا ابن مريم وامه ءايه وءاوينهما الي ربوه ذات قرار ومعين
normalizedTranslation: and we made the son of mary and his mother a sign and sheltered them within a high ground having level [areas] and flowing water

arabic: يَـٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلرُّسُلُ كُلُواْ مِنَ ٱلطَّيِّبَٰتِ وَٱعۡمَلُواْ صَٰلِحًاۖ إِنِّي بِمَا تَعۡمَلُونَ عَلِيمٞ
translation: [Allah said], "O messengers, eat from the good foods and work righteousness. Indeed, I, of what you do, am Knowing
normalizedArabic: يايها الرسل كلوا من الطيبت واعملوا صلحا اني بما تعملون عليم
normalizedTranslation: [allah said], "o messengers, eat from the good foods and work righteousness. indeed, i, of what you do, am knowing

arabic: وَإِنَّ هَٰذِهِۦٓ أُمَّتُكُمۡ أُمَّةٗ وَٰحِدَةٗ وَأَنَا۠ رَبُّكُمۡ فَٱتَّقُونِ
translation: And indeed this, your religion, is one religion, and I am your Lord, so fear Me
normalizedArabic: وان هذه امتكم امه وحده وانا ربكم فاتقون
normalizedTranslation: and indeed this, your religion, is one religion, and i am your lord, so fear me

arabic: فَتَقَطَّعُوٓاْ أَمۡرَهُم بَيۡنَهُمۡ زُبُرٗاۖ كُلُّ حِزۡبِۭ بِمَا لَدَيۡهِمۡ فَرِحُونَ
translation: But the people divided their religion among them into sects - each faction, in what it has, rejoicing
normalizedArabic: فتقطعوا امرهم بينهم زبرا كل حزب بما لديهم فرحون
normalizedTranslation: but the people divided their religion among them into sects - each faction, in what it has, rejoicing

arabic: فَذَرۡهُمۡ فِي غَمۡرَتِهِمۡ حَتَّىٰ حِينٍ
translation: So leave them in their confusion for a time
normalizedArabic: فذرهم في غمرتهم حتي حين
normalizedTranslation: so leave them in their confusion for a time

arabic: أَيَحۡسَبُونَ أَنَّمَا نُمِدُّهُم بِهِۦ مِن مَّالٖ وَبَنِينَ
translation: Do they think that what We extend to them of wealth and children
normalizedArabic: ايحسبون انما نمدهم به من مال وبنين
normalizedTranslation: do they think that what we extend to them of wealth and children

arabic: نُسَارِعُ لَهُمۡ فِي ٱلۡخَيۡرَٰتِۚ بَل لَّا يَشۡعُرُونَ
translation: Is [because] We hasten for them good things? Rather, they do not perceive
normalizedArabic: نسارع لهم في الخيرت بل لا يشعرون
normalizedTranslation: is [because] we hasten for them good things? rather, they do not perceive

arabic: إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ هُم مِّنۡ خَشۡيَةِ رَبِّهِم مُّشۡفِقُونَ
translation: Indeed, they who are apprehensive from fear of their Lord
normalizedArabic: ان الذين هم من خشيه ربهم مشفقون
normalizedTranslation: indeed, they who are apprehensive from fear of their lord

arabic: وَٱلَّذِينَ هُم بِـَٔايَٰتِ رَبِّهِمۡ يُؤۡمِنُونَ
translation: And they who believe in the signs of their Lord
normalizedArabic: والذين هم بايت ربهم يومنون
normalizedTranslation: and they who believe in the signs of their lord

arabic: وَٱلَّذِينَ هُم بِرَبِّهِمۡ لَا يُشۡرِكُونَ
translation: And they who do not associate anything with their Lord
normalizedArabic: والذين هم بربهم لا يشركون
normalizedTranslation: and they who do not associate anything with their lord

arabic: وَٱلَّذِينَ يُؤۡتُونَ مَآ ءَاتَواْ وَّقُلُوبُهُمۡ وَجِلَةٌ أَنَّهُمۡ إِلَىٰ رَبِّهِمۡ رَٰجِعُونَ
translation: And they who give what they give while their hearts are fearful because they will be returning to their Lord
normalizedArabic: والذين يوتون ما ءاتوا وقلوبهم وجله انهم الي ربهم رجعون
normalizedTranslation: and they who give what they give while their hearts are fearful because they will be returning to their lord

arabic: أُوْلَـٰٓئِكَ يُسَٰرِعُونَ فِي ٱلۡخَيۡرَٰتِ وَهُمۡ لَهَا سَٰبِقُونَ
translation: It is those who hasten to good deeds, and they outstrip [others] therein
normalizedArabic: اوليك يسرعون في الخيرت وهم لها سبقون
normalizedTranslation: it is those who hasten to good deeds, and they outstrip [others] therein

arabic: وَلَا نُكَلِّفُ نَفۡسًا إِلَّا وُسۡعَهَاۚ وَلَدَيۡنَا كِتَٰبٞ يَنطِقُ بِٱلۡحَقِّ وَهُمۡ لَا يُظۡلَمُونَ
translation: And We charge no soul except [with that within] its capacity, and with Us is a record which speaks with truth; and they will not be wronged
normalizedArabic: ولا نكلف نفسا الا وسعها ولدينا كتب ينطق بالحق وهم لا يظلمون
normalizedTranslation: and we charge no soul except [with that within] its capacity, and with us is a record which speaks with truth; and they will not be wronged

arabic: بَلۡ قُلُوبُهُمۡ فِي غَمۡرَةٖ مِّنۡ هَٰذَا وَلَهُمۡ أَعۡمَٰلٞ مِّن دُونِ ذَٰلِكَ هُمۡ لَهَا عَٰمِلُونَ
translation: But their hearts are covered with confusion over this, and they have [evil] deeds besides disbelief which they are doing
normalizedArabic: بل قلوبهم في غمره من هذا ولهم اعمل من دون ذلك هم لها عملون
normalizedTranslation: but their hearts are covered with confusion over this, and they have [evil] deeds besides disbelief which they are doing

arabic: حَتَّىٰٓ إِذَآ أَخَذۡنَا مُتۡرَفِيهِم بِٱلۡعَذَابِ إِذَا هُمۡ يَجۡـَٔرُونَ
translation: Until when We seize their affluent ones with punishment, at once they are crying [to Allah] for help
normalizedArabic: حتي اذا اخذنا مترفيهم بالعذاب اذا هم يجرون
normalizedTranslation: until when we seize their affluent ones with punishment, at once they are crying [to allah] for help

arabic: لَا تَجۡـَٔرُواْ ٱلۡيَوۡمَۖ إِنَّكُم مِّنَّا لَا تُنصَرُونَ
translation: Do not cry out today. Indeed, by Us you will not be helped
normalizedArabic: لا تجروا اليوم انكم منا لا تنصرون
normalizedTranslation: do not cry out today. indeed, by us you will not be helped

arabic: قَدۡ كَانَتۡ ءَايَٰتِي تُتۡلَىٰ عَلَيۡكُمۡ فَكُنتُمۡ عَلَىٰٓ أَعۡقَٰبِكُمۡ تَنكِصُونَ
translation: My verses had already been recited to you, but you were turning back on your heels
normalizedArabic: قد كانت ءايتي تتلي عليكم فكنتم علي اعقبكم تنكصون
normalizedTranslation: my verses had already been recited to you, but you were turning back on your heels

arabic: مُسۡتَكۡبِرِينَ بِهِۦ سَٰمِرٗا تَهۡجُرُونَ
translation: In arrogance regarding it, conversing by night, speaking evil
normalizedArabic: مستكبرين به سمرا تهجرون
normalizedTranslation: in arrogance regarding it, conversing by night, speaking evil

arabic: أَفَلَمۡ يَدَّبَّرُواْ ٱلۡقَوۡلَ أَمۡ جَآءَهُم مَّا لَمۡ يَأۡتِ ءَابَآءَهُمُ ٱلۡأَوَّلِينَ
translation: Then have they not reflected over the Qur'an, or has there come to them that which had not come to their forefathers
normalizedArabic: افلم يدبروا القول ام جاءهم ما لم يات ءاباءهم الاولين
normalizedTranslation: then have they not reflected over the qur'an, or has there come to them that which had not come to their forefathers

arabic: أَمۡ لَمۡ يَعۡرِفُواْ رَسُولَهُمۡ فَهُمۡ لَهُۥ مُنكِرُونَ
translation: Or did they not know their Messenger, so they are toward him disacknowledging
normalizedArabic: ام لم يعرفوا رسولهم فهم له منكرون
normalizedTranslation: or did they not know their messenger, so they are toward him disacknowledging

arabic: أَمۡ يَقُولُونَ بِهِۦ جِنَّةُۢۚ بَلۡ جَآءَهُم بِٱلۡحَقِّ وَأَكۡثَرُهُمۡ لِلۡحَقِّ كَٰرِهُونَ
translation: Or do they say, "In him is madness?" Rather, he brought them the truth, but most of them, to the truth, are averse
normalizedArabic: ام يقولون به جنه بل جاءهم بالحق واكثرهم للحق كرهون
normalizedTranslation: or do they say, "in him is madness?" rather, he brought them the truth, but most of them, to the truth, are averse

arabic: وَلَوِ ٱتَّبَعَ ٱلۡحَقُّ أَهۡوَآءَهُمۡ لَفَسَدَتِ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتُ وَٱلۡأَرۡضُ وَمَن فِيهِنَّۚ بَلۡ أَتَيۡنَٰهُم بِذِكۡرِهِمۡ فَهُمۡ عَن ذِكۡرِهِم مُّعۡرِضُونَ
translation: But if the Truth had followed their inclinations, the heavens and the earth and whoever is in them would have been ruined. Rather, We have brought them their message, but they, from their message, are turning away
normalizedArabic: ولو اتبع الحق اهواءهم لفسدت السموت والارض ومن فيهن بل اتينهم بذكرهم فهم عن ذكرهم معرضون
normalizedTranslation: but if the truth had followed their inclinations, the heavens and the earth and whoever is in them would have been ruined. rather, we have brought them their message, but they, from their message, are turning away

arabic: أَمۡ تَسۡـَٔلُهُمۡ خَرۡجٗا فَخَرَاجُ رَبِّكَ خَيۡرٞۖ وَهُوَ خَيۡرُ ٱلرَّـٰزِقِينَ
translation: Or do you, [O Muhammad], ask them for payment? But the reward of your Lord is best, and He is the best of providers
normalizedArabic: ام تسلهم خرجا فخراج ربك خير وهو خير الرزقين
normalizedTranslation: or do you, [o muhammad], ask them for payment? but the reward of your lord is best, and he is the best of providers

arabic: وَإِنَّكَ لَتَدۡعُوهُمۡ إِلَىٰ صِرَٰطٖ مُّسۡتَقِيمٖ
translation: And indeed, you invite them to a straight path
normalizedArabic: وانك لتدعوهم الي صرط مستقيم
normalizedTranslation: and indeed, you invite them to a straight path

arabic: وَإِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ لَا يُؤۡمِنُونَ بِٱلۡأٓخِرَةِ عَنِ ٱلصِّرَٰطِ لَنَٰكِبُونَ
translation: But indeed, those who do not believe in the Hereafter are deviating from the path
normalizedArabic: وان الذين لا يومنون بالاخره عن الصرط لنكبون
normalizedTranslation: but indeed, those who do not believe in the hereafter are deviating from the path

arabic: ۞وَلَوۡ رَحِمۡنَٰهُمۡ وَكَشَفۡنَا مَا بِهِم مِّن ضُرّٖ لَّلَجُّواْ فِي طُغۡيَٰنِهِمۡ يَعۡمَهُونَ
translation: And even if We gave them mercy and removed what was upon them of affliction, they would persist in their transgression, wandering blindly
normalizedArabic: ولو رحمنهم وكشفنا ما بهم من ضر للجوا في طغينهم يعمهون
normalizedTranslation: and even if we gave them mercy and removed what was upon them of affliction, they would persist in their transgression, wandering blindly

arabic: وَلَقَدۡ أَخَذۡنَٰهُم بِٱلۡعَذَابِ فَمَا ٱسۡتَكَانُواْ لِرَبِّهِمۡ وَمَا يَتَضَرَّعُونَ
translation: And We had gripped them with suffering [as a warning], but they did not yield to their Lord, nor did they humbly supplicate, [and will continue thus]
normalizedArabic: ولقد اخذنهم بالعذاب فما استكانوا لربهم وما يتضرعون
normalizedTranslation: and we had gripped them with suffering [as a warning], but they did not yield to their lord, nor did they humbly supplicate, [and will continue thus]

arabic: حَتَّىٰٓ إِذَا فَتَحۡنَا عَلَيۡهِم بَابٗا ذَا عَذَابٖ شَدِيدٍ إِذَا هُمۡ فِيهِ مُبۡلِسُونَ
translation: Until when We have opened before them a door of severe punishment, immediately they will be therein in despair
normalizedArabic: حتي اذا فتحنا عليهم بابا ذا عذاب شديد اذا هم فيه مبلسون
normalizedTranslation: until when we have opened before them a door of severe punishment, immediately they will be therein in despair

arabic: وَهُوَ ٱلَّذِيٓ أَنشَأَ لَكُمُ ٱلسَّمۡعَ وَٱلۡأَبۡصَٰرَ وَٱلۡأَفۡـِٔدَةَۚ قَلِيلٗا مَّا تَشۡكُرُونَ
translation: And it is He who produced for you hearing and vision and hearts; little are you grateful
normalizedArabic: وهو الذي انشا لكم السمع والابصر والافده قليلا ما تشكرون
normalizedTranslation: and it is he who produced for you hearing and vision and hearts; little are you grateful

arabic: وَهُوَ ٱلَّذِي ذَرَأَكُمۡ فِي ٱلۡأَرۡضِ وَإِلَيۡهِ تُحۡشَرُونَ
translation: And it is He who has multiplied you throughout the earth, and to Him you will be gathered
normalizedArabic: وهو الذي ذراكم في الارض واليه تحشرون
normalizedTranslation: and it is he who has multiplied you throughout the earth, and to him you will be gathered

arabic: وَهُوَ ٱلَّذِي يُحۡيِۦ وَيُمِيتُ وَلَهُ ٱخۡتِلَٰفُ ٱلَّيۡلِ وَٱلنَّهَارِۚ أَفَلَا تَعۡقِلُونَ
translation: And it is He who gives life and causes death, and His is the alternation of the night and the day. Then will you not reason
normalizedArabic: وهو الذي يحي ويميت وله اختلف اليل والنهار افلا تعقلون
normalizedTranslation: and it is he who gives life and causes death, and his is the alternation of the night and the day. then will you not reason

arabic: بَلۡ قَالُواْ مِثۡلَ مَا قَالَ ٱلۡأَوَّلُونَ
translation: Rather, they say like what the former peoples said
normalizedArabic: بل قالوا مثل ما قال الاولون
normalizedTranslation: rather, they say like what the former peoples said

arabic: قَالُوٓاْ أَءِذَا مِتۡنَا وَكُنَّا تُرَابٗا وَعِظَٰمًا أَءِنَّا لَمَبۡعُوثُونَ
