arabic: فَلَمَّا جَآءَهُم مُّوسَىٰ بِـَٔايَٰتِنَا بَيِّنَٰتٖ قَالُواْ مَا هَٰذَآ إِلَّا سِحۡرٞ مُّفۡتَرٗى وَمَا سَمِعۡنَا بِهَٰذَا فِيٓ ءَابَآئِنَا ٱلۡأَوَّلِينَ
translation: But when Moses came to them with Our signs as clear evidences, they said, "This is not except invented magic, and we have not heard of this [religion] among our forefathers
normalizedArabic: فلما جاءهم موسي بايتنا بينت قالوا ما هذا الا سحر مفتري وما سمعنا بهذا في ءاباينا الاولين
normalizedTranslation: but when moses came to them with our signs as clear evidences, they said, "this is not except invented magic, and we have not heard of this [religion] among our forefathers

arabic: وَقَالَ مُوسَىٰ رَبِّيٓ أَعۡلَمُ بِمَن جَآءَ بِٱلۡهُدَىٰ مِنۡ عِندِهِۦ وَمَن تَكُونُ لَهُۥ عَٰقِبَةُ ٱلدَّارِۚ إِنَّهُۥ لَا يُفۡلِحُ ٱلظَّـٰلِمُونَ
translation: And Moses said, "My Lord is more knowing [than we or you] of who has come with guidance from Him and to whom will be succession in the home. Indeed, wrongdoers do not succeed
normalizedArabic: وقال موسي ربي اعلم بمن جاء بالهدي من عنده ومن تكون له عقبه الدار انه لا يفلح الظلمون
normalizedTranslation: and moses said, "my lord is more knowing [than we or you] of who has come with guidance from him and to whom will be succession in the home. indeed, wrongdoers do not succeed

arabic: وَقَالَ فِرۡعَوۡنُ يَـٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلۡمَلَأُ مَا عَلِمۡتُ لَكُم مِّنۡ إِلَٰهٍ غَيۡرِي فَأَوۡقِدۡ لِي يَٰهَٰمَٰنُ عَلَى ٱلطِّينِ فَٱجۡعَل لِّي صَرۡحٗا لَّعَلِّيٓ أَطَّلِعُ إِلَىٰٓ إِلَٰهِ مُوسَىٰ وَإِنِّي لَأَظُنُّهُۥ مِنَ ٱلۡكَٰذِبِينَ
translation: And Pharaoh said, "O eminent ones, I have not known you to have a god other than me. Then ignite for me, O Haman, [a fire] upon the clay and make for me a tower that I may look at the God of Moses. And indeed, I do think he is among the liars
normalizedArabic: وقال فرعون يايها الملا ما علمت لكم من اله غيري فاوقد لي يهمن علي الطين فاجعل لي صرحا لعلي اطلع الي اله موسي واني لاظنه من الكذبين
normalizedTranslation: and pharaoh said, "o eminent ones, i have not known you to have a god other than me. then ignite for me, o haman, [a fire] upon the clay and make for me a tower that i may look at the god of moses. and indeed, i do think he is among the liars

arabic: وَٱسۡتَكۡبَرَ هُوَ وَجُنُودُهُۥ فِي ٱلۡأَرۡضِ بِغَيۡرِ ٱلۡحَقِّ وَظَنُّوٓاْ أَنَّهُمۡ إِلَيۡنَا لَا يُرۡجَعُونَ
translation: And he was arrogant, he and his soldiers, in the land, without right, and they thought that they would not be returned to Us
normalizedArabic: واستكبر هو وجنوده في الارض بغير الحق وظنوا انهم الينا لا يرجعون
normalizedTranslation: and he was arrogant, he and his soldiers, in the land, without right, and they thought that they would not be returned to us

arabic: فَأَخَذۡنَٰهُ وَجُنُودَهُۥ فَنَبَذۡنَٰهُمۡ فِي ٱلۡيَمِّۖ فَٱنظُرۡ كَيۡفَ كَانَ عَٰقِبَةُ ٱلظَّـٰلِمِينَ
translation: So We took him and his soldiers and threw them into the sea. So see how was the end of the wrongdoers
normalizedArabic: فاخذنه وجنوده فنبذنهم في اليم فانظر كيف كان عقبه الظلمين
normalizedTranslation: so we took him and his soldiers and threw them into the sea. so see how was the end of the wrongdoers

arabic: وَجَعَلۡنَٰهُمۡ أَئِمَّةٗ يَدۡعُونَ إِلَى ٱلنَّارِۖ وَيَوۡمَ ٱلۡقِيَٰمَةِ لَا يُنصَرُونَ
translation: And We made them leaders inviting to the Fire, and on the Day of Resurrection they will not be helped
normalizedArabic: وجعلنهم ايمه يدعون الي النار ويوم القيمه لا ينصرون
normalizedTranslation: and we made them leaders inviting to the fire, and on the day of resurrection they will not be helped

arabic: وَأَتۡبَعۡنَٰهُمۡ فِي هَٰذِهِ ٱلدُّنۡيَا لَعۡنَةٗۖ وَيَوۡمَ ٱلۡقِيَٰمَةِ هُم مِّنَ ٱلۡمَقۡبُوحِينَ
translation: And We caused to overtake them in this world a curse, and on the Day of Resurrection they will be of the despised
normalizedArabic: واتبعنهم في هذه الدنيا لعنه ويوم القيمه هم من المقبوحين
normalizedTranslation: and we caused to overtake them in this world a curse, and on the day of resurrection they will be of the despised

arabic: وَلَقَدۡ ءَاتَيۡنَا مُوسَى ٱلۡكِتَٰبَ مِنۢ بَعۡدِ مَآ أَهۡلَكۡنَا ٱلۡقُرُونَ ٱلۡأُولَىٰ بَصَآئِرَ لِلنَّاسِ وَهُدٗى وَرَحۡمَةٗ لَّعَلَّهُمۡ يَتَذَكَّرُونَ
translation: And We gave Moses the Scripture, after We had destroyed the former generations, as enlightenment for the people and guidance and mercy that they might be reminded
normalizedArabic: ولقد ءاتينا موسي الكتب من بعد ما اهلكنا القرون الاولي بصاير للناس وهدي ورحمه لعلهم يتذكرون
normalizedTranslation: and we gave moses the scripture, after we had destroyed the former generations, as enlightenment for the people and guidance and mercy that they might be reminded

arabic: وَمَا كُنتَ بِجَانِبِ ٱلۡغَرۡبِيِّ إِذۡ قَضَيۡنَآ إِلَىٰ مُوسَى ٱلۡأَمۡرَ وَمَا كُنتَ مِنَ ٱلشَّـٰهِدِينَ
translation: And you, [O Muhammad], were not on the western side [of the mount] when We revealed to Moses the command, and you were not among the witnesses [to that]
normalizedArabic: وما كنت بجانب الغربي اذ قضينا الي موسي الامر وما كنت من الشهدين
normalizedTranslation: and you, [o muhammad], were not on the western side [of the mount] when we revealed to moses the command, and you were not among the witnesses [to that]

arabic: وَلَٰكِنَّآ أَنشَأۡنَا قُرُونٗا فَتَطَاوَلَ عَلَيۡهِمُ ٱلۡعُمُرُۚ وَمَا كُنتَ ثَاوِيٗا فِيٓ أَهۡلِ مَدۡيَنَ تَتۡلُواْ عَلَيۡهِمۡ ءَايَٰتِنَا وَلَٰكِنَّا كُنَّا مُرۡسِلِينَ
translation: But We produced [many] generations [after Moses], and prolonged was their duration. And you were not a resident among the people of Madyan, reciting to them Our verses, but We were senders [of this message]
normalizedArabic: ولكنا انشانا قرونا فتطاول عليهم العمر وما كنت ثاويا في اهل مدين تتلوا عليهم ءايتنا ولكنا كنا مرسلين
normalizedTranslation: but we produced [many] generations [after moses], and prolonged was their duration. and you were not a resident among the people of madyan, reciting to them our verses, but we were senders [of this message]

arabic: وَمَا كُنتَ بِجَانِبِ ٱلطُّورِ إِذۡ نَادَيۡنَا وَلَٰكِن رَّحۡمَةٗ مِّن رَّبِّكَ لِتُنذِرَ قَوۡمٗا مَّآ أَتَىٰهُم مِّن نَّذِيرٖ مِّن قَبۡلِكَ لَعَلَّهُمۡ يَتَذَكَّرُونَ
translation: And you were not at the side of the mount when We called [Moses] but [were sent] as a mercy from your Lord to warn a people to whom no warner had come before you that they might be reminded
normalizedArabic: وما كنت بجانب الطور اذ نادينا ولكن رحمه من ربك لتنذر قوما ما اتيهم من نذير من قبلك لعلهم يتذكرون
normalizedTranslation: and you were not at the side of the mount when we called [moses] but [were sent] as a mercy from your lord to warn a people to whom no warner had come before you that they might be reminded

arabic: وَلَوۡلَآ أَن تُصِيبَهُم مُّصِيبَةُۢ بِمَا قَدَّمَتۡ أَيۡدِيهِمۡ فَيَقُولُواْ رَبَّنَا لَوۡلَآ أَرۡسَلۡتَ إِلَيۡنَا رَسُولٗا فَنَتَّبِعَ ءَايَٰتِكَ وَنَكُونَ مِنَ ٱلۡمُؤۡمِنِينَ
translation: And if not that a disaster should strike them for what their hands put forth [of sins] and they would say, "Our Lord, why did You not send us a messenger so we could have followed Your verses and been among the believers
normalizedArabic: ولولا ان تصيبهم مصيبه بما قدمت ايديهم فيقولوا ربنا لولا ارسلت الينا رسولا فنتبع ءايتك ونكون من المومنين
normalizedTranslation: and if not that a disaster should strike them for what their hands put forth [of sins] and they would say, "our lord, why did you not send us a messenger so we could have followed your verses and been among the believers

arabic: فَلَمَّا جَآءَهُمُ ٱلۡحَقُّ مِنۡ عِندِنَا قَالُواْ لَوۡلَآ أُوتِيَ مِثۡلَ مَآ أُوتِيَ مُوسَىٰٓۚ أَوَلَمۡ يَكۡفُرُواْ بِمَآ أُوتِيَ مُوسَىٰ مِن قَبۡلُۖ قَالُواْ سِحۡرَانِ تَظَٰهَرَا وَقَالُوٓاْ إِنَّا بِكُلّٖ كَٰفِرُونَ
translation: But when the truth came to them from Us, they said, "Why was he not given like that which was given to Moses?" Did they not disbelieve in that which was given to Moses before? They said, "[They are but] two works of magic supporting each other, and indeed we are, in both, disbelievers
normalizedArabic: فلما جاءهم الحق من عندنا قالوا لولا اوتي مثل ما اوتي موسي اولم يكفروا بما اوتي موسي من قبل قالوا سحران تظهرا وقالوا انا بكل كفرون
normalizedTranslation: but when the truth came to them from us, they said, "why was he not given like that which was given to moses?" did they not disbelieve in that which was given to moses before? they said, "[they are but] two works of magic supporting each other, and indeed we are, in both, disbelievers

arabic: قُلۡ فَأۡتُواْ بِكِتَٰبٖ مِّنۡ عِندِ ٱللَّهِ هُوَ أَهۡدَىٰ مِنۡهُمَآ أَتَّبِعۡهُ إِن كُنتُمۡ صَٰدِقِينَ
translation: Say, "Then bring a scripture from Allah which is more guiding than either of them that I may follow it, if you should be truthful
normalizedArabic: قل فاتوا بكتب من عند الله هو اهدي منهما اتبعه ان كنتم صدقين
normalizedTranslation: say, "then bring a scripture from allah which is more guiding than either of them that i may follow it, if you should be truthful

arabic: فَإِن لَّمۡ يَسۡتَجِيبُواْ لَكَ فَٱعۡلَمۡ أَنَّمَا يَتَّبِعُونَ أَهۡوَآءَهُمۡۚ وَمَنۡ أَضَلُّ مِمَّنِ ٱتَّبَعَ هَوَىٰهُ بِغَيۡرِ هُدٗى مِّنَ ٱللَّهِۚ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ لَا يَهۡدِي ٱلۡقَوۡمَ ٱلظَّـٰلِمِينَ
translation: But if they do not respond to you - then know that they only follow their [own] desires. And who is more astray than one who follows his desire without guidance from Allah? Indeed, Allah does not guide the wrongdoing people
normalizedArabic: فان لم يستجيبوا لك فاعلم انما يتبعون اهواءهم ومن اضل ممن اتبع هويه بغير هدي من الله ان الله لا يهدي القوم الظلمين
normalizedTranslation: but if they do not respond to you - then know that they only follow their [own] desires. and who is more astray than one who follows his desire without guidance from allah? indeed, allah does not guide the wrongdoing people

arabic: ۞وَلَقَدۡ وَصَّلۡنَا لَهُمُ ٱلۡقَوۡلَ لَعَلَّهُمۡ يَتَذَكَّرُونَ
translation: And We have [repeatedly] conveyed to them the Qur'an that they might be reminded
normalizedArabic: ولقد وصلنا لهم القول لعلهم يتذكرون
normalizedTranslation: and we have [repeatedly] conveyed to them the qur'an that they might be reminded

arabic: ٱلَّذِينَ ءَاتَيۡنَٰهُمُ ٱلۡكِتَٰبَ مِن قَبۡلِهِۦ هُم بِهِۦ يُؤۡمِنُونَ
translation: Those to whom We gave the Scripture before it - they are believers in it
normalizedArabic: الذين ءاتينهم الكتب من قبله هم به يومنون
normalizedTranslation: those to whom we gave the scripture before it - they are believers in it

arabic: وَإِذَا يُتۡلَىٰ عَلَيۡهِمۡ قَالُوٓاْ ءَامَنَّا بِهِۦٓ إِنَّهُ ٱلۡحَقُّ مِن رَّبِّنَآ إِنَّا كُنَّا مِن قَبۡلِهِۦ مُسۡلِمِينَ
translation: And when it is recited to them, they say, "We have believed in it; indeed, it is the truth from our Lord. Indeed we were, [even] before it, Muslims [submitting to Allah]
normalizedArabic: واذا يتلي عليهم قالوا ءامنا به انه الحق من ربنا انا كنا من قبله مسلمين
normalizedTranslation: and when it is recited to them, they say, "we have believed in it; indeed, it is the truth from our lord. indeed we were, [even] before it, muslims [submitting to allah]

arabic: أُوْلَـٰٓئِكَ يُؤۡتَوۡنَ أَجۡرَهُم مَّرَّتَيۡنِ بِمَا صَبَرُواْ وَيَدۡرَءُونَ بِٱلۡحَسَنَةِ ٱلسَّيِّئَةَ وَمِمَّا رَزَقۡنَٰهُمۡ يُنفِقُونَ
translation: Those will be given their reward twice for what they patiently endured and [because] they avert evil through good, and from what We have provided them they spend
normalizedArabic: اوليك يوتون اجرهم مرتين بما صبروا ويدرءون بالحسنه السييه ومما رزقنهم ينفقون
normalizedTranslation: those will be given their reward twice for what they patiently endured and [because] they avert evil through good, and from what we have provided them they spend

arabic: وَإِذَا سَمِعُواْ ٱللَّغۡوَ أَعۡرَضُواْ عَنۡهُ وَقَالُواْ لَنَآ أَعۡمَٰلُنَا وَلَكُمۡ أَعۡمَٰلُكُمۡ سَلَٰمٌ عَلَيۡكُمۡ لَا نَبۡتَغِي ٱلۡجَٰهِلِينَ
translation: And when they hear ill speech, they turn away from it and say, "For us are our deeds, and for you are your deeds. Peace will be upon you; we seek not the ignorant
normalizedArabic: واذا سمعوا اللغو اعرضوا عنه وقالوا لنا اعملنا ولكم اعملكم سلم عليكم لا نبتغي الجهلين
normalizedTranslation: and when they hear ill speech, they turn away from it and say, "for us are our deeds, and for you are your deeds. peace will be upon you; we seek not the ignorant

arabic: إِنَّكَ لَا تَهۡدِي مَنۡ أَحۡبَبۡتَ وَلَٰكِنَّ ٱللَّهَ يَهۡدِي مَن يَشَآءُۚ وَهُوَ أَعۡلَمُ بِٱلۡمُهۡتَدِينَ
translation: Indeed, [O Muhammad], you do not guide whom you like, but Allah guides whom He wills. And He is most knowing of the [rightly] guided
normalizedArabic: انك لا تهدي من احببت ولكن الله يهدي من يشاء وهو اعلم بالمهتدين
normalizedTranslation: indeed, [o muhammad], you do not guide whom you like, but allah guides whom he wills. and he is most knowing of the [rightly] guided

arabic: وَقَالُوٓاْ إِن نَّتَّبِعِ ٱلۡهُدَىٰ مَعَكَ نُتَخَطَّفۡ مِنۡ أَرۡضِنَآۚ أَوَلَمۡ نُمَكِّن لَّهُمۡ حَرَمًا ءَامِنٗا يُجۡبَىٰٓ إِلَيۡهِ ثَمَرَٰتُ كُلِّ شَيۡءٖ رِّزۡقٗا مِّن لَّدُنَّا وَلَٰكِنَّ أَكۡثَرَهُمۡ لَا يَعۡلَمُونَ
translation: And they say, "If we were to follow the guidance with you, we would be swept from our land." Have we not established for them a safe sanctuary to which are brought the fruits of all things as provision from Us? But most of them do not know
normalizedArabic: وقالوا ان نتبع الهدي معك نتخطف من ارضنا اولم نمكن لهم حرما ءامنا يجبي اليه ثمرت كل شيء رزقا من لدنا ولكن اكثرهم لا يعلمون
normalizedTranslation: and they say, "if we were to follow the guidance with you, we would be swept from our land." have we not established for them a safe sanctuary to which are brought the fruits of all things as provision from us? but most of them do not know

arabic: وَكَمۡ أَهۡلَكۡنَا مِن قَرۡيَةِۭ بَطِرَتۡ مَعِيشَتَهَاۖ فَتِلۡكَ مَسَٰكِنُهُمۡ لَمۡ تُسۡكَن مِّنۢ بَعۡدِهِمۡ إِلَّا قَلِيلٗاۖ وَكُنَّا نَحۡنُ ٱلۡوَٰرِثِينَ
translation: And how many a city have We destroyed that was insolent in its [way of] living, and those are their dwellings which have not been inhabited after them except briefly. And it is We who were the inheritors
normalizedArabic: وكم اهلكنا من قريه بطرت معيشتها فتلك مسكنهم لم تسكن من بعدهم الا قليلا وكنا نحن الورثين
normalizedTranslation: and how many a city have we destroyed that was insolent in its [way of] living, and those are their dwellings which have not been inhabited after them except briefly. and it is we who were the inheritors

arabic: وَمَا كَانَ رَبُّكَ مُهۡلِكَ ٱلۡقُرَىٰ حَتَّىٰ يَبۡعَثَ فِيٓ أُمِّهَا رَسُولٗا يَتۡلُواْ عَلَيۡهِمۡ ءَايَٰتِنَاۚ وَمَا كُنَّا مُهۡلِكِي ٱلۡقُرَىٰٓ إِلَّا وَأَهۡلُهَا ظَٰلِمُونَ
translation: And never would your Lord have destroyed the cities until He had sent to their mother a messenger reciting to them Our verses. And We would not destroy the cities except while their people were wrongdoers
normalizedArabic: وما كان ربك مهلك القري حتي يبعث في امها رسولا يتلوا عليهم ءايتنا وما كنا مهلكي القري الا واهلها ظلمون
normalizedTranslation: and never would your lord have destroyed the cities until he had sent to their mother a messenger reciting to them our verses. and we would not destroy the cities except while their people were wrongdoers

arabic: وَمَآ أُوتِيتُم مِّن شَيۡءٖ فَمَتَٰعُ ٱلۡحَيَوٰةِ ٱلدُّنۡيَا وَزِينَتُهَاۚ وَمَا عِندَ ٱللَّهِ خَيۡرٞ وَأَبۡقَىٰٓۚ أَفَلَا تَعۡقِلُونَ
translation: And whatever thing you [people] have been given - it is [only for] the enjoyment of worldly life and its adornment. And what is with Allah is better and more lasting; so will you not use reason
normalizedArabic: وما اوتيتم من شيء فمتع الحيوه الدنيا وزينتها وما عند الله خير وابقي افلا تعقلون
normalizedTranslation: and whatever thing you [people] have been given - it is [only for] the enjoyment of worldly life and its adornment. and what is with allah is better and more lasting; so will you not use reason

arabic: أَفَمَن وَعَدۡنَٰهُ وَعۡدًا حَسَنٗا فَهُوَ لَٰقِيهِ كَمَن مَّتَّعۡنَٰهُ مَتَٰعَ ٱلۡحَيَوٰةِ ٱلدُّنۡيَا ثُمَّ هُوَ يَوۡمَ ٱلۡقِيَٰمَةِ مِنَ ٱلۡمُحۡضَرِينَ
translation: Then is he whom We have promised a good promise which he will obtain like he for whom We provided enjoyment of worldly life [but] then he is, on the Day of Resurrection, among those presented [for punishment in Hell]
normalizedArabic: افمن وعدنه وعدا حسنا فهو لقيه كمن متعنه متع الحيوه الدنيا ثم هو يوم القيمه من المحضرين
normalizedTranslation: then is he whom we have promised a good promise which he will obtain like he for whom we provided enjoyment of worldly life [but] then he is, on the day of resurrection, among those presented [for punishment in hell]

arabic: وَيَوۡمَ يُنَادِيهِمۡ فَيَقُولُ أَيۡنَ شُرَكَآءِيَ ٱلَّذِينَ كُنتُمۡ تَزۡعُمُونَ
translation: And [warn of] the Day He will call them and say, "Where are My 'partners' which you used to claim
normalizedArabic: ويوم يناديهم فيقول اين شركاءي الذين كنتم تزعمون
normalizedTranslation: and [warn of] the day he will call them and say, "where are my 'partners' which you used to claim

arabic: قَالَ ٱلَّذِينَ حَقَّ عَلَيۡهِمُ ٱلۡقَوۡلُ رَبَّنَا هَـٰٓؤُلَآءِ ٱلَّذِينَ أَغۡوَيۡنَآ أَغۡوَيۡنَٰهُمۡ كَمَا غَوَيۡنَاۖ تَبَرَّأۡنَآ إِلَيۡكَۖ مَا كَانُوٓاْ إِيَّانَا يَعۡبُدُونَ

normalizedTranslation: those upon whom the word will have come into effect will say, "our lord, these are the ones we led to error. we led them to error just as we were in error. we declare our disassociation [from them] to you. they did not used to worship us

arabic: وَقِيلَ ٱدۡعُواْ شُرَكَآءَكُمۡ فَدَعَوۡهُمۡ فَلَمۡ يَسۡتَجِيبُواْ لَهُمۡ وَرَأَوُاْ ٱلۡعَذَابَۚ لَوۡ أَنَّهُمۡ كَانُواْ يَهۡتَدُونَ
translation: And it will be said, "Invoke your 'partners' " and they will invoke them; but they will not respond to them, and they will see the punishment. If only they had followed guidance

normalizedTranslation: and it will be said, "invoke your 'partners' " and they will invoke them; but they will not respond to them, and they will see the punishment. if only they had followed guidance

arabic: وَيَوۡمَ يُنَادِيهِمۡ فَيَقُولُ مَاذَآ أَجَبۡتُمُ ٱلۡمُرۡسَلِينَ
translation: And [mention] the Day He will call them and say, "What did you answer the messengers

normalizedTranslation: and [mention] the day he will call them and say, "what did you answer the messengers

arabic: فَعَمِيَتۡ عَلَيۡهِمُ ٱلۡأَنۢبَآءُ يَوۡمَئِذٖ فَهُمۡ لَا يَتَسَآءَلُونَ

normalizedTranslation: but the information will be unapparent to them that day, so they will not [be able to] ask one another

arabic: فَأَمَّا مَن تَابَ وَءَامَنَ وَعَمِلَ صَٰلِحٗا فَعَسَىٰٓ أَن يَكُونَ مِنَ ٱلۡمُفۡلِحِينَ
translation: But as for one who had repented, believed, and done righteousness, it is promised by Allah that he will be among the successful

normalizedTranslation: but as for one who had repented, believed, and done righteousness, it is promised by allah that he will be among the successful

arabic: وَرَبُّكَ يَخۡلُقُ مَا يَشَآءُ وَيَخۡتَارُۗ مَا كَانَ لَهُمُ ٱلۡخِيَرَةُۚ سُبۡحَٰنَ ٱللَّهِ وَتَعَٰلَىٰ عَمَّا يُشۡرِكُونَ
translation: And your Lord creates what He wills and chooses; not for them was the choice. Exalted is Allah and high above what they associate with Him
normalizedArabic: وربك يخلق ما يشاء ويختار ما كان لهم الخيره سبحن الله وتعلي عما يشركون
normalizedTranslation: and your lord creates what he wills and chooses; not for them was the choice. exalted is allah and high above what they associate with him

arabic: وَرَبُّكَ يَعۡلَمُ مَا تُكِنُّ صُدُورُهُمۡ وَمَا يُعۡلِنُونَ
translation: And your Lord knows what their breasts conceal and what they declare

normalizedTranslation: and your lord knows what their breasts conceal and what they declare

arabic: وَهُوَ ٱللَّهُ لَآ إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا هُوَۖ لَهُ ٱلۡحَمۡدُ فِي ٱلۡأُولَىٰ وَٱلۡأٓخِرَةِۖ وَلَهُ ٱلۡحُكۡمُ وَإِلَيۡهِ تُرۡجَعُونَ
translation: And He is Allah; there is no deity except Him. To Him is [due all] praise in the first [life] and the Hereafter. And His is the [final] decision, and to Him you will be returned

normalizedTranslation: and he is allah; there is no deity except him. to him is [due all] praise in the first [life] and the hereafter. and his is the [final] decision, and to him you will be returned

arabic: قُلۡ أَرَءَيۡتُمۡ إِن جَعَلَ ٱللَّهُ عَلَيۡكُمُ ٱلَّيۡلَ سَرۡمَدًا إِلَىٰ يَوۡمِ ٱلۡقِيَٰمَةِ مَنۡ إِلَٰهٌ غَيۡرُ ٱللَّهِ يَأۡتِيكُم بِضِيَآءٍۚ أَفَلَا تَسۡمَعُونَ

normalizedTranslation: say, "have you considered: if allah should make for you the night continuous until the day of resurrection, what deity other than allah could bring you light? then will you not hear

arabic: وَنَزَعۡنَا مِن كُلِّ أُمَّةٖ شَهِيدٗا فَقُلۡنَا هَاتُواْ بُرۡهَٰنَكُمۡ فَعَلِمُوٓاْ أَنَّ ٱلۡحَقَّ لِلَّهِ وَضَلَّ عَنۡهُم مَّا كَانُواْ يَفۡتَرُونَ
translation: And We will extract from every nation a witness and say, "Produce your proof," and they will know that the truth belongs to Allah, and lost from them is that which they used to invent

normalizedTranslation: and we will extract from every nation a witness and say, "produce your proof," and they will know that the truth belongs to allah, and lost from them is that which they used to invent

normalizedTranslation: indeed, qarun was from the people of moses, but he tyrannized them. and we gave him of treasures whose keys would burden a band of strong men; thereupon his people said to him, "do not exult. indeed, allah does not like the exultant

arabic: وَٱبۡتَغِ فِيمَآ ءَاتَىٰكَ ٱللَّهُ ٱلدَّارَ ٱلۡأٓخِرَةَۖ وَلَا تَنسَ نَصِيبَكَ مِنَ ٱلدُّنۡيَاۖ وَأَحۡسِن كَمَآ أَحۡسَنَ ٱللَّهُ إِلَيۡكَۖ وَلَا تَبۡغِ ٱلۡفَسَادَ فِي ٱلۡأَرۡضِۖ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ لَا يُحِبُّ ٱلۡمُفۡسِدِينَ

normalizedTranslation: but seek, through that which allah has given you, the home of the hereafter; and [yet], do not forget your share of the world. and do good as allah has done good to you. and desire not corruption in the land. indeed, allah does not like corrupters

arabic: قَالَ إِنَّمَآ أُوتِيتُهُۥ عَلَىٰ عِلۡمٍ عِندِيٓۚ أَوَلَمۡ يَعۡلَمۡ أَنَّ ٱللَّهَ قَدۡ أَهۡلَكَ مِن قَبۡلِهِۦ مِنَ ٱلۡقُرُونِ مَنۡ هُوَ أَشَدُّ مِنۡهُ قُوَّةٗ وَأَكۡثَرُ جَمۡعٗاۚ وَلَا يُسۡـَٔلُ عَن ذُنُوبِهِمُ ٱلۡمُجۡرِمُونَ
translation: He said, "I was only given it because of knowledge I have." Did he not know that Allah had destroyed before him of generations those who were greater than him in power and greater in accumulation [of wealth]? But the criminals, about their sins, will not be asked

normalizedTranslation: he said, "i was only given it because of knowledge i have." did he not know that allah had destroyed before him of generations those who were greater than him in power and greater in accumulation [of wealth]? but the criminals, about their sins, will not be asked

translation: So he came out before his people in his adornment. Those who desired the worldly life said, "Oh, would that we had like what was given to Qarun. Indeed, he is one of great fortune

normalizedTranslation: so he came out before his people in his adornment. those who desired the worldly life said, "oh, would that we had like what was given to qarun. indeed, he is one of great fortune

normalizedTranslation: but those who had been given knowledge said, "woe to you! the reward of allah is better for he who believes and does righteousness. and none are granted it except the patient

arabic: فَخَسَفۡنَا بِهِۦ وَبِدَارِهِ ٱلۡأَرۡضَ فَمَا كَانَ لَهُۥ مِن فِئَةٖ يَنصُرُونَهُۥ مِن دُونِ ٱللَّهِ وَمَا كَانَ مِنَ ٱلۡمُنتَصِرِينَ

normalizedArabic: من جاء بالحسنه فله خير منها ومن جاء بالسييه فلا يجزي الذين عملوا السيات الا ما كانوا يعملون
normalizedTranslation: whoever comes [on the day of judgement] with a good deed will have better than it; and whoever comes with an evil deed - then those who did evil deeds will not be recompensed except [as much as] what they used to do

arabic: إِنَّ ٱلَّذِي فَرَضَ عَلَيۡكَ ٱلۡقُرۡءَانَ لَرَآدُّكَ إِلَىٰ مَعَادٖۚ قُل رَّبِّيٓ أَعۡلَمُ مَن جَآءَ بِٱلۡهُدَىٰ وَمَنۡ هُوَ فِي ضَلَٰلٖ مُّبِينٖ
translation: Indeed, [O Muhammad], He who imposed upon you the Qur'an will take you back to a place of return. Say, "My Lord is most knowing of who brings guidance and who is in clear error
normalizedArabic: ان الذي فرض عليك القرءان لرادك الي معاد قل ربي اعلم من جاء بالهدي ومن هو في ضلل مبين
normalizedTranslation: indeed, [o muhammad], he who imposed upon you the qur'an will take you back to a place of return. say, "my lord is most knowing of who brings guidance and who is in clear error

arabic: وَمَا كُنتَ تَرۡجُوٓاْ أَن يُلۡقَىٰٓ إِلَيۡكَ ٱلۡكِتَٰبُ إِلَّا رَحۡمَةٗ مِّن رَّبِّكَۖ فَلَا تَكُونَنَّ ظَهِيرٗا لِّلۡكَٰفِرِينَ
translation: And you were not expecting that the Book would be conveyed to you, but [it is] a mercy from your Lord. So do not be an assistant to the disbelievers
normalizedArabic: وما كنت ترجوا ان يلقي اليك الكتب الا رحمه من ربك فلا تكونن ظهيرا للكفرين
normalizedTranslation: and you were not expecting that the book would be conveyed to you, but [it is] a mercy from your lord. so do not be an assistant to the disbelievers

arabic: وَلَا يَصُدُّنَّكَ عَنۡ ءَايَٰتِ ٱللَّهِ بَعۡدَ إِذۡ أُنزِلَتۡ إِلَيۡكَۖ وَٱدۡعُ إِلَىٰ رَبِّكَۖ وَلَا تَكُونَنَّ مِنَ ٱلۡمُشۡرِكِينَ
translation: And never let them avert you from the verses of Allah after they have been revealed to you. And invite [people] to your Lord. And never be of those who associate others with Allah
normalizedArabic: ولا يصدنك عن ءايت الله بعد اذ انزلت اليك وادع الي ربك ولا تكونن من المشركين
normalizedTranslation: and never let them avert you from the verses of allah after they have been revealed to you. and invite [people] to your lord. and never be of those who associate others with allah

arabic: وَلَا تَدۡعُ مَعَ ٱللَّهِ إِلَٰهًا ءَاخَرَۘ لَآ إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا هُوَۚ كُلُّ شَيۡءٍ هَالِكٌ إِلَّا وَجۡهَهُۥۚ لَهُ ٱلۡحُكۡمُ وَإِلَيۡهِ تُرۡجَعُونَ
translation: And do not invoke with Allah another deity. There is no deity except Him. Everything will be destroyed except His Face. His is the judgement, and to Him you will be returned
normalizedArabic: ولا تدع مع الله الها ءاخر لا اله الا هو كل شيء هالك الا وجهه له الحكم واليه ترجعون
normalizedTranslation: and do not invoke with allah another deity. there is no deity except him. everything will be destroyed except his face. his is the judgement, and to him you will be returned

arabic: الٓمٓ
translation: Alif, Lam, Meem
normalizedArabic: الم
normalizedTranslation: alif, lam, meem

arabic: أَحَسِبَ ٱلنَّاسُ أَن يُتۡرَكُوٓاْ أَن يَقُولُوٓاْ ءَامَنَّا وَهُمۡ لَا يُفۡتَنُونَ
translation: Do the people think that they will be left to say, "We believe" and they will not be tried
normalizedArabic: احسب الناس ان يتركوا ان يقولوا ءامنا وهم لا يفتنون
normalizedTranslation: do the people think that they will be left to say, "we believe" and they will not be tried

arabic: وَلَقَدۡ فَتَنَّا ٱلَّذِينَ مِن قَبۡلِهِمۡۖ فَلَيَعۡلَمَنَّ ٱللَّهُ ٱلَّذِينَ صَدَقُواْ وَلَيَعۡلَمَنَّ ٱلۡكَٰذِبِينَ
translation: But We have certainly tried those before them, and Allah will surely make evident those who are truthful, and He will surely make evident the liars
normalizedArabic: ولقد فتنا الذين من قبلهم فليعلمن الله الذين صدقوا وليعلمن الكذبين
normalizedTranslation: but we have certainly tried those before them, and allah will surely make evident those who are truthful, and he will surely make evident the liars

arabic: أَمۡ حَسِبَ ٱلَّذِينَ يَعۡمَلُونَ ٱلسَّيِّـَٔاتِ أَن يَسۡبِقُونَاۚ سَآءَ مَا يَحۡكُمُونَ
translation: Or do those who do evil deeds think they can outrun Us? Evil is what they judge
normalizedArabic: ام حسب الذين يعملون السيات ان يسبقونا ساء ما يحكمون
normalizedTranslation: or do those who do evil deeds think they can outrun us? evil is what they judge

arabic: مَن كَانَ يَرۡجُواْ لِقَآءَ ٱللَّهِ فَإِنَّ أَجَلَ ٱللَّهِ لَأٓتٖۚ وَهُوَ ٱلسَّمِيعُ ٱلۡعَلِيمُ
translation: Whoever should hope for the meeting with Allah - indeed, the term decreed by Allah is coming. And He is the Hearing, the Knowing
normalizedArabic: من كان يرجوا لقاء الله فان اجل الله لات وهو السميع العليم
normalizedTranslation: whoever should hope for the meeting with allah - indeed, the term decreed by allah is coming. and he is the hearing, the knowing

arabic: وَمَن جَٰهَدَ فَإِنَّمَا يُجَٰهِدُ لِنَفۡسِهِۦٓۚ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ لَغَنِيٌّ عَنِ ٱلۡعَٰلَمِينَ
translation: And whoever strives only strives for [the benefit of] himself. Indeed, Allah is free from need of the worlds
normalizedArabic: ومن جهد فانما يجهد لنفسه ان الله لغني عن العلمين
normalizedTranslation: and whoever strives only strives for [the benefit of] himself. indeed, allah is free from need of the worlds

arabic: وَٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُواْ وَعَمِلُواْ ٱلصَّـٰلِحَٰتِ لَنُكَفِّرَنَّ عَنۡهُمۡ سَيِّـَٔاتِهِمۡ وَلَنَجۡزِيَنَّهُمۡ أَحۡسَنَ ٱلَّذِي كَانُواْ يَعۡمَلُونَ
translation: And those who believe and do righteous deeds - We will surely remove from them their misdeeds and will surely reward them according to the best of what they used to do
normalizedArabic: والذين ءامنوا وعملوا الصلحت لنكفرن عنهم سياتهم ولنجزينهم احسن الذي كانوا يعملون
normalizedTranslation: and those who believe and do righteous deeds - we will surely remove from them their misdeeds and will surely reward them according to the best of what they used to do

arabic: وَوَصَّيۡنَا ٱلۡإِنسَٰنَ بِوَٰلِدَيۡهِ حُسۡنٗاۖ وَإِن جَٰهَدَاكَ لِتُشۡرِكَ بِي مَا لَيۡسَ لَكَ بِهِۦ عِلۡمٞ فَلَا تُطِعۡهُمَآۚ إِلَيَّ مَرۡجِعُكُمۡ فَأُنَبِّئُكُم بِمَا كُنتُمۡ تَعۡمَلُونَ
translation: And We have enjoined upon man goodness to parents. But if they endeavor to make you associate with Me that of which you have no knowledge, do not obey them. To Me is your return, and I will inform you about what you used to do
normalizedArabic: ووصينا الانسن بولديه حسنا وان جهداك لتشرك بي ما ليس لك به علم فلا تطعهما الي مرجعكم فانبيكم بما كنتم تعملون
normalizedTranslation: and we have enjoined upon man goodness to parents. but if they endeavor to make you associate with me that of which you have no knowledge, do not obey them. to me is your return, and i will inform you about what you used to do

arabic: وَٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُواْ وَعَمِلُواْ ٱلصَّـٰلِحَٰتِ لَنُدۡخِلَنَّهُمۡ فِي ٱلصَّـٰلِحِينَ
translation: And those who believe and do righteous deeds - We will surely admit them among the righteous [into Paradise]
normalizedArabic: والذين ءامنوا وعملوا الصلحت لندخلنهم في الصلحين
normalizedTranslation: and those who believe and do righteous deeds - we will surely admit them among the righteous [into paradise]

arabic: وَمِنَ ٱلنَّاسِ مَن يَقُولُ ءَامَنَّا بِٱللَّهِ فَإِذَآ أُوذِيَ فِي ٱللَّهِ جَعَلَ فِتۡنَةَ ٱلنَّاسِ كَعَذَابِ ٱللَّهِۖ وَلَئِن جَآءَ نَصۡرٞ مِّن رَّبِّكَ لَيَقُولُنَّ إِنَّا كُنَّا مَعَكُمۡۚ أَوَلَيۡسَ ٱللَّهُ بِأَعۡلَمَ بِمَا فِي صُدُورِ ٱلۡعَٰلَمِينَ
translation: And of the people are some who say, "We believe in Allah," but when one [of them] is harmed for [the cause of] Allah, they consider the trial of the people as [if it were] the punishment of Allah. But if victory comes from your Lord, they say, "Indeed, We were with you." Is not Allah most knowing of what is within the breasts of all creatures
normalizedArabic: ومن الناس من يقول ءامنا بالله فاذا اوذي في الله جعل فتنه الناس كعذاب الله ولين جاء نصر من ربك ليقولن انا كنا معكم اوليس الله باعلم بما في صدور العلمين
normalizedTranslation: and of the people are some who say, "we believe in allah," but when one [of them] is harmed for [the cause of] allah, they consider the trial of the people as [if it were] the punishment of allah. but if victory comes from your lord, they say, "indeed, we were with you." is not allah most knowing of what is within the breasts of all creatures

arabic: وَلَيَعۡلَمَنَّ ٱللَّهُ ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُواْ وَلَيَعۡلَمَنَّ ٱلۡمُنَٰفِقِينَ
translation: And Allah will surely make evident those who believe, and He will surely make evident the hypocrites
normalizedArabic: وليعلمن الله الذين ءامنوا وليعلمن المنفقين
normalizedTranslation: and allah will surely make evident those who believe, and he will surely make evident the hypocrites

arabic: وَقَالَ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُواْ لِلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُواْ ٱتَّبِعُواْ سَبِيلَنَا وَلۡنَحۡمِلۡ خَطَٰيَٰكُمۡ وَمَا هُم بِحَٰمِلِينَ مِنۡ خَطَٰيَٰهُم مِّن شَيۡءٍۖ إِنَّهُمۡ لَكَٰذِبُونَ
translation: And those who disbelieve say to those who believe, "Follow our way, and we will carry your sins." But they will not carry anything of their sins. Indeed, they are liars
normalizedArabic: وقال الذين كفروا للذين ءامنوا اتبعوا سبيلنا ولنحمل خطيكم وما هم بحملين من خطيهم من شيء انهم لكذبون
normalizedTranslation: and those who disbelieve say to those who believe, "follow our way, and we will carry your sins." but they will not carry anything of their sins. indeed, they are liars

arabic: وَلَيَحۡمِلُنَّ أَثۡقَالَهُمۡ وَأَثۡقَالٗا مَّعَ أَثۡقَالِهِمۡۖ وَلَيُسۡـَٔلُنَّ يَوۡمَ ٱلۡقِيَٰمَةِ عَمَّا كَانُواْ يَفۡتَرُونَ
translation: But they will surely carry their [own] burdens and [other] burdens along with their burdens, and they will surely be questioned on the Day of Resurrection about what they used to invent
normalizedArabic: وليحملن اثقالهم واثقالا مع اثقالهم وليسلن يوم القيمه عما كانوا يفترون
normalizedTranslation: but they will surely carry their [own] burdens and [other] burdens along with their burdens, and they will surely be questioned on the day of resurrection about what they used to invent

arabic: وَلَقَدۡ أَرۡسَلۡنَا نُوحًا إِلَىٰ قَوۡمِهِۦ فَلَبِثَ فِيهِمۡ أَلۡفَ سَنَةٍ إِلَّا خَمۡسِينَ عَامٗا فَأَخَذَهُمُ ٱلطُّوفَانُ وَهُمۡ ظَٰلِمُونَ
translation: And We certainly sent Noah to his people, and he remained among them a thousand years minus fifty years, and the flood seized them while they were wrongdoers
normalizedArabic: ولقد ارسلنا نوحا الي قومه فلبث فيهم الف سنه الا خمسين عاما فاخذهم الطوفان وهم ظلمون
normalizedTranslation: and we certainly sent noah to his people, and he remained among them a thousand years minus fifty years, and the flood seized them while they were wrongdoers

arabic: فَأَنجَيۡنَٰهُ وَأَصۡحَٰبَ ٱلسَّفِينَةِ وَجَعَلۡنَٰهَآ ءَايَةٗ لِّلۡعَٰلَمِينَ
translation: But We saved him and the companions of the ship, and We made it a sign for the worlds
normalizedArabic: فانجينه واصحب السفينه وجعلنها ءايه للعلمين
normalizedTranslation: but we saved him and the companions of the ship, and we made it a sign for the worlds

arabic: وَإِبۡرَٰهِيمَ إِذۡ قَالَ لِقَوۡمِهِ ٱعۡبُدُواْ ٱللَّهَ وَٱتَّقُوهُۖ ذَٰلِكُمۡ خَيۡرٞ لَّكُمۡ إِن كُنتُمۡ تَعۡلَمُونَ
translation: And [We sent] Abraham, when he said to his people, "Worship Allah and fear Him. That is best for you, if you should know
normalizedArabic: وابرهيم اذ قال لقومه اعبدوا الله واتقوه ذلكم خير لكم ان كنتم تعلمون
normalizedTranslation: and [we sent] abraham, when he said to his people, "worship allah and fear him. that is best for you, if you should know

arabic: إِنَّمَا تَعۡبُدُونَ مِن دُونِ ٱللَّهِ أَوۡثَٰنٗا وَتَخۡلُقُونَ إِفۡكًاۚ إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ تَعۡبُدُونَ مِن دُونِ ٱللَّهِ لَا يَمۡلِكُونَ لَكُمۡ رِزۡقٗا فَٱبۡتَغُواْ عِندَ ٱللَّهِ ٱلرِّزۡقَ وَٱعۡبُدُوهُ وَٱشۡكُرُواْ لَهُۥٓۖ إِلَيۡهِ تُرۡجَعُونَ
translation: You only worship, besides Allah, idols, and you produce a falsehood. Indeed, those you worship besides Allah do not possess for you [the power of] provision. So seek from Allah provision and worship Him and be grateful to Him. To Him you will be returned
normalizedArabic: انما تعبدون من دون الله اوثنا وتخلقون افكا ان الذين تعبدون من دون الله لا يملكون لكم رزقا فابتغوا عند الله الرزق واعبدوه واشكروا له اليه ترجعون
normalizedTranslation: you only worship, besides allah, idols, and you produce a falsehood. indeed, those you worship besides allah do not possess for you [the power of] provision. so seek from allah provision and worship him and be grateful to him. to him you will be returned

arabic: وَإِن تُكَذِّبُواْ فَقَدۡ كَذَّبَ أُمَمٞ مِّن قَبۡلِكُمۡۖ وَمَا عَلَى ٱلرَّسُولِ إِلَّا ٱلۡبَلَٰغُ ٱلۡمُبِينُ
translation: And if you [people] deny [the message] - already nations before you have denied. And there is not upon the Messenger except [the duty of] clear notification
normalizedArabic: وان تكذبوا فقد كذب امم من قبلكم وما علي الرسول الا البلغ المبين
normalizedTranslation: and if you [people] deny [the message] - already nations before you have denied. and there is not upon the messenger except [the duty of] clear notification

arabic: أَوَلَمۡ يَرَوۡاْ كَيۡفَ يُبۡدِئُ ٱللَّهُ ٱلۡخَلۡقَ ثُمَّ يُعِيدُهُۥٓۚ إِنَّ ذَٰلِكَ عَلَى ٱللَّهِ يَسِيرٞ
translation: Have they not considered how Allah begins creation and then repeats it? Indeed that, for Allah, is easy
normalizedArabic: اولم يروا كيف يبدي الله الخلق ثم يعيده ان ذلك علي الله يسير
normalizedTranslation: have they not considered how allah begins creation and then repeats it? indeed that, for allah, is easy

arabic: قُلۡ سِيرُواْ فِي ٱلۡأَرۡضِ فَٱنظُرُواْ كَيۡفَ بَدَأَ ٱلۡخَلۡقَۚ ثُمَّ ٱللَّهُ يُنشِئُ ٱلنَّشۡأَةَ ٱلۡأٓخِرَةَۚ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ عَلَىٰ كُلِّ شَيۡءٖ قَدِيرٞ
translation: Say, [O Muhammad], "Travel through the land and observe how He began creation. Then Allah will produce the final creation. Indeed Allah, over all things, is competent
normalizedArabic: قل سيروا في الارض فانظروا كيف بدا الخلق ثم الله ينشي النشاه الاخره ان الله علي كل شيء قدير
normalizedTranslation: say, [o muhammad], "travel through the land and observe how he began creation. then allah will produce the final creation. indeed allah, over all things, is competent

arabic: يُعَذِّبُ مَن يَشَآءُ وَيَرۡحَمُ مَن يَشَآءُۖ وَإِلَيۡهِ تُقۡلَبُونَ
translation: He punishes whom He wills and has mercy upon whom He wills, and to Him you will be returned
normalizedArabic: يعذب من يشاء ويرحم من يشاء واليه تقلبون
normalizedTranslation: he punishes whom he wills and has mercy upon whom he wills, and to him you will be returned

arabic: وَمَآ أَنتُم بِمُعۡجِزِينَ فِي ٱلۡأَرۡضِ وَلَا فِي ٱلسَّمَآءِۖ وَمَا لَكُم مِّن دُونِ ٱللَّهِ مِن وَلِيّٖ وَلَا نَصِيرٖ
translation: And you will not cause failure [to Allah] upon the earth or in the heaven. And you have not other than Allah any protector or any helper
normalizedArabic: وما انتم بمعجزين في الارض ولا في السماء وما لكم من دون الله من ولي ولا نصير
normalizedTranslation: and you will not cause failure [to allah] upon the earth or in the heaven. and you have not other than allah any protector or any helper

arabic: وَٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُواْ بِـَٔايَٰتِ ٱللَّهِ وَلِقَآئِهِۦٓ أُوْلَـٰٓئِكَ يَئِسُواْ مِن رَّحۡمَتِي وَأُوْلَـٰٓئِكَ لَهُمۡ عَذَابٌ أَلِيمٞ
translation: And the ones who disbelieve in the signs of Allah and the meeting with Him - those have despaired of My mercy, and they will have a painful punishment
normalizedArabic: والذين كفروا بايت الله ولقايه اوليك ييسوا من رحمتي واوليك لهم عذاب اليم
normalizedTranslation: and the ones who disbelieve in the signs of allah and the meeting with him - those have despaired of my mercy, and they will have a painful punishment

arabic: فَمَا كَانَ جَوَابَ قَوۡمِهِۦٓ إِلَّآ أَن قَالُواْ ٱقۡتُلُوهُ أَوۡ حَرِّقُوهُ فَأَنجَىٰهُ ٱللَّهُ مِنَ ٱلنَّارِۚ إِنَّ فِي ذَٰلِكَ لَأٓيَٰتٖ لِّقَوۡمٖ يُؤۡمِنُونَ
translation: And the answer of Abraham's people was not but that they said, "Kill him or burn him," but Allah saved him from the fire. Indeed in that are signs for a people who believe
normalizedArabic: فما كان جواب قومه الا ان قالوا اقتلوه او حرقوه فانجيه الله من النار ان في ذلك لايت لقوم يومنون
normalizedTranslation: and the answer of abraham's people was not but that they said, "kill him or burn him," but allah saved him from the fire. indeed in that are signs for a people who believe

arabic: وَقَالَ إِنَّمَا ٱتَّخَذۡتُم مِّن دُونِ ٱللَّهِ أَوۡثَٰنٗا مَّوَدَّةَ بَيۡنِكُمۡ فِي ٱلۡحَيَوٰةِ ٱلدُّنۡيَاۖ ثُمَّ يَوۡمَ ٱلۡقِيَٰمَةِ يَكۡفُرُ بَعۡضُكُم بِبَعۡضٖ وَيَلۡعَنُ بَعۡضُكُم بَعۡضٗا وَمَأۡوَىٰكُمُ ٱلنَّارُ وَمَا لَكُم مِّن نَّـٰصِرِينَ
translation: And [Abraham] said, "You have only taken, other than Allah, idols as [a bond of] affection among you in worldly life. Then on the Day of Resurrection you will deny one another and curse one another, and your refuge will be the Fire, and you will not have any helpers
normalizedArabic: وقال انما اتخذتم من دون الله اوثنا موده بينكم في الحيوه الدنيا ثم يوم القيمه يكفر بعضكم ببعض ويلعن بعضكم بعضا وماويكم النار وما لكم من نصرين
normalizedTranslation: and [abraham] said, "you have only taken, other than allah, idols as [a bond of] affection among you in worldly life. then on the day of resurrection you will deny one another and curse one another, and your refuge will be the fire, and you will not have any helpers

arabic: ۞فَـَٔامَنَ لَهُۥ لُوطٞۘ وَقَالَ إِنِّي مُهَاجِرٌ إِلَىٰ رَبِّيٓۖ إِنَّهُۥ هُوَ ٱلۡعَزِيزُ ٱلۡحَكِيمُ
translation: And Lot believed him. [Abraham] said, "Indeed, I will emigrate to [the service of] my Lord. Indeed, He is the Exalted in Might, the Wise
normalizedArabic: فامن له لوط وقال اني مهاجر الي ربي انه هو العزيز الحكيم
normalizedTranslation: and lot believed him. [abraham] said, "indeed, i will emigrate to [the service of] my lord. indeed, he is the exalted in might, the wise

arabic: وَوَهَبۡنَا لَهُۥٓ إِسۡحَٰقَ وَيَعۡقُوبَ وَجَعَلۡنَا فِي ذُرِّيَّتِهِ ٱلنُّبُوَّةَ وَٱلۡكِتَٰبَ وَءَاتَيۡنَٰهُ أَجۡرَهُۥ فِي ٱلدُّنۡيَاۖ وَإِنَّهُۥ فِي ٱلۡأٓخِرَةِ لَمِنَ ٱلصَّـٰلِحِينَ

normalizedArabic: ووهبنا له اسحق ويعقوب وجعلنا في ذريته النبوه والكتب وءاتينه اجره في الدنيا وانه في الاخره لمن الصلحين
normalizedTranslation: and we gave to him isaac and jacob and placed in his descendants prophethood and scripture. and we gave him his reward in this world, and indeed, he is in the hereafter among the righteous

arabic: وَلُوطًا إِذۡ قَالَ لِقَوۡمِهِۦٓ إِنَّكُمۡ لَتَأۡتُونَ ٱلۡفَٰحِشَةَ مَا سَبَقَكُم بِهَا مِنۡ أَحَدٖ مِّنَ ٱلۡعَٰلَمِينَ
translation: And [mention] Lot, when he said to his people, "Indeed, you commit such immorality as no one has preceded you with from among the worlds

normalizedTranslation: and [mention] lot, when he said to his people, "indeed, you commit such immorality as no one has preceded you with from among the worlds

arabic: أَئِنَّكُمۡ لَتَأۡتُونَ ٱلرِّجَالَ وَتَقۡطَعُونَ ٱلسَّبِيلَ وَتَأۡتُونَ فِي نَادِيكُمُ ٱلۡمُنكَرَۖ فَمَا كَانَ جَوَابَ قَوۡمِهِۦٓ إِلَّآ أَن قَالُواْ ٱئۡتِنَا بِعَذَابِ ٱللَّهِ إِن كُنتَ مِنَ ٱلصَّـٰدِقِينَ
translation: Indeed, you approach men and obstruct the road and commit in your meetings [every] evil." And the answer of his people was not but they said, "Bring us the punishment of Allah, if you should be of the truthful

normalizedTranslation: indeed, you approach men and obstruct the road and commit in your meetings [every] evil." and the answer of his people was not but they said, "bring us the punishment of allah, if you should be of the truthful

arabic: قَالَ رَبِّ ٱنصُرۡنِي عَلَى ٱلۡقَوۡمِ ٱلۡمُفۡسِدِينَ
translation: He said, "My Lord, support me against the corrupting people

normalizedTranslation: he said, "my lord, support me against the corrupting people

arabic: وَلَمَّا جَآءَتۡ رُسُلُنَآ إِبۡرَٰهِيمَ بِٱلۡبُشۡرَىٰ قَالُوٓاْ إِنَّا مُهۡلِكُوٓاْ أَهۡلِ هَٰذِهِ ٱلۡقَرۡيَةِۖ إِنَّ أَهۡلَهَا كَانُواْ ظَٰلِمِينَ
translation: And when Our messengers came to Abraham with the good tidings, they said, "Indeed, we will destroy the people of that Lot's city. Indeed, its people have been wrongdoers
normalizedArabic: ولما جاءت رسلنا ابرهيم بالبشري قالوا انا مهلكوا اهل هذه القريه ان اهلها كانوا ظلمين
normalizedTranslation: and when our messengers came to abraham with the good tidings, they said, "indeed, we will destroy the people of that lot's city. indeed, its people have been wrongdoers

arabic: قَالَ إِنَّ فِيهَا لُوطٗاۚ قَالُواْ نَحۡنُ أَعۡلَمُ بِمَن فِيهَاۖ لَنُنَجِّيَنَّهُۥ وَأَهۡلَهُۥٓ إِلَّا ٱمۡرَأَتَهُۥ كَانَتۡ مِنَ ٱلۡغَٰبِرِينَ
translation: [Abraham] said, "Indeed, within it is Lot." They said, "We are more knowing of who is within it. We will surely save him and his family, except his wife. She is to be of those who remain behind
normalizedArabic: قال ان فيها لوطا قالوا نحن اعلم بمن فيها لننجينه واهله الا امراته كانت من الغبرين
normalizedTranslation: [abraham] said, "indeed, within it is lot." they said, "we are more knowing of who is within it. we will surely save him and his family, except his wife. she is to be of those who remain behind

arabic: وَلَمَّآ أَن جَآءَتۡ رُسُلُنَا لُوطٗا سِيٓءَ بِهِمۡ وَضَاقَ بِهِمۡ ذَرۡعٗاۖ وَقَالُواْ لَا تَخَفۡ وَلَا تَحۡزَنۡ إِنَّا مُنَجُّوكَ وَأَهۡلَكَ إِلَّا ٱمۡرَأَتَكَ كَانَتۡ مِنَ ٱلۡغَٰبِرِينَ
translation: And when Our messengers came to Lot, he was distressed for them and felt for them great discomfort. They said, "Fear not, nor grieve. Indeed, we will save you and your family, except your wife; she is to be of those who remain behind

normalizedTranslation: and when our messengers came to lot, he was distressed for them and felt for them great discomfort. they said, "fear not, nor grieve. indeed, we will save you and your family, except your wife; she is to be of those who remain behind

arabic: إِنَّا مُنزِلُونَ عَلَىٰٓ أَهۡلِ هَٰذِهِ ٱلۡقَرۡيَةِ رِجۡزٗا مِّنَ ٱلسَّمَآءِ بِمَا كَانُواْ يَفۡسُقُونَ

arabic: وَلَقَد تَّرَكۡنَا مِنۡهَآ ءَايَةَۢ بَيِّنَةٗ لِّقَوۡمٖ يَعۡقِلُونَ
translation: And We have certainly left of it a sign as clear evidence for a people who use reason
normalizedArabic: ولقد تركنا منها ءايه بينه لقوم يعقلون
normalizedTranslation: and we have certainly left of it a sign as clear evidence for a people who use reason

arabic: وَإِلَىٰ مَدۡيَنَ أَخَاهُمۡ شُعَيۡبٗا فَقَالَ يَٰقَوۡمِ ٱعۡبُدُواْ ٱللَّهَ وَٱرۡجُواْ ٱلۡيَوۡمَ ٱلۡأٓخِرَ وَلَا تَعۡثَوۡاْ فِي ٱلۡأَرۡضِ مُفۡسِدِينَ
translation: And to Madyan [We sent] their brother Shu'ayb, and he said, "O my people, worship Allah and expect the Last Day and do not commit abuse on the earth, spreading corruption

normalizedTranslation: and to madyan [we sent] their brother shu'ayb, and he said, "o my people, worship allah and expect the last day and do not commit abuse on the earth, spreading corruption

translation: But they denied him, so the earthquake seized them, and they became within their home [corpses] fallen prone

normalizedTranslation: but they denied him, so the earthquake seized them, and they became within their home [corpses] fallen prone

arabic: وَعَادٗا وَثَمُودَاْ وَقَد تَّبَيَّنَ لَكُم مِّن مَّسَٰكِنِهِمۡۖ وَزَيَّنَ لَهُمُ ٱلشَّيۡطَٰنُ أَعۡمَٰلَهُمۡ فَصَدَّهُمۡ عَنِ ٱلسَّبِيلِ وَكَانُواْ مُسۡتَبۡصِرِينَ
translation: And [We destroyed] 'Aad and Thamud, and it has become clear to you from their [ruined] dwellings. And Satan had made pleasing to them their deeds and averted them from the path, and they were endowed with perception

normalizedTranslation: and [we destroyed] 'aad and thamud, and it has become clear to you from their [ruined] dwellings. and satan had made pleasing to them their deeds and averted them from the path, and they were endowed with perception

translation: And [We destroyed] Qarun and Pharaoh and Haman. And Moses had already come to them with clear evidences, and they were arrogant in the land, but they were not outrunners [of Our punishment]

arabic: مَثَلُ ٱلَّذِينَ ٱتَّخَذُواْ مِن دُونِ ٱللَّهِ أَوۡلِيَآءَ كَمَثَلِ ٱلۡعَنكَبُوتِ ٱتَّخَذَتۡ بَيۡتٗاۖ وَإِنَّ أَوۡهَنَ ٱلۡبُيُوتِ لَبَيۡتُ ٱلۡعَنكَبُوتِۚ لَوۡ كَانُواْ يَعۡلَمُونَ
translation: The example of those who take allies other than Allah is like that of the spider who takes a home. And indeed, the weakest of homes is the home of the spider, if they only knew

normalizedTranslation: the example of those who take allies other than allah is like that of the spider who takes a home. and indeed, the weakest of homes is the home of the spider, if they only knew

translation: Indeed, Allah knows whatever thing they call upon other than Him. And He is the Exalted in Might, the Wise

normalizedTranslation: indeed, allah knows whatever thing they call upon other than him. and he is the exalted in might, the wise

arabic: وَتِلۡكَ ٱلۡأَمۡثَٰلُ نَضۡرِبُهَا لِلنَّاسِۖ وَمَا يَعۡقِلُهَآ إِلَّا ٱلۡعَٰلِمُونَ
translation: And these examples We present to the people, but none will understand them except those of knowledge

normalizedTranslation: and these examples we present to the people, but none will understand them except those of knowledge

normalizedTranslation: allah created the heavens and the earth in truth. indeed in that is a sign for the believers

arabic: ٱتۡلُ مَآ أُوحِيَ إِلَيۡكَ مِنَ ٱلۡكِتَٰبِ وَأَقِمِ ٱلصَّلَوٰةَۖ إِنَّ ٱلصَّلَوٰةَ تَنۡهَىٰ عَنِ ٱلۡفَحۡشَآءِ وَٱلۡمُنكَرِۗ وَلَذِكۡرُ ٱللَّهِ أَكۡبَرُۗ وَٱللَّهُ يَعۡلَمُ مَا تَصۡنَعُونَ
translation: Recite, [O Muhammad], what has been revealed to you of the Book and establish prayer. Indeed, prayer prohibits immorality and wrongdoing, and the remembrance of Allah is greater. And Allah knows that which you do

normalizedTranslation: recite, [o muhammad], what has been revealed to you of the book and establish prayer. indeed, prayer prohibits immorality and wrongdoing, and the remembrance of allah is greater. and allah knows that which you do

arabic: ۞وَلَا تُجَٰدِلُوٓاْ أَهۡلَ ٱلۡكِتَٰبِ إِلَّا بِٱلَّتِي هِيَ أَحۡسَنُ إِلَّا ٱلَّذِينَ ظَلَمُواْ مِنۡهُمۡۖ وَقُولُوٓاْ ءَامَنَّا بِٱلَّذِيٓ أُنزِلَ إِلَيۡنَا وَأُنزِلَ إِلَيۡكُمۡ وَإِلَٰهُنَا وَإِلَٰهُكُمۡ وَٰحِدٞ وَنَحۡنُ لَهُۥ مُسۡلِمُونَ
translation: And do not argue with the People of the Scripture except in a way that is best, except for those who commit injustice among them, and say, "We believe in that which has been revealed to us and revealed to you. And our God and your God is one; and we are Muslims [in submission] to Him
normalizedArabic: ولا تجدلوا اهل الكتب الا بالتي هي احسن الا الذين ظلموا منهم وقولوا ءامنا بالذي انزل الينا وانزل اليكم والهنا والهكم وحد ونحن له مسلمون
normalizedTranslation: and do not argue with the people of the scripture except in a way that is best, except for those who commit injustice among them, and say, "we believe in that which has been revealed to us and revealed to you. and our god and your god is one; and we are muslims [in submission] to him

arabic: وَكَذَٰلِكَ أَنزَلۡنَآ إِلَيۡكَ ٱلۡكِتَٰبَۚ فَٱلَّذِينَ ءَاتَيۡنَٰهُمُ ٱلۡكِتَٰبَ يُؤۡمِنُونَ بِهِۦۖ وَمِنۡ هَـٰٓؤُلَآءِ مَن يُؤۡمِنُ بِهِۦۚ وَمَا يَجۡحَدُ بِـَٔايَٰتِنَآ إِلَّا ٱلۡكَٰفِرُونَ
translation: And thus We have sent down to you the Qur'an. And those to whom We [previously] gave the Scripture believe in it. And among these [people of Makkah] are those who believe in it. And none reject Our verses except the disbelievers
