normalizedTranslation: and thus we have sent down to you the qur'an. and those to whom we [previously] gave the scripture believe in it. and among these [people of makkah] are those who believe in it. and none reject our verses except the disbelievers

arabic: وَمَا كُنتَ تَتۡلُواْ مِن قَبۡلِهِۦ مِن كِتَٰبٖ وَلَا تَخُطُّهُۥ بِيَمِينِكَۖ إِذٗا لَّٱرۡتَابَ ٱلۡمُبۡطِلُونَ
translation: And you did not recite before it any scripture, nor did you inscribe one with your right hand. Otherwise the falsifiers would have had [cause for] doubt
normalizedArabic: وما كنت تتلوا من قبله من كتب ولا تخطه بيمينك اذا لارتاب المبطلون
normalizedTranslation: and you did not recite before it any scripture, nor did you inscribe one with your right hand. otherwise the falsifiers would have had [cause for] doubt

arabic: بَلۡ هُوَ ءَايَٰتُۢ بَيِّنَٰتٞ فِي صُدُورِ ٱلَّذِينَ أُوتُواْ ٱلۡعِلۡمَۚ وَمَا يَجۡحَدُ بِـَٔايَٰتِنَآ إِلَّا ٱلظَّـٰلِمُونَ
translation: Rather, the Qur'an is distinct verses [preserved] within the breasts of those who have been given knowledge. And none reject Our verses except the wrongdoers
normalizedArabic: بل هو ءايت بينت في صدور الذين اوتوا العلم وما يجحد بايتنا الا الظلمون
normalizedTranslation: rather, the qur'an is distinct verses [preserved] within the breasts of those who have been given knowledge. and none reject our verses except the wrongdoers

arabic: وَقَالُواْ لَوۡلَآ أُنزِلَ عَلَيۡهِ ءَايَٰتٞ مِّن رَّبِّهِۦۚ قُلۡ إِنَّمَا ٱلۡأٓيَٰتُ عِندَ ٱللَّهِ وَإِنَّمَآ أَنَا۠ نَذِيرٞ مُّبِينٌ
translation: But they say, "Why are not signs sent down to him from his Lord?" Say, "The signs are only with Allah, and I am only a clear warner
normalizedArabic: وقالوا لولا انزل عليه ءايت من ربه قل انما الايت عند الله وانما انا نذير مبين
normalizedTranslation: but they say, "why are not signs sent down to him from his lord?" say, "the signs are only with allah, and i am only a clear warner

arabic: أَوَلَمۡ يَكۡفِهِمۡ أَنَّآ أَنزَلۡنَا عَلَيۡكَ ٱلۡكِتَٰبَ يُتۡلَىٰ عَلَيۡهِمۡۚ إِنَّ فِي ذَٰلِكَ لَرَحۡمَةٗ وَذِكۡرَىٰ لِقَوۡمٖ يُؤۡمِنُونَ
translation: And is it not sufficient for them that We revealed to you the Book which is recited to them? Indeed in that is a mercy and reminder for a people who believe
normalizedArabic: اولم يكفهم انا انزلنا عليك الكتب يتلي عليهم ان في ذلك لرحمه وذكري لقوم يومنون
normalizedTranslation: and is it not sufficient for them that we revealed to you the book which is recited to them? indeed in that is a mercy and reminder for a people who believe

arabic: قُلۡ كَفَىٰ بِٱللَّهِ بَيۡنِي وَبَيۡنَكُمۡ شَهِيدٗاۖ يَعۡلَمُ مَا فِي ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلۡأَرۡضِۗ وَٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُواْ بِٱلۡبَٰطِلِ وَكَفَرُواْ بِٱللَّهِ أُوْلَـٰٓئِكَ هُمُ ٱلۡخَٰسِرُونَ
translation: Say, "Sufficient is Allah between me and you as Witness. He knows what is in the heavens and earth. And they who have believed in falsehood and disbelieved in Allah - it is those who are the losers
normalizedArabic: قل كفي بالله بيني وبينكم شهيدا يعلم ما في السموت والارض والذين ءامنوا بالبطل وكفروا بالله اوليك هم الخسرون
normalizedTranslation: say, "sufficient is allah between me and you as witness. he knows what is in the heavens and earth. and they who have believed in falsehood and disbelieved in allah - it is those who are the losers

arabic: وَيَسۡتَعۡجِلُونَكَ بِٱلۡعَذَابِ وَلَوۡلَآ أَجَلٞ مُّسَمّٗى لَّجَآءَهُمُ ٱلۡعَذَابُۚ وَلَيَأۡتِيَنَّهُم بَغۡتَةٗ وَهُمۡ لَا يَشۡعُرُونَ
translation: And they urge you to hasten the punishment. And if not for [the decree of] a specified term, punishment would have reached them. But it will surely come to them suddenly while they perceive not
normalizedArabic: ويستعجلونك بالعذاب ولولا اجل مسمي لجاءهم العذاب ولياتينهم بغته وهم لا يشعرون
normalizedTranslation: and they urge you to hasten the punishment. and if not for [the decree of] a specified term, punishment would have reached them. but it will surely come to them suddenly while they perceive not

arabic: يَسۡتَعۡجِلُونَكَ بِٱلۡعَذَابِ وَإِنَّ جَهَنَّمَ لَمُحِيطَةُۢ بِٱلۡكَٰفِرِينَ
translation: They urge you to hasten the punishment. And indeed, Hell will be encompassing of the disbelievers
normalizedArabic: يستعجلونك بالعذاب وان جهنم لمحيطه بالكفرين
normalizedTranslation: they urge you to hasten the punishment. and indeed, hell will be encompassing of the disbelievers

arabic: يَوۡمَ يَغۡشَىٰهُمُ ٱلۡعَذَابُ مِن فَوۡقِهِمۡ وَمِن تَحۡتِ أَرۡجُلِهِمۡ وَيَقُولُ ذُوقُواْ مَا كُنتُمۡ تَعۡمَلُونَ
translation: On the Day the punishment will cover them from above them and from below their feet and it is said, "Taste [the result of] what you used to do
normalizedArabic: يوم يغشيهم العذاب من فوقهم ومن تحت ارجلهم ويقول ذوقوا ما كنتم تعملون
normalizedTranslation: on the day the punishment will cover them from above them and from below their feet and it is said, "taste [the result of] what you used to do

arabic: يَٰعِبَادِيَ ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوٓاْ إِنَّ أَرۡضِي وَٰسِعَةٞ فَإِيَّـٰيَ فَٱعۡبُدُونِ
translation: O My servants who have believed, indeed My earth is spacious, so worship only Me
normalizedArabic: يعبادي الذين ءامنوا ان ارضي وسعه فايي فاعبدون
normalizedTranslation: o my servants who have believed, indeed my earth is spacious, so worship only me

arabic: كُلُّ نَفۡسٖ ذَآئِقَةُ ٱلۡمَوۡتِۖ ثُمَّ إِلَيۡنَا تُرۡجَعُونَ
translation: Every soul will taste death. Then to Us will you be returned
normalizedArabic: كل نفس ذايقه الموت ثم الينا ترجعون
normalizedTranslation: every soul will taste death. then to us will you be returned

arabic: وَٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُواْ وَعَمِلُواْ ٱلصَّـٰلِحَٰتِ لَنُبَوِّئَنَّهُم مِّنَ ٱلۡجَنَّةِ غُرَفٗا تَجۡرِي مِن تَحۡتِهَا ٱلۡأَنۡهَٰرُ خَٰلِدِينَ فِيهَاۚ نِعۡمَ أَجۡرُ ٱلۡعَٰمِلِينَ
translation: And those who have believed and done righteous deeds - We will surely assign to them of Paradise [elevated] chambers beneath which rivers flow, wherein they abide eternally. Excellent is the reward of the [righteous] workers
normalizedArabic: والذين ءامنوا وعملوا الصلحت لنبوينهم من الجنه غرفا تجري من تحتها الانهر خلدين فيها نعم اجر العملين
normalizedTranslation: and those who have believed and done righteous deeds - we will surely assign to them of paradise [elevated] chambers beneath which rivers flow, wherein they abide eternally. excellent is the reward of the [righteous] workers

arabic: ٱلَّذِينَ صَبَرُواْ وَعَلَىٰ رَبِّهِمۡ يَتَوَكَّلُونَ
translation: Who have been patient and upon their Lord rely
normalizedArabic: الذين صبروا وعلي ربهم يتوكلون
normalizedTranslation: who have been patient and upon their lord rely

arabic: وَكَأَيِّن مِّن دَآبَّةٖ لَّا تَحۡمِلُ رِزۡقَهَا ٱللَّهُ يَرۡزُقُهَا وَإِيَّاكُمۡۚ وَهُوَ ٱلسَّمِيعُ ٱلۡعَلِيمُ
translation: And how many a creature carries not its [own] provision. Allah provides for it and for you. And He is the Hearing, the Knowing
normalizedArabic: وكاين من دابه لا تحمل رزقها الله يرزقها واياكم وهو السميع العليم
normalizedTranslation: and how many a creature carries not its [own] provision. allah provides for it and for you. and he is the hearing, the knowing

arabic: وَلَئِن سَأَلۡتَهُم مَّنۡ خَلَقَ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلۡأَرۡضَ وَسَخَّرَ ٱلشَّمۡسَ وَٱلۡقَمَرَ لَيَقُولُنَّ ٱللَّهُۖ فَأَنَّىٰ يُؤۡفَكُونَ
translation: If you asked them, "Who created the heavens and earth and subjected the sun and the moon?" they would surely say, "Allah." Then how are they deluded
normalizedArabic: ولين سالتهم من خلق السموت والارض وسخر الشمس والقمر ليقولن الله فاني يوفكون
normalizedTranslation: if you asked them, "who created the heavens and earth and subjected the sun and the moon?" they would surely say, "allah." then how are they deluded

arabic: ٱللَّهُ يَبۡسُطُ ٱلرِّزۡقَ لِمَن يَشَآءُ مِنۡ عِبَادِهِۦ وَيَقۡدِرُ لَهُۥٓۚ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ بِكُلِّ شَيۡءٍ عَلِيمٞ
translation: Allah extends provision for whom He wills of His servants and restricts for him. Indeed Allah is, of all things, Knowing
normalizedArabic: الله يبسط الرزق لمن يشاء من عباده ويقدر له ان الله بكل شيء عليم
normalizedTranslation: allah extends provision for whom he wills of his servants and restricts for him. indeed allah is, of all things, knowing

arabic: وَلَئِن سَأَلۡتَهُم مَّن نَّزَّلَ مِنَ ٱلسَّمَآءِ مَآءٗ فَأَحۡيَا بِهِ ٱلۡأَرۡضَ مِنۢ بَعۡدِ مَوۡتِهَا لَيَقُولُنَّ ٱللَّهُۚ قُلِ ٱلۡحَمۡدُ لِلَّهِۚ بَلۡ أَكۡثَرُهُمۡ لَا يَعۡقِلُونَ
translation: And if you asked them, "Who sends down rain from the sky and gives life thereby to the earth after its lifelessness?" they would surely say " Allah." Say, "Praise to Allah "; but most of them do not reason
normalizedArabic: ولين سالتهم من نزل من السماء ماء فاحيا به الارض من بعد موتها ليقولن الله قل الحمد لله بل اكثرهم لا يعقلون
normalizedTranslation: and if you asked them, "who sends down rain from the sky and gives life thereby to the earth after its lifelessness?" they would surely say " allah." say, "praise to allah "; but most of them do not reason

arabic: وَمَا هَٰذِهِ ٱلۡحَيَوٰةُ ٱلدُّنۡيَآ إِلَّا لَهۡوٞ وَلَعِبٞۚ وَإِنَّ ٱلدَّارَ ٱلۡأٓخِرَةَ لَهِيَ ٱلۡحَيَوَانُۚ لَوۡ كَانُواْ يَعۡلَمُونَ
translation: And this worldly life is not but diversion and amusement. And indeed, the home of the Hereafter - that is the [eternal] life, if only they knew
normalizedArabic: وما هذه الحيوه الدنيا الا لهو ولعب وان الدار الاخره لهي الحيوان لو كانوا يعلمون
normalizedTranslation: and this worldly life is not but diversion and amusement. and indeed, the home of the hereafter - that is the [eternal] life, if only they knew

arabic: فَإِذَا رَكِبُواْ فِي ٱلۡفُلۡكِ دَعَوُاْ ٱللَّهَ مُخۡلِصِينَ لَهُ ٱلدِّينَ فَلَمَّا نَجَّىٰهُمۡ إِلَى ٱلۡبَرِّ إِذَا هُمۡ يُشۡرِكُونَ
translation: And when they board a ship, they supplicate Allah, sincere to Him in religion. But when He delivers them to the land, at once they associate others with Him
normalizedArabic: فاذا ركبوا في الفلك دعوا الله مخلصين له الدين فلما نجيهم الي البر اذا هم يشركون
normalizedTranslation: and when they board a ship, they supplicate allah, sincere to him in religion. but when he delivers them to the land, at once they associate others with him

arabic: لِيَكۡفُرُواْ بِمَآ ءَاتَيۡنَٰهُمۡ وَلِيَتَمَتَّعُواْۚ فَسَوۡفَ يَعۡلَمُونَ
translation: So that they will deny what We have granted them, and they will enjoy themselves. But they are going to know
normalizedArabic: ليكفروا بما ءاتينهم وليتمتعوا فسوف يعلمون
normalizedTranslation: so that they will deny what we have granted them, and they will enjoy themselves. but they are going to know

arabic: أَوَلَمۡ يَرَوۡاْ أَنَّا جَعَلۡنَا حَرَمًا ءَامِنٗا وَيُتَخَطَّفُ ٱلنَّاسُ مِنۡ حَوۡلِهِمۡۚ أَفَبِٱلۡبَٰطِلِ يُؤۡمِنُونَ وَبِنِعۡمَةِ ٱللَّهِ يَكۡفُرُونَ
translation: Have they not seen that We made [Makkah] a safe sanctuary, while people are being taken away all around them? Then in falsehood do they believe, and in the favor of Allah they disbelieve
normalizedArabic: اولم يروا انا جعلنا حرما ءامنا ويتخطف الناس من حولهم افبالبطل يومنون وبنعمه الله يكفرون
normalizedTranslation: have they not seen that we made [makkah] a safe sanctuary, while people are being taken away all around them? then in falsehood do they believe, and in the favor of allah they disbelieve

arabic: وَمَنۡ أَظۡلَمُ مِمَّنِ ٱفۡتَرَىٰ عَلَى ٱللَّهِ كَذِبًا أَوۡ كَذَّبَ بِٱلۡحَقِّ لَمَّا جَآءَهُۥٓۚ أَلَيۡسَ فِي جَهَنَّمَ مَثۡوٗى لِّلۡكَٰفِرِينَ
translation: And who is more unjust than one who invents a lie about Allah or denies the truth when it has come to him? Is there not in Hell a [sufficient] residence for the disbelievers
normalizedArabic: ومن اظلم ممن افتري علي الله كذبا او كذب بالحق لما جاءه اليس في جهنم مثوي للكفرين
normalizedTranslation: and who is more unjust than one who invents a lie about allah or denies the truth when it has come to him? is there not in hell a [sufficient] residence for the disbelievers

arabic: وَٱلَّذِينَ جَٰهَدُواْ فِينَا لَنَهۡدِيَنَّهُمۡ سُبُلَنَاۚ وَإِنَّ ٱللَّهَ لَمَعَ ٱلۡمُحۡسِنِينَ
translation: And those who strive for Us - We will surely guide them to Our ways. And indeed, Allah is with the doers of good
normalizedArabic: والذين جهدوا فينا لنهدينهم سبلنا وان الله لمع المحسنين
normalizedTranslation: and those who strive for us - we will surely guide them to our ways. and indeed, allah is with the doers of good

arabic: الٓمٓ
translation: Alif, Lam, Meem
normalizedArabic: الم
normalizedTranslation: alif, lam, meem

arabic: غُلِبَتِ ٱلرُّومُ
translation: The Byzantines have been defeated
normalizedArabic: غلبت الروم
normalizedTranslation: the byzantines have been defeated

arabic: فِيٓ أَدۡنَى ٱلۡأَرۡضِ وَهُم مِّنۢ بَعۡدِ غَلَبِهِمۡ سَيَغۡلِبُونَ
translation: In the nearest land. But they, after their defeat, will overcome
normalizedArabic: في ادني الارض وهم من بعد غلبهم سيغلبون
normalizedTranslation: in the nearest land. but they, after their defeat, will overcome

arabic: فِي بِضۡعِ سِنِينَۗ لِلَّهِ ٱلۡأَمۡرُ مِن قَبۡلُ وَمِنۢ بَعۡدُۚ وَيَوۡمَئِذٖ يَفۡرَحُ ٱلۡمُؤۡمِنُونَ
translation: Within three to nine years. To Allah belongs the command before and after. And that day the believers will rejoice
normalizedArabic: في بضع سنين لله الامر من قبل ومن بعد ويوميذ يفرح المومنون
normalizedTranslation: within three to nine years. to allah belongs the command before and after. and that day the believers will rejoice

arabic: بِنَصۡرِ ٱللَّهِۚ يَنصُرُ مَن يَشَآءُۖ وَهُوَ ٱلۡعَزِيزُ ٱلرَّحِيمُ
translation: In the victory of Allah. He gives victory to whom He wills, and He is the Exalted in Might, the Merciful
normalizedArabic: بنصر الله ينصر من يشاء وهو العزيز الرحيم
normalizedTranslation: in the victory of allah. he gives victory to whom he wills, and he is the exalted in might, the merciful

arabic: وَعۡدَ ٱللَّهِۖ لَا يُخۡلِفُ ٱللَّهُ وَعۡدَهُۥ وَلَٰكِنَّ أَكۡثَرَ ٱلنَّاسِ لَا يَعۡلَمُونَ
translation: [It is] the promise of Allah. Allah does not fail in His promise, but most of the people do not know
normalizedArabic: وعد الله لا يخلف الله وعده ولكن اكثر الناس لا يعلمون
normalizedTranslation: [it is] the promise of allah. allah does not fail in his promise, but most of the people do not know

arabic: يَعۡلَمُونَ ظَٰهِرٗا مِّنَ ٱلۡحَيَوٰةِ ٱلدُّنۡيَا وَهُمۡ عَنِ ٱلۡأٓخِرَةِ هُمۡ غَٰفِلُونَ
translation: They know what is apparent of the worldly life, but they, of the Hereafter, are unaware
normalizedArabic: يعلمون ظهرا من الحيوه الدنيا وهم عن الاخره هم غفلون
normalizedTranslation: they know what is apparent of the worldly life, but they, of the hereafter, are unaware

arabic: أَوَلَمۡ يَتَفَكَّرُواْ فِيٓ أَنفُسِهِمۗ مَّا خَلَقَ ٱللَّهُ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلۡأَرۡضَ وَمَا بَيۡنَهُمَآ إِلَّا بِٱلۡحَقِّ وَأَجَلٖ مُّسَمّٗىۗ وَإِنَّ كَثِيرٗا مِّنَ ٱلنَّاسِ بِلِقَآيِٕ رَبِّهِمۡ لَكَٰفِرُونَ
translation: Do they not contemplate within themselves? Allah has not created the heavens and the earth and what is between them except in truth and for a specified term. And indeed, many of the people, in [the matter of] the meeting with their Lord, are disbelievers
normalizedArabic: اولم يتفكروا في انفسهم ما خلق الله السموت والارض وما بينهما الا بالحق واجل مسمي وان كثيرا من الناس بلقاي ربهم لكفرون
normalizedTranslation: do they not contemplate within themselves? allah has not created the heavens and the earth and what is between them except in truth and for a specified term. and indeed, many of the people, in [the matter of] the meeting with their lord, are disbelievers

arabic: أَوَلَمۡ يَسِيرُواْ فِي ٱلۡأَرۡضِ فَيَنظُرُواْ كَيۡفَ كَانَ عَٰقِبَةُ ٱلَّذِينَ مِن قَبۡلِهِمۡۚ كَانُوٓاْ أَشَدَّ مِنۡهُمۡ قُوَّةٗ وَأَثَارُواْ ٱلۡأَرۡضَ وَعَمَرُوهَآ أَكۡثَرَ مِمَّا عَمَرُوهَا وَجَآءَتۡهُمۡ رُسُلُهُم بِٱلۡبَيِّنَٰتِۖ فَمَا كَانَ ٱللَّهُ لِيَظۡلِمَهُمۡ وَلَٰكِن كَانُوٓاْ أَنفُسَهُمۡ يَظۡلِمُونَ
translation: Have they not traveled through the earth and observed how was the end of those before them? They were greater than them in power, and they plowed the earth and built it up more than they have built it up, and their messengers came to them with clear evidences. And Allah would not ever have wronged them, but they were wronging themselves
normalizedArabic: اولم يسيروا في الارض فينظروا كيف كان عقبه الذين من قبلهم كانوا اشد منهم قوه واثاروا الارض وعمروها اكثر مما عمروها وجاءتهم رسلهم بالبينت فما كان الله ليظلمهم ولكن كانوا انفسهم يظلمون
normalizedTranslation: have they not traveled through the earth and observed how was the end of those before them? they were greater than them in power, and they plowed the earth and built it up more than they have built it up, and their messengers came to them with clear evidences. and allah would not ever have wronged them, but they were wronging themselves

arabic: ثُمَّ كَانَ عَٰقِبَةَ ٱلَّذِينَ أَسَـٰٓـُٔواْ ٱلسُّوٓأَىٰٓ أَن كَذَّبُواْ بِـَٔايَٰتِ ٱللَّهِ وَكَانُواْ بِهَا يَسۡتَهۡزِءُونَ
translation: Then the end of those who did evil was the worst [consequence] because they denied the signs of Allah and used to ridicule them
normalizedArabic: ثم كان عقبه الذين اسوا السواي ان كذبوا بايت الله وكانوا بها يستهزءون
normalizedTranslation: then the end of those who did evil was the worst [consequence] because they denied the signs of allah and used to ridicule them

arabic: ٱللَّهُ يَبۡدَؤُاْ ٱلۡخَلۡقَ ثُمَّ يُعِيدُهُۥ ثُمَّ إِلَيۡهِ تُرۡجَعُونَ
translation: Allah begins creation; then He will repeat it; then to Him you will be returned
normalizedArabic: الله يبدوا الخلق ثم يعيده ثم اليه ترجعون
normalizedTranslation: allah begins creation; then he will repeat it; then to him you will be returned

arabic: وَيَوۡمَ تَقُومُ ٱلسَّاعَةُ يُبۡلِسُ ٱلۡمُجۡرِمُونَ
translation: And the Day the Hour appears the criminals will be in despair
normalizedArabic: ويوم تقوم الساعه يبلس المجرمون
normalizedTranslation: and the day the hour appears the criminals will be in despair

arabic: وَلَمۡ يَكُن لَّهُم مِّن شُرَكَآئِهِمۡ شُفَعَـٰٓؤُاْ وَكَانُواْ بِشُرَكَآئِهِمۡ كَٰفِرِينَ
translation: And there will not be for them among their [alleged] partners any intercessors, and they will [then] be disbelievers in their partners
normalizedArabic: ولم يكن لهم من شركايهم شفعوا وكانوا بشركايهم كفرين
normalizedTranslation: and there will not be for them among their [alleged] partners any intercessors, and they will [then] be disbelievers in their partners

arabic: وَيَوۡمَ تَقُومُ ٱلسَّاعَةُ يَوۡمَئِذٖ يَتَفَرَّقُونَ
translation: And the Day the Hour appears - that Day they will become separated
normalizedArabic: ويوم تقوم الساعه يوميذ يتفرقون
normalizedTranslation: and the day the hour appears - that day they will become separated

arabic: فَأَمَّا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُواْ وَعَمِلُواْ ٱلصَّـٰلِحَٰتِ فَهُمۡ فِي رَوۡضَةٖ يُحۡبَرُونَ
translation: And as for those who had believed and done righteous deeds, they will be in a garden [of Paradise], delighted
normalizedArabic: فاما الذين ءامنوا وعملوا الصلحت فهم في روضه يحبرون
normalizedTranslation: and as for those who had believed and done righteous deeds, they will be in a garden [of paradise], delighted

arabic: وَأَمَّا ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُواْ وَكَذَّبُواْ بِـَٔايَٰتِنَا وَلِقَآيِٕ ٱلۡأٓخِرَةِ فَأُوْلَـٰٓئِكَ فِي ٱلۡعَذَابِ مُحۡضَرُونَ
translation: But as for those who disbelieved and denied Our verses and the meeting of the Hereafter, those will be brought into the punishment [to remain]
normalizedArabic: واما الذين كفروا وكذبوا بايتنا ولقاي الاخره فاوليك في العذاب محضرون
normalizedTranslation: but as for those who disbelieved and denied our verses and the meeting of the hereafter, those will be brought into the punishment [to remain]

arabic: فَسُبۡحَٰنَ ٱللَّهِ حِينَ تُمۡسُونَ وَحِينَ تُصۡبِحُونَ
translation: So exalted is Allah when you reach the evening and when you reach the morning
normalizedArabic: فسبحن الله حين تمسون وحين تصبحون
normalizedTranslation: so exalted is allah when you reach the evening and when you reach the morning

arabic: وَلَهُ ٱلۡحَمۡدُ فِي ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلۡأَرۡضِ وَعَشِيّٗا وَحِينَ تُظۡهِرُونَ
translation: And to Him is [due all] praise throughout the heavens and the earth. And [exalted is He] at night and when you are at noon
normalizedArabic: وله الحمد في السموت والارض وعشيا وحين تظهرون
normalizedTranslation: and to him is [due all] praise throughout the heavens and the earth. and [exalted is he] at night and when you are at noon

arabic: يُخۡرِجُ ٱلۡحَيَّ مِنَ ٱلۡمَيِّتِ وَيُخۡرِجُ ٱلۡمَيِّتَ مِنَ ٱلۡحَيِّ وَيُحۡيِ ٱلۡأَرۡضَ بَعۡدَ مَوۡتِهَاۚ وَكَذَٰلِكَ تُخۡرَجُونَ
translation: He brings the living out of the dead and brings the dead out of the living and brings to life the earth after its lifelessness. And thus will you be brought out
normalizedArabic: يخرج الحي من الميت ويخرج الميت من الحي ويحي الارض بعد موتها وكذلك تخرجون
normalizedTranslation: he brings the living out of the dead and brings the dead out of the living and brings to life the earth after its lifelessness. and thus will you be brought out

arabic: وَمِنۡ ءَايَٰتِهِۦٓ أَنۡ خَلَقَكُم مِّن تُرَابٖ ثُمَّ إِذَآ أَنتُم بَشَرٞ تَنتَشِرُونَ
translation: And of His signs is that He created you from dust; then, suddenly you were human beings dispersing [throughout the earth]
normalizedArabic: ومن ءايته ان خلقكم من تراب ثم اذا انتم بشر تنتشرون
normalizedTranslation: and of his signs is that he created you from dust; then, suddenly you were human beings dispersing [throughout the earth]

arabic: وَمِنۡ ءَايَٰتِهِۦٓ أَنۡ خَلَقَ لَكُم مِّنۡ أَنفُسِكُمۡ أَزۡوَٰجٗا لِّتَسۡكُنُوٓاْ إِلَيۡهَا وَجَعَلَ بَيۡنَكُم مَّوَدَّةٗ وَرَحۡمَةًۚ إِنَّ فِي ذَٰلِكَ لَأٓيَٰتٖ لِّقَوۡمٖ يَتَفَكَّرُونَ
translation: And of His signs is that He created for you from yourselves mates that you may find tranquillity in them; and He placed between you affection and mercy. Indeed in that are signs for a people who give thought
normalizedArabic: ومن ءايته ان خلق لكم من انفسكم ازوجا لتسكنوا اليها وجعل بينكم موده ورحمه ان في ذلك لايت لقوم يتفكرون
normalizedTranslation: and of his signs is that he created for you from yourselves mates that you may find tranquillity in them; and he placed between you affection and mercy. indeed in that are signs for a people who give thought

arabic: وَمِنۡ ءَايَٰتِهِۦ خَلۡقُ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلۡأَرۡضِ وَٱخۡتِلَٰفُ أَلۡسِنَتِكُمۡ وَأَلۡوَٰنِكُمۡۚ إِنَّ فِي ذَٰلِكَ لَأٓيَٰتٖ لِّلۡعَٰلِمِينَ
translation: And of His signs is the creation of the heavens and the earth and the diversity of your languages and your colors. Indeed in that are signs for those of knowledge
normalizedArabic: ومن ءايته خلق السموت والارض واختلف السنتكم والونكم ان في ذلك لايت للعلمين
normalizedTranslation: and of his signs is the creation of the heavens and the earth and the diversity of your languages and your colors. indeed in that are signs for those of knowledge

arabic: وَمِنۡ ءَايَٰتِهِۦ مَنَامُكُم بِٱلَّيۡلِ وَٱلنَّهَارِ وَٱبۡتِغَآؤُكُم مِّن فَضۡلِهِۦٓۚ إِنَّ فِي ذَٰلِكَ لَأٓيَٰتٖ لِّقَوۡمٖ يَسۡمَعُونَ
translation: And of His signs is your sleep by night and day and your seeking of His bounty. Indeed in that are signs for a people who listen
normalizedArabic: ومن ءايته منامكم باليل والنهار وابتغاوكم من فضله ان في ذلك لايت لقوم يسمعون
normalizedTranslation: and of his signs is your sleep by night and day and your seeking of his bounty. indeed in that are signs for a people who listen

arabic: وَمِنۡ ءَايَٰتِهِۦ يُرِيكُمُ ٱلۡبَرۡقَ خَوۡفٗا وَطَمَعٗا وَيُنَزِّلُ مِنَ ٱلسَّمَآءِ مَآءٗ فَيُحۡيِۦ بِهِ ٱلۡأَرۡضَ بَعۡدَ مَوۡتِهَآۚ إِنَّ فِي ذَٰلِكَ لَأٓيَٰتٖ لِّقَوۡمٖ يَعۡقِلُونَ
translation: And of His signs is [that] He shows you the lightning [causing] fear and aspiration, and He sends down rain from the sky by which He brings to life the earth after its lifelessness. Indeed in that are signs for a people who use reason
normalizedArabic: ومن ءايته يريكم البرق خوفا وطمعا وينزل من السماء ماء فيحي به الارض بعد موتها ان في ذلك لايت لقوم يعقلون
normalizedTranslation: and of his signs is [that] he shows you the lightning [causing] fear and aspiration, and he sends down rain from the sky by which he brings to life the earth after its lifelessness. indeed in that are signs for a people who use reason

arabic: وَمِنۡ ءَايَٰتِهِۦٓ أَن تَقُومَ ٱلسَّمَآءُ وَٱلۡأَرۡضُ بِأَمۡرِهِۦۚ ثُمَّ إِذَا دَعَاكُمۡ دَعۡوَةٗ مِّنَ ٱلۡأَرۡضِ إِذَآ أَنتُمۡ تَخۡرُجُونَ
translation: And of His signs is that the heaven and earth remain by His command. Then when He calls you with a [single] call from the earth, immediately you will come forth
normalizedArabic: ومن ءايته ان تقوم السماء والارض بامره ثم اذا دعاكم دعوه من الارض اذا انتم تخرجون
normalizedTranslation: and of his signs is that the heaven and earth remain by his command. then when he calls you with a [single] call from the earth, immediately you will come forth

arabic: وَلَهُۥ مَن فِي ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلۡأَرۡضِۖ كُلّٞ لَّهُۥ قَٰنِتُونَ
translation: And to Him belongs whoever is in the heavens and earth. All are to Him devoutly obedient
normalizedArabic: وله من في السموت والارض كل له قنتون
normalizedTranslation: and to him belongs whoever is in the heavens and earth. all are to him devoutly obedient

arabic: وَهُوَ ٱلَّذِي يَبۡدَؤُاْ ٱلۡخَلۡقَ ثُمَّ يُعِيدُهُۥ وَهُوَ أَهۡوَنُ عَلَيۡهِۚ وَلَهُ ٱلۡمَثَلُ ٱلۡأَعۡلَىٰ فِي ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلۡأَرۡضِۚ وَهُوَ ٱلۡعَزِيزُ ٱلۡحَكِيمُ
translation: And it is He who begins creation; then He repeats it, and that is [even] easier for Him. To Him belongs the highest attribute in the heavens and earth. And He is the Exalted in Might, the Wise
normalizedArabic: وهو الذي يبدوا الخلق ثم يعيده وهو اهون عليه وله المثل الاعلي في السموت والارض وهو العزيز الحكيم
normalizedTranslation: and it is he who begins creation; then he repeats it, and that is [even] easier for him. to him belongs the highest attribute in the heavens and earth. and he is the exalted in might, the wise

arabic: ضَرَبَ لَكُم مَّثَلٗا مِّنۡ أَنفُسِكُمۡۖ هَل لَّكُم مِّن مَّا مَلَكَتۡ أَيۡمَٰنُكُم مِّن شُرَكَآءَ فِي مَا رَزَقۡنَٰكُمۡ فَأَنتُمۡ فِيهِ سَوَآءٞ تَخَافُونَهُمۡ كَخِيفَتِكُمۡ أَنفُسَكُمۡۚ كَذَٰلِكَ نُفَصِّلُ ٱلۡأٓيَٰتِ لِقَوۡمٖ يَعۡقِلُونَ
translation: He presents to you an example from yourselves. Do you have among those whom your right hands possess any partners in what We have provided for you so that you are equal therein [and] would fear them as your fear of one another [within a partnership]? Thus do We detail the verses for a people who use reason
normalizedArabic: ضرب لكم مثلا من انفسكم هل لكم من ما ملكت ايمنكم من شركاء في ما رزقنكم فانتم فيه سواء تخافونهم كخيفتكم انفسكم كذلك نفصل الايت لقوم يعقلون
normalizedTranslation: he presents to you an example from yourselves. do you have among those whom your right hands possess any partners in what we have provided for you so that you are equal therein [and] would fear them as your fear of one another [within a partnership]? thus do we detail the verses for a people who use reason

arabic: بَلِ ٱتَّبَعَ ٱلَّذِينَ ظَلَمُوٓاْ أَهۡوَآءَهُم بِغَيۡرِ عِلۡمٖۖ فَمَن يَهۡدِي مَنۡ أَضَلَّ ٱللَّهُۖ وَمَا لَهُم مِّن نَّـٰصِرِينَ
translation: But those who wrong follow their [own] desires without knowledge. Then who can guide one whom Allah has sent astray? And for them there are no helpers
normalizedArabic: بل اتبع الذين ظلموا اهواءهم بغير علم فمن يهدي من اضل الله وما لهم من نصرين
normalizedTranslation: but those who wrong follow their [own] desires without knowledge. then who can guide one whom allah has sent astray? and for them there are no helpers

arabic: فَأَقِمۡ وَجۡهَكَ لِلدِّينِ حَنِيفٗاۚ فِطۡرَتَ ٱللَّهِ ٱلَّتِي فَطَرَ ٱلنَّاسَ عَلَيۡهَاۚ لَا تَبۡدِيلَ لِخَلۡقِ ٱللَّهِۚ ذَٰلِكَ ٱلدِّينُ ٱلۡقَيِّمُ وَلَٰكِنَّ أَكۡثَرَ ٱلنَّاسِ لَا يَعۡلَمُونَ
translation: So direct your face toward the religion, inclining to truth. [Adhere to] the fitrah of Allah upon which He has created [all] people. No change should there be in the creation of Allah. That is the correct religion, but most of the people do not know
normalizedArabic: فاقم وجهك للدين حنيفا فطرت الله التي فطر الناس عليها لا تبديل لخلق الله ذلك الدين القيم ولكن اكثر الناس لا يعلمون
normalizedTranslation: so direct your face toward the religion, inclining to truth. [adhere to] the fitrah of allah upon which he has created [all] people. no change should there be in the creation of allah. that is the correct religion, but most of the people do not know

arabic: ۞مُنِيبِينَ إِلَيۡهِ وَٱتَّقُوهُ وَأَقِيمُواْ ٱلصَّلَوٰةَ وَلَا تَكُونُواْ مِنَ ٱلۡمُشۡرِكِينَ
translation: [Adhere to it], turning in repentance to Him, and fear Him and establish prayer and do not be of those who associate others with Allah
normalizedArabic: منيبين اليه واتقوه واقيموا الصلوه ولا تكونوا من المشركين
normalizedTranslation: [adhere to it], turning in repentance to him, and fear him and establish prayer and do not be of those who associate others with allah

arabic: مِنَ ٱلَّذِينَ فَرَّقُواْ دِينَهُمۡ وَكَانُواْ شِيَعٗاۖ كُلُّ حِزۡبِۭ بِمَا لَدَيۡهِمۡ فَرِحُونَ
translation: [Or] of those who have divided their religion and become sects, every faction rejoicing in what it has
normalizedArabic: من الذين فرقوا دينهم وكانوا شيعا كل حزب بما لديهم فرحون
normalizedTranslation: [or] of those who have divided their religion and become sects, every faction rejoicing in what it has

arabic: وَإِذَا مَسَّ ٱلنَّاسَ ضُرّٞ دَعَوۡاْ رَبَّهُم مُّنِيبِينَ إِلَيۡهِ ثُمَّ إِذَآ أَذَاقَهُم مِّنۡهُ رَحۡمَةً إِذَا فَرِيقٞ مِّنۡهُم بِرَبِّهِمۡ يُشۡرِكُونَ
translation: And when adversity touches the people, they call upon their Lord, turning in repentance to Him. Then when He lets them taste mercy from Him, at once a party of them associate others with their Lord
normalizedArabic: واذا مس الناس ضر دعوا ربهم منيبين اليه ثم اذا اذاقهم منه رحمه اذا فريق منهم بربهم يشركون
normalizedTranslation: and when adversity touches the people, they call upon their lord, turning in repentance to him. then when he lets them taste mercy from him, at once a party of them associate others with their lord

arabic: لِيَكۡفُرُواْ بِمَآ ءَاتَيۡنَٰهُمۡۚ فَتَمَتَّعُواْ فَسَوۡفَ تَعۡلَمُونَ
translation: So that they will deny what We have granted them. Then enjoy yourselves, for you are going to know
normalizedArabic: ليكفروا بما ءاتينهم فتمتعوا فسوف تعلمون
normalizedTranslation: so that they will deny what we have granted them. then enjoy yourselves, for you are going to know

arabic: أَمۡ أَنزَلۡنَا عَلَيۡهِمۡ سُلۡطَٰنٗا فَهُوَ يَتَكَلَّمُ بِمَا كَانُواْ بِهِۦ يُشۡرِكُونَ
translation: Or have We sent down to them an authority, and it speaks of what they were associating with Him
normalizedArabic: ام انزلنا عليهم سلطنا فهو يتكلم بما كانوا به يشركون
normalizedTranslation: or have we sent down to them an authority, and it speaks of what they were associating with him

arabic: وَإِذَآ أَذَقۡنَا ٱلنَّاسَ رَحۡمَةٗ فَرِحُواْ بِهَاۖ وَإِن تُصِبۡهُمۡ سَيِّئَةُۢ بِمَا قَدَّمَتۡ أَيۡدِيهِمۡ إِذَا هُمۡ يَقۡنَطُونَ
translation: And when We let the people taste mercy, they rejoice therein, but if evil afflicts them for what their hands have put forth, immediately they despair
normalizedArabic: واذا اذقنا الناس رحمه فرحوا بها وان تصبهم سييه بما قدمت ايديهم اذا هم يقنطون
normalizedTranslation: and when we let the people taste mercy, they rejoice therein, but if evil afflicts them for what their hands have put forth, immediately they despair

arabic: أَوَلَمۡ يَرَوۡاْ أَنَّ ٱللَّهَ يَبۡسُطُ ٱلرِّزۡقَ لِمَن يَشَآءُ وَيَقۡدِرُۚ إِنَّ فِي ذَٰلِكَ لَأٓيَٰتٖ لِّقَوۡمٖ يُؤۡمِنُونَ
translation: Do they not see that Allah extends provision for whom He wills and restricts [it]? Indeed, in that are signs for a people who believe
normalizedArabic: اولم يروا ان الله يبسط الرزق لمن يشاء ويقدر ان في ذلك لايت لقوم يومنون
normalizedTranslation: do they not see that allah extends provision for whom he wills and restricts [it]? indeed, in that are signs for a people who believe

arabic: فَـَٔاتِ ذَا ٱلۡقُرۡبَىٰ حَقَّهُۥ وَٱلۡمِسۡكِينَ وَٱبۡنَ ٱلسَّبِيلِۚ ذَٰلِكَ خَيۡرٞ لِّلَّذِينَ يُرِيدُونَ وَجۡهَ ٱللَّهِۖ وَأُوْلَـٰٓئِكَ هُمُ ٱلۡمُفۡلِحُونَ
translation: So give the relative his right, as well as the needy and the traveler. That is best for those who desire the countenance of Allah, and it is they who will be the successful
normalizedArabic: فات ذا القربي حقه والمسكين وابن السبيل ذلك خير للذين يريدون وجه الله واوليك هم المفلحون
normalizedTranslation: so give the relative his right, as well as the needy and the traveler. that is best for those who desire the countenance of allah, and it is they who will be the successful

arabic: وَمَآ ءَاتَيۡتُم مِّن رِّبٗا لِّيَرۡبُوَاْ فِيٓ أَمۡوَٰلِ ٱلنَّاسِ فَلَا يَرۡبُواْ عِندَ ٱللَّهِۖ وَمَآ ءَاتَيۡتُم مِّن زَكَوٰةٖ تُرِيدُونَ وَجۡهَ ٱللَّهِ فَأُوْلَـٰٓئِكَ هُمُ ٱلۡمُضۡعِفُونَ
translation: And whatever you give for interest to increase within the wealth of people will not increase with Allah. But what you give in zakah, desiring the countenance of Allah - those are the multipliers
normalizedArabic: وما ءاتيتم من ربا ليربوا في امول الناس فلا يربوا عند الله وما ءاتيتم من زكوه تريدون وجه الله فاوليك هم المضعفون
normalizedTranslation: and whatever you give for interest to increase within the wealth of people will not increase with allah. but what you give in zakah, desiring the countenance of allah - those are the multipliers

arabic: ٱللَّهُ ٱلَّذِي خَلَقَكُمۡ ثُمَّ رَزَقَكُمۡ ثُمَّ يُمِيتُكُمۡ ثُمَّ يُحۡيِيكُمۡۖ هَلۡ مِن شُرَكَآئِكُم مَّن يَفۡعَلُ مِن ذَٰلِكُم مِّن شَيۡءٖۚ سُبۡحَٰنَهُۥ وَتَعَٰلَىٰ عَمَّا يُشۡرِكُونَ
translation: Allah is the one who created you, then provided for you, then will cause you to die, and then will give you life. Are there any of your "partners" who does anything of that? Exalted is He and high above what they associate with Him
normalizedArabic: الله الذي خلقكم ثم رزقكم ثم يميتكم ثم يحييكم هل من شركايكم من يفعل من ذلكم من شيء سبحنه وتعلي عما يشركون
normalizedTranslation: allah is the one who created you, then provided for you, then will cause you to die, and then will give you life. are there any of your "partners" who does anything of that? exalted is he and high above what they associate with him

arabic: ظَهَرَ ٱلۡفَسَادُ فِي ٱلۡبَرِّ وَٱلۡبَحۡرِ بِمَا كَسَبَتۡ أَيۡدِي ٱلنَّاسِ لِيُذِيقَهُم بَعۡضَ ٱلَّذِي عَمِلُواْ لَعَلَّهُمۡ يَرۡجِعُونَ
translation: Corruption has appeared throughout the land and sea by [reason of] what the hands of people have earned so He may let them taste part of [the consequence of] what they have done that perhaps they will return [to righteousness]
normalizedArabic: ظهر الفساد في البر والبحر بما كسبت ايدي الناس ليذيقهم بعض الذي عملوا لعلهم يرجعون
normalizedTranslation: corruption has appeared throughout the land and sea by [reason of] what the hands of people have earned so he may let them taste part of [the consequence of] what they have done that perhaps they will return [to righteousness]

arabic: قُلۡ سِيرُواْ فِي ٱلۡأَرۡضِ فَٱنظُرُواْ كَيۡفَ كَانَ عَٰقِبَةُ ٱلَّذِينَ مِن قَبۡلُۚ كَانَ أَكۡثَرُهُم مُّشۡرِكِينَ
translation: Say, [O Muhammad], "Travel through the land and observe how was the end of those before. Most of them were associators [of others with Allah]
normalizedArabic: قل سيروا في الارض فانظروا كيف كان عقبه الذين من قبل كان اكثرهم مشركين
normalizedTranslation: say, [o muhammad], "travel through the land and observe how was the end of those before. most of them were associators [of others with allah]

arabic: فَأَقِمۡ وَجۡهَكَ لِلدِّينِ ٱلۡقَيِّمِ مِن قَبۡلِ أَن يَأۡتِيَ يَوۡمٞ لَّا مَرَدَّ لَهُۥ مِنَ ٱللَّهِۖ يَوۡمَئِذٖ يَصَّدَّعُونَ
translation: So direct your face toward the correct religion before a Day comes from Allah of which there is no repelling. That Day, they will be divided
normalizedArabic: فاقم وجهك للدين القيم من قبل ان ياتي يوم لا مرد له من الله يوميذ يصدعون
normalizedTranslation: so direct your face toward the correct religion before a day comes from allah of which there is no repelling. that day, they will be divided

arabic: مَن كَفَرَ فَعَلَيۡهِ كُفۡرُهُۥۖ وَمَنۡ عَمِلَ صَٰلِحٗا فَلِأَنفُسِهِمۡ يَمۡهَدُونَ
translation: Whoever disbelieves - upon him is [the consequence of] his disbelief. And whoever does righteousness - they are for themselves preparing
normalizedArabic: من كفر فعليه كفره ومن عمل صلحا فلانفسهم يمهدون
normalizedTranslation: whoever disbelieves - upon him is [the consequence of] his disbelief. and whoever does righteousness - they are for themselves preparing

arabic: لِيَجۡزِيَ ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُواْ وَعَمِلُواْ ٱلصَّـٰلِحَٰتِ مِن فَضۡلِهِۦٓۚ إِنَّهُۥ لَا يُحِبُّ ٱلۡكَٰفِرِينَ
translation: That He may reward those who have believed and done righteous deeds out of His bounty. Indeed, He does not like the disbelievers
normalizedArabic: ليجزي الذين ءامنوا وعملوا الصلحت من فضله انه لا يحب الكفرين
normalizedTranslation: that he may reward those who have believed and done righteous deeds out of his bounty. indeed, he does not like the disbelievers

arabic: وَمِنۡ ءَايَٰتِهِۦٓ أَن يُرۡسِلَ ٱلرِّيَاحَ مُبَشِّرَٰتٖ وَلِيُذِيقَكُم مِّن رَّحۡمَتِهِۦ وَلِتَجۡرِيَ ٱلۡفُلۡكُ بِأَمۡرِهِۦ وَلِتَبۡتَغُواْ مِن فَضۡلِهِۦ وَلَعَلَّكُمۡ تَشۡكُرُونَ
translation: And of His signs is that He sends the winds as bringers of good tidings and to let you taste His mercy and so the ships may sail at His command and so you may seek of His bounty, and perhaps you will be grateful
normalizedArabic: ومن ءايته ان يرسل الرياح مبشرت وليذيقكم من رحمته ولتجري الفلك بامره ولتبتغوا من فضله ولعلكم تشكرون
normalizedTranslation: and of his signs is that he sends the winds as bringers of good tidings and to let you taste his mercy and so the ships may sail at his command and so you may seek of his bounty, and perhaps you will be grateful

arabic: وَلَقَدۡ أَرۡسَلۡنَا مِن قَبۡلِكَ رُسُلًا إِلَىٰ قَوۡمِهِمۡ فَجَآءُوهُم بِٱلۡبَيِّنَٰتِ فَٱنتَقَمۡنَا مِنَ ٱلَّذِينَ أَجۡرَمُواْۖ وَكَانَ حَقًّا عَلَيۡنَا نَصۡرُ ٱلۡمُؤۡمِنِينَ
translation: And We have already sent messengers before you to their peoples, and they came to them with clear evidences; then We took retribution from those who committed crimes, and incumbent upon Us was support of the believers
normalizedArabic: ولقد ارسلنا من قبلك رسلا الي قومهم فجاءوهم بالبينت فانتقمنا من الذين اجرموا وكان حقا علينا نصر المومنين
normalizedTranslation: and we have already sent messengers before you to their peoples, and they came to them with clear evidences; then we took retribution from those who committed crimes, and incumbent upon us was support of the believers

arabic: ٱللَّهُ ٱلَّذِي يُرۡسِلُ ٱلرِّيَٰحَ فَتُثِيرُ سَحَابٗا فَيَبۡسُطُهُۥ فِي ٱلسَّمَآءِ كَيۡفَ يَشَآءُ وَيَجۡعَلُهُۥ كِسَفٗا فَتَرَى ٱلۡوَدۡقَ يَخۡرُجُ مِنۡ خِلَٰلِهِۦۖ فَإِذَآ أَصَابَ بِهِۦ مَن يَشَآءُ مِنۡ عِبَادِهِۦٓ إِذَا هُمۡ يَسۡتَبۡشِرُونَ
translation: It is Allah who sends the winds, and they stir the clouds and spread them in the sky however He wills, and He makes them fragments so you see the rain emerge from within them. And when He causes it to fall upon whom He wills of His servants, immediately they rejoice
normalizedArabic: الله الذي يرسل الريح فتثير سحابا فيبسطه في السماء كيف يشاء ويجعله كسفا فتري الودق يخرج من خلله فاذا اصاب به من يشاء من عباده اذا هم يستبشرون
normalizedTranslation: it is allah who sends the winds, and they stir the clouds and spread them in the sky however he wills, and he makes them fragments so you see the rain emerge from within them. and when he causes it to fall upon whom he wills of his servants, immediately they rejoice

arabic: وَإِن كَانُواْ مِن قَبۡلِ أَن يُنَزَّلَ عَلَيۡهِم مِّن قَبۡلِهِۦ لَمُبۡلِسِينَ
translation: Although they were, before it was sent down upon them - before that, in despair
normalizedArabic: وان كانوا من قبل ان ينزل عليهم من قبله لمبلسين
normalizedTranslation: although they were, before it was sent down upon them - before that, in despair

arabic: فَٱنظُرۡ إِلَىٰٓ ءَاثَٰرِ رَحۡمَتِ ٱللَّهِ كَيۡفَ يُحۡيِ ٱلۡأَرۡضَ بَعۡدَ مَوۡتِهَآۚ إِنَّ ذَٰلِكَ لَمُحۡيِ ٱلۡمَوۡتَىٰۖ وَهُوَ عَلَىٰ كُلِّ شَيۡءٖ قَدِيرٞ
translation: So observe the effects of the mercy of Allah - how He gives life to the earth after its lifelessness. Indeed, that [same one] will give life to the dead, and He is over all things competent
normalizedArabic: فانظر الي ءاثر رحمت الله كيف يحي الارض بعد موتها ان ذلك لمحي الموتي وهو علي كل شيء قدير
normalizedTranslation: so observe the effects of the mercy of allah - how he gives life to the earth after its lifelessness. indeed, that [same one] will give life to the dead, and he is over all things competent

arabic: وَلَئِنۡ أَرۡسَلۡنَا رِيحٗا فَرَأَوۡهُ مُصۡفَرّٗا لَّظَلُّواْ مِنۢ بَعۡدِهِۦ يَكۡفُرُونَ
translation: But if We should send a [bad] wind and they saw [their crops] turned yellow, they would remain thereafter disbelievers
normalizedArabic: ولين ارسلنا ريحا فراوه مصفرا لظلوا من بعده يكفرون
normalizedTranslation: but if we should send a [bad] wind and they saw [their crops] turned yellow, they would remain thereafter disbelievers

arabic: فَإِنَّكَ لَا تُسۡمِعُ ٱلۡمَوۡتَىٰ وَلَا تُسۡمِعُ ٱلصُّمَّ ٱلدُّعَآءَ إِذَا وَلَّوۡاْ مُدۡبِرِينَ
translation: So indeed, you will not make the dead hear, nor will you make the deaf hear the call when they turn their backs, retreating
normalizedArabic: فانك لا تسمع الموتي ولا تسمع الصم الدعاء اذا ولوا مدبرين
normalizedTranslation: so indeed, you will not make the dead hear, nor will you make the deaf hear the call when they turn their backs, retreating

arabic: وَمَآ أَنتَ بِهَٰدِ ٱلۡعُمۡيِ عَن ضَلَٰلَتِهِمۡۖ إِن تُسۡمِعُ إِلَّا مَن يُؤۡمِنُ بِـَٔايَٰتِنَا فَهُم مُّسۡلِمُونَ
translation: And you cannot guide the blind away from their error. You will only make hear those who believe in Our verses so they are Muslims [in submission to Allah]
normalizedArabic: وما انت بهد العمي عن ضللتهم ان تسمع الا من يومن بايتنا فهم مسلمون
normalizedTranslation: and you cannot guide the blind away from their error. you will only make hear those who believe in our verses so they are muslims [in submission to allah]

arabic: ۞ٱللَّهُ ٱلَّذِي خَلَقَكُم مِّن ضَعۡفٖ ثُمَّ جَعَلَ مِنۢ بَعۡدِ ضَعۡفٖ قُوَّةٗ ثُمَّ جَعَلَ مِنۢ بَعۡدِ قُوَّةٖ ضَعۡفٗا وَشَيۡبَةٗۚ يَخۡلُقُ مَا يَشَآءُۚ وَهُوَ ٱلۡعَلِيمُ ٱلۡقَدِيرُ
translation: Allah is the one who created you from weakness, then made after weakness strength, then made after strength weakness and white hair. He creates what He wills, and He is the Knowing, the Competent
normalizedArabic: الله الذي خلقكم من ضعف ثم جعل من بعد ضعف قوه ثم جعل من بعد قوه ضعفا وشيبه يخلق ما يشاء وهو العليم القدير
normalizedTranslation: allah is the one who created you from weakness, then made after weakness strength, then made after strength weakness and white hair. he creates what he wills, and he is the knowing, the competent

arabic: وَيَوۡمَ تَقُومُ ٱلسَّاعَةُ يُقۡسِمُ ٱلۡمُجۡرِمُونَ مَا لَبِثُواْ غَيۡرَ سَاعَةٖۚ كَذَٰلِكَ كَانُواْ يُؤۡفَكُونَ
translation: And the Day the Hour appears the criminals will swear they had remained but an hour. Thus they were deluded
normalizedArabic: ويوم تقوم الساعه يقسم المجرمون ما لبثوا غير ساعه كذلك كانوا يوفكون
normalizedTranslation: and the day the hour appears the criminals will swear they had remained but an hour. thus they were deluded

arabic: وَقَالَ ٱلَّذِينَ أُوتُواْ ٱلۡعِلۡمَ وَٱلۡإِيمَٰنَ لَقَدۡ لَبِثۡتُمۡ فِي كِتَٰبِ ٱللَّهِ إِلَىٰ يَوۡمِ ٱلۡبَعۡثِۖ فَهَٰذَا يَوۡمُ ٱلۡبَعۡثِ وَلَٰكِنَّكُمۡ كُنتُمۡ لَا تَعۡلَمُونَ
translation: But those who were given knowledge and faith will say, "You remained the extent of Allah 's decree until the Day of Resurrection, and this is the Day of Resurrection, but you did not used to know
normalizedArabic: وقال الذين اوتوا العلم والايمن لقد لبثتم في كتب الله الي يوم البعث فهذا يوم البعث ولكنكم كنتم لا تعلمون
normalizedTranslation: but those who were given knowledge and faith will say, "you remained the extent of allah 's decree until the day of resurrection, and this is the day of resurrection, but you did not used to know

arabic: فَيَوۡمَئِذٖ لَّا يَنفَعُ ٱلَّذِينَ ظَلَمُواْ مَعۡذِرَتُهُمۡ وَلَا هُمۡ يُسۡتَعۡتَبُونَ
translation: So that Day, their excuse will not benefit those who wronged, nor will they be asked to appease [Allah]
normalizedArabic: فيوميذ لا ينفع الذين ظلموا معذرتهم ولا هم يستعتبون
normalizedTranslation: so that day, their excuse will not benefit those who wronged, nor will they be asked to appease [allah]

arabic: وَلَقَدۡ ضَرَبۡنَا لِلنَّاسِ فِي هَٰذَا ٱلۡقُرۡءَانِ مِن كُلِّ مَثَلٖۚ وَلَئِن جِئۡتَهُم بِـَٔايَةٖ لَّيَقُولَنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوٓاْ إِنۡ أَنتُمۡ إِلَّا مُبۡطِلُونَ
translation: And We have certainly presented to the people in this Qur'an from every [kind of] example. But, [O Muhammad], if you should bring them a sign, the disbelievers will surely say, "You [believers] are but falsifiers
normalizedArabic: ولقد ضربنا للناس في هذا القرءان من كل مثل ولين جيتهم بايه ليقولن الذين كفروا ان انتم الا مبطلون
normalizedTranslation: and we have certainly presented to the people in this qur'an from every [kind of] example. but, [o muhammad], if you should bring them a sign, the disbelievers will surely say, "you [believers] are but falsifiers

arabic: كَذَٰلِكَ يَطۡبَعُ ٱللَّهُ عَلَىٰ قُلُوبِ ٱلَّذِينَ لَا يَعۡلَمُونَ
translation: Thus does Allah seal the hearts of those who do not know
normalizedArabic: كذلك يطبع الله علي قلوب الذين لا يعلمون
normalizedTranslation: thus does allah seal the hearts of those who do not know

arabic: فَٱصۡبِرۡ إِنَّ وَعۡدَ ٱللَّهِ حَقّٞۖ وَلَا يَسۡتَخِفَّنَّكَ ٱلَّذِينَ لَا يُوقِنُونَ
translation: So be patient. Indeed, the promise of Allah is truth. And let them not disquiet you who are not certain [in faith]
normalizedArabic: فاصبر ان وعد الله حق ولا يستخفنك الذين لا يوقنون
normalizedTranslation: so be patient. indeed, the promise of allah is truth. and let them not disquiet you who are not certain [in faith]

arabic: الٓمٓ
translation: Alif, Lam, Meem
normalizedArabic: الم
normalizedTranslation: alif, lam, meem

arabic: تِلۡكَ ءَايَٰتُ ٱلۡكِتَٰبِ ٱلۡحَكِيمِ
translation: These are verses of the wise Book
normalizedArabic: تلك ءايت الكتب الحكيم
normalizedTranslation: these are verses of the wise book

arabic: هُدٗى وَرَحۡمَةٗ لِّلۡمُحۡسِنِينَ
translation: As guidance and mercy for the doers of good
normalizedArabic: هدي ورحمه للمحسنين
normalizedTranslation: as guidance and mercy for the doers of good

arabic: ٱلَّذِينَ يُقِيمُونَ ٱلصَّلَوٰةَ وَيُؤۡتُونَ ٱلزَّكَوٰةَ وَهُم بِٱلۡأٓخِرَةِ هُمۡ يُوقِنُونَ
translation: Who establish prayer and give zakah, and they, of the Hereafter, are certain [in faith]
normalizedArabic: الذين يقيمون الصلوه ويوتون الزكوه وهم بالاخره هم يوقنون
normalizedTranslation: who establish prayer and give zakah, and they, of the hereafter, are certain [in faith]

arabic: أُوْلَـٰٓئِكَ عَلَىٰ هُدٗى مِّن رَّبِّهِمۡۖ وَأُوْلَـٰٓئِكَ هُمُ ٱلۡمُفۡلِحُونَ
translation: Those are on [right] guidance from their Lord, and it is those who are the successful
normalizedArabic: اوليك علي هدي من ربهم واوليك هم المفلحون
normalizedTranslation: those are on [right] guidance from their lord, and it is those who are the successful

arabic: وَمِنَ ٱلنَّاسِ مَن يَشۡتَرِي لَهۡوَ ٱلۡحَدِيثِ لِيُضِلَّ عَن سَبِيلِ ٱللَّهِ بِغَيۡرِ عِلۡمٖ وَيَتَّخِذَهَا هُزُوًاۚ أُوْلَـٰٓئِكَ لَهُمۡ عَذَابٞ مُّهِينٞ
translation: And of the people is he who buys the amusement of speech to mislead [others] from the way of Allah without knowledge and who takes it in ridicule. Those will have a humiliating punishment
normalizedArabic: ومن الناس من يشتري لهو الحديث ليضل عن سبيل الله بغير علم ويتخذها هزوا اوليك لهم عذاب مهين
normalizedTranslation: and of the people is he who buys the amusement of speech to mislead [others] from the way of allah without knowledge and who takes it in ridicule. those will have a humiliating punishment

arabic: وَإِذَا تُتۡلَىٰ عَلَيۡهِ ءَايَٰتُنَا وَلَّىٰ مُسۡتَكۡبِرٗا كَأَن لَّمۡ يَسۡمَعۡهَا كَأَنَّ فِيٓ أُذُنَيۡهِ وَقۡرٗاۖ فَبَشِّرۡهُ بِعَذَابٍ أَلِيمٍ
translation: And when our verses are recited to him, he turns away arrogantly as if he had not heard them, as if there was in his ears deafness. So give him tidings of a painful punishment
normalizedArabic: واذا تتلي عليه ءايتنا ولي مستكبرا كان لم يسمعها كان في اذنيه وقرا فبشره بعذاب اليم
normalizedTranslation: and when our verses are recited to him, he turns away arrogantly as if he had not heard them, as if there was in his ears deafness. so give him tidings of a painful punishment

arabic: إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُواْ وَعَمِلُواْ ٱلصَّـٰلِحَٰتِ لَهُمۡ جَنَّـٰتُ ٱلنَّعِيمِ
translation: Indeed, those who believe and do righteous deeds - for them are the Gardens of Pleasure
normalizedArabic: ان الذين ءامنوا وعملوا الصلحت لهم جنت النعيم
normalizedTranslation: indeed, those who believe and do righteous deeds - for them are the gardens of pleasure

arabic: خَٰلِدِينَ فِيهَاۖ وَعۡدَ ٱللَّهِ حَقّٗاۚ وَهُوَ ٱلۡعَزِيزُ ٱلۡحَكِيمُ
translation: Wherein they abide eternally; [it is] the promise of Allah [which is] truth. And He is the Exalted in Might, the Wise
normalizedArabic: خلدين فيها وعد الله حقا وهو العزيز الحكيم
normalizedTranslation: wherein they abide eternally; [it is] the promise of allah [which is] truth. and he is the exalted in might, the wise

arabic: خَلَقَ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ بِغَيۡرِ عَمَدٖ تَرَوۡنَهَاۖ وَأَلۡقَىٰ فِي ٱلۡأَرۡضِ رَوَٰسِيَ أَن تَمِيدَ بِكُمۡ وَبَثَّ فِيهَا مِن كُلِّ دَآبَّةٖۚ وَأَنزَلۡنَا مِنَ ٱلسَّمَآءِ مَآءٗ فَأَنۢبَتۡنَا فِيهَا مِن كُلِّ زَوۡجٖ كَرِيمٍ
translation: He created the heavens without pillars that you see and has cast into the earth firmly set mountains, lest it should shift with you, and dispersed therein from every creature. And We sent down rain from the sky and made grow therein [plants] of every noble kind
normalizedArabic: خلق السموت بغير عمد ترونها والقي في الارض روسي ان تميد بكم وبث فيها من كل دابه وانزلنا من السماء ماء فانبتنا فيها من كل زوج كريم
normalizedTranslation: he created the heavens without pillars that you see and has cast into the earth firmly set mountains, lest it should shift with you, and dispersed therein from every creature. and we sent down rain from the sky and made grow therein [plants] of every noble kind

arabic: هَٰذَا خَلۡقُ ٱللَّهِ فَأَرُونِي مَاذَا خَلَقَ ٱلَّذِينَ مِن دُونِهِۦۚ بَلِ ٱلظَّـٰلِمُونَ فِي ضَلَٰلٖ مُّبِينٖ
translation: This is the creation of Allah. So show Me what those other than Him have created. Rather, the wrongdoers are in clear error
normalizedArabic: هذا خلق الله فاروني ماذا خلق الذين من دونه بل الظلمون في ضلل مبين
normalizedTranslation: this is the creation of allah. so show me what those other than him have created. rather, the wrongdoers are in clear error

arabic: وَلَقَدۡ ءَاتَيۡنَا لُقۡمَٰنَ ٱلۡحِكۡمَةَ أَنِ ٱشۡكُرۡ لِلَّهِۚ وَمَن يَشۡكُرۡ فَإِنَّمَا يَشۡكُرُ لِنَفۡسِهِۦۖ وَمَن كَفَرَ فَإِنَّ ٱللَّهَ غَنِيٌّ حَمِيدٞ
translation: And We had certainly given Luqman wisdom [and said], "Be grateful to Allah." And whoever is grateful is grateful for [the benefit of] himself. And whoever denies [His favor] - then indeed, Allah is Free of need and Praiseworthy
normalizedArabic: ولقد ءاتينا لقمن الحكمه ان اشكر لله ومن يشكر فانما يشكر لنفسه ومن كفر فان الله غني حميد
normalizedTranslation: and we had certainly given luqman wisdom [and said], "be grateful to allah." and whoever is grateful is grateful for [the benefit of] himself. and whoever denies [his favor] - then indeed, allah is free of need and praiseworthy

arabic: وَإِذۡ قَالَ لُقۡمَٰنُ لِٱبۡنِهِۦ وَهُوَ يَعِظُهُۥ يَٰبُنَيَّ لَا تُشۡرِكۡ بِٱللَّهِۖ إِنَّ ٱلشِّرۡكَ لَظُلۡمٌ عَظِيمٞ
translation: And [mention, O Muhammad], when Luqman said to his son while he was instructing him, "O my son, do not associate [anything] with Allah. Indeed, association [with him] is great injustice
normalizedArabic: واذ قال لقمن لابنه وهو يعظه يبني لا تشرك بالله ان الشرك لظلم عظيم
normalizedTranslation: and [mention, o muhammad], when luqman said to his son while he was instructing him, "o my son, do not associate [anything] with allah. indeed, association [with him] is great injustice

arabic: وَوَصَّيۡنَا ٱلۡإِنسَٰنَ بِوَٰلِدَيۡهِ حَمَلَتۡهُ أُمُّهُۥ وَهۡنًا عَلَىٰ وَهۡنٖ وَفِصَٰلُهُۥ فِي عَامَيۡنِ أَنِ ٱشۡكُرۡ لِي وَلِوَٰلِدَيۡكَ إِلَيَّ ٱلۡمَصِيرُ
translation: And We have enjoined upon man [care] for his parents. His mother carried him, [increasing her] in weakness upon weakness, and his weaning is in two years. Be grateful to Me and to your parents; to Me is the [final] destination
normalizedArabic: ووصينا الانسن بولديه حملته امه وهنا علي وهن وفصله في عامين ان اشكر لي ولولديك الي المصير
normalizedTranslation: and we have enjoined upon man [care] for his parents. his mother carried him, [increasing her] in weakness upon weakness, and his weaning is in two years. be grateful to me and to your parents; to me is the [final] destination

arabic: وَإِن جَٰهَدَاكَ عَلَىٰٓ أَن تُشۡرِكَ بِي مَا لَيۡسَ لَكَ بِهِۦ عِلۡمٞ فَلَا تُطِعۡهُمَاۖ وَصَاحِبۡهُمَا فِي ٱلدُّنۡيَا مَعۡرُوفٗاۖ وَٱتَّبِعۡ سَبِيلَ مَنۡ أَنَابَ إِلَيَّۚ ثُمَّ إِلَيَّ مَرۡجِعُكُمۡ فَأُنَبِّئُكُم بِمَا كُنتُمۡ تَعۡمَلُونَ
translation: But if they endeavor to make you associate with Me that of which you have no knowledge, do not obey them but accompany them in [this] world with appropriate kindness and follow the way of those who turn back to Me [in repentance]. Then to Me will be your return, and I will inform you about what you used to do
normalizedArabic: وان جهداك علي ان تشرك بي ما ليس لك به علم فلا تطعهما وصاحبهما في الدنيا معروفا واتبع سبيل من اناب الي ثم الي مرجعكم فانبيكم بما كنتم تعملون
normalizedTranslation: but if they endeavor to make you associate with me that of which you have no knowledge, do not obey them but accompany them in [this] world with appropriate kindness and follow the way of those who turn back to me [in repentance]. then to me will be your return, and i will inform you about what you used to do

arabic: يَٰبُنَيَّ إِنَّهَآ إِن تَكُ مِثۡقَالَ حَبَّةٖ مِّنۡ خَرۡدَلٖ فَتَكُن فِي صَخۡرَةٍ أَوۡ فِي ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ أَوۡ فِي ٱلۡأَرۡضِ يَأۡتِ بِهَا ٱللَّهُۚ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ لَطِيفٌ خَبِيرٞ
translation: [And Luqman said], "O my son, indeed if wrong should be the weight of a mustard seed and should be within a rock or [anywhere] in the heavens or in the earth, Allah will bring it forth. Indeed, Allah is Subtle and Acquainted
normalizedArabic: يبني انها ان تك مثقال حبه من خردل فتكن في صخره او في السموت او في الارض يات بها الله ان الله لطيف خبير
normalizedTranslation: [and luqman said], "o my son, indeed if wrong should be the weight of a mustard seed and should be within a rock or [anywhere] in the heavens or in the earth, allah will bring it forth. indeed, allah is subtle and acquainted

arabic: يَٰبُنَيَّ أَقِمِ ٱلصَّلَوٰةَ وَأۡمُرۡ بِٱلۡمَعۡرُوفِ وَٱنۡهَ عَنِ ٱلۡمُنكَرِ وَٱصۡبِرۡ عَلَىٰ مَآ أَصَابَكَۖ إِنَّ ذَٰلِكَ مِنۡ عَزۡمِ ٱلۡأُمُورِ
translation: O my son, establish prayer, enjoin what is right, forbid what is wrong, and be patient over what befalls you. Indeed, [all] that is of the matters [requiring] determination
normalizedArabic: يبني اقم الصلوه وامر بالمعروف وانه عن المنكر واصبر علي ما اصابك ان ذلك من عزم الامور
normalizedTranslation: o my son, establish prayer, enjoin what is right, forbid what is wrong, and be patient over what befalls you. indeed, [all] that is of the matters [requiring] determination

arabic: وَلَا تُصَعِّرۡ خَدَّكَ لِلنَّاسِ وَلَا تَمۡشِ فِي ٱلۡأَرۡضِ مَرَحًاۖ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ لَا يُحِبُّ كُلَّ مُخۡتَالٖ فَخُورٖ
translation: And do not turn your cheek [in contempt] toward people and do not walk through the earth exultantly. Indeed, Allah does not like everyone self-deluded and boastful
normalizedArabic: ولا تصعر خدك للناس ولا تمش في الارض مرحا ان الله لا يحب كل مختال فخور
normalizedTranslation: and do not turn your cheek [in contempt] toward people and do not walk through the earth exultantly. indeed, allah does not like everyone self-deluded and boastful

arabic: وَٱقۡصِدۡ فِي مَشۡيِكَ وَٱغۡضُضۡ مِن صَوۡتِكَۚ إِنَّ أَنكَرَ ٱلۡأَصۡوَٰتِ لَصَوۡتُ ٱلۡحَمِيرِ
translation: And be moderate in your pace and lower your voice; indeed, the most disagreeable of sounds is the voice of donkeys
normalizedArabic: واقصد في مشيك واغضض من صوتك ان انكر الاصوت لصوت الحمير
normalizedTranslation: and be moderate in your pace and lower your voice; indeed, the most disagreeable of sounds is the voice of donkeys

arabic: أَلَمۡ تَرَوۡاْ أَنَّ ٱللَّهَ سَخَّرَ لَكُم مَّا فِي ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَمَا فِي ٱلۡأَرۡضِ وَأَسۡبَغَ عَلَيۡكُمۡ نِعَمَهُۥ ظَٰهِرَةٗ وَبَاطِنَةٗۗ وَمِنَ ٱلنَّاسِ مَن يُجَٰدِلُ فِي ٱللَّهِ بِغَيۡرِ عِلۡمٖ وَلَا هُدٗى وَلَا كِتَٰبٖ مُّنِيرٖ
translation: Do you not see that Allah has made subject to you whatever is in the heavens and whatever is in the earth and amply bestowed upon you His favors, [both] apparent and unapparent? But of the people is he who disputes about Allah without knowledge or guidance or an enlightening Book [from Him]
normalizedArabic: الم تروا ان الله سخر لكم ما في السموت وما في الارض واسبغ عليكم نعمه ظهره وباطنه ومن الناس من يجدل في الله بغير علم ولا هدي ولا كتب منير
normalizedTranslation: do you not see that allah has made subject to you whatever is in the heavens and whatever is in the earth and amply bestowed upon you his favors, [both] apparent and unapparent? but of the people is he who disputes about allah without knowledge or guidance or an enlightening book [from him]

arabic: وَإِذَا قِيلَ لَهُمُ ٱتَّبِعُواْ مَآ أَنزَلَ ٱللَّهُ قَالُواْ بَلۡ نَتَّبِعُ مَا وَجَدۡنَا عَلَيۡهِ ءَابَآءَنَآۚ أَوَلَوۡ كَانَ ٱلشَّيۡطَٰنُ يَدۡعُوهُمۡ إِلَىٰ عَذَابِ ٱلسَّعِيرِ
translation: And when it is said to them, "Follow what Allah has revealed," they say, "Rather, we will follow that upon which we found our fathers." Even if Satan was inviting them to the punishment of the Blaze
normalizedArabic: واذا قيل لهم اتبعوا ما انزل الله قالوا بل نتبع ما وجدنا عليه ءاباءنا اولو كان الشيطن يدعوهم الي عذاب السعير
normalizedTranslation: and when it is said to them, "follow what allah has revealed," they say, "rather, we will follow that upon which we found our fathers." even if satan was inviting them to the punishment of the blaze

arabic: ۞وَمَن يُسۡلِمۡ وَجۡهَهُۥٓ إِلَى ٱللَّهِ وَهُوَ مُحۡسِنٞ فَقَدِ ٱسۡتَمۡسَكَ بِٱلۡعُرۡوَةِ ٱلۡوُثۡقَىٰۗ وَإِلَى ٱللَّهِ عَٰقِبَةُ ٱلۡأُمُورِ
translation: And whoever submits his face to Allah while he is a doer of good - then he has grasped the most trustworthy handhold. And to Allah will be the outcome of [all] matters
normalizedArabic: ومن يسلم وجهه الي الله وهو محسن فقد استمسك بالعروه الوثقي والي الله عقبه الامور
normalizedTranslation: and whoever submits his face to allah while he is a doer of good - then he has grasped the most trustworthy handhold. and to allah will be the outcome of [all] matters

arabic: وَمَن كَفَرَ فَلَا يَحۡزُنكَ كُفۡرُهُۥٓۚ إِلَيۡنَا مَرۡجِعُهُمۡ فَنُنَبِّئُهُم بِمَا عَمِلُوٓاْۚ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ عَلِيمُۢ بِذَاتِ ٱلصُّدُورِ
translation: And whoever has disbelieved - let not his disbelief grieve you. To Us is their return, and We will inform them of what they did. Indeed, Allah is Knowing of that within the breasts
normalizedArabic: ومن كفر فلا يحزنك كفره الينا مرجعهم فننبيهم بما عملوا ان الله عليم بذات الصدور
normalizedTranslation: and whoever has disbelieved - let not his disbelief grieve you. to us is their return, and we will inform them of what they did. indeed, allah is knowing of that within the breasts

arabic: نُمَتِّعُهُمۡ قَلِيلٗا ثُمَّ نَضۡطَرُّهُمۡ إِلَىٰ عَذَابٍ غَلِيظٖ
translation: We grant them enjoyment for a little; then We will force them to a massive punishment
normalizedArabic: نمتعهم قليلا ثم نضطرهم الي عذاب غليظ
normalizedTranslation: we grant them enjoyment for a little; then we will force them to a massive punishment

arabic: وَلَئِن سَأَلۡتَهُم مَّنۡ خَلَقَ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلۡأَرۡضَ لَيَقُولُنَّ ٱللَّهُۚ قُلِ ٱلۡحَمۡدُ لِلَّهِۚ بَلۡ أَكۡثَرُهُمۡ لَا يَعۡلَمُونَ
translation: And if you asked them, "Who created the heavens and earth?" they would surely say, "Allah." Say, "[All] praise is [due] to Allah "; but most of them do not know
normalizedArabic: ولين سالتهم من خلق السموت والارض ليقولن الله قل الحمد لله بل اكثرهم لا يعلمون
normalizedTranslation: and if you asked them, "who created the heavens and earth?" they would surely say, "allah." say, "[all] praise is [due] to allah "; but most of them do not know

arabic: لِلَّهِ مَا فِي ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلۡأَرۡضِۚ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ هُوَ ٱلۡغَنِيُّ ٱلۡحَمِيدُ
translation: To Allah belongs whatever is in the heavens and earth. Indeed, Allah is the Free of need, the Praiseworthy
normalizedArabic: لله ما في السموت والارض ان الله هو الغني الحميد
normalizedTranslation: to allah belongs whatever is in the heavens and earth. indeed, allah is the free of need, the praiseworthy

arabic: وَلَوۡ أَنَّمَا فِي ٱلۡأَرۡضِ مِن شَجَرَةٍ أَقۡلَٰمٞ وَٱلۡبَحۡرُ يَمُدُّهُۥ مِنۢ بَعۡدِهِۦ سَبۡعَةُ أَبۡحُرٖ مَّا نَفِدَتۡ كَلِمَٰتُ ٱللَّهِۚ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ عَزِيزٌ حَكِيمٞ
translation: And if whatever trees upon the earth were pens and the sea [was ink], replenished thereafter by seven [more] seas, the words of Allah would not be exhausted. Indeed, Allah is Exalted in Might and Wise
normalizedArabic: ولو انما في الارض من شجره اقلم والبحر يمده من بعده سبعه ابحر ما نفدت كلمت الله ان الله عزيز حكيم
normalizedTranslation: and if whatever trees upon the earth were pens and the sea [was ink], replenished thereafter by seven [more] seas, the words of allah would not be exhausted. indeed, allah is exalted in might and wise

arabic: مَّا خَلۡقُكُمۡ وَلَا بَعۡثُكُمۡ إِلَّا كَنَفۡسٖ وَٰحِدَةٍۚ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ سَمِيعُۢ بَصِيرٌ
translation: Your creation and your resurrection will not be but as that of a single soul. Indeed, Allah is Hearing and Seeing
normalizedArabic: ما خلقكم ولا بعثكم الا كنفس وحده ان الله سميع بصير
normalizedTranslation: your creation and your resurrection will not be but as that of a single soul. indeed, allah is hearing and seeing

arabic: أَلَمۡ تَرَ أَنَّ ٱللَّهَ يُولِجُ ٱلَّيۡلَ فِي ٱلنَّهَارِ وَيُولِجُ ٱلنَّهَارَ فِي ٱلَّيۡلِ وَسَخَّرَ ٱلشَّمۡسَ وَٱلۡقَمَرَۖ كُلّٞ يَجۡرِيٓ إِلَىٰٓ أَجَلٖ مُّسَمّٗى وَأَنَّ ٱللَّهَ بِمَا تَعۡمَلُونَ خَبِيرٞ
translation: Do you not see that Allah causes the night to enter the day and causes the day to enter the night and has subjected the sun and the moon, each running [its course] for a specified term, and that Allah, with whatever you do, is Acquainted
normalizedArabic: الم تر ان الله يولج اليل في النهار ويولج النهار في اليل وسخر الشمس والقمر كل يجري الي اجل مسمي وان الله بما تعملون خبير
normalizedTranslation: do you not see that allah causes the night to enter the day and causes the day to enter the night and has subjected the sun and the moon, each running [its course] for a specified term, and that allah, with whatever you do, is acquainted

arabic: ذَٰلِكَ بِأَنَّ ٱللَّهَ هُوَ ٱلۡحَقُّ وَأَنَّ مَا يَدۡعُونَ مِن دُونِهِ ٱلۡبَٰطِلُ وَأَنَّ ٱللَّهَ هُوَ ٱلۡعَلِيُّ ٱلۡكَبِيرُ
translation: That is because Allah is the Truth, and that what they call upon other than Him is falsehood, and because Allah is the Most High, the Grand
normalizedArabic: ذلك بان الله هو الحق وان ما يدعون من دونه البطل وان الله هو العلي الكبير
normalizedTranslation: that is because allah is the truth, and that what they call upon other than him is falsehood, and because allah is the most high, the grand

arabic: أَلَمۡ تَرَ أَنَّ ٱلۡفُلۡكَ تَجۡرِي فِي ٱلۡبَحۡرِ بِنِعۡمَتِ ٱللَّهِ لِيُرِيَكُم مِّنۡ ءَايَٰتِهِۦٓۚ إِنَّ فِي ذَٰلِكَ لَأٓيَٰتٖ لِّكُلِّ صَبَّارٖ شَكُورٖ
translation: Do you not see that ships sail through the sea by the favor of Allah that He may show you of His signs? Indeed in that are signs for everyone patient and grateful
normalizedArabic: الم تر ان الفلك تجري في البحر بنعمت الله ليريكم من ءايته ان في ذلك لايت لكل صبار شكور
normalizedTranslation: do you not see that ships sail through the sea by the favor of allah that he may show you of his signs? indeed in that are signs for everyone patient and grateful

arabic: وَإِذَا غَشِيَهُم مَّوۡجٞ كَٱلظُّلَلِ دَعَوُاْ ٱللَّهَ مُخۡلِصِينَ لَهُ ٱلدِّينَ فَلَمَّا نَجَّىٰهُمۡ إِلَى ٱلۡبَرِّ فَمِنۡهُم مُّقۡتَصِدٞۚ وَمَا يَجۡحَدُ بِـَٔايَٰتِنَآ إِلَّا كُلُّ خَتَّارٖ كَفُورٖ
translation: And when waves come over them like canopies, they supplicate Allah, sincere to Him in religion. But when He delivers them to the land, there are [some] of them who are moderate [in faith]. And none rejects Our signs except everyone treacherous and ungrateful
normalizedArabic: واذا غشيهم موج كالظلل دعوا الله مخلصين له الدين فلما نجيهم الي البر فمنهم مقتصد وما يجحد بايتنا الا كل ختار كفور
normalizedTranslation: and when waves come over them like canopies, they supplicate allah, sincere to him in religion. but when he delivers them to the land, there are [some] of them who are moderate [in faith]. and none rejects our signs except everyone treacherous and ungrateful

arabic: يَـٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلنَّاسُ ٱتَّقُواْ رَبَّكُمۡ وَٱخۡشَوۡاْ يَوۡمٗا لَّا يَجۡزِي وَالِدٌ عَن وَلَدِهِۦ وَلَا مَوۡلُودٌ هُوَ جَازٍ عَن وَالِدِهِۦ شَيۡـًٔاۚ إِنَّ وَعۡدَ ٱللَّهِ حَقّٞۖ فَلَا تَغُرَّنَّكُمُ ٱلۡحَيَوٰةُ ٱلدُّنۡيَا وَلَا يَغُرَّنَّكُم بِٱللَّهِ ٱلۡغَرُورُ
translation: O mankind, fear your Lord and fear a Day when no father will avail his son, nor will a son avail his father at all. Indeed, the promise of Allah is truth, so let not the worldly life delude you and be not deceived about Allah by the Deceiver
normalizedArabic: يايها الناس اتقوا ربكم واخشوا يوما لا يجزي والد عن ولده ولا مولود هو جاز عن والده شيا ان وعد الله حق فلا تغرنكم الحيوه الدنيا ولا يغرنكم بالله الغرور
normalizedTranslation: o mankind, fear your lord and fear a day when no father will avail his son, nor will a son avail his father at all. indeed, the promise of allah is truth, so let not the worldly life delude you and be not deceived about allah by the deceiver

arabic: إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ عِندَهُۥ عِلۡمُ ٱلسَّاعَةِ وَيُنَزِّلُ ٱلۡغَيۡثَ وَيَعۡلَمُ مَا فِي ٱلۡأَرۡحَامِۖ وَمَا تَدۡرِي نَفۡسٞ مَّاذَا تَكۡسِبُ غَدٗاۖ وَمَا تَدۡرِي نَفۡسُۢ بِأَيِّ أَرۡضٖ تَمُوتُۚ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ عَلِيمٌ خَبِيرُۢ
translation: Indeed, Allah [alone] has knowledge of the Hour and sends down the rain and knows what is in the wombs. And no soul perceives what it will earn tomorrow, and no soul perceives in what land it will die. Indeed, Allah is Knowing and Acquainted
normalizedArabic: ان الله عنده علم الساعه وينزل الغيث ويعلم ما في الارحام وما تدري نفس ماذا تكسب غدا وما تدري نفس باي ارض تموت ان الله عليم خبير
normalizedTranslation: indeed, allah [alone] has knowledge of the hour and sends down the rain and knows what is in the wombs. and no soul perceives what it will earn tomorrow, and no soul perceives in what land it will die. indeed, allah is knowing and acquainted

arabic: الٓمٓ

normalizedArabic: الم
normalizedTranslation: alif, lam, meem

arabic: تَنزِيلُ ٱلۡكِتَٰبِ لَا رَيۡبَ فِيهِ مِن رَّبِّ ٱلۡعَٰلَمِينَ
translation: [This is] the revelation of the Book about which there is no doubt from the Lord of the worlds
normalizedArabic: تنزيل الكتب لا ريب فيه من رب العلمين
normalizedTranslation: [this is] the revelation of the book about which there is no doubt from the lord of the worlds

arabic: أَمۡ يَقُولُونَ ٱفۡتَرَىٰهُۚ بَلۡ هُوَ ٱلۡحَقُّ مِن رَّبِّكَ لِتُنذِرَ قَوۡمٗا مَّآ أَتَىٰهُم مِّن نَّذِيرٖ مِّن قَبۡلِكَ لَعَلَّهُمۡ يَهۡتَدُونَ
translation: Or do they say, "He invented it"? Rather, it is the truth from your Lord, [O Muhammad], that you may warn a people to whom no warner has come before you [so] perhaps they will be guided
normalizedArabic: ام يقولون افتريه بل هو الحق من ربك لتنذر قوما ما اتيهم من نذير من قبلك لعلهم يهتدون
normalizedTranslation: or do they say, "he invented it"? rather, it is the truth from your lord, [o muhammad], that you may warn a people to whom no warner has come before you [so] perhaps they will be guided

arabic: ٱللَّهُ ٱلَّذِي خَلَقَ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلۡأَرۡضَ وَمَا بَيۡنَهُمَا فِي سِتَّةِ أَيَّامٖ ثُمَّ ٱسۡتَوَىٰ عَلَى ٱلۡعَرۡشِۖ مَا لَكُم مِّن دُونِهِۦ مِن وَلِيّٖ وَلَا شَفِيعٍۚ أَفَلَا تَتَذَكَّرُونَ
translation: It is Allah who created the heavens and the earth and whatever is between them in six days; then He established Himself above the Throne. You have not besides Him any protector or any intercessor; so will you not be reminded

normalizedTranslation: it is allah who created the heavens and the earth and whatever is between them in six days; then he established himself above the throne. you have not besides him any protector or any intercessor; so will you not be reminded

arabic: يُدَبِّرُ ٱلۡأَمۡرَ مِنَ ٱلسَّمَآءِ إِلَى ٱلۡأَرۡضِ ثُمَّ يَعۡرُجُ إِلَيۡهِ فِي يَوۡمٖ كَانَ مِقۡدَارُهُۥٓ أَلۡفَ سَنَةٖ مِّمَّا تَعُدُّونَ

arabic: ذَٰلِكَ عَٰلِمُ ٱلۡغَيۡبِ وَٱلشَّهَٰدَةِ ٱلۡعَزِيزُ ٱلرَّحِيمُ

arabic: وَقَالُوٓاْ أَءِذَا ضَلَلۡنَا فِي ٱلۡأَرۡضِ أَءِنَّا لَفِي خَلۡقٖ جَدِيدِۭۚ بَلۡ هُم بِلِقَآءِ رَبِّهِمۡ كَٰفِرُونَ

arabic: ۞قُلۡ يَتَوَفَّىٰكُم مَّلَكُ ٱلۡمَوۡتِ ٱلَّذِي وُكِّلَ بِكُمۡ ثُمَّ إِلَىٰ رَبِّكُمۡ تُرۡجَعُونَ

arabic: فَذُوقُواْ بِمَا نَسِيتُمۡ لِقَآءَ يَوۡمِكُمۡ هَٰذَآ إِنَّا نَسِينَٰكُمۡۖ وَذُوقُواْ عَذَابَ ٱلۡخُلۡدِ بِمَا كُنتُمۡ تَعۡمَلُونَ

arabic: فَلَا تَعۡلَمُ نَفۡسٞ مَّآ أُخۡفِيَ لَهُم مِّن قُرَّةِ أَعۡيُنٖ جَزَآءَۢ بِمَا كَانُواْ يَعۡمَلُونَ

arabic: أَفَمَن كَانَ مُؤۡمِنٗا كَمَن كَانَ فَاسِقٗاۚ لَّا يَسۡتَوُۥنَ

arabic: أَمَّا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُواْ وَعَمِلُواْ ٱلصَّـٰلِحَٰتِ فَلَهُمۡ جَنَّـٰتُ ٱلۡمَأۡوَىٰ نُزُلَۢا بِمَا كَانُواْ يَعۡمَلُونَ

normalizedTranslation: as for those who believed and did righteous deeds, for them will be the gardens of refuge as accommodation for what they used to do

arabic: وَأَمَّا ٱلَّذِينَ فَسَقُواْ فَمَأۡوَىٰهُمُ ٱلنَّارُۖ كُلَّمَآ أَرَادُوٓاْ أَن يَخۡرُجُواْ مِنۡهَآ أُعِيدُواْ فِيهَا وَقِيلَ لَهُمۡ ذُوقُواْ عَذَابَ ٱلنَّارِ ٱلَّذِي كُنتُم بِهِۦ تُكَذِّبُونَ

normalizedTranslation: but as for those who defiantly disobeyed, their refuge is the fire. every time they wish to emerge from it, they will be returned to it while it is said to them, "taste the punishment of the fire which you used to deny
