normalizedArabic: ولنذيقنهم من العذاب الادني دون العذاب الاكبر لعلهم يرجعون
normalizedTranslation: and we will surely let them taste the nearer punishment short of the greater punishment that perhaps they will repent

arabic: وَمَنۡ أَظۡلَمُ مِمَّن ذُكِّرَ بِـَٔايَٰتِ رَبِّهِۦ ثُمَّ أَعۡرَضَ عَنۡهَآۚ إِنَّا مِنَ ٱلۡمُجۡرِمِينَ مُنتَقِمُونَ
translation: And who is more unjust than one who is reminded of the verses of his Lord; then he turns away from them? Indeed We, from the criminals, will take retribution
normalizedArabic: ومن اظلم ممن ذكر بايت ربه ثم اعرض عنها انا من المجرمين منتقمون
normalizedTranslation: and who is more unjust than one who is reminded of the verses of his lord; then he turns away from them? indeed we, from the criminals, will take retribution

arabic: وَلَقَدۡ ءَاتَيۡنَا مُوسَى ٱلۡكِتَٰبَ فَلَا تَكُن فِي مِرۡيَةٖ مِّن لِّقَآئِهِۦۖ وَجَعَلۡنَٰهُ هُدٗى لِّبَنِيٓ إِسۡرَـٰٓءِيلَ
translation: And We certainly gave Moses the Scripture, so do not be in doubt over his meeting. And we made the Torah guidance for the Children of Israel
normalizedArabic: ولقد ءاتينا موسي الكتب فلا تكن في مريه من لقايه وجعلنه هدي لبني اسرءيل
normalizedTranslation: and we certainly gave moses the scripture, so do not be in doubt over his meeting. and we made the torah guidance for the children of israel

arabic: وَجَعَلۡنَا مِنۡهُمۡ أَئِمَّةٗ يَهۡدُونَ بِأَمۡرِنَا لَمَّا صَبَرُواْۖ وَكَانُواْ بِـَٔايَٰتِنَا يُوقِنُونَ
translation: And We made from among them leaders guiding by Our command when they were patient and [when] they were certain of Our signs
normalizedArabic: وجعلنا منهم ايمه يهدون بامرنا لما صبروا وكانوا بايتنا يوقنون
normalizedTranslation: and we made from among them leaders guiding by our command when they were patient and [when] they were certain of our signs

arabic: إِنَّ رَبَّكَ هُوَ يَفۡصِلُ بَيۡنَهُمۡ يَوۡمَ ٱلۡقِيَٰمَةِ فِيمَا كَانُواْ فِيهِ يَخۡتَلِفُونَ
translation: Indeed, your Lord will judge between them on the Day of Resurrection concerning that over which they used to differ
normalizedArabic: ان ربك هو يفصل بينهم يوم القيمه فيما كانوا فيه يختلفون
normalizedTranslation: indeed, your lord will judge between them on the day of resurrection concerning that over which they used to differ

arabic: أَوَلَمۡ يَهۡدِ لَهُمۡ كَمۡ أَهۡلَكۡنَا مِن قَبۡلِهِم مِّنَ ٱلۡقُرُونِ يَمۡشُونَ فِي مَسَٰكِنِهِمۡۚ إِنَّ فِي ذَٰلِكَ لَأٓيَٰتٍۚ أَفَلَا يَسۡمَعُونَ
translation: Has it not become clear to them how many generations We destroyed before them, [as] they walk among their dwellings? Indeed in that are signs; then do they not hear
normalizedArabic: اولم يهد لهم كم اهلكنا من قبلهم من القرون يمشون في مسكنهم ان في ذلك لايت افلا يسمعون
normalizedTranslation: has it not become clear to them how many generations we destroyed before them, [as] they walk among their dwellings? indeed in that are signs; then do they not hear

arabic: أَوَلَمۡ يَرَوۡاْ أَنَّا نَسُوقُ ٱلۡمَآءَ إِلَى ٱلۡأَرۡضِ ٱلۡجُرُزِ فَنُخۡرِجُ بِهِۦ زَرۡعٗا تَأۡكُلُ مِنۡهُ أَنۡعَٰمُهُمۡ وَأَنفُسُهُمۡۚ أَفَلَا يُبۡصِرُونَ
translation: Have they not seen that We drive the water [in clouds] to barren land and bring forth thereby crops from which their livestock eat and [they] themselves? Then do they not see
normalizedArabic: اولم يروا انا نسوق الماء الي الارض الجرز فنخرج به زرعا تاكل منه انعمهم وانفسهم افلا يبصرون
normalizedTranslation: have they not seen that we drive the water [in clouds] to barren land and bring forth thereby crops from which their livestock eat and [they] themselves? then do they not see

arabic: وَيَقُولُونَ مَتَىٰ هَٰذَا ٱلۡفَتۡحُ إِن كُنتُمۡ صَٰدِقِينَ
translation: And they say, "When will be this conquest, if you should be truthful
normalizedArabic: ويقولون متي هذا الفتح ان كنتم صدقين
normalizedTranslation: and they say, "when will be this conquest, if you should be truthful

arabic: قُلۡ يَوۡمَ ٱلۡفَتۡحِ لَا يَنفَعُ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوٓاْ إِيمَٰنُهُمۡ وَلَا هُمۡ يُنظَرُونَ
translation: Say, [O Muhammad], "On the Day of Conquest the belief of those who had disbelieved will not benefit them, nor will they be reprieved
normalizedArabic: قل يوم الفتح لا ينفع الذين كفروا ايمنهم ولا هم ينظرون
normalizedTranslation: say, [o muhammad], "on the day of conquest the belief of those who had disbelieved will not benefit them, nor will they be reprieved

arabic: فَأَعۡرِضۡ عَنۡهُمۡ وَٱنتَظِرۡ إِنَّهُم مُّنتَظِرُونَ
translation: So turn away from them and wait. Indeed, they are waiting
normalizedArabic: فاعرض عنهم وانتظر انهم منتظرون
normalizedTranslation: so turn away from them and wait. indeed, they are waiting

arabic: يَـٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلنَّبِيُّ ٱتَّقِ ٱللَّهَ وَلَا تُطِعِ ٱلۡكَٰفِرِينَ وَٱلۡمُنَٰفِقِينَۚ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ كَانَ عَلِيمًا حَكِيمٗا
translation: O Prophet, fear Allah and do not obey the disbelievers and the hypocrites. Indeed, Allah is ever Knowing and Wise
normalizedArabic: يايها النبي اتق الله ولا تطع الكفرين والمنفقين ان الله كان عليما حكيما
normalizedTranslation: o prophet, fear allah and do not obey the disbelievers and the hypocrites. indeed, allah is ever knowing and wise

arabic: وَٱتَّبِعۡ مَا يُوحَىٰٓ إِلَيۡكَ مِن رَّبِّكَۚ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ كَانَ بِمَا تَعۡمَلُونَ خَبِيرٗا
translation: And follow that which is revealed to you from your Lord. Indeed Allah is ever, with what you do, Acquainted
normalizedArabic: واتبع ما يوحي اليك من ربك ان الله كان بما تعملون خبيرا
normalizedTranslation: and follow that which is revealed to you from your lord. indeed allah is ever, with what you do, acquainted

arabic: وَتَوَكَّلۡ عَلَى ٱللَّهِۚ وَكَفَىٰ بِٱللَّهِ وَكِيلٗا
translation: And rely upon Allah; and sufficient is Allah as Disposer of affairs
normalizedArabic: وتوكل علي الله وكفي بالله وكيلا
normalizedTranslation: and rely upon allah; and sufficient is allah as disposer of affairs

arabic: مَّا جَعَلَ ٱللَّهُ لِرَجُلٖ مِّن قَلۡبَيۡنِ فِي جَوۡفِهِۦۚ وَمَا جَعَلَ أَزۡوَٰجَكُمُ ٱلَّـٰٓـِٔي تُظَٰهِرُونَ مِنۡهُنَّ أُمَّهَٰتِكُمۡۚ وَمَا جَعَلَ أَدۡعِيَآءَكُمۡ أَبۡنَآءَكُمۡۚ ذَٰلِكُمۡ قَوۡلُكُم بِأَفۡوَٰهِكُمۡۖ وَٱللَّهُ يَقُولُ ٱلۡحَقَّ وَهُوَ يَهۡدِي ٱلسَّبِيلَ
translation: Allah has not made for a man two hearts in his interior. And He has not made your wives whom you declare unlawful your mothers. And he has not made your adopted sons your [true] sons. That is [merely] your saying by your mouths, but Allah says the truth, and He guides to the [right] way
normalizedArabic: ما جعل الله لرجل من قلبين في جوفه وما جعل ازوجكم الي تظهرون منهن امهتكم وما جعل ادعياءكم ابناءكم ذلكم قولكم بافوهكم والله يقول الحق وهو يهدي السبيل
normalizedTranslation: allah has not made for a man two hearts in his interior. and he has not made your wives whom you declare unlawful your mothers. and he has not made your adopted sons your [true] sons. that is [merely] your saying by your mouths, but allah says the truth, and he guides to the [right] way

arabic: ٱدۡعُوهُمۡ لِأٓبَآئِهِمۡ هُوَ أَقۡسَطُ عِندَ ٱللَّهِۚ فَإِن لَّمۡ تَعۡلَمُوٓاْ ءَابَآءَهُمۡ فَإِخۡوَٰنُكُمۡ فِي ٱلدِّينِ وَمَوَٰلِيكُمۡۚ وَلَيۡسَ عَلَيۡكُمۡ جُنَاحٞ فِيمَآ أَخۡطَأۡتُم بِهِۦ وَلَٰكِن مَّا تَعَمَّدَتۡ قُلُوبُكُمۡۚ وَكَانَ ٱللَّهُ غَفُورٗا رَّحِيمًا
translation: Call them by [the names of] their fathers; it is more just in the sight of Allah. But if you do not know their fathers - then they are [still] your brothers in religion and those entrusted to you. And there is no blame upon you for that in which you have erred but [only for] what your hearts intended. And ever is Allah Forgiving and Merciful
normalizedArabic: ادعوهم لابايهم هو اقسط عند الله فان لم تعلموا ءاباءهم فاخونكم في الدين وموليكم وليس عليكم جناح فيما اخطاتم به ولكن ما تعمدت قلوبكم وكان الله غفورا رحيما
normalizedTranslation: call them by [the names of] their fathers; it is more just in the sight of allah. but if you do not know their fathers - then they are [still] your brothers in religion and those entrusted to you. and there is no blame upon you for that in which you have erred but [only for] what your hearts intended. and ever is allah forgiving and merciful

arabic: ٱلنَّبِيُّ أَوۡلَىٰ بِٱلۡمُؤۡمِنِينَ مِنۡ أَنفُسِهِمۡۖ وَأَزۡوَٰجُهُۥٓ أُمَّهَٰتُهُمۡۗ وَأُوْلُواْ ٱلۡأَرۡحَامِ بَعۡضُهُمۡ أَوۡلَىٰ بِبَعۡضٖ فِي كِتَٰبِ ٱللَّهِ مِنَ ٱلۡمُؤۡمِنِينَ وَٱلۡمُهَٰجِرِينَ إِلَّآ أَن تَفۡعَلُوٓاْ إِلَىٰٓ أَوۡلِيَآئِكُم مَّعۡرُوفٗاۚ كَانَ ذَٰلِكَ فِي ٱلۡكِتَٰبِ مَسۡطُورٗا
translation: The Prophet is more worthy of the believers than themselves, and his wives are [in the position of] their mothers. And those of [blood] relationship are more entitled [to inheritance] in the decree of Allah than the [other] believers and the emigrants, except that you may do to your close associates a kindness [through bequest]. That was in the Book inscribed
normalizedArabic: النبي اولي بالمومنين من انفسهم وازوجه امهتهم واولوا الارحام بعضهم اولي ببعض في كتب الله من المومنين والمهجرين الا ان تفعلوا الي اوليايكم معروفا كان ذلك في الكتب مسطورا
normalizedTranslation: the prophet is more worthy of the believers than themselves, and his wives are [in the position of] their mothers. and those of [blood] relationship are more entitled [to inheritance] in the decree of allah than the [other] believers and the emigrants, except that you may do to your close associates a kindness [through bequest]. that was in the book inscribed

arabic: وَإِذۡ أَخَذۡنَا مِنَ ٱلنَّبِيِّـۧنَ مِيثَٰقَهُمۡ وَمِنكَ وَمِن نُّوحٖ وَإِبۡرَٰهِيمَ وَمُوسَىٰ وَعِيسَى ٱبۡنِ مَرۡيَمَۖ وَأَخَذۡنَا مِنۡهُم مِّيثَٰقًا غَلِيظٗا
translation: And [mention, O Muhammad], when We took from the prophets their covenant and from you and from Noah and Abraham and Moses and Jesus, the son of Mary; and We took from them a solemn covenant
normalizedArabic: واذ اخذنا من النبين ميثقهم ومنك ومن نوح وابرهيم وموسي وعيسي ابن مريم واخذنا منهم ميثقا غليظا
normalizedTranslation: and [mention, o muhammad], when we took from the prophets their covenant and from you and from noah and abraham and moses and jesus, the son of mary; and we took from them a solemn covenant

arabic: لِّيَسۡـَٔلَ ٱلصَّـٰدِقِينَ عَن صِدۡقِهِمۡۚ وَأَعَدَّ لِلۡكَٰفِرِينَ عَذَابًا أَلِيمٗا
translation: That He may question the truthful about their truth. And He has prepared for the disbelievers a painful punishment
normalizedArabic: ليسل الصدقين عن صدقهم واعد للكفرين عذابا اليما
normalizedTranslation: that he may question the truthful about their truth. and he has prepared for the disbelievers a painful punishment

arabic: يَـٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُواْ ٱذۡكُرُواْ نِعۡمَةَ ٱللَّهِ عَلَيۡكُمۡ إِذۡ جَآءَتۡكُمۡ جُنُودٞ فَأَرۡسَلۡنَا عَلَيۡهِمۡ رِيحٗا وَجُنُودٗا لَّمۡ تَرَوۡهَاۚ وَكَانَ ٱللَّهُ بِمَا تَعۡمَلُونَ بَصِيرًا
translation: O you who have believed, remember the favor of Allah upon you when armies came to [attack] you and We sent upon them a wind and armies [of angels] you did not see. And ever is Allah, of what you do, Seeing
normalizedArabic: يايها الذين ءامنوا اذكروا نعمه الله عليكم اذ جاءتكم جنود فارسلنا عليهم ريحا وجنودا لم تروها وكان الله بما تعملون بصيرا
normalizedTranslation: o you who have believed, remember the favor of allah upon you when armies came to [attack] you and we sent upon them a wind and armies [of angels] you did not see. and ever is allah, of what you do, seeing

arabic: إِذۡ جَآءُوكُم مِّن فَوۡقِكُمۡ وَمِنۡ أَسۡفَلَ مِنكُمۡ وَإِذۡ زَاغَتِ ٱلۡأَبۡصَٰرُ وَبَلَغَتِ ٱلۡقُلُوبُ ٱلۡحَنَاجِرَ وَتَظُنُّونَ بِٱللَّهِ ٱلظُّنُونَا۠
translation: [Remember] when they came at you from above you and from below you, and when eyes shifted [in fear], and hearts reached the throats and you assumed about Allah [various] assumptions
normalizedArabic: اذ جاءوكم من فوقكم ومن اسفل منكم واذ زاغت الابصر وبلغت القلوب الحناجر وتظنون بالله الظنونا
normalizedTranslation: [remember] when they came at you from above you and from below you, and when eyes shifted [in fear], and hearts reached the throats and you assumed about allah [various] assumptions

arabic: هُنَالِكَ ٱبۡتُلِيَ ٱلۡمُؤۡمِنُونَ وَزُلۡزِلُواْ زِلۡزَالٗا شَدِيدٗا
translation: There the believers were tested and shaken with a severe shaking
normalizedArabic: هنالك ابتلي المومنون وزلزلوا زلزالا شديدا
normalizedTranslation: there the believers were tested and shaken with a severe shaking

arabic: وَإِذۡ يَقُولُ ٱلۡمُنَٰفِقُونَ وَٱلَّذِينَ فِي قُلُوبِهِم مَّرَضٞ مَّا وَعَدَنَا ٱللَّهُ وَرَسُولُهُۥٓ إِلَّا غُرُورٗا
translation: And [remember] when the hypocrites and those in whose hearts is disease said, "Allah and His Messenger did not promise us except delusion
normalizedArabic: واذ يقول المنفقون والذين في قلوبهم مرض ما وعدنا الله ورسوله الا غرورا
normalizedTranslation: and [remember] when the hypocrites and those in whose hearts is disease said, "allah and his messenger did not promise us except delusion

arabic: وَإِذۡ قَالَت طَّآئِفَةٞ مِّنۡهُمۡ يَـٰٓأَهۡلَ يَثۡرِبَ لَا مُقَامَ لَكُمۡ فَٱرۡجِعُواْۚ وَيَسۡتَـٔۡذِنُ فَرِيقٞ مِّنۡهُمُ ٱلنَّبِيَّ يَقُولُونَ إِنَّ بُيُوتَنَا عَوۡرَةٞ وَمَا هِيَ بِعَوۡرَةٍۖ إِن يُرِيدُونَ إِلَّا فِرَارٗا
translation: And when a faction of them said, "O people of Yathrib, there is no stability for you [here], so return [home]." And a party of them asked permission of the Prophet, saying, "Indeed, our houses are unprotected," while they were not exposed. They did not intend except to flee
normalizedArabic: واذ قالت طايفه منهم ياهل يثرب لا مقام لكم فارجعوا ويستذن فريق منهم النبي يقولون ان بيوتنا عوره وما هي بعوره ان يريدون الا فرارا
normalizedTranslation: and when a faction of them said, "o people of yathrib, there is no stability for you [here], so return [home]." and a party of them asked permission of the prophet, saying, "indeed, our houses are unprotected," while they were not exposed. they did not intend except to flee

arabic: وَلَوۡ دُخِلَتۡ عَلَيۡهِم مِّنۡ أَقۡطَارِهَا ثُمَّ سُئِلُواْ ٱلۡفِتۡنَةَ لَأٓتَوۡهَا وَمَا تَلَبَّثُواْ بِهَآ إِلَّا يَسِيرٗا
translation: And if they had been entered upon from all its [surrounding] regions and fitnah had been demanded of them, they would have done it and not hesitated over it except briefly
normalizedArabic: ولو دخلت عليهم من اقطارها ثم سيلوا الفتنه لاتوها وما تلبثوا بها الا يسيرا
normalizedTranslation: and if they had been entered upon from all its [surrounding] regions and fitnah had been demanded of them, they would have done it and not hesitated over it except briefly

arabic: وَلَقَدۡ كَانُواْ عَٰهَدُواْ ٱللَّهَ مِن قَبۡلُ لَا يُوَلُّونَ ٱلۡأَدۡبَٰرَۚ وَكَانَ عَهۡدُ ٱللَّهِ مَسۡـُٔولٗا
translation: And they had already promised Allah before not to turn their backs and flee. And ever is the promise to Allah [that about which one will be] questioned
normalizedArabic: ولقد كانوا عهدوا الله من قبل لا يولون الادبر وكان عهد الله مسولا
normalizedTranslation: and they had already promised allah before not to turn their backs and flee. and ever is the promise to allah [that about which one will be] questioned

arabic: قُل لَّن يَنفَعَكُمُ ٱلۡفِرَارُ إِن فَرَرۡتُم مِّنَ ٱلۡمَوۡتِ أَوِ ٱلۡقَتۡلِ وَإِذٗا لَّا تُمَتَّعُونَ إِلَّا قَلِيلٗا
translation: Say, [O Muhammad], "Never will fleeing benefit you if you should flee from death or killing; and then [if you did], you would not be given enjoyment [of life] except for a little
normalizedArabic: قل لن ينفعكم الفرار ان فررتم من الموت او القتل واذا لا تمتعون الا قليلا
normalizedTranslation: say, [o muhammad], "never will fleeing benefit you if you should flee from death or killing; and then [if you did], you would not be given enjoyment [of life] except for a little

arabic: قُلۡ مَن ذَا ٱلَّذِي يَعۡصِمُكُم مِّنَ ٱللَّهِ إِنۡ أَرَادَ بِكُمۡ سُوٓءًا أَوۡ أَرَادَ بِكُمۡ رَحۡمَةٗۚ وَلَا يَجِدُونَ لَهُم مِّن دُونِ ٱللَّهِ وَلِيّٗا وَلَا نَصِيرٗا
translation: Say, "Who is it that can protect you from Allah if He intends for you an ill or intends for you a mercy?" And they will not find for themselves besides Allah any protector or any helper
normalizedArabic: قل من ذا الذي يعصمكم من الله ان اراد بكم سوءا او اراد بكم رحمه ولا يجدون لهم من دون الله وليا ولا نصيرا
normalizedTranslation: say, "who is it that can protect you from allah if he intends for you an ill or intends for you a mercy?" and they will not find for themselves besides allah any protector or any helper

arabic: ۞قَدۡ يَعۡلَمُ ٱللَّهُ ٱلۡمُعَوِّقِينَ مِنكُمۡ وَٱلۡقَآئِلِينَ لِإِخۡوَٰنِهِمۡ هَلُمَّ إِلَيۡنَاۖ وَلَا يَأۡتُونَ ٱلۡبَأۡسَ إِلَّا قَلِيلًا
translation: Already Allah knows the hinderers among you and those [hypocrites] who say to their brothers, "Come to us," and do not go to battle, except for a few
normalizedArabic: قد يعلم الله المعوقين منكم والقايلين لاخونهم هلم الينا ولا ياتون الباس الا قليلا
normalizedTranslation: already allah knows the hinderers among you and those [hypocrites] who say to their brothers, "come to us," and do not go to battle, except for a few

arabic: أَشِحَّةً عَلَيۡكُمۡۖ فَإِذَا جَآءَ ٱلۡخَوۡفُ رَأَيۡتَهُمۡ يَنظُرُونَ إِلَيۡكَ تَدُورُ أَعۡيُنُهُمۡ كَٱلَّذِي يُغۡشَىٰ عَلَيۡهِ مِنَ ٱلۡمَوۡتِۖ فَإِذَا ذَهَبَ ٱلۡخَوۡفُ سَلَقُوكُم بِأَلۡسِنَةٍ حِدَادٍ أَشِحَّةً عَلَى ٱلۡخَيۡرِۚ أُوْلَـٰٓئِكَ لَمۡ يُؤۡمِنُواْ فَأَحۡبَطَ ٱللَّهُ أَعۡمَٰلَهُمۡۚ وَكَانَ ذَٰلِكَ عَلَى ٱللَّهِ يَسِيرٗا
translation: Indisposed toward you. And when fear comes, you see them looking at you, their eyes revolving like one being overcome by death. But when fear departs, they lash you with sharp tongues, indisposed toward [any] good. Those have not believed, so Allah has rendered their deeds worthless, and ever is that, for Allah, easy
normalizedArabic: اشحه عليكم فاذا جاء الخوف رايتهم ينظرون اليك تدور اعينهم كالذي يغشي عليه من الموت فاذا ذهب الخوف سلقوكم بالسنه حداد اشحه علي الخير اوليك لم يومنوا فاحبط الله اعملهم وكان ذلك علي الله يسيرا
normalizedTranslation: indisposed toward you. and when fear comes, you see them looking at you, their eyes revolving like one being overcome by death. but when fear departs, they lash you with sharp tongues, indisposed toward [any] good. those have not believed, so allah has rendered their deeds worthless, and ever is that, for allah, easy

arabic: يَحۡسَبُونَ ٱلۡأَحۡزَابَ لَمۡ يَذۡهَبُواْۖ وَإِن يَأۡتِ ٱلۡأَحۡزَابُ يَوَدُّواْ لَوۡ أَنَّهُم بَادُونَ فِي ٱلۡأَعۡرَابِ يَسۡـَٔلُونَ عَنۡ أَنۢبَآئِكُمۡۖ وَلَوۡ كَانُواْ فِيكُم مَّا قَٰتَلُوٓاْ إِلَّا قَلِيلٗا
translation: They think the companies have not [yet] withdrawn. And if the companies should come [again], they would wish they were in the desert among the bedouins, inquiring [from afar] about your news. And if they should be among you, they would not fight except for a little
normalizedArabic: يحسبون الاحزاب لم يذهبوا وان يات الاحزاب يودوا لو انهم بادون في الاعراب يسلون عن انبايكم ولو كانوا فيكم ما قتلوا الا قليلا
normalizedTranslation: they think the companies have not [yet] withdrawn. and if the companies should come [again], they would wish they were in the desert among the bedouins, inquiring [from afar] about your news. and if they should be among you, they would not fight except for a little

arabic: لَّقَدۡ كَانَ لَكُمۡ فِي رَسُولِ ٱللَّهِ أُسۡوَةٌ حَسَنَةٞ لِّمَن كَانَ يَرۡجُواْ ٱللَّهَ وَٱلۡيَوۡمَ ٱلۡأٓخِرَ وَذَكَرَ ٱللَّهَ كَثِيرٗا
translation: There has certainly been for you in the Messenger of Allah an excellent pattern for anyone whose hope is in Allah and the Last Day and [who] remembers Allah often
normalizedArabic: لقد كان لكم في رسول الله اسوه حسنه لمن كان يرجوا الله واليوم الاخر وذكر الله كثيرا
normalizedTranslation: there has certainly been for you in the messenger of allah an excellent pattern for anyone whose hope is in allah and the last day and [who] remembers allah often

arabic: وَلَمَّا رَءَا ٱلۡمُؤۡمِنُونَ ٱلۡأَحۡزَابَ قَالُواْ هَٰذَا مَا وَعَدَنَا ٱللَّهُ وَرَسُولُهُۥ وَصَدَقَ ٱللَّهُ وَرَسُولُهُۥۚ وَمَا زَادَهُمۡ إِلَّآ إِيمَٰنٗا وَتَسۡلِيمٗا
translation: And when the believers saw the companies, they said, "This is what Allah and His Messenger had promised us, and Allah and His Messenger spoke the truth." And it increased them only in faith and acceptance
normalizedArabic: ولما رءا المومنون الاحزاب قالوا هذا ما وعدنا الله ورسوله وصدق الله ورسوله وما زادهم الا ايمنا وتسليما
normalizedTranslation: and when the believers saw the companies, they said, "this is what allah and his messenger had promised us, and allah and his messenger spoke the truth." and it increased them only in faith and acceptance

arabic: مِّنَ ٱلۡمُؤۡمِنِينَ رِجَالٞ صَدَقُواْ مَا عَٰهَدُواْ ٱللَّهَ عَلَيۡهِۖ فَمِنۡهُم مَّن قَضَىٰ نَحۡبَهُۥ وَمِنۡهُم مَّن يَنتَظِرُۖ وَمَا بَدَّلُواْ تَبۡدِيلٗا
translation: Among the believers are men true to what they promised Allah. Among them is he who has fulfilled his vow [to the death], and among them is he who awaits [his chance]. And they did not alter [the terms of their commitment] by any alteration
normalizedArabic: من المومنين رجال صدقوا ما عهدوا الله عليه فمنهم من قضي نحبه ومنهم من ينتظر وما بدلوا تبديلا
normalizedTranslation: among the believers are men true to what they promised allah. among them is he who has fulfilled his vow [to the death], and among them is he who awaits [his chance]. and they did not alter [the terms of their commitment] by any alteration

arabic: لِّيَجۡزِيَ ٱللَّهُ ٱلصَّـٰدِقِينَ بِصِدۡقِهِمۡ وَيُعَذِّبَ ٱلۡمُنَٰفِقِينَ إِن شَآءَ أَوۡ يَتُوبَ عَلَيۡهِمۡۚ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ كَانَ غَفُورٗا رَّحِيمٗا
translation: That Allah may reward the truthful for their truth and punish the hypocrites if He wills or accept their repentance. Indeed, Allah is ever Forgiving and Merciful
normalizedArabic: ليجزي الله الصدقين بصدقهم ويعذب المنفقين ان شاء او يتوب عليهم ان الله كان غفورا رحيما
normalizedTranslation: that allah may reward the truthful for their truth and punish the hypocrites if he wills or accept their repentance. indeed, allah is ever forgiving and merciful

arabic: وَرَدَّ ٱللَّهُ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُواْ بِغَيۡظِهِمۡ لَمۡ يَنَالُواْ خَيۡرٗاۚ وَكَفَى ٱللَّهُ ٱلۡمُؤۡمِنِينَ ٱلۡقِتَالَۚ وَكَانَ ٱللَّهُ قَوِيًّا عَزِيزٗا
translation: And Allah repelled those who disbelieved, in their rage, not having obtained any good. And sufficient was Allah for the believers in battle, and ever is Allah Powerful and Exalted in Might
normalizedArabic: ورد الله الذين كفروا بغيظهم لم ينالوا خيرا وكفي الله المومنين القتال وكان الله قويا عزيزا
normalizedTranslation: and allah repelled those who disbelieved, in their rage, not having obtained any good. and sufficient was allah for the believers in battle, and ever is allah powerful and exalted in might

arabic: وَأَنزَلَ ٱلَّذِينَ ظَٰهَرُوهُم مِّنۡ أَهۡلِ ٱلۡكِتَٰبِ مِن صَيَاصِيهِمۡ وَقَذَفَ فِي قُلُوبِهِمُ ٱلرُّعۡبَ فَرِيقٗا تَقۡتُلُونَ وَتَأۡسِرُونَ فَرِيقٗا
translation: And He brought down those who supported them among the People of the Scripture from their fortresses and cast terror into their hearts [so that] a party you killed, and you took captive a party
normalizedArabic: وانزل الذين ظهروهم من اهل الكتب من صياصيهم وقذف في قلوبهم الرعب فريقا تقتلون وتاسرون فريقا
normalizedTranslation: and he brought down those who supported them among the people of the scripture from their fortresses and cast terror into their hearts [so that] a party you killed, and you took captive a party

arabic: وَأَوۡرَثَكُمۡ أَرۡضَهُمۡ وَدِيَٰرَهُمۡ وَأَمۡوَٰلَهُمۡ وَأَرۡضٗا لَّمۡ تَطَـُٔوهَاۚ وَكَانَ ٱللَّهُ عَلَىٰ كُلِّ شَيۡءٖ قَدِيرٗا
translation: And He caused you to inherit their land and their homes and their properties and a land which you have not trodden. And ever is Allah, over all things, competent
normalizedArabic: واورثكم ارضهم وديرهم وامولهم وارضا لم تطوها وكان الله علي كل شيء قديرا
normalizedTranslation: and he caused you to inherit their land and their homes and their properties and a land which you have not trodden. and ever is allah, over all things, competent

arabic: يَـٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلنَّبِيُّ قُل لِّأَزۡوَٰجِكَ إِن كُنتُنَّ تُرِدۡنَ ٱلۡحَيَوٰةَ ٱلدُّنۡيَا وَزِينَتَهَا فَتَعَالَيۡنَ أُمَتِّعۡكُنَّ وَأُسَرِّحۡكُنَّ سَرَاحٗا جَمِيلٗا
translation: O Prophet, say to your wives, "If you should desire the worldly life and its adornment, then come, I will provide for you and give you a gracious release
normalizedArabic: يايها النبي قل لازوجك ان كنتن تردن الحيوه الدنيا وزينتها فتعالين امتعكن واسرحكن سراحا جميلا
normalizedTranslation: o prophet, say to your wives, "if you should desire the worldly life and its adornment, then come, i will provide for you and give you a gracious release

arabic: وَإِن كُنتُنَّ تُرِدۡنَ ٱللَّهَ وَرَسُولَهُۥ وَٱلدَّارَ ٱلۡأٓخِرَةَ فَإِنَّ ٱللَّهَ أَعَدَّ لِلۡمُحۡسِنَٰتِ مِنكُنَّ أَجۡرًا عَظِيمٗا
translation: But if you should desire Allah and His Messenger and the home of the Hereafter - then indeed, Allah has prepared for the doers of good among you a great reward
normalizedArabic: وان كنتن تردن الله ورسوله والدار الاخره فان الله اعد للمحسنت منكن اجرا عظيما
normalizedTranslation: but if you should desire allah and his messenger and the home of the hereafter - then indeed, allah has prepared for the doers of good among you a great reward

arabic: يَٰنِسَآءَ ٱلنَّبِيِّ مَن يَأۡتِ مِنكُنَّ بِفَٰحِشَةٖ مُّبَيِّنَةٖ يُضَٰعَفۡ لَهَا ٱلۡعَذَابُ ضِعۡفَيۡنِۚ وَكَانَ ذَٰلِكَ عَلَى ٱللَّهِ يَسِيرٗا
translation: O wives of the Prophet, whoever of you should commit a clear immorality - for her the punishment would be doubled two fold, and ever is that, for Allah, easy
normalizedArabic: ينساء النبي من يات منكن بفحشه مبينه يضعف لها العذاب ضعفين وكان ذلك علي الله يسيرا
normalizedTranslation: o wives of the prophet, whoever of you should commit a clear immorality - for her the punishment would be doubled two fold, and ever is that, for allah, easy

arabic: ۞وَمَن يَقۡنُتۡ مِنكُنَّ لِلَّهِ وَرَسُولِهِۦ وَتَعۡمَلۡ صَٰلِحٗا نُّؤۡتِهَآ أَجۡرَهَا مَرَّتَيۡنِ وَأَعۡتَدۡنَا لَهَا رِزۡقٗا كَرِيمٗا
translation: And whoever of you devoutly obeys Allah and His Messenger and does righteousness - We will give her her reward twice; and We have prepared for her a noble provision
normalizedArabic: ومن يقنت منكن لله ورسوله وتعمل صلحا نوتها اجرها مرتين واعتدنا لها رزقا كريما
normalizedTranslation: and whoever of you devoutly obeys allah and his messenger and does righteousness - we will give her her reward twice; and we have prepared for her a noble provision

arabic: يَٰنِسَآءَ ٱلنَّبِيِّ لَسۡتُنَّ كَأَحَدٖ مِّنَ ٱلنِّسَآءِ إِنِ ٱتَّقَيۡتُنَّۚ فَلَا تَخۡضَعۡنَ بِٱلۡقَوۡلِ فَيَطۡمَعَ ٱلَّذِي فِي قَلۡبِهِۦ مَرَضٞ وَقُلۡنَ قَوۡلٗا مَّعۡرُوفٗا
translation: O wives of the Prophet, you are not like anyone among women. If you fear Allah, then do not be soft in speech [to men], lest he in whose heart is disease should covet, but speak with appropriate speech
normalizedArabic: ينساء النبي لستن كاحد من النساء ان اتقيتن فلا تخضعن بالقول فيطمع الذي في قلبه مرض وقلن قولا معروفا
normalizedTranslation: o wives of the prophet, you are not like anyone among women. if you fear allah, then do not be soft in speech [to men], lest he in whose heart is disease should covet, but speak with appropriate speech

arabic: وَقَرۡنَ فِي بُيُوتِكُنَّ وَلَا تَبَرَّجۡنَ تَبَرُّجَ ٱلۡجَٰهِلِيَّةِ ٱلۡأُولَىٰۖ وَأَقِمۡنَ ٱلصَّلَوٰةَ وَءَاتِينَ ٱلزَّكَوٰةَ وَأَطِعۡنَ ٱللَّهَ وَرَسُولَهُۥٓۚ إِنَّمَا يُرِيدُ ٱللَّهُ لِيُذۡهِبَ عَنكُمُ ٱلرِّجۡسَ أَهۡلَ ٱلۡبَيۡتِ وَيُطَهِّرَكُمۡ تَطۡهِيرٗا
translation: And abide in your houses and do not display yourselves as [was] the display of the former times of ignorance. And establish prayer and give zakah and obey Allah and His Messenger. Allah intends only to remove from you the impurity [of sin], O people of the [Prophet's] household, and to purify you with [extensive] purification
normalizedArabic: وقرن في بيوتكن ولا تبرجن تبرج الجهليه الاولي واقمن الصلوه وءاتين الزكوه واطعن الله ورسوله انما يريد الله ليذهب عنكم الرجس اهل البيت ويطهركم تطهيرا
normalizedTranslation: and abide in your houses and do not display yourselves as [was] the display of the former times of ignorance. and establish prayer and give zakah and obey allah and his messenger. allah intends only to remove from you the impurity [of sin], o people of the [prophet's] household, and to purify you with [extensive] purification

arabic: وَٱذۡكُرۡنَ مَا يُتۡلَىٰ فِي بُيُوتِكُنَّ مِنۡ ءَايَٰتِ ٱللَّهِ وَٱلۡحِكۡمَةِۚ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ كَانَ لَطِيفًا خَبِيرًا
translation: And remember what is recited in your houses of the verses of Allah and wisdom. Indeed, Allah is ever Subtle and Acquainted [with all things]
normalizedArabic: واذكرن ما يتلي في بيوتكن من ءايت الله والحكمه ان الله كان لطيفا خبيرا
normalizedTranslation: and remember what is recited in your houses of the verses of allah and wisdom. indeed, allah is ever subtle and acquainted [with all things]

arabic: إِنَّ ٱلۡمُسۡلِمِينَ وَٱلۡمُسۡلِمَٰتِ وَٱلۡمُؤۡمِنِينَ وَٱلۡمُؤۡمِنَٰتِ وَٱلۡقَٰنِتِينَ وَٱلۡقَٰنِتَٰتِ وَٱلصَّـٰدِقِينَ وَٱلصَّـٰدِقَٰتِ وَٱلصَّـٰبِرِينَ وَٱلصَّـٰبِرَٰتِ وَٱلۡخَٰشِعِينَ وَٱلۡخَٰشِعَٰتِ وَٱلۡمُتَصَدِّقِينَ وَٱلۡمُتَصَدِّقَٰتِ وَٱلصَّـٰٓئِمِينَ وَٱلصَّـٰٓئِمَٰتِ وَٱلۡحَٰفِظِينَ فُرُوجَهُمۡ وَٱلۡحَٰفِظَٰتِ وَٱلذَّـٰكِرِينَ ٱللَّهَ كَثِيرٗا وَٱلذَّـٰكِرَٰتِ أَعَدَّ ٱللَّهُ لَهُم مَّغۡفِرَةٗ وَأَجۡرًا عَظِيمٗا
translation: Indeed, the Muslim men and Muslim women, the believing men and believing women, the obedient men and obedient women, the truthful men and truthful women, the patient men and patient women, the humble men and humble women, the charitable men and charitable women, the fasting men and fasting women, the men who guard their private parts and the women who do so, and the men who remember Allah often and the women who do so - for them Allah has prepared forgiveness and a great reward
normalizedArabic: ان المسلمين والمسلمت والمومنين والمومنت والقنتين والقنتت والصدقين والصدقت والصبرين والصبرت والخشعين والخشعت والمتصدقين والمتصدقت والصيمين والصيمت والحفظين فروجهم والحفظت والذكرين الله كثيرا والذكرت اعد الله لهم مغفره واجرا عظيما
normalizedTranslation: indeed, the muslim men and muslim women, the believing men and believing women, the obedient men and obedient women, the truthful men and truthful women, the patient men and patient women, the humble men and humble women, the charitable men and charitable women, the fasting men and fasting women, the men who guard their private parts and the women who do so, and the men who remember allah often and the women who do so - for them allah has prepared forgiveness and a great reward

arabic: وَمَا كَانَ لِمُؤۡمِنٖ وَلَا مُؤۡمِنَةٍ إِذَا قَضَى ٱللَّهُ وَرَسُولُهُۥٓ أَمۡرًا أَن يَكُونَ لَهُمُ ٱلۡخِيَرَةُ مِنۡ أَمۡرِهِمۡۗ وَمَن يَعۡصِ ٱللَّهَ وَرَسُولَهُۥ فَقَدۡ ضَلَّ ضَلَٰلٗا مُّبِينٗا
translation: It is not for a believing man or a believing woman, when Allah and His Messenger have decided a matter, that they should [thereafter] have any choice about their affair. And whoever disobeys Allah and His Messenger has certainly strayed into clear error
normalizedArabic: وما كان لمومن ولا مومنه اذا قضي الله ورسوله امرا ان يكون لهم الخيره من امرهم ومن يعص الله ورسوله فقد ضل ضللا مبينا
normalizedTranslation: it is not for a believing man or a believing woman, when allah and his messenger have decided a matter, that they should [thereafter] have any choice about their affair. and whoever disobeys allah and his messenger has certainly strayed into clear error

arabic: وَإِذۡ تَقُولُ لِلَّذِيٓ أَنۡعَمَ ٱللَّهُ عَلَيۡهِ وَأَنۡعَمۡتَ عَلَيۡهِ أَمۡسِكۡ عَلَيۡكَ زَوۡجَكَ وَٱتَّقِ ٱللَّهَ وَتُخۡفِي فِي نَفۡسِكَ مَا ٱللَّهُ مُبۡدِيهِ وَتَخۡشَى ٱلنَّاسَ وَٱللَّهُ أَحَقُّ أَن تَخۡشَىٰهُۖ فَلَمَّا قَضَىٰ زَيۡدٞ مِّنۡهَا وَطَرٗا زَوَّجۡنَٰكَهَا لِكَيۡ لَا يَكُونَ عَلَى ٱلۡمُؤۡمِنِينَ حَرَجٞ فِيٓ أَزۡوَٰجِ أَدۡعِيَآئِهِمۡ إِذَا قَضَوۡاْ مِنۡهُنَّ وَطَرٗاۚ وَكَانَ أَمۡرُ ٱللَّهِ مَفۡعُولٗا
translation: And [remember, O Muhammad], when you said to the one on whom Allah bestowed favor and you bestowed favor, "Keep your wife and fear Allah," while you concealed within yourself that which Allah is to disclose. And you feared the people, while Allah has more right that you fear Him. So when Zayd had no longer any need for her, We married her to you in order that there not be upon the believers any discomfort concerning the wives of their adopted sons when they no longer have need of them. And ever is the command of Allah accomplished
normalizedArabic: واذ تقول للذي انعم الله عليه وانعمت عليه امسك عليك زوجك واتق الله وتخفي في نفسك ما الله مبديه وتخشي الناس والله احق ان تخشيه فلما قضي زيد منها وطرا زوجنكها لكي لا يكون علي المومنين حرج في ازوج ادعيايهم اذا قضوا منهن وطرا وكان امر الله مفعولا
normalizedTranslation: and [remember, o muhammad], when you said to the one on whom allah bestowed favor and you bestowed favor, "keep your wife and fear allah," while you concealed within yourself that which allah is to disclose. and you feared the people, while allah has more right that you fear him. so when zayd had no longer any need for her, we married her to you in order that there not be upon the believers any discomfort concerning the wives of their adopted sons when they no longer have need of them. and ever is the command of allah accomplished

arabic: مَّا كَانَ عَلَى ٱلنَّبِيِّ مِنۡ حَرَجٖ فِيمَا فَرَضَ ٱللَّهُ لَهُۥۖ سُنَّةَ ٱللَّهِ فِي ٱلَّذِينَ خَلَوۡاْ مِن قَبۡلُۚ وَكَانَ أَمۡرُ ٱللَّهِ قَدَرٗا مَّقۡدُورًا
translation: There is not to be upon the Prophet any discomfort concerning that which Allah has imposed upon him. [This is] the established way of Allah with those [prophets] who have passed on before. And ever is the command of Allah a destiny decreed
normalizedArabic: ما كان علي النبي من حرج فيما فرض الله له سنه الله في الذين خلوا من قبل وكان امر الله قدرا مقدورا
normalizedTranslation: there is not to be upon the prophet any discomfort concerning that which allah has imposed upon him. [this is] the established way of allah with those [prophets] who have passed on before. and ever is the command of allah a destiny decreed

arabic: ٱلَّذِينَ يُبَلِّغُونَ رِسَٰلَٰتِ ٱللَّهِ وَيَخۡشَوۡنَهُۥ وَلَا يَخۡشَوۡنَ أَحَدًا إِلَّا ٱللَّهَۗ وَكَفَىٰ بِٱللَّهِ حَسِيبٗا
translation: [Allah praises] those who convey the messages of Allah and fear Him and do not fear anyone but Allah. And sufficient is Allah as Accountant
normalizedArabic: الذين يبلغون رسلت الله ويخشونه ولا يخشون احدا الا الله وكفي بالله حسيبا
normalizedTranslation: [allah praises] those who convey the messages of allah and fear him and do not fear anyone but allah. and sufficient is allah as accountant

arabic: مَّا كَانَ مُحَمَّدٌ أَبَآ أَحَدٖ مِّن رِّجَالِكُمۡ وَلَٰكِن رَّسُولَ ٱللَّهِ وَخَاتَمَ ٱلنَّبِيِّـۧنَۗ وَكَانَ ٱللَّهُ بِكُلِّ شَيۡءٍ عَلِيمٗا
translation: Muhammad is not the father of [any] one of your men, but [he is] the Messenger of Allah and last of the prophets. And ever is Allah, of all things, Knowing
normalizedArabic: ما كان محمد ابا احد من رجالكم ولكن رسول الله وخاتم النبين وكان الله بكل شيء عليما
normalizedTranslation: muhammad is not the father of [any] one of your men, but [he is] the messenger of allah and last of the prophets. and ever is allah, of all things, knowing

arabic: يَـٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُواْ ٱذۡكُرُواْ ٱللَّهَ ذِكۡرٗا كَثِيرٗا
translation: O you who have believed, remember Allah with much remembrance
normalizedArabic: يايها الذين ءامنوا اذكروا الله ذكرا كثيرا
normalizedTranslation: o you who have believed, remember allah with much remembrance

arabic: وَسَبِّحُوهُ بُكۡرَةٗ وَأَصِيلًا
translation: And exalt Him morning and afternoon
normalizedArabic: وسبحوه بكره واصيلا
normalizedTranslation: and exalt him morning and afternoon

arabic: هُوَ ٱلَّذِي يُصَلِّي عَلَيۡكُمۡ وَمَلَـٰٓئِكَتُهُۥ لِيُخۡرِجَكُم مِّنَ ٱلظُّلُمَٰتِ إِلَى ٱلنُّورِۚ وَكَانَ بِٱلۡمُؤۡمِنِينَ رَحِيمٗا
translation: It is He who confers blessing upon you, and His angels [ask Him to do so] that He may bring you out from darknesses into the light. And ever is He, to the believers, Merciful
normalizedArabic: هو الذي يصلي عليكم ومليكته ليخرجكم من الظلمت الي النور وكان بالمومنين رحيما
normalizedTranslation: it is he who confers blessing upon you, and his angels [ask him to do so] that he may bring you out from darknesses into the light. and ever is he, to the believers, merciful

arabic: تَحِيَّتُهُمۡ يَوۡمَ يَلۡقَوۡنَهُۥ سَلَٰمٞۚ وَأَعَدَّ لَهُمۡ أَجۡرٗا كَرِيمٗا
translation: Their greeting the Day they meet Him will be, "Peace." And He has prepared for them a noble reward
normalizedArabic: تحيتهم يوم يلقونه سلم واعد لهم اجرا كريما
normalizedTranslation: their greeting the day they meet him will be, "peace." and he has prepared for them a noble reward

arabic: يَـٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلنَّبِيُّ إِنَّآ أَرۡسَلۡنَٰكَ شَٰهِدٗا وَمُبَشِّرٗا وَنَذِيرٗا
translation: O Prophet, indeed We have sent you as a witness and a bringer of good tidings and a warner
normalizedArabic: يايها النبي انا ارسلنك شهدا ومبشرا ونذيرا
normalizedTranslation: o prophet, indeed we have sent you as a witness and a bringer of good tidings and a warner

arabic: وَدَاعِيًا إِلَى ٱللَّهِ بِإِذۡنِهِۦ وَسِرَاجٗا مُّنِيرٗا
translation: And one who invites to Allah, by His permission, and an illuminating lamp
normalizedArabic: وداعيا الي الله باذنه وسراجا منيرا
normalizedTranslation: and one who invites to allah, by his permission, and an illuminating lamp

arabic: وَبَشِّرِ ٱلۡمُؤۡمِنِينَ بِأَنَّ لَهُم مِّنَ ٱللَّهِ فَضۡلٗا كَبِيرٗا
translation: And give good tidings to the believers that they will have from Allah great bounty
normalizedArabic: وبشر المومنين بان لهم من الله فضلا كبيرا
normalizedTranslation: and give good tidings to the believers that they will have from allah great bounty

arabic: وَلَا تُطِعِ ٱلۡكَٰفِرِينَ وَٱلۡمُنَٰفِقِينَ وَدَعۡ أَذَىٰهُمۡ وَتَوَكَّلۡ عَلَى ٱللَّهِۚ وَكَفَىٰ بِٱللَّهِ وَكِيلٗا
translation: And do not obey the disbelievers and the hypocrites but do not harm them, and rely upon Allah. And sufficient is Allah as Disposer of affairs
normalizedArabic: ولا تطع الكفرين والمنفقين ودع اذيهم وتوكل علي الله وكفي بالله وكيلا
normalizedTranslation: and do not obey the disbelievers and the hypocrites but do not harm them, and rely upon allah. and sufficient is allah as disposer of affairs

arabic: يَـٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوٓاْ إِذَا نَكَحۡتُمُ ٱلۡمُؤۡمِنَٰتِ ثُمَّ طَلَّقۡتُمُوهُنَّ مِن قَبۡلِ أَن تَمَسُّوهُنَّ فَمَا لَكُمۡ عَلَيۡهِنَّ مِنۡ عِدَّةٖ تَعۡتَدُّونَهَاۖ فَمَتِّعُوهُنَّ وَسَرِّحُوهُنَّ سَرَاحٗا جَمِيلٗا
translation: O You who have believed, when you marry believing women and then divorce them before you have touched them, then there is not for you any waiting period to count concerning them. So provide for them and give them a gracious release
normalizedArabic: يايها الذين ءامنوا اذا نكحتم المومنت ثم طلقتموهن من قبل ان تمسوهن فما لكم عليهن من عده تعتدونها فمتعوهن وسرحوهن سراحا جميلا
normalizedTranslation: o you who have believed, when you marry believing women and then divorce them before you have touched them, then there is not for you any waiting period to count concerning them. so provide for them and give them a gracious release

arabic: يَـٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلنَّبِيُّ إِنَّآ أَحۡلَلۡنَا لَكَ أَزۡوَٰجَكَ ٱلَّـٰتِيٓ ءَاتَيۡتَ أُجُورَهُنَّ وَمَا مَلَكَتۡ يَمِينُكَ مِمَّآ أَفَآءَ ٱللَّهُ عَلَيۡكَ وَبَنَاتِ عَمِّكَ وَبَنَاتِ عَمَّـٰتِكَ وَبَنَاتِ خَالِكَ وَبَنَاتِ خَٰلَٰتِكَ ٱلَّـٰتِي هَاجَرۡنَ مَعَكَ وَٱمۡرَأَةٗ مُّؤۡمِنَةً إِن وَهَبَتۡ نَفۡسَهَا لِلنَّبِيِّ إِنۡ أَرَادَ ٱلنَّبِيُّ أَن يَسۡتَنكِحَهَا خَالِصَةٗ لَّكَ مِن دُونِ ٱلۡمُؤۡمِنِينَۗ قَدۡ عَلِمۡنَا مَا فَرَضۡنَا عَلَيۡهِمۡ فِيٓ أَزۡوَٰجِهِمۡ وَمَا مَلَكَتۡ أَيۡمَٰنُهُمۡ لِكَيۡلَا يَكُونَ عَلَيۡكَ حَرَجٞۗ وَكَانَ ٱللَّهُ غَفُورٗا رَّحِيمٗا
translation: O Prophet, indeed We have made lawful to you your wives to whom you have given their due compensation and those your right hand possesses from what Allah has returned to you [of captives] and the daughters of your paternal uncles and the daughters of your paternal aunts and the daughters of your maternal uncles and the daughters of your maternal aunts who emigrated with you and a believing woman if she gives herself to the Prophet [and] if the Prophet wishes to marry her, [this is] only for you, excluding the [other] believers. We certainly know what We have made obligatory upon them concerning their wives and those their right hands possess, [but this is for you] in order that there will be upon you no discomfort. And ever is Allah Forgiving and Merciful
normalizedArabic: يايها النبي انا احللنا لك ازوجك التي ءاتيت اجورهن وما ملكت يمينك مما افاء الله عليك وبنات عمك وبنات عمتك وبنات خالك وبنات خلتك التي هاجرن معك وامراه مومنه ان وهبت نفسها للنبي ان اراد النبي ان يستنكحها خالصه لك من دون المومنين قد علمنا ما فرضنا عليهم في ازوجهم وما ملكت ايمنهم لكيلا يكون عليك حرج وكان الله غفورا رحيما
normalizedTranslation: o prophet, indeed we have made lawful to you your wives to whom you have given their due compensation and those your right hand possesses from what allah has returned to you [of captives] and the daughters of your paternal uncles and the daughters of your paternal aunts and the daughters of your maternal uncles and the daughters of your maternal aunts who emigrated with you and a believing woman if she gives herself to the prophet [and] if the prophet wishes to marry her, [this is] only for you, excluding the [other] believers. we certainly know what we have made obligatory upon them concerning their wives and those their right hands possess, [but this is for you] in order that there will be upon you no discomfort. and ever is allah forgiving and merciful

arabic: ۞تُرۡجِي مَن تَشَآءُ مِنۡهُنَّ وَتُـٔۡوِيٓ إِلَيۡكَ مَن تَشَآءُۖ وَمَنِ ٱبۡتَغَيۡتَ مِمَّنۡ عَزَلۡتَ فَلَا جُنَاحَ عَلَيۡكَۚ ذَٰلِكَ أَدۡنَىٰٓ أَن تَقَرَّ أَعۡيُنُهُنَّ وَلَا يَحۡزَنَّ وَيَرۡضَيۡنَ بِمَآ ءَاتَيۡتَهُنَّ كُلُّهُنَّۚ وَٱللَّهُ يَعۡلَمُ مَا فِي قُلُوبِكُمۡۚ وَكَانَ ٱللَّهُ عَلِيمًا حَلِيمٗا
translation: You, [O Muhammad], may put aside whom you will of them or take to yourself whom you will. And any that you desire of those [wives] from whom you had [temporarily] separated - there is no blame upon you [in returning her]. That is more suitable that they should be content and not grieve and that they should be satisfied with what you have given them - all of them. And Allah knows what is in your hearts. And ever is Allah Knowing and Forbearing
normalizedArabic: ترجي من تشاء منهن وتوي اليك من تشاء ومن ابتغيت ممن عزلت فلا جناح عليك ذلك ادني ان تقر اعينهن ولا يحزن ويرضين بما ءاتيتهن كلهن والله يعلم ما في قلوبكم وكان الله عليما حليما
normalizedTranslation: you, [o muhammad], may put aside whom you will of them or take to yourself whom you will. and any that you desire of those [wives] from whom you had [temporarily] separated - there is no blame upon you [in returning her]. that is more suitable that they should be content and not grieve and that they should be satisfied with what you have given them - all of them. and allah knows what is in your hearts. and ever is allah knowing and forbearing

arabic: لَّا يَحِلُّ لَكَ ٱلنِّسَآءُ مِنۢ بَعۡدُ وَلَآ أَن تَبَدَّلَ بِهِنَّ مِنۡ أَزۡوَٰجٖ وَلَوۡ أَعۡجَبَكَ حُسۡنُهُنَّ إِلَّا مَا مَلَكَتۡ يَمِينُكَۗ وَكَانَ ٱللَّهُ عَلَىٰ كُلِّ شَيۡءٖ رَّقِيبٗا
translation: Not lawful to you, [O Muhammad], are [any additional] women after [this], nor [is it] for you to exchange them for [other] wives, even if their beauty were to please you, except what your right hand possesses. And ever is Allah, over all things, an Observer
normalizedArabic: لا يحل لك النساء من بعد ولا ان تبدل بهن من ازوج ولو اعجبك حسنهن الا ما ملكت يمينك وكان الله علي كل شيء رقيبا
normalizedTranslation: not lawful to you, [o muhammad], are [any additional] women after [this], nor [is it] for you to exchange them for [other] wives, even if their beauty were to please you, except what your right hand possesses. and ever is allah, over all things, an observer

arabic: يَـٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُواْ لَا تَدۡخُلُواْ بُيُوتَ ٱلنَّبِيِّ إِلَّآ أَن يُؤۡذَنَ لَكُمۡ إِلَىٰ طَعَامٍ غَيۡرَ نَٰظِرِينَ إِنَىٰهُ وَلَٰكِنۡ إِذَا دُعِيتُمۡ فَٱدۡخُلُواْ فَإِذَا طَعِمۡتُمۡ فَٱنتَشِرُواْ وَلَا مُسۡتَـٔۡنِسِينَ لِحَدِيثٍۚ إِنَّ ذَٰلِكُمۡ كَانَ يُؤۡذِي ٱلنَّبِيَّ فَيَسۡتَحۡيِۦ مِنكُمۡۖ وَٱللَّهُ لَا يَسۡتَحۡيِۦ مِنَ ٱلۡحَقِّۚ وَإِذَا سَأَلۡتُمُوهُنَّ مَتَٰعٗا فَسۡـَٔلُوهُنَّ مِن وَرَآءِ حِجَابٖۚ ذَٰلِكُمۡ أَطۡهَرُ لِقُلُوبِكُمۡ وَقُلُوبِهِنَّۚ وَمَا كَانَ لَكُمۡ أَن تُؤۡذُواْ رَسُولَ ٱللَّهِ وَلَآ أَن تَنكِحُوٓاْ أَزۡوَٰجَهُۥ مِنۢ بَعۡدِهِۦٓ أَبَدًاۚ إِنَّ ذَٰلِكُمۡ كَانَ عِندَ ٱللَّهِ عَظِيمًا
translation: O you who have believed, do not enter the houses of the Prophet except when you are permitted for a meal, without awaiting its readiness. But when you are invited, then enter; and when you have eaten, disperse without seeking to remain for conversation. Indeed, that [behavior] was troubling the Prophet, and he is shy of [dismissing] you. But Allah is not shy of the truth. And when you ask [his wives] for something, ask them from behind a partition. That is purer for your hearts and their hearts. And it is not [conceivable or lawful] for you to harm the Messenger of Allah or to marry his wives after him, ever. Indeed, that would be in the sight of Allah an enormity
