arabic: لَقَدۡ حَقَّ ٱلۡقَوۡلُ عَلَىٰٓ أَكۡثَرِهِمۡ فَهُمۡ لَا يُؤۡمِنُونَ
translation: Already the word has come into effect upon most of them, so they do not believe
normalizedArabic: لقد حق القول علي اكثرهم فهم لا يومنون
normalizedTranslation: already the word has come into effect upon most of them, so they do not believe

arabic: إِنَّا جَعَلۡنَا فِيٓ أَعۡنَٰقِهِمۡ أَغۡلَٰلٗا فَهِيَ إِلَى ٱلۡأَذۡقَانِ فَهُم مُّقۡمَحُونَ
translation: Indeed, We have put shackles on their necks, and they are to their chins, so they are with heads [kept] aloft
normalizedArabic: انا جعلنا في اعنقهم اغللا فهي الي الاذقان فهم مقمحون
normalizedTranslation: indeed, we have put shackles on their necks, and they are to their chins, so they are with heads [kept] aloft

arabic: وَجَعَلۡنَا مِنۢ بَيۡنِ أَيۡدِيهِمۡ سَدّٗا وَمِنۡ خَلۡفِهِمۡ سَدّٗا فَأَغۡشَيۡنَٰهُمۡ فَهُمۡ لَا يُبۡصِرُونَ
translation: And We have put before them a barrier and behind them a barrier and covered them, so they do not see
normalizedArabic: وجعلنا من بين ايديهم سدا ومن خلفهم سدا فاغشينهم فهم لا يبصرون
normalizedTranslation: and we have put before them a barrier and behind them a barrier and covered them, so they do not see

arabic: وَسَوَآءٌ عَلَيۡهِمۡ ءَأَنذَرۡتَهُمۡ أَمۡ لَمۡ تُنذِرۡهُمۡ لَا يُؤۡمِنُونَ
translation: And it is all the same for them whether you warn them or do not warn them - they will not believe
normalizedArabic: وسواء عليهم ءانذرتهم ام لم تنذرهم لا يومنون
normalizedTranslation: and it is all the same for them whether you warn them or do not warn them - they will not believe

arabic: إِنَّمَا تُنذِرُ مَنِ ٱتَّبَعَ ٱلذِّكۡرَ وَخَشِيَ ٱلرَّحۡمَٰنَ بِٱلۡغَيۡبِۖ فَبَشِّرۡهُ بِمَغۡفِرَةٖ وَأَجۡرٖ كَرِيمٍ
translation: You can only warn one who follows the message and fears the Most Merciful unseen. So give him good tidings of forgiveness and noble reward
normalizedArabic: انما تنذر من اتبع الذكر وخشي الرحمن بالغيب فبشره بمغفره واجر كريم
normalizedTranslation: you can only warn one who follows the message and fears the most merciful unseen. so give him good tidings of forgiveness and noble reward

arabic: إِنَّا نَحۡنُ نُحۡيِ ٱلۡمَوۡتَىٰ وَنَكۡتُبُ مَا قَدَّمُواْ وَءَاثَٰرَهُمۡۚ وَكُلَّ شَيۡءٍ أَحۡصَيۡنَٰهُ فِيٓ إِمَامٖ مُّبِينٖ
translation: Indeed, it is We who bring the dead to life and record what they have put forth and what they left behind, and all things We have enumerated in a clear register
normalizedArabic: انا نحن نحي الموتي ونكتب ما قدموا وءاثرهم وكل شيء احصينه في امام مبين
normalizedTranslation: indeed, it is we who bring the dead to life and record what they have put forth and what they left behind, and all things we have enumerated in a clear register

arabic: وَٱضۡرِبۡ لَهُم مَّثَلًا أَصۡحَٰبَ ٱلۡقَرۡيَةِ إِذۡ جَآءَهَا ٱلۡمُرۡسَلُونَ
translation: And present to them an example: the people of the city, when the messengers came to it
normalizedArabic: واضرب لهم مثلا اصحب القريه اذ جاءها المرسلون
normalizedTranslation: and present to them an example: the people of the city, when the messengers came to it

arabic: إِذۡ أَرۡسَلۡنَآ إِلَيۡهِمُ ٱثۡنَيۡنِ فَكَذَّبُوهُمَا فَعَزَّزۡنَا بِثَالِثٖ فَقَالُوٓاْ إِنَّآ إِلَيۡكُم مُّرۡسَلُونَ
translation: When We sent to them two but they denied them, so We strengthened them with a third, and they said, "Indeed, we are messengers to you
normalizedArabic: اذ ارسلنا اليهم اثنين فكذبوهما فعززنا بثالث فقالوا انا اليكم مرسلون
normalizedTranslation: when we sent to them two but they denied them, so we strengthened them with a third, and they said, "indeed, we are messengers to you

arabic: قَالُواْ مَآ أَنتُمۡ إِلَّا بَشَرٞ مِّثۡلُنَا وَمَآ أَنزَلَ ٱلرَّحۡمَٰنُ مِن شَيۡءٍ إِنۡ أَنتُمۡ إِلَّا تَكۡذِبُونَ
translation: They said, "You are not but human beings like us, and the Most Merciful has not revealed a thing. You are only telling lies
normalizedArabic: قالوا ما انتم الا بشر مثلنا وما انزل الرحمن من شيء ان انتم الا تكذبون
normalizedTranslation: they said, "you are not but human beings like us, and the most merciful has not revealed a thing. you are only telling lies

arabic: قَالُواْ رَبُّنَا يَعۡلَمُ إِنَّآ إِلَيۡكُمۡ لَمُرۡسَلُونَ
translation: They said, "Our Lord knows that we are messengers to you
normalizedArabic: قالوا ربنا يعلم انا اليكم لمرسلون
normalizedTranslation: they said, "our lord knows that we are messengers to you

arabic: وَمَا عَلَيۡنَآ إِلَّا ٱلۡبَلَٰغُ ٱلۡمُبِينُ
translation: And we are not responsible except for clear notification
normalizedArabic: وما علينا الا البلغ المبين
normalizedTranslation: and we are not responsible except for clear notification

arabic: قَالُوٓاْ إِنَّا تَطَيَّرۡنَا بِكُمۡۖ لَئِن لَّمۡ تَنتَهُواْ لَنَرۡجُمَنَّكُمۡ وَلَيَمَسَّنَّكُم مِّنَّا عَذَابٌ أَلِيمٞ
translation: They said, "Indeed, we consider you a bad omen. If you do not desist, we will surely stone you, and there will surely touch you, from us, a painful punishment
normalizedArabic: قالوا انا تطيرنا بكم لين لم تنتهوا لنرجمنكم وليمسنكم منا عذاب اليم
normalizedTranslation: they said, "indeed, we consider you a bad omen. if you do not desist, we will surely stone you, and there will surely touch you, from us, a painful punishment

arabic: قَالُواْ طَـٰٓئِرُكُم مَّعَكُمۡ أَئِن ذُكِّرۡتُمۚ بَلۡ أَنتُمۡ قَوۡمٞ مُّسۡرِفُونَ
translation: They said, "Your omen is with yourselves. Is it because you were reminded? Rather, you are a transgressing people
normalizedArabic: قالوا طيركم معكم اين ذكرتم بل انتم قوم مسرفون
normalizedTranslation: they said, "your omen is with yourselves. is it because you were reminded? rather, you are a transgressing people

arabic: وَجَآءَ مِنۡ أَقۡصَا ٱلۡمَدِينَةِ رَجُلٞ يَسۡعَىٰ قَالَ يَٰقَوۡمِ ٱتَّبِعُواْ ٱلۡمُرۡسَلِينَ
translation: And there came from the farthest end of the city a man, running. He said, "O my people, follow the messengers
normalizedArabic: وجاء من اقصا المدينه رجل يسعي قال يقوم اتبعوا المرسلين
normalizedTranslation: and there came from the farthest end of the city a man, running. he said, "o my people, follow the messengers

arabic: ٱتَّبِعُواْ مَن لَّا يَسۡـَٔلُكُمۡ أَجۡرٗا وَهُم مُّهۡتَدُونَ
translation: Follow those who do not ask of you [any] payment, and they are [rightly] guided
normalizedArabic: اتبعوا من لا يسلكم اجرا وهم مهتدون
normalizedTranslation: follow those who do not ask of you [any] payment, and they are [rightly] guided

arabic: وَمَالِيَ لَآ أَعۡبُدُ ٱلَّذِي فَطَرَنِي وَإِلَيۡهِ تُرۡجَعُونَ
translation: And why should I not worship He who created me and to whom you will be returned
normalizedArabic: ومالي لا اعبد الذي فطرني واليه ترجعون
normalizedTranslation: and why should i not worship he who created me and to whom you will be returned

arabic: ءَأَتَّخِذُ مِن دُونِهِۦٓ ءَالِهَةً إِن يُرِدۡنِ ٱلرَّحۡمَٰنُ بِضُرّٖ لَّا تُغۡنِ عَنِّي شَفَٰعَتُهُمۡ شَيۡـٔٗا وَلَا يُنقِذُونِ
translation: Should I take other than Him [false] deities [while], if the Most Merciful intends for me some adversity, their intercession will not avail me at all, nor can they save me
normalizedArabic: ءاتخذ من دونه ءالهه ان يردن الرحمن بضر لا تغن عني شفعتهم شيا ولا ينقذون
normalizedTranslation: should i take other than him [false] deities [while], if the most merciful intends for me some adversity, their intercession will not avail me at all, nor can they save me

arabic: إِنِّيٓ إِذٗا لَّفِي ضَلَٰلٖ مُّبِينٍ
translation: Indeed, I would then be in manifest error
normalizedArabic: اني اذا لفي ضلل مبين
normalizedTranslation: indeed, i would then be in manifest error

arabic: إِنِّيٓ ءَامَنتُ بِرَبِّكُمۡ فَٱسۡمَعُونِ
translation: Indeed, I have believed in your Lord, so listen to me
normalizedArabic: اني ءامنت بربكم فاسمعون
normalizedTranslation: indeed, i have believed in your lord, so listen to me

arabic: قِيلَ ٱدۡخُلِ ٱلۡجَنَّةَۖ قَالَ يَٰلَيۡتَ قَوۡمِي يَعۡلَمُونَ
translation: It was said, "Enter Paradise." He said, "I wish my people could know
normalizedArabic: قيل ادخل الجنه قال يليت قومي يعلمون
normalizedTranslation: it was said, "enter paradise." he said, "i wish my people could know

arabic: بِمَا غَفَرَ لِي رَبِّي وَجَعَلَنِي مِنَ ٱلۡمُكۡرَمِينَ
translation: Of how my Lord has forgiven me and placed me among the honored
normalizedArabic: بما غفر لي ربي وجعلني من المكرمين
normalizedTranslation: of how my lord has forgiven me and placed me among the honored

arabic: ۞وَمَآ أَنزَلۡنَا عَلَىٰ قَوۡمِهِۦ مِنۢ بَعۡدِهِۦ مِن جُندٖ مِّنَ ٱلسَّمَآءِ وَمَا كُنَّا مُنزِلِينَ
translation: And We did not send down upon his people after him any soldiers from the heaven, nor would We have done so
normalizedArabic: وما انزلنا علي قومه من بعده من جند من السماء وما كنا منزلين
normalizedTranslation: and we did not send down upon his people after him any soldiers from the heaven, nor would we have done so

arabic: إِن كَانَتۡ إِلَّا صَيۡحَةٗ وَٰحِدَةٗ فَإِذَا هُمۡ خَٰمِدُونَ
translation: It was not but one shout, and immediately they were extinguished
normalizedArabic: ان كانت الا صيحه وحده فاذا هم خمدون
normalizedTranslation: it was not but one shout, and immediately they were extinguished

arabic: يَٰحَسۡرَةً عَلَى ٱلۡعِبَادِۚ مَا يَأۡتِيهِم مِّن رَّسُولٍ إِلَّا كَانُواْ بِهِۦ يَسۡتَهۡزِءُونَ
translation: How regretful for the servants. There did not come to them any messenger except that they used to ridicule him
normalizedArabic: يحسره علي العباد ما ياتيهم من رسول الا كانوا به يستهزءون
normalizedTranslation: how regretful for the servants. there did not come to them any messenger except that they used to ridicule him

arabic: أَلَمۡ يَرَوۡاْ كَمۡ أَهۡلَكۡنَا قَبۡلَهُم مِّنَ ٱلۡقُرُونِ أَنَّهُمۡ إِلَيۡهِمۡ لَا يَرۡجِعُونَ
translation: Have they not considered how many generations We destroyed before them - that they to them will not return
normalizedArabic: الم يروا كم اهلكنا قبلهم من القرون انهم اليهم لا يرجعون
normalizedTranslation: have they not considered how many generations we destroyed before them - that they to them will not return

arabic: وَإِن كُلّٞ لَّمَّا جَمِيعٞ لَّدَيۡنَا مُحۡضَرُونَ
translation: And indeed, all of them will yet be brought present before Us
normalizedArabic: وان كل لما جميع لدينا محضرون
normalizedTranslation: and indeed, all of them will yet be brought present before us

arabic: وَءَايَةٞ لَّهُمُ ٱلۡأَرۡضُ ٱلۡمَيۡتَةُ أَحۡيَيۡنَٰهَا وَأَخۡرَجۡنَا مِنۡهَا حَبّٗا فَمِنۡهُ يَأۡكُلُونَ
translation: And a sign for them is the dead earth. We have brought it to life and brought forth from it grain, and from it they eat
normalizedArabic: وءايه لهم الارض الميته احيينها واخرجنا منها حبا فمنه ياكلون
normalizedTranslation: and a sign for them is the dead earth. we have brought it to life and brought forth from it grain, and from it they eat

arabic: وَجَعَلۡنَا فِيهَا جَنَّـٰتٖ مِّن نَّخِيلٖ وَأَعۡنَٰبٖ وَفَجَّرۡنَا فِيهَا مِنَ ٱلۡعُيُونِ
translation: And We placed therein gardens of palm trees and grapevines and caused to burst forth therefrom some springs
normalizedArabic: وجعلنا فيها جنت من نخيل واعنب وفجرنا فيها من العيون
normalizedTranslation: and we placed therein gardens of palm trees and grapevines and caused to burst forth therefrom some springs

arabic: لِيَأۡكُلُواْ مِن ثَمَرِهِۦ وَمَا عَمِلَتۡهُ أَيۡدِيهِمۡۚ أَفَلَا يَشۡكُرُونَ
translation: That they may eat of His fruit. And their hands have not produced it, so will they not be grateful
normalizedArabic: لياكلوا من ثمره وما عملته ايديهم افلا يشكرون
normalizedTranslation: that they may eat of his fruit. and their hands have not produced it, so will they not be grateful

arabic: سُبۡحَٰنَ ٱلَّذِي خَلَقَ ٱلۡأَزۡوَٰجَ كُلَّهَا مِمَّا تُنۢبِتُ ٱلۡأَرۡضُ وَمِنۡ أَنفُسِهِمۡ وَمِمَّا لَا يَعۡلَمُونَ
translation: Exalted is He who created all pairs - from what the earth grows and from themselves and from that which they do not know
normalizedArabic: سبحن الذي خلق الازوج كلها مما تنبت الارض ومن انفسهم ومما لا يعلمون
normalizedTranslation: exalted is he who created all pairs - from what the earth grows and from themselves and from that which they do not know

arabic: وَءَايَةٞ لَّهُمُ ٱلَّيۡلُ نَسۡلَخُ مِنۡهُ ٱلنَّهَارَ فَإِذَا هُم مُّظۡلِمُونَ
translation: And a sign for them is the night. We remove from it [the light of] day, so they are [left] in darkness
normalizedArabic: وءايه لهم اليل نسلخ منه النهار فاذا هم مظلمون
normalizedTranslation: and a sign for them is the night. we remove from it [the light of] day, so they are [left] in darkness

arabic: وَٱلشَّمۡسُ تَجۡرِي لِمُسۡتَقَرّٖ لَّهَاۚ ذَٰلِكَ تَقۡدِيرُ ٱلۡعَزِيزِ ٱلۡعَلِيمِ
translation: And the sun runs [on course] toward its stopping point. That is the determination of the Exalted in Might, the Knowing
normalizedArabic: والشمس تجري لمستقر لها ذلك تقدير العزيز العليم
normalizedTranslation: and the sun runs [on course] toward its stopping point. that is the determination of the exalted in might, the knowing

arabic: وَٱلۡقَمَرَ قَدَّرۡنَٰهُ مَنَازِلَ حَتَّىٰ عَادَ كَٱلۡعُرۡجُونِ ٱلۡقَدِيمِ
translation: And the moon - We have determined for it phases, until it returns [appearing] like the old date stalk
normalizedArabic: والقمر قدرنه منازل حتي عاد كالعرجون القديم
normalizedTranslation: and the moon - we have determined for it phases, until it returns [appearing] like the old date stalk

arabic: لَا ٱلشَّمۡسُ يَنۢبَغِي لَهَآ أَن تُدۡرِكَ ٱلۡقَمَرَ وَلَا ٱلَّيۡلُ سَابِقُ ٱلنَّهَارِۚ وَكُلّٞ فِي فَلَكٖ يَسۡبَحُونَ
translation: It is not allowable for the sun to reach the moon, nor does the night overtake the day, but each, in an orbit, is swimming
normalizedArabic: لا الشمس ينبغي لها ان تدرك القمر ولا اليل سابق النهار وكل في فلك يسبحون
normalizedTranslation: it is not allowable for the sun to reach the moon, nor does the night overtake the day, but each, in an orbit, is swimming

arabic: وَءَايَةٞ لَّهُمۡ أَنَّا حَمَلۡنَا ذُرِّيَّتَهُمۡ فِي ٱلۡفُلۡكِ ٱلۡمَشۡحُونِ
translation: And a sign for them is that We carried their forefathers in a laden ship
normalizedArabic: وءايه لهم انا حملنا ذريتهم في الفلك المشحون
normalizedTranslation: and a sign for them is that we carried their forefathers in a laden ship

arabic: وَخَلَقۡنَا لَهُم مِّن مِّثۡلِهِۦ مَا يَرۡكَبُونَ
translation: And We created for them from the likes of it that which they ride
normalizedArabic: وخلقنا لهم من مثله ما يركبون
normalizedTranslation: and we created for them from the likes of it that which they ride

arabic: وَإِن نَّشَأۡ نُغۡرِقۡهُمۡ فَلَا صَرِيخَ لَهُمۡ وَلَا هُمۡ يُنقَذُونَ
translation: And if We should will, We could drown them; then no one responding to a cry would there be for them, nor would they be saved
normalizedArabic: وان نشا نغرقهم فلا صريخ لهم ولا هم ينقذون
normalizedTranslation: and if we should will, we could drown them; then no one responding to a cry would there be for them, nor would they be saved

arabic: إِلَّا رَحۡمَةٗ مِّنَّا وَمَتَٰعًا إِلَىٰ حِينٖ
translation: Except as a mercy from Us and provision for a time
normalizedArabic: الا رحمه منا ومتعا الي حين
normalizedTranslation: except as a mercy from us and provision for a time

arabic: وَإِذَا قِيلَ لَهُمُ ٱتَّقُواْ مَا بَيۡنَ أَيۡدِيكُمۡ وَمَا خَلۡفَكُمۡ لَعَلَّكُمۡ تُرۡحَمُونَ
translation: But when it is said to them, "Beware of what is before you and what is behind you; perhaps you will receive mercy
normalizedArabic: واذا قيل لهم اتقوا ما بين ايديكم وما خلفكم لعلكم ترحمون
normalizedTranslation: but when it is said to them, "beware of what is before you and what is behind you; perhaps you will receive mercy

arabic: وَمَا تَأۡتِيهِم مِّنۡ ءَايَةٖ مِّنۡ ءَايَٰتِ رَبِّهِمۡ إِلَّا كَانُواْ عَنۡهَا مُعۡرِضِينَ
translation: And no sign comes to them from the signs of their Lord except that they are from it turning away
normalizedArabic: وما تاتيهم من ءايه من ءايت ربهم الا كانوا عنها معرضين
normalizedTranslation: and no sign comes to them from the signs of their lord except that they are from it turning away

normalizedArabic: فلولا انه كان من المسبحين
normalizedTranslation: and had he not been of those who exalt allah

arabic: لَلَبِثَ فِي بَطۡنِهِۦٓ إِلَىٰ يَوۡمِ يُبۡعَثُونَ
translation: He would have remained inside its belly until the Day they are resurrected
normalizedArabic: للبث في بطنه الي يوم يبعثون
normalizedTranslation: he would have remained inside its belly until the day they are resurrected

arabic: ۞فَنَبَذۡنَٰهُ بِٱلۡعَرَآءِ وَهُوَ سَقِيمٞ
translation: But We threw him onto the open shore while he was ill
normalizedArabic: فنبذنه بالعراء وهو سقيم
normalizedTranslation: but we threw him onto the open shore while he was ill

arabic: وَأَنۢبَتۡنَا عَلَيۡهِ شَجَرَةٗ مِّن يَقۡطِينٖ
translation: And We caused to grow over him a gourd vine
normalizedArabic: وانبتنا عليه شجره من يقطين
normalizedTranslation: and we caused to grow over him a gourd vine

arabic: وَأَرۡسَلۡنَٰهُ إِلَىٰ مِاْئَةِ أَلۡفٍ أَوۡ يَزِيدُونَ
translation: And We sent him to [his people of] a hundred thousand or more
normalizedArabic: وارسلنه الي مايه الف او يزيدون
normalizedTranslation: and we sent him to [his people of] a hundred thousand or more

arabic: فَـَٔامَنُواْ فَمَتَّعۡنَٰهُمۡ إِلَىٰ حِينٖ
translation: And they believed, so We gave them enjoyment [of life] for a time
normalizedArabic: فامنوا فمتعنهم الي حين
normalizedTranslation: and they believed, so we gave them enjoyment [of life] for a time

arabic: فَٱسۡتَفۡتِهِمۡ أَلِرَبِّكَ ٱلۡبَنَاتُ وَلَهُمُ ٱلۡبَنُونَ
translation: So inquire of them, [O Muhammad], "Does your Lord have daughters while they have sons
normalizedArabic: فاستفتهم الربك البنات ولهم البنون
normalizedTranslation: so inquire of them, [o muhammad], "does your lord have daughters while they have sons

arabic: أَمۡ خَلَقۡنَا ٱلۡمَلَـٰٓئِكَةَ إِنَٰثٗا وَهُمۡ شَٰهِدُونَ
translation: Or did We create the angels as females while they were witnesses
normalizedArabic: ام خلقنا المليكه انثا وهم شهدون
normalizedTranslation: or did we create the angels as females while they were witnesses

arabic: أَلَآ إِنَّهُم مِّنۡ إِفۡكِهِمۡ لَيَقُولُونَ
translation: Unquestionably, it is out of their [invented] falsehood that they say
normalizedArabic: الا انهم من افكهم ليقولون
normalizedTranslation: unquestionably, it is out of their [invented] falsehood that they say

arabic: وَلَدَ ٱللَّهُ وَإِنَّهُمۡ لَكَٰذِبُونَ
translation: Allah has begotten," and indeed, they are liars
normalizedArabic: ولد الله وانهم لكذبون
normalizedTranslation: allah has begotten," and indeed, they are liars

arabic: أَصۡطَفَى ٱلۡبَنَاتِ عَلَى ٱلۡبَنِينَ
translation: Has He chosen daughters over sons
normalizedArabic: اصطفي البنات علي البنين
normalizedTranslation: has he chosen daughters over sons

arabic: مَا لَكُمۡ كَيۡفَ تَحۡكُمُونَ
translation: What is [wrong] with you? How do you make judgement
normalizedArabic: ما لكم كيف تحكمون
normalizedTranslation: what is [wrong] with you? how do you make judgement

arabic: أَفَلَا تَذَكَّرُونَ
translation: Then will you not be reminded
normalizedArabic: افلا تذكرون
normalizedTranslation: then will you not be reminded

arabic: أَمۡ لَكُمۡ سُلۡطَٰنٞ مُّبِينٞ
translation: Or do you have a clear authority
normalizedArabic: ام لكم سلطن مبين
normalizedTranslation: or do you have a clear authority

arabic: فَأۡتُواْ بِكِتَٰبِكُمۡ إِن كُنتُمۡ صَٰدِقِينَ
translation: Then produce your scripture, if you should be truthful
normalizedArabic: فاتوا بكتبكم ان كنتم صدقين
normalizedTranslation: then produce your scripture, if you should be truthful

arabic: وَجَعَلُواْ بَيۡنَهُۥ وَبَيۡنَ ٱلۡجِنَّةِ نَسَبٗاۚ وَلَقَدۡ عَلِمَتِ ٱلۡجِنَّةُ إِنَّهُمۡ لَمُحۡضَرُونَ
translation: And they have claimed between Him and the jinn a lineage, but the jinn have already known that they [who made such claims] will be brought to [punishment]
normalizedArabic: وجعلوا بينه وبين الجنه نسبا ولقد علمت الجنه انهم لمحضرون
normalizedTranslation: and they have claimed between him and the jinn a lineage, but the jinn have already known that they [who made such claims] will be brought to [punishment]

arabic: سُبۡحَٰنَ ٱللَّهِ عَمَّا يَصِفُونَ
translation: Exalted is Allah above what they describe
normalizedArabic: سبحن الله عما يصفون
normalizedTranslation: exalted is allah above what they describe

arabic: إِلَّا عِبَادَ ٱللَّهِ ٱلۡمُخۡلَصِينَ
translation: Except the chosen servants of Allah [who do not share in that sin]
normalizedArabic: الا عباد الله المخلصين
normalizedTranslation: except the chosen servants of allah [who do not share in that sin]

arabic: فَإِنَّكُمۡ وَمَا تَعۡبُدُونَ
translation: So indeed, you [disbelievers] and whatever you worship
normalizedArabic: فانكم وما تعبدون
normalizedTranslation: so indeed, you [disbelievers] and whatever you worship

arabic: مَآ أَنتُمۡ عَلَيۡهِ بِفَٰتِنِينَ
translation: You cannot tempt [anyone] away from Him
normalizedArabic: ما انتم عليه بفتنين
normalizedTranslation: you cannot tempt [anyone] away from him

arabic: إِلَّا مَنۡ هُوَ صَالِ ٱلۡجَحِيمِ
translation: Except he who is to [enter and] burn in the Hellfire
normalizedArabic: الا من هو صال الجحيم
normalizedTranslation: except he who is to [enter and] burn in the hellfire

arabic: وَمَامِنَّآ إِلَّا لَهُۥ مَقَامٞ مَّعۡلُومٞ
translation: [The angels say], "There is not among us any except that he has a known position
normalizedArabic: ومامنا الا له مقام معلوم
normalizedTranslation: [the angels say], "there is not among us any except that he has a known position

arabic: وَإِنَّا لَنَحۡنُ ٱلصَّآفُّونَ
translation: And indeed, we are those who line up [for prayer]
normalizedArabic: وانا لنحن الصافون
normalizedTranslation: and indeed, we are those who line up [for prayer]

arabic: وَإِنَّا لَنَحۡنُ ٱلۡمُسَبِّحُونَ
translation: And indeed, we are those who exalt Allah
normalizedArabic: وانا لنحن المسبحون
normalizedTranslation: and indeed, we are those who exalt allah

arabic: وَإِن كَانُواْ لَيَقُولُونَ
translation: And indeed, the disbelievers used to say
normalizedArabic: وان كانوا ليقولون
normalizedTranslation: and indeed, the disbelievers used to say

arabic: لَوۡ أَنَّ عِندَنَا ذِكۡرٗا مِّنَ ٱلۡأَوَّلِينَ
translation: If we had a message from [those of] the former peoples
normalizedArabic: لو ان عندنا ذكرا من الاولين
normalizedTranslation: if we had a message from [those of] the former peoples

arabic: لَكُنَّا عِبَادَ ٱللَّهِ ٱلۡمُخۡلَصِينَ
translation: We would have been the chosen servants of Allah
normalizedArabic: لكنا عباد الله المخلصين
normalizedTranslation: we would have been the chosen servants of allah

arabic: فَكَفَرُواْ بِهِۦۖ فَسَوۡفَ يَعۡلَمُونَ
translation: But they disbelieved in it, so they are going to know
normalizedArabic: فكفروا به فسوف يعلمون
normalizedTranslation: but they disbelieved in it, so they are going to know

arabic: وَلَقَدۡ سَبَقَتۡ كَلِمَتُنَا لِعِبَادِنَا ٱلۡمُرۡسَلِينَ
translation: And Our word has already preceded for Our servants, the messengers
normalizedArabic: ولقد سبقت كلمتنا لعبادنا المرسلين
normalizedTranslation: and our word has already preceded for our servants, the messengers

arabic: إِنَّهُمۡ لَهُمُ ٱلۡمَنصُورُونَ
translation: [That] indeed, they would be those given victory
normalizedArabic: انهم لهم المنصورون
normalizedTranslation: [that] indeed, they would be those given victory

arabic: وَإِنَّ جُندَنَا لَهُمُ ٱلۡغَٰلِبُونَ
translation: And [that] indeed, Our soldiers will be those who overcome
normalizedArabic: وان جندنا لهم الغلبون
normalizedTranslation: and [that] indeed, our soldiers will be those who overcome

arabic: فَتَوَلَّ عَنۡهُمۡ حَتَّىٰ حِينٖ
translation: So, [O Muhammad], leave them for a time
normalizedArabic: فتول عنهم حتي حين
normalizedTranslation: so, [o muhammad], leave them for a time

arabic: وَأَبۡصِرۡهُمۡ فَسَوۡفَ يُبۡصِرُونَ
translation: And see [what will befall] them, for they are going to see
normalizedArabic: وابصرهم فسوف يبصرون
normalizedTranslation: and see [what will befall] them, for they are going to see

arabic: أَفَبِعَذَابِنَا يَسۡتَعۡجِلُونَ
translation: Then for Our punishment are they impatient
normalizedArabic: افبعذابنا يستعجلون
normalizedTranslation: then for our punishment are they impatient

arabic: فَإِذَا نَزَلَ بِسَاحَتِهِمۡ فَسَآءَ صَبَاحُ ٱلۡمُنذَرِينَ
translation: But when it descends in their territory, then evil is the morning of those who were warned
normalizedArabic: فاذا نزل بساحتهم فساء صباح المنذرين
normalizedTranslation: but when it descends in their territory, then evil is the morning of those who were warned

arabic: وَتَوَلَّ عَنۡهُمۡ حَتَّىٰ حِينٖ
translation: And leave them for a time
normalizedArabic: وتول عنهم حتي حين
normalizedTranslation: and leave them for a time

arabic: وَأَبۡصِرۡ فَسَوۡفَ يُبۡصِرُونَ
translation: And see, for they are going to see
normalizedArabic: وابصر فسوف يبصرون
normalizedTranslation: and see, for they are going to see

arabic: سُبۡحَٰنَ رَبِّكَ رَبِّ ٱلۡعِزَّةِ عَمَّا يَصِفُونَ
translation: Exalted is your Lord, the Lord of might, above what they describe
normalizedArabic: سبحن ربك رب العزه عما يصفون
normalizedTranslation: exalted is your lord, the lord of might, above what they describe

arabic: وَسَلَٰمٌ عَلَى ٱلۡمُرۡسَلِينَ
translation: And peace upon the messengers
normalizedArabic: وسلم علي المرسلين
normalizedTranslation: and peace upon the messengers

arabic: وَٱلۡحَمۡدُ لِلَّهِ رَبِّ ٱلۡعَٰلَمِينَ
translation: And praise to Allah, Lord of the worlds
normalizedArabic: والحمد لله رب العلمين
normalizedTranslation: and praise to allah, lord of the worlds

arabic: صٓۚ وَٱلۡقُرۡءَانِ ذِي ٱلذِّكۡرِ
translation: Sad. By the Qur'an containing reminder
normalizedArabic: ص والقرءان ذي الذكر
normalizedTranslation: sad. by the qur'an containing reminder

arabic: بَلِ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُواْ فِي عِزَّةٖ وَشِقَاقٖ
translation: But those who disbelieve are in pride and dissension
normalizedArabic: بل الذين كفروا في عزه وشقاق
normalizedTranslation: but those who disbelieve are in pride and dissension

arabic: كَمۡ أَهۡلَكۡنَا مِن قَبۡلِهِم مِّن قَرۡنٖ فَنَادَواْ وَّلَاتَ حِينَ مَنَاصٖ
translation: How many a generation have We destroyed before them, and they [then] called out; but it was not a time for escape
normalizedArabic: كم اهلكنا من قبلهم من قرن فنادوا ولات حين مناص
normalizedTranslation: how many a generation have we destroyed before them, and they [then] called out; but it was not a time for escape

arabic: وَعَجِبُوٓاْ أَن جَآءَهُم مُّنذِرٞ مِّنۡهُمۡۖ وَقَالَ ٱلۡكَٰفِرُونَ هَٰذَا سَٰحِرٞ كَذَّابٌ
translation: And they wonder that there has come to them a warner from among themselves. And the disbelievers say, "This is a magician and a liar
normalizedArabic: وعجبوا ان جاءهم منذر منهم وقال الكفرون هذا سحر كذاب
normalizedTranslation: and they wonder that there has come to them a warner from among themselves. and the disbelievers say, "this is a magician and a liar

arabic: أَجَعَلَ ٱلۡأٓلِهَةَ إِلَٰهٗا وَٰحِدًاۖ إِنَّ هَٰذَا لَشَيۡءٌ عُجَابٞ
translation: Has he made the gods [only] one God? Indeed, this is a curious thing
normalizedArabic: اجعل الالهه الها وحدا ان هذا لشيء عجاب
normalizedTranslation: has he made the gods [only] one god? indeed, this is a curious thing

arabic: وَٱنطَلَقَ ٱلۡمَلَأُ مِنۡهُمۡ أَنِ ٱمۡشُواْ وَٱصۡبِرُواْ عَلَىٰٓ ءَالِهَتِكُمۡۖ إِنَّ هَٰذَا لَشَيۡءٞ يُرَادُ
translation: And the eminent among them went forth, [saying], "Continue, and be patient over [the defense of] your gods. Indeed, this is a thing intended
normalizedArabic: وانطلق الملا منهم ان امشوا واصبروا علي ءالهتكم ان هذا لشيء يراد
normalizedTranslation: and the eminent among them went forth, [saying], "continue, and be patient over [the defense of] your gods. indeed, this is a thing intended

arabic: مَا سَمِعۡنَا بِهَٰذَا فِي ٱلۡمِلَّةِ ٱلۡأٓخِرَةِ إِنۡ هَٰذَآ إِلَّا ٱخۡتِلَٰقٌ
translation: We have not heard of this in the latest religion. This is not but a fabrication
normalizedArabic: ما سمعنا بهذا في المله الاخره ان هذا الا اختلق
normalizedTranslation: we have not heard of this in the latest religion. this is not but a fabrication

arabic: أَءُنزِلَ عَلَيۡهِ ٱلذِّكۡرُ مِنۢ بَيۡنِنَاۚ بَلۡ هُمۡ فِي شَكّٖ مِّن ذِكۡرِيۚ بَل لَّمَّا يَذُوقُواْ عَذَابِ
translation: Has the message been revealed to him out of [all of] us?" Rather, they are in doubt about My message. Rather, they have not yet tasted My punishment
normalizedArabic: اءنزل عليه الذكر من بيننا بل هم في شك من ذكري بل لما يذوقوا عذاب
normalizedTranslation: has the message been revealed to him out of [all of] us?" rather, they are in doubt about my message. rather, they have not yet tasted my punishment

arabic: أَمۡ عِندَهُمۡ خَزَآئِنُ رَحۡمَةِ رَبِّكَ ٱلۡعَزِيزِ ٱلۡوَهَّابِ
translation: Or do they have the depositories of the mercy of your Lord, the Exalted in Might, the Bestower
normalizedArabic: ام عندهم خزاين رحمه ربك العزيز الوهاب
normalizedTranslation: or do they have the depositories of the mercy of your lord, the exalted in might, the bestower

arabic: أَمۡ لَهُم مُّلۡكُ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلۡأَرۡضِ وَمَا بَيۡنَهُمَاۖ فَلۡيَرۡتَقُواْ فِي ٱلۡأَسۡبَٰبِ
translation: Or is theirs the dominion of the heavens and the earth and what is between them? Then let them ascend through [any] ways of access
normalizedArabic: ام لهم ملك السموت والارض وما بينهما فليرتقوا في الاسبب
normalizedTranslation: or is theirs the dominion of the heavens and the earth and what is between them? then let them ascend through [any] ways of access

arabic: جُندٞ مَّا هُنَالِكَ مَهۡزُومٞ مِّنَ ٱلۡأَحۡزَابِ
translation: [They are but] soldiers [who will be] defeated there among the companies [of disbelievers]
normalizedArabic: جند ما هنالك مهزوم من الاحزاب
normalizedTranslation: [they are but] soldiers [who will be] defeated there among the companies [of disbelievers]

arabic: كَذَّبَتۡ قَبۡلَهُمۡ قَوۡمُ نُوحٖ وَعَادٞ وَفِرۡعَوۡنُ ذُو ٱلۡأَوۡتَادِ
translation: The people of Noah denied before them, and [the tribe of] 'Aad and Pharaoh, the owner of stakes
normalizedArabic: كذبت قبلهم قوم نوح وعاد وفرعون ذو الاوتاد
normalizedTranslation: the people of noah denied before them, and [the tribe of] 'aad and pharaoh, the owner of stakes

arabic: وَثَمُودُ وَقَوۡمُ لُوطٖ وَأَصۡحَٰبُ لۡـَٔيۡكَةِۚ أُوْلَـٰٓئِكَ ٱلۡأَحۡزَابُ
translation: And [the tribe of] Thamud and the people of Lot and the companions of the thicket. Those are the companies
normalizedArabic: وثمود وقوم لوط واصحب ليكه اوليك الاحزاب
normalizedTranslation: and [the tribe of] thamud and the people of lot and the companions of the thicket. those are the companies

arabic: إِن كُلٌّ إِلَّا كَذَّبَ ٱلرُّسُلَ فَحَقَّ عِقَابِ
translation: Each of them denied the messengers, so My penalty was justified
normalizedArabic: ان كل الا كذب الرسل فحق عقاب
normalizedTranslation: each of them denied the messengers, so my penalty was justified

arabic: وَمَا يَنظُرُ هَـٰٓؤُلَآءِ إِلَّا صَيۡحَةٗ وَٰحِدَةٗ مَّا لَهَا مِن فَوَاقٖ
translation: And these [disbelievers] await not but one blast [of the Horn]; for it there will be no delay
normalizedArabic: وما ينظر هولاء الا صيحه وحده ما لها من فواق
normalizedTranslation: and these [disbelievers] await not but one blast [of the horn]; for it there will be no delay

arabic: وَقَالُواْ رَبَّنَا عَجِّل لَّنَا قِطَّنَا قَبۡلَ يَوۡمِ ٱلۡحِسَابِ
translation: And they say, "Our Lord, hasten for us our share [of the punishment] before the Day of Account
normalizedArabic: وقالوا ربنا عجل لنا قطنا قبل يوم الحساب
normalizedTranslation: and they say, "our lord, hasten for us our share [of the punishment] before the day of account

arabic: ٱصۡبِرۡ عَلَىٰ مَا يَقُولُونَ وَٱذۡكُرۡ عَبۡدَنَا دَاوُۥدَ ذَا ٱلۡأَيۡدِۖ إِنَّهُۥٓ أَوَّابٌ
translation: Be patient over what they say and remember Our servant, David, the possessor of strength; indeed, he was one who repeatedly turned back [to Allah]
normalizedArabic: اصبر علي ما يقولون واذكر عبدنا داود ذا الايد انه اواب
normalizedTranslation: be patient over what they say and remember our servant, david, the possessor of strength; indeed, he was one who repeatedly turned back [to allah]

arabic: إِنَّا سَخَّرۡنَا ٱلۡجِبَالَ مَعَهُۥ يُسَبِّحۡنَ بِٱلۡعَشِيِّ وَٱلۡإِشۡرَاقِ
translation: Indeed, We subjected the mountains [to praise] with him, exalting [Allah] in the [late] afternoon and [after] sunrise

normalizedTranslation: indeed, we subjected the mountains [to praise] with him, exalting [allah] in the [late] afternoon and [after] sunrise

arabic: وَٱلطَّيۡرَ مَحۡشُورَةٗۖ كُلّٞ لَّهُۥٓ أَوَّابٞ
translation: And the birds were assembled, all with him repeating [praises]
normalizedArabic: والطير محشوره كل له اواب
normalizedTranslation: and the birds were assembled, all with him repeating [praises]

arabic: وَشَدَدۡنَا مُلۡكَهُۥ وَءَاتَيۡنَٰهُ ٱلۡحِكۡمَةَ وَفَصۡلَ ٱلۡخِطَابِ

arabic: ۞وَإِذَا مَسَّ ٱلۡإِنسَٰنَ ضُرّٞ دَعَا رَبَّهُۥ مُنِيبًا إِلَيۡهِ ثُمَّ إِذَا خَوَّلَهُۥ نِعۡمَةٗ مِّنۡهُ نَسِيَ مَا كَانَ يَدۡعُوٓاْ إِلَيۡهِ مِن قَبۡلُ وَجَعَلَ لِلَّهِ أَندَادٗا لِّيُضِلَّ عَن سَبِيلِهِۦۚ قُلۡ تَمَتَّعۡ بِكُفۡرِكَ قَلِيلًا إِنَّكَ مِنۡ أَصۡحَٰبِ ٱلنَّارِ
translation: And when adversity touches man, he calls upon his Lord, turning to Him [alone]; then when He bestows on him a favor from Himself, he forgets Him whom he called upon before, and he attributes to Allah equals to mislead [people] from His way. Say, "Enjoy your disbelief for a little; indeed, you are of the companions of the Fire
normalizedArabic: واذا مس الانسن ضر دعا ربه منيبا اليه ثم اذا خوله نعمه منه نسي ما كان يدعوا اليه من قبل وجعل لله اندادا ليضل عن سبيله قل تمتع بكفرك قليلا انك من اصحب النار
normalizedTranslation: and when adversity touches man, he calls upon his lord, turning to him [alone]; then when he bestows on him a favor from himself, he forgets him whom he called upon before, and he attributes to allah equals to mislead [people] from his way. say, "enjoy your disbelief for a little; indeed, you are of the companions of the fire

arabic: أَمَّنۡ هُوَ قَٰنِتٌ ءَانَآءَ ٱلَّيۡلِ سَاجِدٗا وَقَآئِمٗا يَحۡذَرُ ٱلۡأٓخِرَةَ وَيَرۡجُواْ رَحۡمَةَ رَبِّهِۦۗ قُلۡ هَلۡ يَسۡتَوِي ٱلَّذِينَ يَعۡلَمُونَ وَٱلَّذِينَ لَا يَعۡلَمُونَۗ إِنَّمَا يَتَذَكَّرُ أُوْلُواْ ٱلۡأَلۡبَٰبِ
translation: Is one who is devoutly obedient during periods of the night, prostrating and standing [in prayer], fearing the Hereafter and hoping for the mercy of his Lord, [like one who does not]? Say, "Are those who know equal to those who do not know?" Only they will remember [who are] people of understanding
normalizedArabic: امن هو قنت ءاناء اليل ساجدا وقايما يحذر الاخره ويرجوا رحمه ربه قل هل يستوي الذين يعلمون والذين لا يعلمون انما يتذكر اولوا الالبب
normalizedTranslation: is one who is devoutly obedient during periods of the night, prostrating and standing [in prayer], fearing the hereafter and hoping for the mercy of his lord, [like one who does not]? say, "are those who know equal to those who do not know?" only they will remember [who are] people of understanding

arabic: قُلۡ يَٰعِبَادِ ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُواْ ٱتَّقُواْ رَبَّكُمۡۚ لِلَّذِينَ أَحۡسَنُواْ فِي هَٰذِهِ ٱلدُّنۡيَا حَسَنَةٞۗ وَأَرۡضُ ٱللَّهِ وَٰسِعَةٌۗ إِنَّمَا يُوَفَّى ٱلصَّـٰبِرُونَ أَجۡرَهُم بِغَيۡرِ حِسَابٖ
translation: Say, "O My servants who have believed, fear your Lord. For those who do good in this world is good, and the earth of Allah is spacious. Indeed, the patient will be given their reward without account
normalizedArabic: قل يعباد الذين ءامنوا اتقوا ربكم للذين احسنوا في هذه الدنيا حسنه وارض الله وسعه انما يوفي الصبرون اجرهم بغير حساب
normalizedTranslation: say, "o my servants who have believed, fear your lord. for those who do good in this world is good, and the earth of allah is spacious. indeed, the patient will be given their reward without account

arabic: قُلۡ إِنِّيٓ أُمِرۡتُ أَنۡ أَعۡبُدَ ٱللَّهَ مُخۡلِصٗا لَّهُ ٱلدِّينَ
translation: Say, [O Muhammad], "Indeed, I have been commanded to worship Allah, [being] sincere to Him in religion
normalizedArabic: قل اني امرت ان اعبد الله مخلصا له الدين
normalizedTranslation: say, [o muhammad], "indeed, i have been commanded to worship allah, [being] sincere to him in religion

arabic: وَأُمِرۡتُ لِأَنۡ أَكُونَ أَوَّلَ ٱلۡمُسۡلِمِينَ
translation: And I have been commanded to be the first [among you] of the Muslims
normalizedArabic: وامرت لان اكون اول المسلمين
normalizedTranslation: and i have been commanded to be the first [among you] of the muslims

arabic: قُلۡ إِنِّيٓ أَخَافُ إِنۡ عَصَيۡتُ رَبِّي عَذَابَ يَوۡمٍ عَظِيمٖ
translation: Say, "Indeed I fear, if I should disobey my Lord, the punishment of a tremendous Day
normalizedArabic: قل اني اخاف ان عصيت ربي عذاب يوم عظيم
normalizedTranslation: say, "indeed i fear, if i should disobey my lord, the punishment of a tremendous day

arabic: قُلِ ٱللَّهَ أَعۡبُدُ مُخۡلِصٗا لَّهُۥ دِينِي
translation: Say, "Allah [alone] do I worship, sincere to Him in my religion
normalizedArabic: قل الله اعبد مخلصا له ديني
normalizedTranslation: say, "allah [alone] do i worship, sincere to him in my religion

arabic: فَٱعۡبُدُواْ مَا شِئۡتُم مِّن دُونِهِۦۗ قُلۡ إِنَّ ٱلۡخَٰسِرِينَ ٱلَّذِينَ خَسِرُوٓاْ أَنفُسَهُمۡ وَأَهۡلِيهِمۡ يَوۡمَ ٱلۡقِيَٰمَةِۗ أَلَا ذَٰلِكَ هُوَ ٱلۡخُسۡرَانُ ٱلۡمُبِينُ
translation: So worship what you will besides Him." Say, "Indeed, the losers are the ones who will lose themselves and their families on the Day of Resurrection. Unquestionably, that is the manifest loss
normalizedArabic: فاعبدوا ما شيتم من دونه قل ان الخسرين الذين خسروا انفسهم واهليهم يوم القيمه الا ذلك هو الخسران المبين
normalizedTranslation: so worship what you will besides him." say, "indeed, the losers are the ones who will lose themselves and their families on the day of resurrection. unquestionably, that is the manifest loss

arabic: لَهُم مِّن فَوۡقِهِمۡ ظُلَلٞ مِّنَ ٱلنَّارِ وَمِن تَحۡتِهِمۡ ظُلَلٞۚ ذَٰلِكَ يُخَوِّفُ ٱللَّهُ بِهِۦ عِبَادَهُۥۚ يَٰعِبَادِ فَٱتَّقُونِ
translation: They will have canopies of fire above them and below them, canopies. By that Allah threatens His servants. O My servants, then fear Me
normalizedArabic: لهم من فوقهم ظلل من النار ومن تحتهم ظلل ذلك يخوف الله به عباده يعباد فاتقون
normalizedTranslation: they will have canopies of fire above them and below them, canopies. by that allah threatens his servants. o my servants, then fear me

arabic: وَٱلَّذِينَ ٱجۡتَنَبُواْ ٱلطَّـٰغُوتَ أَن يَعۡبُدُوهَا وَأَنَابُوٓاْ إِلَى ٱللَّهِ لَهُمُ ٱلۡبُشۡرَىٰۚ فَبَشِّرۡ عِبَادِ
translation: But those who have avoided Taghut, lest they worship it, and turned back to Allah - for them are good tidings. So give good tidings to My servants
normalizedArabic: والذين اجتنبوا الطغوت ان يعبدوها وانابوا الي الله لهم البشري فبشر عباد
normalizedTranslation: but those who have avoided taghut, lest they worship it, and turned back to allah - for them are good tidings. so give good tidings to my servants

arabic: ٱلَّذِينَ يَسۡتَمِعُونَ ٱلۡقَوۡلَ فَيَتَّبِعُونَ أَحۡسَنَهُۥٓۚ أُوْلَـٰٓئِكَ ٱلَّذِينَ هَدَىٰهُمُ ٱللَّهُۖ وَأُوْلَـٰٓئِكَ هُمۡ أُوْلُواْ ٱلۡأَلۡبَٰبِ
translation: Who listen to speech and follow the best of it. Those are the ones Allah has guided, and those are people of understanding
normalizedArabic: الذين يستمعون القول فيتبعون احسنه اوليك الذين هديهم الله واوليك هم اولوا الالبب
normalizedTranslation: who listen to speech and follow the best of it. those are the ones allah has guided, and those are people of understanding

arabic: أَفَمَنۡ حَقَّ عَلَيۡهِ كَلِمَةُ ٱلۡعَذَابِ أَفَأَنتَ تُنقِذُ مَن فِي ٱلنَّارِ
translation: Then, is one who has deserved the decree of punishment [to be guided]? Then, can you save one who is in the Fire
normalizedArabic: افمن حق عليه كلمه العذاب افانت تنقذ من في النار
normalizedTranslation: then, is one who has deserved the decree of punishment [to be guided]? then, can you save one who is in the fire

arabic: لَٰكِنِ ٱلَّذِينَ ٱتَّقَوۡاْ رَبَّهُمۡ لَهُمۡ غُرَفٞ مِّن فَوۡقِهَا غُرَفٞ مَّبۡنِيَّةٞ تَجۡرِي مِن تَحۡتِهَا ٱلۡأَنۡهَٰرُۖ وَعۡدَ ٱللَّهِ لَا يُخۡلِفُ ٱللَّهُ ٱلۡمِيعَادَ
translation: But those who have feared their Lord - for them are chambers, above them chambers built high, beneath which rivers flow. [This is] the promise of Allah. Allah does not fail in [His] promise
normalizedArabic: لكن الذين اتقوا ربهم لهم غرف من فوقها غرف مبنيه تجري من تحتها الانهر وعد الله لا يخلف الله الميعاد
normalizedTranslation: but those who have feared their lord - for them are chambers, above them chambers built high, beneath which rivers flow. [this is] the promise of allah. allah does not fail in [his] promise

arabic: أَلَمۡ تَرَ أَنَّ ٱللَّهَ أَنزَلَ مِنَ ٱلسَّمَآءِ مَآءٗ فَسَلَكَهُۥ يَنَٰبِيعَ فِي ٱلۡأَرۡضِ ثُمَّ يُخۡرِجُ بِهِۦ زَرۡعٗا مُّخۡتَلِفًا أَلۡوَٰنُهُۥ ثُمَّ يَهِيجُ فَتَرَىٰهُ مُصۡفَرّٗا ثُمَّ يَجۡعَلُهُۥ حُطَٰمًاۚ إِنَّ فِي ذَٰلِكَ لَذِكۡرَىٰ لِأُوْلِي ٱلۡأَلۡبَٰبِ
translation: Do you not see that Allah sends down rain from the sky and makes it flow as springs [and rivers] in the earth; then He produces thereby crops of varying colors; then they dry and you see them turned yellow; then He makes them [scattered] debris. Indeed in that is a reminder for those of understanding
normalizedArabic: الم تر ان الله انزل من السماء ماء فسلكه ينبيع في الارض ثم يخرج به زرعا مختلفا الونه ثم يهيج فتريه مصفرا ثم يجعله حطما ان في ذلك لذكري لاولي الالبب
normalizedTranslation: do you not see that allah sends down rain from the sky and makes it flow as springs [and rivers] in the earth; then he produces thereby crops of varying colors; then they dry and you see them turned yellow; then he makes them [scattered] debris. indeed in that is a reminder for those of understanding

arabic: أَفَمَن شَرَحَ ٱللَّهُ صَدۡرَهُۥ لِلۡإِسۡلَٰمِ فَهُوَ عَلَىٰ نُورٖ مِّن رَّبِّهِۦۚ فَوَيۡلٞ لِّلۡقَٰسِيَةِ قُلُوبُهُم مِّن ذِكۡرِ ٱللَّهِۚ أُوْلَـٰٓئِكَ فِي ضَلَٰلٖ مُّبِينٍ
translation: So is one whose breast Allah has expanded to [accept] Islam and he is upon a light from his Lord [like one whose heart rejects it]? Then woe to those whose hearts are hardened against the remembrance of Allah. Those are in manifest error
normalizedArabic: افمن شرح الله صدره للاسلم فهو علي نور من ربه فويل للقسيه قلوبهم من ذكر الله اوليك في ضلل مبين
normalizedTranslation: so is one whose breast allah has expanded to [accept] islam and he is upon a light from his lord [like one whose heart rejects it]? then woe to those whose hearts are hardened against the remembrance of allah. those are in manifest error

arabic: ٱللَّهُ نَزَّلَ أَحۡسَنَ ٱلۡحَدِيثِ كِتَٰبٗا مُّتَشَٰبِهٗا مَّثَانِيَ تَقۡشَعِرُّ مِنۡهُ جُلُودُ ٱلَّذِينَ يَخۡشَوۡنَ رَبَّهُمۡ ثُمَّ تَلِينُ جُلُودُهُمۡ وَقُلُوبُهُمۡ إِلَىٰ ذِكۡرِ ٱللَّهِۚ ذَٰلِكَ هُدَى ٱللَّهِ يَهۡدِي بِهِۦ مَن يَشَآءُۚ وَمَن يُضۡلِلِ ٱللَّهُ فَمَا لَهُۥ مِنۡ هَادٍ
translation: Allah has sent down the best statement: a consistent Book wherein is reiteration. The skins shiver therefrom of those who fear their Lord; then their skins and their hearts relax at the remembrance of Allah. That is the guidance of Allah by which He guides whom He wills. And one whom Allah leaves astray - for him there is no guide
normalizedArabic: الله نزل احسن الحديث كتبا متشبها مثاني تقشعر منه جلود الذين يخشون ربهم ثم تلين جلودهم وقلوبهم الي ذكر الله ذلك هدي الله يهدي به من يشاء ومن يضلل الله فما له من هاد
normalizedTranslation: allah has sent down the best statement: a consistent book wherein is reiteration. the skins shiver therefrom of those who fear their lord; then their skins and their hearts relax at the remembrance of allah. that is the guidance of allah by which he guides whom he wills. and one whom allah leaves astray - for him there is no guide

arabic: أَفَمَن يَتَّقِي بِوَجۡهِهِۦ سُوٓءَ ٱلۡعَذَابِ يَوۡمَ ٱلۡقِيَٰمَةِۚ وَقِيلَ لِلظَّـٰلِمِينَ ذُوقُواْ مَا كُنتُمۡ تَكۡسِبُونَ
translation: Then is he who will shield with his face the worst of the punishment on the Day of Resurrection [like one secure from it]? And it will be said to the wrongdoers, "Taste what you used to earn
normalizedArabic: افمن يتقي بوجهه سوء العذاب يوم القيمه وقيل للظلمين ذوقوا ما كنتم تكسبون
normalizedTranslation: then is he who will shield with his face the worst of the punishment on the day of resurrection [like one secure from it]? and it will be said to the wrongdoers, "taste what you used to earn

arabic: كَذَّبَ ٱلَّذِينَ مِن قَبۡلِهِمۡ فَأَتَىٰهُمُ ٱلۡعَذَابُ مِنۡ حَيۡثُ لَا يَشۡعُرُونَ
translation: Those before them denied, and punishment came upon them from where they did not perceive
normalizedArabic: كذب الذين من قبلهم فاتيهم العذاب من حيث لا يشعرون
normalizedTranslation: those before them denied, and punishment came upon them from where they did not perceive

arabic: فَأَذَاقَهُمُ ٱللَّهُ ٱلۡخِزۡيَ فِي ٱلۡحَيَوٰةِ ٱلدُّنۡيَاۖ وَلَعَذَابُ ٱلۡأٓخِرَةِ أَكۡبَرُۚ لَوۡ كَانُواْ يَعۡلَمُونَ
translation: So Allah made them taste disgrace in worldly life. But the punishment of the Hereafter is greater, if they only knew
normalizedArabic: فاذاقهم الله الخزي في الحيوه الدنيا ولعذاب الاخره اكبر لو كانوا يعلمون
normalizedTranslation: so allah made them taste disgrace in worldly life. but the punishment of the hereafter is greater, if they only knew

arabic: وَلَقَدۡ ضَرَبۡنَا لِلنَّاسِ فِي هَٰذَا ٱلۡقُرۡءَانِ مِن كُلِّ مَثَلٖ لَّعَلَّهُمۡ يَتَذَكَّرُونَ
translation: And We have certainly presented for the people in this Qur'an from every [kind of] example - that they might remember
normalizedArabic: ولقد ضربنا للناس في هذا القرءان من كل مثل لعلهم يتذكرون
normalizedTranslation: and we have certainly presented for the people in this qur'an from every [kind of] example - that they might remember

arabic: قُرۡءَانًا عَرَبِيًّا غَيۡرَ ذِي عِوَجٖ لَّعَلَّهُمۡ يَتَّقُونَ
translation: [It is] an Arabic Qur'an, without any deviance that they might become righteous
normalizedArabic: قرءانا عربيا غير ذي عوج لعلهم يتقون
normalizedTranslation: [it is] an arabic qur'an, without any deviance that they might become righteous

arabic: ضَرَبَ ٱللَّهُ مَثَلٗا رَّجُلٗا فِيهِ شُرَكَآءُ مُتَشَٰكِسُونَ وَرَجُلٗا سَلَمٗا لِّرَجُلٍ هَلۡ يَسۡتَوِيَانِ مَثَلًاۚ ٱلۡحَمۡدُ لِلَّهِۚ بَلۡ أَكۡثَرُهُمۡ لَا يَعۡلَمُونَ
translation: Allah presents an example: a slave owned by quarreling partners and another belonging exclusively to one man - are they equal in comparison? Praise be to Allah! But most of them do not know
normalizedArabic: ضرب الله مثلا رجلا فيه شركاء متشكسون ورجلا سلما لرجل هل يستويان مثلا الحمد لله بل اكثرهم لا يعلمون
normalizedTranslation: allah presents an example: a slave owned by quarreling partners and another belonging exclusively to one man - are they equal in comparison? praise be to allah! but most of them do not know

arabic: إِنَّكَ مَيِّتٞ وَإِنَّهُم مَّيِّتُونَ
translation: Indeed, you are to die, and indeed, they are to die
normalizedArabic: انك ميت وانهم ميتون
normalizedTranslation: indeed, you are to die, and indeed, they are to die

arabic: ثُمَّ إِنَّكُمۡ يَوۡمَ ٱلۡقِيَٰمَةِ عِندَ رَبِّكُمۡ تَخۡتَصِمُونَ
translation: Then indeed you, on the Day of Resurrection, before your Lord, will dispute
normalizedArabic: ثم انكم يوم القيمه عند ربكم تختصمون
normalizedTranslation: then indeed you, on the day of resurrection, before your lord, will dispute

arabic: ۞فَمَنۡ أَظۡلَمُ مِمَّن كَذَبَ عَلَى ٱللَّهِ وَكَذَّبَ بِٱلصِّدۡقِ إِذۡ جَآءَهُۥٓۚ أَلَيۡسَ فِي جَهَنَّمَ مَثۡوٗى لِّلۡكَٰفِرِينَ
translation: So who is more unjust than one who lies about Allah and denies the truth when it has come to him? Is there not in Hell a residence for the disbelievers
normalizedArabic: فمن اظلم ممن كذب علي الله وكذب بالصدق اذ جاءه اليس في جهنم مثوي للكفرين
normalizedTranslation: so who is more unjust than one who lies about allah and denies the truth when it has come to him? is there not in hell a residence for the disbelievers

arabic: وَٱلَّذِي جَآءَ بِٱلصِّدۡقِ وَصَدَّقَ بِهِۦٓ أُوْلَـٰٓئِكَ هُمُ ٱلۡمُتَّقُونَ
translation: And the one who has brought the truth and [they who] believed in it - those are the righteous
normalizedArabic: والذي جاء بالصدق وصدق به اوليك هم المتقون
normalizedTranslation: and the one who has brought the truth and [they who] believed in it - those are the righteous

arabic: لَهُم مَّا يَشَآءُونَ عِندَ رَبِّهِمۡۚ ذَٰلِكَ جَزَآءُ ٱلۡمُحۡسِنِينَ
translation: They will have whatever they desire with their Lord. That is the reward of the doers of good
normalizedArabic: لهم ما يشاءون عند ربهم ذلك جزاء المحسنين
normalizedTranslation: they will have whatever they desire with their lord. that is the reward of the doers of good

arabic: لِيُكَفِّرَ ٱللَّهُ عَنۡهُمۡ أَسۡوَأَ ٱلَّذِي عَمِلُواْ وَيَجۡزِيَهُمۡ أَجۡرَهُم بِأَحۡسَنِ ٱلَّذِي كَانُواْ يَعۡمَلُونَ
translation: That Allah may remove from them the worst of what they did and reward them their due for the best of what they used to do

arabic: أَلَيۡسَ ٱللَّهُ بِكَافٍ عَبۡدَهُۥۖ وَيُخَوِّفُونَكَ بِٱلَّذِينَ مِن دُونِهِۦۚ وَمَن يُضۡلِلِ ٱللَّهُ فَمَا لَهُۥ مِنۡ هَادٖ

normalizedTranslation: is not allah sufficient for his servant [prophet muhammad]? and [yet], they threaten you with those [they worship] other than him. and whoever allah leaves astray - for him there is no guide

arabic: وَمَن يَهۡدِ ٱللَّهُ فَمَا لَهُۥ مِن مُّضِلٍّۗ أَلَيۡسَ ٱللَّهُ بِعَزِيزٖ ذِي ٱنتِقَامٖ

arabic: وَلَئِن سَأَلۡتَهُم مَّنۡ خَلَقَ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلۡأَرۡضَ لَيَقُولُنَّ ٱللَّهُۚ قُلۡ أَفَرَءَيۡتُم مَّا تَدۡعُونَ مِن دُونِ ٱللَّهِ إِنۡ أَرَادَنِيَ ٱللَّهُ بِضُرٍّ هَلۡ هُنَّ كَٰشِفَٰتُ ضُرِّهِۦٓ أَوۡ أَرَادَنِي بِرَحۡمَةٍ هَلۡ هُنَّ مُمۡسِكَٰتُ رَحۡمَتِهِۦۚ قُلۡ حَسۡبِيَ ٱللَّهُۖ عَلَيۡهِ يَتَوَكَّلُ ٱلۡمُتَوَكِّلُونَ
translation: And if you asked them, "Who created the heavens and the earth?" they would surely say, "Allah." Say, "Then have you considered what you invoke besides Allah? If Allah intended me harm, are they removers of His harm; or if He intended me mercy, are they withholders of His mercy?" Say, "Sufficient for me is Allah; upon Him [alone] rely the [wise] reliers
normalizedArabic: ولين سالتهم من خلق السموت والارض ليقولن الله قل افرءيتم ما تدعون من دون الله ان ارادني الله بضر هل هن كشفت ضره او ارادني برحمه هل هن ممسكت رحمته قل حسبي الله عليه يتوكل المتوكلون

arabic: قُلۡ يَٰقَوۡمِ ٱعۡمَلُواْ عَلَىٰ مَكَانَتِكُمۡ إِنِّي عَٰمِلٞۖ فَسَوۡفَ تَعۡلَمُونَ
translation: Say, "O my people, work according to your position, [for] indeed, I am working; and you are going to know

normalizedTranslation: say, "o my people, work according to your position, [for] indeed, i am working; and you are going to know

arabic: مَن يَأۡتِيهِ عَذَابٞ يُخۡزِيهِ وَيَحِلُّ عَلَيۡهِ عَذَابٞ مُّقِيمٌ
translation: To whom will come a torment disgracing him and on whom will descend an enduring punishment
normalizedArabic: من ياتيه عذاب يخزيه ويحل عليه عذاب مقيم
normalizedTranslation: to whom will come a torment disgracing him and on whom will descend an enduring punishment

arabic: إِنَّآ أَنزَلۡنَا عَلَيۡكَ ٱلۡكِتَٰبَ لِلنَّاسِ بِٱلۡحَقِّۖ فَمَنِ ٱهۡتَدَىٰ فَلِنَفۡسِهِۦۖ وَمَن ضَلَّ فَإِنَّمَا يَضِلُّ عَلَيۡهَاۖ وَمَآ أَنتَ عَلَيۡهِم بِوَكِيلٍ
translation: Indeed, We sent down to you the Book for the people in truth. So whoever is guided - it is for [the benefit of] his soul; and whoever goes astray only goes astray to its detriment. And you are not a manager over them
normalizedArabic: انا انزلنا عليك الكتب للناس بالحق فمن اهتدي فلنفسه ومن ضل فانما يضل عليها وما انت عليهم بوكيل
normalizedTranslation: indeed, we sent down to you the book for the people in truth. so whoever is guided - it is for [the benefit of] his soul; and whoever goes astray only goes astray to its detriment. and you are not a manager over them

arabic: ٱللَّهُ يَتَوَفَّى ٱلۡأَنفُسَ حِينَ مَوۡتِهَا وَٱلَّتِي لَمۡ تَمُتۡ فِي مَنَامِهَاۖ فَيُمۡسِكُ ٱلَّتِي قَضَىٰ عَلَيۡهَا ٱلۡمَوۡتَ وَيُرۡسِلُ ٱلۡأُخۡرَىٰٓ إِلَىٰٓ أَجَلٖ مُّسَمًّىۚ إِنَّ فِي ذَٰلِكَ لَأٓيَٰتٖ لِّقَوۡمٖ يَتَفَكَّرُونَ
translation: Allah takes the souls at the time of their death, and those that do not die [He takes] during their sleep. Then He keeps those for which He has decreed death and releases the others for a specified term. Indeed in that are signs for a people who give thought

normalizedTranslation: allah takes the souls at the time of their death, and those that do not die [he takes] during their sleep. then he keeps those for which he has decreed death and releases the others for a specified term. indeed in that are signs for a people who give thought

arabic: أَمِ ٱتَّخَذُواْ مِن دُونِ ٱللَّهِ شُفَعَآءَۚ قُلۡ أَوَلَوۡ كَانُواْ لَا يَمۡلِكُونَ شَيۡـٔٗا وَلَا يَعۡقِلُونَ
translation: Or have they taken other than Allah as intercessors? Say, "Even though they do not possess [power over] anything, nor do they reason

translation: And when Allah is mentioned alone, the hearts of those who do not believe in the Hereafter shrink with aversion, but when those [worshipped] other than Him are mentioned, immediately they rejoice

normalizedTranslation: and when allah is mentioned alone, the hearts of those who do not believe in the hereafter shrink with aversion, but when those [worshipped] other than him are mentioned, immediately they rejoice

arabic: وَبَدَا لَهُمۡ سَيِّـَٔاتُ مَا كَسَبُواْ وَحَاقَ بِهِم مَّا كَانُواْ بِهِۦ يَسۡتَهۡزِءُونَ

normalizedTranslation: and when adversity touches man, he calls upon us; then when we bestow on him a favor from us, he says, "i have only been given it because of [my] knowledge." rather, it is a trial, but most of them do not know

arabic: قَدۡ قَالَهَا ٱلَّذِينَ مِن قَبۡلِهِمۡ فَمَآ أَغۡنَىٰ عَنۡهُم مَّا كَانُواْ يَكۡسِبُونَ

arabic: وَيُنَجِّي ٱللَّهُ ٱلَّذِينَ ٱتَّقَوۡاْ بِمَفَازَتِهِمۡ لَا يَمَسُّهُمُ ٱلسُّوٓءُ وَلَا هُمۡ يَحۡزَنُونَ
translation: And Allah will save those who feared Him by their attainment; no evil will touch them, nor will they grieve

normalizedTranslation: and allah will save those who feared him by their attainment; no evil will touch them, nor will they grieve

arabic: ٱللَّهُ خَٰلِقُ كُلِّ شَيۡءٖۖ وَهُوَ عَلَىٰ كُلِّ شَيۡءٖ وَكِيلٞ
translation: Allah is the Creator of all things, and He is, over all things, Disposer of affairs

normalizedTranslation: allah is the creator of all things, and he is, over all things, disposer of affairs

arabic: لَّهُۥ مَقَالِيدُ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلۡأَرۡضِۗ وَٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُواْ بِـَٔايَٰتِ ٱللَّهِ أُوْلَـٰٓئِكَ هُمُ ٱلۡخَٰسِرُونَ

arabic: قُلۡ أَفَغَيۡرَ ٱللَّهِ تَأۡمُرُوٓنِّيٓ أَعۡبُدُ أَيُّهَا ٱلۡجَٰهِلُونَ

normalizedTranslation: say, [o muhammad], "is it other than allah that you order me to worship, o ignorant ones

arabic: وَلَقَدۡ أُوحِيَ إِلَيۡكَ وَإِلَى ٱلَّذِينَ مِن قَبۡلِكَ لَئِنۡ أَشۡرَكۡتَ لَيَحۡبَطَنَّ عَمَلُكَ وَلَتَكُونَنَّ مِنَ ٱلۡخَٰسِرِينَ
translation: And it was already revealed to you and to those before you that if you should associate [anything] with Allah, your work would surely become worthless, and you would surely be among the losers

normalizedTranslation: and it was already revealed to you and to those before you that if you should associate [anything] with allah, your work would surely become worthless, and you would surely be among the losers

arabic: بَلِ ٱللَّهَ فَٱعۡبُدۡ وَكُن مِّنَ ٱلشَّـٰكِرِينَ
translation: Rather, worship [only] Allah and be among the grateful
normalizedArabic: بل الله فاعبد وكن من الشكرين
normalizedTranslation: rather, worship [only] allah and be among the grateful

arabic: وَمَا قَدَرُواْ ٱللَّهَ حَقَّ قَدۡرِهِۦ وَٱلۡأَرۡضُ جَمِيعٗا قَبۡضَتُهُۥ يَوۡمَ ٱلۡقِيَٰمَةِ وَٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتُ مَطۡوِيَّـٰتُۢ بِيَمِينِهِۦۚ سُبۡحَٰنَهُۥ وَتَعَٰلَىٰ عَمَّا يُشۡرِكُونَ
translation: They have not appraised Allah with true appraisal, while the earth entirely will be [within] His grip on the Day of Resurrection, and the heavens will be folded in His right hand. Exalted is He and high above what they associate with Him

normalizedTranslation: they have not appraised allah with true appraisal, while the earth entirely will be [within] his grip on the day of resurrection, and the heavens will be folded in his right hand. exalted is he and high above what they associate with him

arabic: وَنُفِخَ فِي ٱلصُّورِ فَصَعِقَ مَن فِي ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَمَن فِي ٱلۡأَرۡضِ إِلَّا مَن شَآءَ ٱللَّهُۖ ثُمَّ نُفِخَ فِيهِ أُخۡرَىٰ فَإِذَا هُمۡ قِيَامٞ يَنظُرُونَ

normalizedTranslation: and the horn will be blown, and whoever is in the heavens and whoever is on the earth will fall dead except whom allah wills. then it will be blown again, and at once they will be standing, looking on

normalizedTranslation: and the earth will shine with the light of its lord, and the record [of deeds] will be placed, and the prophets and the witnesses will be brought, and it will be judged between them in truth, and they will not be wronged

They will say, "Yes, but the word of punishment has come into effect upon the disbelievers

arabic: لَا جَرَمَ أَنَّمَا تَدۡعُونَنِيٓ إِلَيۡهِ لَيۡسَ لَهُۥ دَعۡوَةٞ فِي ٱلدُّنۡيَا وَلَا فِي ٱلۡأٓخِرَةِ وَأَنَّ مَرَدَّنَآ إِلَى ٱللَّهِ وَأَنَّ ٱلۡمُسۡرِفِينَ هُمۡ أَصۡحَٰبُ ٱلنَّارِ

normalizedTranslation: assuredly, that to which you invite me has no [response to a] supplication in this world or in the hereafter; and indeed, our return is to allah, and indeed, the transgressors will be companions of the fire

arabic: هُوَ ٱلۡحَيُّ لَآ إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا هُوَ فَٱدۡعُوهُ مُخۡلِصِينَ لَهُ ٱلدِّينَۗ ٱلۡحَمۡدُ لِلَّهِ رَبِّ ٱلۡعَٰلَمِينَ

normalizedTranslation: he is the ever-living; there is no deity except him, so call upon him, [being] sincere to him in religion. [all] praise is [due] to allah, lord of the worlds

arabic: ۞قُلۡ إِنِّي نُهِيتُ أَنۡ أَعۡبُدَ ٱلَّذِينَ تَدۡعُونَ مِن دُونِ ٱللَّهِ لَمَّا جَآءَنِيَ ٱلۡبَيِّنَٰتُ مِن رَّبِّي وَأُمِرۡتُ أَنۡ أُسۡلِمَ لِرَبِّ ٱلۡعَٰلَمِينَ

normalizedTranslation: say, [o muhammad], "indeed, i have been forbidden to worship those you call upon besides allah once the clear proofs have come to me from my lord, and i have been commanded to submit to the lord of the worlds

arabic: هُوَ ٱلَّذِي خَلَقَكُم مِّن تُرَابٖ ثُمَّ مِن نُّطۡفَةٖ ثُمَّ مِنۡ عَلَقَةٖ ثُمَّ يُخۡرِجُكُمۡ طِفۡلٗا ثُمَّ لِتَبۡلُغُوٓاْ أَشُدَّكُمۡ ثُمَّ لِتَكُونُواْ شُيُوخٗاۚ وَمِنكُم مَّن يُتَوَفَّىٰ مِن قَبۡلُۖ وَلِتَبۡلُغُوٓاْ أَجَلٗا مُّسَمّٗى وَلَعَلَّكُمۡ تَعۡقِلُونَ
translation: It is He who created you from dust, then from a sperm-drop, then from a clinging clot; then He brings you out as a child; then [He develops you] that you reach your [time of] maturity, then [further] that you become elders. And among you is he who is taken in death before [that], so that you reach a specified term; and perhaps you will use reason
normalizedArabic: هو الذي خلقكم من تراب ثم من نطفه ثم من علقه ثم يخرجكم طفلا ثم لتبلغوا اشدكم ثم لتكونوا شيوخا ومنكم من يتوفي من قبل ولتبلغوا اجلا مسمي ولعلكم تعقلون
normalizedTranslation: it is he who created you from dust, then from a sperm-drop, then from a clinging clot; then he brings you out as a child; then [he develops you] that you reach your [time of] maturity, then [further] that you become elders. and among you is he who is taken in death before [that], so that you reach a specified term; and perhaps you will use reason

arabic: هُوَ ٱلَّذِي يُحۡيِۦ وَيُمِيتُۖ فَإِذَا قَضَىٰٓ أَمۡرٗا فَإِنَّمَا يَقُولُ لَهُۥ كُن فَيَكُونُ
translation: He it is who gives life and causes death; and when He decrees a matter, He but says to it, "Be," and it is

normalizedTranslation: he it is who gives life and causes death; and when he decrees a matter, he but says to it, "be," and it is

arabic: أَلَمۡ تَرَ إِلَى ٱلَّذِينَ يُجَٰدِلُونَ فِيٓ ءَايَٰتِ ٱللَّهِ أَنَّىٰ يُصۡرَفُونَ

normalizedTranslation: do you not consider those who dispute concerning the signs of allah - how are they averted

arabic: ٱلَّذِينَ كَذَّبُواْ بِٱلۡكِتَٰبِ وَبِمَآ أَرۡسَلۡنَا بِهِۦ رُسُلَنَاۖ فَسَوۡفَ يَعۡلَمُونَ

normalizedArabic: الذين كذبوا بالكتب وبما ارسلنا به رسلنا فسوف يعلمون
normalizedTranslation: those who deny the book and that with which we sent our messengers - they are going to know

arabic: إِذِ ٱلۡأَغۡلَٰلُ فِيٓ أَعۡنَٰقِهِمۡ وَٱلسَّلَٰسِلُ يُسۡحَبُونَ

normalizedTranslation: when the shackles are around their necks and the chains; they will be dragged

arabic: فِي ٱلۡحَمِيمِ ثُمَّ فِي ٱلنَّارِ يُسۡجَرُونَ

normalizedTranslation: in boiling water; then in the fire they will be filled [with flame]

arabic: ثُمَّ قِيلَ لَهُمۡ أَيۡنَ مَا كُنتُمۡ تُشۡرِكُونَ
translation: Then it will be said to them, "Where is that which you used to associate [with Him in worship]
normalizedArabic: ثم قيل لهم اين ما كنتم تشركون
normalizedTranslation: then it will be said to them, "where is that which you used to associate [with him in worship]

arabic: مِن دُونِ ٱللَّهِۖ قَالُواْ ضَلُّواْ عَنَّا بَل لَّمۡ نَكُن نَّدۡعُواْ مِن قَبۡلُ شَيۡـٔٗاۚ كَذَٰلِكَ يُضِلُّ ٱللَّهُ ٱلۡكَٰفِرِينَ
translation: Other than Allah?" They will say, "They have departed from us; rather, we did not used to invoke previously anything." Thus does Allah put astray the disbelievers
normalizedArabic: من دون الله قالوا ضلوا عنا بل لم نكن ندعوا من قبل شيا كذلك يضل الله الكفرين
normalizedTranslation: other than allah?" they will say, "they have departed from us; rather, we did not used to invoke previously anything." thus does allah put astray the disbelievers

arabic: ذَٰلِكُم بِمَا كُنتُمۡ تَفۡرَحُونَ فِي ٱلۡأَرۡضِ بِغَيۡرِ ٱلۡحَقِّ وَبِمَا كُنتُمۡ تَمۡرَحُونَ
translation: [The angels will say], "That was because you used to exult upon the earth without right and you used to behave insolently
normalizedArabic: ذلكم بما كنتم تفرحون في الارض بغير الحق وبما كنتم تمرحون
normalizedTranslation: [the angels will say], "that was because you used to exult upon the earth without right and you used to behave insolently

arabic: ٱدۡخُلُوٓاْ أَبۡوَٰبَ جَهَنَّمَ خَٰلِدِينَ فِيهَاۖ فَبِئۡسَ مَثۡوَى ٱلۡمُتَكَبِّرِينَ
translation: Enter the gates of Hell to abide eternally therein, and wretched is the residence of the arrogant
normalizedArabic: ادخلوا ابوب جهنم خلدين فيها فبيس مثوي المتكبرين
normalizedTranslation: enter the gates of hell to abide eternally therein, and wretched is the residence of the arrogant

arabic: فَٱصۡبِرۡ إِنَّ وَعۡدَ ٱللَّهِ حَقّٞۚ فَإِمَّا نُرِيَنَّكَ بَعۡضَ ٱلَّذِي نَعِدُهُمۡ أَوۡ نَتَوَفَّيَنَّكَ فَإِلَيۡنَا يُرۡجَعُونَ

normalizedTranslation: so be patient, [o muhammad]; indeed, the promise of allah is truth. and whether we show you some of what we have promised them or we take you in death, it is to us they will be returned

arabic: وَلَقَدۡ أَرۡسَلۡنَا رُسُلٗا مِّن قَبۡلِكَ مِنۡهُم مَّن قَصَصۡنَا عَلَيۡكَ وَمِنۡهُم مَّن لَّمۡ نَقۡصُصۡ عَلَيۡكَۗ وَمَا كَانَ لِرَسُولٍ أَن يَأۡتِيَ بِـَٔايَةٍ إِلَّا بِإِذۡنِ ٱللَّهِۚ فَإِذَا جَآءَ أَمۡرُ ٱللَّهِ قُضِيَ بِٱلۡحَقِّ وَخَسِرَ هُنَالِكَ ٱلۡمُبۡطِلُونَ
translation: And We have already sent messengers before you. Among them are those [whose stories] We have related to you, and among them are those [whose stories] We have not related to you. normalizedArabic: ولقد ارسلنا رسلا من قبلك منهم من قصصنا عليك ومنهم من لم نقصص عليك وما كان لرسول ان ياتي بايه الا باذن الله فاذا جاء امر الله قضي بالحق وخسر هنالك المبطلون
normalizedTranslation: and we have already sent messengers before you. among them are those [whose stories] we have related to you, and among them are those [whose stories] we have not related to you. and it was not for any messenger to bring a sign [or verse] except by permission of allah. so when the command of allah comes, it will be concluded in truth, and the falsifiers will thereupon lose [all]

arabic: ٱللَّهُ ٱلَّذِي جَعَلَ لَكُمُ ٱلۡأَنۡعَٰمَ لِتَرۡكَبُواْ مِنۡهَا وَمِنۡهَا تَأۡكُلُونَ

normalizedTranslation: it is allah who made for you the grazing animals upon which you ride, and some of them you eat

arabic: وَلَكُمۡ فِيهَا مَنَٰفِعُ وَلِتَبۡلُغُواْ عَلَيۡهَا حَاجَةٗ فِي صُدُورِكُمۡ وَعَلَيۡهَا وَعَلَى ٱلۡفُلۡكِ تُحۡمَلُونَ

normalizedTranslation: and for you therein are [other] benefits and that you may realize upon them a need which is in your breasts; and upon them and upon ships you are carried

arabic: وَيُرِيكُمۡ ءَايَٰتِهِۦ فَأَيَّ ءَايَٰتِ ٱللَّهِ تُنكِرُونَ
translation: And He shows you His signs. So which of the signs of Allah do you deny

normalizedTranslation: and he shows you his signs. so which of the signs of allah do you deny

arabic: أَفَلَمۡ يَسِيرُواْ فِي ٱلۡأَرۡضِ فَيَنظُرُواْ كَيۡفَ كَانَ عَٰقِبَةُ ٱلَّذِينَ مِن قَبۡلِهِمۡۚ كَانُوٓاْ أَكۡثَرَ مِنۡهُمۡ وَأَشَدَّ قُوَّةٗ وَءَاثَارٗا فِي ٱلۡأَرۡضِ فَمَآ أَغۡنَىٰ عَنۡهُم مَّا كَانُواْ يَكۡسِبُونَ

translation: And when their messengers came to them with clear proofs, they [merely] rejoiced in what they had of knowledge, but they were enveloped by what they used to ridicule

arabic: فَلَمۡ يَكُ يَنفَعُهُمۡ إِيمَٰنُهُمۡ لَمَّا رَأَوۡاْ بَأۡسَنَاۖ سُنَّتَ ٱللَّهِ ٱلَّتِي قَدۡ خَلَتۡ فِي عِبَادِهِۦۖ وَخَسِرَ هُنَالِكَ ٱلۡكَٰفِرُونَ

normalizedArabic: قل اينكم لتكفرون بالذي خلق الارض في يومين وتجعلون له اندادا ذلك رب العلمين
normalizedTranslation: say, "do you indeed disbelieve in he who created the earth in two days and attribute to him equals? that is the lord of the worlds

arabic: وَجَعَلَ فِيهَا رَوَٰسِيَ مِن فَوۡقِهَا وَبَٰرَكَ فِيهَا وَقَدَّرَ فِيهَآ أَقۡوَٰتَهَا فِيٓ أَرۡبَعَةِ أَيَّامٖ سَوَآءٗ لِّلسَّآئِلِينَ
translation: And He placed on the earth firmly set mountains over its surface, and He blessed it and determined therein its [creatures'] sustenance in four days without distinction - for [the information] of those who ask
normalizedArabic: وجعل فيها روسي من فوقها وبرك فيها وقدر فيها اقوتها في اربعه ايام سواء للسايلين
normalizedTranslation: and he placed on the earth firmly set mountains over its surface, and he blessed it and determined therein its [creatures'] sustenance in four days without distinction - for [the information] of those who ask

arabic: ثُمَّ ٱسۡتَوَىٰٓ إِلَى ٱلسَّمَآءِ وَهِيَ دُخَانٞ فَقَالَ لَهَا وَلِلۡأَرۡضِ ٱئۡتِيَا طَوۡعًا أَوۡ كَرۡهٗا قَالَتَآ أَتَيۡنَا طَآئِعِينَ
translation: Then He directed Himself to the heaven while it was smoke and said to it and to the earth, "Come [into being], willingly or by compulsion." They said, "We have come willingly
normalizedArabic: ثم استوي الي السماء وهي دخان فقال لها وللارض ايتيا طوعا او كرها قالتا اتينا طايعين
normalizedTranslation: then he directed himself to the heaven while it was smoke and said to it and to the earth, "come [into being], willingly or by compulsion." they said, "we have come willingly

arabic: فَقَضَىٰهُنَّ سَبۡعَ سَمَٰوَاتٖ فِي يَوۡمَيۡنِ وَأَوۡحَىٰ فِي كُلِّ سَمَآءٍ أَمۡرَهَاۚ وَزَيَّنَّا ٱلسَّمَآءَ ٱلدُّنۡيَا بِمَصَٰبِيحَ وَحِفۡظٗاۚ ذَٰلِكَ تَقۡدِيرُ ٱلۡعَزِيزِ ٱلۡعَلِيمِ
translation: And He completed them as seven heavens within two days and inspired in each heaven its command. And We adorned the nearest heaven with lamps and as protection. That is the determination of the Exalted in Might, the Knowing
normalizedArabic: فقضيهن سبع سموات في يومين واوحي في كل سماء امرها وزينا السماء الدنيا بمصبيح وحفظا ذلك تقدير العزيز العليم
normalizedTranslation: and he completed them as seven heavens within two days and inspired in each heaven its command. and we adorned the nearest heaven with lamps and as protection. that is the determination of the exalted in might, the knowing

arabic: فَإِنۡ أَعۡرَضُواْ فَقُلۡ أَنذَرۡتُكُمۡ صَٰعِقَةٗ مِّثۡلَ صَٰعِقَةِ عَادٖ وَثَمُودَ
translation: But if they turn away, then say, "I have warned you of a thunderbolt like the thunderbolt [that struck] 'Aad and Thamud
normalizedArabic: فان اعرضوا فقل انذرتكم صعقه مثل صعقه عاد وثمود
normalizedTranslation: but if they turn away, then say, "i have warned you of a thunderbolt like the thunderbolt [that struck] 'aad and thamud

arabic: إِذۡ جَآءَتۡهُمُ ٱلرُّسُلُ مِنۢ بَيۡنِ أَيۡدِيهِمۡ وَمِنۡ خَلۡفِهِمۡ أَلَّا تَعۡبُدُوٓاْ إِلَّا ٱللَّهَۖ قَالُواْ لَوۡ شَآءَ رَبُّنَا لَأَنزَلَ مَلَـٰٓئِكَةٗ فَإِنَّا بِمَآ أُرۡسِلۡتُم بِهِۦ كَٰفِرُونَ
translation: [That occurred] when the messengers had come to them before them and after them, [saying], "Worship not except Allah." They said, "If our Lord had willed, He would have sent down the angels, so indeed we, in that with which you have been sent, are disbelievers
normalizedArabic: اذ جاءتهم الرسل من بين ايديهم ومن خلفهم الا تعبدوا الا الله قالوا لو شاء ربنا لانزل مليكه فانا بما ارسلتم به كفرون
normalizedTranslation: [that occurred] when the messengers had come to them before them and after them, [saying], "worship not except allah." they said, "if our lord had willed, he would have sent down the angels, so indeed we, in that with which you have been sent, are disbelievers

arabic: فَأَمَّا عَادٞ فَٱسۡتَكۡبَرُواْ فِي ٱلۡأَرۡضِ بِغَيۡرِ ٱلۡحَقِّ وَقَالُواْ مَنۡ أَشَدُّ مِنَّا قُوَّةًۖ أَوَلَمۡ يَرَوۡاْ أَنَّ ٱللَّهَ ٱلَّذِي خَلَقَهُمۡ هُوَ أَشَدُّ مِنۡهُمۡ قُوَّةٗۖ وَكَانُواْ بِـَٔايَٰتِنَا يَجۡحَدُونَ
translation: As for 'Aad, they were arrogant upon the earth without right and said, "Who is greater than us in strength?" Did they not consider that Allah who created them was greater than them in strength? But they were rejecting Our signs
normalizedArabic: فاما عاد فاستكبروا في الارض بغير الحق وقالوا من اشد منا قوه اولم يروا ان الله الذي خلقهم هو اشد منهم قوه وكانوا بايتنا يجحدون
normalizedTranslation: as for 'aad, they were arrogant upon the earth without right and said, "who is greater than us in strength?" did they not consider that allah who created them was greater than them in strength? but they were rejecting our signs

arabic: فَأَرۡسَلۡنَا عَلَيۡهِمۡ رِيحٗا صَرۡصَرٗا فِيٓ أَيَّامٖ نَّحِسَاتٖ لِّنُذِيقَهُمۡ عَذَابَ ٱلۡخِزۡيِ فِي ٱلۡحَيَوٰةِ ٱلدُّنۡيَاۖ وَلَعَذَابُ ٱلۡأٓخِرَةِ أَخۡزَىٰۖ وَهُمۡ لَا يُنصَرُونَ
translation: So We sent upon them a screaming wind during days of misfortune to make them taste the punishment of disgrace in the worldly life; but the punishment of the Hereafter is more disgracing, and they will not be helped
normalizedArabic: فارسلنا عليهم ريحا صرصرا في ايام نحسات لنذيقهم عذاب الخزي في الحيوه الدنيا ولعذاب الاخره اخزي وهم لا ينصرون
normalizedTranslation: so we sent upon them a screaming wind during days of misfortune to make them taste the punishment of disgrace in the worldly life; but the punishment of the hereafter is more disgracing, and they will not be helped

arabic: وَأَمَّا ثَمُودُ فَهَدَيۡنَٰهُمۡ فَٱسۡتَحَبُّواْ ٱلۡعَمَىٰ عَلَى ٱلۡهُدَىٰ فَأَخَذَتۡهُمۡ صَٰعِقَةُ ٱلۡعَذَابِ ٱلۡهُونِ بِمَا كَانُواْ يَكۡسِبُونَ
translation: And as for Thamud, We guided them, but they preferred blindness over guidance, so the thunderbolt of humiliating punishment seized them for what they used to earn
normalizedArabic: واما ثمود فهدينهم فاستحبوا العمي علي الهدي فاخذتهم صعقه العذاب الهون بما كانوا يكسبون
normalizedTranslation: and as for thamud, we guided them, but they preferred blindness over guidance, so the thunderbolt of humiliating punishment seized them for what they used to earn

arabic: وَنَجَّيۡنَا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُواْ وَكَانُواْ يَتَّقُونَ
translation: And We saved those who believed and used to fear Allah
normalizedArabic: ونجينا الذين ءامنوا وكانوا يتقون
normalizedTranslation: and we saved those who believed and used to fear allah

arabic: وَيَوۡمَ يُحۡشَرُ أَعۡدَآءُ ٱللَّهِ إِلَى ٱلنَّارِ فَهُمۡ يُوزَعُونَ
translation: And [mention, O Muhammad], the Day when the enemies of Allah will be gathered to the Fire while they are [driven] assembled in rows
normalizedArabic: ويوم يحشر اعداء الله الي النار فهم يوزعون
normalizedTranslation: and [mention, o muhammad], the day when the enemies of allah will be gathered to the fire while they are [driven] assembled in rows

arabic: حَتَّىٰٓ إِذَا مَا جَآءُوهَا شَهِدَ عَلَيۡهِمۡ سَمۡعُهُمۡ وَأَبۡصَٰرُهُمۡ وَجُلُودُهُم بِمَا كَانُواْ يَعۡمَلُونَ
translation: Until, when they reach it, their hearing and their eyes and their skins will testify against them of what they used to do
normalizedArabic: حتي اذا ما جاءوها شهد عليهم سمعهم وابصرهم وجلودهم بما كانوا يعملون
normalizedTranslation: until, when they reach it, their hearing and their eyes and their skins will testify against them of what they used to do

arabic: وَقَالُواْ لِجُلُودِهِمۡ لِمَ شَهِدتُّمۡ عَلَيۡنَاۖ قَالُوٓاْ أَنطَقَنَا ٱللَّهُ ٱلَّذِيٓ أَنطَقَ كُلَّ شَيۡءٖۚ وَهُوَ خَلَقَكُمۡ أَوَّلَ مَرَّةٖ وَإِلَيۡهِ تُرۡجَعُونَ
translation: And they will say to their skins, "Why have you testified against us?" They will say, "We were made to speak by Allah, who has made everything speak; and He created you the first time, and to Him you are returned
normalizedArabic: وقالوا لجلودهم لم شهدتم علينا قالوا انطقنا الله الذي انطق كل شيء وهو خلقكم اول مره واليه ترجعون
normalizedTranslation: and they will say to their skins, "why have you testified against us?" they will say, "we were made to speak by allah, who has made everything speak; and he created you the first time, and to him you are returned

arabic: وَمَا كُنتُمۡ تَسۡتَتِرُونَ أَن يَشۡهَدَ عَلَيۡكُمۡ سَمۡعُكُمۡ وَلَآ أَبۡصَٰرُكُمۡ وَلَا جُلُودُكُمۡ وَلَٰكِن ظَنَنتُمۡ أَنَّ ٱللَّهَ لَا يَعۡلَمُ كَثِيرٗا مِّمَّا تَعۡمَلُونَ
translation: And you were not covering yourselves, lest your hearing testify against you or your sight or your skins, but you assumed that Allah does not know much of what you do
normalizedArabic: وما كنتم تستترون ان يشهد عليكم سمعكم ولا ابصركم ولا جلودكم ولكن ظننتم ان الله لا يعلم كثيرا مما تعملون
normalizedTranslation: and you were not covering yourselves, lest your hearing testify against you or your sight or your skins, but you assumed that allah does not know much of what you do

arabic: وَذَٰلِكُمۡ ظَنُّكُمُ ٱلَّذِي ظَنَنتُم بِرَبِّكُمۡ أَرۡدَىٰكُمۡ فَأَصۡبَحۡتُم مِّنَ ٱلۡخَٰسِرِينَ
translation: And that was your assumption which you assumed about your Lord. It has brought you to ruin, and you have become among the losers
normalizedArabic: وذلكم ظنكم الذي ظننتم بربكم ارديكم فاصبحتم من الخسرين
normalizedTranslation: and that was your assumption which you assumed about your lord. it has brought you to ruin, and you have become among the losers

arabic: فَإِن يَصۡبِرُواْ فَٱلنَّارُ مَثۡوٗى لَّهُمۡۖ وَإِن يَسۡتَعۡتِبُواْ فَمَا هُم مِّنَ ٱلۡمُعۡتَبِينَ
translation: So [even] if they are patient, the Fire is a residence for them; and if they ask to appease [Allah], they will not be of those who are allowed to appease
normalizedArabic: فان يصبروا فالنار مثوي لهم وان يستعتبوا فما هم من المعتبين
normalizedTranslation: so [even] if they are patient, the fire is a residence for them; and if they ask to appease [allah], they will not be of those who are allowed to appease

arabic: ۞وَقَيَّضۡنَا لَهُمۡ قُرَنَآءَ فَزَيَّنُواْ لَهُم مَّا بَيۡنَ أَيۡدِيهِمۡ وَمَا خَلۡفَهُمۡ وَحَقَّ عَلَيۡهِمُ ٱلۡقَوۡلُ فِيٓ أُمَمٖ قَدۡ خَلَتۡ مِن قَبۡلِهِم مِّنَ ٱلۡجِنِّ وَٱلۡإِنسِۖ إِنَّهُمۡ كَانُواْ خَٰسِرِينَ
translation: And We appointed for them companions who made attractive to them what was before them and what was behind them [of sin], and the word has come into effect upon them among nations which had passed on before them of jinn and men. Indeed, they [all] were losers
normalizedArabic: وقيضنا لهم قرناء فزينوا لهم ما بين ايديهم وما خلفهم وحق عليهم القول في امم قد خلت من قبلهم من الجن والانس انهم كانوا خسرين
normalizedTranslation: and we appointed for them companions who made attractive to them what was before them and what was behind them [of sin], and the word has come into effect upon them among nations which had passed on before them of jinn and men. indeed, they [all] were losers

arabic: وَقَالَ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُواْ لَا تَسۡمَعُواْ لِهَٰذَا ٱلۡقُرۡءَانِ وَٱلۡغَوۡاْ فِيهِ لَعَلَّكُمۡ تَغۡلِبُونَ
translation: And those who disbelieve say, "Do not listen to this Qur'an and speak noisily during [the recitation of] it that perhaps you will overcome
normalizedArabic: وقال الذين كفروا لا تسمعوا لهذا القرءان والغوا فيه لعلكم تغلبون
normalizedTranslation: and those who disbelieve say, "do not listen to this qur'an and speak noisily during [the recitation of] it that perhaps you will overcome

arabic: فَلَنُذِيقَنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُواْ عَذَابٗا شَدِيدٗا وَلَنَجۡزِيَنَّهُمۡ أَسۡوَأَ ٱلَّذِي كَانُواْ يَعۡمَلُونَ
translation: But We will surely cause those who disbelieve to taste a severe punishment, and We will surely recompense them for the worst of what they had been doing
normalizedArabic: فلنذيقن الذين كفروا عذابا شديدا ولنجزينهم اسوا الذي كانوا يعملون
normalizedTranslation: but we will surely cause those who disbelieve to taste a severe punishment, and we will surely recompense them for the worst of what they had been doing

arabic: ذَٰلِكَ جَزَآءُ أَعۡدَآءِ ٱللَّهِ ٱلنَّارُۖ لَهُمۡ فِيهَا دَارُ ٱلۡخُلۡدِ جَزَآءَۢ بِمَا كَانُواْ بِـَٔايَٰتِنَا يَجۡحَدُونَ
translation: That is the recompense of the enemies of Allah - the Fire. For them therein is the home of eternity as recompense for what they, of Our verses, were rejecting
normalizedArabic: ذلك جزاء اعداء الله النار لهم فيها دار الخلد جزاء بما كانوا بايتنا يجحدون
normalizedTranslation: that is the recompense of the enemies of allah - the fire. for them therein is the home of eternity as recompense for what they, of our verses, were rejecting

arabic: وَقَالَ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُواْ رَبَّنَآ أَرِنَا ٱلَّذَيۡنِ أَضَلَّانَا مِنَ ٱلۡجِنِّ وَٱلۡإِنسِ نَجۡعَلۡهُمَا تَحۡتَ أَقۡدَامِنَا لِيَكُونَا مِنَ ٱلۡأَسۡفَلِينَ
translation: And those who disbelieved will [then] say, "Our Lord, show us those who misled us of the jinn and men [so] we may put them under our feet that they will be among the lowest
normalizedArabic: وقال الذين كفروا ربنا ارنا الذين اضلانا من الجن والانس نجعلهما تحت اقدامنا ليكونا من الاسفلين
normalizedTranslation: and those who disbelieved will [then] say, "our lord, show us those who misled us of the jinn and men [so] we may put them under our feet that they will be among the lowest

arabic: إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ قَالُواْ رَبُّنَا ٱللَّهُ ثُمَّ ٱسۡتَقَٰمُواْ تَتَنَزَّلُ عَلَيۡهِمُ ٱلۡمَلَـٰٓئِكَةُ أَلَّا تَخَافُواْ وَلَا تَحۡزَنُواْ وَأَبۡشِرُواْ بِٱلۡجَنَّةِ ٱلَّتِي كُنتُمۡ تُوعَدُونَ
translation: Indeed, those who have said, "Our Lord is Allah " and then remained on a right course - the angels will descend upon them, [saying], "Do not fear and do not grieve but receive good tidings of Paradise, which you were promised
normalizedArabic: ان الذين قالوا ربنا الله ثم استقموا تتنزل عليهم المليكه الا تخافوا ولا تحزنوا وابشروا بالجنه التي كنتم توعدون
normalizedTranslation: indeed, those who have said, "our lord is allah " and then remained on a right course - the angels will descend upon them, [saying], "do not fear and do not grieve but receive good tidings of paradise, which you were promised

arabic: نَحۡنُ أَوۡلِيَآؤُكُمۡ فِي ٱلۡحَيَوٰةِ ٱلدُّنۡيَا وَفِي ٱلۡأٓخِرَةِۖ وَلَكُمۡ فِيهَا مَا تَشۡتَهِيٓ أَنفُسُكُمۡ وَلَكُمۡ فِيهَا مَا تَدَّعُونَ
translation: We [angels] were your allies in worldly life and [are so] in the Hereafter. And you will have therein whatever your souls desire, and you will have therein whatever you request [or wish]
normalizedArabic: نحن اولياوكم في الحيوه الدنيا وفي الاخره ولكم فيها ما تشتهي انفسكم ولكم فيها ما تدعون
normalizedTranslation: we [angels] were your allies in worldly life and [are so] in the hereafter. and you will have therein whatever your souls desire, and you will have therein whatever you request [or wish]

arabic: نُزُلٗا مِّنۡ غَفُورٖ رَّحِيمٖ
translation: As accommodation from a [Lord who is] Forgiving and Merciful
normalizedArabic: نزلا من غفور رحيم
normalizedTranslation: as accommodation from a [lord who is] forgiving and merciful

arabic: وَمَنۡ أَحۡسَنُ قَوۡلٗا مِّمَّن دَعَآ إِلَى ٱللَّهِ وَعَمِلَ صَٰلِحٗا وَقَالَ إِنَّنِي مِنَ ٱلۡمُسۡلِمِينَ
translation: And who is better in speech than one who invites to Allah and does righteousness and says, "Indeed, I am of the Muslims
normalizedArabic: ومن احسن قولا ممن دعا الي الله وعمل صلحا وقال انني من المسلمين
normalizedTranslation: and who is better in speech than one who invites to allah and does righteousness and says, "indeed, i am of the muslims

arabic: وَلَا تَسۡتَوِي ٱلۡحَسَنَةُ وَلَا ٱلسَّيِّئَةُۚ ٱدۡفَعۡ بِٱلَّتِي هِيَ أَحۡسَنُ فَإِذَا ٱلَّذِي بَيۡنَكَ وَبَيۡنَهُۥ عَدَٰوَةٞ كَأَنَّهُۥ وَلِيٌّ حَمِيمٞ
translation: And not equal are the good deed and the bad. Repel [evil] by that [deed] which is better; and thereupon the one whom between you and him is enmity [will become] as though he was a devoted friend

normalizedTranslation: and not equal are the good deed and the bad. repel [evil] by that [deed] which is better; and thereupon the one whom between you and him is enmity [will become] as though he was a devoted friend

arabic: وَمَا يُلَقَّىٰهَآ إِلَّا ٱلَّذِينَ صَبَرُواْ وَمَا يُلَقَّىٰهَآ إِلَّا ذُو حَظٍّ عَظِيمٖ
translation: But none is granted it except those who are patient, and none is granted it except one having a great portion [of good]
