normalizedTranslation: but none is granted it except those who are patient, and none is granted it except one having a great portion [of good]

arabic: وَإِمَّا يَنزَغَنَّكَ مِنَ ٱلشَّيۡطَٰنِ نَزۡغٞ فَٱسۡتَعِذۡ بِٱللَّهِۖ إِنَّهُۥ هُوَ ٱلسَّمِيعُ ٱلۡعَلِيمُ
translation: And if there comes to you from Satan an evil suggestion, then seek refuge in Allah. Indeed, He is the Hearing, the Knowing
normalizedArabic: واما ينزغنك من الشيطن نزغ فاستعذ بالله انه هو السميع العليم
normalizedTranslation: and if there comes to you from satan an evil suggestion, then seek refuge in allah. indeed, he is the hearing, the knowing

arabic: وَمِنۡ ءَايَٰتِهِ ٱلَّيۡلُ وَٱلنَّهَارُ وَٱلشَّمۡسُ وَٱلۡقَمَرُۚ لَا تَسۡجُدُواْ لِلشَّمۡسِ وَلَا لِلۡقَمَرِ وَٱسۡجُدُواْۤ لِلَّهِۤ ٱلَّذِي خَلَقَهُنَّ إِن كُنتُمۡ إِيَّاهُ تَعۡبُدُونَ
translation: And of His signs are the night and day and the sun and moon. Do not prostrate to the sun or to the moon, but prostate to Allah, who created them, if it should be Him that you worship
normalizedArabic: ومن ءايته اليل والنهار والشمس والقمر لا تسجدوا للشمس ولا للقمر واسجدوا لله الذي خلقهن ان كنتم اياه تعبدون
normalizedTranslation: and of his signs are the night and day and the sun and moon. do not prostrate to the sun or to the moon, but prostate to allah, who created them, if it should be him that you worship

arabic: فَإِنِ ٱسۡتَكۡبَرُواْ فَٱلَّذِينَ عِندَ رَبِّكَ يُسَبِّحُونَ لَهُۥ بِٱلَّيۡلِ وَٱلنَّهَارِ وَهُمۡ لَا يَسۡـَٔمُونَ۩
translation: But if they are arrogant - then those who are near your Lord exalt Him by night and by day, and they do not become weary
normalizedArabic: فان استكبروا فالذين عند ربك يسبحون له باليل والنهار وهم لا يسمون
normalizedTranslation: but if they are arrogant - then those who are near your lord exalt him by night and by day, and they do not become weary

arabic: وَمِنۡ ءَايَٰتِهِۦٓ أَنَّكَ تَرَى ٱلۡأَرۡضَ خَٰشِعَةٗ فَإِذَآ أَنزَلۡنَا عَلَيۡهَا ٱلۡمَآءَ ٱهۡتَزَّتۡ وَرَبَتۡۚ إِنَّ ٱلَّذِيٓ أَحۡيَاهَا لَمُحۡيِ ٱلۡمَوۡتَىٰٓۚ إِنَّهُۥ عَلَىٰ كُلِّ شَيۡءٖ قَدِيرٌ
translation: And of His signs is that you see the earth stilled, but when We send down upon it rain, it quivers and grows. Indeed, He who has given it life is the Giver of Life to the dead. Indeed, He is over all things competent
normalizedArabic: ومن ءايته انك تري الارض خشعه فاذا انزلنا عليها الماء اهتزت وربت ان الذي احياها لمحي الموتي انه علي كل شيء قدير
normalizedTranslation: and of his signs is that you see the earth stilled, but when we send down upon it rain, it quivers and grows. indeed, he who has given it life is the giver of life to the dead. indeed, he is over all things competent

arabic: إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ يُلۡحِدُونَ فِيٓ ءَايَٰتِنَا لَا يَخۡفَوۡنَ عَلَيۡنَآۗ أَفَمَن يُلۡقَىٰ فِي ٱلنَّارِ خَيۡرٌ أَم مَّن يَأۡتِيٓ ءَامِنٗا يَوۡمَ ٱلۡقِيَٰمَةِۚ ٱعۡمَلُواْ مَا شِئۡتُمۡ إِنَّهُۥ بِمَا تَعۡمَلُونَ بَصِيرٌ
translation: Indeed, those who inject deviation into Our verses are not concealed from Us. So, is he who is cast into the Fire better or he who comes secure on the Day of Resurrection? Do whatever you will; indeed, He is Seeing of what you do
normalizedArabic: ان الذين يلحدون في ءايتنا لا يخفون علينا افمن يلقي في النار خير ام من ياتي ءامنا يوم القيمه اعملوا ما شيتم انه بما تعملون بصير
normalizedTranslation: indeed, those who inject deviation into our verses are not concealed from us. so, is he who is cast into the fire better or he who comes secure on the day of resurrection? do whatever you will; indeed, he is seeing of what you do

arabic: إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُواْ بِٱلذِّكۡرِ لَمَّا جَآءَهُمۡۖ وَإِنَّهُۥ لَكِتَٰبٌ عَزِيزٞ
translation: Indeed, those who disbelieve in the message after it has come to them... And indeed, it is a mighty Book
normalizedArabic: ان الذين كفروا بالذكر لما جاءهم وانه لكتب عزيز
normalizedTranslation: indeed, those who disbelieve in the message after it has come to them... and indeed, it is a mighty book

arabic: لَّا يَأۡتِيهِ ٱلۡبَٰطِلُ مِنۢ بَيۡنِ يَدَيۡهِ وَلَا مِنۡ خَلۡفِهِۦۖ تَنزِيلٞ مِّنۡ حَكِيمٍ حَمِيدٖ
translation: Falsehood cannot approach it from before it or from behind it; [it is] a revelation from a [Lord who is] Wise and Praiseworthy

normalizedTranslation: falsehood cannot approach it from before it or from behind it; [it is] a revelation from a [lord who is] wise and praiseworthy

arabic: مَّا يُقَالُ لَكَ إِلَّا مَا قَدۡ قِيلَ لِلرُّسُلِ مِن قَبۡلِكَۚ إِنَّ رَبَّكَ لَذُو مَغۡفِرَةٖ وَذُو عِقَابٍ أَلِيمٖ
translation: Nothing is said to you, [O Muhammad], except what was already said to the messengers before you. Indeed, your Lord is a possessor of forgiveness and a possessor of painful penalty

normalizedTranslation: nothing is said to you, [o muhammad], except what was already said to the messengers before you. indeed, your lord is a possessor of forgiveness and a possessor of painful penalty

arabic: وَلَوۡ جَعَلۡنَٰهُ قُرۡءَانًا أَعۡجَمِيّٗا لَّقَالُواْ لَوۡلَا فُصِّلَتۡ ءَايَٰتُهُۥٓۖ ءَا۬عۡجَمِيّٞ وَعَرَبِيّٞۗ قُلۡ هُوَ لِلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُواْ هُدٗى وَشِفَآءٞۚ وَٱلَّذِينَ لَا يُؤۡمِنُونَ فِيٓ ءَاذَانِهِمۡ وَقۡرٞ وَهُوَ عَلَيۡهِمۡ عَمًىۚ أُوْلَـٰٓئِكَ يُنَادَوۡنَ مِن مَّكَانِۭ بَعِيدٖ
translation: And if We had made it a non-Arabic Qur'an, they would have said, "Why are its verses not explained in detail [in our language]? Is it a foreign [recitation] and an Arab [messenger]?" Say, "It is, for those who believe, a guidance and cure." And those who do not believe - in their ears is deafness, and it is upon them blindness. Those are being called from a distant place
normalizedArabic: ولو جعلنه قرءانا اعجميا لقالوا لولا فصلت ءايته ءاعجمي وعربي قل هو للذين ءامنوا هدي وشفاء والذين لا يومنون في ءاذانهم وقر وهو عليهم عمي اوليك ينادون من مكان بعيد
normalizedTranslation: and if we had made it a non-arabic qur'an, they would have said, "why are its verses not explained in detail [in our language]? is it a foreign [recitation] and an arab [messenger]?" say, "it is, for those who believe, a guidance and cure." and those who do not believe - in their ears is deafness, and it is upon them blindness. those are being called from a distant place

arabic: وَلَقَدۡ ءَاتَيۡنَا مُوسَى ٱلۡكِتَٰبَ فَٱخۡتُلِفَ فِيهِۚ وَلَوۡلَا كَلِمَةٞ سَبَقَتۡ مِن رَّبِّكَ لَقُضِيَ بَيۡنَهُمۡۚ وَإِنَّهُمۡ لَفِي شَكّٖ مِّنۡهُ مُرِيبٖ
translation: And We had already given Moses the Scripture, but it came under disagreement. And if not for a word that preceded from your Lord, it would have been concluded between them. And indeed they are, concerning the Qur'an, in disquieting doubt

normalizedTranslation: and we had already given moses the scripture, but it came under disagreement. and if not for a word that preceded from your lord, it would have been concluded between them. and indeed they are, concerning the qur'an, in disquieting doubt

arabic: مَّنۡ عَمِلَ صَٰلِحٗا فَلِنَفۡسِهِۦۖ وَمَنۡ أَسَآءَ فَعَلَيۡهَاۗ وَمَا رَبُّكَ بِظَلَّـٰمٖ لِّلۡعَبِيدِ
translation: Whoever does righteousness - it is for his [own] soul; and whoever does evil [does so] against it. And your Lord is not ever unjust to [His] servants
normalizedArabic: من عمل صلحا فلنفسه ومن اساء فعليها وما ربك بظلم للعبيد
normalizedTranslation: whoever does righteousness - it is for his [own] soul; and whoever does evil [does so] against it. and your lord is not ever unjust to [his] servants

arabic: ۞إِلَيۡهِ يُرَدُّ عِلۡمُ ٱلسَّاعَةِۚ وَمَا تَخۡرُجُ مِن ثَمَرَٰتٖ مِّنۡ أَكۡمَامِهَا وَمَا تَحۡمِلُ مِنۡ أُنثَىٰ وَلَا تَضَعُ إِلَّا بِعِلۡمِهِۦۚ وَيَوۡمَ يُنَادِيهِمۡ أَيۡنَ شُرَكَآءِي قَالُوٓاْ ءَاذَنَّـٰكَ مَامِنَّا مِن شَهِيدٖ
translation: To him [alone] is attributed knowledge of the Hour. And fruits emerge not from their coverings nor does a female conceive or give birth except with His knowledge. And the Day He will call to them, "Where are My 'partners'?" they will say, "We announce to You that there is [no longer] among us any witness [to that]
normalizedArabic: اليه يرد علم الساعه وما تخرج من ثمرت من اكمامها وما تحمل من انثي ولا تضع الا بعلمه ويوم يناديهم اين شركاءي قالوا ءاذنك مامنا من شهيد

arabic: وَضَلَّ عَنۡهُم مَّا كَانُواْ يَدۡعُونَ مِن قَبۡلُۖ وَظَنُّواْ مَا لَهُم مِّن مَّحِيصٖ
translation: And lost from them will be those they were invoking before, and they will be certain that they have no place of escape

translation: And if We let him taste mercy from Us after an adversity which has touched him, he will surely say, "This is [due] to me, and I do not think the Hour will occur; and [even] if I should be returned to my Lord, indeed, for me there will be with Him the best." But We will surely inform those who disbelieved about what they did, and We will surely make them taste a massive punishment

normalizedArabic: والذين اتخذوا من دونه اولياء الله حفيظ عليهم وما انت عليهم بوكيل
normalizedTranslation: and those who take as allies other than him - allah is [yet] guardian over them; and you, [o muhammad], are not over them a manager

arabic: وَكَذَٰلِكَ أَوۡحَيۡنَآ إِلَيۡكَ قُرۡءَانًا عَرَبِيّٗا لِّتُنذِرَ أُمَّ ٱلۡقُرَىٰ وَمَنۡ حَوۡلَهَا وَتُنذِرَ يَوۡمَ ٱلۡجَمۡعِ لَا رَيۡبَ فِيهِۚ فَرِيقٞ فِي ٱلۡجَنَّةِ وَفَرِيقٞ فِي ٱلسَّعِيرِ
translation: And thus We have revealed to you an Arabic Qur'an that you may warn the Mother of Cities [Makkah] and those around it and warn of the Day of Assembly, about which there is no doubt. A party will be in Paradise and a party in the Blaze
normalizedArabic: وكذلك اوحينا اليك قرءانا عربيا لتنذر ام القري ومن حولها وتنذر يوم الجمع لا ريب فيه فريق في الجنه وفريق في السعير
normalizedTranslation: and thus we have revealed to you an arabic qur'an that you may warn the mother of cities [makkah] and those around it and warn of the day of assembly, about which there is no doubt. a party will be in paradise and a party in the blaze

arabic: وَلَوۡ شَآءَ ٱللَّهُ لَجَعَلَهُمۡ أُمَّةٗ وَٰحِدَةٗ وَلَٰكِن يُدۡخِلُ مَن يَشَآءُ فِي رَحۡمَتِهِۦۚ وَٱلظَّـٰلِمُونَ مَا لَهُم مِّن وَلِيّٖ وَلَا نَصِيرٍ
translation: And if Allah willed, He could have made them [of] one religion, but He admits whom He wills into His mercy. And the wrongdoers have not any protector or helper
normalizedArabic: ولو شاء الله لجعلهم امه وحده ولكن يدخل من يشاء في رحمته والظلمون ما لهم من ولي ولا نصير
normalizedTranslation: and if allah willed, he could have made them [of] one religion, but he admits whom he wills into his mercy. and the wrongdoers have not any protector or helper

arabic: أَمِ ٱتَّخَذُواْ مِن دُونِهِۦٓ أَوۡلِيَآءَۖ فَٱللَّهُ هُوَ ٱلۡوَلِيُّ وَهُوَ يُحۡيِ ٱلۡمَوۡتَىٰ وَهُوَ عَلَىٰ كُلِّ شَيۡءٖ قَدِيرٞ
translation: Or have they taken protectors [or allies] besides him? But Allah - He is the Protector, and He gives life to the dead, and He is over all things competent
normalizedArabic: ام اتخذوا من دونه اولياء فالله هو الولي وهو يحي الموتي وهو علي كل شيء قدير
normalizedTranslation: or have they taken protectors [or allies] besides him? but allah - he is the protector, and he gives life to the dead, and he is over all things competent

arabic: وَمَا ٱخۡتَلَفۡتُمۡ فِيهِ مِن شَيۡءٖ فَحُكۡمُهُۥٓ إِلَى ٱللَّهِۚ ذَٰلِكُمُ ٱللَّهُ رَبِّي عَلَيۡهِ تَوَكَّلۡتُ وَإِلَيۡهِ أُنِيبُ
translation: And in anything over which you disagree - its ruling is [to be referred] to Allah. [Say], "That is Allah, my Lord; upon Him I have relied, and to Him I turn back
normalizedArabic: وما اختلفتم فيه من شيء فحكمه الي الله ذلكم الله ربي عليه توكلت واليه انيب
normalizedTranslation: and in anything over which you disagree - its ruling is [to be referred] to allah. [say], "that is allah, my lord; upon him i have relied, and to him i turn back

arabic: فَاطِرُ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلۡأَرۡضِۚ جَعَلَ لَكُم مِّنۡ أَنفُسِكُمۡ أَزۡوَٰجٗا وَمِنَ ٱلۡأَنۡعَٰمِ أَزۡوَٰجٗا يَذۡرَؤُكُمۡ فِيهِۚ لَيۡسَ كَمِثۡلِهِۦ شَيۡءٞۖ وَهُوَ ٱلسَّمِيعُ ٱلۡبَصِيرُ
translation: [He is] Creator of the heavens and the earth. He has made for you from yourselves, mates, and among the cattle, mates; He multiplies you thereby. There is nothing like unto Him, and He is the Hearing, the Seeing
normalizedArabic: فاطر السموت والارض جعل لكم من انفسكم ازوجا ومن الانعم ازوجا يذروكم فيه ليس كمثله شيء وهو السميع البصير
normalizedTranslation: [he is] creator of the heavens and the earth. he has made for you from yourselves, mates, and among the cattle, mates; he multiplies you thereby. there is nothing like unto him, and he is the hearing, the seeing

arabic: لَهُۥ مَقَالِيدُ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلۡأَرۡضِۖ يَبۡسُطُ ٱلرِّزۡقَ لِمَن يَشَآءُ وَيَقۡدِرُۚ إِنَّهُۥ بِكُلِّ شَيۡءٍ عَلِيمٞ
translation: To Him belong the keys of the heavens and the earth. He extends provision for whom He wills and restricts [it]. Indeed He is, of all things, Knowing
normalizedArabic: له مقاليد السموت والارض يبسط الرزق لمن يشاء ويقدر انه بكل شيء عليم
normalizedTranslation: to him belong the keys of the heavens and the earth. he extends provision for whom he wills and restricts [it]. indeed he is, of all things, knowing

arabic: ۞شَرَعَ لَكُم مِّنَ ٱلدِّينِ مَا وَصَّىٰ بِهِۦ نُوحٗا وَٱلَّذِيٓ أَوۡحَيۡنَآ إِلَيۡكَ وَمَا وَصَّيۡنَا بِهِۦٓ إِبۡرَٰهِيمَ وَمُوسَىٰ وَعِيسَىٰٓۖ أَنۡ أَقِيمُواْ ٱلدِّينَ وَلَا تَتَفَرَّقُواْ فِيهِۚ كَبُرَ عَلَى ٱلۡمُشۡرِكِينَ مَا تَدۡعُوهُمۡ إِلَيۡهِۚ ٱللَّهُ يَجۡتَبِيٓ إِلَيۡهِ مَن يَشَآءُ وَيَهۡدِيٓ إِلَيۡهِ مَن يُنِيبُ
translation: He has ordained for you of religion what He enjoined upon Noah and that which We have revealed to you, [O Muhammad], and what We enjoined upon Abraham and Moses and Jesus - to establish the religion and not be divided therein. Difficult for those who associate others with Allah is that to which you invite them. Allah chooses for Himself whom He wills and guides to Himself whoever turns back [to Him]
normalizedArabic: شرع لكم من الدين ما وصي به نوحا والذي اوحينا اليك وما وصينا به ابرهيم وموسي وعيسي ان اقيموا الدين ولا تتفرقوا فيه كبر علي المشركين ما تدعوهم اليه الله يجتبي اليه من يشاء ويهدي اليه من ينيب
normalizedTranslation: he has ordained for you of religion what he enjoined upon noah and that which we have revealed to you, [o muhammad], and what we enjoined upon abraham and moses and jesus - to establish the religion and not be divided therein. difficult for those who associate others with allah is that to which you invite them. allah chooses for himself whom he wills and guides to himself whoever turns back [to him]

arabic: وَمَا تَفَرَّقُوٓاْ إِلَّا مِنۢ بَعۡدِ مَا جَآءَهُمُ ٱلۡعِلۡمُ بَغۡيَۢا بَيۡنَهُمۡۚ وَلَوۡلَا كَلِمَةٞ سَبَقَتۡ مِن رَّبِّكَ إِلَىٰٓ أَجَلٖ مُّسَمّٗى لَّقُضِيَ بَيۡنَهُمۡۚ وَإِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ أُورِثُواْ ٱلۡكِتَٰبَ مِنۢ بَعۡدِهِمۡ لَفِي شَكّٖ مِّنۡهُ مُرِيبٖ
translation: And they did not become divided until after knowledge had come to them - out of jealous animosity between themselves. And if not for a word that preceded from your Lord [postponing the penalty] until a specified time, it would have been concluded between them. And indeed, those who were granted inheritance of the Scripture after them are, concerning it, in disquieting doubt
normalizedArabic: وما تفرقوا الا من بعد ما جاءهم العلم بغيا بينهم ولولا كلمه سبقت من ربك الي اجل مسمي لقضي بينهم وان الذين اورثوا الكتب من بعدهم لفي شك منه مريب
normalizedTranslation: and they did not become divided until after knowledge had come to them - out of jealous animosity between themselves. and if not for a word that preceded from your lord [postponing the penalty] until a specified time, it would have been concluded between them. and indeed, those who were granted inheritance of the scripture after them are, concerning it, in disquieting doubt

arabic: فَلِذَٰلِكَ فَٱدۡعُۖ وَٱسۡتَقِمۡ كَمَآ أُمِرۡتَۖ وَلَا تَتَّبِعۡ أَهۡوَآءَهُمۡۖ وَقُلۡ ءَامَنتُ بِمَآ أَنزَلَ ٱللَّهُ مِن كِتَٰبٖۖ وَأُمِرۡتُ لِأَعۡدِلَ بَيۡنَكُمُۖ ٱللَّهُ رَبُّنَا وَرَبُّكُمۡۖ لَنَآ أَعۡمَٰلُنَا وَلَكُمۡ أَعۡمَٰلُكُمۡۖ لَا حُجَّةَ بَيۡنَنَا وَبَيۡنَكُمُۖ ٱللَّهُ يَجۡمَعُ بَيۡنَنَاۖ وَإِلَيۡهِ ٱلۡمَصِيرُ
translation: So to that [religion of Allah] invite, [O Muhammad], and remain on a right course as you are commanded and do not follow their inclinations but say, "I have believed in what Allah has revealed of the Qur'an, and I have been commanded to do justice among you. Allah is our Lord and your Lord. For us are our deeds, and for you your deeds. There is no [need for] argument between us and you. Allah will bring us together, and to Him is the [final] destination
normalizedArabic: فلذلك فادع واستقم كما امرت ولا تتبع اهواءهم وقل ءامنت بما انزل الله من كتب وامرت لاعدل بينكم الله ربنا وربكم لنا اعملنا ولكم اعملكم لا حجه بيننا وبينكم الله يجمع بيننا واليه المصير
normalizedTranslation: so to that [religion of allah] invite, [o muhammad], and remain on a right course as you are commanded and do not follow their inclinations but say, "i have believed in what allah has revealed of the qur'an, and i have been commanded to do justice among you. allah is our lord and your lord. for us are our deeds, and for you your deeds. there is no [need for] argument between us and you. allah will bring us together, and to him is the [final] destination

arabic: وَٱلَّذِينَ يُحَآجُّونَ فِي ٱللَّهِ مِنۢ بَعۡدِ مَا ٱسۡتُجِيبَ لَهُۥ حُجَّتُهُمۡ دَاحِضَةٌ عِندَ رَبِّهِمۡ وَعَلَيۡهِمۡ غَضَبٞ وَلَهُمۡ عَذَابٞ شَدِيدٌ
translation: And those who argue concerning Allah after He has been responded to - their argument is invalid with their Lord, and upon them is [His] wrath, and for them is a severe punishment
normalizedArabic: والذين يحاجون في الله من بعد ما استجيب له حجتهم داحضه عند ربهم وعليهم غضب ولهم عذاب شديد
normalizedTranslation: and those who argue concerning allah after he has been responded to - their argument is invalid with their lord, and upon them is [his] wrath, and for them is a severe punishment

arabic: ٱللَّهُ ٱلَّذِيٓ أَنزَلَ ٱلۡكِتَٰبَ بِٱلۡحَقِّ وَٱلۡمِيزَانَۗ وَمَا يُدۡرِيكَ لَعَلَّ ٱلسَّاعَةَ قَرِيبٞ
translation: It is Allah who has sent down the Book in truth and [also] the balance. And what will make you perceive? Perhaps the Hour is near
normalizedArabic: الله الذي انزل الكتب بالحق والميزان وما يدريك لعل الساعه قريب
normalizedTranslation: it is allah who has sent down the book in truth and [also] the balance. and what will make you perceive? perhaps the hour is near

arabic: يَسۡتَعۡجِلُ بِهَا ٱلَّذِينَ لَا يُؤۡمِنُونَ بِهَاۖ وَٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُواْ مُشۡفِقُونَ مِنۡهَا وَيَعۡلَمُونَ أَنَّهَا ٱلۡحَقُّۗ أَلَآ إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ يُمَارُونَ فِي ٱلسَّاعَةِ لَفِي ضَلَٰلِۭ بَعِيدٍ
translation: Those who do not believe in it are impatient for it, but those who believe are fearful of it and know that it is the truth. Unquestionably, those who dispute concerning the Hour are in extreme error
normalizedArabic: يستعجل بها الذين لا يومنون بها والذين ءامنوا مشفقون منها ويعلمون انها الحق الا ان الذين يمارون في الساعه لفي ضلل بعيد
normalizedTranslation: those who do not believe in it are impatient for it, but those who believe are fearful of it and know that it is the truth. unquestionably, those who dispute concerning the hour are in extreme error

arabic: ٱللَّهُ لَطِيفُۢ بِعِبَادِهِۦ يَرۡزُقُ مَن يَشَآءُۖ وَهُوَ ٱلۡقَوِيُّ ٱلۡعَزِيزُ
translation: Allah is Subtle with His servants; He gives provisions to whom He wills. And He is the Powerful, the Exalted in Might
normalizedArabic: الله لطيف بعباده يرزق من يشاء وهو القوي العزيز
normalizedTranslation: allah is subtle with his servants; he gives provisions to whom he wills. and he is the powerful, the exalted in might

arabic: مَن كَانَ يُرِيدُ حَرۡثَ ٱلۡأٓخِرَةِ نَزِدۡ لَهُۥ فِي حَرۡثِهِۦۖ وَمَن كَانَ يُرِيدُ حَرۡثَ ٱلدُّنۡيَا نُؤۡتِهِۦ مِنۡهَا وَمَا لَهُۥ فِي ٱلۡأٓخِرَةِ مِن نَّصِيبٍ
translation: Whoever desires the harvest of the Hereafter - We increase for him in his harvest. And whoever desires the harvest of this world - We give him thereof, but there is not for him in the Hereafter any share
normalizedArabic: من كان يريد حرث الاخره نزد له في حرثه ومن كان يريد حرث الدنيا نوته منها وما له في الاخره من نصيب
normalizedTranslation: whoever desires the harvest of the hereafter - we increase for him in his harvest. and whoever desires the harvest of this world - we give him thereof, but there is not for him in the hereafter any share

arabic: أَمۡ لَهُمۡ شُرَكَـٰٓؤُاْ شَرَعُواْ لَهُم مِّنَ ٱلدِّينِ مَا لَمۡ يَأۡذَنۢ بِهِ ٱللَّهُۚ وَلَوۡلَا كَلِمَةُ ٱلۡفَصۡلِ لَقُضِيَ بَيۡنَهُمۡۗ وَإِنَّ ٱلظَّـٰلِمِينَ لَهُمۡ عَذَابٌ أَلِيمٞ
translation: Or have they other deities who have ordained for them a religion to which Allah has not consented? But if not for the decisive word, it would have been concluded between them. And indeed, the wrongdoers will have a painful punishment
normalizedArabic: ام لهم شركوا شرعوا لهم من الدين ما لم ياذن به الله ولولا كلمه الفصل لقضي بينهم وان الظلمين لهم عذاب اليم
normalizedTranslation: or have they other deities who have ordained for them a religion to which allah has not consented? but if not for the decisive word, it would have been concluded between them. and indeed, the wrongdoers will have a painful punishment

arabic: تَرَى ٱلظَّـٰلِمِينَ مُشۡفِقِينَ مِمَّا كَسَبُواْ وَهُوَ وَاقِعُۢ بِهِمۡۗ وَٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُواْ وَعَمِلُواْ ٱلصَّـٰلِحَٰتِ فِي رَوۡضَاتِ ٱلۡجَنَّاتِۖ لَهُم مَّا يَشَآءُونَ عِندَ رَبِّهِمۡۚ ذَٰلِكَ هُوَ ٱلۡفَضۡلُ ٱلۡكَبِيرُ
translation: You will see the wrongdoers fearful of what they have earned, and it will [certainly] befall them. And those who have believed and done righteous deeds will be in lush regions of the gardens [in Paradise] having whatever they will in the presence of their Lord. That is what is the great bounty
normalizedArabic: تري الظلمين مشفقين مما كسبوا وهو واقع بهم والذين ءامنوا وعملوا الصلحت في روضات الجنات لهم ما يشاءون عند ربهم ذلك هو الفضل الكبير
normalizedTranslation: you will see the wrongdoers fearful of what they have earned, and it will [certainly] befall them. and those who have believed and done righteous deeds will be in lush regions of the gardens [in paradise] having whatever they will in the presence of their lord. that is what is the great bounty

arabic: ذَٰلِكَ ٱلَّذِي يُبَشِّرُ ٱللَّهُ عِبَادَهُ ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُواْ وَعَمِلُواْ ٱلصَّـٰلِحَٰتِۗ قُل لَّآ أَسۡـَٔلُكُمۡ عَلَيۡهِ أَجۡرًا إِلَّا ٱلۡمَوَدَّةَ فِي ٱلۡقُرۡبَىٰۗ وَمَن يَقۡتَرِفۡ حَسَنَةٗ نَّزِدۡ لَهُۥ فِيهَا حُسۡنًاۚ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ غَفُورٞ شَكُورٌ
translation: It is that of which Allah gives good tidings to His servants who believe and do righteous deeds. Say, [O Muhammad], "I do not ask you for this message any payment [but] only good will through kinship." And whoever commits a good deed - We will increase for him good therein. Indeed, Allah is Forgiving and Appreciative
normalizedArabic: ذلك الذي يبشر الله عباده الذين ءامنوا وعملوا الصلحت قل لا اسلكم عليه اجرا الا الموده في القربي ومن يقترف حسنه نزد له فيها حسنا ان الله غفور شكور
normalizedTranslation: it is that of which allah gives good tidings to his servants who believe and do righteous deeds. say, [o muhammad], "i do not ask you for this message any payment [but] only good will through kinship." and whoever commits a good deed - we will increase for him good therein. indeed, allah is forgiving and appreciative

arabic: أَمۡ يَقُولُونَ ٱفۡتَرَىٰ عَلَى ٱللَّهِ كَذِبٗاۖ فَإِن يَشَإِ ٱللَّهُ يَخۡتِمۡ عَلَىٰ قَلۡبِكَۗ وَيَمۡحُ ٱللَّهُ ٱلۡبَٰطِلَ وَيُحِقُّ ٱلۡحَقَّ بِكَلِمَٰتِهِۦٓۚ إِنَّهُۥ عَلِيمُۢ بِذَاتِ ٱلصُّدُورِ
translation: Or do they say, "He has invented about Allah a lie"? But if Allah willed, He could seal over your heart. And Allah eliminates falsehood and establishes the truth by His words. Indeed, He is Knowing of that within the breasts
normalizedArabic: ام يقولون افتري علي الله كذبا فان يشا الله يختم علي قلبك ويمح الله البطل ويحق الحق بكلمته انه عليم بذات الصدور
normalizedTranslation: or do they say, "he has invented about allah a lie"? but if allah willed, he could seal over your heart. and allah eliminates falsehood and establishes the truth by his words. indeed, he is knowing of that within the breasts

arabic: وَهُوَ ٱلَّذِي يَقۡبَلُ ٱلتَّوۡبَةَ عَنۡ عِبَادِهِۦ وَيَعۡفُواْ عَنِ ٱلسَّيِّـَٔاتِ وَيَعۡلَمُ مَا تَفۡعَلُونَ
translation: And it is He who accepts repentance from his servants and pardons misdeeds, and He knows what you do
normalizedArabic: وهو الذي يقبل التوبه عن عباده ويعفوا عن السيات ويعلم ما تفعلون
normalizedTranslation: and it is he who accepts repentance from his servants and pardons misdeeds, and he knows what you do

arabic: وَيَسۡتَجِيبُ ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُواْ وَعَمِلُواْ ٱلصَّـٰلِحَٰتِ وَيَزِيدُهُم مِّن فَضۡلِهِۦۚ وَٱلۡكَٰفِرُونَ لَهُمۡ عَذَابٞ شَدِيدٞ
translation: And He answers [the supplication of] those who have believed and done righteous deeds and increases [for] them from His bounty. But the disbelievers will have a severe punishment
normalizedArabic: ويستجيب الذين ءامنوا وعملوا الصلحت ويزيدهم من فضله والكفرون لهم عذاب شديد
normalizedTranslation: and he answers [the supplication of] those who have believed and done righteous deeds and increases [for] them from his bounty. but the disbelievers will have a severe punishment

arabic: ۞وَلَوۡ بَسَطَ ٱللَّهُ ٱلرِّزۡقَ لِعِبَادِهِۦ لَبَغَوۡاْ فِي ٱلۡأَرۡضِ وَلَٰكِن يُنَزِّلُ بِقَدَرٖ مَّا يَشَآءُۚ إِنَّهُۥ بِعِبَادِهِۦ خَبِيرُۢ بَصِيرٞ
translation: And if Allah had extended [excessively] provision for His servants, they would have committed tyranny throughout the earth. But He sends [it] down in an amount which He wills. Indeed He is, of His servants, Acquainted and Seeing
normalizedArabic: ولو بسط الله الرزق لعباده لبغوا في الارض ولكن ينزل بقدر ما يشاء انه بعباده خبير بصير
normalizedTranslation: and if allah had extended [excessively] provision for his servants, they would have committed tyranny throughout the earth. but he sends [it] down in an amount which he wills. indeed he is, of his servants, acquainted and seeing

arabic: وَهُوَ ٱلَّذِي يُنَزِّلُ ٱلۡغَيۡثَ مِنۢ بَعۡدِ مَا قَنَطُواْ وَيَنشُرُ رَحۡمَتَهُۥۚ وَهُوَ ٱلۡوَلِيُّ ٱلۡحَمِيدُ
translation: And it is He who sends down the rain after they had despaired and spreads His mercy. And He is the Protector, the Praiseworthy
normalizedArabic: وهو الذي ينزل الغيث من بعد ما قنطوا وينشر رحمته وهو الولي الحميد
normalizedTranslation: and it is he who sends down the rain after they had despaired and spreads his mercy. and he is the protector, the praiseworthy

arabic: وَمِنۡ ءَايَٰتِهِۦ خَلۡقُ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلۡأَرۡضِ وَمَا بَثَّ فِيهِمَا مِن دَآبَّةٖۚ وَهُوَ عَلَىٰ جَمۡعِهِمۡ إِذَا يَشَآءُ قَدِيرٞ
translation: And of his signs is the creation of the heavens and earth and what He has dispersed throughout them of creatures. And He, for gathering them when He wills, is competent
normalizedArabic: ومن ءايته خلق السموت والارض وما بث فيهما من دابه وهو علي جمعهم اذا يشاء قدير
normalizedTranslation: and of his signs is the creation of the heavens and earth and what he has dispersed throughout them of creatures. and he, for gathering them when he wills, is competent

arabic: وَمَآ أَصَٰبَكُم مِّن مُّصِيبَةٖ فَبِمَا كَسَبَتۡ أَيۡدِيكُمۡ وَيَعۡفُواْ عَن كَثِيرٖ
translation: And whatever strikes you of disaster - it is for what your hands have earned; but He pardons much
normalizedArabic: وما اصبكم من مصيبه فبما كسبت ايديكم ويعفوا عن كثير
normalizedTranslation: and whatever strikes you of disaster - it is for what your hands have earned; but he pardons much

arabic: وَمَآ أَنتُم بِمُعۡجِزِينَ فِي ٱلۡأَرۡضِۖ وَمَا لَكُم مِّن دُونِ ٱللَّهِ مِن وَلِيّٖ وَلَا نَصِيرٖ
translation: And you will not cause failure [to Allah] upon the earth. And you have not besides Allah any protector or helper
normalizedArabic: وما انتم بمعجزين في الارض وما لكم من دون الله من ولي ولا نصير
normalizedTranslation: and you will not cause failure [to allah] upon the earth. and you have not besides allah any protector or helper

arabic: وَمِنۡ ءَايَٰتِهِ ٱلۡجَوَارِ فِي ٱلۡبَحۡرِ كَٱلۡأَعۡلَٰمِ
translation: And of His signs are the ships in the sea, like mountains
normalizedArabic: ومن ءايته الجوار في البحر كالاعلم
normalizedTranslation: and of his signs are the ships in the sea, like mountains

arabic: إِن يَشَأۡ يُسۡكِنِ ٱلرِّيحَ فَيَظۡلَلۡنَ رَوَاكِدَ عَلَىٰ ظَهۡرِهِۦٓۚ إِنَّ فِي ذَٰلِكَ لَأٓيَٰتٖ لِّكُلِّ صَبَّارٖ شَكُورٍ
translation: If He willed, He could still the wind, and they would remain motionless on its surface. Indeed in that are signs for everyone patient and grateful
normalizedArabic: ان يشا يسكن الريح فيظللن رواكد علي ظهره ان في ذلك لايت لكل صبار شكور
normalizedTranslation: if he willed, he could still the wind, and they would remain motionless on its surface. indeed in that are signs for everyone patient and grateful

arabic: أَوۡ يُوبِقۡهُنَّ بِمَا كَسَبُواْ وَيَعۡفُ عَن كَثِيرٖ
translation: Or He could destroy them for what they earned; but He pardons much
normalizedArabic: او يوبقهن بما كسبوا ويعف عن كثير
normalizedTranslation: or he could destroy them for what they earned; but he pardons much

arabic: وَيَعۡلَمَ ٱلَّذِينَ يُجَٰدِلُونَ فِيٓ ءَايَٰتِنَا مَا لَهُم مِّن مَّحِيصٖ
translation: And [that is so] those who dispute concerning Our signs may know that for them there is no place of escape
normalizedArabic: ويعلم الذين يجدلون في ءايتنا ما لهم من محيص
normalizedTranslation: and [that is so] those who dispute concerning our signs may know that for them there is no place of escape

arabic: فَمَآ أُوتِيتُم مِّن شَيۡءٖ فَمَتَٰعُ ٱلۡحَيَوٰةِ ٱلدُّنۡيَاۚ وَمَا عِندَ ٱللَّهِ خَيۡرٞ وَأَبۡقَىٰ لِلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُواْ وَعَلَىٰ رَبِّهِمۡ يَتَوَكَّلُونَ
translation: So whatever thing you have been given - it is but [for] enjoyment of the worldly life. But what is with Allah is better and more lasting for those who have believed and upon their Lord rely
normalizedArabic: فما اوتيتم من شيء فمتع الحيوه الدنيا وما عند الله خير وابقي للذين ءامنوا وعلي ربهم يتوكلون
normalizedTranslation: so whatever thing you have been given - it is but [for] enjoyment of the worldly life. but what is with allah is better and more lasting for those who have believed and upon their lord rely

arabic: وَٱلَّذِينَ يَجۡتَنِبُونَ كَبَـٰٓئِرَ ٱلۡإِثۡمِ وَٱلۡفَوَٰحِشَ وَإِذَا مَا غَضِبُواْ هُمۡ يَغۡفِرُونَ
translation: And those who avoid the major sins and immoralities, and when they are angry, they forgive
normalizedArabic: والذين يجتنبون كبير الاثم والفوحش واذا ما غضبوا هم يغفرون
normalizedTranslation: and those who avoid the major sins and immoralities, and when they are angry, they forgive

arabic: وَٱلَّذِينَ ٱسۡتَجَابُواْ لِرَبِّهِمۡ وَأَقَامُواْ ٱلصَّلَوٰةَ وَأَمۡرُهُمۡ شُورَىٰ بَيۡنَهُمۡ وَمِمَّا رَزَقۡنَٰهُمۡ يُنفِقُونَ
translation: And those who have responded to their lord and established prayer and whose affair is [determined by] consultation among themselves, and from what We have provided them, they spend
normalizedArabic: والذين استجابوا لربهم واقاموا الصلوه وامرهم شوري بينهم ومما رزقنهم ينفقون
normalizedTranslation: and those who have responded to their lord and established prayer and whose affair is [determined by] consultation among themselves, and from what we have provided them, they spend

arabic: وَٱلَّذِينَ إِذَآ أَصَابَهُمُ ٱلۡبَغۡيُ هُمۡ يَنتَصِرُونَ
translation: And those who, when tyranny strikes them, they defend themselves
normalizedArabic: والذين اذا اصابهم البغي هم ينتصرون
normalizedTranslation: and those who, when tyranny strikes them, they defend themselves

arabic: وَجَزَـٰٓؤُاْ سَيِّئَةٖ سَيِّئَةٞ مِّثۡلُهَاۖ فَمَنۡ عَفَا وَأَصۡلَحَ فَأَجۡرُهُۥ عَلَى ٱللَّهِۚ إِنَّهُۥ لَا يُحِبُّ ٱلظَّـٰلِمِينَ
translation: And the retribution for an evil act is an evil one like it, but whoever pardons and makes reconciliation - his reward is [due] from Allah. Indeed, He does not like wrongdoers
normalizedArabic: وجزوا سييه سييه مثلها فمن عفا واصلح فاجره علي الله انه لا يحب الظلمين
normalizedTranslation: and the retribution for an evil act is an evil one like it, but whoever pardons and makes reconciliation - his reward is [due] from allah. indeed, he does not like wrongdoers

arabic: وَلَمَنِ ٱنتَصَرَ بَعۡدَ ظُلۡمِهِۦ فَأُوْلَـٰٓئِكَ مَا عَلَيۡهِم مِّن سَبِيلٍ
translation: And whoever avenges himself after having been wronged - those have not upon them any cause [for blame]
normalizedArabic: ولمن انتصر بعد ظلمه فاوليك ما عليهم من سبيل
normalizedTranslation: and whoever avenges himself after having been wronged - those have not upon them any cause [for blame]

arabic: إِنَّمَا ٱلسَّبِيلُ عَلَى ٱلَّذِينَ يَظۡلِمُونَ ٱلنَّاسَ وَيَبۡغُونَ فِي ٱلۡأَرۡضِ بِغَيۡرِ ٱلۡحَقِّۚ أُوْلَـٰٓئِكَ لَهُمۡ عَذَابٌ أَلِيمٞ
translation: The cause is only against the ones who wrong the people and tyrannize upon the earth without right. Those will have a painful punishment
normalizedArabic: انما السبيل علي الذين يظلمون الناس ويبغون في الارض بغير الحق اوليك لهم عذاب اليم
normalizedTranslation: the cause is only against the ones who wrong the people and tyrannize upon the earth without right. those will have a painful punishment

arabic: وَلَمَن صَبَرَ وَغَفَرَ إِنَّ ذَٰلِكَ لَمِنۡ عَزۡمِ ٱلۡأُمُورِ
translation: And whoever is patient and forgives - indeed, that is of the matters [requiring] determination
normalizedArabic: ولمن صبر وغفر ان ذلك لمن عزم الامور
normalizedTranslation: and whoever is patient and forgives - indeed, that is of the matters [requiring] determination

arabic: وَمَن يُضۡلِلِ ٱللَّهُ فَمَا لَهُۥ مِن وَلِيّٖ مِّنۢ بَعۡدِهِۦۗ وَتَرَى ٱلظَّـٰلِمِينَ لَمَّا رَأَوُاْ ٱلۡعَذَابَ يَقُولُونَ هَلۡ إِلَىٰ مَرَدّٖ مِّن سَبِيلٖ
translation: And he whom Allah sends astray - for him there is no protector beyond Him. And you will see the wrongdoers, when they see the punishment, saying, "Is there for return [to the former world] any way
normalizedArabic: ومن يضلل الله فما له من ولي من بعده وتري الظلمين لما راوا العذاب يقولون هل الي مرد من سبيل
normalizedTranslation: and he whom allah sends astray - for him there is no protector beyond him. and you will see the wrongdoers, when they see the punishment, saying, "is there for return [to the former world] any way

arabic: وَتَرَىٰهُمۡ يُعۡرَضُونَ عَلَيۡهَا خَٰشِعِينَ مِنَ ٱلذُّلِّ يَنظُرُونَ مِن طَرۡفٍ خَفِيّٖۗ وَقَالَ ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوٓاْ إِنَّ ٱلۡخَٰسِرِينَ ٱلَّذِينَ خَسِرُوٓاْ أَنفُسَهُمۡ وَأَهۡلِيهِمۡ يَوۡمَ ٱلۡقِيَٰمَةِۗ أَلَآ إِنَّ ٱلظَّـٰلِمِينَ فِي عَذَابٖ مُّقِيمٖ
translation: And you will see them being exposed to the Fire, humbled from humiliation, looking from [behind] a covert glance. And those who had believed will say, "Indeed, the [true] losers are the ones who lost themselves and their families on the Day of Resurrection. Unquestionably, the wrongdoers are in an enduring punishment
normalizedArabic: وتريهم يعرضون عليها خشعين من الذل ينظرون من طرف خفي وقال الذين ءامنوا ان الخسرين الذين خسروا انفسهم واهليهم يوم القيمه الا ان الظلمين في عذاب مقيم
normalizedTranslation: and you will see them being exposed to the fire, humbled from humiliation, looking from [behind] a covert glance. and those who had believed will say, "indeed, the [true] losers are the ones who lost themselves and their families on the day of resurrection. unquestionably, the wrongdoers are in an enduring punishment

arabic: وَمَا كَانَ لَهُم مِّنۡ أَوۡلِيَآءَ يَنصُرُونَهُم مِّن دُونِ ٱللَّهِۗ وَمَن يُضۡلِلِ ٱللَّهُ فَمَا لَهُۥ مِن سَبِيلٍ
translation: And there will not be for them any allies to aid them other than Allah. And whoever Allah sends astray - for him there is no way
normalizedArabic: وما كان لهم من اولياء ينصرونهم من دون الله ومن يضلل الله فما له من سبيل
normalizedTranslation: and there will not be for them any allies to aid them other than allah. and whoever allah sends astray - for him there is no way

arabic: ٱسۡتَجِيبُواْ لِرَبِّكُم مِّن قَبۡلِ أَن يَأۡتِيَ يَوۡمٞ لَّا مَرَدَّ لَهُۥ مِنَ ٱللَّهِۚ مَا لَكُم مِّن مَّلۡجَإٖ يَوۡمَئِذٖ وَمَا لَكُم مِّن نَّكِيرٖ
translation: Respond to your Lord before a Day comes from Allah of which there is no repelling. No refuge will you have that day, nor for you will there be any denial
normalizedArabic: استجيبوا لربكم من قبل ان ياتي يوم لا مرد له من الله ما لكم من ملجا يوميذ وما لكم من نكير
normalizedTranslation: respond to your lord before a day comes from allah of which there is no repelling. no refuge will you have that day, nor for you will there be any denial

arabic: فَإِنۡ أَعۡرَضُواْ فَمَآ أَرۡسَلۡنَٰكَ عَلَيۡهِمۡ حَفِيظًاۖ إِنۡ عَلَيۡكَ إِلَّا ٱلۡبَلَٰغُۗ وَإِنَّآ إِذَآ أَذَقۡنَا ٱلۡإِنسَٰنَ مِنَّا رَحۡمَةٗ فَرِحَ بِهَاۖ وَإِن تُصِبۡهُمۡ سَيِّئَةُۢ بِمَا قَدَّمَتۡ أَيۡدِيهِمۡ فَإِنَّ ٱلۡإِنسَٰنَ كَفُورٞ
translation: But if they turn away - then We have not sent you, [O Muhammad], over them as a guardian; upon you is only [the duty of] notification. And indeed, when We let man taste mercy from us, he rejoices in it; but if evil afflicts him for what his hands have put forth, then indeed, man is ungrateful
normalizedArabic: فان اعرضوا فما ارسلنك عليهم حفيظا ان عليك الا البلغ وانا اذا اذقنا الانسن منا رحمه فرح بها وان تصبهم سييه بما قدمت ايديهم فان الانسن كفور
normalizedTranslation: but if they turn away - then we have not sent you, [o muhammad], over them as a guardian; upon you is only [the duty of] notification. and indeed, when we let man taste mercy from us, he rejoices in it; but if evil afflicts him for what his hands have put forth, then indeed, man is ungrateful

arabic: لِّلَّهِ مُلۡكُ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلۡأَرۡضِۚ يَخۡلُقُ مَا يَشَآءُۚ يَهَبُ لِمَن يَشَآءُ إِنَٰثٗا وَيَهَبُ لِمَن يَشَآءُ ٱلذُّكُورَ
translation: To Allah belongs the dominion of the heavens and the earth; He creates what he wills. He gives to whom He wills female [children], and He gives to whom He wills males
normalizedArabic: لله ملك السموت والارض يخلق ما يشاء يهب لمن يشاء انثا ويهب لمن يشاء الذكور
normalizedTranslation: to allah belongs the dominion of the heavens and the earth; he creates what he wills. he gives to whom he wills female [children], and he gives to whom he wills males

arabic: أَوۡ يُزَوِّجُهُمۡ ذُكۡرَانٗا وَإِنَٰثٗاۖ وَيَجۡعَلُ مَن يَشَآءُ عَقِيمًاۚ إِنَّهُۥ عَلِيمٞ قَدِيرٞ
translation: Or He makes them [both] males and females, and He renders whom He wills barren. Indeed, He is Knowing and Competent
normalizedArabic: او يزوجهم ذكرانا وانثا ويجعل من يشاء عقيما انه عليم قدير
normalizedTranslation: or he makes them [both] males and females, and he renders whom he wills barren. indeed, he is knowing and competent

arabic: ۞وَمَا كَانَ لِبَشَرٍ أَن يُكَلِّمَهُ ٱللَّهُ إِلَّا وَحۡيًا أَوۡ مِن وَرَآيِٕ حِجَابٍ أَوۡ يُرۡسِلَ رَسُولٗا فَيُوحِيَ بِإِذۡنِهِۦ مَا يَشَآءُۚ إِنَّهُۥ عَلِيٌّ حَكِيمٞ
translation: And it is not for any human being that Allah should speak to him except by revelation or from behind a partition or that He sends a messenger to reveal, by His permission, what He wills. Indeed, He is Most High and Wise
normalizedArabic: وما كان لبشر ان يكلمه الله الا وحيا او من وراي حجاب او يرسل رسولا فيوحي باذنه ما يشاء انه علي حكيم
normalizedTranslation: and it is not for any human being that allah should speak to him except by revelation or from behind a partition or that he sends a messenger to reveal, by his permission, what he wills. indeed, he is most high and wise

arabic: وَكَذَٰلِكَ أَوۡحَيۡنَآ إِلَيۡكَ رُوحٗا مِّنۡ أَمۡرِنَاۚ مَا كُنتَ تَدۡرِي مَا ٱلۡكِتَٰبُ وَلَا ٱلۡإِيمَٰنُ وَلَٰكِن جَعَلۡنَٰهُ نُورٗا نَّهۡدِي بِهِۦ مَن نَّشَآءُ مِنۡ عِبَادِنَاۚ وَإِنَّكَ لَتَهۡدِيٓ إِلَىٰ صِرَٰطٖ مُّسۡتَقِيمٖ
translation: And thus We have revealed to you an inspiration of Our command. You did not know what is the Book or [what is] faith, but We have made it a light by which We guide whom We will of Our servants. And indeed, [O Muhammad], you guide to a straight path
normalizedArabic: وكذلك اوحينا اليك روحا من امرنا ما كنت تدري ما الكتب ولا الايمن ولكن جعلنه نورا نهدي به من نشاء من عبادنا وانك لتهدي الي صرط مستقيم
normalizedTranslation: and thus we have revealed to you an inspiration of our command. you did not know what is the book or [what is] faith, but we have made it a light by which we guide whom we will of our servants. and indeed, [o muhammad], you guide to a straight path

arabic: صِرَٰطِ ٱللَّهِ ٱلَّذِي لَهُۥ مَا فِي ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَمَا فِي ٱلۡأَرۡضِۗ أَلَآ إِلَى ٱللَّهِ تَصِيرُ ٱلۡأُمُورُ
translation: The path of Allah, to whom belongs whatever is in the heavens and whatever is on the earth. Unquestionably, to Allah do [all] matters evolve
normalizedArabic: صرط الله الذي له ما في السموت وما في الارض الا الي الله تصير الامور
normalizedTranslation: the path of allah, to whom belongs whatever is in the heavens and whatever is on the earth. unquestionably, to allah do [all] matters evolve

arabic: حمٓ
translation: Ha, Meem
normalizedArabic: حم
normalizedTranslation: ha, meem

arabic: وَٱلۡكِتَٰبِ ٱلۡمُبِينِ
translation: By the clear Book
normalizedArabic: والكتب المبين
normalizedTranslation: by the clear book

arabic: إِنَّا جَعَلۡنَٰهُ قُرۡءَٰنًا عَرَبِيّٗا لَّعَلَّكُمۡ تَعۡقِلُونَ
translation: Indeed, We have made it an Arabic Qur'an that you might understand
normalizedArabic: انا جعلنه قرءنا عربيا لعلكم تعقلون
normalizedTranslation: indeed, we have made it an arabic qur'an that you might understand

arabic: وَإِنَّهُۥ فِيٓ أُمِّ ٱلۡكِتَٰبِ لَدَيۡنَا لَعَلِيٌّ حَكِيمٌ
translation: And indeed it is, in the Mother of the Book with Us, exalted and full of wisdom
normalizedArabic: وانه في ام الكتب لدينا لعلي حكيم
normalizedTranslation: and indeed it is, in the mother of the book with us, exalted and full of wisdom

arabic: أَفَنَضۡرِبُ عَنكُمُ ٱلذِّكۡرَ صَفۡحًا أَن كُنتُمۡ قَوۡمٗا مُّسۡرِفِينَ
translation: Then should We turn the message away, disregarding you, because you are a transgressing people
normalizedArabic: افنضرب عنكم الذكر صفحا ان كنتم قوما مسرفين
normalizedTranslation: then should we turn the message away, disregarding you, because you are a transgressing people

arabic: وَكَمۡ أَرۡسَلۡنَا مِن نَّبِيّٖ فِي ٱلۡأَوَّلِينَ
translation: And how many a prophet We sent among the former peoples
normalizedArabic: وكم ارسلنا من نبي في الاولين
normalizedTranslation: and how many a prophet we sent among the former peoples

arabic: وَمَا يَأۡتِيهِم مِّن نَّبِيٍّ إِلَّا كَانُواْ بِهِۦ يَسۡتَهۡزِءُونَ
translation: But there would not come to them a prophet except that they used to ridicule him
normalizedArabic: وما ياتيهم من نبي الا كانوا به يستهزءون
normalizedTranslation: but there would not come to them a prophet except that they used to ridicule him

arabic: فَأَهۡلَكۡنَآ أَشَدَّ مِنۡهُم بَطۡشٗا وَمَضَىٰ مَثَلُ ٱلۡأَوَّلِينَ
translation: And We destroyed greater than them in [striking] power, and the example of the former peoples has preceded
normalizedArabic: فاهلكنا اشد منهم بطشا ومضي مثل الاولين
normalizedTranslation: and we destroyed greater than them in [striking] power, and the example of the former peoples has preceded

arabic: وَلَئِن سَأَلۡتَهُم مَّنۡ خَلَقَ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلۡأَرۡضَ لَيَقُولُنَّ خَلَقَهُنَّ ٱلۡعَزِيزُ ٱلۡعَلِيمُ
translation: And if you should ask them, "Who has created the heavens and the earth?" they would surely say, "They were created by the Exalted in Might, the Knowing
normalizedArabic: ولين سالتهم من خلق السموت والارض ليقولن خلقهن العزيز العليم
normalizedTranslation: and if you should ask them, "who has created the heavens and the earth?" they would surely say, "they were created by the exalted in might, the knowing

arabic: ٱلَّذِي جَعَلَ لَكُمُ ٱلۡأَرۡضَ مَهۡدٗا وَجَعَلَ لَكُمۡ فِيهَا سُبُلٗا لَّعَلَّكُمۡ تَهۡتَدُونَ
translation: [The one] who has made for you the earth a bed and made for you upon it roads that you might be guided
normalizedArabic: الذي جعل لكم الارض مهدا وجعل لكم فيها سبلا لعلكم تهتدون
normalizedTranslation: [the one] who has made for you the earth a bed and made for you upon it roads that you might be guided

arabic: وَٱلَّذِي نَزَّلَ مِنَ ٱلسَّمَآءِ مَآءَۢ بِقَدَرٖ فَأَنشَرۡنَا بِهِۦ بَلۡدَةٗ مَّيۡتٗاۚ كَذَٰلِكَ تُخۡرَجُونَ
translation: And who sends down rain from the sky in measured amounts, and We revive thereby a dead land - thus will you be brought forth
normalizedArabic: والذي نزل من السماء ماء بقدر فانشرنا به بلده ميتا كذلك تخرجون
normalizedTranslation: and who sends down rain from the sky in measured amounts, and we revive thereby a dead land - thus will you be brought forth

arabic: وَٱلَّذِي خَلَقَ ٱلۡأَزۡوَٰجَ كُلَّهَا وَجَعَلَ لَكُم مِّنَ ٱلۡفُلۡكِ وَٱلۡأَنۡعَٰمِ مَا تَرۡكَبُونَ
translation: And who created the species, all of them, and has made for you of ships and animals those which you mount
normalizedArabic: والذي خلق الازوج كلها وجعل لكم من الفلك والانعم ما تركبون
normalizedTranslation: and who created the species, all of them, and has made for you of ships and animals those which you mount

arabic: لِتَسۡتَوُۥاْ عَلَىٰ ظُهُورِهِۦ ثُمَّ تَذۡكُرُواْ نِعۡمَةَ رَبِّكُمۡ إِذَا ٱسۡتَوَيۡتُمۡ عَلَيۡهِ وَتَقُولُواْ سُبۡحَٰنَ ٱلَّذِي سَخَّرَ لَنَا هَٰذَا وَمَا كُنَّا لَهُۥ مُقۡرِنِينَ
translation: That you may settle yourselves upon their backs and then remember the favor of your Lord when you have settled upon them and say. "Exalted is He who has subjected this to us, and we could not have [otherwise] subdued it
normalizedArabic: لتستوا علي ظهوره ثم تذكروا نعمه ربكم اذا استويتم عليه وتقولوا سبحن الذي سخر لنا هذا وما كنا له مقرنين
normalizedTranslation: that you may settle yourselves upon their backs and then remember the favor of your lord when you have settled upon them and say. "exalted is he who has subjected this to us, and we could not have [otherwise] subdued it

arabic: وَإِنَّآ إِلَىٰ رَبِّنَا لَمُنقَلِبُونَ
translation: And indeed we, to our Lord, will [surely] return
normalizedArabic: وانا الي ربنا لمنقلبون
normalizedTranslation: and indeed we, to our lord, will [surely] return

arabic: وَجَعَلُواْ لَهُۥ مِنۡ عِبَادِهِۦ جُزۡءًاۚ إِنَّ ٱلۡإِنسَٰنَ لَكَفُورٞ مُّبِينٌ
translation: But they have attributed to Him from His servants a portion. Indeed, man is clearly ungrateful
normalizedArabic: وجعلوا له من عباده جزءا ان الانسن لكفور مبين
normalizedTranslation: but they have attributed to him from his servants a portion. indeed, man is clearly ungrateful

arabic: أَمِ ٱتَّخَذَ مِمَّا يَخۡلُقُ بَنَاتٖ وَأَصۡفَىٰكُم بِٱلۡبَنِينَ
translation: Or has He taken, out of what He has created, daughters and chosen you for [having] sons
normalizedArabic: ام اتخذ مما يخلق بنات واصفيكم بالبنين
normalizedTranslation: or has he taken, out of what he has created, daughters and chosen you for [having] sons

arabic: وَإِذَا بُشِّرَ أَحَدُهُم بِمَا ضَرَبَ لِلرَّحۡمَٰنِ مَثَلٗا ظَلَّ وَجۡهُهُۥ مُسۡوَدّٗا وَهُوَ كَظِيمٌ
translation: And when one of them is given good tidings of that which he attributes to the Most Merciful in comparison, his face becomes dark, and he suppresses grief
normalizedArabic: واذا بشر احدهم بما ضرب للرحمن مثلا ظل وجهه مسودا وهو كظيم
normalizedTranslation: and when one of them is given good tidings of that which he attributes to the most merciful in comparison, his face becomes dark, and he suppresses grief

arabic: أَوَمَن يُنَشَّؤُاْ فِي ٱلۡحِلۡيَةِ وَهُوَ فِي ٱلۡخِصَامِ غَيۡرُ مُبِينٖ
translation: So is one brought up in ornaments while being during conflict unevident [attributed to Allah]
normalizedArabic: اومن ينشوا في الحليه وهو في الخصام غير مبين
normalizedTranslation: so is one brought up in ornaments while being during conflict unevident [attributed to allah]

arabic: وَجَعَلُواْ ٱلۡمَلَـٰٓئِكَةَ ٱلَّذِينَ هُمۡ عِبَٰدُ ٱلرَّحۡمَٰنِ إِنَٰثًاۚ أَشَهِدُواْ خَلۡقَهُمۡۚ سَتُكۡتَبُ شَهَٰدَتُهُمۡ وَيُسۡـَٔلُونَ
translation: And they have made the angels, who are servants of the Most Merciful, females. Did they witness their creation? Their testimony will be recorded, and they will be questioned
normalizedArabic: وجعلوا المليكه الذين هم عبد الرحمن انثا اشهدوا خلقهم ستكتب شهدتهم ويسلون
normalizedTranslation: and they have made the angels, who are servants of the most merciful, females. did they witness their creation? their testimony will be recorded, and they will be questioned

arabic: وَقَالُواْ لَوۡ شَآءَ ٱلرَّحۡمَٰنُ مَا عَبَدۡنَٰهُمۗ مَّا لَهُم بِذَٰلِكَ مِنۡ عِلۡمٍۖ إِنۡ هُمۡ إِلَّا يَخۡرُصُونَ
translation: And they said, "If the Most Merciful had willed, we would not have worshipped them." They have of that no knowledge. They are not but falsifying
normalizedArabic: وقالوا لو شاء الرحمن ما عبدنهم ما لهم بذلك من علم ان هم الا يخرصون
normalizedTranslation: and they said, "if the most merciful had willed, we would not have worshipped them." they have of that no knowledge. they are not but falsifying

arabic: أَمۡ ءَاتَيۡنَٰهُمۡ كِتَٰبٗا مِّن قَبۡلِهِۦ فَهُم بِهِۦ مُسۡتَمۡسِكُونَ
translation: Or have We given them a book before the Qur'an to which they are adhering
normalizedArabic: ام ءاتينهم كتبا من قبله فهم به مستمسكون
normalizedTranslation: or have we given them a book before the qur'an to which they are adhering

arabic: بَلۡ قَالُوٓاْ إِنَّا وَجَدۡنَآ ءَابَآءَنَا عَلَىٰٓ أُمَّةٖ وَإِنَّا عَلَىٰٓ ءَاثَٰرِهِم مُّهۡتَدُونَ
translation: Rather, they say, "Indeed, we found our fathers upon a religion, and we are in their footsteps [rightly] guided

normalizedTranslation: rather, they say, "indeed, we found our fathers upon a religion, and we are in their footsteps [rightly] guided

arabic: وَكَذَٰلِكَ مَآ أَرۡسَلۡنَا مِن قَبۡلِكَ فِي قَرۡيَةٖ مِّن نَّذِيرٍ إِلَّا قَالَ مُتۡرَفُوهَآ إِنَّا وَجَدۡنَآ ءَابَآءَنَا عَلَىٰٓ أُمَّةٖ وَإِنَّا عَلَىٰٓ ءَاثَٰرِهِم مُّقۡتَدُونَ
translation: And similarly, We did not send before you any warner into a city except that its affluent said, "Indeed, we found our fathers upon a religion, and we are, in their footsteps, following
normalizedArabic: وكذلك ما ارسلنا من قبلك في قريه من نذير الا قال مترفوها انا وجدنا ءاباءنا علي امه وانا علي ءاثرهم مقتدون
normalizedTranslation: and similarly, we did not send before you any warner into a city except that its affluent said, "indeed, we found our fathers upon a religion, and we are, in their footsteps, following

arabic: ۞قَٰلَ أَوَلَوۡ جِئۡتُكُم بِأَهۡدَىٰ مِمَّا وَجَدتُّمۡ عَلَيۡهِ ءَابَآءَكُمۡۖ قَالُوٓاْ إِنَّا بِمَآ أُرۡسِلۡتُم بِهِۦ كَٰفِرُونَ
translation: [Each warner] said, "Even if I brought you better guidance than that [religion] upon which you found your fathers?" They said, "Indeed we, in that with which you were sent, are disbelievers
normalizedArabic: قل اولو جيتكم باهدي مما وجدتم عليه ءاباءكم قالوا انا بما ارسلتم به كفرون
normalizedTranslation: [each warner] said, "even if i brought you better guidance than that [religion] upon which you found your fathers?" they said, "indeed we, in that with which you were sent, are disbelievers

arabic: فَٱنتَقَمۡنَا مِنۡهُمۡۖ فَٱنظُرۡ كَيۡفَ كَانَ عَٰقِبَةُ ٱلۡمُكَذِّبِينَ
translation: So we took retribution from them; then see how was the end of the deniers
normalizedArabic: فانتقمنا منهم فانظر كيف كان عقبه المكذبين
normalizedTranslation: so we took retribution from them; then see how was the end of the deniers

arabic: وَإِذۡ قَالَ إِبۡرَٰهِيمُ لِأَبِيهِ وَقَوۡمِهِۦٓ إِنَّنِي بَرَآءٞ مِّمَّا تَعۡبُدُونَ
translation: And [mention, O Muhammad], when Abraham said to his father and his people, "Indeed, I am disassociated from that which you worship
normalizedArabic: واذ قال ابرهيم لابيه وقومه انني براء مما تعبدون
normalizedTranslation: and [mention, o muhammad], when abraham said to his father and his people, "indeed, i am disassociated from that which you worship

arabic: إِلَّا ٱلَّذِي فَطَرَنِي فَإِنَّهُۥ سَيَهۡدِينِ
translation: Except for He who created me; and indeed, He will guide me
normalizedArabic: الا الذي فطرني فانه سيهدين
normalizedTranslation: except for he who created me; and indeed, he will guide me

arabic: وَجَعَلَهَا كَلِمَةَۢ بَاقِيَةٗ فِي عَقِبِهِۦ لَعَلَّهُمۡ يَرۡجِعُونَ
translation: And he made it a word remaining among his descendants that they might return [to it]

normalizedTranslation: and he made it a word remaining among his descendants that they might return [to it]

arabic: بَلۡ مَتَّعۡتُ هَـٰٓؤُلَآءِ وَءَابَآءَهُمۡ حَتَّىٰ جَآءَهُمُ ٱلۡحَقُّ وَرَسُولٞ مُّبِينٞ

normalizedTranslation: however, i gave enjoyment to these [people of makkah] and their fathers until there came to them the truth and a clear messenger

arabic: وَلَمَّا جَآءَهُمُ ٱلۡحَقُّ قَالُواْ هَٰذَا سِحۡرٞ وَإِنَّا بِهِۦ كَٰفِرُونَ

normalizedTranslation: but when the truth came to them, they said, "this is magic, and indeed we are, concerning it, disbelievers

arabic: وَقَالُواْ لَوۡلَا نُزِّلَ هَٰذَا ٱلۡقُرۡءَانُ عَلَىٰ رَجُلٖ مِّنَ ٱلۡقَرۡيَتَيۡنِ عَظِيمٍ
translation: And they said, "Why was this Qur'an not sent down upon a great man from [one of] the two cities
normalizedArabic: وقالوا لولا نزل هذا القرءان علي رجل من القريتين عظيم
normalizedTranslation: and they said, "why was this qur'an not sent down upon a great man from [one of] the two cities

arabic: أَهُمۡ يَقۡسِمُونَ رَحۡمَتَ رَبِّكَۚ نَحۡنُ قَسَمۡنَا بَيۡنَهُم مَّعِيشَتَهُمۡ فِي ٱلۡحَيَوٰةِ ٱلدُّنۡيَاۚ وَرَفَعۡنَا بَعۡضَهُمۡ فَوۡقَ بَعۡضٖ دَرَجَٰتٖ لِّيَتَّخِذَ بَعۡضُهُم بَعۡضٗا سُخۡرِيّٗاۗ وَرَحۡمَتُ رَبِّكَ خَيۡرٞ مِّمَّا يَجۡمَعُونَ
translation: Do they distribute the mercy of your Lord? It is We who have apportioned among them their livelihood in the life of this world and have raised some of them above others in degrees [of rank] that they may make use of one another for service. But the mercy of your Lord is better than whatever they accumulate

normalizedTranslation: do they distribute the mercy of your lord? it is we who have apportioned among them their livelihood in the life of this world and have raised some of them above others in degrees [of rank] that they may make use of one another for service. but the mercy of your lord is better than whatever they accumulate

arabic: وَلَوۡلَآ أَن يَكُونَ ٱلنَّاسُ أُمَّةٗ وَٰحِدَةٗ لَّجَعَلۡنَا لِمَن يَكۡفُرُ بِٱلرَّحۡمَٰنِ لِبُيُوتِهِمۡ سُقُفٗا مِّن فِضَّةٖ وَمَعَارِجَ عَلَيۡهَا يَظۡهَرُونَ
translation: And if it were not that the people would become one community [of disbelievers], We would have made for those who disbelieve in the Most Merciful - for their houses - ceilings and stairways of silver upon which to mount
