normalizedTranslation: and if it were not that the people would become one community [of disbelievers], we would have made for those who disbelieve in the most merciful - for their houses - ceilings and stairways of silver upon which to mount

arabic: وَلِبُيُوتِهِمۡ أَبۡوَٰبٗا وَسُرُرًا عَلَيۡهَا يَتَّكِـُٔونَ
translation: And for their houses - doors and couches [of silver] upon which to recline
normalizedArabic: ولبيوتهم ابوبا وسررا عليها يتكون
normalizedTranslation: and for their houses - doors and couches [of silver] upon which to recline

arabic: وَزُخۡرُفٗاۚ وَإِن كُلُّ ذَٰلِكَ لَمَّا مَتَٰعُ ٱلۡحَيَوٰةِ ٱلدُّنۡيَاۚ وَٱلۡأٓخِرَةُ عِندَ رَبِّكَ لِلۡمُتَّقِينَ
translation: And gold ornament. But all that is not but the enjoyment of worldly life. And the Hereafter with your Lord is for the righteous
normalizedArabic: وزخرفا وان كل ذلك لما متع الحيوه الدنيا والاخره عند ربك للمتقين
normalizedTranslation: and gold ornament. but all that is not but the enjoyment of worldly life. and the hereafter with your lord is for the righteous

arabic: وَمَن يَعۡشُ عَن ذِكۡرِ ٱلرَّحۡمَٰنِ نُقَيِّضۡ لَهُۥ شَيۡطَٰنٗا فَهُوَ لَهُۥ قَرِينٞ
translation: And whoever is blinded from remembrance of the Most Merciful - We appoint for him a devil, and he is to him a companion
normalizedArabic: ومن يعش عن ذكر الرحمن نقيض له شيطنا فهو له قرين
normalizedTranslation: and whoever is blinded from remembrance of the most merciful - we appoint for him a devil, and he is to him a companion

arabic: وَإِنَّهُمۡ لَيَصُدُّونَهُمۡ عَنِ ٱلسَّبِيلِ وَيَحۡسَبُونَ أَنَّهُم مُّهۡتَدُونَ
translation: And indeed, the devils avert them from the way [of guidance] while they think that they are [rightly] guided
normalizedArabic: وانهم ليصدونهم عن السبيل ويحسبون انهم مهتدون
normalizedTranslation: and indeed, the devils avert them from the way [of guidance] while they think that they are [rightly] guided

arabic: حَتَّىٰٓ إِذَا جَآءَنَا قَالَ يَٰلَيۡتَ بَيۡنِي وَبَيۡنَكَ بُعۡدَ ٱلۡمَشۡرِقَيۡنِ فَبِئۡسَ ٱلۡقَرِينُ
translation: Until, when he comes to Us [at Judgement], he says [to his companion], "Oh, I wish there was between me and you the distance between the east and west - how wretched a companion
normalizedArabic: حتي اذا جاءنا قال يليت بيني وبينك بعد المشرقين فبيس القرين
normalizedTranslation: until, when he comes to us [at judgement], he says [to his companion], "oh, i wish there was between me and you the distance between the east and west - how wretched a companion

arabic: وَلَن يَنفَعَكُمُ ٱلۡيَوۡمَ إِذ ظَّلَمۡتُمۡ أَنَّكُمۡ فِي ٱلۡعَذَابِ مُشۡتَرِكُونَ
translation: And never will it benefit you that Day, when you have wronged, that you are [all] sharing in the punishment
normalizedArabic: ولن ينفعكم اليوم اذ ظلمتم انكم في العذاب مشتركون
normalizedTranslation: and never will it benefit you that day, when you have wronged, that you are [all] sharing in the punishment

arabic: أَفَأَنتَ تُسۡمِعُ ٱلصُّمَّ أَوۡ تَهۡدِي ٱلۡعُمۡيَ وَمَن كَانَ فِي ضَلَٰلٖ مُّبِينٖ
translation: Then will you make the deaf hear, [O Muhammad], or guide the blind or he who is in clear error
normalizedArabic: افانت تسمع الصم او تهدي العمي ومن كان في ضلل مبين
normalizedTranslation: then will you make the deaf hear, [o muhammad], or guide the blind or he who is in clear error

arabic: فَإِمَّا نَذۡهَبَنَّ بِكَ فَإِنَّا مِنۡهُم مُّنتَقِمُونَ
translation: And whether [or not] We take you away [in death], indeed, We will take retribution upon them
normalizedArabic: فاما نذهبن بك فانا منهم منتقمون
normalizedTranslation: and whether [or not] we take you away [in death], indeed, we will take retribution upon them

arabic: أَوۡ نُرِيَنَّكَ ٱلَّذِي وَعَدۡنَٰهُمۡ فَإِنَّا عَلَيۡهِم مُّقۡتَدِرُونَ
translation: Or whether [or not] We show you that which We have promised them, indeed, We are Perfect in Ability
normalizedArabic: او نرينك الذي وعدنهم فانا عليهم مقتدرون
normalizedTranslation: or whether [or not] we show you that which we have promised them, indeed, we are perfect in ability

arabic: فَٱسۡتَمۡسِكۡ بِٱلَّذِيٓ أُوحِيَ إِلَيۡكَۖ إِنَّكَ عَلَىٰ صِرَٰطٖ مُّسۡتَقِيمٖ
translation: So adhere to that which is revealed to you. Indeed, you are on a straight path
normalizedArabic: فاستمسك بالذي اوحي اليك انك علي صرط مستقيم
normalizedTranslation: so adhere to that which is revealed to you. indeed, you are on a straight path

arabic: وَإِنَّهُۥ لَذِكۡرٞ لَّكَ وَلِقَوۡمِكَۖ وَسَوۡفَ تُسۡـَٔلُونَ
translation: And indeed, it is a remembrance for you and your people, and you [all] are going to be questioned
normalizedArabic: وانه لذكر لك ولقومك وسوف تسلون
normalizedTranslation: and indeed, it is a remembrance for you and your people, and you [all] are going to be questioned

arabic: وَسۡـَٔلۡ مَنۡ أَرۡسَلۡنَا مِن قَبۡلِكَ مِن رُّسُلِنَآ أَجَعَلۡنَا مِن دُونِ ٱلرَّحۡمَٰنِ ءَالِهَةٗ يُعۡبَدُونَ
translation: And ask those We sent before you of Our messengers; have We made besides the Most Merciful deities to be worshipped
normalizedArabic: وسل من ارسلنا من قبلك من رسلنا اجعلنا من دون الرحمن ءالهه يعبدون
normalizedTranslation: and ask those we sent before you of our messengers; have we made besides the most merciful deities to be worshipped

arabic: وَلَقَدۡ أَرۡسَلۡنَا مُوسَىٰ بِـَٔايَٰتِنَآ إِلَىٰ فِرۡعَوۡنَ وَمَلَإِيْهِۦ فَقَالَ إِنِّي رَسُولُ رَبِّ ٱلۡعَٰلَمِينَ
translation: And certainly did We send Moses with Our signs to Pharaoh and his establishment, and he said, "Indeed, I am the messenger of the Lord of the worlds
normalizedArabic: ولقد ارسلنا موسي بايتنا الي فرعون وملايه فقال اني رسول رب العلمين
normalizedTranslation: and certainly did we send moses with our signs to pharaoh and his establishment, and he said, "indeed, i am the messenger of the lord of the worlds

arabic: فَلَمَّا جَآءَهُم بِـَٔايَٰتِنَآ إِذَا هُم مِّنۡهَا يَضۡحَكُونَ
translation: But when he brought them Our signs, at once they laughed at them
normalizedArabic: فلما جاءهم بايتنا اذا هم منها يضحكون
normalizedTranslation: but when he brought them our signs, at once they laughed at them

arabic: وَمَا نُرِيهِم مِّنۡ ءَايَةٍ إِلَّا هِيَ أَكۡبَرُ مِنۡ أُخۡتِهَاۖ وَأَخَذۡنَٰهُم بِٱلۡعَذَابِ لَعَلَّهُمۡ يَرۡجِعُونَ
translation: And We showed them not a sign except that it was greater than its sister, and We seized them with affliction that perhaps they might return [to faith]
normalizedArabic: وما نريهم من ءايه الا هي اكبر من اختها واخذنهم بالعذاب لعلهم يرجعون
normalizedTranslation: and we showed them not a sign except that it was greater than its sister, and we seized them with affliction that perhaps they might return [to faith]

arabic: وَقَالُواْ يَـٰٓأَيُّهَ ٱلسَّاحِرُ ٱدۡعُ لَنَا رَبَّكَ بِمَا عَهِدَ عِندَكَ إِنَّنَا لَمُهۡتَدُونَ
translation: And they said [to Moses], "O magician, invoke for us your Lord by what He has promised you. Indeed, we will be guided
normalizedArabic: وقالوا يايه الساحر ادع لنا ربك بما عهد عندك اننا لمهتدون
normalizedTranslation: and they said [to moses], "o magician, invoke for us your lord by what he has promised you. indeed, we will be guided

arabic: فَلَمَّا كَشَفۡنَا عَنۡهُمُ ٱلۡعَذَابَ إِذَا هُمۡ يَنكُثُونَ
translation: But when We removed from them the affliction, at once they broke their word
normalizedArabic: فلما كشفنا عنهم العذاب اذا هم ينكثون
normalizedTranslation: but when we removed from them the affliction, at once they broke their word

arabic: وَنَادَىٰ فِرۡعَوۡنُ فِي قَوۡمِهِۦ قَالَ يَٰقَوۡمِ أَلَيۡسَ لِي مُلۡكُ مِصۡرَ وَهَٰذِهِ ٱلۡأَنۡهَٰرُ تَجۡرِي مِن تَحۡتِيٓۚ أَفَلَا تُبۡصِرُونَ
translation: And Pharaoh called out among his people; he said, "O my people, does not the kingdom of Egypt belong to me, and these rivers flowing beneath me; then do you not see
normalizedArabic: ونادي فرعون في قومه قال يقوم اليس لي ملك مصر وهذه الانهر تجري من تحتي افلا تبصرون
normalizedTranslation: and pharaoh called out among his people; he said, "o my people, does not the kingdom of egypt belong to me, and these rivers flowing beneath me; then do you not see

arabic: أَمۡ أَنَا۠ خَيۡرٞ مِّنۡ هَٰذَا ٱلَّذِي هُوَ مَهِينٞ وَلَا يَكَادُ يُبِينُ
translation: Or am I [not] better than this one who is insignificant and hardly makes himself clear
normalizedArabic: ام انا خير من هذا الذي هو مهين ولا يكاد يبين
normalizedTranslation: or am i [not] better than this one who is insignificant and hardly makes himself clear

arabic: فَلَوۡلَآ أُلۡقِيَ عَلَيۡهِ أَسۡوِرَةٞ مِّن ذَهَبٍ أَوۡ جَآءَ مَعَهُ ٱلۡمَلَـٰٓئِكَةُ مُقۡتَرِنِينَ
translation: Then why have there not been placed upon him bracelets of gold or come with him the angels in conjunction
normalizedArabic: فلولا القي عليه اسوره من ذهب او جاء معه المليكه مقترنين
normalizedTranslation: then why have there not been placed upon him bracelets of gold or come with him the angels in conjunction

arabic: فَٱسۡتَخَفَّ قَوۡمَهُۥ فَأَطَاعُوهُۚ إِنَّهُمۡ كَانُواْ قَوۡمٗا فَٰسِقِينَ
translation: So he bluffed his people, and they obeyed him. Indeed, they were [themselves] a people defiantly disobedient [of Allah]
normalizedArabic: فاستخف قومه فاطاعوه انهم كانوا قوما فسقين
normalizedTranslation: so he bluffed his people, and they obeyed him. indeed, they were [themselves] a people defiantly disobedient [of allah]

arabic: فَلَمَّآ ءَاسَفُونَا ٱنتَقَمۡنَا مِنۡهُمۡ فَأَغۡرَقۡنَٰهُمۡ أَجۡمَعِينَ
translation: And when they angered Us, We took retribution from them and drowned them all
normalizedArabic: فلما ءاسفونا انتقمنا منهم فاغرقنهم اجمعين
normalizedTranslation: and when they angered us, we took retribution from them and drowned them all

arabic: فَجَعَلۡنَٰهُمۡ سَلَفٗا وَمَثَلٗا لِّلۡأٓخِرِينَ
translation: And We made them a precedent and an example for the later peoples
normalizedArabic: فجعلنهم سلفا ومثلا للاخرين
normalizedTranslation: and we made them a precedent and an example for the later peoples

arabic: ۞وَلَمَّا ضُرِبَ ٱبۡنُ مَرۡيَمَ مَثَلًا إِذَا قَوۡمُكَ مِنۡهُ يَصِدُّونَ
translation: And when the son of Mary was presented as an example, immediately your people laughed aloud
normalizedArabic: ولما ضرب ابن مريم مثلا اذا قومك منه يصدون
normalizedTranslation: and when the son of mary was presented as an example, immediately your people laughed aloud

arabic: وَقَالُوٓاْ ءَأَٰلِهَتُنَا خَيۡرٌ أَمۡ هُوَۚ مَا ضَرَبُوهُ لَكَ إِلَّا جَدَلَۢاۚ بَلۡ هُمۡ قَوۡمٌ خَصِمُونَ
translation: And they said, "Are your gods better, or is he?" They did not present the comparison except for [mere] argument. But, [in fact], they are a people prone to dispute
normalizedArabic: وقالوا ءالهتنا خير ام هو ما ضربوه لك الا جدلا بل هم قوم خصمون
normalizedTranslation: and they said, "are your gods better, or is he?" they did not present the comparison except for [mere] argument. but, [in fact], they are a people prone to dispute

arabic: إِنۡ هُوَ إِلَّا عَبۡدٌ أَنۡعَمۡنَا عَلَيۡهِ وَجَعَلۡنَٰهُ مَثَلٗا لِّبَنِيٓ إِسۡرَـٰٓءِيلَ
translation: Jesus was not but a servant upon whom We bestowed favor, and We made him an example for the Children of Israel
normalizedArabic: ان هو الا عبد انعمنا عليه وجعلنه مثلا لبني اسرءيل
normalizedTranslation: jesus was not but a servant upon whom we bestowed favor, and we made him an example for the children of israel

arabic: وَلَوۡ نَشَآءُ لَجَعَلۡنَا مِنكُم مَّلَـٰٓئِكَةٗ فِي ٱلۡأَرۡضِ يَخۡلُفُونَ
translation: And if We willed, We could have made [instead] of you angels succeeding [one another] on the earth
normalizedArabic: ولو نشاء لجعلنا منكم مليكه في الارض يخلفون
normalizedTranslation: and if we willed, we could have made [instead] of you angels succeeding [one another] on the earth

arabic: وَإِنَّهُۥ لَعِلۡمٞ لِّلسَّاعَةِ فَلَا تَمۡتَرُنَّ بِهَا وَٱتَّبِعُونِۚ هَٰذَا صِرَٰطٞ مُّسۡتَقِيمٞ
translation: And indeed, Jesus will be [a sign for] knowledge of the Hour, so be not in doubt of it, and follow Me. This is a straight path
normalizedArabic: وانه لعلم للساعه فلا تمترن بها واتبعون هذا صرط مستقيم
normalizedTranslation: and indeed, jesus will be [a sign for] knowledge of the hour, so be not in doubt of it, and follow me. this is a straight path

arabic: وَلَا يَصُدَّنَّكُمُ ٱلشَّيۡطَٰنُۖ إِنَّهُۥ لَكُمۡ عَدُوّٞ مُّبِينٞ
translation: And never let Satan avert you. Indeed, he is to you a clear enemy
normalizedArabic: ولا يصدنكم الشيطن انه لكم عدو مبين
normalizedTranslation: and never let satan avert you. indeed, he is to you a clear enemy

arabic: وَلَمَّا جَآءَ عِيسَىٰ بِٱلۡبَيِّنَٰتِ قَالَ قَدۡ جِئۡتُكُم بِٱلۡحِكۡمَةِ وَلِأُبَيِّنَ لَكُم بَعۡضَ ٱلَّذِي تَخۡتَلِفُونَ فِيهِۖ فَٱتَّقُواْ ٱللَّهَ وَأَطِيعُونِ
translation: And when Jesus brought clear proofs, he said, "I have come to you with wisdom and to make clear to you some of that over which you differ, so fear Allah and obey me
normalizedArabic: ولما جاء عيسي بالبينت قال قد جيتكم بالحكمه ولابين لكم بعض الذي تختلفون فيه فاتقوا الله واطيعون
normalizedTranslation: and when jesus brought clear proofs, he said, "i have come to you with wisdom and to make clear to you some of that over which you differ, so fear allah and obey me

arabic: إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ هُوَ رَبِّي وَرَبُّكُمۡ فَٱعۡبُدُوهُۚ هَٰذَا صِرَٰطٞ مُّسۡتَقِيمٞ
translation: Indeed, Allah is my Lord and your Lord, so worship Him. This is a straight path
normalizedArabic: ان الله هو ربي وربكم فاعبدوه هذا صرط مستقيم
normalizedTranslation: indeed, allah is my lord and your lord, so worship him. this is a straight path

arabic: فَٱخۡتَلَفَ ٱلۡأَحۡزَابُ مِنۢ بَيۡنِهِمۡۖ فَوَيۡلٞ لِّلَّذِينَ ظَلَمُواْ مِنۡ عَذَابِ يَوۡمٍ أَلِيمٍ
translation: But the denominations from among them differed [and separated], so woe to those who have wronged from the punishment of a painful Day
normalizedArabic: فاختلف الاحزاب من بينهم فويل للذين ظلموا من عذاب يوم اليم
normalizedTranslation: but the denominations from among them differed [and separated], so woe to those who have wronged from the punishment of a painful day

arabic: هَلۡ يَنظُرُونَ إِلَّا ٱلسَّاعَةَ أَن تَأۡتِيَهُم بَغۡتَةٗ وَهُمۡ لَا يَشۡعُرُونَ
translation: Are they waiting except for the Hour to come upon them suddenly while they perceive not
normalizedArabic: هل ينظرون الا الساعه ان تاتيهم بغته وهم لا يشعرون
normalizedTranslation: are they waiting except for the hour to come upon them suddenly while they perceive not

arabic: ٱلۡأَخِلَّآءُ يَوۡمَئِذِۭ بَعۡضُهُمۡ لِبَعۡضٍ عَدُوٌّ إِلَّا ٱلۡمُتَّقِينَ
translation: Close friends, that Day, will be enemies to each other, except for the righteous
normalizedArabic: الاخلاء يوميذ بعضهم لبعض عدو الا المتقين
normalizedTranslation: close friends, that day, will be enemies to each other, except for the righteous

arabic: يَٰعِبَادِ لَا خَوۡفٌ عَلَيۡكُمُ ٱلۡيَوۡمَ وَلَآ أَنتُمۡ تَحۡزَنُونَ
translation: [To whom Allah will say], "O My servants, no fear will there be concerning you this Day, nor will you grieve
normalizedArabic: يعباد لا خوف عليكم اليوم ولا انتم تحزنون
normalizedTranslation: [to whom allah will say], "o my servants, no fear will there be concerning you this day, nor will you grieve

arabic: ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُواْ بِـَٔايَٰتِنَا وَكَانُواْ مُسۡلِمِينَ
translation: [You] who believed in Our verses and were Muslims
normalizedArabic: الذين ءامنوا بايتنا وكانوا مسلمين
normalizedTranslation: [you] who believed in our verses and were muslims

arabic: ٱدۡخُلُواْ ٱلۡجَنَّةَ أَنتُمۡ وَأَزۡوَٰجُكُمۡ تُحۡبَرُونَ
translation: Enter Paradise, you and your kinds, delighted
normalizedArabic: ادخلوا الجنه انتم وازوجكم تحبرون
normalizedTranslation: enter paradise, you and your kinds, delighted

arabic: يُطَافُ عَلَيۡهِم بِصِحَافٖ مِّن ذَهَبٖ وَأَكۡوَابٖۖ وَفِيهَا مَا تَشۡتَهِيهِ ٱلۡأَنفُسُ وَتَلَذُّ ٱلۡأَعۡيُنُۖ وَأَنتُمۡ فِيهَا خَٰلِدُونَ
translation: Circulated among them will be plates and vessels of gold. And therein is whatever the souls desire and [what] delights the eyes, and you will abide therein eternally
normalizedArabic: يطاف عليهم بصحاف من ذهب واكواب وفيها ما تشتهيه الانفس وتلذ الاعين وانتم فيها خلدون
normalizedTranslation: circulated among them will be plates and vessels of gold. and therein is whatever the souls desire and [what] delights the eyes, and you will abide therein eternally

arabic: وَتِلۡكَ ٱلۡجَنَّةُ ٱلَّتِيٓ أُورِثۡتُمُوهَا بِمَا كُنتُمۡ تَعۡمَلُونَ
translation: And that is Paradise which you are made to inherit for what you used to do
normalizedArabic: وتلك الجنه التي اورثتموها بما كنتم تعملون
normalizedTranslation: and that is paradise which you are made to inherit for what you used to do

arabic: لَكُمۡ فِيهَا فَٰكِهَةٞ كَثِيرَةٞ مِّنۡهَا تَأۡكُلُونَ
translation: For you therein is much fruit from which you will eat
normalizedArabic: لكم فيها فكهه كثيره منها تاكلون
normalizedTranslation: for you therein is much fruit from which you will eat

arabic: إِنَّ ٱلۡمُجۡرِمِينَ فِي عَذَابِ جَهَنَّمَ خَٰلِدُونَ
translation: Indeed, the criminals will be in the punishment of Hell, abiding eternally
normalizedArabic: ان المجرمين في عذاب جهنم خلدون
normalizedTranslation: indeed, the criminals will be in the punishment of hell, abiding eternally

arabic: لَا يُفَتَّرُ عَنۡهُمۡ وَهُمۡ فِيهِ مُبۡلِسُونَ
translation: It will not be allowed to subside for them, and they, therein, are in despair
normalizedArabic: لا يفتر عنهم وهم فيه مبلسون
normalizedTranslation: it will not be allowed to subside for them, and they, therein, are in despair

arabic: وَمَا ظَلَمۡنَٰهُمۡ وَلَٰكِن كَانُواْ هُمُ ٱلظَّـٰلِمِينَ
translation: And We did not wrong them, but it was they who were the wrongdoers
normalizedArabic: وما ظلمنهم ولكن كانوا هم الظلمين
normalizedTranslation: and we did not wrong them, but it was they who were the wrongdoers

arabic: وَنَادَوۡاْ يَٰمَٰلِكُ لِيَقۡضِ عَلَيۡنَا رَبُّكَۖ قَالَ إِنَّكُم مَّـٰكِثُونَ
translation: And they will call, "O Malik, let your Lord put an end to us!" He will say, "Indeed, you will remain
normalizedArabic: ونادوا يملك ليقض علينا ربك قال انكم مكثون
normalizedTranslation: and they will call, "o malik, let your lord put an end to us!" he will say, "indeed, you will remain

arabic: لَقَدۡ جِئۡنَٰكُم بِٱلۡحَقِّ وَلَٰكِنَّ أَكۡثَرَكُمۡ لِلۡحَقِّ كَٰرِهُونَ
translation: We had certainly brought you the truth, but most of you, to the truth, were averse
normalizedArabic: لقد جينكم بالحق ولكن اكثركم للحق كرهون
normalizedTranslation: we had certainly brought you the truth, but most of you, to the truth, were averse

arabic: أَمۡ أَبۡرَمُوٓاْ أَمۡرٗا فَإِنَّا مُبۡرِمُونَ
translation: Or have they devised [some] affair? But indeed, We are devising [a plan]
normalizedArabic: ام ابرموا امرا فانا مبرمون
normalizedTranslation: or have they devised [some] affair? but indeed, we are devising [a plan]

arabic: أَمۡ يَحۡسَبُونَ أَنَّا لَا نَسۡمَعُ سِرَّهُمۡ وَنَجۡوَىٰهُمۚ بَلَىٰ وَرُسُلُنَا لَدَيۡهِمۡ يَكۡتُبُونَ
translation: Or do they think that We hear not their secrets and their private conversations? Yes, [We do], and Our messengers are with them recording
normalizedArabic: ام يحسبون انا لا نسمع سرهم ونجويهم بلي ورسلنا لديهم يكتبون
normalizedTranslation: or do they think that we hear not their secrets and their private conversations? yes, [we do], and our messengers are with them recording

arabic: قُلۡ إِن كَانَ لِلرَّحۡمَٰنِ وَلَدٞ فَأَنَا۠ أَوَّلُ ٱلۡعَٰبِدِينَ
translation: Say, [O Muhammad], "If the Most Merciful had a son, then I would be the first of [his] worshippers
normalizedArabic: قل ان كان للرحمن ولد فانا اول العبدين
normalizedTranslation: say, [o muhammad], "if the most merciful had a son, then i would be the first of [his] worshippers

arabic: سُبۡحَٰنَ رَبِّ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلۡأَرۡضِ رَبِّ ٱلۡعَرۡشِ عَمَّا يَصِفُونَ
translation: Exalted is the Lord of the heavens and the earth, Lord of the Throne, above what they describe
normalizedArabic: سبحن رب السموت والارض رب العرش عما يصفون
normalizedTranslation: exalted is the lord of the heavens and the earth, lord of the throne, above what they describe

arabic: فَذَرۡهُمۡ يَخُوضُواْ وَيَلۡعَبُواْ حَتَّىٰ يُلَٰقُواْ يَوۡمَهُمُ ٱلَّذِي يُوعَدُونَ
translation: So leave them to converse vainly and amuse themselves until they meet their Day which they are promised
normalizedArabic: فذرهم يخوضوا ويلعبوا حتي يلقوا يومهم الذي يوعدون
normalizedTranslation: so leave them to converse vainly and amuse themselves until they meet their day which they are promised

arabic: وَهُوَ ٱلَّذِي فِي ٱلسَّمَآءِ إِلَٰهٞ وَفِي ٱلۡأَرۡضِ إِلَٰهٞۚ وَهُوَ ٱلۡحَكِيمُ ٱلۡعَلِيمُ
translation: And it is Allah who is [the only] deity in the heaven, and on the earth [the only] deity. And He is the Wise, the Knowing
normalizedArabic: وهو الذي في السماء اله وفي الارض اله وهو الحكيم العليم
normalizedTranslation: and it is allah who is [the only] deity in the heaven, and on the earth [the only] deity. and he is the wise, the knowing

arabic: وَتَبَارَكَ ٱلَّذِي لَهُۥ مُلۡكُ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلۡأَرۡضِ وَمَا بَيۡنَهُمَا وَعِندَهُۥ عِلۡمُ ٱلسَّاعَةِ وَإِلَيۡهِ تُرۡجَعُونَ
translation: And blessed is He to whom belongs the dominion of the heavens and the earth and whatever is between them and with whom is knowledge of the Hour and to whom you will be returned
normalizedArabic: وتبارك الذي له ملك السموت والارض وما بينهما وعنده علم الساعه واليه ترجعون
normalizedTranslation: and blessed is he to whom belongs the dominion of the heavens and the earth and whatever is between them and with whom is knowledge of the hour and to whom you will be returned

arabic: وَلَا يَمۡلِكُ ٱلَّذِينَ يَدۡعُونَ مِن دُونِهِ ٱلشَّفَٰعَةَ إِلَّا مَن شَهِدَ بِٱلۡحَقِّ وَهُمۡ يَعۡلَمُونَ
translation: And those they invoke besides Him do not possess [power of] intercession; but only those who testify to the truth [can benefit], and they know
normalizedArabic: ولا يملك الذين يدعون من دونه الشفعه الا من شهد بالحق وهم يعلمون
normalizedTranslation: and those they invoke besides him do not possess [power of] intercession; but only those who testify to the truth [can benefit], and they know

arabic: وَلَئِن سَأَلۡتَهُم مَّنۡ خَلَقَهُمۡ لَيَقُولُنَّ ٱللَّهُۖ فَأَنَّىٰ يُؤۡفَكُونَ
translation: And if you asked them who created them, they would surely say, "Allah." So how are they deluded
normalizedArabic: ولين سالتهم من خلقهم ليقولن الله فاني يوفكون
normalizedTranslation: and if you asked them who created them, they would surely say, "allah." so how are they deluded

arabic: وَقِيلِهِۦ يَٰرَبِّ إِنَّ هَـٰٓؤُلَآءِ قَوۡمٞ لَّا يُؤۡمِنُونَ
translation: And [Allah acknowledges] his saying, "O my Lord, indeed these are a people who do not believe
normalizedArabic: وقيله يرب ان هولاء قوم لا يومنون
normalizedTranslation: and [allah acknowledges] his saying, "o my lord, indeed these are a people who do not believe

arabic: فَٱصۡفَحۡ عَنۡهُمۡ وَقُلۡ سَلَٰمٞۚ فَسَوۡفَ يَعۡلَمُونَ
translation: So turn aside from them and say, "Peace." But they are going to know
normalizedArabic: فاصفح عنهم وقل سلم فسوف يعلمون
normalizedTranslation: so turn aside from them and say, "peace." but they are going to know

arabic: حمٓ
translation: Ha, Meem
normalizedArabic: حم
normalizedTranslation: ha, meem

arabic: وَٱلۡكِتَٰبِ ٱلۡمُبِينِ
translation: By the clear Book
normalizedArabic: والكتب المبين
normalizedTranslation: by the clear book

arabic: إِنَّآ أَنزَلۡنَٰهُ فِي لَيۡلَةٖ مُّبَٰرَكَةٍۚ إِنَّا كُنَّا مُنذِرِينَ
translation: Indeed, We sent it down during a blessed night. Indeed, We were to warn [mankind]
normalizedArabic: انا انزلنه في ليله مبركه انا كنا منذرين
normalizedTranslation: indeed, we sent it down during a blessed night. indeed, we were to warn [mankind]

arabic: فِيهَا يُفۡرَقُ كُلُّ أَمۡرٍ حَكِيمٍ
translation: On that night is made distinct every precise matter
normalizedArabic: فيها يفرق كل امر حكيم
normalizedTranslation: on that night is made distinct every precise matter

arabic: أَمۡرٗا مِّنۡ عِندِنَآۚ إِنَّا كُنَّا مُرۡسِلِينَ
translation: [Every] matter [proceeding] from Us. Indeed, We were to send [a messenger]
normalizedArabic: امرا من عندنا انا كنا مرسلين
normalizedTranslation: [every] matter [proceeding] from us. indeed, we were to send [a messenger]

arabic: رَحۡمَةٗ مِّن رَّبِّكَۚ إِنَّهُۥ هُوَ ٱلسَّمِيعُ ٱلۡعَلِيمُ
translation: As mercy from your Lord. Indeed, He is the Hearing, the Knowing
normalizedArabic: رحمه من ربك انه هو السميع العليم
normalizedTranslation: as mercy from your lord. indeed, he is the hearing, the knowing

arabic: رَبِّ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلۡأَرۡضِ وَمَا بَيۡنَهُمَآۖ إِن كُنتُم مُّوقِنِينَ
translation: Lord of the heavens and the earth and that between them, if you would be certain
normalizedArabic: رب السموت والارض وما بينهما ان كنتم موقنين
normalizedTranslation: lord of the heavens and the earth and that between them, if you would be certain

arabic: لَآ إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا هُوَ يُحۡيِۦ وَيُمِيتُۖ رَبُّكُمۡ وَرَبُّ ءَابَآئِكُمُ ٱلۡأَوَّلِينَ
translation: There is no deity except Him; He gives life and causes death. [He is] your Lord and the Lord of your first forefathers
normalizedArabic: لا اله الا هو يحي ويميت ربكم ورب ءابايكم الاولين
normalizedTranslation: there is no deity except him; he gives life and causes death. [he is] your lord and the lord of your first forefathers

arabic: بَلۡ هُمۡ فِي شَكّٖ يَلۡعَبُونَ
translation: But they are in doubt, amusing themselves
normalizedArabic: بل هم في شك يلعبون
normalizedTranslation: but they are in doubt, amusing themselves

arabic: فَٱرۡتَقِبۡ يَوۡمَ تَأۡتِي ٱلسَّمَآءُ بِدُخَانٖ مُّبِينٖ
translation: Then watch for the Day when the sky will bring a visible smoke
normalizedArabic: فارتقب يوم تاتي السماء بدخان مبين
normalizedTranslation: then watch for the day when the sky will bring a visible smoke

arabic: يَغۡشَى ٱلنَّاسَۖ هَٰذَا عَذَابٌ أَلِيمٞ
translation: Covering the people; this is a painful torment
normalizedArabic: يغشي الناس هذا عذاب اليم
normalizedTranslation: covering the people; this is a painful torment

arabic: رَّبَّنَا ٱكۡشِفۡ عَنَّا ٱلۡعَذَابَ إِنَّا مُؤۡمِنُونَ
translation: [They will say], "Our Lord, remove from us the torment; indeed, we are believers
normalizedArabic: ربنا اكشف عنا العذاب انا مومنون
normalizedTranslation: [they will say], "our lord, remove from us the torment; indeed, we are believers

arabic: أَنَّىٰ لَهُمُ ٱلذِّكۡرَىٰ وَقَدۡ جَآءَهُمۡ رَسُولٞ مُّبِينٞ
translation: How will there be for them a reminder [at that time]? And there had come to them a clear Messenger
normalizedArabic: اني لهم الذكري وقد جاءهم رسول مبين
normalizedTranslation: how will there be for them a reminder [at that time]? and there had come to them a clear messenger

arabic: ثُمَّ تَوَلَّوۡاْ عَنۡهُ وَقَالُواْ مُعَلَّمٞ مَّجۡنُونٌ
translation: Then they turned away from him and said, "[He was] taught [and is] a madman
normalizedArabic: ثم تولوا عنه وقالوا معلم مجنون
normalizedTranslation: then they turned away from him and said, "[he was] taught [and is] a madman

arabic: إِنَّا كَاشِفُواْ ٱلۡعَذَابِ قَلِيلًاۚ إِنَّكُمۡ عَآئِدُونَ
translation: Indeed, We will remove the torment for a little. Indeed, you [disbelievers] will return [to disbelief]
normalizedArabic: انا كاشفوا العذاب قليلا انكم عايدون
normalizedTranslation: indeed, we will remove the torment for a little. indeed, you [disbelievers] will return [to disbelief]

arabic: يَوۡمَ نَبۡطِشُ ٱلۡبَطۡشَةَ ٱلۡكُبۡرَىٰٓ إِنَّا مُنتَقِمُونَ
translation: The Day We will strike with the greatest assault, indeed, We will take retribution
normalizedArabic: يوم نبطش البطشه الكبري انا منتقمون
normalizedTranslation: the day we will strike with the greatest assault, indeed, we will take retribution

arabic: ۞وَلَقَدۡ فَتَنَّا قَبۡلَهُمۡ قَوۡمَ فِرۡعَوۡنَ وَجَآءَهُمۡ رَسُولٞ كَرِيمٌ
translation: And We had already tried before them the people of Pharaoh, and there came to them a noble messenger
normalizedArabic: ولقد فتنا قبلهم قوم فرعون وجاءهم رسول كريم
normalizedTranslation: and we had already tried before them the people of pharaoh, and there came to them a noble messenger

arabic: أَنۡ أَدُّوٓاْ إِلَيَّ عِبَادَ ٱللَّهِۖ إِنِّي لَكُمۡ رَسُولٌ أَمِينٞ
translation: [Saying], "Render to me the servants of Allah. Indeed, I am to you a trustworthy messenger
normalizedArabic: ان ادوا الي عباد الله اني لكم رسول امين
normalizedTranslation: [saying], "render to me the servants of allah. indeed, i am to you a trustworthy messenger

arabic: وَأَن لَّا تَعۡلُواْ عَلَى ٱللَّهِۖ إِنِّيٓ ءَاتِيكُم بِسُلۡطَٰنٖ مُّبِينٖ
translation: And [saying], "Be not haughty with Allah. Indeed, I have come to you with clear authority
normalizedArabic: وان لا تعلوا علي الله اني ءاتيكم بسلطن مبين
normalizedTranslation: and [saying], "be not haughty with allah. indeed, i have come to you with clear authority

arabic: وَإِنِّي عُذۡتُ بِرَبِّي وَرَبِّكُمۡ أَن تَرۡجُمُونِ
translation: And indeed, I have sought refuge in my Lord and your Lord, lest you stone me
normalizedArabic: واني عذت بربي وربكم ان ترجمون
normalizedTranslation: and indeed, i have sought refuge in my lord and your lord, lest you stone me

arabic: وَإِن لَّمۡ تُؤۡمِنُواْ لِي فَٱعۡتَزِلُونِ
translation: But if you do not believe me, then leave me alone
normalizedArabic: وان لم تومنوا لي فاعتزلون
normalizedTranslation: but if you do not believe me, then leave me alone

arabic: فَدَعَا رَبَّهُۥٓ أَنَّ هَـٰٓؤُلَآءِ قَوۡمٞ مُّجۡرِمُونَ
translation: And [finally] he called to his Lord that these were a criminal people
normalizedArabic: فدعا ربه ان هولاء قوم مجرمون
normalizedTranslation: and [finally] he called to his lord that these were a criminal people

arabic: فَأَسۡرِ بِعِبَادِي لَيۡلًا إِنَّكُم مُّتَّبَعُونَ
translation: [Allah said], "Then set out with My servants by night. Indeed, you are to be pursued
normalizedArabic: فاسر بعبادي ليلا انكم متبعون
normalizedTranslation: [allah said], "then set out with my servants by night. indeed, you are to be pursued

arabic: وَٱتۡرُكِ ٱلۡبَحۡرَ رَهۡوًاۖ إِنَّهُمۡ جُندٞ مُّغۡرَقُونَ
translation: And leave the sea in stillness. Indeed, they are an army to be drowned
normalizedArabic: واترك البحر رهوا انهم جند مغرقون
normalizedTranslation: and leave the sea in stillness. indeed, they are an army to be drowned

arabic: كَمۡ تَرَكُواْ مِن جَنَّـٰتٖ وَعُيُونٖ
translation: How much they left behind of gardens and springs
normalizedArabic: كم تركوا من جنت وعيون
normalizedTranslation: how much they left behind of gardens and springs

arabic: وَزُرُوعٖ وَمَقَامٖ كَرِيمٖ
translation: And crops and noble sites
normalizedArabic: وزروع ومقام كريم
normalizedTranslation: and crops and noble sites

arabic: وَنَعۡمَةٖ كَانُواْ فِيهَا فَٰكِهِينَ
translation: And comfort wherein they were amused
normalizedArabic: ونعمه كانوا فيها فكهين
normalizedTranslation: and comfort wherein they were amused

arabic: كَذَٰلِكَۖ وَأَوۡرَثۡنَٰهَا قَوۡمًا ءَاخَرِينَ
translation: Thus. And We caused to inherit it another people
normalizedArabic: كذلك واورثنها قوما ءاخرين
normalizedTranslation: thus. and we caused to inherit it another people

arabic: فَمَا بَكَتۡ عَلَيۡهِمُ ٱلسَّمَآءُ وَٱلۡأَرۡضُ وَمَا كَانُواْ مُنظَرِينَ
translation: And the heaven and earth wept not for them, nor were they reprieved
normalizedArabic: فما بكت عليهم السماء والارض وما كانوا منظرين
normalizedTranslation: and the heaven and earth wept not for them, nor were they reprieved

arabic: وَلَقَدۡ نَجَّيۡنَا بَنِيٓ إِسۡرَـٰٓءِيلَ مِنَ ٱلۡعَذَابِ ٱلۡمُهِينِ
translation: And We certainly saved the Children of Israel from the humiliating torment
normalizedArabic: ولقد نجينا بني اسرءيل من العذاب المهين
normalizedTranslation: and we certainly saved the children of israel from the humiliating torment

arabic: مِن فِرۡعَوۡنَۚ إِنَّهُۥ كَانَ عَالِيٗا مِّنَ ٱلۡمُسۡرِفِينَ
translation: From Pharaoh. Indeed, he was a haughty one among the transgressors
normalizedArabic: من فرعون انه كان عاليا من المسرفين
normalizedTranslation: from pharaoh. indeed, he was a haughty one among the transgressors

arabic: وَلَقَدِ ٱخۡتَرۡنَٰهُمۡ عَلَىٰ عِلۡمٍ عَلَى ٱلۡعَٰلَمِينَ
translation: And We certainly chose them by knowledge over [all] the worlds
normalizedArabic: ولقد اخترنهم علي علم علي العلمين
normalizedTranslation: and we certainly chose them by knowledge over [all] the worlds

arabic: وَءَاتَيۡنَٰهُم مِّنَ ٱلۡأٓيَٰتِ مَا فِيهِ بَلَـٰٓؤٞاْ مُّبِينٌ
translation: And We gave them of signs that in which there was a clear trial
normalizedArabic: وءاتينهم من الايت ما فيه بلوا مبين
normalizedTranslation: and we gave them of signs that in which there was a clear trial

arabic: إِنَّ هَـٰٓؤُلَآءِ لَيَقُولُونَ
translation: Indeed, these [disbelievers] are saying
normalizedArabic: ان هولاء ليقولون
normalizedTranslation: indeed, these [disbelievers] are saying

arabic: إِنۡ هِيَ إِلَّا مَوۡتَتُنَا ٱلۡأُولَىٰ وَمَا نَحۡنُ بِمُنشَرِينَ
translation: There is not but our first death, and we will not be resurrected
normalizedArabic: ان هي الا موتتنا الاولي وما نحن بمنشرين
normalizedTranslation: there is not but our first death, and we will not be resurrected

arabic: فَأۡتُواْ بِـَٔابَآئِنَآ إِن كُنتُمۡ صَٰدِقِينَ
translation: Then bring [back] our forefathers, if you should be truthful
normalizedArabic: فاتوا باباينا ان كنتم صدقين
normalizedTranslation: then bring [back] our forefathers, if you should be truthful

arabic: أَهُمۡ خَيۡرٌ أَمۡ قَوۡمُ تُبَّعٖ وَٱلَّذِينَ مِن قَبۡلِهِمۡ أَهۡلَكۡنَٰهُمۡۚ إِنَّهُمۡ كَانُواْ مُجۡرِمِينَ
translation: Are they better or the people of Tubba' and those before them? We destroyed them, [for] indeed, they were criminals
normalizedArabic: اهم خير ام قوم تبع والذين من قبلهم اهلكنهم انهم كانوا مجرمين
normalizedTranslation: are they better or the people of tubba' and those before them? we destroyed them, [for] indeed, they were criminals

arabic: وَمَا خَلَقۡنَا ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلۡأَرۡضَ وَمَا بَيۡنَهُمَا لَٰعِبِينَ
translation: And We did not create the heavens and earth and that between them in play
normalizedArabic: وما خلقنا السموت والارض وما بينهما لعبين
normalizedTranslation: and we did not create the heavens and earth and that between them in play

normalizedTranslation: they will not taste death therein except the first death, and he will have protected them from the punishment of hellfire

arabic: فَضۡلٗا مِّن رَّبِّكَۚ ذَٰلِكَ هُوَ ٱلۡفَوۡزُ ٱلۡعَظِيمُ

arabic: فَإِنَّمَا يَسَّرۡنَٰهُ بِلِسَانِكَ لَعَلَّهُمۡ يَتَذَكَّرُونَ

normalizedTranslation: and indeed, we have eased the qur'an in your tongue that they might be reminded

arabic: إِنَّ فِي ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلۡأَرۡضِ لَأٓيَٰتٖ لِّلۡمُؤۡمِنِينَ

normalizedTranslation: indeed, within the heavens and earth are signs for the believers

arabic: وَفِي خَلۡقِكُمۡ وَمَا يَبُثُّ مِن دَآبَّةٍ ءَايَٰتٞ لِّقَوۡمٖ يُوقِنُونَ
translation: And in the creation of yourselves and what He disperses of moving creatures are signs for people who are certain [in faith]

normalizedTranslation: and in the creation of yourselves and what he disperses of moving creatures are signs for people who are certain [in faith]

arabic: وَٱخۡتِلَٰفِ ٱلَّيۡلِ وَٱلنَّهَارِ وَمَآ أَنزَلَ ٱللَّهُ مِنَ ٱلسَّمَآءِ مِن رِّزۡقٖ فَأَحۡيَا بِهِ ٱلۡأَرۡضَ بَعۡدَ مَوۡتِهَا وَتَصۡرِيفِ ٱلرِّيَٰحِ ءَايَٰتٞ لِّقَوۡمٖ يَعۡقِلُونَ
translation: And [in] the alternation of night and day and [in] what Allah sends down from the sky of provision and gives life thereby to the earth after its lifelessness and [in His] directing of the winds are signs for a people who reason

normalizedTranslation: and [in] the alternation of night and day and [in] what allah sends down from the sky of provision and gives life thereby to the earth after its lifelessness and [in his] directing of the winds are signs for a people who reason

arabic: تِلۡكَ ءَايَٰتُ ٱللَّهِ نَتۡلُوهَا عَلَيۡكَ بِٱلۡحَقِّۖ فَبِأَيِّ حَدِيثِۭ بَعۡدَ ٱللَّهِ وَءَايَٰتِهِۦ يُؤۡمِنُونَ

normalizedTranslation: these are the verses of allah which we recite to you in truth. then in what statement after allah and his verses will they believe

arabic: وَيۡلٞ لِّكُلِّ أَفَّاكٍ أَثِيمٖ

normalizedTranslation: woe to every sinful liar

arabic: يَسۡمَعُ ءَايَٰتِ ٱللَّهِ تُتۡلَىٰ عَلَيۡهِ ثُمَّ يُصِرُّ مُسۡتَكۡبِرٗا كَأَن لَّمۡ يَسۡمَعۡهَاۖ فَبَشِّرۡهُ بِعَذَابٍ أَلِيمٖ
translation: Who hears the verses of Allah recited to him, then persists arrogantly as if he had not heard them. So give him tidings of a painful punishment

normalizedTranslation: who hears the verses of allah recited to him, then persists arrogantly as if he had not heard them. so give him tidings of a painful punishment

arabic: وَإِذَا عَلِمَ مِنۡ ءَايَٰتِنَا شَيۡـًٔا ٱتَّخَذَهَا هُزُوًاۚ أُوْلَـٰٓئِكَ لَهُمۡ عَذَابٞ مُّهِينٞ

normalizedTranslation: and when he knows anything of our verses, he takes them in ridicule. those will have a humiliating punishment

arabic: مِّن وَرَآئِهِمۡ جَهَنَّمُۖ وَلَا يُغۡنِي عَنۡهُم مَّا كَسَبُواْ شَيۡـٔٗا وَلَا مَا ٱتَّخَذُواْ مِن دُونِ ٱللَّهِ أَوۡلِيَآءَۖ وَلَهُمۡ عَذَابٌ عَظِيمٌ
translation: Before them is Hell, and what they had earned will not avail them at all nor what they had taken besides Allah as allies. And they will have a great punishment
normalizedArabic: من ورايهم جهنم ولا يغني عنهم ما كسبوا شيا ولا ما اتخذوا من دون الله اولياء ولهم عذاب عظيم
normalizedTranslation: before them is hell, and what they had earned will not avail them at all nor what they had taken besides allah as allies. and they will have a great punishment

arabic: هَٰذَا هُدٗىۖ وَٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُواْ بِـَٔايَٰتِ رَبِّهِمۡ لَهُمۡ عَذَابٞ مِّن رِّجۡزٍ أَلِيمٌ

normalizedTranslation: this [qur'an] is guidance. and those who have disbelieved in the verses of their lord will have a painful punishment of foul nature

arabic: ۞ٱللَّهُ ٱلَّذِي سَخَّرَ لَكُمُ ٱلۡبَحۡرَ لِتَجۡرِيَ ٱلۡفُلۡكُ فِيهِ بِأَمۡرِهِۦ وَلِتَبۡتَغُواْ مِن فَضۡلِهِۦ وَلَعَلَّكُمۡ تَشۡكُرُونَ
translation: It is Allah who subjected to you the sea so that ships may sail upon it by His command and that you may seek of His bounty; and perhaps you will be grateful

normalizedTranslation: it is allah who subjected to you the sea so that ships may sail upon it by his command and that you may seek of his bounty; and perhaps you will be grateful

arabic: وَسَخَّرَ لَكُم مَّا فِي ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَمَا فِي ٱلۡأَرۡضِ جَمِيعٗا مِّنۡهُۚ إِنَّ فِي ذَٰلِكَ لَأٓيَٰتٖ لِّقَوۡمٖ يَتَفَكَّرُونَ
translation: And He has subjected to you whatever is in the heavens and whatever is on the earth - all from Him. Indeed in that are signs for a people who give thought

normalizedTranslation: and he has subjected to you whatever is in the heavens and whatever is on the earth - all from him. indeed in that are signs for a people who give thought

arabic: قُل لِّلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُواْ يَغۡفِرُواْ لِلَّذِينَ لَا يَرۡجُونَ أَيَّامَ ٱللَّهِ لِيَجۡزِيَ قَوۡمَۢا بِمَا كَانُواْ يَكۡسِبُونَ
translation: Say, [O Muhammad], to those who have believed that they [should] forgive those who expect not the days of Allah so that He may recompense a people for what they used to earn
normalizedArabic: قل للذين ءامنوا يغفروا للذين لا يرجون ايام الله ليجزي قوما بما كانوا يكسبون
normalizedTranslation: say, [o muhammad], to those who have believed that they [should] forgive those who expect not the days of allah so that he may recompense a people for what they used to earn

arabic: مَنۡ عَمِلَ صَٰلِحٗا فَلِنَفۡسِهِۦۖ وَمَنۡ أَسَآءَ فَعَلَيۡهَاۖ ثُمَّ إِلَىٰ رَبِّكُمۡ تُرۡجَعُونَ
translation: Whoever does a good deed - it is for himself; and whoever does evil - it is against the self. Then to your Lord you will be returned
normalizedArabic: من عمل صلحا فلنفسه ومن اساء فعليها ثم الي ربكم ترجعون
normalizedTranslation: whoever does a good deed - it is for himself; and whoever does evil - it is against the self. then to your lord you will be returned

arabic: وَلَقَدۡ ءَاتَيۡنَا بَنِيٓ إِسۡرَـٰٓءِيلَ ٱلۡكِتَٰبَ وَٱلۡحُكۡمَ وَٱلنُّبُوَّةَ وَرَزَقۡنَٰهُم مِّنَ ٱلطَّيِّبَٰتِ وَفَضَّلۡنَٰهُمۡ عَلَى ٱلۡعَٰلَمِينَ
translation: And We did certainly give the Children of Israel the Scripture and judgement and prophethood, and We provided them with good things and preferred them over the worlds
normalizedArabic: ولقد ءاتينا بني اسرءيل الكتب والحكم والنبوه ورزقنهم من الطيبت وفضلنهم علي العلمين
normalizedTranslation: and we did certainly give the children of israel the scripture and judgement and prophethood, and we provided them with good things and preferred them over the worlds

arabic: وَءَاتَيۡنَٰهُم بَيِّنَٰتٖ مِّنَ ٱلۡأَمۡرِۖ فَمَا ٱخۡتَلَفُوٓاْ إِلَّا مِنۢ بَعۡدِ مَا جَآءَهُمُ ٱلۡعِلۡمُ بَغۡيَۢا بَيۡنَهُمۡۚ إِنَّ رَبَّكَ يَقۡضِي بَيۡنَهُمۡ يَوۡمَ ٱلۡقِيَٰمَةِ فِيمَا كَانُواْ فِيهِ يَخۡتَلِفُونَ
translation: And We gave them clear proofs of the matter [of religion]. And they did not differ except after knowledge had come to them - out of jealous animosity between themselves. Indeed, your Lord will judge between them on the Day of Resurrection concerning that over which they used to differ
normalizedArabic: وءاتينهم بينت من الامر فما اختلفوا الا من بعد ما جاءهم العلم بغيا بينهم ان ربك يقضي بينهم يوم القيمه فيما كانوا فيه يختلفون
normalizedTranslation: and we gave them clear proofs of the matter [of religion]. and they did not differ except after knowledge had come to them - out of jealous animosity between themselves. indeed, your lord will judge between them on the day of resurrection concerning that over which they used to differ

arabic: ثُمَّ جَعَلۡنَٰكَ عَلَىٰ شَرِيعَةٖ مِّنَ ٱلۡأَمۡرِ فَٱتَّبِعۡهَا وَلَا تَتَّبِعۡ أَهۡوَآءَ ٱلَّذِينَ لَا يَعۡلَمُونَ
translation: Then We put you, [O Muhammad], on an ordained way concerning the matter [of religion]; so follow it and do not follow the inclinations of those who do not know
normalizedArabic: ثم جعلنك علي شريعه من الامر فاتبعها ولا تتبع اهواء الذين لا يعلمون
normalizedTranslation: then we put you, [o muhammad], on an ordained way concerning the matter [of religion]; so follow it and do not follow the inclinations of those who do not know

arabic: إِنَّهُمۡ لَن يُغۡنُواْ عَنكَ مِنَ ٱللَّهِ شَيۡـٔٗاۚ وَإِنَّ ٱلظَّـٰلِمِينَ بَعۡضُهُمۡ أَوۡلِيَآءُ بَعۡضٖۖ وَٱللَّهُ وَلِيُّ ٱلۡمُتَّقِينَ
translation: Indeed, they will never avail you against Allah at all. And indeed, the wrongdoers are allies of one another; but Allah is the protector of the righteous
normalizedArabic: انهم لن يغنوا عنك من الله شيا وان الظلمين بعضهم اولياء بعض والله ولي المتقين
normalizedTranslation: indeed, they will never avail you against allah at all. and indeed, the wrongdoers are allies of one another; but allah is the protector of the righteous

arabic: هَٰذَا بَصَـٰٓئِرُ لِلنَّاسِ وَهُدٗى وَرَحۡمَةٞ لِّقَوۡمٖ يُوقِنُونَ
translation: This [Qur'an] is enlightenment for mankind and guidance and mercy for a people who are certain [in faith]
normalizedArabic: هذا بصير للناس وهدي ورحمه لقوم يوقنون
normalizedTranslation: this [qur'an] is enlightenment for mankind and guidance and mercy for a people who are certain [in faith]

arabic: أَمۡ حَسِبَ ٱلَّذِينَ ٱجۡتَرَحُواْ ٱلسَّيِّـَٔاتِ أَن نَّجۡعَلَهُمۡ كَٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُواْ وَعَمِلُواْ ٱلصَّـٰلِحَٰتِ سَوَآءٗ مَّحۡيَاهُمۡ وَمَمَاتُهُمۡۚ سَآءَ مَا يَحۡكُمُونَ
translation: Or do those who commit evils think We will make them like those who have believed and done righteous deeds - [make them] equal in their life and their death? Evil is that which they judge
