arabic: هُوَ ٱلَّذِي بَعَثَ فِي ٱلۡأُمِّيِّـۧنَ رَسُولٗا مِّنۡهُمۡ يَتۡلُواْ عَلَيۡهِمۡ ءَايَٰتِهِۦ وَيُزَكِّيهِمۡ وَيُعَلِّمُهُمُ ٱلۡكِتَٰبَ وَٱلۡحِكۡمَةَ وَإِن كَانُواْ مِن قَبۡلُ لَفِي ضَلَٰلٖ مُّبِينٖ
translation: It is He who has sent among the unlettered a Messenger from themselves reciting to them His verses and purifying them and teaching them the Book and wisdom - although they were before in clear error
normalizedArabic: هو الذي بعث في الامين رسولا منهم يتلوا عليهم ءايته ويزكيهم ويعلمهم الكتب والحكمه وان كانوا من قبل لفي ضلل مبين
normalizedTranslation: it is he who has sent among the unlettered a messenger from themselves reciting to them his verses and purifying them and teaching them the book and wisdom - although they were before in clear error

arabic: وَءَاخَرِينَ مِنۡهُمۡ لَمَّا يَلۡحَقُواْ بِهِمۡۚ وَهُوَ ٱلۡعَزِيزُ ٱلۡحَكِيمُ
translation: And [to] others of them who have not yet joined them. And He is the Exalted in Might, the Wise
normalizedArabic: وءاخرين منهم لما يلحقوا بهم وهو العزيز الحكيم
normalizedTranslation: and [to] others of them who have not yet joined them. and he is the exalted in might, the wise

arabic: ذَٰلِكَ فَضۡلُ ٱللَّهِ يُؤۡتِيهِ مَن يَشَآءُۚ وَٱللَّهُ ذُو ٱلۡفَضۡلِ ٱلۡعَظِيمِ
translation: That is the bounty of Allah, which He gives to whom He wills, and Allah is the possessor of great bounty
normalizedArabic: ذلك فضل الله يوتيه من يشاء والله ذو الفضل العظيم
normalizedTranslation: that is the bounty of allah, which he gives to whom he wills, and allah is the possessor of great bounty

arabic: مَثَلُ ٱلَّذِينَ حُمِّلُواْ ٱلتَّوۡرَىٰةَ ثُمَّ لَمۡ يَحۡمِلُوهَا كَمَثَلِ ٱلۡحِمَارِ يَحۡمِلُ أَسۡفَارَۢاۚ بِئۡسَ مَثَلُ ٱلۡقَوۡمِ ٱلَّذِينَ كَذَّبُواْ بِـَٔايَٰتِ ٱللَّهِۚ وَٱللَّهُ لَا يَهۡدِي ٱلۡقَوۡمَ ٱلظَّـٰلِمِينَ
translation: The example of those who were entrusted with the Torah and then did not take it on is like that of a donkey who carries volumes [of books]. Wretched is the example of the people who deny the signs of Allah. And Allah does not guide the wrongdoing people
normalizedArabic: مثل الذين حملوا التوريه ثم لم يحملوها كمثل الحمار يحمل اسفارا بيس مثل القوم الذين كذبوا بايت الله والله لا يهدي القوم الظلمين
normalizedTranslation: the example of those who were entrusted with the torah and then did not take it on is like that of a donkey who carries volumes [of books]. wretched is the example of the people who deny the signs of allah. and allah does not guide the wrongdoing people

arabic: قُلۡ يَـٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلَّذِينَ هَادُوٓاْ إِن زَعَمۡتُمۡ أَنَّكُمۡ أَوۡلِيَآءُ لِلَّهِ مِن دُونِ ٱلنَّاسِ فَتَمَنَّوُاْ ٱلۡمَوۡتَ إِن كُنتُمۡ صَٰدِقِينَ
translation: Say, "O you who are Jews, if you claim that you are allies of Allah, excluding the [other] people, then wish for death, if you should be truthful
normalizedArabic: قل يايها الذين هادوا ان زعمتم انكم اولياء لله من دون الناس فتمنوا الموت ان كنتم صدقين
normalizedTranslation: say, "o you who are jews, if you claim that you are allies of allah, excluding the [other] people, then wish for death, if you should be truthful

arabic: وَلَا يَتَمَنَّوۡنَهُۥٓ أَبَدَۢا بِمَا قَدَّمَتۡ أَيۡدِيهِمۡۚ وَٱللَّهُ عَلِيمُۢ بِٱلظَّـٰلِمِينَ
translation: But they will not wish for it, ever, because of what their hands have put forth. And Allah is Knowing of the wrongdoers
normalizedArabic: ولا يتمنونه ابدا بما قدمت ايديهم والله عليم بالظلمين
normalizedTranslation: but they will not wish for it, ever, because of what their hands have put forth. and allah is knowing of the wrongdoers

arabic: قُلۡ إِنَّ ٱلۡمَوۡتَ ٱلَّذِي تَفِرُّونَ مِنۡهُ فَإِنَّهُۥ مُلَٰقِيكُمۡۖ ثُمَّ تُرَدُّونَ إِلَىٰ عَٰلِمِ ٱلۡغَيۡبِ وَٱلشَّهَٰدَةِ فَيُنَبِّئُكُم بِمَا كُنتُمۡ تَعۡمَلُونَ
translation: Say, "Indeed, the death from which you flee - indeed, it will meet you. Then you will be returned to the Knower of the unseen and the witnessed, and He will inform you about what you used to do
normalizedArabic: قل ان الموت الذي تفرون منه فانه ملقيكم ثم تردون الي علم الغيب والشهده فينبيكم بما كنتم تعملون
normalizedTranslation: say, "indeed, the death from which you flee - indeed, it will meet you. then you will be returned to the knower of the unseen and the witnessed, and he will inform you about what you used to do

arabic: يَـٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوٓاْ إِذَا نُودِيَ لِلصَّلَوٰةِ مِن يَوۡمِ ٱلۡجُمُعَةِ فَٱسۡعَوۡاْ إِلَىٰ ذِكۡرِ ٱللَّهِ وَذَرُواْ ٱلۡبَيۡعَۚ ذَٰلِكُمۡ خَيۡرٞ لَّكُمۡ إِن كُنتُمۡ تَعۡلَمُونَ
translation: O you who have believed, when [the adhan] is called for the prayer on the day of Jumu'ah [Friday], then proceed to the remembrance of Allah and leave trade. That is better for you, if you only knew
normalizedArabic: يايها الذين ءامنوا اذا نودي للصلوه من يوم الجمعه فاسعوا الي ذكر الله وذروا البيع ذلكم خير لكم ان كنتم تعلمون
normalizedTranslation: o you who have believed, when [the adhan] is called for the prayer on the day of jumu'ah [friday], then proceed to the remembrance of allah and leave trade. that is better for you, if you only knew

arabic: فَإِذَا قُضِيَتِ ٱلصَّلَوٰةُ فَٱنتَشِرُواْ فِي ٱلۡأَرۡضِ وَٱبۡتَغُواْ مِن فَضۡلِ ٱللَّهِ وَٱذۡكُرُواْ ٱللَّهَ كَثِيرٗا لَّعَلَّكُمۡ تُفۡلِحُونَ
translation: And when the prayer has been concluded, disperse within the land and seek from the bounty of Allah, and remember Allah often that you may succeed
normalizedArabic: فاذا قضيت الصلوه فانتشروا في الارض وابتغوا من فضل الله واذكروا الله كثيرا لعلكم تفلحون
normalizedTranslation: and when the prayer has been concluded, disperse within the land and seek from the bounty of allah, and remember allah often that you may succeed

arabic: وَإِذَا رَأَوۡاْ تِجَٰرَةً أَوۡ لَهۡوًا ٱنفَضُّوٓاْ إِلَيۡهَا وَتَرَكُوكَ قَآئِمٗاۚ قُلۡ مَا عِندَ ٱللَّهِ خَيۡرٞ مِّنَ ٱللَّهۡوِ وَمِنَ ٱلتِّجَٰرَةِۚ وَٱللَّهُ خَيۡرُ ٱلرَّـٰزِقِينَ
translation: But when they saw a transaction or a diversion, [O Muhammad], they rushed to it and left you standing. Say, "What is with Allah is better than diversion and than a transaction, and Allah is the best of providers
normalizedArabic: واذا راوا تجره او لهوا انفضوا اليها وتركوك قايما قل ما عند الله خير من اللهو ومن التجره والله خير الرزقين
normalizedTranslation: but when they saw a transaction or a diversion, [o muhammad], they rushed to it and left you standing. say, "what is with allah is better than diversion and than a transaction, and allah is the best of providers

arabic: إِذَا جَآءَكَ ٱلۡمُنَٰفِقُونَ قَالُواْ نَشۡهَدُ إِنَّكَ لَرَسُولُ ٱللَّهِۗ وَٱللَّهُ يَعۡلَمُ إِنَّكَ لَرَسُولُهُۥ وَٱللَّهُ يَشۡهَدُ إِنَّ ٱلۡمُنَٰفِقِينَ لَكَٰذِبُونَ
translation: When the hypocrites come to you, [O Muhammad], they say, "We testify that you are the Messenger of Allah." And Allah knows that you are His Messenger, and Allah testifies that the hypocrites are liars
normalizedArabic: اذا جاءك المنفقون قالوا نشهد انك لرسول الله والله يعلم انك لرسوله والله يشهد ان المنفقين لكذبون
normalizedTranslation: when the hypocrites come to you, [o muhammad], they say, "we testify that you are the messenger of allah." and allah knows that you are his messenger, and allah testifies that the hypocrites are liars

arabic: ٱتَّخَذُوٓاْ أَيۡمَٰنَهُمۡ جُنَّةٗ فَصَدُّواْ عَن سَبِيلِ ٱللَّهِۚ إِنَّهُمۡ سَآءَ مَا كَانُواْ يَعۡمَلُونَ
translation: They have taken their oaths as a cover, so they averted [people] from the way of Allah. Indeed, it was evil that they were doing
normalizedArabic: اتخذوا ايمنهم جنه فصدوا عن سبيل الله انهم ساء ما كانوا يعملون
normalizedTranslation: they have taken their oaths as a cover, so they averted [people] from the way of allah. indeed, it was evil that they were doing

arabic: ذَٰلِكَ بِأَنَّهُمۡ ءَامَنُواْ ثُمَّ كَفَرُواْ فَطُبِعَ عَلَىٰ قُلُوبِهِمۡ فَهُمۡ لَا يَفۡقَهُونَ
translation: That is because they believed, and then they disbelieved; so their hearts were sealed over, and they do not understand
normalizedArabic: ذلك بانهم ءامنوا ثم كفروا فطبع علي قلوبهم فهم لا يفقهون
normalizedTranslation: that is because they believed, and then they disbelieved; so their hearts were sealed over, and they do not understand

arabic: ۞وَإِذَا رَأَيۡتَهُمۡ تُعۡجِبُكَ أَجۡسَامُهُمۡۖ وَإِن يَقُولُواْ تَسۡمَعۡ لِقَوۡلِهِمۡۖ كَأَنَّهُمۡ خُشُبٞ مُّسَنَّدَةٞۖ يَحۡسَبُونَ كُلَّ صَيۡحَةٍ عَلَيۡهِمۡۚ هُمُ ٱلۡعَدُوُّ فَٱحۡذَرۡهُمۡۚ قَٰتَلَهُمُ ٱللَّهُۖ أَنَّىٰ يُؤۡفَكُونَ
translation: And when you see them, their forms please you, and if they speak, you listen to their speech. [They are] as if they were pieces of wood propped up - they think that every shout is against them. They are the enemy, so beware of them. May Allah destroy them; how are they deluded
normalizedArabic: واذا رايتهم تعجبك اجسامهم وان يقولوا تسمع لقولهم كانهم خشب مسنده يحسبون كل صيحه عليهم هم العدو فاحذرهم قتلهم الله اني يوفكون
normalizedTranslation: and when you see them, their forms please you, and if they speak, you listen to their speech. [they are] as if they were pieces of wood propped up - they think that every shout is against them. they are the enemy, so beware of them. may allah destroy them; how are they deluded

arabic: وَإِذَا قِيلَ لَهُمۡ تَعَالَوۡاْ يَسۡتَغۡفِرۡ لَكُمۡ رَسُولُ ٱللَّهِ لَوَّوۡاْ رُءُوسَهُمۡ وَرَأَيۡتَهُمۡ يَصُدُّونَ وَهُم مُّسۡتَكۡبِرُونَ
translation: And when it is said to them, "Come, the Messenger of Allah will ask forgiveness for you," they turn their heads aside and you see them evading while they are arrogant
normalizedArabic: واذا قيل لهم تعالوا يستغفر لكم رسول الله لووا رءوسهم ورايتهم يصدون وهم مستكبرون
normalizedTranslation: and when it is said to them, "come, the messenger of allah will ask forgiveness for you," they turn their heads aside and you see them evading while they are arrogant

arabic: سَوَآءٌ عَلَيۡهِمۡ أَسۡتَغۡفَرۡتَ لَهُمۡ أَمۡ لَمۡ تَسۡتَغۡفِرۡ لَهُمۡ لَن يَغۡفِرَ ٱللَّهُ لَهُمۡۚ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ لَا يَهۡدِي ٱلۡقَوۡمَ ٱلۡفَٰسِقِينَ
translation: It is all the same for them whether you ask forgiveness for them or do not ask forgiveness for them; never will Allah forgive them. Indeed, Allah does not guide the defiantly disobedient people
normalizedArabic: سواء عليهم استغفرت لهم ام لم تستغفر لهم لن يغفر الله لهم ان الله لا يهدي القوم الفسقين
normalizedTranslation: it is all the same for them whether you ask forgiveness for them or do not ask forgiveness for them; never will allah forgive them. indeed, allah does not guide the defiantly disobedient people

arabic: هُمُ ٱلَّذِينَ يَقُولُونَ لَا تُنفِقُواْ عَلَىٰ مَنۡ عِندَ رَسُولِ ٱللَّهِ حَتَّىٰ يَنفَضُّواْۗ وَلِلَّهِ خَزَآئِنُ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلۡأَرۡضِ وَلَٰكِنَّ ٱلۡمُنَٰفِقِينَ لَا يَفۡقَهُونَ
translation: They are the ones who say, "Do not spend on those who are with the Messenger of Allah until they disband." And to Allah belongs the depositories of the heavens and the earth, but the hypocrites do not understand
normalizedArabic: هم الذين يقولون لا تنفقوا علي من عند رسول الله حتي ينفضوا ولله خزاين السموت والارض ولكن المنفقين لا يفقهون
normalizedTranslation: they are the ones who say, "do not spend on those who are with the messenger of allah until they disband." and to allah belongs the depositories of the heavens and the earth, but the hypocrites do not understand

arabic: يَقُولُونَ لَئِن رَّجَعۡنَآ إِلَى ٱلۡمَدِينَةِ لَيُخۡرِجَنَّ ٱلۡأَعَزُّ مِنۡهَا ٱلۡأَذَلَّۚ وَلِلَّهِ ٱلۡعِزَّةُ وَلِرَسُولِهِۦ وَلِلۡمُؤۡمِنِينَ وَلَٰكِنَّ ٱلۡمُنَٰفِقِينَ لَا يَعۡلَمُونَ
translation: They say, "If we return to al-Madinah, the more honored [for power] will surely expel therefrom the more humble." And to Allah belongs [all] honor, and to His Messenger, and to the believers, but the hypocrites do not know
normalizedArabic: يقولون لين رجعنا الي المدينه ليخرجن الاعز منها الاذل ولله العزه ولرسوله وللمومنين ولكن المنفقين لا يعلمون
normalizedTranslation: they say, "if we return to al-madinah, the more honored [for power] will surely expel therefrom the more humble." and to allah belongs [all] honor, and to his messenger, and to the believers, but the hypocrites do not know

arabic: يَـٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُواْ لَا تُلۡهِكُمۡ أَمۡوَٰلُكُمۡ وَلَآ أَوۡلَٰدُكُمۡ عَن ذِكۡرِ ٱللَّهِۚ وَمَن يَفۡعَلۡ ذَٰلِكَ فَأُوْلَـٰٓئِكَ هُمُ ٱلۡخَٰسِرُونَ
translation: O you who have believed, let not your wealth and your children divert you from remembrance of Allah. And whoever does that - then those are the losers
normalizedArabic: يايها الذين ءامنوا لا تلهكم امولكم ولا اولدكم عن ذكر الله ومن يفعل ذلك فاوليك هم الخسرون
normalizedTranslation: o you who have believed, let not your wealth and your children divert you from remembrance of allah. and whoever does that - then those are the losers

arabic: وَأَنفِقُواْ مِن مَّا رَزَقۡنَٰكُم مِّن قَبۡلِ أَن يَأۡتِيَ أَحَدَكُمُ ٱلۡمَوۡتُ فَيَقُولَ رَبِّ لَوۡلَآ أَخَّرۡتَنِيٓ إِلَىٰٓ أَجَلٖ قَرِيبٖ فَأَصَّدَّقَ وَأَكُن مِّنَ ٱلصَّـٰلِحِينَ
translation: And spend [in the way of Allah] from what We have provided you before death approaches one of you and he says, "My Lord, if only You would delay me for a brief term so I would give charity and be among the righteous
normalizedArabic: وانفقوا من ما رزقنكم من قبل ان ياتي احدكم الموت فيقول رب لولا اخرتني الي اجل قريب فاصدق واكن من الصلحين
normalizedTranslation: and spend [in the way of allah] from what we have provided you before death approaches one of you and he says, "my lord, if only you would delay me for a brief term so i would give charity and be among the righteous

arabic: وَلَن يُؤَخِّرَ ٱللَّهُ نَفۡسًا إِذَا جَآءَ أَجَلُهَاۚ وَٱللَّهُ خَبِيرُۢ بِمَا تَعۡمَلُونَ
translation: But never will Allah delay a soul when its time has come. And Allah is Acquainted with what you do
normalizedArabic: ولن يوخر الله نفسا اذا جاء اجلها والله خبير بما تعملون
normalizedTranslation: but never will allah delay a soul when its time has come. and allah is acquainted with what you do

arabic: يُسَبِّحُ لِلَّهِ مَا فِي ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَمَا فِي ٱلۡأَرۡضِۖ لَهُ ٱلۡمُلۡكُ وَلَهُ ٱلۡحَمۡدُۖ وَهُوَ عَلَىٰ كُلِّ شَيۡءٖ قَدِيرٌ
translation: Whatever is in the heavens and whatever is on the earth is exalting Allah. To Him belongs dominion, and to Him belongs [all] praise, and He is over all things competent
normalizedArabic: يسبح لله ما في السموت وما في الارض له الملك وله الحمد وهو علي كل شيء قدير
normalizedTranslation: whatever is in the heavens and whatever is on the earth is exalting allah. to him belongs dominion, and to him belongs [all] praise, and he is over all things competent

arabic: هُوَ ٱلَّذِي خَلَقَكُمۡ فَمِنكُمۡ كَافِرٞ وَمِنكُم مُّؤۡمِنٞۚ وَٱللَّهُ بِمَا تَعۡمَلُونَ بَصِيرٌ
translation: It is He who created you, and among you is the disbeliever, and among you is the believer. And Allah, of what you do, is Seeing
normalizedArabic: هو الذي خلقكم فمنكم كافر ومنكم مومن والله بما تعملون بصير
normalizedTranslation: it is he who created you, and among you is the disbeliever, and among you is the believer. and allah, of what you do, is seeing

arabic: خَلَقَ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلۡأَرۡضَ بِٱلۡحَقِّ وَصَوَّرَكُمۡ فَأَحۡسَنَ صُوَرَكُمۡۖ وَإِلَيۡهِ ٱلۡمَصِيرُ
translation: He created the heavens and earth in truth and formed you and perfected your forms; and to Him is the [final] destination
normalizedArabic: خلق السموت والارض بالحق وصوركم فاحسن صوركم واليه المصير
normalizedTranslation: he created the heavens and earth in truth and formed you and perfected your forms; and to him is the [final] destination

arabic: يَعۡلَمُ مَا فِي ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلۡأَرۡضِ وَيَعۡلَمُ مَا تُسِرُّونَ وَمَا تُعۡلِنُونَۚ وَٱللَّهُ عَلِيمُۢ بِذَاتِ ٱلصُّدُورِ
translation: He knows what is within the heavens and earth and knows what you conceal and what you declare. And Allah is Knowing of that within the breasts
normalizedArabic: يعلم ما في السموت والارض ويعلم ما تسرون وما تعلنون والله عليم بذات الصدور
normalizedTranslation: he knows what is within the heavens and earth and knows what you conceal and what you declare. and allah is knowing of that within the breasts

arabic: أَلَمۡ يَأۡتِكُمۡ نَبَؤُاْ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُواْ مِن قَبۡلُ فَذَاقُواْ وَبَالَ أَمۡرِهِمۡ وَلَهُمۡ عَذَابٌ أَلِيمٞ
translation: Has there not come to you the news of those who disbelieved before? So they tasted the bad consequence of their affair, and they will have a painful punishment
normalizedArabic: الم ياتكم نبوا الذين كفروا من قبل فذاقوا وبال امرهم ولهم عذاب اليم
normalizedTranslation: has there not come to you the news of those who disbelieved before? so they tasted the bad consequence of their affair, and they will have a painful punishment

arabic: ذَٰلِكَ بِأَنَّهُۥ كَانَت تَّأۡتِيهِمۡ رُسُلُهُم بِٱلۡبَيِّنَٰتِ فَقَالُوٓاْ أَبَشَرٞ يَهۡدُونَنَا فَكَفَرُواْ وَتَوَلَّواْۖ وَّٱسۡتَغۡنَى ٱللَّهُۚ وَٱللَّهُ غَنِيٌّ حَمِيدٞ
translation: That is because their messengers used to come to them with clear evidences, but they said, "Shall human beings guide us?" and disbelieved and turned away. And Allah dispensed [with them]; and Allah is Free of need and Praiseworthy
normalizedArabic: ذلك بانه كانت تاتيهم رسلهم بالبينت فقالوا ابشر يهدوننا فكفروا وتولوا واستغني الله والله غني حميد
normalizedTranslation: that is because their messengers used to come to them with clear evidences, but they said, "shall human beings guide us?" and disbelieved and turned away. and allah dispensed [with them]; and allah is free of need and praiseworthy

arabic: زَعَمَ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوٓاْ أَن لَّن يُبۡعَثُواْۚ قُلۡ بَلَىٰ وَرَبِّي لَتُبۡعَثُنَّ ثُمَّ لَتُنَبَّؤُنَّ بِمَا عَمِلۡتُمۡۚ وَذَٰلِكَ عَلَى ٱللَّهِ يَسِيرٞ
translation: Those who disbelieve have claimed that they will never be resurrected. Say, "Yes, by my Lord, you will surely be resurrected; then you will surely be informed of what you did. And that, for Allah, is easy
normalizedArabic: زعم الذين كفروا ان لن يبعثوا قل بلي وربي لتبعثن ثم لتنبون بما عملتم وذلك علي الله يسير
normalizedTranslation: those who disbelieve have claimed that they will never be resurrected. say, "yes, by my lord, you will surely be resurrected; then you will surely be informed of what you did. and that, for allah, is easy

arabic: فَـَٔامِنُواْ بِٱللَّهِ وَرَسُولِهِۦ وَٱلنُّورِ ٱلَّذِيٓ أَنزَلۡنَاۚ وَٱللَّهُ بِمَا تَعۡمَلُونَ خَبِيرٞ
translation: So believe in Allah and His Messenger and the Qur'an which We have sent down. And Allah is Acquainted with what you do
normalizedArabic: فامنوا بالله ورسوله والنور الذي انزلنا والله بما تعملون خبير
normalizedTranslation: so believe in allah and his messenger and the qur'an which we have sent down. and allah is acquainted with what you do

arabic: يَوۡمَ يَجۡمَعُكُمۡ لِيَوۡمِ ٱلۡجَمۡعِۖ ذَٰلِكَ يَوۡمُ ٱلتَّغَابُنِۗ وَمَن يُؤۡمِنۢ بِٱللَّهِ وَيَعۡمَلۡ صَٰلِحٗا يُكَفِّرۡ عَنۡهُ سَيِّـَٔاتِهِۦ وَيُدۡخِلۡهُ جَنَّـٰتٖ تَجۡرِي مِن تَحۡتِهَا ٱلۡأَنۡهَٰرُ خَٰلِدِينَ فِيهَآ أَبَدٗاۚ ذَٰلِكَ ٱلۡفَوۡزُ ٱلۡعَظِيمُ
translation: The Day He will assemble you for the Day of Assembly - that is the Day of Deprivation. And whoever believes in Allah and does righteousness - He will remove from him his misdeeds and admit him to gardens beneath which rivers flow, wherein they will abide forever. That is the great attainment
normalizedArabic: يوم يجمعكم ليوم الجمع ذلك يوم التغابن ومن يومن بالله ويعمل صلحا يكفر عنه سياته ويدخله جنت تجري من تحتها الانهر خلدين فيها ابدا ذلك الفوز العظيم
normalizedTranslation: the day he will assemble you for the day of assembly - that is the day of deprivation. and whoever believes in allah and does righteousness - he will remove from him his misdeeds and admit him to gardens beneath which rivers flow, wherein they will abide forever. that is the great attainment

arabic: وَٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُواْ وَكَذَّبُواْ بِـَٔايَٰتِنَآ أُوْلَـٰٓئِكَ أَصۡحَٰبُ ٱلنَّارِ خَٰلِدِينَ فِيهَاۖ وَبِئۡسَ ٱلۡمَصِيرُ
translation: But the ones who disbelieved and denied Our verses - those are the companions of the Fire, abiding eternally therein; and wretched is the destination
normalizedArabic: والذين كفروا وكذبوا بايتنا اوليك اصحب النار خلدين فيها وبيس المصير
normalizedTranslation: but the ones who disbelieved and denied our verses - those are the companions of the fire, abiding eternally therein; and wretched is the destination

arabic: مَآ أَصَابَ مِن مُّصِيبَةٍ إِلَّا بِإِذۡنِ ٱللَّهِۗ وَمَن يُؤۡمِنۢ بِٱللَّهِ يَهۡدِ قَلۡبَهُۥۚ وَٱللَّهُ بِكُلِّ شَيۡءٍ عَلِيمٞ
translation: No disaster strikes except by permission of Allah. And whoever believes in Allah - He will guide his heart. And Allah is Knowing of all things
normalizedArabic: ما اصاب من مصيبه الا باذن الله ومن يومن بالله يهد قلبه والله بكل شيء عليم
normalizedTranslation: no disaster strikes except by permission of allah. and whoever believes in allah - he will guide his heart. and allah is knowing of all things

arabic: وَأَطِيعُواْ ٱللَّهَ وَأَطِيعُواْ ٱلرَّسُولَۚ فَإِن تَوَلَّيۡتُمۡ فَإِنَّمَا عَلَىٰ رَسُولِنَا ٱلۡبَلَٰغُ ٱلۡمُبِينُ
translation: And obey Allah and obey the Messenger; but if you turn away - then upon Our Messenger is only [the duty of] clear notification
normalizedArabic: واطيعوا الله واطيعوا الرسول فان توليتم فانما علي رسولنا البلغ المبين
normalizedTranslation: and obey allah and obey the messenger; but if you turn away - then upon our messenger is only [the duty of] clear notification

arabic: ٱللَّهُ لَآ إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا هُوَۚ وَعَلَى ٱللَّهِ فَلۡيَتَوَكَّلِ ٱلۡمُؤۡمِنُونَ
translation: Allah - there is no deity except Him. And upon Allah let the believers rely
normalizedArabic: الله لا اله الا هو وعلي الله فليتوكل المومنون
normalizedTranslation: allah - there is no deity except him. and upon allah let the believers rely

arabic: يَـٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوٓاْ إِنَّ مِنۡ أَزۡوَٰجِكُمۡ وَأَوۡلَٰدِكُمۡ عَدُوّٗا لَّكُمۡ فَٱحۡذَرُوهُمۡۚ وَإِن تَعۡفُواْ وَتَصۡفَحُواْ وَتَغۡفِرُواْ فَإِنَّ ٱللَّهَ غَفُورٞ رَّحِيمٌ
translation: O you who have believed, indeed, among your wives and your children are enemies to you, so beware of them. But if you pardon and overlook and forgive - then indeed, Allah is Forgiving and Merciful
normalizedArabic: يايها الذين ءامنوا ان من ازوجكم واولدكم عدوا لكم فاحذروهم وان تعفوا وتصفحوا وتغفروا فان الله غفور رحيم
normalizedTranslation: o you who have believed, indeed, among your wives and your children are enemies to you, so beware of them. but if you pardon and overlook and forgive - then indeed, allah is forgiving and merciful

arabic: إِنَّمَآ أَمۡوَٰلُكُمۡ وَأَوۡلَٰدُكُمۡ فِتۡنَةٞۚ وَٱللَّهُ عِندَهُۥٓ أَجۡرٌ عَظِيمٞ
translation: Your wealth and your children are but a trial, and Allah has with Him a great reward
normalizedArabic: انما امولكم واولدكم فتنه والله عنده اجر عظيم
normalizedTranslation: your wealth and your children are but a trial, and allah has with him a great reward

arabic: فَٱتَّقُواْ ٱللَّهَ مَا ٱسۡتَطَعۡتُمۡ وَٱسۡمَعُواْ وَأَطِيعُواْ وَأَنفِقُواْ خَيۡرٗا لِّأَنفُسِكُمۡۗ وَمَن يُوقَ شُحَّ نَفۡسِهِۦ فَأُوْلَـٰٓئِكَ هُمُ ٱلۡمُفۡلِحُونَ
translation: So fear Allah as much as you are able and listen and obey and spend [in the way of Allah]; it is better for your selves. And whoever is protected from the stinginess of his soul - it is those who will be the successful
normalizedArabic: فاتقوا الله ما استطعتم واسمعوا واطيعوا وانفقوا خيرا لانفسكم ومن يوق شح نفسه فاوليك هم المفلحون
normalizedTranslation: so fear allah as much as you are able and listen and obey and spend [in the way of allah]; it is better for your selves. and whoever is protected from the stinginess of his soul - it is those who will be the successful

arabic: إِن تُقۡرِضُواْ ٱللَّهَ قَرۡضًا حَسَنٗا يُضَٰعِفۡهُ لَكُمۡ وَيَغۡفِرۡ لَكُمۡۚ وَٱللَّهُ شَكُورٌ حَلِيمٌ
translation: If you loan Allah a goodly loan, He will multiply it for you and forgive you. And Allah is Most Appreciative and Forbearing
normalizedArabic: ان تقرضوا الله قرضا حسنا يضعفه لكم ويغفر لكم والله شكور حليم
normalizedTranslation: if you loan allah a goodly loan, he will multiply it for you and forgive you. and allah is most appreciative and forbearing

arabic: عَٰلِمُ ٱلۡغَيۡبِ وَٱلشَّهَٰدَةِ ٱلۡعَزِيزُ ٱلۡحَكِيمُ
translation: Knower of the unseen and the witnessed, the Exalted in Might, the Wise
normalizedArabic: علم الغيب والشهده العزيز الحكيم
normalizedTranslation: knower of the unseen and the witnessed, the exalted in might, the wise

arabic: يَـٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلنَّبِيُّ إِذَا طَلَّقۡتُمُ ٱلنِّسَآءَ فَطَلِّقُوهُنَّ لِعِدَّتِهِنَّ وَأَحۡصُواْ ٱلۡعِدَّةَۖ وَٱتَّقُواْ ٱللَّهَ رَبَّكُمۡۖ لَا تُخۡرِجُوهُنَّ مِنۢ بُيُوتِهِنَّ وَلَا يَخۡرُجۡنَ إِلَّآ أَن يَأۡتِينَ بِفَٰحِشَةٖ مُّبَيِّنَةٖۚ وَتِلۡكَ حُدُودُ ٱللَّهِۚ وَمَن يَتَعَدَّ حُدُودَ ٱللَّهِ فَقَدۡ ظَلَمَ نَفۡسَهُۥۚ لَا تَدۡرِي لَعَلَّ ٱللَّهَ يُحۡدِثُ بَعۡدَ ذَٰلِكَ أَمۡرٗا
translation: O Prophet, when you [Muslims] divorce women, divorce them for [the commencement of] their waiting period and keep count of the waiting period, and fear Allah, your Lord. Do not turn them out of their [husbands'] houses, nor should they [themselves] leave [during that period] unless they are committing a clear immorality. And those are the limits [set by] Allah. And whoever transgresses the limits of Allah has certainly wronged himself. You know not; perhaps Allah will bring about after that a [different] matter
normalizedArabic: يايها النبي اذا طلقتم النساء فطلقوهن لعدتهن واحصوا العده واتقوا الله ربكم لا تخرجوهن من بيوتهن ولا يخرجن الا ان ياتين بفحشه مبينه وتلك حدود الله ومن يتعد حدود الله فقد ظلم نفسه لا تدري لعل الله يحدث بعد ذلك امرا
normalizedTranslation: o prophet, when you [muslims] divorce women, divorce them for [the commencement of] their waiting period and keep count of the waiting period, and fear allah, your lord. do not turn them out of their [husbands'] houses, nor should they [themselves] leave [during that period] unless they are committing a clear immorality. and those are the limits [set by] allah. and whoever transgresses the limits of allah has certainly wronged himself. you know not; perhaps allah will bring about after that a [different] matter

arabic: فَإِذَا بَلَغۡنَ أَجَلَهُنَّ فَأَمۡسِكُوهُنَّ بِمَعۡرُوفٍ أَوۡ فَارِقُوهُنَّ بِمَعۡرُوفٖ وَأَشۡهِدُواْ ذَوَيۡ عَدۡلٖ مِّنكُمۡ وَأَقِيمُواْ ٱلشَّهَٰدَةَ لِلَّهِۚ ذَٰلِكُمۡ يُوعَظُ بِهِۦ مَن كَانَ يُؤۡمِنُ بِٱللَّهِ وَٱلۡيَوۡمِ ٱلۡأٓخِرِۚ وَمَن يَتَّقِ ٱللَّهَ يَجۡعَل لَّهُۥ مَخۡرَجٗا
translation: And when they have [nearly] fulfilled their term, either retain them according to acceptable terms or part with them according to acceptable terms. And bring to witness two just men from among you and establish the testimony for [the acceptance of] Allah. That is instructed to whoever should believe in Allah and the Last day. And whoever fears Allah - He will make for him a way out
normalizedArabic: فاذا بلغن اجلهن فامسكوهن بمعروف او فارقوهن بمعروف واشهدوا ذوي عدل منكم واقيموا الشهده لله ذلكم يوعظ به من كان يومن بالله واليوم الاخر ومن يتق الله يجعل له مخرجا
normalizedTranslation: and when they have [nearly] fulfilled their term, either retain them according to acceptable terms or part with them according to acceptable terms. and bring to witness two just men from among you and establish the testimony for [the acceptance of] allah. that is instructed to whoever should believe in allah and the last day. and whoever fears allah - he will make for him a way out

arabic: وَيَرۡزُقۡهُ مِنۡ حَيۡثُ لَا يَحۡتَسِبُۚ وَمَن يَتَوَكَّلۡ عَلَى ٱللَّهِ فَهُوَ حَسۡبُهُۥٓۚ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ بَٰلِغُ أَمۡرِهِۦۚ قَدۡ جَعَلَ ٱللَّهُ لِكُلِّ شَيۡءٖ قَدۡرٗا
translation: And will provide for him from where he does not expect. And whoever relies upon Allah - then He is sufficient for him. Indeed, Allah will accomplish His purpose. Allah has already set for everything a [decreed] extent
normalizedArabic: ويرزقه من حيث لا يحتسب ومن يتوكل علي الله فهو حسبه ان الله بلغ امره قد جعل الله لكل شيء قدرا
normalizedTranslation: and will provide for him from where he does not expect. and whoever relies upon allah - then he is sufficient for him. indeed, allah will accomplish his purpose. allah has already set for everything a [decreed] extent

arabic: وَٱلَّـٰٓـِٔي يَئِسۡنَ مِنَ ٱلۡمَحِيضِ مِن نِّسَآئِكُمۡ إِنِ ٱرۡتَبۡتُمۡ فَعِدَّتُهُنَّ ثَلَٰثَةُ أَشۡهُرٖ وَٱلَّـٰٓـِٔي لَمۡ يَحِضۡنَۚ وَأُوْلَٰتُ ٱلۡأَحۡمَالِ أَجَلُهُنَّ أَن يَضَعۡنَ حَمۡلَهُنَّۚ وَمَن يَتَّقِ ٱللَّهَ يَجۡعَل لَّهُۥ مِنۡ أَمۡرِهِۦ يُسۡرٗا
translation: And those who no longer expect menstruation among your women - if you doubt, then their period is three months, and [also for] those who have not menstruated. And for those who are pregnant, their term is until they give birth. And whoever fears Allah - He will make for him of his matter ease
normalizedArabic: والي ييسن من المحيض من نسايكم ان ارتبتم فعدتهن ثلثه اشهر والي لم يحضن واولت الاحمال اجلهن ان يضعن حملهن ومن يتق الله يجعل له من امره يسرا
normalizedTranslation: and those who no longer expect menstruation among your women - if you doubt, then their period is three months, and [also for] those who have not menstruated. and for those who are pregnant, their term is until they give birth. and whoever fears allah - he will make for him of his matter ease

arabic: ذَٰلِكَ أَمۡرُ ٱللَّهِ أَنزَلَهُۥٓ إِلَيۡكُمۡۚ وَمَن يَتَّقِ ٱللَّهَ يُكَفِّرۡ عَنۡهُ سَيِّـَٔاتِهِۦ وَيُعۡظِمۡ لَهُۥٓ أَجۡرًا
translation: That is the command of Allah, which He has sent down to you; and whoever fears Allah - He will remove for him his misdeeds and make great for him his reward
normalizedArabic: ذلك امر الله انزله اليكم ومن يتق الله يكفر عنه سياته ويعظم له اجرا
normalizedTranslation: that is the command of allah, which he has sent down to you; and whoever fears allah - he will remove for him his misdeeds and make great for him his reward

arabic: أَسۡكِنُوهُنَّ مِنۡ حَيۡثُ سَكَنتُم مِّن وُجۡدِكُمۡ وَلَا تُضَآرُّوهُنَّ لِتُضَيِّقُواْ عَلَيۡهِنَّۚ وَإِن كُنَّ أُوْلَٰتِ حَمۡلٖ فَأَنفِقُواْ عَلَيۡهِنَّ حَتَّىٰ يَضَعۡنَ حَمۡلَهُنَّۚ فَإِنۡ أَرۡضَعۡنَ لَكُمۡ فَـَٔاتُوهُنَّ أُجُورَهُنَّ وَأۡتَمِرُواْ بَيۡنَكُم بِمَعۡرُوفٖۖ وَإِن تَعَاسَرۡتُمۡ فَسَتُرۡضِعُ لَهُۥٓ أُخۡرَىٰ
translation: Lodge them [in a section] of where you dwell out of your means and do not harm them in order to oppress them. And if they should be pregnant, then spend on them until they give birth. And if they breastfeed for you, then give them their payment and confer among yourselves in the acceptable way; but if you are in discord, then there may breastfeed for the father another woman
normalizedArabic: اسكنوهن من حيث سكنتم من وجدكم ولا تضاروهن لتضيقوا عليهن وان كن اولت حمل فانفقوا عليهن حتي يضعن حملهن فان ارضعن لكم فاتوهن اجورهن واتمروا بينكم بمعروف وان تعاسرتم فسترضع له اخري
normalizedTranslation: lodge them [in a section] of where you dwell out of your means and do not harm them in order to oppress them. and if they should be pregnant, then spend on them until they give birth. and if they breastfeed for you, then give them their payment and confer among yourselves in the acceptable way; but if you are in discord, then there may breastfeed for the father another woman

arabic: لِيُنفِقۡ ذُو سَعَةٖ مِّن سَعَتِهِۦۖ وَمَن قُدِرَ عَلَيۡهِ رِزۡقُهُۥ فَلۡيُنفِقۡ مِمَّآ ءَاتَىٰهُ ٱللَّهُۚ لَا يُكَلِّفُ ٱللَّهُ نَفۡسًا إِلَّا مَآ ءَاتَىٰهَاۚ سَيَجۡعَلُ ٱللَّهُ بَعۡدَ عُسۡرٖ يُسۡرٗا
translation: Let a man of wealth spend from his wealth, and he whose provision is restricted - let him spend from what Allah has given him. Allah does not charge a soul except [according to] what He has given it. Allah will bring about, after hardship, ease
normalizedArabic: لينفق ذو سعه من سعته ومن قدر عليه رزقه فلينفق مما ءاتيه الله لا يكلف الله نفسا الا ما ءاتيها سيجعل الله بعد عسر يسرا
normalizedTranslation: let a man of wealth spend from his wealth, and he whose provision is restricted - let him spend from what allah has given him. allah does not charge a soul except [according to] what he has given it. allah will bring about, after hardship, ease

arabic: وَكَأَيِّن مِّن قَرۡيَةٍ عَتَتۡ عَنۡ أَمۡرِ رَبِّهَا وَرُسُلِهِۦ فَحَاسَبۡنَٰهَا حِسَابٗا شَدِيدٗا وَعَذَّبۡنَٰهَا عَذَابٗا نُّكۡرٗا
translation: And how many a city was insolent toward the command of its Lord and His messengers, so We took it to severe account and punished it with a terrible punishment
normalizedArabic: وكاين من قريه عتت عن امر ربها ورسله فحاسبنها حسابا شديدا وعذبنها عذابا نكرا
normalizedTranslation: and how many a city was insolent toward the command of its lord and his messengers, so we took it to severe account and punished it with a terrible punishment

arabic: فَذَاقَتۡ وَبَالَ أَمۡرِهَا وَكَانَ عَٰقِبَةُ أَمۡرِهَا خُسۡرًا
translation: And it tasted the bad consequence of its affair, and the outcome of its affair was loss
normalizedArabic: فذاقت وبال امرها وكان عقبه امرها خسرا
normalizedTranslation: and it tasted the bad consequence of its affair, and the outcome of its affair was loss

arabic: أَعَدَّ ٱللَّهُ لَهُمۡ عَذَابٗا شَدِيدٗاۖ فَٱتَّقُواْ ٱللَّهَ يَـٰٓأُوْلِي ٱلۡأَلۡبَٰبِ ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُواْۚ قَدۡ أَنزَلَ ٱللَّهُ إِلَيۡكُمۡ ذِكۡرٗا
translation: Allah has prepared for them a severe punishment; so fear Allah, O you of understanding who have believed. Allah has sent down to you the Qur'an

normalizedTranslation: allah has prepared for them a severe punishment; so fear allah, o you of understanding who have believed. allah has sent down to you the qur'an

arabic: رَّسُولٗا يَتۡلُواْ عَلَيۡكُمۡ ءَايَٰتِ ٱللَّهِ مُبَيِّنَٰتٖ لِّيُخۡرِجَ ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُواْ وَعَمِلُواْ ٱلصَّـٰلِحَٰتِ مِنَ ٱلظُّلُمَٰتِ إِلَى ٱلنُّورِۚ وَمَن يُؤۡمِنۢ بِٱللَّهِ وَيَعۡمَلۡ صَٰلِحٗا يُدۡخِلۡهُ جَنَّـٰتٖ تَجۡرِي مِن تَحۡتِهَا ٱلۡأَنۡهَٰرُ خَٰلِدِينَ فِيهَآ أَبَدٗاۖ قَدۡ أَحۡسَنَ ٱللَّهُ لَهُۥ رِزۡقًا
translation: [He sent] a Messenger [Muhammad] reciting to you the distinct verses of Allah that He may bring out those who believe and do righteous deeds from darknesses into the light. arabic: ٱللَّهُ ٱلَّذِي خَلَقَ سَبۡعَ سَمَٰوَٰتٖ وَمِنَ ٱلۡأَرۡضِ مِثۡلَهُنَّۖ يَتَنَزَّلُ ٱلۡأَمۡرُ بَيۡنَهُنَّ لِتَعۡلَمُوٓاْ أَنَّ ٱللَّهَ عَلَىٰ كُلِّ شَيۡءٖ قَدِيرٞ وَأَنَّ ٱللَّهَ قَدۡ أَحَاطَ بِكُلِّ شَيۡءٍ عِلۡمَۢا

normalizedTranslation: it is allah who has created seven heavens and of the earth, the like of them. [his] command descends among them so you may know that allah is over all things competent and that allah has encompassed all things in knowledge

arabic: يَـٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلنَّبِيُّ لِمَ تُحَرِّمُ مَآ أَحَلَّ ٱللَّهُ لَكَۖ تَبۡتَغِي مَرۡضَاتَ أَزۡوَٰجِكَۚ وَٱللَّهُ غَفُورٞ رَّحِيمٞ
translation: O Prophet, why do you prohibit [yourself from] what Allah has made lawful for you, seeking the approval of your wives? And Allah is Forgiving and Merciful

arabic: ٱلَّذِي خَلَقَ ٱلۡمَوۡتَ وَٱلۡحَيَوٰةَ لِيَبۡلُوَكُمۡ أَيُّكُمۡ أَحۡسَنُ عَمَلٗاۚ وَهُوَ ٱلۡعَزِيزُ ٱلۡغَفُورُ
translation: [He] who created death and life to test you [as to] which of you is best in deed - and He is the Exalted in Might, the Forgiving
normalizedArabic: الذي خلق الموت والحيوه ليبلوكم ايكم احسن عملا وهو العزيز الغفور
normalizedTranslation: [he] who created death and life to test you [as to] which of you is best in deed - and he is the exalted in might, the forgiving

arabic: ٱلَّذِي خَلَقَ سَبۡعَ سَمَٰوَٰتٖ طِبَاقٗاۖ مَّا تَرَىٰ فِي خَلۡقِ ٱلرَّحۡمَٰنِ مِن تَفَٰوُتٖۖ فَٱرۡجِعِ ٱلۡبَصَرَ هَلۡ تَرَىٰ مِن فُطُورٖ
translation: [And] who created seven heavens in layers. You do not see in the creation of the Most Merciful any inconsistency. So return [your] vision [to the sky]; do you see any breaks
normalizedArabic: الذي خلق سبع سموت طباقا ما تري في خلق الرحمن من تفوت فارجع البصر هل تري من فطور
normalizedTranslation: [and] who created seven heavens in layers. you do not see in the creation of the most merciful any inconsistency. so return [your] vision [to the sky]; do you see any breaks

arabic: ثُمَّ ٱرۡجِعِ ٱلۡبَصَرَ كَرَّتَيۡنِ يَنقَلِبۡ إِلَيۡكَ ٱلۡبَصَرُ خَاسِئٗا وَهُوَ حَسِيرٞ
translation: Then return [your] vision twice again. [Your] vision will return to you humbled while it is fatigued
normalizedArabic: ثم ارجع البصر كرتين ينقلب اليك البصر خاسيا وهو حسير
normalizedTranslation: then return [your] vision twice again. [your] vision will return to you humbled while it is fatigued

arabic: وَلَقَدۡ زَيَّنَّا ٱلسَّمَآءَ ٱلدُّنۡيَا بِمَصَٰبِيحَ وَجَعَلۡنَٰهَا رُجُومٗا لِّلشَّيَٰطِينِۖ وَأَعۡتَدۡنَا لَهُمۡ عَذَابَ ٱلسَّعِيرِ
translation: And We have certainly beautified the nearest heaven with stars and have made [from] them what is thrown at the devils and have prepared for them the punishment of the Blaze
normalizedArabic: ولقد زينا السماء الدنيا بمصبيح وجعلنها رجوما للشيطين واعتدنا لهم عذاب السعير
normalizedTranslation: and we have certainly beautified the nearest heaven with stars and have made [from] them what is thrown at the devils and have prepared for them the punishment of the blaze

arabic: وَلِلَّذِينَ كَفَرُواْ بِرَبِّهِمۡ عَذَابُ جَهَنَّمَۖ وَبِئۡسَ ٱلۡمَصِيرُ
translation: And for those who disbelieved in their Lord is the punishment of Hell, and wretched is the destination
normalizedArabic: وللذين كفروا بربهم عذاب جهنم وبيس المصير
normalizedTranslation: and for those who disbelieved in their lord is the punishment of hell, and wretched is the destination

arabic: إِذَآ أُلۡقُواْ فِيهَا سَمِعُواْ لَهَا شَهِيقٗا وَهِيَ تَفُورُ
translation: When they are thrown into it, they hear from it a [dreadful] inhaling while it boils up
normalizedArabic: اذا القوا فيها سمعوا لها شهيقا وهي تفور
normalizedTranslation: when they are thrown into it, they hear from it a [dreadful] inhaling while it boils up

arabic: تَكَادُ تَمَيَّزُ مِنَ ٱلۡغَيۡظِۖ كُلَّمَآ أُلۡقِيَ فِيهَا فَوۡجٞ سَأَلَهُمۡ خَزَنَتُهَآ أَلَمۡ يَأۡتِكُمۡ نَذِيرٞ
translation: It almost bursts with rage. Every time a company is thrown into it, its keepers ask them, "Did there not come to you a warner
normalizedArabic: تكاد تميز من الغيظ كلما القي فيها فوج سالهم خزنتها الم ياتكم نذير
normalizedTranslation: it almost bursts with rage. every time a company is thrown into it, its keepers ask them, "did there not come to you a warner

arabic: قَالُواْ بَلَىٰ قَدۡ جَآءَنَا نَذِيرٞ فَكَذَّبۡنَا وَقُلۡنَا مَا نَزَّلَ ٱللَّهُ مِن شَيۡءٍ إِنۡ أَنتُمۡ إِلَّا فِي ضَلَٰلٖ كَبِيرٖ
translation: They will say," Yes, a warner had come to us, but we denied and said, 'Allah has not sent down anything. You are not but in great error
normalizedArabic: قالوا بلي قد جاءنا نذير فكذبنا وقلنا ما نزل الله من شيء ان انتم الا في ضلل كبير
normalizedTranslation: they will say," yes, a warner had come to us, but we denied and said, 'allah has not sent down anything. you are not but in great error

arabic: وَقَالُواْ لَوۡ كُنَّا نَسۡمَعُ أَوۡ نَعۡقِلُ مَا كُنَّا فِيٓ أَصۡحَٰبِ ٱلسَّعِيرِ
translation: And they will say, "If only we had been listening or reasoning, we would not be among the companions of the Blaze
normalizedArabic: وقالوا لو كنا نسمع او نعقل ما كنا في اصحب السعير
normalizedTranslation: and they will say, "if only we had been listening or reasoning, we would not be among the companions of the blaze

arabic: فَٱعۡتَرَفُواْ بِذَنۢبِهِمۡ فَسُحۡقٗا لِّأَصۡحَٰبِ ٱلسَّعِيرِ
translation: And they will admit their sin, so [it is] alienation for the companions of the Blaze
normalizedArabic: فاعترفوا بذنبهم فسحقا لاصحب السعير
normalizedTranslation: and they will admit their sin, so [it is] alienation for the companions of the blaze

arabic: إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ يَخۡشَوۡنَ رَبَّهُم بِٱلۡغَيۡبِ لَهُم مَّغۡفِرَةٞ وَأَجۡرٞ كَبِيرٞ
translation: Indeed, those who fear their Lord unseen will have forgiveness and great reward
normalizedArabic: ان الذين يخشون ربهم بالغيب لهم مغفره واجر كبير
normalizedTranslation: indeed, those who fear their lord unseen will have forgiveness and great reward

arabic: وَأَسِرُّواْ قَوۡلَكُمۡ أَوِ ٱجۡهَرُواْ بِهِۦٓۖ إِنَّهُۥ عَلِيمُۢ بِذَاتِ ٱلصُّدُورِ
translation: And conceal your speech or publicize it; indeed, He is Knowing of that within the breasts
normalizedArabic: واسروا قولكم او اجهروا به انه عليم بذات الصدور
normalizedTranslation: and conceal your speech or publicize it; indeed, he is knowing of that within the breasts

arabic: أَلَا يَعۡلَمُ مَنۡ خَلَقَ وَهُوَ ٱللَّطِيفُ ٱلۡخَبِيرُ
translation: Does He who created not know, while He is the Subtle, the Acquainted
normalizedArabic: الا يعلم من خلق وهو اللطيف الخبير
normalizedTranslation: does he who created not know, while he is the subtle, the acquainted

arabic: هُوَ ٱلَّذِي جَعَلَ لَكُمُ ٱلۡأَرۡضَ ذَلُولٗا فَٱمۡشُواْ فِي مَنَاكِبِهَا وَكُلُواْ مِن رِّزۡقِهِۦۖ وَإِلَيۡهِ ٱلنُّشُورُ
translation: It is He who made the earth tame for you - so walk among its slopes and eat of His provision - and to Him is the resurrection
normalizedArabic: هو الذي جعل لكم الارض ذلولا فامشوا في مناكبها وكلوا من رزقه واليه النشور
normalizedTranslation: it is he who made the earth tame for you - so walk among its slopes and eat of his provision - and to him is the resurrection

arabic: ءَأَمِنتُم مَّن فِي ٱلسَّمَآءِ أَن يَخۡسِفَ بِكُمُ ٱلۡأَرۡضَ فَإِذَا هِيَ تَمُورُ
translation: Do you feel secure that He who [holds authority] in the heaven would not cause the earth to swallow you and suddenly it would sway
normalizedArabic: ءامنتم من في السماء ان يخسف بكم الارض فاذا هي تمور
normalizedTranslation: do you feel secure that he who [holds authority] in the heaven would not cause the earth to swallow you and suddenly it would sway

arabic: أَمۡ أَمِنتُم مَّن فِي ٱلسَّمَآءِ أَن يُرۡسِلَ عَلَيۡكُمۡ حَاصِبٗاۖ فَسَتَعۡلَمُونَ كَيۡفَ نَذِيرِ
translation: Or do you feel secure that He who [holds authority] in the heaven would not send against you a storm of stones? Then you would know how [severe] was My warning
normalizedArabic: ام امنتم من في السماء ان يرسل عليكم حاصبا فستعلمون كيف نذير
normalizedTranslation: or do you feel secure that he who [holds authority] in the heaven would not send against you a storm of stones? then you would know how [severe] was my warning

arabic: وَلَقَدۡ كَذَّبَ ٱلَّذِينَ مِن قَبۡلِهِمۡ فَكَيۡفَ كَانَ نَكِيرِ
translation: And already had those before them denied, and how [terrible] was My reproach
normalizedArabic: ولقد كذب الذين من قبلهم فكيف كان نكير
normalizedTranslation: and already had those before them denied, and how [terrible] was my reproach

arabic: أَوَلَمۡ يَرَوۡاْ إِلَى ٱلطَّيۡرِ فَوۡقَهُمۡ صَـٰٓفَّـٰتٖ وَيَقۡبِضۡنَۚ مَا يُمۡسِكُهُنَّ إِلَّا ٱلرَّحۡمَٰنُۚ إِنَّهُۥ بِكُلِّ شَيۡءِۭ بَصِيرٌ
translation: Do they not see the birds above them with wings outspread and [sometimes] folded in? None holds them [aloft] except the Most Merciful. Indeed He is, of all things, Seeing
normalizedArabic: اولم يروا الي الطير فوقهم صفت ويقبضن ما يمسكهن الا الرحمن انه بكل شيء بصير
normalizedTranslation: do they not see the birds above them with wings outspread and [sometimes] folded in? none holds them [aloft] except the most merciful. indeed he is, of all things, seeing

arabic: أَمَّنۡ هَٰذَا ٱلَّذِي هُوَ جُندٞ لَّكُمۡ يَنصُرُكُم مِّن دُونِ ٱلرَّحۡمَٰنِۚ إِنِ ٱلۡكَٰفِرُونَ إِلَّا فِي غُرُورٍ
translation: Or who is it that could be an army for you to aid you other than the Most Merciful? The disbelievers are not but in delusion
normalizedArabic: امن هذا الذي هو جند لكم ينصركم من دون الرحمن ان الكفرون الا في غرور
normalizedTranslation: or who is it that could be an army for you to aid you other than the most merciful? the disbelievers are not but in delusion

arabic: أَمَّنۡ هَٰذَا ٱلَّذِي يَرۡزُقُكُمۡ إِنۡ أَمۡسَكَ رِزۡقَهُۥۚ بَل لَّجُّواْ فِي عُتُوّٖ وَنُفُورٍ
translation: Or who is it that could provide for you if He withheld His provision? But they have persisted in insolence and aversion
normalizedArabic: امن هذا الذي يرزقكم ان امسك رزقه بل لجوا في عتو ونفور
normalizedTranslation: or who is it that could provide for you if he withheld his provision? but they have persisted in insolence and aversion

arabic: أَفَمَن يَمۡشِي مُكِبًّا عَلَىٰ وَجۡهِهِۦٓ أَهۡدَىٰٓ أَمَّن يَمۡشِي سَوِيًّا عَلَىٰ صِرَٰطٖ مُّسۡتَقِيمٖ
translation: Then is one who walks fallen on his face better guided or one who walks erect on a straight path
normalizedArabic: افمن يمشي مكبا علي وجهه اهدي امن يمشي سويا علي صرط مستقيم
normalizedTranslation: then is one who walks fallen on his face better guided or one who walks erect on a straight path

arabic: قُلۡ هُوَ ٱلَّذِيٓ أَنشَأَكُمۡ وَجَعَلَ لَكُمُ ٱلسَّمۡعَ وَٱلۡأَبۡصَٰرَ وَٱلۡأَفۡـِٔدَةَۚ قَلِيلٗا مَّا تَشۡكُرُونَ
translation: Say, "It is He who has produced you and made for you hearing and vision and hearts; little are you grateful
normalizedArabic: قل هو الذي انشاكم وجعل لكم السمع والابصر والافده قليلا ما تشكرون
normalizedTranslation: say, "it is he who has produced you and made for you hearing and vision and hearts; little are you grateful

arabic: قُلۡ هُوَ ٱلَّذِي ذَرَأَكُمۡ فِي ٱلۡأَرۡضِ وَإِلَيۡهِ تُحۡشَرُونَ
translation: Say, "It is He who has multiplied you throughout the earth, and to Him you will be gathered
normalizedArabic: قل هو الذي ذراكم في الارض واليه تحشرون
normalizedTranslation: say, "it is he who has multiplied you throughout the earth, and to him you will be gathered

arabic: وَيَقُولُونَ مَتَىٰ هَٰذَا ٱلۡوَعۡدُ إِن كُنتُمۡ صَٰدِقِينَ
translation: And they say, "When is this promise, if you should be truthful
normalizedArabic: ويقولون متي هذا الوعد ان كنتم صدقين
normalizedTranslation: and they say, "when is this promise, if you should be truthful

arabic: قُلۡ إِنَّمَا ٱلۡعِلۡمُ عِندَ ٱللَّهِ وَإِنَّمَآ أَنَا۠ نَذِيرٞ مُّبِينٞ
translation: Say, "The knowledge is only with Allah, and I am only a clear warner
normalizedArabic: قل انما العلم عند الله وانما انا نذير مبين
normalizedTranslation: say, "the knowledge is only with allah, and i am only a clear warner

arabic: فَلَمَّا رَأَوۡهُ زُلۡفَةٗ سِيٓـَٔتۡ وُجُوهُ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُواْ وَقِيلَ هَٰذَا ٱلَّذِي كُنتُم بِهِۦ تَدَّعُونَ
translation: But when they see it approaching, the faces of those who disbelieve will be distressed, and it will be said, "This is that for which you used to call
normalizedArabic: فلما راوه زلفه سيت وجوه الذين كفروا وقيل هذا الذي كنتم به تدعون
normalizedTranslation: but when they see it approaching, the faces of those who disbelieve will be distressed, and it will be said, "this is that for which you used to call

arabic: قُلۡ أَرَءَيۡتُمۡ إِنۡ أَهۡلَكَنِيَ ٱللَّهُ وَمَن مَّعِيَ أَوۡ رَحِمَنَا فَمَن يُجِيرُ ٱلۡكَٰفِرِينَ مِنۡ عَذَابٍ أَلِيمٖ
translation: Say, [O Muhammad], "Have you considered: whether Allah should cause my death and those with me or have mercy upon us, who can protect the disbelievers from a painful punishment
normalizedArabic: قل ارءيتم ان اهلكني الله ومن معي او رحمنا فمن يجير الكفرين من عذاب اليم
normalizedTranslation: say, [o muhammad], "have you considered: whether allah should cause my death and those with me or have mercy upon us, who can protect the disbelievers from a painful punishment

arabic: قُلۡ هُوَ ٱلرَّحۡمَٰنُ ءَامَنَّا بِهِۦ وَعَلَيۡهِ تَوَكَّلۡنَاۖ فَسَتَعۡلَمُونَ مَنۡ هُوَ فِي ضَلَٰلٖ مُّبِينٖ
translation: Say, "He is the Most Merciful; we have believed in Him, and upon Him we have relied. And you will [come to] know who it is that is in clear error
normalizedArabic: قل هو الرحمن ءامنا به وعليه توكلنا فستعلمون من هو في ضلل مبين
normalizedTranslation: say, "he is the most merciful; we have believed in him, and upon him we have relied. and you will [come to] know who it is that is in clear error

arabic: قُلۡ أَرَءَيۡتُمۡ إِنۡ أَصۡبَحَ مَآؤُكُمۡ غَوۡرٗا فَمَن يَأۡتِيكُم بِمَآءٖ مَّعِينِۭ
translation: Say, "Have you considered: if your water was to become sunken [into the earth], then who could bring you flowing water
normalizedArabic: قل ارءيتم ان اصبح ماوكم غورا فمن ياتيكم بماء معين
normalizedTranslation: say, "have you considered: if your water was to become sunken [into the earth], then who could bring you flowing water

arabic: نٓۚ وَٱلۡقَلَمِ وَمَا يَسۡطُرُونَ
translation: Nun. By the pen and what they inscribe
normalizedArabic: ن والقلم وما يسطرون
normalizedTranslation: nun. by the pen and what they inscribe

arabic: مَآ أَنتَ بِنِعۡمَةِ رَبِّكَ بِمَجۡنُونٖ
translation: You are not, [O Muhammad], by the favor of your Lord, a madman
normalizedArabic: ما انت بنعمه ربك بمجنون
normalizedTranslation: you are not, [o muhammad], by the favor of your lord, a madman

arabic: وَإِنَّ لَكَ لَأَجۡرًا غَيۡرَ مَمۡنُونٖ
translation: And indeed, for you is a reward uninterrupted
normalizedArabic: وان لك لاجرا غير ممنون
normalizedTranslation: and indeed, for you is a reward uninterrupted

arabic: وَإِنَّكَ لَعَلَىٰ خُلُقٍ عَظِيمٖ
translation: And indeed, you are of a great moral character
normalizedArabic: وانك لعلي خلق عظيم
normalizedTranslation: and indeed, you are of a great moral character

arabic: فَسَتُبۡصِرُ وَيُبۡصِرُونَ
translation: So you will see and they will see
normalizedArabic: فستبصر ويبصرون
normalizedTranslation: so you will see and they will see

arabic: بِأَييِّكُمُ ٱلۡمَفۡتُونُ
translation: Which of you is the afflicted [by a devil]
normalizedArabic: باييكم المفتون
normalizedTranslation: which of you is the afflicted [by a devil]

arabic: إِنَّ رَبَّكَ هُوَ أَعۡلَمُ بِمَن ضَلَّ عَن سَبِيلِهِۦ وَهُوَ أَعۡلَمُ بِٱلۡمُهۡتَدِينَ
translation: Indeed, your Lord is most knowing of who has gone astray from His way, and He is most knowing of the [rightly] guided
normalizedArabic: ان ربك هو اعلم بمن ضل عن سبيله وهو اعلم بالمهتدين
normalizedTranslation: indeed, your lord is most knowing of who has gone astray from his way, and he is most knowing of the [rightly] guided

arabic: فَلَا تُطِعِ ٱلۡمُكَذِّبِينَ
translation: Then do not obey the deniers
normalizedArabic: فلا تطع المكذبين
normalizedTranslation: then do not obey the deniers

arabic: وَدُّواْ لَوۡ تُدۡهِنُ فَيُدۡهِنُونَ
translation: They wish that you would soften [in your position], so they would soften [toward you]
normalizedArabic: ودوا لو تدهن فيدهنون
normalizedTranslation: they wish that you would soften [in your position], so they would soften [toward you]

arabic: وَلَا تُطِعۡ كُلَّ حَلَّافٖ مَّهِينٍ
translation: And do not obey every worthless habitual swearer
normalizedArabic: ولا تطع كل حلاف مهين
normalizedTranslation: and do not obey every worthless habitual swearer

arabic: هَمَّازٖ مَّشَّآءِۭ بِنَمِيمٖ
translation: [And] scorner, going about with malicious gossip
normalizedArabic: هماز مشاء بنميم
normalizedTranslation: [and] scorner, going about with malicious gossip

arabic: مَّنَّاعٖ لِّلۡخَيۡرِ مُعۡتَدٍ أَثِيمٍ
translation: A preventer of good, transgressing and sinful
normalizedArabic: مناع للخير معتد اثيم
normalizedTranslation: a preventer of good, transgressing and sinful

arabic: عُتُلِّۭ بَعۡدَ ذَٰلِكَ زَنِيمٍ
translation: Cruel, moreover, and an illegitimate pretender
normalizedArabic: عتل بعد ذلك زنيم
normalizedTranslation: cruel, moreover, and an illegitimate pretender

arabic: أَن كَانَ ذَا مَالٖ وَبَنِينَ
translation: Because he is a possessor of wealth and children

arabic: وَأَنَّا مِنَّا ٱلصَّـٰلِحُونَ وَمِنَّا دُونَ ذَٰلِكَۖ كُنَّا طَرَآئِقَ قِدَدٗا
translation: And among us are the righteous, and among us are [others] not so; we were [of] divided ways
normalizedArabic: وانا منا الصلحون ومنا دون ذلك كنا طرايق قددا
normalizedTranslation: and among us are the righteous, and among us are [others] not so; we were [of] divided ways

arabic: وَأَنَّا ظَنَنَّآ أَن لَّن نُّعۡجِزَ ٱللَّهَ فِي ٱلۡأَرۡضِ وَلَن نُّعۡجِزَهُۥ هَرَبٗا
translation: And we have become certain that we will never cause failure to Allah upon earth, nor can we escape Him by flight
normalizedArabic: وانا ظننا ان لن نعجز الله في الارض ولن نعجزه هربا
normalizedTranslation: and we have become certain that we will never cause failure to allah upon earth, nor can we escape him by flight

arabic: وَأَنَّا لَمَّا سَمِعۡنَا ٱلۡهُدَىٰٓ ءَامَنَّا بِهِۦۖ فَمَن يُؤۡمِنۢ بِرَبِّهِۦ فَلَا يَخَافُ بَخۡسٗا وَلَا رَهَقٗا
translation: And when we heard the guidance, we believed in it. And whoever believes in his Lord will not fear deprivation or burden
normalizedArabic: وانا لما سمعنا الهدي ءامنا به فمن يومن بربه فلا يخاف بخسا ولا رهقا
normalizedTranslation: and when we heard the guidance, we believed in it. and whoever believes in his lord will not fear deprivation or burden

arabic: وَأَنَّا مِنَّا ٱلۡمُسۡلِمُونَ وَمِنَّا ٱلۡقَٰسِطُونَۖ فَمَنۡ أَسۡلَمَ فَأُوْلَـٰٓئِكَ تَحَرَّوۡاْ رَشَدٗا
translation: And among us are Muslims [in submission to Allah], and among us are the unjust. And whoever has become Muslim - those have sought out the right course
normalizedArabic: وانا منا المسلمون ومنا القسطون فمن اسلم فاوليك تحروا رشدا
normalizedTranslation: and among us are muslims [in submission to allah], and among us are the unjust. and whoever has become muslim - those have sought out the right course

arabic: وَأَمَّا ٱلۡقَٰسِطُونَ فَكَانُواْ لِجَهَنَّمَ حَطَبٗا
translation: But as for the unjust, they will be, for Hell, firewood
normalizedArabic: واما القسطون فكانوا لجهنم حطبا
normalizedTranslation: but as for the unjust, they will be, for hell, firewood

arabic: وَأَلَّوِ ٱسۡتَقَٰمُواْ عَلَى ٱلطَّرِيقَةِ لَأَسۡقَيۡنَٰهُم مَّآءً غَدَقٗا
translation: And [Allah revealed] that if they had remained straight on the way, We would have given them abundant provision
normalizedArabic: والو استقموا علي الطريقه لاسقينهم ماء غدقا
normalizedTranslation: and [allah revealed] that if they had remained straight on the way, we would have given them abundant provision

arabic: لِّنَفۡتِنَهُمۡ فِيهِۚ وَمَن يُعۡرِضۡ عَن ذِكۡرِ رَبِّهِۦ يَسۡلُكۡهُ عَذَابٗا صَعَدٗا
translation: So We might test them therein. And whoever turns away from the remembrance of his Lord He will put into arduous punishment
normalizedArabic: لنفتنهم فيه ومن يعرض عن ذكر ربه يسلكه عذابا صعدا
normalizedTranslation: so we might test them therein. and whoever turns away from the remembrance of his lord he will put into arduous punishment

arabic: وَأَنَّ ٱلۡمَسَٰجِدَ لِلَّهِ فَلَا تَدۡعُواْ مَعَ ٱللَّهِ أَحَدٗا
translation: And [He revealed] that the masjids are for Allah, so do not invoke with Allah anyone
normalizedArabic: وان المسجد لله فلا تدعوا مع الله احدا
normalizedTranslation: and [he revealed] that the masjids are for allah, so do not invoke with allah anyone

arabic: وَأَنَّهُۥ لَمَّا قَامَ عَبۡدُ ٱللَّهِ يَدۡعُوهُ كَادُواْ يَكُونُونَ عَلَيۡهِ لِبَدٗا
translation: And that when the Servant of Allah stood up supplicating Him, they almost became about him a compacted mass
normalizedArabic: وانه لما قام عبد الله يدعوه كادوا يكونون عليه لبدا
normalizedTranslation: and that when the servant of allah stood up supplicating him, they almost became about him a compacted mass

arabic: قُلۡ إِنَّمَآ أَدۡعُواْ رَبِّي وَلَآ أُشۡرِكُ بِهِۦٓ أَحَدٗا
translation: Say, [O Muhammad], "I only invoke my Lord and do not associate with Him anyone
normalizedArabic: قل انما ادعوا ربي ولا اشرك به احدا
normalizedTranslation: say, [o muhammad], "i only invoke my lord and do not associate with him anyone

arabic: قُلۡ إِنِّي لَآ أَمۡلِكُ لَكُمۡ ضَرّٗا وَلَا رَشَدٗا
translation: Say, "Indeed, I do not possess for you [the power of] harm or right direction
normalizedArabic: قل اني لا املك لكم ضرا ولا رشدا
normalizedTranslation: say, "indeed, i do not possess for you [the power of] harm or right direction

arabic: قُلۡ إِنِّي لَن يُجِيرَنِي مِنَ ٱللَّهِ أَحَدٞ وَلَنۡ أَجِدَ مِن دُونِهِۦ مُلۡتَحَدًا
translation: Say, "Indeed, there will never protect me from Allah anyone [if I should disobey], nor will I find in other than Him a refuge
normalizedArabic: قل اني لن يجيرني من الله احد ولن اجد من دونه ملتحدا
normalizedTranslation: say, "indeed, there will never protect me from allah anyone [if i should disobey], nor will i find in other than him a refuge

arabic: إِلَّا بَلَٰغٗا مِّنَ ٱللَّهِ وَرِسَٰلَٰتِهِۦۚ وَمَن يَعۡصِ ٱللَّهَ وَرَسُولَهُۥ فَإِنَّ لَهُۥ نَارَ جَهَنَّمَ خَٰلِدِينَ فِيهَآ أَبَدًا
translation: But [I have for you] only notification from Allah, and His messages." And whoever disobeys Allah and His Messenger - then indeed, for him is the fire of Hell; they will abide therein forever
normalizedArabic: الا بلغا من الله ورسلته ومن يعص الله ورسوله فان له نار جهنم خلدين فيها ابدا
normalizedTranslation: but [i have for you] only notification from allah, and his messages." and whoever disobeys allah and his messenger - then indeed, for him is the fire of hell; they will abide therein forever

arabic: حَتَّىٰٓ إِذَا رَأَوۡاْ مَا يُوعَدُونَ فَسَيَعۡلَمُونَ مَنۡ أَضۡعَفُ نَاصِرٗا وَأَقَلُّ عَدَدٗا
translation: [The disbelievers continue] until, when they see that which they are promised, then they will know who is weaker in helpers and less in number
normalizedArabic: حتي اذا راوا ما يوعدون فسيعلمون من اضعف ناصرا واقل عددا
normalizedTranslation: [the disbelievers continue] until, when they see that which they are promised, then they will know who is weaker in helpers and less in number

arabic: قُلۡ إِنۡ أَدۡرِيٓ أَقَرِيبٞ مَّا تُوعَدُونَ أَمۡ يَجۡعَلُ لَهُۥ رَبِّيٓ أَمَدًا
translation: Say, "I do not know if what you are promised is near or if my Lord will grant for it a [long] period
normalizedArabic: قل ان ادري اقريب ما توعدون ام يجعل له ربي امدا
normalizedTranslation: say, "i do not know if what you are promised is near or if my lord will grant for it a [long] period

arabic: عَٰلِمُ ٱلۡغَيۡبِ فَلَا يُظۡهِرُ عَلَىٰ غَيۡبِهِۦٓ أَحَدًا
translation: [He is] Knower of the unseen, and He does not disclose His [knowledge of the] unseen to anyone
normalizedArabic: علم الغيب فلا يظهر علي غيبه احدا
normalizedTranslation: [he is] knower of the unseen, and he does not disclose his [knowledge of the] unseen to anyone

arabic: إِلَّا مَنِ ٱرۡتَضَىٰ مِن رَّسُولٖ فَإِنَّهُۥ يَسۡلُكُ مِنۢ بَيۡنِ يَدَيۡهِ وَمِنۡ خَلۡفِهِۦ رَصَدٗا
translation: Except whom He has approved of messengers, and indeed, He sends before each messenger and behind him observers
normalizedArabic: الا من ارتضي من رسول فانه يسلك من بين يديه ومن خلفه رصدا
normalizedTranslation: except whom he has approved of messengers, and indeed, he sends before each messenger and behind him observers

arabic: لِّيَعۡلَمَ أَن قَدۡ أَبۡلَغُواْ رِسَٰلَٰتِ رَبِّهِمۡ وَأَحَاطَ بِمَا لَدَيۡهِمۡ وَأَحۡصَىٰ كُلَّ شَيۡءٍ عَدَدَۢا
translation: That he may know that they have conveyed the messages of their Lord; and He has encompassed whatever is with them and has enumerated all things in number
normalizedArabic: ليعلم ان قد ابلغوا رسلت ربهم واحاط بما لديهم واحصي كل شيء عددا
normalizedTranslation: that he may know that they have conveyed the messages of their lord; and he has encompassed whatever is with them and has enumerated all things in number

arabic: يَـٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلۡمُزَّمِّلُ
translation: O you who wraps himself [in clothing]
normalizedArabic: يايها المزمل
normalizedTranslation: o you who wraps himself [in clothing]

arabic: قُمِ ٱلَّيۡلَ إِلَّا قَلِيلٗا
translation: Arise [to pray] the night, except for a little
normalizedArabic: قم اليل الا قليلا
normalizedTranslation: arise [to pray] the night, except for a little

arabic: نِّصۡفَهُۥٓ أَوِ ٱنقُصۡ مِنۡهُ قَلِيلًا
translation: Half of it - or subtract from it a little
normalizedArabic: نصفه او انقص منه قليلا
normalizedTranslation: half of it - or subtract from it a little

arabic: أَوۡ زِدۡ عَلَيۡهِ وَرَتِّلِ ٱلۡقُرۡءَانَ تَرۡتِيلًا
translation: Or add to it, and recite the Qur'an with measured recitation
normalizedArabic: او زد عليه ورتل القرءان ترتيلا
normalizedTranslation: or add to it, and recite the qur'an with measured recitation

arabic: إِنَّا سَنُلۡقِي عَلَيۡكَ قَوۡلٗا ثَقِيلًا
translation: Indeed, We will cast upon you a heavy word
normalizedArabic: انا سنلقي عليك قولا ثقيلا
normalizedTranslation: indeed, we will cast upon you a heavy word

arabic: إِنَّ نَاشِئَةَ ٱلَّيۡلِ هِيَ أَشَدُّ وَطۡـٔٗا وَأَقۡوَمُ قِيلًا
translation: Indeed, the hours of the night are more effective for concurrence [of heart and tongue] and more suitable for words
normalizedArabic: ان ناشيه اليل هي اشد وطا واقوم قيلا
normalizedTranslation: indeed, the hours of the night are more effective for concurrence [of heart and tongue] and more suitable for words

arabic: إِنَّ لَكَ فِي ٱلنَّهَارِ سَبۡحٗا طَوِيلٗا
translation: Indeed, for you by day is prolonged occupation
normalizedArabic: ان لك في النهار سبحا طويلا
normalizedTranslation: indeed, for you by day is prolonged occupation

arabic: وَٱذۡكُرِ ٱسۡمَ رَبِّكَ وَتَبَتَّلۡ إِلَيۡهِ تَبۡتِيلٗا
translation: And remember the name of your Lord and devote yourself to Him with [complete] devotion
normalizedArabic: واذكر اسم ربك وتبتل اليه تبتيلا
normalizedTranslation: and remember the name of your lord and devote yourself to him with [complete] devotion

arabic: رَّبُّ ٱلۡمَشۡرِقِ وَٱلۡمَغۡرِبِ لَآ إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا هُوَ فَٱتَّخِذۡهُ وَكِيلٗا
translation: [He is] the Lord of the East and the West; there is no deity except Him, so take Him as Disposer of [your] affairs
normalizedArabic: رب المشرق والمغرب لا اله الا هو فاتخذه وكيلا
normalizedTranslation: [he is] the lord of the east and the west; there is no deity except him, so take him as disposer of [your] affairs

arabic: وَٱصۡبِرۡ عَلَىٰ مَا يَقُولُونَ وَٱهۡجُرۡهُمۡ هَجۡرٗا جَمِيلٗا
translation: And be patient over what they say and avoid them with gracious avoidance
normalizedArabic: واصبر علي ما يقولون واهجرهم هجرا جميلا
normalizedTranslation: and be patient over what they say and avoid them with gracious avoidance

arabic: وَذَرۡنِي وَٱلۡمُكَذِّبِينَ أُوْلِي ٱلنَّعۡمَةِ وَمَهِّلۡهُمۡ قَلِيلًا
translation: And leave Me with [the matter of] the deniers, those of ease [in life], and allow them respite a little
normalizedArabic: وذرني والمكذبين اولي النعمه ومهلهم قليلا
normalizedTranslation: and leave me with [the matter of] the deniers, those of ease [in life], and allow them respite a little

arabic: إِنَّ لَدَيۡنَآ أَنكَالٗا وَجَحِيمٗا
translation: Indeed, with Us [for them] are shackles and burning fire
normalizedArabic: ان لدينا انكالا وجحيما
normalizedTranslation: indeed, with us [for them] are shackles and burning fire

arabic: وَطَعَامٗا ذَا غُصَّةٖ وَعَذَابًا أَلِيمٗا
translation: And food that chokes and a painful punishment
normalizedArabic: وطعاما ذا غصه وعذابا اليما
normalizedTranslation: and food that chokes and a painful punishment

arabic: يَوۡمَ تَرۡجُفُ ٱلۡأَرۡضُ وَٱلۡجِبَالُ وَكَانَتِ ٱلۡجِبَالُ كَثِيبٗا مَّهِيلًا
translation: On the Day the earth and the mountains will convulse and the mountains will become a heap of sand pouring down
normalizedArabic: يوم ترجف الارض والجبال وكانت الجبال كثيبا مهيلا
normalizedTranslation: on the day the earth and the mountains will convulse and the mountains will become a heap of sand pouring down

arabic: إِنَّآ أَرۡسَلۡنَآ إِلَيۡكُمۡ رَسُولٗا شَٰهِدًا عَلَيۡكُمۡ كَمَآ أَرۡسَلۡنَآ إِلَىٰ فِرۡعَوۡنَ رَسُولٗا
translation: Indeed, We have sent to you a Messenger as a witness upon you just as We sent to Pharaoh a messenger
normalizedArabic: انا ارسلنا اليكم رسولا شهدا عليكم كما ارسلنا الي فرعون رسولا
normalizedTranslation: indeed, we have sent to you a messenger as a witness upon you just as we sent to pharaoh a messenger

arabic: فَعَصَىٰ فِرۡعَوۡنُ ٱلرَّسُولَ فَأَخَذۡنَٰهُ أَخۡذٗا وَبِيلٗا
translation: But Pharaoh disobeyed the messenger, so We seized him with a ruinous seizure
normalizedArabic: فعصي فرعون الرسول فاخذنه اخذا وبيلا
normalizedTranslation: but pharaoh disobeyed the messenger, so we seized him with a ruinous seizure

arabic: فَكَيۡفَ تَتَّقُونَ إِن كَفَرۡتُمۡ يَوۡمٗا يَجۡعَلُ ٱلۡوِلۡدَٰنَ شِيبًا
translation: Then how can you fear, if you disbelieve, a Day that will make the children white- haired
normalizedArabic: فكيف تتقون ان كفرتم يوما يجعل الولدن شيبا
normalizedTranslation: then how can you fear, if you disbelieve, a day that will make the children white- haired

arabic: ٱلسَّمَآءُ مُنفَطِرُۢ بِهِۦۚ كَانَ وَعۡدُهُۥ مَفۡعُولًا
translation: The heaven will break apart therefrom; ever is His promise fulfilled
normalizedArabic: السماء منفطر به كان وعده مفعولا
normalizedTranslation: the heaven will break apart therefrom; ever is his promise fulfilled

arabic: إِنَّ هَٰذِهِۦ تَذۡكِرَةٞۖ فَمَن شَآءَ ٱتَّخَذَ إِلَىٰ رَبِّهِۦ سَبِيلًا
translation: Indeed, this is a reminder, so whoever wills may take to his Lord a way
normalizedArabic: ان هذه تذكره فمن شاء اتخذ الي ربه سبيلا
normalizedTranslation: indeed, this is a reminder, so whoever wills may take to his lord a way

arabic: ۞إِنَّ رَبَّكَ يَعۡلَمُ أَنَّكَ تَقُومُ أَدۡنَىٰ مِن ثُلُثَيِ ٱلَّيۡلِ وَنِصۡفَهُۥ وَثُلُثَهُۥ وَطَآئِفَةٞ مِّنَ ٱلَّذِينَ مَعَكَۚ وَٱللَّهُ يُقَدِّرُ ٱلَّيۡلَ وَٱلنَّهَارَۚ عَلِمَ أَن لَّن تُحۡصُوهُ فَتَابَ عَلَيۡكُمۡۖ فَٱقۡرَءُواْ مَا تَيَسَّرَ مِنَ ٱلۡقُرۡءَانِۚ عَلِمَ أَن سَيَكُونُ مِنكُم مَّرۡضَىٰ وَءَاخَرُونَ يَضۡرِبُونَ فِي ٱلۡأَرۡضِ يَبۡتَغُونَ مِن فَضۡلِ ٱللَّهِ وَءَاخَرُونَ يُقَٰتِلُونَ فِي سَبِيلِ ٱللَّهِۖ فَٱقۡرَءُواْ مَا تَيَسَّرَ مِنۡهُۚ وَأَقِيمُواْ ٱلصَّلَوٰةَ وَءَاتُواْ ٱلزَّكَوٰةَ وَأَقۡرِضُواْ ٱللَّهَ قَرۡضًا حَسَنٗاۚ وَمَا تُقَدِّمُواْ لِأَنفُسِكُم مِّنۡ خَيۡرٖ تَجِدُوهُ عِندَ ٱللَّهِ هُوَ خَيۡرٗا وَأَعۡظَمَ أَجۡرٗاۚ وَٱسۡتَغۡفِرُواْ ٱللَّهَۖ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ غَفُورٞ رَّحِيمُۢ
translation: Indeed, your Lord knows, [O Muhammad], that you stand [in prayer] almost two thirds of the night or half of it or a third of it, and [so do] a group of those with you. And Allah determines [the extent of] the night and the day. He has known that you [Muslims] will not be able to do it and has turned to you in forgiveness, so recite what is easy [for you] of the Qur'an. He has known that there will be among you those who are ill and others traveling throughout the land seeking [something] of the bounty of Allah and others fighting for the cause of Allah. So recite what is easy from it and establish prayer and give zakah and loan Allah a goodly loan. And whatever good you put forward for yourselves - you will find it with Allah. It is better and greater in reward. And seek forgiveness of Allah. Indeed, Allah is Forgiving and Merciful
normalizedArabic: ان ربك يعلم انك تقوم ادني من ثلثي اليل ونصفه وثلثه وطايفه من الذين معك والله يقدر اليل والنهار علم ان لن تحصوه فتاب عليكم فاقرءوا ما تيسر من القرءان علم ان سيكون منكم مرضي وءاخرون يضربون في الارض يبتغون من فضل الله وءاخرون يقتلون في سبيل الله فاقرءوا ما تيسر منه واقيموا الصلوه وءاتوا الزكوه واقرضوا الله قرضا حسنا وما تقدموا لانفسكم من خير تجدوه عند الله هو خيرا واعظم اجرا واستغفروا الله ان الله غفور رحيم
normalizedTranslation: indeed, your lord knows, [o muhammad], that you stand [in prayer] almost two thirds of the night or half of it or a third of it, and [so do] a group of those with you. and allah determines [the extent of] the night and the day. he has known that you [muslims] will not be able to do it and has turned to you in forgiveness, so recite what is easy [for you] of the qur'an. he has known that there will be among you those who are ill and others traveling throughout the land seeking [something] of the bounty of allah and others fighting for the cause of allah. so recite what is easy from it and establish prayer and give zakah and loan allah a goodly loan. and whatever good you put forward for yourselves - you will find it with allah. it is better and greater in reward. and seek forgiveness of allah. indeed, allah is forgiving and merciful

normalizedTranslation: and they give food in spite of love for it to the needy, the orphan, and the captive
